title: Parameter misspecification in physics-informed neural networks: A closed-form audit and its limits
comment: 10 pages main body, 3 figures main body, 7 pages supplementary material
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are trained to minimize the residual of a prescribed equation, so a low training loss does not indicate whether a coefficient in that equation was specified incorrectly. This study evaluates what can be inferred about the encoded parameter from the trained network alone. When the residual is linear in the parameter, written as $A - νB$, the least-squares estimate $\hatν = A^{\top}B/B^{\top}B$ is obtained from a single evaluation of the frozen network, without retraining or reference data. Its accuracy depends on how closely the network satisfies its own equation, quantified by a normalized residual $ρ$. Recovery error is associated with $ρ$ (log-log correlation 0.72 across 36 convection-diffusion networks), and empirical exponents of 0.63 to 1.20 across three equations decompose into one half plus a measurable angular term. For Burgers' equation, a single-model test based on a block-bootstrap standard error flagged 3 of 300 correctly specified networks (observed false-alarm rate 1%), all 2% misspecifications at a practical budget, and two thirds of 1% misspecifications after convergence. For the self-similar blowup rate of the Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos equation, where the rate also enters the architecture, the estimator recovers about half of the misspecification, whereas $ρ$ increases approximately quadratically and distinguishes a 0.2% error. When the incorrect rate enters both the equation and the architecture, errors of up to 2% were not detected at the precision reached. At practical budgets, the raw loss can be lower for the misspecified model, a scaling effect that $ρ$ does not share.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出仅凭已训练的PINN即可从冻结网络中估计编码参数ν：当残差关于参数线性（A−νB）时，用最小二乘估计ν̂ = AᵀB/BᵀB，无需重训练或参考数据；其误差与归一化残差ρ相关，并可用于检测方程参数设定错误。
AI.motivation: PINN以最小化方程残差为目标训练，训练损失低并不能说明方程中系数是否被正确设定，因此需要回答"仅凭训练好的网络能否推断所编码的参数、并识别参数设定错误"这一问题。
AI.method: 在残差对参数线性（A−νB）的前提下，对冻结网络做单次评估得到最小二乘估计ν̂ = AᵀB/BᵀB；以归一化残差ρ量化网络对自身方程的满足程度，通过36个对流扩散网络的log-log相关分析及三种方程的经验指数分解（1/2加可测角度项）建立误差–ρ关系；在Burgers方程上用基于block-bootstrap标准误的单模型检验判定是否误设；在Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos方程中考察参数同时进入方程与架构时的自相似爆破速率恢复情况。
AI.result: 恢复误差与ρ的log-log相关系数为0.72（36个对流扩散网络），三种方程经验指数为0.63–1.20，可分解为1/2加一可测角度项；Burgers方程中该检验在300个正确设定网络上误报3个（误报率1%），在实用预算下检出全部2%的误设，收敛后检出三分之二的1%误设；自相似爆破速率情形下估计器恢复约一半的误设量，而ρ近似二次增长、可区分0.2%的误差；当错误速率同时进入方程与架构时，精度范围内未能检出高达2%的误差。实用预算下误设模型的原始损失可能更低，而ρ不受此尺度效应影响。
AI.conclusion: 训练好的PINN冻结参数可直接用于参数估计与方程误设检测，ρ是比训练损失更可靠的诊断指标：它不受损失尺度效应影响，并能通过bootstrap标准误实现可控误报率的统计检验；但当参数进入架构时，检测能力显著下降，构成主要局限。

title: Transformers as Adaptive Kernel Learners across Tasks for In-Context Learning
summary: Transformers have emerged as a dominant architecture in modern machine learning, with in-context learning (ICL) enabling models to adapt to new tasks by conditioning on prompts, without any parameter updates. To understand the attention mechanism in transformer blocks, a growing line of theoretical work interprets ICL through the lens of classical statistical estimators. Recent works have established a connection between the attention mechanism and kernel methods, while the kernel function is usually assumed to be fixed. In practice, the query and key matrices in the attention mechanism are trained, which allows the attention mechanism to serve as an adaptive kernel method. In this work, we demonstrate that transformers can act as adaptive anisotropic kernel learners. Specifically, we study ICL for low-rank linear and multi-index nonlinear regressions, and conduct numerical simulations to show that the learned attention scores closely resemble the oracle kernels for these function classes. We then develop a general framework to analyze the generalization error of ICL by connecting transformers to the oracle kernel estimator for each function class. Our theory gives an explicit and constructive implementation of the oracle kernel estimators for these function classes using a wide and shallow transformer architecture, illustrating how the prediction is carried out by the interaction between the query token and the context tokens. Our work complements existing studies by providing numerical and theoretical evidence of how the attention mechanism adapts to anisotropic kernels in both linear and nonlinear settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明Transformer的注意力机制可视为自适应各向异性核学习器，通过对低秩线性回归与多指标非线性回归的ICL分析，给出注意力得分逼近oracle核的数值证据，并建立用宽浅Transformer实现oracle核估计器的显式构造框架，从而导出ICL泛化误差。
AI.motivation: 已有理论工作将注意力机制与核方法相联系，但通常假设核函数固定；而实际中query/key矩阵是可训练的，因此注意力应为自适应核方法。现有研究缺乏对注意力如何在线性与非线性场景下适配各向异性核的数值与理论刻画。
AI.method: 研究两类函数类上的ICL：低秩线性回归与多指标非线性回归。先通过数值模拟显示学习到的注意力得分与相应oracle核高度接近；再建立通用框架，将Transformer与各函数类的oracle核估计器相连接以分析ICL泛化误差，并给出用宽而浅的Transformer架构显式、构造性地实现这些oracle核估计器，说明预测由query token与上下文token的交互完成。
AI.result: 数值上，学习到的注意力得分与低秩线性、多指标非线性函数类的oracle核高度吻合；理论上，给出oracle核估计器的显式构造性Transformer实现，并据此得到ICL泛化误差的显式分析。
AI.conclusion: 注意力机制在训练后可自适应地形成各向异性核，Transformer可视为自适应各向异性核学习器；该工作以数值与理论证据补充了注意力在线性与非线性设定下适配各向异性核的既有研究。

title: LowNet: Looped Wavelet Neural Networks with 24 Learnable Parameters for Solving Poisson Equations
summary: Poisson equations frequently appear in various fields, such as mathematics, physics and informatics. Solving Poisson equation, however, is challenging. Traditional methods are not data-specific, although have high certainty. They require a large number of iterations due to the CFL numerical stability. In contrast, deep learning methods are data-driven and more efficient, but require accurate training data and suffer from heavy computation. To tackle these issues, we propose a wavelet-inspired Poisson solver with 24 trainable scalars. The proposed network has several advantages. First, it is compact. It has four independent $5\times5$ kernels, each represented by six parameters, leading to 24 scalars in total. Such compact format can be deployed on most devices. Second, thanks to the loop design, it achieves higher accuracy than previous methods. A residual loop reuses the wavelet block without increasing its parameters. Numerical experiments confirm that such loop indeed improves the solving accuracy. On 10000 images, one, two, and three loops of the wavelet block lead to PSNRs of $47.27$, $74.14$, and $100.74$ dB, respectively. Third, the proposed method is computationally fast. Thanks to the wavelet transform, the proposed method has linear computation complexity, leading to high computation performance. In short, we propose a novel looped wavelet neural network with compactness, accuracy and efficiency for solving Poisson equations. Our method can be applied in various fields, such as computational fluid dynamics, image reconstruction, biomedical engineering, electromagnetic field simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种受小波启发的泊松方程求解器，仅含24个可训练标量（4个独立的5×5卷积核，每个由6个参数表示），并采用残差循环复用同一小波块以在不增加参数的情况下提升精度，实现线性复杂度的高效求解。
AI.motivation: 传统数值方法确定性高但非数据定制，受CFL稳定性约束需大量迭代；深度学习方法虽数据驱动且高效，却依赖精确训练数据且计算开销大。因此需要一个兼具紧凑性、准确性与高效性的求解方案。
AI.method: 构建受小波变换启发的小波神经网络：4个独立5×5卷积核，每核6个参数，共24个可训练标量；采用残差循环结构反复复用同一小波块，参数不增；借助小波变换获得线性计算复杂度。
AI.result: 在10000张图像上，小波块循环1、2、3次分别达到PSNR 47.27、74.14、100.74 dB，验证循环结构确实提升求解精度；方法计算快、复杂度线性，模型紧凑可部署于多数设备。
AI.conclusion: 该循环小波神经网络以极简参数实现高精度、高效率的泊松方程求解，可应用于计算流体力学、图像重建、生物医学工程、电磁场仿真等领域。

title: When Does Evidence-Graph Structure Predict Answer Correctness? Label-Free Abstention for Structured Retrieval
comment: 34 pages, 5 figures, 37 tables. Under review at ACM Transactions on Information Systems
summary: Retrieval systems return scored answers, but a high score does not show that an answer should be trusted. The proposed training-free abstention method applies the boundary cut to the selected evidence in an evidence graph. The signal is the weighted cut between selected and unselected candidates and requires no correctness labels or confidence-model training. On MemoryAgentBench (MAB) FactConsolidation multi-hop, with unresolved queries ranked last for every selector, it raises area under the precision-coverage curve from 0.736 for the best score baseline to 0.785 (+0.049, 95% CI [+0.008, +0.092]); under the native evaluation, where score baselines keep their unresolved values, the gap is +0.108. A zero-cut subset contains 71 of 400 queries at 100% observed precision. In this pipeline, the subset corresponds to structural closure; controlled analyses attribute much of the remaining separation to resolution status, with little benefit from continuous edge weights. Across external benchmarks, usefulness varies with graph construction, edge semantics, and relation; typed structure alone does not ensure useful confidence. A supervised gradient-boosted selector achieves 0.814 versus the boundary cut's 0.785 when the retrieval stack matches. These findings provide empirical guidance for using available evidence graphs for lightweight, auditable post-retrieval abstention without additional model inference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的弃答方法：在证据图上对选中证据做边界割，以选中与未选中候选间的加权割作为可信度信号，无需正确性标签或置信模型训练，在MAB多跳任务上将精确率-覆盖率曲线下面积由0.736提升至0.785。
AI.motivation: 检索系统给出的高分并不代表答案可信，分数高低无法反映答案是否应被采信，因此需要一种后检索阶段的轻量、可审计弃答机制，且不希望依赖正确性标签或额外置信模型训练。
AI.method: 无需训练的边界割方法：在证据图中对已选证据计算其与未选候选之间的加权割作为弃答信号；在MAB FactConsolidation多跳任务上，对每个选择器将未解析查询排在最后评估，另做原生评估设置；并进行零割子集分析、受控消融（分辨率状态、连续边权）以及跨外部基准的图构建、边语义与关系类型分析，并与监督式梯度提升选择器对比。
AI.result: AUC由最优分数基线0.736升至0.785（+0.049，95% CI [+0.008, +0.092]）；原生评估下差距为+0.108；零割子集含400个查询中的71个，观测精确率100%，对应结构闭合；受控分析显示剩余区分度多归因于解析状态，连续边权收益甚微；外部基准上效用随图构建、边语义与关系变化，仅有类型化结构不足以保证有用置信度；检索栈匹配时监督梯度提升选择器为0.814，优于边界割的0.785。
AI.conclusion: 证据图边界割可为后检索弃答提供轻量、可审计且无需额外模型推理的经验性方案，但其效用依赖于图构建质量与边语义，并存在监督方法的性能上限差距。

title: Agentic Interpretation: Harness-Governed Evidence Construction for Software Agents
summary:
Software agents answer behavioral questions about code, such as whether a patch passes tests or which lines caused a failure. These tasks require repository-wide evidence, yet most scaffolds leave intermediate findings in free-form trajectories, making them hard to reuse and easy to disconnect from final answers. We present Agentic Interpretation (AgInt), a framework for harness-governed evidence construction. The model proposes typed records, while a deterministic harness admits, grades, and persists them, reports unresolved requirements, and licenses answers under task-specific rules. The resulting certificate gives the model persistent external state and leaves an auditable decision record. Formally, append-only certificate states form a grounding lattice ordered by record inclusion, where each admitted record extends the state by union.
  We evaluate AgInt with four models on SWE-bench-Live and DeepSWE for patch acceptance and Defects4J and GitBug-Java for fault localization. AgInt outperforms the plain agent and Agentic Code Reasoning on all reported patch-acceptance metrics and ranks responsible lines higher while inspecting fewer irrelevant lines in fault localization. For GLM-5, reject-class F1 rises from 0.256 to 0.543 on SWE-bench-Live, All@1 rises from 0.140 to 0.400 on Defects4J, and wasted inspected lines fall from 31.5 to 11.7 on GitBug-Java. A matched-template control separates the mechanism: the persistent scaffold drives most fault-localization gains, while the certificate body and gate govern patch-acceptance calibration. With execution licensed, AgInt produces harness-reproduced witnesses for 293 of 475 null-dereference candidates versus 253 for a matched shell agent, and 62 of 117 resource-leak candidates versus 58. Across reported efficiency measurements, it uses 35% fewer executions and reduces cost per candidate by 59%.

AI.tldr: AgInt 是一个由确定性 harness 治理的“证据构造”框架：模型提议类型化记录，harness 负责准入、评分、持久化并授权回答，形成可审计的证书状态（按记录包含关系构成 grounding 格）。在补丁验收与故障定位任务上优于普通 agent 与 Agentic Code Reasoning。
AI.motivation: 代码行为类问题（补丁是否通过测试、哪几行导致失败）需要全仓库证据，但现有 scaffold 多将中间发现留在自由形式的轨迹里，难以复用、易与最终答案脱节。
AI.method: 提出 Agentic Interpretation（AgInt）：模型提议 typed records，确定性 harness 对其准入、评分、持久化，报告未满足的需求，并在任务特定规则下许可回答；证书为模型提供持久外部状态与可审计决策记录。形式上，append-only 证书状态按记录包含序构成 grounding lattice，每条准入记录以并集方式扩展状态。实验覆盖 SWE-bench-Live、DeepSWE（补丁验收）与 Defects4J、GitBug-Java（故障定位），四模型；并设 matched-template 对照以分离机制贡献。
AI.result: 全部报告指标上优于 plain agent 与 Agentic Code Reasoning；故障定位中排名更准且检查更少无关行。GLM-5：SWE-bench-Live reject-class F1 0.256→0.543，Defects4J All@1 0.140→0.400，GitBug-Java 浪费检查行 31.5→11.7。对照显示：持久化 scaffold 主要驱动故障定位增益，证书主体与 gate 主导补丁验收校准。执行许可下，空指针候选复现 witness 293/475（对照 shell agent 253），资源泄漏 62/117（对照 58）；执行次数减少 35%，单候选成本降低 59%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、可审计的外部证据状态比自由形式轨迹更有效，且不同组件贡献可分离：持久化结构利于定位，证书与门控利于验收校准，整体兼顾效果与成本效率。

title: GardenBench: A lightweight, daily evaluation of LLM capabilities
summary: We introduce GardenBench, a benchmark with 11 test suites that evaluate the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a range of tasks. By systematically prompting LLMs with various lightweight queries, we document day-to-day changes in model performance, including run costs and times, that other benchmarks miss. This allows us to compare the accuracy and features of responses across model providers and versions. We account for daily variations in model accuracy, capturing both model progress and degradation, for instance, when a model is changed post-deployment or when a new model is released. We base our evaluation on general-use tasks and make our results publicly accessible via a live dashboard, diversifying existing approaches to LLM testing. Our main contribution is an innovative, lightweight, and inexpensive benchmark, designed to be consumer-facing and for everyday tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出GardenBench——一个含11个测试套件的轻量级、低成本、面向消费者的LLM基准，通过日常轻量查询记录模型性能的逐日变化（含运行成本与耗时），以捕捉模型上线后变更或新版本发布带来的进步与退化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准多侧重静态、单次评测，缺乏对模型性能逐日波动的追踪，难以反映模型上线后变更、版本迭代带来的精度变化、退化及运行成本/耗时等日常可用性信息。
AI.method: 构建GardenBench基准，包含11个测试套件，覆盖一系列通用型及日常任务；用多样化的轻量查询系统性提示LLM，记录准确率、运行成本与运行时间，并跨模型提供商与版本进行比较；同时刻画模型准确率的日间变化，公开结果并以实时仪表盘呈现。
AI.result: 可记录模型的逐日性能变化，捕捉模型进步的退化（如部署后模型被替换或新模型发布），并在准确率与响应特性维度上横向比较不同提供商和版本，同时提供公开可访问的实时仪表盘结果。
AI.conclusion: GardenBench是一种创新、轻量、低成本的基准，面向消费者与日常任务，补充并多样化了现有LLM评测方法，为持续监测模型表现提供了可行方案。

title: Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 5th International Conference on Big Data, Information and Computer Network (BDICN 2026); proceedings published by ACM ICPS
summary:
Intelligent agent interactions in real-world web environments are commonly constrained by request budgets, time delays, anti-crawling restrictions, and operational failure risks. Strategies solely optimizing task success rates often exhibit unusable phenomena such as "high success but high cost" or "low risk but conservative failure." This paper proposes a constrained agentic reinforcement learning model for web agents, unifying page access, search requests, and external API calls into a unified long-term decision-making framework with associated costs. It simultaneously incorporates cost budget constraints and tail risk control into the optimization objective: constructing a multidimensional cost vector comprising cumulative request count, total latency, and failure penalties to achieve budget compliance via Lagrange dual updates, while employing a CVaR risk term to suppress excessive exploration of high-failure-probability paths, thereby achieving an adaptive balance among "completion rate, cost, and risk."
  Experiments were conducted across 30-70 site/page templates and 800-1,500 end-to-end web tasks, including information extraction, price comparison, form submission, and cross-page navigation. Interaction sequences spanned 20-120 steps with tool scales of 30-200. Performance was benchmarked against unconstrained RL, budget-constrained RL, and rule-based/scripted web agents, quantifying task completion rates, cost-per-success, failure rates, and policy stability.
  Results demonstrate that at equivalent completion rates, our method reduces C-PS by 22%-31% and lowers failure rates by 18%-26% under high failure penalties. Under fixed budgets, task completion rates increase by 10%-16%, highlighting the necessity and effectiveness of constraint modeling for practical web agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向Web智能体的约束型智能体强化学习模型，将页面访问、搜索请求与外部API调用统一为带成本的长期决策框架，并同时引入成本预算约束（拉格朗日对偶）与CVaR尾部风险控制，实现"完成率—成本—风险"的自适应平衡。实验显示在同完成率下C-PS降低22%–31%、失败率降低18%–26%，固定预算下完成率提升10%–16%。
AI.motivation: 真实Web环境中的智能体受请求预算、时延、反爬限制与操作失败风险约束；仅优化任务成功率的策略常出现"高成功高成本"或"低风险但保守失败"的不可用现象，缺少对成本与风险的显式建模。
AI.method: 构建约束型智能体强化学习模型：将页面访问、搜索请求、外部API调用统一为带成本的长期决策；构造由累计请求数、总时延、失败惩罚组成的多维成本向量，通过拉格朗日对偶更新实现预算合规；引入CVaR风险项抑制对高失败概率路径的过度探索。
AI.result: 在30–70个站点/页面模板、800–1500个端到端Web任务（信息抽取、比价、表单提交、跨页导航）上，交互序列20–120步、工具规模30–200；对比无约束RL、预算约束RL及规则/脚本型智能体。同完成率下C-PS降低22%–31%，高失败惩罚下失败率降低18%–26%；固定预算下完成率提升10%–16%。
AI.conclusion: 约束建模对Web智能体的实际部署具有必要性与有效性，能够在不牺牲完成率的前提下显著降低单次成功成本与失败风险，并在预算受限时提升任务完成率。

title: Location, Location, Generation: Where You Ask Matters for Generative Engine Optimization
summary: Generative search engines answer local and commercial questions with a written answer and a few cited sources. A growing practice of generative engine optimization (GEO) monitors which sources and brands these answers show, typically from a single place. In this paper, we present a controlled audit of how the user's location changes the sources that generative engines cite. We ask 300 questions of ChatGPT with 19 declared locations, and of ChatGPT and Gemini from five network locations, each twice to measure run-to-run noise (31,200 answers). The engines take location from different channels. ChatGPT follows the location an application declares, down to the city: it writes the place into its own searches, and its search backend localizes results even when the queries name no place. It ignores the network. Gemini ignores the declared location and follows the country of the network, changing most of its sources even for questions that do not depend on place. The businesses the answers recommend change with the sources. Thus, visibility in generative search is specific to the user's location, and audits must control both channels.

AI.tldr: 本文对生成式引擎引用的来源如何随用户地理位置变化进行了受控审计，发现ChatGPT依据应用声明的位置（精确到城市）进行本地化，而Gemini依据网络所在国家进行本地化，且推荐商家随来源改变，因此生成式搜索的可见性具有位置特异性，审计需同时控制两种位置渠道。
AI.motivation: 生成式引擎优化（GEO）实践日益增长，但其监测通常只在单一地点进行，忽略了用户位置可能影响引擎引用的来源与品牌，缺乏对位置因素的系统性控制研究。
AI.method: 提出受控审计方法：对300个问题，在19个声明位置下查询ChatGPT，并在5个网络位置下分别查询ChatGPT与Gemini，每个条件重复两次以测量运行间噪声，共获得31,200条回答。
AI.result: ChatGPT通过应用声明的位置（精确到城市）进行本地化：将地点写入自身搜索查询，且其搜索后端即使查询未提及地点也会本地化结果，同时忽略网络位置；Gemini则忽略声明位置，遵循网络所在国家，即使在非地点相关问题中也会改变大部分引用来源；回答推荐的商家随来源变化。
AI.conclusion: 生成式搜索中的可见性具有用户位置特异性，不同引擎从不同渠道获取位置信息，因此GEO与引用审计必须同时控制声明位置与网络位置两种渠道。

title: Does AI-Assisted Development Homogenize Software? An Empirical Study of Code Similarity, Quality, and Evolution
summary: AI-assisted software development is evolving from interactive LLM assistance toward agentic systems that autonomously perform software engineering tasks, yet the effects of this shift remain insufficiently understood. We present an empirical study of 50 long-lived Java and Python open-source projects across three eras: pre-LLM, potentially LLM-assisted, and detected agentic development. Using snapshots from Software Heritage, we examine code similarity, software quality, and software evolution. Similarity is measured semantically through embedding-based cosine similarity and syntactically through CodeBLEU*. Quality is assessed with SonarQube metrics covering maintainability, complexity, reliability, and security. Evolution is characterized by annualized growth rates of LOC, functions, classes, files, and statements, and by commit activity in the three months preceding each snapshot. Results show no consistent evidence of increased similarity as semantic and syntactic similarity decreased significantly in Java for both the LLM and agentic eras relative to the pre-LLM era, while Python showed no significant differences. Software quality remained largely stable, although the agentic era showed significantly lower code-smell and SQALE index densities. Structural growth was generally lower in the agentic era, particularly for files, whereas development activity increased moderately in Java, especially in commits and added lines. These findings challenge the assumption that LLM- and agent-assisted development necessarily homogenizes code, degrades quality, or accelerates growth.

AI.tldr: 对50个Java/Python开源项目在LLM前、LLM辅助、Agent时代三阶段的实证研究发现：代码相似度未上升（Java显著下降），质量基本稳定（Agent时代代码异味与SQALE密度更低），结构性增长放缓但Java开发活动增加。
AI.motivation: AI辅助软件开发正从交互式LLM辅助转向自主执行工程任务的agentic系统，但这一转变的实际影响（是否导致代码同质化、质量下降、增长加速）尚缺乏实证证据。
AI.method: 基于Software Heritage快照，选取50个长期活跃的Java与Python开源项目，划分三个时代（pre-LLM、potentially LLM-assisted、detected agentic）。相似度用嵌入余弦相似度（语义）与CodeBLEU*（语法）度量；质量用SonarQube的可维护性、复杂度、可靠性、安全性指标；演化用LOC、函数、类、文件、语句的年化增长率及快照前三个月提交活动刻画。
AI.result: 语义与语法相似度在Java的LLM与Agent时代相对pre-LLM均显著下降，Python无显著差异；质量总体稳定，Agent时代代码异味密度与SQALE指数密度显著更低；结构性增长普遍放缓（尤其文件数），而Java开发活动温和上升（提交数与新增行数）。
AI.conclusion: 研究否定了LLM与Agent辅助开发必然导致代码同质化、质量退化或加速增长的假设，提示需以实证而非直觉评估AI对软件工程的影响。

title: Doing Less with More: A First-Principles Exploration of the Suitability of Agentic Computing over Alternative Architectural Choices
comment: Accepted to AAAI Fall Symposium - Trustworthy Agentic Systems (https://tas2026.github.io/accepted/) 8 pages, 3 figures
summary:
There is growing interest in automating business activities with Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to latter's seeming ease of use. Never has it been easier, or costlier, to do less with more. However, little is known about when agents are preferable to established alternatives such as local computation, Representational State Transfer (REST), the Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), particularly when development speed, performance, and operational cost are considered. We investigate this question using a controlled mathematical task that compares seven methods on a benchmark of 1,000 arithmetic expressions where semantics of operator precedence has to be preserved. We ran this setup across a native Function Calling baseline (Python library), REST, SOAP and MCP microservice architectures, direct responses from large language models (LLMs) using a Groq cloud API and five locally deployed Ollama models, and agentic systems in which five local LLMs invoke MCP tools. The deterministic methods achieve 100% accuracy with negligible latency. Direct LLM evaluation achieves at most 92.9% accuracy at over 22,000x the latency of a native function call. With MCP tools, the best agent reaches 99.9% accuracy, but incurs nearly 1,000,000x the baseline latency. These results demonstrate that LLMs approaches are poorly suited for exact arithmetic evaluation and motivate an informed architectural decision framework (ADF) for choosing an architecture based on accuracy and throughput requirements. We recognize that an actual interaction with an agent may span both reasoning and linguistic tasks. Hence our recommendation is to explore multiple architectural choices (based on task type) rather than one-size-fits-all solution (LLMs).
  Code is available at - https://github.com/Ritvik-G/adf/

AI.tldr: 该文用可控算术任务对比7类方法（原生函数调用/Python库、REST、SOAP、MCP微服务、直接LLM响应、本地LLM经MCP调用工具），发现确定性方法100%准确且延迟可忽略，直接LLM最多92.9%精度但延迟>22000倍，最佳Agent达99.9%但延迟近百万倍，据此提出基于准确率与吞吐的架构决策框架（ADF）。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI看似易用，引发自动化业务活动的热潮，但缺乏证据说明何时应优先采用Agent而非既有成熟方案（本地计算、REST、SOAP、MCP），尤其在开发速度、性能与运营成本维度上。作者希望量化比较，避免"用更多资源做更少事"的误区。
AI.method: 构建1,000条需保持运算符优先级语义的算术表达式基准，对7种方法进行受控对比：原生Function Calling（Python库）基线、REST、SOAP、MCP微服务架构、Groq云API的LLM直接作答、5个本地Ollama模型直接作答，以及5个本地LLM通过MCP工具调用的Agent系统；测量准确率与延迟。
AI.result: 确定性方法准确率100%、延迟可忽略；直接LLM评估最高92.9%准确率，延迟为原生函数调用的22,000倍以上；Agent调用MCP工具时最佳模型达99.9%准确率，但延迟接近基线的1,000,000倍。
AI.conclusion: LLM方法不适合精确算术求值；作者提出架构决策框架（ADF），依据准确率与吞吐需求选择架构，并建议按任务类型（推理型与语言型）探索多种架构组合，而非采用LLM"一刀切"方案。

title: PolyGraph: Plan-Buffered CUDA Graphs for Adaptive Speculative Decoding
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Trace-driven prototype evaluated on NVIDIA H800
summary: Adaptive speculative decoding changes the active batch size B and draft length d from one decode step to the next, whereas a CUDA Graph replays a fixed launch configuration. The resulting verification width M = B d forces serving systems to pre-capture many shapes, capture new ones on the serving path, or pad every step to the largest draft. We present PolyGraph, a plan-buffer mechanism for custom Triton kernels that avoids this choice. PolyGraph captures one maximum-grid graph and writes the active shape to GPU memory before each replay. Kernels skip tiles beyond that shape, while graph topology, allocations, layouts, pointers, and launch grids remain fixed; the update transfers only 28 bytes. On one NVIDIA H800, a trace-driven prototype with Qwen2.5-3B dimensions replaces 64 shape-specific graphs with one, matches the warmed baseline in observed step latency (17.7 vs. 17.8 ms P50), and reduces measured pre-serving graph-build time from 3,915 to 93 ms. Fixed-draft controls show that the benefit comes from avoiding padded payload: the P99 difference from MaxPad is negligible at zero padding waste but reaches an 18.7% reduction at 100% waste. Our evidence establishes a bounded work-shape mechanism for custom kernels, not a production serving system, and is limited to synthetic traces on one GPU.

AI.tldr: PolyGraph 用"计划缓冲"机制让单个最大网格 CUDA Graph 支持自适应投机解码的动态形状：每次重放前只向 GPU 写入 28 字节的有效形状，自定义 Triton kernel 据此跳过超范围 tile。
AI.motivation: 自适应投机解码每步都会改变活跃批大小 B 与草稿长度 d，验证宽度 M = B·d 随之变化；而 CUDA Graph 只能重放固定启动配置，迫使服务系统预捕获大量形状、在服务路径上现捕图，或把每步填充到最大草稿长度。三者均代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出 PolyGraph：面向自定义 Triton kernel 的计划缓冲机制。仅捕获一个最大网格图，重放前把有效形状写入 GPU 内存（28 字节传输）；kernel 跳过超出该形状的 tile，同时图拓扑、显存分配、布局、指针与启动网格全部保持不变。在单张 NVIDIA H800 上以 Qwen2.5-3B 维度构建 trace 驱动原型，并与固定草稿长度（含 MaxPad）对照。
AI.result: 以 1 个图替代 64 个形状专用图；观测步时延与预热基线相当（P50 17.7 vs 17.8 ms）；预服务建图时间从 3,915 ms 降至 93 ms。固定草稿对照显示收益来自避免填充负载：零填充浪费时相对 MaxPad 的 P99 差异可忽略，100% 浪费时 P99 降低 18.7%。
AI.conclusion: PolyGraph 为自定义 kernel 建立了有界工作形状机制，而非生产级服务系统；结论受限于单 GPU 上的合成 trace。

title: Candidate-dependent residual routing trades top-of-list accuracy for recall in sequential recommendation
comment: 33 pages, 3 figures. Includes 18 pages of Supplemental Information with 18 supplementary tables
summary: Candidate-dependent routing lets a sequential recommender weight a user's past behaviors differently for each item it scores. We test whether this flexibility helps by adding a small residual routing module to a self-attentive baseline, in two versions that differ only in what sets the routing weights: the user's history representation or the candidate item's embedding. Across five paired seeds on the REES46 cosmetics-shop dataset, with matched training for all three models, candidate-dependent routing leaves the primary metric, normalized discounted cumulative gain at cutoff ten (NDCG@10), essentially unchanged (mean relative change +0.003%). Secondary and exploratory analyses show that this flat average hides two effects that cancel. The candidate-dependent model places more relevant items in its top ten (recall +1.81%) but ranks the first one lower (mean reciprocal rank -1.09%), and most of its new hits land at positions six to ten. Its gains come from queries with at least one target among the user's last 50 events, while queries whose targets all lie outside that window get worse. In this form, candidate-dependent routing trades accuracy at the top of the list for recall further down.

AI.tldr: 在REES46数据集上，给自注意力序列推荐基线加入小型残差候选依赖路由模块后，NDCG@10几乎不变（+0.003%）；这种平均持平掩盖了召回提升（+1.81%）与首位排序下降（MRR -1.09%）的相互抵消。
AI.motivation: 检验候选依赖路由（对每个待打分物品以不同方式加权用户历史行为）这一灵活机制是否真能提升序列推荐效果，并将其与仅由用户历史表示设定权重的对照版本区分开。
AI.method: 在自注意力序列推荐基线上增加小型残差路由模块，设置两个仅路由权重来源不同的版本：用户历史表示 vs. 候选物品嵌入；在REES46化妆品店数据集上以五个配对随机种子、三模型匹配训练进行对照实验，并做次级与探索性分析。
AI.result: 主指标NDCG@10基本不变（平均相对变化+0.003%）；召回率+1.81%，MRR -1.09%；新增命中多落在第6–10位；增益集中于目标物品出现在用户最近50个事件中的查询，目标全在该窗口外的查询反而变差。
AI.conclusion: 在该实现形式下，候选依赖路由以牺牲列表顶部精度换取更靠后位置的召回，整体收益中性。

title: Towards an Intelligent Decision Engine for Smart Contract Deployment
comment: Accepted for the 30th IEEE International Conference on System Theory, Control and Computing, ICSTCC 2026; Copyright is with IEEE
summary: Layer 2 (L2) blockchain solutions emerged in recent years, predominantly in the Ethereum ecosystem, as a viable option for scaling a main blockchain network (L1). However, the selection of a L2 solution for deploying smart contracts backing blockchain applications is a decision that depends on many factors, such as costs, efficiency, popularity, and stability. We propose here a systematic methodology to help with this decision making process by using a set of relevant metrics and introducing user-defined profiles that capture different priorities among these metrics. We collect the major categories of smart contracts from a community-maintained data source, and we gather transactions for a six months period from three major L2 solutions: Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base. For each contract category and each blockchain, we compute a set of metrics and scores tailored to each user profile. By applying our methodology, we identify a clear bias in the classification, showing which L2 solutions are better suited for particular application types and user profiles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套系统化方法论，通过一组相关指标和用户自定义偏好档案（profile），帮助开发者在其L2方案选择（Arbitrum、Optimism、Base）上做决策，并基于六大类智能合约的半年交易数据给出评分。
AI.motivation: 以太坊等L1的扩容需求催生了众多L2方案，但对支撑区块链应用的智能合约而言，选择哪条L2取决于成本、效率、流行度、稳定性等诸多因素，缺乏可复现、可比较的决策依据。
AI.method: 从社区维护的数据源抽取主要智能合约类别；采集Arbitrum、Optimism、Base三条L2在六个月内的交易数据；按合约类别与链分别计算一组指标，并引入反映不同优先级（costs、efficiency、popularity、stability）的用户自定义profile，据此计算评分。
AI.result: 应用该流程后，发现分类结果存在明显偏向性（clear bias），可明确辨识出哪些L2方案更适合特定应用类型与特定用户profile。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法论可操作、可复现，能将抽象的多因素权衡转化为按应用类别与用户偏好量化的L2选型结论，为智能合约部署的链选择提供依据。

title: A Controlled LLM Workflow for Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis of Risk Score Differences
comment: Accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering Researches (ICECER 2026), December 3-5, 2026
summary: We propose a controlled Large Language Model (LLM) workflow for explaining risk score differences using similar historical transactions. The workflow combines reference retrieval and contrastive SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) evidence with reference-based LLM reasoning and deterministic validation. Experiments on a test dataset show that the workflow produces more consistent, evidence-grounded and traceable diagnoses than the same LLM without structured workflow guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受控LLM工作流，结合相似历史交易检索、对比SHAP证据、基于参照的LLM推理与确定性校验，用于解释风险评分差异，并较无结构化引导的LLM产生更一致、有证据支撑、可追溯的诊断。
AI.motivation: 风险评分差异的解释需要一致、可溯源且基于证据的说明，而直接使用LLM缺乏结构化约束，易产生不一致或缺乏依据的诊断。
AI.method: 构建受控LLM工作流：①检索相似历史交易作为参照；②引入对比式SHAP（contrastive SHAP）证据；③进行基于参照的LLM推理；④采用确定性验证（deterministic validation）对输出进行校验约束。
AI.result: 在测试数据集上的实验表明，相比无结构化工作流引导的同一LLM，该工作流生成的诊断更一致、更具证据基础、更可追溯。
AI.conclusion: 通过检索+对比SHAP证据+参照式推理+确定性校验的组合设计，可有效提升LLM在风险评分差异解释任务中的可靠性；但摘要未给出定量指标与消融细节。

title: Forecasting Patient Trajectories from the Electronic Health Records with Action-Conditioned World Models
summary: We introduce a predictive world model for electronic health records (EHR) that represents patient histories as action conditioned latent trajectories. Rather than modeling clinical events solely through autoregressive token prediction, our framework explicitly separates patient states from observed clinical actions and learns their evolution through a state and action conditioned transition operator. At its core is a state dependent linearization predictor that propagates local changes in latent patient state, enabling time resolved prediction, multi step rollout, and action conditioned simulation. Empirically, we show that generated latent trajectories preserve downstream predictive signal, temporal structure, and subgroup level statistical relationships present in encoder derived representations. We further decode free running rollouts into the original clinical feature space and evaluate future clinical measurements against observed values using task matched forecasting baselines, demonstrating that the learned dynamics retain predictive information beyond latent space agreement. Across binary classification and time to event tasks, EHR WM achieves competitive, though task dependent, performance relative to substantially larger EHR foundation models while using a 30x smaller parameter footprint. Finally, perturbing observed action sequences produces corresponding changes in generated trajectories, demonstrating the action sensitivity of the learned dynamics. Together, these results support world modeling as a complementary framework for learning explicit, time indexed representations of patient evolution from longitudinal EHR.

AI.tldr: 提出EHR世界模型（EHR WM），将患者病史表示为动作条件化的隐轨迹，通过状态-动作条件转移算子学习其演化，参数量仅为大型EHR基础模型的1/30却取得有竞争力的下游性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多以自回归token预测建模临床事件，缺乏对"患者状态"与"临床动作（干预/观测）"的显式分离，难以支持时间分辨预测、多步推演与动作条件模拟。
AI.method: 构建预测式世界模型：显式分离潜在患者状态与观测到的临床动作，核心为状态相关的线性化预测器（state-dependent linearization predictor），传播潜在状态的局部变化，实现时间分辨预测、多步rollout与动作条件仿真；并将自由运行rollout解码回原始临床特征空间评估。
AI.result: 生成的隐轨迹保留了下游预测信号、时间结构及编码器表示中的亚组统计关系；解码后的未来临床测量在任务匹配的预测基线下仍具预测信息；在二分类与时间-事件任务上，以30倍更小的参数规模取得与大型EHR基础模型相当（任务依赖）的性能；扰动动作序列可引起轨迹相应变化，验证动作敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型可作为从纵向EHR学习显式、时间索引的患者演化表示的互补框架。

title: Optimal Fusion Weights Form Intervals, Not Points: A Latency-Aware Study of Query-Adaptive WRRF
summary: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) is widely used to combine sparse and dense retrievers in hybrid information retrieval, but a critical limitation is that it assigns a fixed, uniform weight to each retriever regardless of the query. Query-aware methods treat the per-query optimal weight as a single point, an assumption whose empirical validity has not been examined. We present an empirical study of eight dynamic fusion weight prediction strategies across four datasets and four sparse--dense retriever pairs. When we compare these approaches to static fusion and a per-query oracle that bounds achievable performance, several findings emerge. First, the per-query optimal fusion weight is typically an interval rather than a point. Queries can have multiple optimal intervals, and these can take on a variety of shapes. Second, 74 of 128 dynamic fusion methods tested were significantly better than standard RRF after false discovery rate correction. Third, dynamic fusion methods exhibit differing quality and latency characteristics that should be considered when choosing an appropriate fusion method. To address this last finding, we present a tiered decision framework that maps practitioner constraints, dataset properties, label availability, hardware, and latency budget to an appropriate method class. We release the code for our experiments at https://github.com/thomsonreuters/query-based-rrf.

AI.tldr: 本文对混合检索中的查询感知融合权重预测进行实证研究：证明每查询最优权重实为区间而非单点，并在128个动态融合配置中有74个经FDR校正后显著优于标准RRF，进而提出分层选型决策框架。
AI.motivation: RRF在稀疏-稠密混合检索中给每个检索器分配固定统一权重，无法随查询变化；现有查询感知方法隐含"每查询最优权重是单一最优点"的假设，但该假设的经验有效性从未被检验。
AI.method: 在4个数据集、4组稀疏-稠密检索器组合上系统评估8种动态融合权重预测策略，共128个配置；与静态融合及每查询oracle（性能上界）对比，并做FDR多重检验校正；基于质量与延迟特征，构建将实践约束、数据属性、标签可得性、硬件与延迟预算映射到方法类的分层决策框架。
AI.result: 每查询最优融合权重通常呈区间而非点，且查询可拥有多个形状各异的区间；128个动态融合配置中74个在FDR校正后显著优于标准RRF；各动态融合方法在效果与延迟上存在明显差异，需按场景取舍。
AI.conclusion: "单点最优权重"假设不成立，区间化视角更贴合实际；动态融合整体可超越RRF但收益依赖配置与查询特性；实践者应依据约束条件通过分层框架选择方法类，而非默认RRF或单一动态方案。

title: Pattern-Based Precondition Inference from Method Implementations
summary: Method preconditions define the conditions that must be satisfied before a method is called. Often, such conditions are not documented and must be inferred. We present Prex, a pattern-based static analysis approach that infers preconditions from explicit checks in Java source code. For each precondition, Prex reports the condition required for a valid call and the reported exception in the case of a violation. Prex also attempts code transformations to convert the condition detected within a method's implementation into an expression that can be evaluated by client code. It leverages the concept of a mutation boundary to separate precondition checks from exceptions that may occur after the method changes the program state. We evaluated Prex from 46 open source Java projects and manually reviewed independent samples of 150 reports. Among the 150 Prex reports, 149 were correct and 125 of the correct reports were executable by client code. In a systematic comparison with an alternative approach based on path expansion, Prex provided more precise results. In total, 122 of the 149 correct reports had no relevant method documentation, and 41 required nontrivial source code analysis to recover manually. Overall, explicit source-code checks provide precondition information that can be absent from method documentation, and Prex can help recover it.

AI.tldr: Prex 是一种基于模式的静态分析技术，通过 Java 源码中的显式检查推断方法前置条件，报告有效调用所需条件及违反时的异常，并借助变异边界区分前置条件检查与状态改变后的异常。
AI.motivation: 方法前置条件常未被文档化，需要推断；显式源码检查中含有的前置条件信息可能在文档中缺失，需要自动化工具帮助恢复。
AI.method: 基于模式的静态分析：从 Java 源码的显式检查中推断前置条件；对每个前置条件报告有效调用所需条件及违反时抛出的异常；尝试代码变换将方法实现内检测到的条件转换为客户端可求值的表达式；利用变异边界(mutation boundary)概念将前置条件检查与方法改变程序状态后可能出现的异常分离。
AI.result: 在46个开源 Java 项目上评估，人工审阅150条独立抽样报告：149条正确，其中125条可由客户端代码执行；与基于路径扩展的替代方法系统比较，Prex 结果更精确；149条正确报告中122条无相关方法文档，41条需非平凡源码分析才能人工恢复。
AI.conclusion: 显式源码检查可提供方法文档中缺失的前置条件信息，Prex 能有效帮助恢复此类前置条件。

title: What Social Media Teaches Us About Accumulative AI Risks
comment: Camera-ready version for CogMI 2026 vision track
summary: Prominent AI safety discussions emphasize existential threats and catastrophic events, such as AI-enabled nuclear conflict or engineered biological outbreaks. This position paper argues that there is another type of AI risk that arises and accumulates from the widespread use of AI. Drawing on lessons from social media, we argue that safety assessments must also address accumulative harms that develop through repeated use, recurring decisions, and feedback across interconnected deployments. Repeated reassurance, selective exposure, recurring decision biases, and growing personal profiles may gradually narrow perspectives, weaken independent judgment, or enable exploitative influence without a single clearly harmful event. We advance the Trajectory Neglect Thesis: a focus on vivid catastrophic events and identifiable incidents risks overlooking less visible harms that accumulate through the widespread daily use of AI. Social media research motivates this position by showing how reciprocal media effects, social reinforcement, and individual susceptibility shape outcomes beyond individual encounters. We examine how related mechanisms may operate in AI systems, using conversational AI as a concrete setting where generation, semantic inference, and persistent memory may tighten feedback loops. Sycophancy, manipulation, and privacy loss provide a case study of how these risks may interact and accumulate. This comparison identifies mechanisms to investigate rather than assuming that repeated AI use is harmful. We therefore call for evaluation of cumulative patterns of use and deployment, individual and societal outcomes, careful causal inference, and proportionate safeguards that preserve useful assistance and informed user choice.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，提出"轨迹忽视论点"（Trajectory Neglect Thesis）：AI安全讨论过度聚焦于显眼的灾难性事件，而忽视了通过AI广泛日常使用而逐渐累积的另一种风险。作者借鉴社交媒体研究的经验，主张安全评估必须纳入累积性危害，并以对话式AI（谄媚、操纵、隐私损失）为案例，呼吁研究累积使用模式、因果推断与适度保障措施。
AI.motivation: 当前主流AI安全讨论集中于存在性威胁和灾难性事件（如AI引发的核冲突、工程化生物疫情暴发），这类风险单点显眼、易于叙事化。作者认为这种聚焦造成了盲区：另一类通过AI广泛、反复日常使用而累积生成的风险缺乏关注。社交媒体的发展历程提供了警示性先例——其危害并非来自单一事件，而是通过反复使用、反馈循环和互联部署逐步显现。因此需要重新界定安全评估的范围。
AI.method: 立场论文（position paper），非实证研究。论证路径为：1）以社交媒体研究为类比来源，援引互惠性媒介效应、社会强化、个体易感性等机制；2）提出"轨迹忽视论点"，界定累积性危害的四类机制——反复 reassurance（ reassurance 即反复获得的安抚/肯定）、选择性接触、反复出现的决策偏差、不断增长的个人画像；3）将该框架迁移至AI系统，以对话式AI为具体情境，分析生成、语义推断与持久记忆如何收紧反馈回路；4）以谄媚（sycophancy）、操纵、隐私损失为案例研究，展示多种风险的交互与累积。
AI.result: 论文并未报告实验数据，其"结果"为概念性产出：识别出一组可检验的累积性风险机制，说明其可导致视角逐渐窄化、独立判断力削弱，或在无单一明确有害事件的情况下形成剥削性影响；并指出生成—推断—记忆三者结合可能强化反馈回路，使谄媚、操纵与隐私损失相互叠加。作者明确强调，该比较的目的是识别待研究机制，而非预设"反复使用AI必然有害"。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁：评估应从单次交互转向累积性的使用与部署模式，同时关注个体与社会层面的结果；需要谨慎的因果推断方法（因累积效应与选择偏差、混杂因素难以分离）；并主张采取与风险相称的保障措施，在保留AI有用辅助功能与用户知情选择的前提下降低累积性危害。

title: SAGE-CP: When Marginal Coverage Hides Route-Conditional Failures in Adaptive VLM Ensembles
summary: Adaptive VLM ensembles save computation by stopping early on easy images and escalating harder ones. Although a single conformal threshold can make the final predictor marginally valid, it can still fail severely along individual computational routes. We characterize this failure precisely: if a route has prevalence pi, marginal 1-alpha coverage allows its conditional coverage to fall to max{0, 1-alpha/pi}. To address this mismatch, we learn the router on development data, freeze all routing choices, and calibrate the returned score separately for early exits and escalated inputs. We call this pipeline SAGE-CP. Its calibration step applies Mondrian split conformal prediction to the operational groups created by the router. Under exchangeability, the resulting prediction sets achieve finite-sample coverage within each route. Across 10 benchmarks, 4 frozen VLMs, and 5 aligned splits, both global calibration and SAGE-CP achieve 0.900 marginal coverage at a 0.90 target, but their route behavior differs substantially. SAGE-CP raises mean worst-route coverage from 0.623 to 0.887 and reduces the mean route-coverage gap from 0.324 to 0.025, using the same routed scores and 1.177 source calls per image. The stronger guarantee increases the mean prediction-set size from 1.893 to 2.212; nevertheless, the sets remain smaller than those of the full ensemble (2.486) while requiring 70.6 percent fewer source calls. The route-level reliability persists across 6 fixed query fractions, while finer exit-depth groups demonstrate the need for additional calibration data on rare routes. Across 5 datasets, SAGE-CP also reduces measured batch-one latency by 58.8 to 63.4 percent and gross GPU energy by 55.7 to 57.5 percent relative to full inference. Thus, routing provides computational savings, while route-stratified calibration attaches coverage guarantees to the operational paths created by the router.

AI.tldr: SAGE-CP通过对路由器产生的各计算路径分别做Mondrian分裂保形校准，实现按路径的有限样本覆盖率保证，同时保留早退带来的算力节省。
AI.motivation: 自适应VLM集成虽可用单一保形阈值获得边际有效覆盖，但会在单条计算路径上严重失效：若某路径占比为π，边际1−α覆盖允许其条件覆盖降至max{0,1−α/π}，这种覆盖错配需要被显式修正。
AI.method: 在开发数据上学习路由器并冻结全部路由选择，对早退输出与升级输入分别校准返回分数；校准步骤对路由器生成的运行分组施加Mondrian分裂保形预测。
AI.result: 在10个基准、4个冻结VLM、5组对齐划分上，全局校准与SAGE-CP均达到0.900边际覆盖（目标0.90）；SAGE-CP将平均最差路径覆盖从0.623提升至0.887，路径覆盖差距从0.324降至0.025。预测集平均大小由1.893增至2.212，但仍小于全集成的2.486，且源调用减少70.6%，每图1.177次源调用。在6个固定查询比例下路径级可靠性保持稳定；更细的退出深度分组显示稀有路径需额外校准数据。在5个数据集上，SAGE-CP相对全量推理将batch-one延迟降低58.8%–63.4%，GPU总能耗降低55.7%–57.5%。
AI.conclusion: 路由提供算力节省，而按路径分层的校准把覆盖保证附着于路由器实际产生的运行路径上；在极小代价（略增预测集）下换取显著的路径级可靠性。

title: DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models
comment: 19 pages. Jiang Wu and Yutong Song contributed equally
summary: Language models can make personalized recommendations from rich item content, user history, and feedback. However, evaluating many candidates with full-text inputs incurs substantial online computation and limits serving throughput. We introduce DuoLM, a framework for fast and effective personalized recommendation that integrates a compact recommendation model with an efficient serving runtime. An encoder LLM learns compact item representations for offline reuse, while a personalized ranker LLM combines them with user history and feedback for recommendation. We train both models end to end with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. The runtime further accelerates inference through virtual token IDs for embedding access, shared history computation, and CUDA Graph replay. Benchmark results show that our framework achieves recommendation quality comparable to that of the expert teacher model. On a single H100, it delivers approximately 26,400 candidate scores per second, about $60\times$ the throughput of the teacher served with vLLM and automatic prefix caching.

AI.tldr: DuoLM 将紧凑编码器 LLM（离线复用物品表征）与个性化排序 LLM 结合，配合虚拟 token ID、共享历史计算与 CUDA Graph 回放的推理运行时，在保持接近教师模型推荐质量的同时，单张 H100 上约 26,400 候选/秒，吞吐约为 vLLM+APC 教师服务的 60 倍。
AI.motivation: 语言模型可基于丰富的物品内容、用户历史与反馈做个性化推荐，但对大量候选进行全文输入评估会带来可观的在线计算开销，限制服务吞吐。因此需要兼顾效果与效率的推荐框架。
AI.method: 提出 DuoLM：紧凑推荐模型 + 高效服务运行时的框架。编码器 LLM 学习紧凑物品表征以供离线复用；个性化排序 LLM 将其与用户历史和反馈结合进行推荐。两模型以推荐监督信号与教师蒸馏端到端训练；运行时通过虚拟 token ID 访问 embedding、共享历史计算和 CUDA Graph 重放加速推理。
AI.result: 推荐质量与专家教师模型相当；单张 H100 上约每秒 26,400 个候选打分，约为使用 vLLM 与自动前缀缓存（APC）服务的教师模型的 60 倍吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 通过“紧凑编码 + 轻量排序 + 专用推理运行时”的协同设计，可在不明显损失推荐质量的前提下大幅提升 LLM 个性化推荐的服务吞吐，说明模型结构与系统优化联合设计是部署高效推荐系统的有效路径。

title: SWE-Bench Pro V2: A Cleaner, Harder-to-Game Coding Benchmark
summary: SWE-Bench Pro is a widely used benchmark of long-horizon software engineering tasks for coding agents. As agents improve, they reach task issues earlier agents never touched and interact with the evaluation environment in ways the original harness did not anticipate. We present SWE-Bench Pro V2, a revised public split built to keep the benchmark accurate as capabilities advance. Agentic audits, expert adjudication and blind re-implementation repaired or retired 480 of the 731 tasks: 23 contracted engineers spent 404 hours, each working in a language they write professionally, and every revised instruction was verified by a second engineer solving the task from the text alone. A hardened protocol restricts network access to the model endpoint and re-grades every patch in a clean container, so agents cannot retrieve upstream fixes or get credit for changes outside their patch. On the 642 V2 tasks frontier agents resolve up to 99.4% while other systems stay clearly separated, and a 51-task Hard split spreads systems from 52.9% to 98.0%. We release the benchmark and distill lessons for maintaining agent benchmarks over time.

AI.tldr: SWE-Bench Pro V2 是对长期软件工程智能体基准的修订版公开测试集，修复或淘汰了731个任务中的480个，并采用更严格的评测协议。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体能力提升，它们触及早期智能体从未涉及的任务问题，并以原始评测框架未预料的方式与环境交互，导致原基准的准确性与公平性受损，因此需要持续维护基准以跟上能力进展。
AI.method: 通过智能体化审计、专家裁决与盲式重新实现来修复或退役480个任务；23名签约工程师共投入404小时，各自使用其职业级编程语言；每条修订后的任务说明均由第二名工程师仅凭文本独立求解验证。同时采用加固协议：网络访问仅限模型端点，并在干净容器中对每个补丁重新评分，防止智能体获取上游修复或为补丁外改动得分。
AI.result: 在642个V2任务上，前沿智能体最高解决率达99.4%，与其他系统保持明显区分；51个任务的Hard子集将各系统区分在52.9%至98.0%区间。
AI.conclusion: 论文发布该基准及V2版本，并总结了长期维护智能体基准的经验教训。

title: Beyond Explicit Intent: Discovering and Shaping Artistic Intent through Human-AI Co-Creation
summary: Generative AI is becoming an important medium for artistic creation, yet existing interactions often assume that creators can specify intentions in advance and accurately communicate them through text prompts. Artistic intentions, however, may be vague, latent, or recognizable only after seeing concrete visual possibilities. We propose a human-AI co-creation paradigm beyond explicit intent expression. By expanding model exploration, we expose artists to diverse visual possibilities, allowing them to identify previously unarticulated preferences through observation, comparison, and selection. We then integrate artists' curatorial judgments into reinforcement learning, assigning different learning strengths based on preferences over generation trajectories, so recognized directions are more strongly reinforced and the model gradually adapts to individual aesthetics. This creates a continuous "explore-identify-shape-re-explore" loop in which artistic intent is progressively discovered, externalized, and shaped. Through three user studies, we examine latent-preference discovery, personalized preference alignment, and the externalization of vague, difficult-to-express creative intentions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种超越显式意图表达的人机协同创作范式：通过扩大模型探索暴露多样视觉可能性，让艺术家在观察、比较与选择中识别潜在偏好，并将策展判断以不同学习强度融入强化学习，形成"探索—识别—塑造—再探索"循环，使意图被逐步发现、外化与塑造。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI艺术创作交互默认创作者能预先明确意图并用文本提示准确传达；但艺术意图常是模糊的、潜在的，或只有在看到具体视觉可能性后才能被识别，因此需要突破显式意图表达的范式。
AI.method: 1）扩展模型探索，向艺术家呈现多样视觉可能性；2）艺术家通过观察、比较、选择进行策展式判断；3）将偏好转化为对生成轨迹的差异化强化学习强度，被识别的方向获得更强强化，使模型逐步适配个体审美；4）构建连续的"探索—识别—塑造—再探索"闭环。
AI.result: 通过三项用户研究分别考察：潜在偏好的发现、个性化偏好对齐，以及模糊、难以言说的创作意图的外化。
AI.conclusion: 艺术意图可由"先表达后生成"转为"在生成中逐步生成与塑造"，策展判断可作为强化学习信号实现个性化审美适配，支持模糊意图的发现与外化。

title: Announced Breaks Separate Conformal Reliability from Frequency Calibration
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). 53 pages, 7 figures
summary: An announced boundary reveals the partition before the first affected outcome, and a reset there serves one of two audits. The per-time audit reads conformal reliability, the expected distance of the threshold's coverage from nominal at miscoverage 0.1. The frequency audit reads frequency calibration, whether a closed window's error rate matched it. The reset rule, the post-boundary empirical quantile, attains the minimax per-time rate for independent scores. On bounded scores a recursion reset at the boundary attains a frequency gap of order one over the count when its floor adds a bounded total. At the 50th forecast after a large synthetic break, the reset rule's per-time gap stands below that of five adaptive methods, four from their authors' code, with every paired band below zero. After an electricity market reform, on 68 unseen scores, the band stands below zero against two, includes zero against two, adaptive conformal inference among them, and is a point at zero against one. After monetary policy decisions its pointwise band stands above zero against all five on 10 of the first 34 days. Of 9 announced boundaries one clears the smallest coverage difference its window detects, where every method's per-time gap at the 50th forecast exceeds the nominal miscoverage. Over the first 50 forecasts the reset recursion leads the frequency audit after every synthetic break.

AI.tldr: 论文研究预测中"已公布边界"(announced boundary)处的时间序列校准问题,提出在边界处重置经验分位数的规则,并从逐时审计(conformal reliability)与频率审计(frequency calibration)两个角度建立理论保证,在合成断点与真实数据上与五种自适应方法比较。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应共形推断方法在分布发生断点(regime break)后需要较长时间才能恢复名义覆盖率。作者注意到许多断点是事先公布或有明确时间戳的(如政策改革、货币政策决议),因此可以在断点前就已知重置时刻,从而设计更高效的校准重置策略,并需要区分"逐时"与"频率"两种审计口径来严格评价。
AI.method: 提出重置规则:在边界后取后验经验分位数,并证明其对独立分数达到逐时(minimax per-time)最优率。对有界分数,给出在边界处重置的递归方案,其频率偏差为O(1/n),条件为下限累计为有界总量。评价采用两种审计指标:逐时审计(阈值覆盖与名义水平在miscoverage=0.1下的期望距离)与频率审计(闭合窗口误差率是否与名义匹配)。实验包括大型合成断点后第50次预测、电力市场改革后68个未见分数、货币政策决议后前34天中的10天,以及9个公布边界。
AI.result: 合成断点后第50次预测处,重置规则的逐时偏差低于五种自适应方法(其中四种用作者原代码),所有配对置信带均低于零。电力市场改革后68个未见分数上,相对两种方法置信带低于零、相对两种(含自适应共形推断)包含零、相对一种为零点。货币政策决议后逐点带在前34天中的10天对全部五种方法均高于零。9个公布边界中仅1个超过其窗口可检测的最小覆盖差异;而所有方法在第50次预测处的逐时偏差均超过名义miscoverage。前50次预测中,重置递归在每次合成断点后的频率审计上均领先。
AI.conclusion: 利用事先公布的边界进行显式重置,可在断点后显著加快校准恢复,并在理论上分别达到逐时最优率与O(1/n)的频率偏差。真实数据表明其收益依情景而定,并非普遍优于所有自适应方法;同时揭示公布边界本身提供的可检测信号有限,凸显了显式重置机制的价值。

title: RAGit: Turning Document Preprocessing into an Experimental Variable for RAG
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the Tool Demonstration Track of the 33rd Asia-Pacific Software Engineering Conference (APSEC 2026)
summary: Document preprocessing choices can substantially affect retrieval in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, yet they are often selected heuristically and are difficult to compare under consistent conditions. We present RAGit, an open-source experimentation workbench for the systematic and reproducible evaluation of document preprocessing choices through downstream retrieval. RAGit represents parsing, chunking, indexing, retrieval, and evaluation as configurable experimental stages, enabling controlled comparisons while the remaining downstream settings are kept fixed. It preserves provenance from retrieved chunks to source pages and maps heterogeneous retrieval units to a common page-level ranking for evaluation. The current implementation supports multiple parsers and chunking strategies, dense and late-interaction retrieval, reusable intermediate artifacts, and multi-configuration benchmarking. We demonstrate RAGit through controlled experiments comparing alternative preprocessing configurations under a fixed retrieval setup, illustrating how preprocessing can be treated as an explicit experimental variable. RAGit and its documentation are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/OmarElbachyr/ragit). A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/tsst-Bhfz4I.

AI.tldr: RAGit 是一个开源实验工作台，将文档预处理作为显式实验变量，通过下游检索进行系统、可复现的受控评估。
AI.motivation: 在 RAG 流水线中，文档预处理（解析、分块等）的选择会显著影响检索效果，但通常依靠启发式选取，且难以在一致条件下进行比较。
AI.method: 将解析、分块、索引、检索和评估建模为可配置的实验阶段，在固定其余下游设置的前提下实现受控对比；保留从检索块到源页面的溯源信息，并将异构检索单元映射到统一的页面级排序进行评估；支持多解析器、多分块策略、稠密与后期交互检索、可复用中间产物以及多配置基准测试。
AI.result: 在固定检索设置下开展受控实验，比较不同预处理配置，展示了预处理可作为显式实验变量进行系统分析。
AI.conclusion: RAGit 为文档预处理选择提供了系统、可复现的评估框架，并已开源（GitHub 与演示视频公开可用）。

title: VERAS: Verification-Guided Adaptive Search for Reliable Operations Research
summary: Advances in reasoning, coding, and tool use enable LLM agents to solve operations research (OR) problems through iterative problem modeling, program construction, and verification. Yet passing self-authored verification does not ensure that the solutions satisfy task constraints and meet optimization quality. This gap can arise from correlated specification errors, where the generated program and its checks share omissions or misinterpretations of task requirements, alongside incomplete verification coverage and ineffective optimization strategies. We propose VERAS, a verification-guided adaptive search harness for reliable OR that uses verification evidence to prioritize feasibility repair, constraint-coverage review, and solution-quality improvement. VERAS combines task-specific solution checkers with a separate verification agent to examine candidate solutions against the task requirements. It uses verification feedback to guide feasibility repair, additional constraint checking, and objective improvement, while candidate acceptance criteria screen revisions for deterioration in output validity or constraint satisfaction. On ORAgentBench, VERAS achieves a 42.99% pass rate, exceeding the reported 35.51% of Codex using the same LLM. Across two industrial-scale OR problems, VERAS reduces inter-datacenter peak bandwidth by 10.34% relative to native Codex and lowers annualized distribution network planning costs by 6.28% compared with expert-designed solutions. Code and evidence are available at https://github.com/holimario/VERAS.

AI.tldr: VERAS 提出一种验证引导的自适应搜索框架，用独立的验证智能体产生的证据来指导运筹优化解修复与改进，在 ORAgentBench 上取得 42.99% 通过率并优于 Codex。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体虽能通过迭代建模、编程与自校验求解运筹优化问题，但自撰校验存在与生成程序相关的规范性偏差（共同遗漏或误读任务约束）、验证覆盖不完整及优化策略低效，导致"自校验通过"不等于解可行且高质量。
AI.method: VERAS 将任务特定解检查器与独立验证智能体结合，对候选解依据任务需求进行审查；利用验证反馈驱动可行性修复、补充约束检查与目标值改进；并设置候选解接受准则，筛除在输出有效性或约束满足度上退化的修订版本，形成验证引导的自适应搜索回路。
AI.result: 在 ORAgentBench 上通过率达 42.99%，高于同款 LLM 下 Codex 的 35.51%；在两个工业级 OR 问题上，相较原生 Codex 将跨数据中心峰值带宽降低 10.34%，相较专家设计方案将年化配电网规划成本降低 6.28%。
AI.conclusion: 将验证从"自证"转变为独立的、证据驱动的外部审查并闭环指导搜索，可有效提升 LLM 智能体求解 OR 问题的可靠性与解质量，且具备工业落地价值。

title: Unified Multiparadigm Fusion Intelligence for Rare Disease Diagnosis
summary: Rare diseases (RDs) affect an estimated 300 million people globally, leaving patients to navigate a protracted diagnostic odyssey constrained by clinical scarcity and fragmented medical knowledge. Artificial intelligence (AI) has progressively advanced RD diagnostics, from symbolic methods and deep learning to large language model (LLM)-based systems. However, each paradigm carries structural limitations: symbolic methods are bounded by knowledge completeness, neural models sacrifice interpretability, and LLM-based systems are vulnerable to evaluation biases like data leakage. In this study, we introduce FusionRare, a unified multiparadigm fusion framework integrating knowledge-driven symbolic reasoning, deep-learning pattern recognition, case-based patient retrieval, and LLM-based heuristic inference via statistical meta-aggregation and knowledge-enhanced agentic reflection. Evaluated on 2,528 strictly isolated clinical cases, FusionRare achieves state-of-the-art RD prioritization, attaining a macro-averaged Recall @1 of 51% for phenotype-only diagnosis and 79% for phenotype-genotype joint analysis. These results represent decisive advantages over the advanced agentic system DeepRare, frontier LLMs including GPT 5.5, and specialized tools like PhenoBrain and LIRICAL under stringent anti-leakage protocols. A randomized, crossover clinician-AI validation demonstrated that FusionRare elevates the true diagnostic rank in 45% of decisions, improves physician confidence in 62%, and reduces time to diagnosis by 21%. These findings indicate that reconciling these orthogonal AI paradigms significantly enhances diagnostic capabilities, bridging the gap between computational benchmarks and actionable clinical reliability. More broadly, this work provides a replicable framework for deploying trustworthy diagnostic AI across complex, high-stakes, and underserved medical domains.

AI.tldr: FusionRare：融合符号推理、深度学习、案例检索与LLM的多范式罕见病诊断框架，在2528例严格隔离病例上实现Recall@1 51%（仅表型）/79%（表型+基因型）的SOTA，并经随机交叉医师-AI验证提升诊断排名、信心与效率。
AI.motivation: 罕见病影响全球约3亿人，诊断历程漫长，受临床稀缺性与医学知识碎片化制约。现有AI范式各有结构性局限：符号方法受知识完备性约束，神经模型牺牲可解释性，LLM系统易受数据泄漏等评估偏差影响，单一范式难以兼顾可靠性与性能。
AI.method: 提出统一多范式融合框架FusionRare，集成知识驱动的符号推理、深度学习模式识别、基于案例的患者检索与LLM启发式推断，通过统计元聚合（meta-aggregation）与知识增强的智能体反思（agentic reflection）进行融合；在2,528例严格隔离的临床病例上评估，采用严格防泄漏协议，并与DeepRare、GPT 5.5等前沿LLM、PhenoBrain、LIRICAL对比，另开展随机交叉临床医师-AI验证。
AI.result: 罕见病排序达到SOTA：仅表型诊断宏平均Recall@1为51%，表型-基因型联合分析为79%，在严格防泄漏协议下显著优于DeepRare、GPT 5.5、PhenoBrain与LIRICAL。随机交叉临床验证显示，FusionRare在45%的决策中提升真实诊断排名，62%情况下提高医师信心，诊断时间缩短21%。
AI.conclusion: 协调正交AI范式可显著增强诊断能力，弥合计算基准与临床可用可靠性之间的差距；该工作为在复杂、高风险且资源不足的医学领域部署可信诊断AI提供了可复现框架。

title: Zero-Shot Tabular Learning via Hypergraph Reasoning with LLMs
summary: Tabular data are prevalent across diverse domains such as healthcare and finance. Zero-shot tabular learning aims to make predictions without labeled data. However, existing LLM-based approaches rely on row-wise prompting, resulting in high inference cost and limited use of inter-row dependencies. In this work, we propose TABHGR+, an efficient relation-aware zero-shot framework for tabular data that leverages LLM-generated rules to label and group rows. Specifically, based on column and task descriptions, we use LLMs to generate rules that assign weak labels to all rows. To refine these noisy weak labels, we construct a hypergraph by grouping semantically related rows using LLM-generated rules and perform hypergraph-based label propagation. Lastly, we further enhance the LLM-generated hypergraph for propagation, which is potentially sub-optimal, by assigning label-adaptive weights to hyperedges. By requiring only a constant number of LLM calls independent of dataset size, TABHGR+ substantially reduces inference cost while achieving higher classification accuracy than zero-shot and strong few-shot baselines.

AI.tldr: TABHGR+ 是一种高效的关系感知零样本表格学习框架：利用 LLM 依据列描述和任务描述生成规则为所有行打弱标签，并以规则将语义相关行分组构建超图，通过超图标签传播去噪，再以标签自适应超边权重优化传播，仅需常数次 LLM 调用即可在降低成本的同时超越零样本与强少样本基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的零样本表格方法采用逐行提示（row-wise prompting），导致推理成本高，且未能利用行间依赖关系。表格数据在医疗、金融等领域广泛存在，亟需兼顾成本与精度的零样本方案。
AI.method: 1) 基于列与任务描述，由 LLM 生成规则为全部行分配弱标签；2) 依据 LLM 生成规则将语义相关的行分组，构建超图并进行超图标签传播以修正噪声弱标签；3) 为超边引入标签自适应权重，缓解 LLM 生成超图可能次优的问题。整体框架仅需与数据规模无关的常数次 LLM 调用。
AI.result: 分类准确率高于零样本基线与强少样本基线，同时因 LLM 调用次数为常数而显著降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 以“LLM 生成规则 + 超图标签传播”替代逐行提示，可在零样本表格学习中同时实现高效性与高精度，说明规则级弱监督与行间关系建模是可行且有效的路径。

title: MemRevise: A Self-Revising Memory for Conversational Search
summary: In conversational search, users correct misun-derstandings, revise their requests and return to earlier topics, so part of the history no longer reflects what they want. Existing benchmarks do not isolate such turns. Current search methods either re-read the history or keep a record of every turn, and none of them marks earlier content as dropped. We introduce CONVREVISE, a benchmark of 4,429 test questions in six tiers of returns and revisions over TopiOCQA, CORAL and OR-QuAC. We also propose MEMREVISE, which combines a revisable memory graph, a 3B writer distilled from teacher memories, and a search guided by the memory. The writer reads each turn once and adds a node that records its topic, its facts and the operations it performs, such as adding, abandoning or reactivating a topic. Topic status follows from these operations, so a dropped topic keeps its facts and can be restored. With a frozen retriever, MEMREVISE reaches a mean MRR@10 of 0.701, against 0.589 for the best competitor, ConvSearch-R1-FT, and 0.617 for a writer distilled the same way without the memory, so the memory and the steps built on it add 0.084. MEMREVISE is significantly better on Topi- OCQA and OR-QuAC, statistically tied with prompted 32B rewriters on CORAL, and never significantly behind the strongest competitor of any tier.

AI.tldr: 提出CONVREVISE基准（4,429题，6档返回/修订层级）与MEMREVISE方法（可修订记忆图+3B蒸馏writer+记忆引导检索），冻结检索器下MRR@10达0.701，较最佳基线0.589提升0.084。
AI.motivation: 对话检索中用户会纠正误解、修改请求、回到早期话题，导致部分历史不再反映当前需求；现有基准未隔离这类turn，现有检索方法要么重读全部历史、要么保留每轮记录，均不能标记被丢弃的内容。
AI.method: 构建CONVREVISE基准（基于TopiOCQA、CORAL、OR-QuAC，含返回与修订的六个层级，4,429个测试问题）；提出MEMREVISE：可修订记忆图、从教师记忆蒸馏的3B writer（每轮只读一次并写入节点，记录主题、事实及操作如添加/放弃/重新激活），主题状态由操作推导，被放弃主题保留事实可恢复，检索由记忆引导。
AI.result: 冻结检索器下平均MRR@10为0.701，最佳对比方法ConvSearch-R1-FT为0.589，同法蒸馏但无记忆的writer为0.617（记忆及其步骤贡献0.084）；在TopiOCQA与OR-QuAC显著更优，CORAL上与prompted 32B rewriter统计持平，任一层级均未显著落后于最强对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模turn级操作与主题状态的可修订记忆能有效处理对话检索中的返回与修订，且以3B小模型实现高效、可与大模型改写器媲美的性能。

title: Safety Analysis of CPSs Over-the-air Updates: Test Case Prioritization and Selection
summary: Over-the-air (OTA) updates for Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) allow engineers to modify their software wirelessly. In the automotive domain, they enable manufacturers to update software without physical access to the vehicle. However, OTA updates can generate a large number of possible software configurations. For example, end users may decide whether or not to install any given OTA updates. The combinatorial explosion of these configurations hampers SW testing, a standard practice for detecting errors in CPS. To overcome this limitation, we propose CRISP (CRIticality-based Selection and Prioritization), a novel framework supporting test case prioritization and selection in the context of OTA updates. Our framework leverages test case robustness, i.e., how far they are from violating the system requirements, to drive test case prioritization and selection. It enables engineers to rank test case executions from most to least critical, and to select only the critical test cases relevant to a given OTA update. We evaluated our approach using a representative SW product line consisting of seven different vehicles, 22 driving scenarios, and two software components. We considered 224 tests, requiring 59 hours of execution time. We assessed the effectiveness of CRISP across five OTA updates. We compared our solution with (a) a random test case prioritization and selection algorithm, and (b) AP-DISC, identified as the state-of-the-art solution in a recent empirical study on the subject. Our results show that CRISP outperforms our baselines in finding failure-revealing test cases, and that our selection procedure can be configured to find reasonable and practical tradeoffs among accuracy (percentage of failure-revealing test cases identified) and computational time (time required to find them).

AI.tldr: 提出CRISP框架，利用测试用例鲁棒性（距违反系统要求的距离）驱动OTA软件配置空间中的测试用例优先级排序与选择。
AI.motivation: 车联网CPS的OTA更新可产生大量软件配置组合（如用户是否安装某更新），组合爆炸使软件测试难以覆盖，需在有限资源下高效选取关键测试用例。
AI.method: CRISP（CRIticality-based Selection and Prioritization）：以测试用例鲁棒性度量其关键性，对测试执行按关键性从高到低排序，并针对给定OTA更新筛选相关关键测试用例。
AI.result: 在含7款车型、22个驾驶场景、2个软件组件、224个测试（59小时执行时间）的产品线及5次OTA更新上评估；相较随机优先级/选择算法及最新实证研究中的SOTA方案AP-DISC，CRISP在发现暴露失败测试用例上更优，并可在准确率与计算时间间配置合理折中。
AI.conclusion: 基于关键性的测试用例优先级与选择能有效应对OTA更新带来的配置组合爆炸，提升失效检测效率并具备实用性权衡能力。

title: LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation
comment: Preprint. Under review. Savitha Sam Abraham and Marjan Alirezaie contributed equally
summary: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. We assess compositional generalisation, finding that the best-performing model`s accuracy drops from 84% on single-constraint prompts to 20% when satisfying multiple constraints simultaneously. Identifying unsatisfiable constraints is also challenging, with the best model correctly recognizing only 23% of such prompts. Building on this framework, we introduce \textbf{LogicVal}, an evaluation methodology that combines neural visual detection with logical reasoning to assess constraint satisfaction in generated images. On CLEVR, LogicVal achieves ROC-AUC scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.98, indicating strong alignment with human judgments. These findings underscore the value of logic-based evaluation for characterizing T2I model capabilities and limitations.

AI.tldr: 将T2I评估形式化为约束满足问题，提出逻辑框架与LogicVal评估方法，揭示模型在复杂多约束下性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I基准多针对属性绑定、计数、空间推理等单项能力，缺乏统一的形式化框架来刻画生成图像必须满足的约束，难以系统刻画模型的组合泛化与逻辑推理能力。
AI.method: 提出逻辑框架，形式化定义基准域（对象、属性、关系）及图像需满足的约束；在9类约束（从单对象-属性到含∀、∃、count、→逻辑算子的多对象关系约束）上评估4个SOTA T2I模型；并提出LogicVal——结合神经视觉检测与逻辑推理的评估方法。
AI.result: 最优模型在单对象约束上达98%准确率，多对象条件关系约束仅53%；单约束84%降至多约束同时满足20%；识别不可满足约束仅23%；LogicVal在CLEVR上ROC-AUC为0.88–0.98，与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于逻辑的评估能有效刻画T2I模型的能力边界，复杂组合与逻辑约束是当前模型的显著短板，LogicVal为约束满足评估提供了可靠方法。

title: Improving Fake Profile Detection Through Multimodal Learning and Research-Guided Feature Integration
summary: Fake accounts continue to undermine online platforms, yet it remains unclear whether multimodal learning offers meaningful improvements over strong metadata baselines or graph-based approaches. In this work, we study bot detection by integrating textual, visual, and account metadata signals on the TwiBot-22 benchmark using a subsample of 30,000 users. We propose a multimodal framework combining pretrained textual (XLM-RoBERTa) and visual (CLIP) embeddings with structured account-level features such as follower counts, posting frequency, and account age, and evaluate multiple modality combinations using CatBoost alongside a Relational Graph Convolutional Network (R-GCN). Results show that metadata alone is highly predictive, while multimodal fusion yields only marginal and largely statistically insignificant gains. The graph-based model underperforms classical variants under the subsampled graph conditions of this study. Overall, our findings suggest that under practical constraints, feature quality and metadata richness matter more than fusion complexity.

AI.tldr: 在 TwiBot-22 的 3 万用户子样本上，融合文本（XLM-RoBERTa）、视觉（CLIP）与账号元数据的多模态机器人检测相比强元数据基线仅有边际且多不显著的提升，图模型（R-GCN）在子采样图条件下亦不如经典模型。
AI.motivation: 虚假账号持续危害在线平台，但尚不清楚多模态学习是否真的优于强元数据基线和图方法，因此需要实证检验多模态融合的实际增益。
AI.method: 在 TwiBot-22 基准的 30,000 用户子样本上，构建多模态框架：预训练文本嵌入（XLM-RoBERTa）、视觉嵌入（CLIP）与账号级结构化特征（粉丝数、发帖频率、账号年龄）组合，用 CatBoost 评估多种模态组合，并与关系图卷积网络（R-GCN）对比。
AI.result: 仅元数据即具有很高预测力；多模态融合仅带来边际且大多统计不显著的增益；在本研究的子采样图条件下，R-GCN 表现逊于经典模型。
AI.conclusion: 在现实约束下，特征质量与元数据丰富度比融合复杂度更重要。

title: VisR-RAG-Fin: Benchmarking Multimodal RAG over Visually Rich Financial Documents
comment: Accepted at the main research track of ACM SIGIR-AP 2026, Singapore, December 13-15, 2026
summary: Enterprise documents such as financial reports are increasingly processed by automated systems, yet they are primarily designed for human reading and exhibit complex visual structure, combining dense text with tables, charts, diagrams, and rich layouts. These characteristics pose significant challenges for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, which must retrieve relevant pages and leverage visual and structural information during answer generation. Despite recent advances in multimodal retrieval and vision-language models, there remains a limited understanding of how design choices across retrieval and generation components affect end-to-end RAG performance on visually rich documents. In this paper, we present a comprehensive empirical study of multimodal RAG for page-level Question Answering (QA) over financial documents. We introduce VisR-RAG-Fin (Visually Rich RAG for Finance), an open-source benchmark constructed through a general pipeline for visually rich documents that preserves original layout and visual content. Using this benchmark, we systematically analyze retrieval and generation behavior under text-only, multimodal, and hybrid configurations, providing a foundation for rigorous evaluation of RAG systems on complex enterprise document collections. Overall, this work provides actionable insights for practitioners designing and evaluating multimodal RAG pipelines over complex, visually rich enterprise documents.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视觉丰富企业文档（如财务报告）构建开源基准VisR-RAG-Fin，并系统实证研究多模态RAG在页面级问答中的检索与生成组件设计选择对端到端性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 企业文档主要面向人类阅读，具有密集文本与表格、图表、版面混排的复杂视觉结构；现有RAG系统需同时检索相关页面并在生成时利用视觉与结构信息，而多模态检索与视觉语言模型的最新进展尚不足以说明检索与生成各组件设计如何影响端到端性能，缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 提出通过保留原始版面与视觉内容的通用流水线构建开源基准VisR-RAG-Fin；在该基准上于纯文本、多模态与混合三种配置下，系统分析检索与生成行为，进行页面级问答的全面实证研究。
AI.result: 提供面向复杂企业文档集合的严格评测基础，揭示纯文本、多模态与混合配置下检索与生成的性能差异与行为特征。
AI.conclusion: 为设计与评估面向复杂视觉丰富企业文档的多模态RAG流水线的实践者提供可操作的洞见，并奠定系统化评测基础。

title: Effective Construction of Feature Database of Fingerprinting Functions for Code-Clone SCA
summary:
In contemporary software development, the extensive adoption of third-party libraries has become standard practice to avoid reinventing the wheel. This trend is particularly evident in programming ecosystems that lack mature package managers, such as C/C++. Within this context, Code Clone Detection (CCD) techniques have emerged as essential tools for identifying instances of code reuse, thereby mitigating security and legal concerns. Despite significant advances in CCD algorithms, a notable gap persists between academic tools and real-world applications. This disparity primarily arises because academic tools rely on experimental datasets composed of a limited number of indexed repositories, whereas real-world applications require a much broader scope of code sources.
  To address this challenge, we propose a novel, systematic approach for selecting appropriate open-source repositories to construct a more effective CCD feature dataset. Our method, OSSScope, employs a greedy algorithm to analyze the diversity of fingerprinting functions across 2.55 million C repositories on GitHub, maximizing unique fingerprinting functions while minimizing the number of repositories required. OSSScope compiles an optimal feature dataset containing 61 million fingerprinting functions from 190K repositories, resulting in a 22.65% improvement in recall over SOTA tools, and covers over 95% of the features from other sources. Leveraging the selected repositories, we introduce RClassifier, a lightweight classification model that determines whether a repository should be included, streamlining construction for migration to other language ecosystems. Our evaluation of RClassifier in the Golang ecosystem validates its effectiveness, achieving recall comparable to the dataset produced by OSSScope.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSScope方法，用贪心算法从GitHub 255万个C仓库中筛选高指纹函数多样性的仓库，构建含6100万指纹函数、19万仓库的CCD特征数据集，召回率较SOTA提升22.65%；并进一步提出轻量级RClassifier，用于判断仓库是否应纳入数据集，在Golang生态验证有效。
AI.motivation: 第三方库复用普遍，C/C++等缺少成熟包管理器的生态尤甚，代码克隆检测（CCD）成为识别复用、应对安全与法律风险的关键手段。但学术工具依赖仅含少量索引仓库的实验数据集，而真实应用需要更广的代码来源，导致学术工具与工业实践之间存在明显鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出OSScope：基于贪心算法分析GitHub 255万个C仓库中指纹函数的多样性，在最大化唯一指纹函数覆盖的同时最小化所需仓库数量，从而系统性地筛选开源仓库；并基于所选仓库训练轻量级分类模型RClassifier，判定某仓库是否应纳入特征数据集，以降低迁移到其他语言生态的构建成本。
AI.result: OSScope构建了包含19万仓库、6100万指纹函数的最优特征数据集；相较SOTA工具召回率提升22.65%，并覆盖其他来源95%以上的特征。RClassifier在Golang生态的评估中取得与OSScope数据集相当的召回率。
AI.conclusion: 系统性、多样性驱动的仓库选择可显著提升CCD特征数据集的覆盖度与检测效果；RClassifier为跨语言生态的数据集构建提供了低成本、可迁移的方案。

title: World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds
summary: As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. The framework allows us to study different elements of collaboration by varying communication, ownership, and resource allocation. We run simulations in three different worlds, totaling more than 10,000 hours of agent work across eight models. Overall, performance improvement scales with inference-time compute, with the best model improving downstream efficiency by up to 31%. We show that most agents can find meaningful tasks via collaboration, but some frontier models can prematurely stop looking for improvements and make little progress. We release the simulation framework and traces to support future studies of agent collaboration at https://szj.io/sw.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Software World框架，用于模拟多AI智能体在真实Python包生态系统中的协作，以研究协作对推理时算力扩展的作用，实验显示性能随算力提升、最佳模型使下游效率提升最高31%。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体团队承担更大项目和长期开放问题，智能体协作成为扩展推理时算力的新维度，但缺乏理解何种协作有效的可控制实验平台。
AI.method: 构建Software World仿真框架及流水线，生成由真实、相互依赖的Python包组成的"软件世界"（主题、规模、依赖结构各异）；仿真中智能体以提升软件效率为目标维护包，可自主发现任务并协作；通过在隐藏依赖包上的加速比集体评估，并可控地改变通信、所有权、资源分配等因素。
AI.result: 在三个世界、八种模型、累计逾1万小时智能体工作中，性能提升随推理时算力扩展，最佳模型使下游效率提升最高达31%；多数智能体能通过协作找到有意义任务，但部分前沿模型会过早停止寻找改进而进展甚微。
AI.conclusion: 智能体协作能随算力扩展带来可测效率收益，但存在部分前沿模型过早终止搜索的失效模式；作者开源框架与轨迹以支持未来协作研究。

title: miniTE: Diagnosing and Bridging the Execution Gap in Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning
summary: Native NVFP4 promises to accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs), but achieving stable learning across separate training and sampling engines remains challenging. We show that matching model weights and numerical formats is insufficient to ensure consistent policy evaluation, highlighting the importance of cross-engine numerical execution. We introduce miniTE, a lightweight framework that combines execution diagnostics, cross-engine numerical alignment, and efficient native W4A4 (4-bit weights and activations) GEMM computation for LLM RL. It improves numerical execution consistency without modifying the RL objective, while reducing implementation overhead to realize the benefits of native low-bit computation. Long-horizon RL experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate stable training and benchmark performance close to BF16, outperforming naive Transformer Engine (TE) NVFP4 in evaluation quality. On single NVIDIA B300 GPU node, the optimized learner reaches 33,540 tokens/s, yielding 1.39x and 1.47x the throughput of BF16 and TE NVFP4, respectively, for complete learner updates. We released the framework, kernels, diagnostics, and training configurations to make native low-bit RL easier.

AI.tldr: 提出 miniTE 框架，通过跨引擎数值对齐与原生 W4A4 GEMM，实现 LLM 强化学习中 NVFP4 低比特训练的稳定收敛与加速。
AI.motivation: 原生 NVFP4 有望加速 LLM 强化学习，但训练引擎与采样引擎分离时难以保证稳定学习。作者指出仅匹配模型权重与数值格式不足以确保一致的策略评估，跨引擎数值执行一致性才是关键。
AI.method: miniTE 为轻量框架，集成三部分：执行诊断（execution diagnostics）、跨引擎数值对齐、以及高效原生 W4A4（4 比特权重与激活）GEMM 计算；在不修改 RL 目标函数的前提下提升数值执行一致性，并降低实现开销。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的长程 RL 实验显示训练稳定，基准性能接近 BF16，评估质量优于朴素 TE NVFP4；单台 NVIDIA B300 GPU 节点上优化后的 learner 达 33,540 tokens/s，完整 learner 更新吞吐为 BF16 的 1.39 倍、TE NVFP4 的 1.47 倍。
AI.conclusion: 跨引擎数值执行一致性是低比特 RL 稳定的必要条件；miniTE 在保持 RL 目标不变的情况下兼顾稳定性与效率，并开源框架、kernel、诊断工具与训练配置以降低原生低比特 RL 的使用门槛。

title: Structure-Aligned History Learning with Subspace-Structured Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
comment: 34 pages, 10 figures, including references and appendices
summary: Generative recommendation constructs semantic IDs for catalog items and predicts the next ID from user interaction histories. However, existing methods face limitations in both stages. First, conventional quantizers may produce imbalanced code assignments and lack coherent intermediate semantic units between individual tokens and complete items, limiting history reconstruction. Second, recommendation models remain dominated by next-item prediction, treating historical interactions mainly as conditioning context and providing limited supervision for recovering persistent preferences across the historical path, particularly when relevant preference signals are distributed over distant interactions. To address these limitations, Structure-Aligned History Learning (SAHL) reconnects the two stages by using the structure created during quantization directly for history reconstruction. Its Semantic Residual Balanced Quantization (SRBQ) forms a balanced token-subspace-item hierarchy, and SAHL reconstructs history at these same granularities. Predictive entropy prioritizes uncertain transitions, while curriculum optimization progressively shifts training to inference-aligned next-item prediction. On four Amazon Review categories, SAHL improves NDCG@10 by 18.6%-30.0% over RPG and 2.7%-6.0% over strong method MHL. Controlled analyses verify balanced code use, the benefit of following quantizer-defined groups during reconstruction, and dependence on user history. The relevant code is available at https://github.com/CQU-MM-Intelligent-Lab/SAHL.

AI.tldr: 提出SAHL框架，通过将量化阶段构建的语义层级结构直接用于历史重构，把语义ID构建与生成式推荐两阶段重新连接，在四个Amazon类目上NDCG@10较RPG提升18.6%–30.0%、较MHL提升2.7%–6.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐在两阶段均存在局限：其一，传统量化器易产生编码分配不均衡，且缺乏介于单个token与完整item之间的一致性中间语义单元，限制历史重构能力；其二，推荐模型以next-item预测为主，将历史交互仅视作条件上下文，对跨长距离交互恢复持久偏好的监督不足。
AI.method: SAHL用量化阶段形成的结构直接进行历史重构。其Semantic Residual Balanced Quantization（SRBQ）构建均衡的token–子空间–item三级语义层级，SAHL在这些相同粒度上重构历史；引入预测熵优先关注不确定转移，并采用课程式优化逐步将训练迁移至与推理对齐的next-item预测。
AI.result: 在四个Amazon Review类目上，NDCG@10较RPG提升18.6%–30.0%，较强基线MHL提升2.7%–6.0%；对照实验验证了编码使用均衡、重构时遵循量化器定义分组的收益以及对用户历史的依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 将量化结构与历史重构相对齐可有效弥合语义ID构建与生成式预测两阶段的裂隙，兼顾编码均衡性与长程偏好监督；代码已开源。

title: When Code Becomes an LLM Call: An Empirical Study of Call-Site Contracts in Agentic Systems
summary: Software quality has long rested on specifications that state what code must do, and on testing and verification that check that the code does it. Agentic systems change this foundation: they replace parts of their logic, such as choosing the next tool, judging whether an action is allowed, or writing code to run, with calls to a large language model (LLM). The program still relies on what this logic must guarantee, but the model's behavior is not fixed by code, varies across runs, and can be steered by its input. The guarantee must therefore come from the program around each LLM call site, as a contract of pre-conditions, prompt constraints, and post-conditions.
