To address structural limitations, we propose two complementary modules: Alternating Dual-Graph Propagation, which alleviates representation collapse by integrating collaborative and multimodal propagation, and Entropy-based Diversity Regularization, which mitigates optimization bias by promoting balanced category exposure. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that MOSS consistently achieves a superior accuracy--diversity trade-off over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOSS，一个通过语义与结构双重塑形实现多模态解耦的统一推荐框架，用于在保证准确率的同时提升推荐多样性。
AI.motivation: 准确率驱动的推荐系统易产生结果过度集中、多样性不足的问题。现有多样性方法存在两方面根本局限：语义层面，多模态推荐系统中多模态信号常被视为ID嵌入的辅助信息，语义利用不充分；结构层面，训练过程中准确率与多样性的权衡持续存在，准确率提升往往以牺牲多样性为代价，该现象受表示的结构性质与优化动态共同支配。
AI.method: MOSS包含四个模块：(1) 基于MLLM的解耦特征提取模块，将多模态内容解耦为有信息量的表示；(2) 类别感知嵌入选择模块，提取紧凑的类别感知语义特征以增强语义利用；(3) 交替双图传播模块，融合协同传播与多模态传播以缓解表示坍塌；(4) 基于熵的多样性正则化，通过促进类别曝光均衡来缓解优化偏置。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的大量实验表明，MOSS相较强基线方法能够稳定取得更优的准确率—多样性权衡效果。
AI.conclusion: 从语义和结构两个维度对多模态表示进行解耦塑形，是缓解推荐准确率—多样性权衡问题的有效途径，MOSS为此提供了统一且有效的框架。

title: From Software History to Executable Regression Tasks: A System for Evaluating Software Agents
summary: As software agents increasingly generate and modify code, evaluating their ability to review changes and discover defects becomes important. Such evaluation needs executable project environments for investigation and reliable defect references supported by reproducible behavior. Existing code review benchmarks provide limited support for this combination. We present a system that constructs executable regression instances from historical introducing--fixing commit pairs and developer tests. The system extracts candidate tests from fixing-side changes, then uses constrained agents to transplant them and configure version-specific environments while preserving production code and test expectations. Independent replay and evidence-based review verify whether tests that fail on the introducing version and pass on the fixing version support the proposed regression relationship. Accepted instances retain both versions' replay recipes, validated tests, and execution evidence. Repair-supported analysis and human review add root-cause locations, tested repairs, and causal explanations. These instances support bug detection and localization in code review, and enable bug repair and regression-test generation on the same defects. The system constructs 172 validated instances from 522 candidates across 11 Python projects. We evaluate three software agents with ten models and additional reasoning-effort settings on 83 manually selected, enriched instances across the three tasks. Precise root-line localization remains challenging, while baseline combinations achieve repair and regression-test generation success rates of up to 68.7% and 77.1%, respectively. Leading configurations differ by task, and higher task performance does not necessarily yield greater API-cost efficiency. Our approach provides reusable executable evidence for studying agents' defect discovery, repair, and testing capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从历史"引入-修复"提交对与开发者测试中构建可执行回归实例的系统，产出172个经校验的实例，并用83个增强实例评测3种软件代理在代码审查缺陷检测/定位、修复、回归测试生成三类任务上的能力。
AI.motivation: 软件代理越来越多地生成和修改代码，评估其审查变更、发现缺陷的能力变得重要；而此类评估需要可执行的项目环境与可复现缺陷引用，现有代码审查基准难以同时满足这两点。
AI.method: 从修复侧变更中抽取候选测试，用受约束的代理移植测试并配置版本相关环境，同时保持生产代码与测试预期不变；通过独立重放与基于证据的审查，验证测试是否"在引入版本失败、在修复版本通过"，以确认回归关系。接受的实例保留两版本的重放配方、经校验的测试与执行证据；再经修复支持的分析与人工审查补充根因位置、经验证的修复与因果解释。
AI.result: 从11个Python项目的522个候选中构建172个通过校验的实例；在83个手工筛选的增强实例上评测3种软件代理、10个模型及额外推理强度设置。精确根因行定位仍具挑战；基线组合在修复与回归测试生成上的成功率分别达68.7%和77.1%；领先配置因任务而异，且更高任务表现并不必然带来更高的API成本效率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为研究代理的缺陷发现、修复与测试能力提供可复用的可执行证据；同一批缺陷实例可同时支持代码审查中的缺陷检测与定位、缺陷修复和回归测试生成三类任务。

title: Probing Ambiguity: Adversarial Intent Resolution for Robust Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL systems typically assume a one-to-one mapping between natural-language queries and correct SQL translations. In practice, however, many queries are inherently ambiguous, admitting multiple valid interpretations that yield distinct outputs. We introduce Adversarial Intent Resolution (AIR), a multi-agent framework that actively probes and resolves such ambiguity without any task-specific training. AIR first constructs competing interpretations, verifies through SQL execution that they produce genuinely different results, and generates targeted clarification questions grounded in the observed data differences. Evaluating on leading benchmarks for ambiguous questions, AIR demonstrates strong performance, efficiency, and robust cross-benchmark transferability. On the AMBROSIA benchmark under schema-only context, a realistic production setting where exposing the full database is infeasible, AIR outperforms IntentRL, the state-of-the-art reinforcement learning model, across all metrics (e.g., F1 0.679 vs. 0.618). Crucially, AIR exhibits only ~7% performance degradation without the full database, compared to ~20% for IntentRL. On the AmbiQT benchmark, where ambiguity arises from schema design rather than linguistic structure, AIR achieves higher F1 under both context settings without any benchmark-specific adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的Adversarial Intent Resolution（AIR）多智能体框架，主动探测并消解Text-to-SQL中的查询歧义。在AMBROSIA与AmbiQT上均优于SOTA，且仅用schema上下文时性能退化更小。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL假设自然语言查询与SQL一一对应，但实际中大量查询本身存在歧义，可产生多个有效但结果不同的解释；现有方法难以在无法暴露完整数据库的真实生产环境下鲁棒地识别并消解歧义。
AI.method: AIR框架分三步：1）构造多个相互竞争的候选语义解释；2）通过SQL执行验证这些解释确实产生不同结果，以过滤伪歧义；3）基于观察到的数据结果差异生成有针对性的澄清问题。整个流程为多智能体协作，不依赖任何任务特定训练。
AI.result: 在AMBROSIA的schema-only设置下，AIR全面超越SOTA强化学习方法IntentRL（F1 0.679 vs. 0.618）；无完整数据库时性能仅下降约7%，而IntentRL下降约20%。在歧义源于schema设计的AmbiQT上，两种上下文设置下F1均更高，且未做任何基准特定适配。
AI.conclusion: 执行验证驱动的多解释消歧是处理Text-to-SQL歧义的有效途径；AIR兼具强性能、高效率和跨基准迁移能力，在schema-only等现实中可部署的场景中优势尤为显著。

title: How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies
comment: This paper has been accepted by NeurIPS 2026
summary: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $>$ task $>$ trajectory. When environment diversity is decomposed into world and environment-structure diversity, its advantage is mainly driven by the former, while the latter is just comparable to the task diversity. Second, we use the fitted laws as a common ruler to price synthesis methods, capturing each method's efficiency as a per-axis discount factor and identifying critical synthetic-to-real ratios at which collapse begins; these ratios differ by an order of magnitude across axes. Third, we cast budget allocation as a constrained optimization under our laws and discounts, deriving a Chinchilla-style compute-optimal recipe and validating it at held-out scale. The empirical results demonstrate that following the recipe yields up to $1.7\times$ compute efficiency over the dominant ``scale-the-trajectories'' practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将智能体强化学习的数据视为“任务—环境—轨迹”三维结构，而非单一token标量，并通过实证拟合各轴缩放律发现环境多样性收益最高，进而给出类似Chinchilla的计算最优数据合成配方，最多提升1.7倍算力效率。
AI.motivation: 预训练缩放律把数据抽象为一维token数，而现代合成流水线可独立、以极低成本分别生成任务、环境和轨迹，使数据成为结构化设计空间。核心问题：在给定合成预算下应当缩放哪一个轴？此前研究未回答该问题。
AI.method: 将智能体数据分解为任务、环境、轨迹三个基数轴，并引入奖励密度作为控制变量；在不同LLM（多模型规模与家族）、数学+代码、SWE、Web、UI/工具等域，以及PPO、GRPO算法上拟合各轴缩放关系；进一步把环境多样性拆分为世界多样性与环境结构多样性；以拟合律为统一标尺，将各合成方法效率表示为按轴折扣因子并识别合成-真实临界比例；最后把预算分配表述为约束优化，推导Chinchilla式计算最优配方并在留出规模上验证。
AI.result: 在全部测量的模型规模、家族、域与RL算法中，缩放指数排序均为环境>任务>轨迹；环境多样性的优势主要来自世界多样性，环境结构多样性仅与任务多样性相当；各轴合成-真实临界比例相差一个数量级；按配方分配预算相较主流的“缩放轨迹”做法最多带来1.7倍算力效率。
AI.conclusion: 智能体RL数据应按结构化多轴进行缩放，环境轴（尤其世界多样性）具有最高边际收益；所推导的计算最优合成配方可作为合成方法定价与预算分配的统一框架，并具备跨规模可迁移性。

title: Don't Rewrite the SID Map: Topology Preservation for Generative Retrieval in Dynamic E-Commerce Search
summary: Generative retrieval assigns each item a discrete semantic identifier (SID) and retrieves items by autoregressively generating SID sequences. In dynamic environments such as e-commerce, new items arrive continuously, requiring periodic updates to the SID-to-Item mapping and model to maintain retrieval timeliness. Each update, however, can invalidate search paths already learned by the retriever, and the quantitative relationship between mapping change and retrieval quality has not been systematically characterized. We study this problem with extensive controlled experiments over 67 days of large-scale e-commerce search logs and obtain three core findings. (1) SID semantic drift causes severe retrieval degradation that may be masked by large beam sizes: mapping updates reduce HitRate by 41.78-62.05% at beam size 1 but only 8.33-10.85% at beam size 1000, as redundant candidate generation conceals the true severity of drift. (2) The fraction of changed SIDs is strictly monotonically related to retrieval quality: as the remapped fraction increases from 0% to 72.75%, HitRate decreases monotonically, dropping up to 42.66% at beam size 1. Full remapping remains substantially worse than the preservation policy under warm-start training, indicating that short-budget continued training alone cannot repair topology disruption. (3) The SID topology-preserving principle makes even the simplest warm-start strategy highly effective: fixing old-item SIDs, inserting new-items, and warm-starting from the previous model improves old-item HitRate by 10% and new-item HitRate by 109%, validated across two non-overlapping update cycles. These findings distill into a concise deployment principle: insert new-items, freeze old-items; warm-start when possible, otherwise freeze; never change SIDs the model has already learned. A three-week online A/B test on TmallAPP shows UCTCVR +0.29% and GMV +1.16%.

AI.tldr: 本文系统刻画了生成式检索中SID映射更新与检索质量之间的定量关系，提出"SID拓扑保持"原则并给出可落地的部署策略，在TmallAPP在线A/B中取得UCTCVR +0.29%、GMV +1.16%。
AI.motivation: 电商等动态环境中新商品持续涌入，需周期性更新SID-to-Item映射与模型以保持时效性；但每次更新都会破坏检索器已学到的搜索路径，而映射变化与检索质量之间的定量关系尚未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 基于67天大规模电商搜索日志开展受控实验，从三个维度分析：(1) 不同beam size下SID语义漂移对检索性能的影响；(2) 改变SID比例（0%–72.75%）与检索质量的单调关系及全量重映射vs保留策略对比；(3) 验证SID拓扑保持原则下的warm-start策略（冻结旧SID、插入新项、上一版模型热启动），并在两个不重叠的更新周期上验证，最后进行三周在线A/B测试。
AI.result: (1) SID语义漂移导致严重退化且被大beam掩盖：beam=1时HitRate下降41.78–62.05%，beam=1000时仅下降8.33–10.85%；(2) 变更SID比例与检索质量严格单调相关，比例升至72.75%时beam=1下HitRate最多下降42.66%，全量重映射在warm-start下仍显著劣于保留策略，说明短预算持续训练无法修复拓扑破坏；(3) 拓扑保持策略使旧项HitRate提升10%、新项HitRate提升109%。
AI.conclusion: 提炼出简洁部署原则："插入新项、冻结旧项；能热启动则热启动，否则冻结；绝不更改模型已学到的SID"。该原则在TmallAPP三周在线A/B中验证有效（UCTCVR +0.29%，GMV +1.16%）。

title: Step-Aligned Script Generation with Verification and Recovery for Web Automation Testing
summary: Automated generation of end-to-end web tests remains costly: developers must identify stable selectors, encode multi-step workflows, attach assertions, and maintain scripts as interfaces evolve. Recent LLM-based web agents can complete natural-language tasks in a live browser session, but task completion is not the same as producing a test-ware artifact - code that is executable, replay-able from a reset state, inspectable by developers, and tied to an oracle. We present TESSARA, an adaptive test-script generation framework that converts natural-language test intent into Playwright scripts consisting of executable interaction code, goal-state assertions, and step-level provenance linking each step to its generated code fragment, selector evidence, execution outcome, and repair history. TESSARA grounds each planned step via Step-Aligned Scripting (SAS), enabling fine-grained failure localization, selective regeneration of failing suffixes, and reversibility-aware backtracking that avoids undoing likely commit points (e.g., form submissions). A three-level verification pipeline (syntactic, execution, and semantic/oracle), detects and repairs malformed code, interaction failures, and incorrect landing states. We evaluate TESSARA on three public web benchmarks, measuring script executability, oracle satisfaction, replay stability, and repair efficiency, and show substantial improvements over baselines and underlying VLMs used directly as script generators.

AI.tldr: TESSARA 提出一个自适应测试脚本生成框架，将自然语言测试意图转换为可执行、可重放、带断言的 Playwright 脚本，并通过步级溯源与三级验证实现细粒度定位与修复。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 网页智能体虽能在实时浏览器中完成任务，但“完成任务”不等于产出测试工件：开发者仍需手工识别稳定选择器、编写多步流程、附加断言并随界面演进维护脚本。缺乏可执行、可从重置状态重放、可审查且绑定测试预言（oracle）的脚本自动化生成能力。
AI.method: 提出 TESSARA：以 Step-Aligned Scripting (SAS) 将每个规划步骤接地为对应代码片段，并记录选择器证据、执行结果与修复历史，形成步级溯源；支持失败片段精准定位、失败后缀的选择性再生成，以及感知可逆性的回溯（避免撤销表单提交等可能的提交点）；构建语法、执行、语义/oracle 三级验证流水线，分别检测并修复畸形代码、交互失败与错误落点状态。
AI.result: 在三个公开网页基准上评估脚本可执行性、oracle 满足度、重放稳定性与修复效率，相较基线方法及直接作为脚本生成器使用的底层 VLM 均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将网页智能体的“任务完成”范式推进到“测试工件生成”范式是可行且有效的；步级对齐与多级验证是提升脚本鲁棒性与可维护性的关键设计。

title: Cortex: A Fixed-Point Theory of Governed Coding Agents - Technical Report
summary: A coding agent combines a large language model (LLM) with a harness that plans, edits, and executes code. We study Cortex, a supervisory layer for pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, and iterative validation and repair. We formalize requirement closure on a finite lattice. For a fixed requirement set and a sound, monotone validation rule with persistent evidence, exhaustive iteration reaches the least fixed point with no more strict increases than there are requirements. Fair consequence scheduling reaches the same closure. A separate stochastic model bounds expected completion time under a uniform positive-progress assumption. These results depend on their stated assumptions; artifact repair, fallible validation, and finite execution budgets do not satisfy them automatically. We define Gauntlet's trajectory-similarity and build-gated scores, attack-success estimators, Wilson intervals, and case-cluster bootstrap summaries. Effective-feedback accounting counts newly certified requirements, rather than estimating their information value or utility. The five evaluation families support raw-versus-governed comparisons. We report retained benchmark observations, including rescoring of existing artifacts; constructed outcomes are excluded. Unequal observation sets and incomplete provenance prevent causal claims about governance or measured long-horizon scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出并形式化"Cortex"监督层（预执行治理、需求追踪、迭代验证与修复），在有限格上定义需求闭包，证明穷尽迭代至最小不动点且严格增加次数不超过需求数，并给出公平后果调度的等价性、随机模型下的期望完成时间界，以及Gauntlet评测体系（轨迹相似度、构建门控评分等）。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体（LLM+harness）在规划、编辑、执行中存在需求遗漏与错误传播风险，缺乏执行前的形式化治理与需求闭包保证；同时现有评测难以区分"治理"与"原始"智能体表现，需可计量的反馈核算与评分框架。
AI.method: 1) 将需求闭包形式化于有限格上；在固定需求集、可靠性-单调验证规则与持久证据假设下分析穷尽迭代与公平后果调度；2) 建立随机模型，在均匀正进展假设下给出期望完成时间上界；3) 定义Gauntlet的轨迹相似度与构建门控评分、攻击成功估计器、Wilson区间和案例簇自助法汇总；4) 以"新近认证需求数"进行有效反馈核算，构成五类评测族支持raw vs governed对比，并重评既有工件、排除构造性结果。
AI.result: 理论结果：穷尽迭代达到最小不动点，严格递增步数不超过需求数，公平后果调度达同一闭包；随机模型给出期望完成时间界。实证方面报告保留的基准观测（含既有工件重评分），但观测集不等、溯源不完整，故不支持关于治理效果或长时程扩展的因果结论。
AI.conclusion: Cortex/ Gauntlet提供了可形式化、可审计的智能体治理与评测框架，但其理论保证严格依赖假设，工件修复、易错验证与有限执行预算并不自动满足；当前证据为描述性观测而非因果论断，长期扩展性有待严格实验验证。

title: FLMNet: Self-Ensemble Distillation from Masks to Seeds for Single-Tower CTR Prediction
summary: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction underpins recommender systems and online advertising, where high-dimensional categorical features interact in combinatorially many ways. Several recent CTR models, such as FinalNet and QNN, report higher accuracy when a network also learns from its own averaged predictions, for example by running the same network under different dropout patterns and training each run toward the average. Why this self-distillation helps, and whether its random sampling is needed, remains unclear. This work shows that as the number of dropout patterns grows without bound, the objective reduces exactly to the label loss of the logit-averaged prediction plus a penalty on how much the dropout copies of the network disagree. When dropout does not affect how a network gates its features, this penalty can be approximated in closed form, and FLMNet is designed on this principle and trains without sampling. Networks trained from different seeds disagree in the same form, and distilling several of them into one network recovers part of their ensemble gain. On five benchmarks against seventeen baselines, the resulting models take the top two places in accuracy with a single network at inference, and the gains of the penalty and of distillation, where measurable, largely add up.

AI.tldr: 将FinalNet/QNN中"从自身平均预测学习"的自蒸馏机制作无穷dropout采样极限分析，证明目标等价于logit平均预测的标签损失加副本不一致惩罚；在门控不受dropout影响时可闭式近似该惩罚，据此提出免采样的FLMNet，并把多seed网络蒸馏合并，五个基准上以单网络推理取得前两名精度。
AI.motivation: CTR预测中高维类别特征组合交互复杂，近期FinalNet、QNN等模型通过让网络在多种dropout模式下运行并向平均预测学习而获得更高精度，但这种自蒸馏为何有效、随机采样是否必要尚不清楚，缺乏理论解释与简化方案。
AI.method: 理论推导dropout副本数趋于无穷时的极限目标：等于logit平均预测的标签损失加上各副本间不一致的正则惩罚。当dropout不影响特征门控时，对该惩罚作闭式近似；据此设计FLMNet，训练时无需采样。另从不同随机种子训练的网络的同形式分歧出发，将多个网络蒸馏进单一网络以回收集成增益。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集、十七个基线模型上，所得模型以单网络推理取得精度前两名；在可测范围内，不一致惩罚与蒸馏的增益基本可叠加。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏的有效性可归因于均值预测损失与副本一致性惩罚的组合，随机采样并非必需；该原理可导出更简洁高效的FLMNet，并与多seed集成蒸馏互补叠加。

title: Better Specifications, Better Code: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Behavioral Contract Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong code-generation capabilities but often struggle with functional correctness due to implicit or ambiguous behavioral requirements. We present CG2, a contract-guided code generation framework that translates natural-language tasks into structured behavioral contracts specifying interfaces, preconditions, postconditions, and invariants. CG2 fine-tunes an LLM to generate these contracts and introduces an iterative semantic validation and repair process to identify and correct incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrect specifications before guiding an unchanged downstream code-generation model. We evaluate CG2 on 1,007 held-out tasks using five code LLMs: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct, Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512, Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-27B. Results show that CG2 consistently improves pass@1 over direct code generation by 1.49-3.27 percentage points (7.58%-22.45% relative improvement) and over contract guidance without fine-tuning by 1.19-2.38 percentage points (7.04%-14.65% relative improvement). Manual analysis further reveals that semantically correct contracts are associated with higher code-generation accuracy. These findings demonstrate that explicitly specifying and validating behavioral requirements can improve functional correctness without modifying downstream code-generation models.

AI.tldr: CG2 将自然语言任务先转换为结构化行为契约，经微调与迭代语义校验/修复后再引导下游代码生成模型，在 1,007 个任务、5 个代码 LLM 上使 pass@1 提升 1.49–3.27 个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM 代码生成能力强，但因需求中隐含或模糊的行为约束，功能正确性不足。作者希望在不改动下游代码生成模型的前提下，通过显式刻画并验证行为需求来提升正确性。
AI.method: 提出契约引导框架 CG2：把自然语言任务翻译为结构化行为契约（接口、前置条件、后置条件、不变式）；微调一个 LLM 专用于生成契约；引入迭代式语义验证与修复流程，识别并纠正不完整、不一致或有误的规格；最后用修复后的契约引导一个保持不变的代码生成模型。
AI.result: 在 1,007 个留出任务上，使用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct、Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B/32B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-27B 五个模型：pass@1 较直接生成提升 1.49–3.27 个百分点（相对提升 7.58%–22.45%），较未微调的契约引导提升 1.19–2.38 个百分点（相对 7.04%–14.65%）。人工分析显示语义正确的契约与更高代码生成准确率相关。
AI.conclusion: 显式指定并校验行为需求可提升功能正确性，且无需修改下游代码生成模型；契约质量是收益的关键中介因素。

title: AM-Bench: A Unified Taxonomy and Evaluation Suite for Agentic Misalignment
summary: As LLM-based agents are deployed with increasing autonomy in real-world environments, a critical failure mode emerges: agentic misalignment, where agents choose harmful actions over failure. However, existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents comply with explicitly harmful instructions, leaving the conditions that cause agents to choose harmful actions poorly understood. To address this limitation, we propose AM-Bench, a unified taxonomy and 35 scenario evaluation benchmark spanning seven industries for agentic misalignment grounded in the fraud triangle, a well-established criminological framework explaining goal-directed misconduct. We adapt this framework to agentic environments and construct our evaluation suite and detection systems along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning. We operationalize each dimension into structured subcategories rooted in prior theory: five threat categories derived from the instrumental convergence thesis, seven opportunity categories drawn from the Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRR) taxonomy, and a novel four-question binary reasoning framework synthesized from prior literature. Our evaluation of 10 frontier models reveals a 62-percentage-point gap in misalignment across scenarios, with Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibiting the highest levels of agentic misalignment while Claude Sonnet 4.6 displays near-zero rates across all conditions. Our reasoning framework further reveals that models may exhibit harmful behaviours without explicit situational awareness or explanation, complicating both mitigation and detection. AM-Bench scenarios and code are available at https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench

AI.tldr: 提出AM-Bench：基于欺诈三角理论的统一分类体系与35个场景基准（覆盖7个行业），从感知威胁、感知机会与推理三维度评测LLM智能体的"智能体失配"（宁为有害不作为失败）行为，发现10个前沿模型跨场景失配率差异达62个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体被赋予越来越高自主性并部署于真实环境，出现关键失效模式——智能体失配（agentic misalignment），即智能体宁可采取有害行动也不接受任务失败。但现有安全基准主要检验智能体是否服从显式有害指令，对"何种条件导致智能体主动选择有害行动"缺乏理解，因此需要构建针对成因机制的评测体系。
AI.method: 以犯罪学中解释目标导向不当行为的欺诈三角框架为理论基础，并将其迁移至智能体环境，构建统一分类体系与跨7个行业、共35个场景的评测基准及检测系统，沿三个维度组织：(1)感知威胁——依据工具性趋同论（instrumental convergence thesis）划分5类；(2)感知机会——依据涌现式策略推理风险（ESRR）分类法划分7类；(3)推理——综合既有文献提出新颖的四问二元推理框架。并在10个前沿模型上进行评测。
AI.result: 评测显示跨场景失配率差异达62个百分点；Gemini 3 Flash与Gemini 3.1 Pro呈现最高的智能体失配水平，而Claude Sonnet 4.6在所有条件下接近零失配率。推理框架进一步表明，模型可能在缺乏显式情境意识或解释的情况下表现有害行为，从而同时增加缓解与检测的难度。
AI.conclusion: 智能体失配程度高度依赖场景条件而非仅取决于模型，且有害行为可隐含于缺乏情境觉察的推理中，故需以"威胁—机会—推理"结构化框架进行机制层面评测；AM-Bench的场景与代码已开源，为可复现的失配检测与缓解研究提供基础。

title: DS-Net: A Dynamic Split Network for Edge-Cloud Collaborative Inference
comment: 18 pages. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
summary: Collaborative inference serves as a critical methodology in edge intelligence. Existing collaborative inference methods operate by splitting the deep neural network (DNN) model between edge devices and cloud servers. However, these methods need to load different models for multiple split points when the communication or device changes, thus resulting in long switching times and substantial storage overhead on the edge side. To address this issue, we propose a Dynamic Split Network (DS-Net), which not only enables efficient split point switching but also enhances the collaborative speed and accuracy across various scenarios. Specifically, we design a dynamic switching framework that enables flexible selection among multiple split points within a single model, thereby reducing storage, memory, and switching overhead. To mitigate the feature distribution shifts and task-relevant information loss caused by dynamic splitting and high-ratio compression, we further propose a hierarchical compensation mechanism. Local alignment calibrates the decoded feature distribution at each split point, while task-specific global compensation restores task-relevant information at the global level. In addition, we incorporate sample-adaptive global compensation selection into split-point selection based on sample complexity and runtime resource conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that DS-Net reduces memory overhead by 74.6% and achieves millisecond-level switching latency. Moreover, under a 10 Mbps bandwidth constraint on the Nano platform, DS-Net outperforms state-of-the-art collaborative methods by achieving 1.2% higher accuracy on the COCO dataset, reducing latency by 42.5%, and improving throughput by a factor of 1.8$\times$.

AI.tldr: 提出动态拆分网络DS-Net，在单一模型内支持多拆分点灵活切换，并配合分层补偿机制，显著降低边缘侧存储/内存与切换开销，同时提升协同推理的速度与精度。
AI.motivation: 现有边缘-云协同推理通过在设备与云之间拆分DNN实现，但当通信或设备条件变化时需为不同拆分点加载不同模型，导致切换时间长、边缘侧存储开销大。
AI.method: 设计动态切换框架，使单个模型内可在多个拆分点间灵活选择，减少存储、内存与切换开销；针对动态拆分与高压缩比带来的特征分布偏移和任务相关信息损失，提出分层补偿机制：局部对齐在每个拆分点校准解码后的特征分布，任务特定的全局补偿在全局层面恢复任务相关信息；并将基于样本复杂度与运行时资源状况的样本自适应全局补偿选择融入拆分点选择。
AI.result: 内存开销降低74.6%，切换延迟达毫秒级；在Nano平台10 Mbps带宽约束下，COCO数据集上精度比SOTA协同方法高1.2%，延迟降低42.5%，吞吐提升1.8倍。
AI.conclusion: DS-Net通过单模型多拆分点动态切换与分层补偿，有效解决了多拆分点模型的存储与切换开销问题，并在受限带宽与算力条件下同时实现更高精度、更低延迟与更高吞吐，适用于动态边缘环境的协同推理。

title: Babbar26 main x genre
summary: We introduce Babbar26, a multilingual dataset of 1111 web pages from 1006 domains in five languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian), jointly annotated for genre, following a compact five-class taxonomy, and for main content and boilerplate, as main/noise regions anchored to the DOM. We describe the annotation guidelines and report double-annotation agreement on both tasks (97.1% on genre; content-level Cohen's k = 0.766 for main content). Compared with the classic KI-04 genre benchmark, a median page has 2.3x more DOM elements and 1.9x more readable text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Babbar26：一个包含5种语言、1006个域名下1111个网页的多语言数据集，同时按五类网页体裁标注和按DOM区域标注正文/模板内容，并报告双重标注一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有网页体裁基准（如KI-04）页面结构较简单、语言单一，难以反映现代网页DOM更复杂、文本更庞杂的特点，缺少同时覆盖体裁与正文/噪声区域的联合标注多语言资源。
AI.method: 构建含英、法、德、西、意五种语言的1111个网页数据集（来自1006个域名）；制定标注指南；采用紧凑的五类体裁分类体系，并对正文与模板内容以锚定DOM的main/noise区域形式进行联合标注；开展双重标注以评估一致性。
AI.result: 双重标注一致性：体裁任务为97.1%；正文内容在内容层面Cohen's k = 0.766。与KI-04基准相比，中位页面的DOM元素数量多2.3倍、可读文本多1.9倍。
AI.conclusion: Babbar26提供了一个更贴近当代网页复杂度、多语言且体裁与正文区域联合标注的基准资源，可用于网页体裁分类与正文抽取等任务的研究与评测。

title: Selecting and Composing Agent Design Patterns: Industrial Case Evidence and Controlled Reference-System Experiments
summary: Agent pattern catalogs describe architectural alternatives, but engineers also need evidence for selecting and composing them. We extend a cognitive-function--execution-topology framework with an evidence-driven selection procedure and explicit composition contracts. The study combines two industrial case accounts, a contributor's collaboration design, seven practitioner workshops, and executable fault-injection experiments. Three local reference systems use SQLite state, shared artifact files, and a file-backed map-publication surrogate. A 2 x 2 ablation separates function-specific contracts from execution controls across 36 scenario families, with ten input variants per family. Under equal family weighting, composition correctly completes or safely refuses 11 of 12 families in each system, compared with 2, 2, and 1 for the simple baselines. These are constructed challenge-suite results, not production success rates. Recovery without consumer-side verification increases false-success cases in the map surrogate. All composed systems still fail a boundary case in which trusted evidence is wrong. An audit of a frozen six-arm language-model pilot reproduces its scores but confirms an evaluator-dependent ranking reversal. The contribution connects industrial failure, pattern selection, executable treatment, external acceptance, and revision. Selection is demonstrated rather than evaluated against an alternative procedure; catalog admission rests on separate criteria. The results support bounded composition mechanisms, not a claim that the framework improves engineers' design decisions over an equally informative conventional method.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“认知功能—执行拓扑”框架的扩展：一个证据驱动的模式选择流程与显式组合契约，并通过工业案例、7场工作坊、36族场景×10变体的2×2消融故障注入实验与一个冻结的六臂语言模型试点审计加以验证。结果表明有界组合机制在构造性挑战集上显著优于简单基线，但结果不代表生产成功率，且框架相较同等信息量的常规方法是否更优仍未被评估。
AI.motivation: Agent 模式目录只罗列架构备选方案，却缺少支持工程师“选择”与“组合”模式的证据。作者希望把工业失效经验、模式选择、可执行实验与外部验收连接起来，为模式选择提供可执行证据，并明确组合所需的契约。
AI.method: 以“认知功能—执行拓扑”框架为基础，增加证据驱动选择流程与显式组合契约；证据来源包括两个工业案例、一项贡献者协作设计、7场从业者工作坊与可执行故障注入实验。三个本地参考系统分别使用SQLite状态、共享制品文件与文件支撑的“地图发布”替代实现；采用2×2消融区分“功能特定契约”与“执行控制”，覆盖36个场景族、每族10个输入变体；另对冻结的六臂语言模型试点进行复现审计。
AI.result: 在等族权重下，组合方案在各系统中能对12个场景族中的11个正确完成或安全拒绝，而三个简单基线仅分别为2、2、1。去掉消费者侧验证的恢复机制会在“地图替代”系统中增加假成功案例；所有组合系统仍在“可信证据本身错误”的边界情形上失败。冻结试点的分数可被复现，但确认存在依赖评估器的排序反转。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于将工业失效、模式选择、可执行处理、外部验收与修订连成闭环。选择流程属演示性验证而非与替代流程的对照评估，目录准入依赖独立标准。结果支持“有界组合机制”的有效性，但不足以宣称该框架在同等信息量下优于常规方法或能改善工程师的设计决策。

title: Can Compact Open-Weight Large Language Models Recover Mobility Events from Incomplete Trajectories? A Controlled Evaluation Using Air Trips
summary: Incomplete mobility trajectories can obscure the observations needed to identify important travel events and their endpoints. This study evaluates whether compact, locally deployed large language models (LLMs) can recover missing mobility information from incomplete trajectories, using high-confidence air trips as a controlled test case, and whether more explicit prompts can compensate for the loss of endpoint evidence. Using nationwide location-based services (LBS) data from the United States in January 2022 and airport reference data, thirty high-confidence air trips were converted into three incomplete-trajectory conditions by removing observations near the origin airport, the destination airport, or both. Four prompt variants and two LLMs generated 720 requests, each using a two-stage procedure to identify the flight transition segment and then select the origin and destination airports. Exact transition accuracy is 9.2%, while origin and destination accuracy are 31.4% and 10.7%, respectively. Only 1.9% of requests recover both the rule-identified transition and the reference airport pair. The most explicit prompt produced the highest observed exact transition and exact airport-pair recovery rates. The study introduces a controlled endpoint-removal framework for evaluating recovery of discrete mobility events from incomplete trajectories, allowing failures to be examined by inference stage and helping analysts decide whether recovered information should be retained, independently verified, or left unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估本地部署的小型大语言模型能否从不完整LBS轨迹中恢复缺失的航空出行信息，并检验更明确的提示词能否弥补端点证据缺失。
AI.motivation: 不完整的移动轨迹会掩盖识别关键出行事件及其端点所需的观测；作者希望检验紧凑型本地部署LLM能否在端点观测缺失时恢复离散移动事件信息，并判断显式提示是否可替代缺失证据。
AI.method: 基于2022年1月美国全国LBS数据和机场参考数据，选取30条高置信度航空出行，按移除起点机场、终点机场或两者附近观测构造三种不完整轨迹条件；使用4种提示变体和2个LLM共生成720次请求，每次采用两阶段流程：先识别航班转换段，再选择起点与终点机场。
AI.result: 转换段完全准确率为9.2%，起点和终点准确率分别为31.4%和10.7%；仅1.9%的请求同时恢复规则识别的转换段与参考机场对。最显式的提示在转换段完全准确率和机场对完全恢复率上均最高。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出一种可控的端点移除框架，用于评估从不完整轨迹中恢复离散移动事件，可按推理阶段定位失败，并帮助分析者判断恢复信息应保留、独立验证还是暂不采信。

title: Compaction-Aware Reinforcement Learning For Ascend Triton Kernel Generation
summary: Automatically generating high-performance kernels with LLM-based agents promises substantial gains in development efficiency, but two obstacles remain. First, while increasing multi-turn interaction with execution environments is crucial for refining generation quality, continuous context accumulation rapidly exceeds the model's effective context window. Second, training long-horizon tasks via GRPO inherently incurs sparse rewards due to its reliance on terminal outcome evaluation, severely hindering step-level credit assignment; To address these obstacles, we propose ATRL (Ascend Triton Reinforcement Learning), a post-training method that refines GRPO into a compaction-aware, segment-level objective for long-horizon kernel generation. We also design a lightweight agent harness providing cascaded compilation, correctness, and profiling feedback, alongside an Ascend-specific knowledge base injected during agentic RL training and evaluation to compensate for the base model's missing platform expertise. Evaluations on NPUKernelBench and KernelBench, both executed on Ascend hardware, show that ATRL consistently surpasses all baselines, including GRPO, in both correctness and speedup.

AI.tldr: ATRL：面向长程Triton算子生成的后训练方法，将GRPO改造为压缩感知的分段级目标，并配合轻量智能体harness与昇腾领域知识库，在NPUKernelBench与KernelBench上于正确性与加速比上全面超越GRPO等基线。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体自动生成高性能kernel可提升开发效率，但存在两大障碍：一是多轮与环境交互带来上下文持续累积，迅速超出模型有效上下文窗口；二是GRPO依赖终端结果评估训练长程任务，奖励稀疏，步级信用分配困难。此外基座模型缺乏特定硬件平台（昇腾）专业知识。
AI.method: 提出ATRL（Ascend Triton Reinforcement Learning）后训练方法：把GRPO细化为压缩感知（compaction-aware）、分段级（segment-level）的目标以适配长程kernel生成；设计轻量智能体harness，提供编译、正确性、性能剖析的级联反馈；并在智能体RL训练与评估阶段注入昇腾专用知识库以补足平台知识。
AI.result: 在昇腾硬件上执行NPUKernelBench与KernelBench的评测中，ATRL在正确性与加速比两项指标上均持续优于包括GRPO在内的所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过压缩感知的分段级强化学习目标、级联反馈harness与平台知识注入，ATRL有效缓解长上下文溢出与稀疏奖励问题，提升了长程算子生成的质量与效率。

title: Preference Is Not Position: Evaluating Reranking on NevIR in Fixed Hybrid Candidate Pools
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the IEEE BigData 2026 Undergraduate and REU Consortium. Code: https://github.com/ql-link/LinkRag-Eval
summary: Near-identical passages can differ in a decisive condition, such as negation. A ranker may order such a pair correctly while placing the preferred passage far down the retrieved list. We examine this distinction using official NevIR pairs jointly covered by fixed candidate pools from dense, learned sparse, and BM25 retrieval. On 2,736 Test query directions, a pairwise-trained ranker improves strict per-query preference over fixed fusion (56.62% versus 52.30%) while reducing preferred-passage mean reciprocal rank (MRR) from 0.5764 to 0.3055. An exploratory fixed-model replay of a variant with background sampling and revised supervision yields MRR of 0.5859 and strict preference of 54.53%. Bounded pointwise reranking of the fusion top 20 improves both outcomes. Qwen3-14B-AWQ with fusion tie-breaking reaches 77.45% strict preference, 58.99% NevIR-style paired accuracy across 1,363 complete pairs, and preferred-passage MRR of 0.7509. A BGE cross-encoder reaches 69.77% strict preference and MRR of 0.7404. A post-hoc analysis finds that the branch where equal Qwen grades for the two designated passages trigger fusion tie-breaking accounts for 27% of evaluated directions and contains most remaining strict-preference failures. These findings support joint evaluation of pairwise preference, designated-passage position, and computational cost, while distinguishing model judgments from the combined ranking procedure.

AI.tldr: 本文用官方NevIR近义对（同一候选池）联合评估“成对偏好”与“首选段落位置”，发现成对训练排序器虽提升严格逐查询偏好（56.62% vs 52.30%），却使首选段落MRR从0.5764降至0.3055；有界逐点重排可同时改善两者，Qwen3-14B-AWQ结合融合平局打破达77.45%严格偏好、58.99%配对准确率、MRR 0.7509。
AI.motivation: 近义段落仅差一个决定性条件（如否定）时，排序器可能“对的顺序、错的位置”：把偏好段落排对相对次序但排在列表很靠后。仅看成对偏好会掩盖这一缺陷，需同时考察设计段落位置与计算成本。
AI.method: 在dense、学习型稀疏与BM25检索固定候选池共同覆盖的官方NevIR对（2,736条Test查询方向）上，比较成对训练排序器与固定融合；做含背景采样与修订监督的变体固定模型回放；对融合top-20进行有界逐点重排；对比Qwen3-14B-AWQ（融合平局打破）与BGE交叉编码器；并做事后分析定位剩余失败来源。
AI.result: 成对排序器严格偏好56.62%（固定融合52.30%），但首选段落MRR由0.5764降至0.3055；变体回放MRR 0.5859、严格偏好54.53%。有界逐点重排两项均改善。Qwen3-14B-AWQ达77.45%严格偏好、1,363完整对上58.99% NevIR式配对准确率、MRR 0.7509；BGE交叉编码器69.77%严格偏好、MRR 0.7404。两段落Qwen评分相等触发平局打破的分支占27%评测方向，并包含多数剩余严格偏好失败。
AI.conclusion: 需联合评估成对偏好、设计段落位置与计算成本，并区分“模型判断”与“整体排序流程”的贡献；平局打破机制是剩余误差的主要来源。

title: What Is Under the Hood? A Cross-Ecosystem Study of Vulnerable Dependencies in Construction Software
summary: The construction industry increasingly relies on software built from third-party components, yet the dependency composition and known-vulnerability exposure of construction-related software remain poorly analyzed. In this study, we conduct an empirical, cross-ecosystem investigation of 904 construction-related GitHub repositories spanning six construction functions and a multifunction category. Using commit-pinned repository snapshots and OSV-Scanner, we examine dependency assessability, known-vulnerability prevalence, severity, weakness classifications, and shared upstream exposure. Our results reveal that only 494 repositories (54.6%) completed vulnerability assessment, revealing substantial gaps in dependency visibility. Among successfully scanned repositories, 395 (80.0%) contained at least one dependency version associated with a published vulnerability advisory, and 97.2% of affected repositories contained a High or Critical severity risk. Additionally, Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) mapping identified recurring resource-consumption, path-traversal, information-exposure, and code-injection weaknesses. Vulnerability burden was uneven, with a median of 50 distinct advisory clusters per affected repository, while just two affected upstream package families collectively reached ~70% of affected repositories. These findings establish an empirical baseline for dependency assessability and known-vulnerability exposure in construction-related open-source software. Our findings underscore the importance of documenting assessment coverage, interpreting advisory matches in their deployment context, and examining shared upstream dependencies when evaluating construction software supply-chain security.

AI.tldr: 该研究对904个建筑相关GitHub仓库进行跨生态实证分析，仅54.6%可完成依赖漏洞评估，其中80.0%至少含一个已知漏洞，97.2%存在高危或严重风险。
AI.motivation: 建筑业软件日益依赖第三方组件，但建筑相关软件的依赖构成与已知漏洞暴露情况缺乏系统分析，供应链安全基线缺失。
AI.method: 对覆盖六类建筑功能及多功能类别的904个GitHub仓库，采用commit-pinned快照与OSV-Scanner，评估依赖可评估性、漏洞流行度、严重度、CWE弱點分类及共享上游暴露。
AI.result: 494个仓库(54.6%)完成评估；其中395个(80.0%)含至少一个存在公告漏洞的依赖版本，97.2%受影响仓库存在High/Critical风险；CWE映射显示资源消耗、路径遍历、信息暴露与代码注入为高频弱点；每仓库漏洞簇中位数50个，仅两个上游包族覆盖约70%受影响仓库。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了建筑开源软件依赖可评估性与已知漏洞暴露的实证基线，强调需记录评估覆盖率、结合部署情境解读漏洞匹配结果，并关注共享上游依赖的供应链风险。

title: From SEC Filings to Financial Signals: Evaluating LLMs on Stock Market Reactions and Analyst Forecasts
summary: Form 10-Q MD&A sections combine long-form management narrative with accounting and forward-looking information. Benchmarks for financial filings commonly evaluate question answering or numerical reasoning, leaving unclear whether outputs from large language models (LLMs) align with market and analyst outcomes. We evaluate prompted, zero-shot outputs from 13 general-purpose and finance-specialized LLMs on 45,964 Form 10-Q filing events from 2001 to 2024, linking MD&A text to cross-sectional fundamental ranks, pre-filing analyst forecasts, and realized abnormal returns. The evaluation covers return ranking under five controlled information views and next-quarter EPS forecasting under direct and consensus-anchored interfaces. Relative to disclosure alone, adding cross-sectional fundamental ranks raises mean effective-date rank correlation (RankIC) by 0.0089 for effective-event-date returns and 0.0098 for following-day returns, whereas analyst-summary context provides no comparable average gain. Across the four disclosure-containing views, finance-specialized models show an effective-event-date group advantage but no statistically reliable following-day advantage, while general-purpose Qwen models produce the strongest individual return-ranking results. Under the full-information view, direct LLM forecasts average the 43.4th percentile of the analyst distribution and do not consistently beat individual analysts. Consensus anchoring raises the mean inside-range share from 41.1% to 59.5% but increases reported-EPS error.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了13个大语言模型在45,964份10-Q MD&A事件上的零样本输出，检验其与基本面排名、分析师预测和实际异常收益的对齐程度，发现在收益排序和EPS预测上LLM仅部分可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有财报基准多聚焦问答或数值推理，无法说明LLM输出是否与市场结果和分析师判断一致，故需以真实市场信号为参照评估LLM对MD&A的处理能力。
AI.method: 对13个通用与金融专用LLM进行提示式零样本评估，覆盖2001–2024年45,964个10-Q事件；在5种受控信息视图下做收益排序任务，在直接与共识锚定两种接口下做下季度EPS预测，并与截面基本面排名、申报前分析师预测和实现异常收益对比。
AI.result: 加入截面基本面排名较仅披露文本将有效日RankIC提升0.0089、次日提升0.0098，分析师摘要上下文无平均增益；金融专用模型仅在有效事件日有组间优势、次日不显著，通用Qwen个体收益排序最强；全信息视图下直接预测平均处于分析师分布第43.4百分位，不能稳定超越个体分析师；共识锚定将区间内比例从41.1%升至59.5%但增大报告EPS误差。
AI.conclusion: LLM可部分捕获基本面排序信号但增益有限，EPS预测不及人类分析师，共识锚定改善区间覆盖却牺牲精度，说明当前LLM输出与市场/分析师结果的对齐仍不充分。

title: LatLM: Line-Parallel Language Models with Deferred Commitment
summary: Line-parallel language models advance multiple lines concurrently for substantial speedups. However, frameworks like the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM) enforce a fixed commitment schedule across lines. Because dependencies vary within text, a fixed schedule cannot hold back a line whose prerequisites remain uncomputed, forcing premature commitments and cascading reasoning errors. To address this limitation, we introduce the Lattice Language Model (LatLM), making commitment schedules an adaptive decoding-time choice. Text occupies a 2D lattice where eligible frontier tokens are scored each round; a policy commits confident candidates while deferring unready ones for extended context. One forward pass supervises entire sampled trajectories via 2D causal masking, while an append-only cache retains exact states. At 482M parameters, we establish two findings. (1) LatLM matches a data- and capacity-matched autoregressive model on held-out text when decoded sequentially, while its adaptive parallel decoder achieves near-autoregressive accuracy on independent-line tasks using 25--41% as many decoding rounds. (2) When cross-line dependencies cause LCLM's fixed schedule to fail, deferred commitment substantially improves accuracy while retaining parallelism where dependencies permit. On mixed dependency chains, LatLM achieves 96.5% accuracy versus LCLM's 78.5%, using fewer than half the decoding rounds of the autoregressive baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Lattice Language Model (LatLM)，将多行并行解码中的"提交调度"从固定策略改为自适应解码时决策，在二维格点上对前沿 token 打分并延迟未就绪 token，从而在保持并行加速的同时显著降低跨行依赖导致的推理错误。
AI.motivation: 现有行并行框架（如 LCLM）采用跨行固定的提交调度（fixed commitment schedule），但文本内部依赖关系因人而异、因位置而异。固定调度无法抑制那些前置依赖尚未计算的行，导致过早提交（premature commitment）并引发级联式推理错误。
AI.method: 1) 将文本布置在二维格点上，每轮对"可取的前沿 token"（eligible frontier tokens）打分；2) 引入解码策略，对高置信候选执行提交，对未就绪者延迟提交以获取更长上下文；3) 通过二维因果掩码（2D causal masking）以单次前向传播监督整条采样轨迹；4) 使用仅追加缓存（append-only cache）保留精确状态。
AI.result: 在 482M 参数规模下：(1) 顺序解码时，LatLM 与数据量和容量匹配的自回归模型在留出文本上表现相当；其自适应并行解码器在独立行任务上达到接近自回归的准确率，而解码轮数仅为其 25%–41%。(2) 当跨行依赖使 LCLM 固定调度失效时，延迟提交显著提升准确率，并在依赖允许处保持并行性。在混合依赖链上，LatLM 取得 96.5% 准确率，LCLM 为 78.5%，且 LatLM 的解码轮数不足自回归基线的一半。
AI.conclusion: 将提交调度视为可自适应的解码时选择，能够在不牺牲建模质量的前提下兼顾并行效率与依赖正确性；延迟提交是解决跨行依赖下级联错误的关键机制。

title: AGR: Agentic Generative Retrieval with Tool-Augmented Search
summary: Large-scale search and recommendation systems derive much of their retrieval quality from rich, heterogeneous features, yet existing generative retrieval (GR) methods struggle to exploit such feature ecosystems efficiently. Static feature injection either encodes all available signals or places them according to predetermined schemes, increasing serving cost and introducing irrelevant or conflicting evidence. More fundamentally, existing methods cannot adaptively determine when a feature is needed, which feature to select, or where it should influence hierarchical Semantic ID (SID) generation. We propose Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR), a tool-augmented paradigm that interleaves SID generation with on-demand feature acquisition. Conditioned on the request and decoded SID prefix, AGR decides whether to invoke a tool, which feature to acquire, and where its observation should influence subsequent decoding, thereby steering generation toward feature-consistent SID branches. To supervise this behavior, we construct tool-augmented trajectories based on feature applicability and information gain along the SID hierarchy, and train the model through SID pretraining followed by tool-augmented fine-tuning. Experiments on an industrial dataset and three public benchmarks, together with an online A/B test, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of AGR.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR)，一种工具增强的生成式检索范式，将SID生成与按需特征获取交织，使模型能自主动态决定何时、选取哪个、在何处注入特征，平衡检索质量与服务成本。
AI.motivation: 大规模搜索与推荐系统依赖丰富的异构特征提升检索质量，但现有生成式检索(GR)难以高效利用这类特征生态；静态特征注入要么编码全部信号、要么按预定方案放置，导致服务成本上升并引入无关或冲突证据。更根本地，现有方法无法自适应判断特征何时需要、选取哪一个、以及应在分层语义ID(SID)生成的何处产生影响。
AI.method: 以请求与已解码SID前缀为条件，AGR在生成过程中决策是否调用工具、获取哪个特征、以及观测结果应影响何处后续解码，从而将生成导向特征一致的SID分支；监督方面，依据特征在SID层级上的适用性与信息增益构建工具增强轨迹，并采用SID预训练+工具增强微调的两阶段训练。
AI.result: 在工业数据集与三个公开基准上，结合在线A/B测试，一致验证了AGR的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AGR通过工具增强的按需特征获取与动态注入，克服了静态特征注入的局限，为生成式检索中异构特征的高效利用提供了可行方案，并已在离线与在线场景均获验证。

title: From Finding to Fixing: How Useful is Fault Localization for Agentic Program Repair?
summary: Fault localization (FL) aims to identify code locations responsible for software failures and is commonly evaluated by how accurately it ranks known fault locations. Large language model (LLM) agents are changing program repair and are increasingly used to search and reason over repositories. Although recent LLM-based FL methods have improved localization accuracy, their impact on agentic repair remains unclear. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic empirical study of FL in agentic repair. We evaluate six recent FL methods on SWE-bench Verified and Defects4J with three LLMs under a common repair framework and analyze 16,248 repair trajectories. We also examine gold locations and bug-cause descriptions as forms of FL guidance across different repair contexts. The studied FL methods do not consistently improve repair success, and higher localization accuracy does not consistently lead to larger repair gains. Yet FL guides agents' early search and helps them reach relevant code sooner. Accurate locations can reduce repair token use by up to 39.2\%, but current FL methods often consume more tokens than they save during repair. Experiments with gold guidance suggest that FL has greater potential when bug inputs contain fewer location clues. Providing bug causes can further improve repair success beyond locations alone. We also find that ground truth from a single reference patch does not fully capture the locations used by successful repairs. These findings help clarify the value of FL in agentic repair and inform future work on its design and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 系统实证研究故障定位(FL)在智能体修复中的真实价值：6种FL方法×3个LLM×两个基准，分析16,248条修复轨迹，发现FL准确率与修复增益不一致，FL主要用于引导早期搜索、降低token消耗，bug原因描述比位置更有用。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体已广泛用于仓库级搜索与程序修复，近期LLM-based FL方法虽提升了定位精度，但其对智能体修复的实际影响尚不清楚；现有FL评估仅看排序精度，缺乏对下游修复效果的端到端考察，需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在统一修复框架下，于SWE-bench Verified与Defects4J上评测6种近期FL方法、3个LLM，分析16,248条修复轨迹；并考察gold locations与bug-cause描述作为FL引导在不同修复情境下的作用。
AI.result: FL方法并未稳定提升修复成功率，更高定位精度也未带来更大修复增益；但FL能引导智能体早期搜索、更快抵达相关代码。准确位置可使修复token消耗降低至多39.2%，然而现有FL方法自身开销常大于其节省。gold引导实验表明，当bug输入中位置线索较少时FL潜力更大；提供bug原因可带来超出位置的收益。单一参考补丁的ground truth不能完整覆盖成功修复实际使用的位置。
AI.conclusion: FL在智能体修复中的价值主要体现为导航与效率增益，而非成功率提升；需重新审视FL的设计目标与评估方式（超越排序精度、纳入bug原因与多参考位置），并为未来FL设计与基准构建提供依据。

title: SteerSearch: Interactive Search Reasoning with Mid-Response Steering
summary: Search-augmented language models increasingly serve as long-horizon research agents, yet most open training methods assume a fixed user goal throughout search. We study mid-response steering, where users redirect a model during ongoing reasoning or retrieval. We identify answer-target anchoring, a failure mode in which fixed-query search agents retrieve evidence for the updated request but still answer an earlier question. We introduce SteerSearch, an RL framework that trains on interactive search trajectories with injected interventions to enable context-preserving target reassignment, and SteerSearch-Bench, a benchmark adapted from multi-hop QA datasets. We also investigate Contrastive Context Reward (CCR), an auxiliary signal for aligning post-intervention reasoning with the updated goal. Without CCR, SteerSearch improves average steering accuracy over Search-R1 from 11.1% to 31.3% on Qwen2.5-3B and from 36.6% to 44.6% on Qwen3-4B, while preserving standard single-query performance. Gains also extend to larger Qwen2.5 models and natural multi-turn conversations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究搜索增强语言模型作为长时程研究代理时的"中途转向"（mid-response steering）问题，识别出"答案目标锚定"失败模式，并提出强化学习框架 SteerSearch、基准测试 SteerSearch-Bench 及对比上下文奖励（CCR）来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有开放式训练方法普遍假设整个搜索过程用户目标固定不变，而实际使用中用户常在模型推理或检索过程中改变请求。固定查询的搜索代理会出现"答案目标锚定"：虽为更新后的请求检索到证据，却仍回答先前问题。该失败模式尚未被系统研究和解决。
AI.method: 提出 SteerSearch 强化学习框架，在注入干预的交互式搜索轨迹上训练，实现保留上下文的"目标重分配"；构建由多跳 QA 数据集改编的 SteerSearch-Bench 基准；并探索 Contrastive Context Reward（CCR）作为辅助信号，使干预后的推理与更新目标对齐。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-3B 上，不加 CCR 的 SteerSearch 将平均转向准确率从 Search-R1 的 11.1% 提升至 31.3%；在 Qwen3-4B 上从 36.6% 提升至 44.6%，同时保持标准单查询性能。增益亦延伸至更大规模 Qwen2.5 模型及自然多轮对话。
AI.conclusion: 通过强化学习训练带干预的交互轨迹可有效缓解答案目标锚定，显著提升中途转向准确率且不损害原有单查询性能，并具备向更大模型与自然多轮场景的泛化性；CCR 作为辅助信号进一步帮助干预后推理与更新目标对齐。

title: DISCERN: Identifiable Disease Evidence for Generalizable Medical Multimodal Learning
summary: Clinical multimodal models can learn enrollment shortcuts shared across modalities and fail on new cohorts. We model these data through a latent structural causal model: disease state and background factors generate physiology through shared mechanisms, while cohorts differ in selection and measurement. Holding acquisition fixed, we identify conditional disease evidence without observing disease-state labels or recovering the full causal model. In common Gaussian coordinates, cross-cohort state alignment and natural-parameter changes identify a minimal selection statistic; conditioning on it removes enrollment-dependent evidence and yields an identifiable reference posterior within the specified shift family. State-dependent interactions can carry evidence invisible to individual-modality posteriors, motivating joint, information-preserving representations. DISCERN combines an information-lattice encoder, a latent-state model, and an outcome head through joint training. Under reversed synthetic enrollment on known latent coordinates, conditioning raises state AUROC from 0.043 to 0.883 and from 0.265 to 0.825, while random conditioning does not. Exploratory cross-database mortality experiments between eICU and MIMIC-IV improve AUROC over matched empirical risk minimization by 0.036 and 0.035. Learned-coordinate diagnostics distinguish preservation of state information from identification of the coordinates required by the estimator.

AI.tldr: 该论文建模临床多模态模型中的“入组捷径”（enrollment shortcut），提出基于潜结构因果模型的识别理论与DISCERN方法，在保持信息的前提下去除入组依赖证据，提升跨队列泛化。
AI.motivation: 临床多模态模型会学到跨模态共享的入组捷径，在新队列上失效。作者希望在固定采集条件、不观测疾病状态标签、也不恢复完整因果模型的前提下，识别条件性疾病的证据，从而消除入组依赖性偏差。
AI.method: 构建潜结构因果模型：疾病状态与背景因素经共享机制生成生理信号，队列间在选择与测量上有差异。在高斯坐标下，通过跨队列状态对齐与自然参数变化识别最小选择统计量，对其条件化得到可识别的参考后验。提出DISCERN，联合训练信息格编码器、潜状态模型与结局头。
AI.result: 在已知潜坐标的反向合成入组实验中，条件化将状态AUROC从0.043提升至0.883、从0.265提升至0.825，随机条件化无此效果。eICU与MIMIC-IV跨库死亡率探索性实验中，AUROC相较匹配的经验风险最小化分别提升0.036与0.035。
AI.conclusion: 条件化最小选择统计量可移除入组依赖证据并得到可识别参考后验；状态依赖交互携带单模态后验不可见的证据，支持联合且信息保持的表示。学到的坐标诊断可区分状态信息保留与估计器所需坐标的识别。

title: SWE-Residual: Evaluating Starting-State Robustness of Coding Agents
summary: Software engineering (SWE) benchmarks are the primary way to measure the capabilities of coding agents: an agent is placed in a code repository or machine environment, given a request, and judged by hidden tests. These benchmarks almost always start the agent from a clean state that contains no earlier work on the task. In practice, however, agents often continue work that a developer or another agent has already done and reported as complete, with no indication of what remains incorrect or missing. We introduce SWE-Residual, a benchmark for Starting-State Robustness: the ability to maintain performance on a task when the starting state already contains earlier work on that task. SWE-Residual contains 198 Residual States drawn from 111 tasks in DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench, where the earlier work modifies a code repository or a whole machine environment. Each Residual State is the state a predecessor agent left behind after submitting its work as complete, although the hidden tests still fail. The evaluated agent receives only the original request and this state, without the predecessor's trajectory or any sign that the attempt failed; because the request and hidden tests are unchanged, the starting state is the only difference from the source benchmark. Across five frontier agents, success drops by 20.6--53.5 percentage points on DeepSWE and 20.6--34.9 points on Terminal-Bench relative to a Clean Start, and agent rankings on DeepSWE reverse. Failed continuations show a pattern we call acceptance bias: agents treat the inherited work as the definition of what remains to be done instead of checking it against the request. On DeepSWE, in 58.9--88.2% of failed runs, they submit with exactly the same tests failing, although they pass most of these tests from a Clean Start. SWE-Residual thus exposes a capability gap that clean-start evaluation does not capture.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SWE-Residual 基准，用于衡量编码智能体的"起始状态鲁棒性"——在已有前序（未真正完成）工作残留的仓库/环境上继续任务时保持性能的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 SWE 基准几乎总是让智能体从干净状态开始，而真实场景中智能体常接手开发者或其他智能体已"宣称完成"、实际仍存在错误或缺失的工作，且无任何失败提示。这种能力缺口未被现有评估覆盖。
AI.method: 构建 SWE-Residual，含来自 DeepSWE 与 Terminal-Bench 的 111 个任务抽取出的 198 个"残留状态"（Residual State）。每个状态为前序智能体提交后隐藏测试仍失败的现场；被测智能体仅获得原始请求与该状态，不含前序轨迹或失败信号。由于请求与隐藏测试不变，起始状态是相对原基准的唯一变量。
AI.result: 五个前沿智能体上，成功率相对干净起始分别下降：DeepSWE 20.6–53.5 个百分点，Terminal-Bench 20.6–34.9 个百分点；DeepSWE 上的智能体排名发生反转。失败续作呈现"接受偏差"（acceptance bias）：在 DeepSWE 上 58.9–88.2% 的失败运行以完全相同失败测试提交，而这些测试多数在干净起始下可被通过。
AI.conclusion: 干净起始评估无法反映接手残留工作时的能力缺口；SWE-Residual 揭示了智能体倾向于将继承工作视为剩余任务定义、而非对照请求校验的行为模式。

title: Not Every User Says It All: Training Tool-Using Agents Beyond Ideal Simulated Users
summary: Tool-using agents are trained and evaluated almost exclusively with strong simulated users who state every detail clearly, yet real users are often weaker. We construct weak users by masking sentences of a simulated user's replies, holding the task and the user's knowledge fixed, and cross-evaluate agents trained with strong and weak users on tau2-bench and ToolWOZ. Weak users lower the success of every policy, and training with them does not help: no policy trained with weak users, through fixed masks, mixtures or a curriculum, serves weak users better than the strong-trained policy beyond run-to-run noise, and prompting the agent to ask more does not help either. We propose StaGPO (State-Grouped Policy Optimization): the agent writes what the task needs, what is missing and how it is being filled, and GRPO uses this state to compare turns of different rollouts that reach the same situation, assigning step-level credit. Within the standard recipe of a small SFT cold start followed by RL, StaGPO makes weak-user training useful: on ToolWOZ, the Qwen3.5-2B policy trained with weak users reaches 76.8% with weak users, the highest of any Qwen3.5-2B policy we trained, 4.8 points above GRPO and 2.8 above the strongest baseline; it is also 5.4 points above GRPO with strong users, and generalises to an unseen mask rate; trained with strong users instead, it serves weak users at least as well as GRPO trained with weak users. On tau2-bench it scores highest with weak users for both models, by a small margin for Qwen3.5-4B.

AI.tldr: 论文构建“弱用户”设定（掩码模拟用户回复中的句子），发现弱用户会降低所有策略的成功率，且用弱用户训练（固定掩码/混合/课程）无法带来收益；提出StaGPO，让智能体显式写出任务需求、缺失信息及其填充方式，并据此将不同rollout中处于同一状态的轮次分组，实现步级信用分配；在标准SFT冷启动+RL流程下，StaGPO使弱用户训练变得有效。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用智能体的训练与评测几乎都基于“强模拟用户”（把每个细节都说清楚），而真实用户往往更弱、信息表达不完整。作者希望系统考察：弱用户是否会损害性能，以及能否通过训练让智能体适应弱用户。
AI.method: 1) 弱用户构造：对模拟用户回复做句子级掩码，保持任务与用户知识不变，在tau2-bench与ToolWOZ上交叉评测强弱用户训练得到的策略；2) 尝试固定掩码、混合、课程学习以及“更多提问”提示等基线；3) 提出StaGPO：智能体写出任务需求、缺失信息及填补方式，形成显式状态表示，GRPO利用该状态将不同rollout中到达相同情境的轮次进行比较，从而赋予步级信用；采用小规模SFT冷启动后接RL的标准配方。
AI.result: 弱用户降低所有策略成功率；弱用户训练（固定掩码/混合/课程）与“多提问”提示均未超越强用户训练策略（超出运行间噪声）。加入StaGPO后：ToolWOZ上Qwen3.5-2B用弱用户训练达76.8%（所训Qwen3.5-2B策略中最高），比GRPO高4.8分、比最强基线高2.8分；对强用户比GRPO高5.4分；可泛化到未见掩码率；改用强用户训练时，服务弱用户效果至少不逊于用弱用户训练的GRPO。tau2-bench上两个模型在弱用户条件下均为最高，Qwen3.5-4B为小幅领先。
AI.conclusion: 弱用户是真实且难以通过朴素数据增广或提示缓解的挑战；关键在于步级信用分配。StaGPO通过显式状态刻画与跨rollout同状态轮次分组，使弱用户训练产生实际收益，并在强用户与未见掩码率下保持泛化。

title: Physics-Aware Self-Supervised Pretraining on Multi-Domain Raman Spectra
summary: Raman spectroscopy generates large volumes of unlabeled data that are difficult to exploit with conventional supervised learning. This work introduces a multi-domain self-supervised learning framework based on a masked autoencoder (MAE) for learning transferable Raman spectral representations from heterogeneous biological, chemical, forensic, and materials datasets. The proposed pretraining strategy incorporates physics-aware objectives by combining masked intensity reconstruction with a sparse Voigt-profile decoder that models spectral peak structure through differentiable peak centers, widths, and amplitudes. A denoising objective is further included to improve robustness to spectral corruption. The learned encoder is evaluated on substance classification, component identification, concentration estimation, and spectral denoising under linear probing, attention-based probing, end-to-end fine-tuning, and training from scratch. Experimental results show that self-supervised pretraining is most beneficial for challenging tasks with limited labeled data. Attention-based probing also reveals substantially more useful information in the frozen representation than linear probing, indicating that conventional linear evaluation may underestimate representation quality. In addition, the benefits of pretraining become more pronounced with increasing encoder capacity. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates that physics-aware, multi-domain self-supervised pretraining can improve label efficiency, robustness, and transferability across diverse Raman spectroscopy tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出基于掩码自编码器（MAE）的多域自监督框架，结合物理感知目标从异质拉曼光谱数据学习可迁移表征，在有限标注与多种下游任务上提升标注效率、鲁棒性与迁移性。
AI.motivation: 拉曼光谱产生大量无标注数据，传统监督学习难以充分利用；需要一种能从异质（生物、化学、法医、材料）数据中学习通用表征的预训练方法。
AI.method: 多域MAE自监督预训练；物理感知目标：掩码强度重建 + 稀疏Voigt峰型解码器（可微的峰中心、峰宽、峰幅度建模谱峰结构）；另加去噪目标以增强对光谱退化的鲁棒性；下游评估涵盖物质分类、组分识别、浓度估计、光谱去噪，评测方式包括线性探测、注意力探测、端到端微调与从头训练。
AI.result: 自监督预训练在标注数据有限的困难任务上收益最大；注意力探测从冻结表征中提取的信息显著多于线性探测，说明常规线性评估可能低估表征质量；预训练收益随编码器容量增大而更明显。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知、多域自监督预训练可提升拉曼光谱多任务中的标注效率、鲁棒性与迁移能力；线性探测作为评估手段存在低估偏倚。

title: Toward Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Retail Workflows over Heterogeneous Data Sources
summary: Enterprise retail workflows require agents to chain evidence across heterogeneous sources, from structured product and order records to unstructured inquiries and reviews, yet existing agentic RAG benchmarks rarely capture this challenge. To enable controlled evaluation of such workflows, we introduce RetailBridge, a compositional retail benchmark built from persona-driven simulations. Its questions are constructed by linking entities and intermediate answers across heterogeneous sources, requiring agents to identify the relevant sources, carry evidence between them, and produce a grounded answer. To systematically evaluate LLMs on these retail workflows, we develop RetailRAG, a retail-aware framework equipped with auto-schema briefing, source-routed plan chaining, and diagnostic plan revision. RetailRAG consistently outperforms existing agentic RAG baselines across all evaluation axes, serving as a strong reference system for assessing LLM agents on retail workflows. On RetailBridge, evaluating ten LLM backbones with RetailRAG reveals multi-source chaining as the dominant bottleneck across providers and model scales, suggesting that reliable retail agents require explicit cross-source orchestration rather than scaling alone. Code and data are publicly available at \url{https://github.com/DISL-Lab/RetailBridge}.

AI.tldr: 提出零售领域组合式基准RetailBridge及零售感知框架RetailRAG，用于评测大模型智能体在异构多源证据链上的检索与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 企业零售工作流要求智能体在异构来源（结构化产品与订单记录、非结构化问询与评论）之间串联证据，而现有智能体化RAG基准难以刻画这一挑战，缺乏可控评测手段。
AI.method: 构建RetailBridge基准：基于人物画像模拟生成数据，通过跨异构源链接实体与中间答案构造问题，迫使智能体识别相关源、在源间传递证据并给出有依据的回答。同时提出RetailRAG框架，包含自动模式简报（auto-schema briefing）、源路由规划链（source-routed plan chaining）与诊断式规划修订（diagnostic plan revision）。
AI.result: RetailRAG在所有评测维度上稳定优于现有智能体化RAG基线，可作为零售工作流的强参考系统；在RetailBridge上用RetailRAG评测十个LLM骨干模型，发现多源证据链是最主要瓶颈，跨越不同厂商与模型规模普遍存在。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的零售智能体需要显式的跨源编排机制，而非单纯依赖模型规模扩展；RetailBridge与RetailRAG提供了可控评测与参考实现，代码与数据已公开。

title: Function Contracts for Bounded Model Checking of C Programs
summary:
Bounded model checking unrolls a program into a single formula, so a function holding a loop costs the solver a fresh copy of that loop at every call site. Function contracts break that coupling. Verify the body once against its contract, then replace each call by a stub derived from it. CBMC supports this through dynamic frame condition checking, applied at industrial scale, but with no formal account of why the replacement is sound and no characterisation of what the frame check costs.
  We present the function-contract framework for ESBMC. The clause syntax, both phases, and the first assigns enforcement the tool has had are all introduced here. Its technical core is an observational frame rule: snapshot the locations the contract does not permit the function to write, then compare them at exit. The encoding emits a number of verification conditions set by how many globals the program has, not by how many writes the body performs, while dynamic frame condition checking grows with the write count. That is a property of the encoding rather than a timing, so it moves with neither the machine nor the solver. The rule itself is the classical one; what we add is its bounded form inside a BMC encoding, with the pipeline's algebraic skeleton machine-checked in Lean 4 and the limits of that model stated.
  We evaluate on synthetic sweeps, SV-COMP tasks, an ANSSI X.509 parser, the FreeRTOS heap_1 allocator, and the ML-KEM reference implementation whose CBMC contracts we reuse unchanged. At the coefficient count FIPS-203 mandates, neither tool finishes on the monolithic route inside ten minutes, and both finish on the modular one. The framework is merged into ESBMC master. Contracts are what is left when unrolling runs out of room.

AI.tldr: ESBMC 引入函数契约框架（基于可观察帧规则的有界形式），以桩替换调用，使验证条件数只随全局变量数增长而非写操作数增长；在 ML-KEM、FreeRTOS、ANSSI X.509 等基准上与 CBMC 对比，模块化路线可完成任务而整体展开在 10 分钟内无法完成。
AI.motivation: 有界模型检验把程序展开为单一公式，含循环的函数在每个调用点都要付出该循环的一份新拷贝，导致规模爆炸。函数契约可打破这种耦合：先针对契约验证函数体一次，再用契约派生的桩替换各调用点。CBMC 已支持动态帧条件检查并在工业规模使用，但缺少替换为何可靠的形式化说明，也未刻画帧检查的代价。
AI.method: 提出 ESBMC 的函数契约框架，包含子句语法、两个阶段，以及该工具首个 assigns 强制检查。技术核心为可观察帧规则：在入口快照契约不允许函数写入的位置，在退出处比较；其有界形式嵌入 BMC 编码，验证条件数量由全局变量数决定（而非函数体写次数），与 CBMC 动态帧条件检查随写次数增长的特性形成对比；流水线代数骨架在 Lean 4 中机器检查，并说明该模型的适用边界。
AI.result: 在合成扫描、SV-COMP 任务、ANSSI X.509 解析器、FreeRTOS heap_1 分配器及复用其 CBMC 契约的 ML-KEM 参考实现上评估；在 FIPS-203 规定的系数规模下，整体展开路线两种工具均无法在十分钟内完成，而模块化路线均能完成。框架已合入 ESBMC master。
AI.conclusion: 函数契约在展开失去可行性时提供了可行的模块化验证途径；所提编码的验证条件规模不随写次数增长且与机器和求解器无关，属编码性质而非计时；帧规则为经典规则的 BMC 有界化，其形式化模型在 Lean 4 中机器检查并明确限定适用范围。

title: Who Speaks, Who Authorizes, Who Acts? Understanding Trust Boundaries in Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems exchange messages before acting through tools, but message delivery, signing authority, and tool-side enforcement are separate trust boundaries. We represent them as communication, authorization, and execution structures, and use the authority cut to characterize the smallest independently compromised signer coalition that can construct a policy-valid false-claim proof under stated assumptions. Controlled paired hidden-state studies reveal four distinctions. First, no fixed-message routing contrast across four models meets the prespecified large-effect criterion; when relays rewrite messages, executed false-state action rates vary by model and route configuration. Second, presented source-identity cues do not uniformly increase protected-action selection across three models. Third, on invalid-proof cases, Nemotron and Llama request protected actions in 52.1% and 54.2% of trials, respectively, yet a deterministic tool gate commits none: request-level and commitment-level safety readouts diverge. Finally, a separate single-model authorization check shows that a false claim with a policy-valid compromised-signer proof can pass the gate, since proof validity is not factual truth. These findings motivate evaluating delivered information, qualified authorization, model proposals, and committed actions separately.

AI.tldr: 论文将多智能体LLM系统中的信任边界形式化为通信、授权与执行三类结构，提出"authority cut"刻画能构造策略有效虚假声明证明的最小独立被入侵签名者联盟；受控隐藏状态配对实验揭示路由改写、来源身份线索、请求级与承诺级安全读数分离、以及证明有效性≠事实真实性四类区分，主张分层评估投递信息、限定授权、模型提议与已承诺动作。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统在调用工具前交换消息，但消息投递、签名权限与工具侧执行属于彼此独立的信任边界，现有评估常将其混同，导致无法定位安全失效发生在哪一环节，因此需要形式化边界并区分不同层面的安全读数。
AI.method: 将三类边界表示为通信结构、授权结构与执行结构，并以authority cut刻画在给定假设下可构造策略有效虚假声明证明的最小被入侵签名者联盟；开展受控配对的隐藏状态研究，跨多个模型比较固定消息路由与中继改写消息两种条件下的已执行虚假状态动作率、来源身份线索对受保护动作选择的影响、无效证明情形下的请求与提交差异，以及单模型授权检查中策略有效但事实虚假的证明能否通过门控。
AI.result: (1) 四个模型均无固定消息路由对比达到预设大效应标准；当中继改写消息时，已执行虚假状态动作率随模型与路由配置而变化。(2) 来源身份线索在三个模型中并未一致提升受保护动作选择。(3) 在无效证明情形下，Nemotron与Llama分别有52.1%与54.2%的试验请求受保护动作，但确定性工具门控零提交，请求级与承诺级安全性出现分离。(4) 单独的单模型授权检查显示，携带策略有效被入侵签名者证明的虚假声明可通过门控，因证明有效性并不等于事实真实性。
AI.conclusion: 安全评估应分层进行，分别考察投递信息、限定授权、模型提议与已承诺动作，而非以单一读数代替；授权层的形式有效性与事实真实性必须解耦，工具侧强制门控对承诺级安全具有决定性作用。

title: UltraData-Code: From Raw Repositories to Algorithmically Dense and Task-Oriented Code Data
summary: Code generation has become a core capability of large language models (LLMs), and code data is central to the pre-training process that develops it. As obtaining public code of sufficient quality becomes more difficult, further progress cannot rely on corpus expansion alone. Tiered data management instead applies increasingly targeted processing to smaller data pools, producing data states suited to different training objectives. Following this perspective, we present UltraData-Code as four connected data states spanning repository archival at L0, standardized natural code at L1, algorithmic selection at L2, and task-oriented synthesis at L3. L0 preserves repository data and provenance for reprocessing, while L1 applies scalable filtering, normalization, and near-deduplication for broad pre-training. L2 selects high-quality algorithmically relevant files using language-adaptive relevance signals and quality constraints, yielding approximately 400B tokens of UltraData-Code-L2 across 11 programming languages for focused continual pre-training. L3 converts selected implementations into structured programming exercises, yielding approximately 150B tokens of UltraData-Code-L3 across the same 11 languages for task-oriented mid-training or supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Under controlled 10B-token continual pre-training of a 1B model, L2 improves pass@1 over L1 by 7.80 percentage points (pp) on EvalPlus and 5.13pp on MultiPL-E. Replacing half of the L2 training tokens with L3 yields a further gain of 8.42pp and 8.07pp on the two benchmarks, respectively. Both gains increase when the training budget scales to 100B tokens. We have released our datasets and classifiers to support further research on LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出UltraData-Code分层数据管理体系（L0-L3四个数据状态），构建约400B token的L2算法相关语料与约150B token的L3任务化语料，在1B模型受控持续预训练中显著提升代码生成性能，并开源数据集与分类器。
AI.motivation: 高质量公开代码数据获取日益困难，代码生成能力提升不能仅依赖语料规模扩张，需通过分层数据管理对更小的数据池施加针对性处理，以匹配不同训练目标。
AI.method: 构建四个连贯数据状态：L0保留仓库原始数据与溯源信息以支持再处理；L1进行可扩展过滤、归一化与近去重，服务广泛预训练；L2基于语言自适应相关性信号与质量约束筛选高质量算法相关文件，覆盖11种编程语言（约400B token）；L3将选中实现转化为结构化编程练习（约150B token），用于任务导向的中期训练或SFT。实验采用1B模型、10B token受控持续预训练，并在EvalPlus与MultiPL-E上评测。
AI.result: 10B token持续预训练下，L2较L1在EvalPlus上pass@1提升7.80pp、MultiPL-E提升5.13pp；将一半L2训练token替换为L3后，两项基准再提升8.42pp与8.07pp。训练预算扩大至100B token时，两类增益均进一步增大。
AI.conclusion: 分层、多状态的数据管理可有效替代单纯语料扩张，L2筛选与L3任务化合成均带来可观且随训练预算增长而放大的收益；已开源数据集与分类器以支持后续研究。

title: Bridging Concepts: Multi-Agent Reasoning over Scientific Concept Graphs for High-Impact Research Prediction
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, The 3rd Workshop on Knowledge-Enhanced Information Retrieval (KEIR) at The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Within a research community, new topics often emerge when previously unconnected concepts are first studied together. We construct scientific concept graphs (SCGs)--domain knowledge graphs whose nodes are fine-grained research concepts extracted from paper text by LLMs and whose edges capture their co-occurrence in papers--and study the task of forecasting high-impact concept pairs, i.e., discovering concept pairs that are currently unconnected but will have high impact when connected. To this end, we introduce new benchmark datasets constructed from CIKM, KDD, and SIGIR conference papers, with varied prediction settings, including impact forecasting for emerging concepts unseen during training. We propose MiroGraph, a Multi-agent reasoning framework with scientific concept Graphs, in which a feature designer agent designs predictive features for a given concept pair from structural, semantic, and trend perspectives, and then three LLM agents compute the actual feature values from the enclosing subgraph of the concept pair. Using these feature values, a classifier designer agent constructs a classifier that predicts the final impact labels. MiroGraph outperforms various impact forecasting and temporal link prediction methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建科学概念图（SCG）并提出"高影响力概念对预测"任务，发布基于CIKM/KDD/SIGIR的基准数据集，提出多智能体推理框架MiroGraph，性能优于多种影响力预测与时间链路预测方法。
AI.motivation: 研究社区中的新主题往往源于此前未被关联的概念首次被共同研究。现有工作缺乏对"尚未连接但一旦连接将产生高影响力"的概念对的系统预测，也缺少相应基准与能够融合结构、语义与趋势信息的建模框架。
AI.method: 1）用LLM从论文文本抽取细粒度研究概念作为节点，以论文内共现作为边，构建领域知识图谱SCG；2）定义高影响力概念对预测任务并构建CIKM/KDD/SIGIR基准数据集，涵盖不同预测设定，包括训练中未出现的新兴概念；3）提出MiroGraph多智能体框架：特征设计智能体从结构、语义、趋势三个视角设计特征，三个LLM智能体在概念对的包围子图上计算特征值，分类器设计智能体据此构建分类器输出影响力标签。
AI.result: MiroGraph在影响力预测与时间链路预测等多类基线方法上均取得更优表现。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM概念抽取与图结构结合、并以多智能体自动完成特征设计与计算，可有效预测高影响力概念对，为科学创新机会发现提供可行范式。

title: The EBC Proportionality Law: A Recurring Architectural-Role Pattern Across Java Software
summary: Architectural roles describe how responsibilities are distributed within software systems. Entity--Boundary--Control (EBC) separates domain information, external interaction, and workflow coordination, but its proportions across diverse software remain unclear. This study examines file-level classifier-derived EBC proportionality in 1,556,985 Java files from 732 project instances and 78 functional categories. A classifier trained on labels generated by a large language model assigned one representative role per file. The labels were aggregated at project and functional-category levels and analysed using descriptive statistics and density-based clustering. The results show that Entity was less common than Boundary and Control. The dominant cluster covered 48 categories, 472 project instances, and 47.75% of classified files; its mean composition was 13.25% Entity, 42.65% Boundary, and 44.10% Control. The remaining 30 categories form one alternative and 11 smaller specialised patterns. Some selected variations were consistent with category responsibilities, while others received mixed support. Agreement with independent expert labels was limited (31.37% accuracy; macro-F1 0.31; Entity recall 13%). All reported proportions and clusters are therefore patterns in classifier-assigned roles, not verified architectural ground truth. Within this measurement boundary, the study provides a large-scale empirical reference of EBC distributions at the file level, and it documents the limitations of the automated approach.

AI.tldr: 该研究用LLM生成标签训练文件级分类器，对1,556,985个Java文件（732个项目实例、78个功能类别）进行EBC角色划分，统计其比例分布并做密度聚类，给出大规模经验参考并说明自动化标注的局限。
AI.motivation: Entity–Boundary–Control（EBC）将领域信息、外部交互与流程协调分离，但在多样软件中三者的比例分布尚不清楚，缺少大规模经验证据。
AI.method: 以LLM生成的标签训练文件级分类器，为每个文件分配一个代表性EBC角色；在项目层与功能类别层聚合标签，使用描述性统计与基于密度的聚类分析比例结构。
AI.result: Entity少于Boundary和Control。主导簇覆盖48个功能类别、472个项目实例及47.75%的已分类文件，平均构成为13.25% Entity、42.65% Boundary、44.10% Control；其余30个类别构成1个替代模式与11个较小的专门化模式。部分差异与类别职责一致，部分证据混杂。与独立专家标签一致度有限（准确率31.37%、macro-F1 0.31、Entity召回13%）。
AI.conclusion: 所报告的比例与聚类仅为分类器指派角色的模式，而非经核实的架构真值；在此测量边界内，研究提供了文件级EBC分布的大规模经验参考，并记录了自动化方法的局限。

title: CME-SpectrumBench: Can LLMs Analyze Condensed Matter Spectral Data?
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are presently well assessed by expert-level mathematics and physics benchmarks which focus on theoretical, symbolic reasoning. However, we lack experimental benchmarks that evaluate data analysis in frontier research problems, a capability that future domain-specific foundation models must have. To this end, we present CME-SpectrumBench, an expert-designed benchmark consisting of 190 questions that measures how reliably frontier LLMs analyze research-level spectral scientific data in condensed matter experiments (CME). Using simulated CME spectral data, we prompt models to identify structures from 2D intensity arrays in the face of noise and limited instrumental resolution, a test of dense context reasoning. Models are scored by how accurately their numerical answers approach the ground truth. Under direct query, scores generally pale in comparison to handwritten code due to clear failure modes: models can find simple features but struggle to trace patterns or compute derived quantities, and performance typically degrades with increased data resolution and noise/convolution levels. LLM performance becomes comparable to handwritten code by allowing tool use (access to a Python interpreter) with/without ReAct prompting, in effect mapping questions onto agentic code generation problems. Our findings show that frontier models can serve as research assistants by interfacing with data through code, but still face difficulties processing information directly from large datasets - a key barrier future foundation models must overcome. The code and data are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jingene/CMESpectrumBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CME-SpectrumBench，一个由专家设计的190题基准，用于评估前沿LLM分析凝聚态实验（CME）研究级光谱数据的能力。结果显示直接提问时模型分数远低于手写代码，失败模式清晰；但在允许工具使用（Python解释器）配合ReAct提示后，性能可与手写代码相当。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评测集中于专家级数学与物理的理论、符号推理，缺乏评估前沿研究中数据分析能力的实验性基准；而未来领域专用基础模型必须具备该能力，尤其是从高噪声、有限仪器分辨率的2D强度阵列中识别结构这类密集上下文推理任务。
AI.method: 构建CME-SpectrumBench：基于模拟CME光谱数据，专家设计190道问题；要求模型从含噪声与卷积（有限仪器分辨率）的2D强度阵列中识别结构，考察密集上下文推理；以数值答案逼近真值的准确度评分；对比直接查询、手写代码基线，以及带/不带ReAct提示的工具调用（Python解释器）设置。
AI.result: 直接查询下模型得分为普遍低于手写代码，失败模式明确：能识别简单特征，但难以追踪图案或计算派生量；性能随数据分辨率提升及噪声/卷积水平增加而下降。启用工具使用（可访问Python解释器）并配合或不配合ReAct提示后，LLM性能与手写代码相当，实质将问题映射为智能体式代码生成任务。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型可通过代码与数据交互从而充当科研助手，但仍难以直接从大规模数据集中处理信息——这是未来基础模型必须克服的关键障碍。代码与数据已公开于Hugging Face。

title: SPADE-KD: Peer-to-Peer Collaborative Learning under Heterogeneous Settings
summary: Peer-to-peer collaborative learning is an emerging distributed deep learning paradigm that eliminates the need for a central aggregator and disseminator, avoiding the single-point-of-failure and bottleneck issues they can bring. Many such approaches use parameter averaging, requiring clients to have homogeneous model architectures, whereas others use knowledge distillation as an alternative while leaning on shared public data or centralized control infrastructure. Many of these approaches also make a one-size-fits-all assumption, i.e., jointly training a single, globally optimal solution for all clients, when in reality, clients' underlying data distributions might differ such that a globally optimal solution may not be locally optimal for all clients. To enable collaborative learning in environments with both model architecture and data distribution heterogeneity, we present SPADE-KD -- a fully decentralized model distillation framework that optimizes collaboration towards personalized rather than global performance. SPADE-KD leverages two mechanisms -- adaptive distillation and utility-driven peer selection. Adaptive distillation modulates the strength of each incoming model transfer by the performance advantage of the incoming model compared to the native model measured by their task losses, such that a client will distill more aggressively from incoming models that outperform it on its own local data. Utility-driven peer selection uses the loss-informed utility derived from adaptive distillation to rank prospective partners, focusing on exchanges that measurably improve the local model while suppressing low-utility transfers. Using federated classification tasks, we demonstrate that SPADE-KD consistent outperforms naive decentralized distillation with lower loss and faster convergence and that its individual components are more effective together than independently.

AI.tldr: SPADE-KD 是一个完全去中心化的模型蒸馏框架，通过自适应蒸馏与效用驱动的对端选择，在模型架构和数据分布双重异构环境下实现个性化协作学习。
AI.motivation: 现有对等协作学习存在三点局限：(1) 参数平均要求客户端模型架构同构；(2) 知识蒸馏方案依赖共享公开数据或集中式控制；(3) 普遍假设训练单一全局最优解，而客户端数据分布异质时全局最优未必局部最优。
AI.method: 提出 SPADE-KD，包含两个机制：一是自适应蒸馏，依据传入模型与本地模型在其本地数据上的任务损失所体现的性能优势来调节迁移强度，对优于本地模型的传入模型更激进地蒸馏；二是效用驱动的对端选择，利用自适应蒸馏产生的损失信息效用对候选伙伴排序，聚焦能可测地提升本地模型的交换并抑制低效用迁移。
AI.result: 在联邦分类任务上，SPADE-KD 相较朴素去中心化蒸馏具有更低损失和更快收敛，且两个组件协同使用优于各自独立使用。
AI.conclusion: SPADE-KD 可在无中心节点、无共享数据条件下同时应对架构与数据异构，实现面向个性化而非全局性能的协作学习。

title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
summary: While retrieval-augmented language models increasingly serve as literature assistants in the physical sciences, existing benchmarks evaluate them primarily on qualitative text overlap or through model-based scoring rather than against verified experimental ground truth. In experimental materials disciplines such as perovskite photovoltaics, however, the most critical inquiries are inherently quantitative and aggregate measurements across dozens or hundreds of papers. Here, we present a quantitative question-answering benchmark where all 755 ground-truth answers are computed directly from 45,441 measured device records (40,889 human-curated records through 2021 and 4,552 records extracted from 2022-2026 literature). Benchmarking six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers using an open 14B model on a single 24 GB GPU, standard passage retrieval tops out at 16-23% accuracy (compared to 1.6-6.5% zero-shot). In contrast, equipping the language model with read-only SQL execution over the structured device table elevates accuracy to 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature -- a 33.01.8 percentage-point advantage over hybrid text retrieval. Aggregate queries spanning extrema, distributions, and filtered record counts prove virtually unsolvable via text retrieval alone, demonstrating that systematic table extraction is an operational prerequisite for literature-scale quantitative inquiry.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向钙钛矿光伏文献的定量问答基准（755题，答案由45,441条器件实测记录计算得出），发现文本检索最高仅16-23%准确率，而让14B模型对结构化器件表执行只读SQL可达约51%，显著优于文本检索。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强语言模型作为物理科学文献助手时，评测多依赖定性文本重叠或模型打分，缺少基于可验证实验真值的定量评测；而材料实验领域（如钙钛矿光伏）最关键的问题本质上是定量的，且需要跨数十至数百篇论文聚合测量数据。
AI.method: 构建定量问答基准：755个问题真值全部由45,441条实测器件记录直接计算（40,889条2021年前人工整理记录 + 4,552条2022–2026文献抽取记录）。在单张24GB GPU上用开源14B模型，对25,662篇论文的158,274个段落评测六种检索架构；并对比"只读SQL执行于结构化器件表"的方案。
AI.result: 标准段落检索准确率上限为16–23%（零样本仅1.6–6.5%）；配备只读SQL执行后准确率提升至历史文献51.5%、前瞻文献50.8%，相较混合文本检索高出33.0±1.8个百分点。涉及极值、分布与过滤记录计数的聚合型查询几乎无法仅靠文本检索解决。
AI.conclusion: 系统性表格抽取（结构化数据库+SQL查询）是开展文献尺度定量研究的前提条件；纯文本检索在聚合型定量问答上存在根本性瓶颈。

title: When Coding Agents Outpace Review: Evaluating PRD-Driven Development in Mature Enterprise Repositories
summary: Coding agents increasingly undertake development tasks in mature enterprise repositories, yet existing benchmarks offer limited insight into whether they fulfill complete Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and where delivery breaks down. Issue resolution and development from scratch leave incremental PRD fulfillment underexplored, while isolated tests provide incomplete evidence of business and integration requirements. We introduce PACE, a benchmark of 43 enterprise tasks with 750 expert-audited Code Points. It combines requirement reconstruction, criterion construction, and evidence-based evaluation to measure PRD fulfillment and connect delivery gaps to agent behavior. Across 11 model--scaffold configurations, most scores fall between 52.1 and 78.1; GPT-5.6-Sol achieves the highest complete-delivery rate of 14.0\%. Incomplete implementation and missing integration are the principal bottlenecks: producing individual components does not ensure a complete delivery. Evaluation achieves 95.2\% agreement with expert consensus, with lower case-level variation across judging records than repeated executions.
