In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central student. The anchor is held fixed within each block and refreshed from the student at block boundaries, so the population stays centered on a stable yet current policy and continues to supply diverse and reliable supervision as the student moves. In single-task test-time adaptation across mathematical reasoning, general knowledge, and medical domains, ESRL improves average accuracy by up to 31.7% relative to the base model and 16.6% relative to the strongest test-time adaptation baseline. Notably, ESRL substantially reduces catastrophic forgetting and achieves the strongest final performance in continual learning.

AI.tldr: 提出进化策略强化学习（ESRL）框架，用政策种群的自我生成监督替代单一策略信号，实现无需外部监督的持续测试时学习，显著缓解策略漂移与灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: LLM需在开放环境中持续适应演化任务，但现有持续学习方法依赖昂贵或不可得的监督（标注数据、示例、奖励信号）；测试时适应虽摆脱外部监督，却从被更新的单一策略中提取自我监督，一旦策略漂移，学习信号随之漂移，导致策略坍塌、推理退化与灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: ESRL在参数空间对锚定策略（anchor policy）施加扰动，构建邻近策略种群；每个策略采样一条轨迹，将其答案聚合为无标签的组相对学习信号，用于训练中心学生策略。锚点在每个块内保持固定，仅在块边界由学生策略刷新，使种群始终以稳定且当前的策略为中心。
AI.result: 在数学推理、通用知识与医学领域的单任务测试时适应中，ESRL相较基座模型平均准确率最高提升31.7%，相较最强测试时适应基线提升16.6%；在持续学习中显著减少灾难性遗忘，并取得最佳最终性能。
AI.conclusion: 以种群而非单一策略作为自我监督来源，可提供多样且可靠的监督信号，是缓解测试时适应中信号漂移与遗忘问题的有效方向。

title: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay
summary: Motivated by recursive self-improvement (RSI), we study how LLM agents can learn through external memory without updating model parameters. Extracting useful experience from a single attempt is difficult: flawed reasoning can produce success, while poor execution can obscure a sound strategy. Preserving its value over time is also difficult: our accumulation baseline without consolidation initially improves but eventually performs below a no-memory baseline. Our key idea is to compare attempts at the same task to identify reusable decisions and refine when they apply. We introduce Hippo, a memory framework inspired by selective hippocampal encoding and replay that learns from these comparisons when shortcomings are diagnosed. It compares the resulting experience with existing memory to merge overlaps and resolve conflicts through explicit applicability conditions. This allows prior guidance to be revised without storing every lesson as a separate entry. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web show performance gains in all three settings and substantially fewer retained experiences than the accumulation baseline. The gains extend across the evaluated base models of varying capabilities, indicating that memory-based adaptation remains useful even for highly capable models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Hippo 记忆框架，让 LLM agent 在不更新参数的情况下，通过比较同一任务的多次尝试学习可复用决策，并用适用条件合并、解决记忆冲突，在 SWE-bench Verified、WebArena、Mind2Web 上均取得性能提升且保留经验更少。
AI.motivation: 受递归自我改进（RSI）启发，探索 LLM agent 依靠外部记忆而非参数更新进行学习。两大难点：单次尝试中难以提取有效经验（错误推理可能侥幸成功，糟糕执行可能掩盖好策略）；经验随时间积累难以保值——无整合的累积基线初期提升但最终低于无记忆基线。
AI.method: 核心思路是对同一任务的多次尝试进行比较，识别可复用决策并细化其适用时机。提出 Hippo 框架，受海马体选择性编码与回放启发：仅在诊断出缺陷时从比较中学习；将新经验与已有记忆对比，合并重叠部分，并通过显式适用条件解决冲突，从而在不为每条经验单独存储条目的前提下修订既有指导。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified、WebArena 和 Mind2Web 三个基准上性能均提升；保留的经验数量显著少于累积基线；增益在能力不同的多个基座模型上均成立，表明即使对能力很强的模型，基于记忆的适应仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 外部记忆式学习可作为参数更新的有效替代路径，关键在于以比较驱动的经验提炼与记忆整合，而非简单累积经验条目。

title: Budgeted Bayesian Bandits for Future Utilization
summary: The multi-armed bandit problem models the trade-off between exploration and exploitation. In this paper, we study the variant where exploration has a hard budget and precedes exploitation. Prior guarantees include a 1/3 approximation by Guha and Munagala using Lagrangian duality, and a 4/27 approximation by Ma against a primal linear programming relaxation for a more general model. We show that the analyses of both algorithms are tight, even when their relaxations are asymptotically exact. We provide a different efficient algorithm that achieves a 0.43 approximation. We then provide an efficient algorithm whose guarantee approaches 1-e^{-1} approx 0.63 for bounded exchangeable reward observations in a non-vanishing regime, which is asymptotically tight against natural linear programming relaxations. The technique also gives certificates for stopping sequential model evaluation.

AI.tldr: 研究"探索有硬预算且先于利用"的多臂老虎机变体，证明已有1/3与4/27近似算法的分析是紧的，并给出0.43近似算法；在可交换有界奖励观测下给出逼近1-1/e≈0.63且对自然LP松弛渐近紧的算法，并可用于停止序列模型评估的证书。
AI.motivation: 经典多臂老虎机刻画探索与利用的权衡；本文关注探索具有硬预算且必须先于利用的变体，已有保证为1/3（Guha–Munagala，拉格朗日对偶）与4/27（Ma，针对更一般模型的原始LP松弛），需厘清这些界是否可改进以及是否存在更优算法。
AI.method: 对Guha–Munagala与Ma两个算法的分析构造紧例，表明即使松弛渐近精确其分析仍紧；提出不同的高效算法达到0.43近似；针对有界可交换奖励观测、在非消失（non-vanishing）机制下设计高效算法，其保证逼近1-e^{-1}，并论证该界对自然线性规划松弛渐近紧；技术还给出停止序列模型评估的证书。
AI.result: 证明现有1/3与4/27近似分析均紧（即使松弛渐近精确）；给出0.43近似的高效算法；在可交换有界奖励的非消失机制下得到逼近1-1/e≈0.63的保证，且对自然LP松弛渐近紧。
AI.conclusion: 已有近似分析的紧性表明其难以通过更精细分析改进，需新算法设计；所提算法将近似比提升至0.43，并在结构化（可交换有界奖励）设定下逼近理论极限1-1/e；所用技术可导出停止序列模型评估的证书。

title: MELD: Recursive Self-Improvement via Hierarchical Coordination for Multi-Agent Scientific Discovery
summary: Multi-agent scientific discovery with large language models raises a coupled learning problem: research assignments determine both which experiments are pursued and the experiences from which agents adapt. We introduce MELD, a unified hierarchical test-time training framework that jointly adapts a team-level Coordinator policy and agent-level individual Scientist policies within a single discovery process. The Coordinator generates a joint portfolio of search branches and research directives over a shared derivation tree, while Scientists develop hypotheses and execution plans implemented by a shared frozen Executor. Both levels receive alternating GRPO-style parameter updates under a shared smooth best-of-budget objective, allowing team organization and individual research behavior to co-evolve in a recursive self-improvement loop. Our analysis establishes objective alignment for the hierarchy, characterizes conditions for coordination gains over independent parallel discovery and the first-order benefit of private adaptation, and derives a finite-budget regret bound for adapted models. On 22 MLGym and MLE-bench tasks, MELD is best on 20 of them and achieves the highest aggregate normalized scores on MLGym, using a 4B backbone for coordination and research. Most baselines use proprietary Scientists, and all systems share one frozen Executor.

AI.tldr: MELD：面向多智能体科学发现的统一分层测试时训练框架，联合自适应团队级Coordinator与个体级Scientist策略，实现组织与个体行为的共同演化。
AI.motivation: 多智能体科学发现本质上是耦合学习问题：研究任务分配既决定 pursued 哪些实验，也决定智能体据以适应的经验，二者相互依赖，需联合建模。
AI.method: MELD在单一发现过程中联合训练层级策略：Coordinator在共享推导树上生成搜索分支组合与研究指令；Scientist基于指令提出假设与执行计划，由共享冻结Executor执行。两层均采用交替的GRPO式参数更新，共享平滑best-of-budget目标，形成递归自我改进循环。理论分析给出层级目标对齐、协调增益优于独立并行发现的条件、私有自适应的一阶收益及有限预算遗憾界。
AI.result: 在22个MLGym与MLE-bench任务上，MELD在20个任务上表现最优，并在MLGym取得最高聚合归一化分数；仅使用4B骨干模型完成协调与研究，而多数基线采用专有Scientist模型，所有系统共享同一冻结Executor。
AI.conclusion: 层级、交替式的测试时训练可使团队组织与个体研究行为协同演化，在受限骨干规模下仍显著优于既有基线，验证了协调与自适应联合优化的有效性。

title: Margin Certificates for Voting Classifiers under Mixing Dependence
summary: Margin bounds explain why weighted votes generalize after training error vanishes, but dependent observations require concentration arguments that keep the dependence model and failure budget explicit. We study stationary mixing streams without treating dependence as a formal substitution of an "effective sample size." For a finite base class, we combine independent-block Rademacher theory for stationary $β$-mixing processes with a clipped margin loss to obtain an explicit uniform voting-margin certificate, whose dependence penalty is set by the number of approximately independent blocks and the coupling budget $4(μ-1)β(a)$. A black-box transfer theorem shows that any i.i.d. voting-margin guarantee remains valid on a regularly spaced subsequence, with only an additive $β$-mixing failure probability. For votes fixed independently of a stationary finite-state reversible Markov stream, spectral concentration gives the cleaner $\sqrt{t_{rel}/n}$ rate, and a sticky-refresh construction shows this exponent is unavoidable. The constant is statistic-specific: the effective sample size is $n/τ_{int}(g)$, with $τ_{int}(g) \le 2t_{rel}-1$. When the dependence scale is unknown, a batch-means Student-t interval is valid up to an explicit remainder vanishing in the number of batches, with width governed by $τ_{int}(g)$ rather than the worst-case $t_{rel}$. Experiments show: the learned-vote certificate is nonvacuous once the block count is large; a two-timescale construction gives a batch-means interval 8.1x narrower than the worst-case interval at nominal coverage (0.945); block-bootstrap and batch-means intervals undercover under strong dependence while the certificate stays valid; and on real, ordered UCI HAR sensor data the dependence-agnostic certificate reaches 0.95 coverage where naive intervals reach only 0.38.

AI.tldr: 本文在平稳β-混合流上给出显式的加权投票间隔界与迁移定理，并用谱方法在可逆Markov流上建立尖锐的√(t_rel/n)速率及匹配下界，同时提出对未知依赖尺度稳健的batch-means置信区间并在实验中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统间隔界解释加权投票在训练误差消失后仍能泛化，但依赖观测需要显式的依赖模型与失效概率预算，本文旨在避免把依赖性简单替换为"有效样本量"，给出显式的依赖惩罚与失效预算。
AI.method: 对平稳β-混合过程，结合独立分块Rademacher理论与截断间隔损失，得到依赖惩罚由近似独立分块数与耦合预算4(μ-1)β(a)决定的均匀投票间隔证书；给出黑盒迁移定理（i.i.d.保证在等距子序列上仅加性损失β-混合失效概率）；对与平稳有限状态可逆Markov流独立的固定投票，用谱集中得到√(t_rel/n)速率并用sticky-refresh构造证明该指数不可避免；未知依赖尺度时使用batch-means Student-t区间。
AI.result: 有效样本量为n/τ_int(g)且τ_int(g)≤2t_rel-1；batch-means区间宽度由τ_int(g)而非最坏情形t_rel控制。实验显示：分块数足够大时学习投票证书非空；两时间尺度构造下batch-means区间在名义覆盖率0.945时比最坏情形区间窄8.1倍；强依赖下block-bootstrap与batch-means欠覆盖而证书仍有效；真实UCI HAR有序传感器数据上依赖不可知证书达0.95覆盖率，朴素区间仅0.38。
AI.conclusion: 显式依赖建模（分块耦合、谱集中、batch-means）可在平稳混合流上给出既尖锐又稳健的投票间隔保证，依赖惩罚由分块数与谱间隙刻画，且对未知依赖尺度保持有效覆盖。

title: Learning to Compose: Recursive Self-Improvement of Shared Executable Stacks for Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Individually competent robot skills can fail when composed: tools may lack a required capability, completion signals may misrepresent physical progress, and one skill may leave a state that violates its successor's prerequisites. We introduce Recursia, a recursive self-improvement framework that treats the shared executable stack, rather than individual task programs, as the persistent unit of improvement. The stack integrates tools, skills with execution contracts, handoffs, and verifiers. Source-side execution traces guide failure attribution and the generation of missing tools or repairs to existing shared components. Generality checks, mechanism tests, and paired selection and regression gates determine which changes become the next parent. The resulting stack is frozen and reused through declarative task adapters, allowing source-derived changes to support new compositions without target-side code repair. Experiments cover LIBERO-Pro Long simulation and a physical Franka FR3 equipped with a Franka Hand. In simulation, Recursia improves success over ASPIRE by 5.8 percentage points under Pos perturbations and 15.1 points under Task perturbations. Across three physical compositional target tasks, it improves mean success over the Skill Document Only baseline by 40 percentage points. Analyses of constituent execution, candidate rejection, and inference drivers distinguish local mechanism improvements from complete task success and characterize the cost of feedback-conditioned orchestration. These results examine shared executable interfaces as a concrete mechanism for compositional transfer in robot programming.

AI.tldr: 提出Recursia递归自改进框架，将共享可执行栈（工具、带执行契约的技能、交接、验证器）作为持续改进单元，通过源侧执行轨迹进行失败归因与缺失工具/组件修复的生成，并经通用性检验、机制测试与成对选择/回归门控筛选后冻结复用；仿真中较ASPIRE在Pos扰动提升5.8个百分点、Task扰动提升15.1个百分点，三个物理组合任务上较Skill Document Only基线平均成功率提升40个百分点。
AI.motivation: 单独胜任的机器人技能在组合时可能失败：缺少所需工具能力、完成信号与实际物理进展不符、前一技能留下的状态违反后继技能的前置条件。现有做法以单个任务程序为改进单位，难以解决这类跨技能的共享层面缺陷。
AI.method: 以共享可执行栈为核心改进单元，栈内整合工具、带执行契约的技能、交接与验证器；利用源侧执行轨迹做失败归因，生成缺失工具或对现有共享组件的修复；通过通用性检查、机制测试以及成对的选择门与回归门决定哪些改动成为下一代父本；最终冻结栈并通过声明式任务适配器复用，使源侧衍生改动支持新组合而无需目标侧代码修补。实验涵盖LIBERO-Pro Long仿真与搭载Franka Hand的实体Franka FR3，并分析成分执行、候选拒绝与推理驱动因素。
AI.result: 仿真中相比ASPIRE在Pos扰动下成功率提升5.8个百分点，在Task扰动下提升15.1个百分点；在三个实体组合目标任务上，相比Skill Document Only基线平均成功率提升40个百分点。成分执行、候选拒绝与推理驱动分析区分了局部机制改进与完整任务成功，并刻画了反馈条件化编排的开销。
AI.conclusion: 共享可执行接口可作为机器人编程中实现组合式迁移的具体机制，将改进从单任务程序上升到共享栈层面能够提升组合任务的鲁棒性与成功率。

title: Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree for Inference-time Search Under Sparse Reward
summary: Tree-based samplers offer a compelling alternative for scalable inference-time search, bypassing the per-step reward and gradient dependencies that introduce systematic bias into SMC-style frameworks. Despite this advantage, contemporary tree samplers fail to achieve broad exploration. Their reliance on learned, DDPM-like transitions inherently couples neighbor states in a trajectory, thereby restricting child-parent feature divergence in the tree sampler. Consequently, these samplers suffer from restricted coverage of the target marginal distribution, severely hindering the exploration critical for efficient search under sparse reward. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a simple yet effective Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree (BSIT) sampler that decouples child node generation from explicit parent dependencies. By expanding the degrees of freedom during child node sampling, BSIT encourages diverse trajectory rollouts and unlocks broader path-space diversity-the exact catalyst needed for efficient exploration. Crucially, we show that BSIT's improved exploration accelerates convergence to the target distribution while achieving broader distributional coverage than samplers that rely on DDPM-like transitions for child-node generation, all without incurring additional function evaluations or reward feedback, thereby providing a highly efficient basis for rare target search. Extensive experiments across diverse search settings, including rare-species discovery and target-aligned molecule generation tasks, demonstrate BSIT's superior search efficiency over the baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree（BSIT）采样器，通过解耦子节点生成与父节点显式依赖，提升探索多样性与分布覆盖，在稀疏奖励下实现更高效的推理期搜索。
AI.motivation: 基于树的采样器规避了 SMC 类框架中逐步奖励与梯度依赖带来的系统性偏差，但现有树采样器依赖类 DDPM 的学习式转移，导致轨迹中相邻状态耦合，子-父特征差异受限，目标边缘分布覆盖不足，在稀疏奖励下探索能力严重受限。
AI.method: 引入 Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree（BSIT）采样器，使子节点生成为显式父依赖解耦；通过在子节点采样中扩展自由度，鼓励多样化的轨迹 rollout，解锁更广的路径空间多样性。
AI.result: BSIT 的增强探索加速了向目标分布的收敛，并相比依赖类 DDPM 转移的采样器获得更广的分布覆盖，且不增加额外函数评估或奖励反馈；在稀有物种发现与目标对齐分子生成等多样化搜索任务上，搜索效率优于基线。
AI.conclusion: BSIT 以简单有效的方式解决树采样器探索受限问题，为稀有目标搜索提供了高效基础，并具备在稀缺奖励搜索场景中的广泛适用性。

title: Pluralistic Alignment in Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations
summary: Pluralistic alignment aims to represent meaningful variation in human preferences rather than collapse heterogeneous judgments into a single target. Yet existing work often mixes three distinct questions: what pluralistic behavior a model should exhibit, whose preferences define the reference, and what evidence is sufficient to demonstrate success. We organize the literature around a two-layer taxonomy. Layer 1 distinguishes representing a range of human-supported viewpoints (Overton Pluralism), adapting faithfully to a specified perspective or preference condition (Steerable Pluralism), and matching the response distribution observed in a target population (Distributional Pluralism). Layer 2 distinguishes aggregate populations, countries and regions, and subgroups as human references. Preference representation, implementation mechanism, modality, and evidence quality are treated as cross-cutting design choices rather than additional forms of pluralism. We synthesize a protocol-bounded corpus of 70 works on pluralistic alignment and neighboring areas, using the objective-by-human-reference matrix to map existing approaches and identify underexplored combinations. The coded literature concentrates on Steerable Pluralism and Distributional Pluralism, while eligible Overton Pluralism work appears only at the aggregate-population level under our stated protocol. We then connect each objective to the evidence needed to support it, including perspective validity, conditional fidelity, distributional fidelity, support preservation, and uncertainty in subgroup estimates. Together, the taxonomy and evaluation framework clarify what current methods establish, where their claims exceed their evidence, and how future systems can represent disagreement without mistaking variation for faithful representation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个两层分类法（Layer 1：Overton/Steerable/Distributional Pluralism；Layer 2：聚合人群、国家/地区、亚群体三种人类参照），并以"目标×人类参照"矩阵系统编码70篇多元对齐文献，配合分目标对应的证据要求框架，诊断现有方法主张与证据的错位。
AI.motivation: 现有"多元对齐"研究混淆了三个本应区分的问题：模型应表现何种多元行为、以谁的偏好为参照、何种证据足以证明成功。这种概念混杂导致方法定位不清、结论超出证据支撑范围。
AI.method: 构建两层分类法：Layer 1按目标区分Overton Pluralism（表征受人类支持的观点范围）、Steerable Pluralism（忠实适配指定视角/偏好条件）、Distributional Pluralism（匹配目标人群的响应分布）；Layer 2按人类参照区分聚合人群、国家与地区、亚群体。将偏好表征、实现机制、模态、证据质量作为横切设计选择而非额外多元类型。在明确的协议边界下综述70篇多元对齐及邻近工作，用"目标×人类参照"矩阵映射现有方法并识别未被探索的组合。
AI.result: 编码文献集中于Steerable Pluralism与Distributional Pluralism；在该协议下，符合标准的Overton Pluralism工作仅出现在聚合人群层面。矩阵化映射揭示了若干"目标—参照"组合的空缺。
AI.conclusion: 将各目标与所需证据相连（视角有效性、条件保真度、分布保真度、支持保持、亚群体估计的不确定性），该分类与评估框架厘清了现有方法实际确立了什么、何处主张超出证据，并为未来系统在表征分歧时不将"变异"误当作"忠实表征"提供指引。

title: On Reparameterizing the Score Function
summary: Policy gradients for autoregressive sequence models differentiate each token's log-probability while holding the conditioning history fixed. This discards information about how earlier decisions shape later conditional distributions, creating a credit-assignment bottleneck when rewards are sparse. We introduce History-Reparameterized (HR) policy gradients, which replace the frozen prefix in the score function with a differentiable reparameterized or relaxed history, allowing gradients of downstream log-probabilities to propagate backward through the generated trajectory. The resulting history-pathwise term is generally biased when added directly, so we derive Optimal HR (OHR), a centered control-variate estimator with a closed-form coefficient that minimizes the trace of the gradient variance at the population level. The variance reduction is governed by temporal structure in the policy dynamics: random or weakly structured policies provide little benefit, while policies with learned sequential dependencies yield informative history-pathwise corrections. For discrete tokens, the choice of relaxation is crucial: embedding-level relaxation yields substantial variance reduction that grows with horizon, whereas straight-through Gumbel-Softmax yields essentially none in our diagnostics. We validate the method on a Gaussian linear Markov model, a sparse-reward T-maze with a recurrent policy, and an autoregressive Transformer model for small Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) instances.

AI.tldr: 论文提出历史重参数化（HR）策略梯度，用可微的松弛历史替代得分函数中冻结的前缀，使下游对数概率的梯度可沿轨迹回传，并推导出带闭式系数的中心化控制变量估计器 OHR 以降低梯度方差。
AI.motivation: 自回归序列模型的策略梯度在固定条件历史下逐 token 求导，丢弃了早期决策如何影响后续条件分布的信息，在稀疏奖励下造成信用分配瓶颈。
AI.method: 将得分函数中的冻结前缀替换为可微重参数化或松弛历史，令下游对数概率梯度回溯传播，得到历史路径项；直接相加存在偏差，故提出 Optimal HR（OHR），即以闭式系数最小化总体梯度方差迹的中心化控制变量估计器。离散 token 上比较嵌入级松弛与 straight-through Gumbel-Softmax 两种松弛选择。
AI.result: 方差缩减取决于策略动态的时间结构：随机或弱结构策略收益甚微，具学习到的序列依赖的策略可获得有效修正；嵌入级松弛带来随视界增长而增大的显著方差缩减，而 straight-through Gumbel-Softmax 在诊断中几乎无收益。在高斯线性马尔可夫模型、带循环策略的稀疏奖励 T-maze、以及小规模 TSP 的自回归 Transformer 上验证了方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过让梯度穿越生成历史回传，OHR 缓解了自回归策略梯度中的信用分配瓶颈；其效果依赖于策略的时序结构与离散松弛方式，嵌入级松弛是关键选择。

title: ConCI: A Controlled Counterfactual Benchmark for Contextual Integrity in LLMs
summary: Contextual integrity (CI) holds that the appropriateness of sharing personal information depends on the context of the information flow, not on the information alone. However, existing CI benchmarks often use independent scenarios that vary multiple CI parameters simultaneously and are dominated by inappropriate flows, making it unclear whether correct predictions reflect sensitivity to context or a general refusal tendency. We present ConCI, a controlled-counterfactual benchmark in which an anchor flow is paired with two counterfactuals that each modify a single CI parameter. The resulting triplet is scored jointly, with credit given only when all three flows are judged correctly. Built from six existing benchmarks, ConCI contains 1,592 flows in 556 triplets, is approximately label-balanced, and is validated by seven human annotators per flow. Across seven LLMs, many correct anchor predictions fail on at least one counterfactual, and even the strongest model errs on about a fifth of triplets. Furthermore, models perform near ceiling on inappropriate flows but weaker on appropriate ones, often continuing to judge a flow inappropriate even when a contextual change should make it appropriate. Larger models narrow this bias toward non-disclosure but do not eliminate it, and reasoning yields only modest gains.

AI.tldr: 提出受控反事实基准ConCI（556组三元组、1592条信息流），要求同时正确判断锚点流与两个仅改动单一CI参数的反事实流；七个LLM普遍在合适流上偏保守，规模增大与推理仅小幅缓解该非披露偏向。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文完整性（CI）基准多用彼此独立的场景，同时变动多个CI参数且以不合适流为主，导致难以区分模型的正确预测究竟来自对上下文的敏感性，还是来自一律拒绝披露的倾向。
AI.method: 构建受控反事实基准ConCI：每个锚点流配两个仅修改单一CI参数的反事实流，组成三元组联合评分，三条全部判断正确才计分；数据整合自六个现有基准，共1592条流、556组三元组，标签近似均衡，每条流由7名人工标注者验证；在七个LLM上评测。
AI.result: 许多锚点预测正确的样本至少在一个反事实流上出错，最强模型在约五分之一三元组上仍出错；模型在不合适流上接近上限，但在合适流上较弱，常在上下文变化本应使其变得合适时仍判定为不合适；更大模型缩小但未消除该非披露偏向，推理仅带来有限提升。
AI.conclusion: 现有CI评测高估了模型对上下文的敏感性，实质上是非披露偏向驱动的表面正确；ConCI通过受控反事实与联合评分提供了更严格的CI能力度量，偏见随规模与推理仅部分缓解。

title: Hidden Trajectories Don't Lie: Correcting Corruption Drift for Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) adapts pretrained models to distribution shifts encountered during deployment. However, most existing methods rely on the weight representations of the final layer or signals derived from the model's output probability distribution. We study hidden trajectories: the ordered sequence of intermediate representations produced across a deep neural network. We observe that clean and corrupted trajectories become more separable as corruption severity increases. We introduce Drift-TTA, which adds zero-initialized low-rank adapters to a frozen backbone and trains them to align corrupted hidden trajectories with those from cleaner inputs. The approach supports two variants: a source-dependent version trained with clean targets, and a source-free setting that learns from corrupted images at different severities. We develop an online TTA approach that freezes the backbone and adapters while updating a scalar gate to control adaptation strength. We further cast trajectory alignment as MAP inference under a Gaussian observation model and derive a KL-based transfer bound characterizing test-time trajectory misalignment in terms of offline residual error, residual dimensionality, and distribution shift between offline and test corruptions. We evaluate Drift-TTA on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, and ImageNet-C using supervised ViTs and CLIP models. On CIFAR-100-C at severity 5, our source-free online approach improves accuracy over no TTA by 13.3 percentage points with ViT-B/16 and 11.6 percentage points with CLIP ViT-B/16, reaching 74.9% and 47.4%, respectively. Under the same setting, prior TTA baselines yield ECEs of 18.00% for ViT and 14.70% for CLIP, while our approach reduces them to 9.53% and 5.77%, respectively. These results demonstrate that hidden trajectory alignment provides an effective signal for both offline correction and lightweight online test-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: Drift-TTA通过零初始化低秩适配器将受损输入的隐藏轨迹对齐到干净输入的轨迹，实现源依赖与无源两种测试时自适应，并提出轻量在线门控方案与基于KL的迁移界，在CIFAR-10/100-C与ImageNet-C上显著提升精度并降低ECE。
AI.motivation: 现有TTA方法多依赖最后一层权重表示或模型输出概率分布信号，信息利用有限；作者观察到干净样本与受损样本的隐藏轨迹随损坏严重程度增加而更易分离，因此希望直接利用跨层中间表示序列（隐藏轨迹）作为更有效的适应信号。
AI.method: 在冻结主干上加入零初始化低秩适配器，训练其将受损隐藏轨迹对齐至较干净输入的轨迹；提供源依赖（使用干净目标）与无源（用不同严重度的受损图像）两种变体。在线TTA阶段冻结主干与适配器，仅更新标量门控以控制适应强度。理论上将轨迹对齐表述为高斯观测模型下的MAP推断，并导出KL迁移界，用离线残差误差、残差维度以及离线与测试损坏间的分布偏移刻画测试时轨迹失配。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-C上以监督ViT与CLIP模型评测。CIFAR-100-C严重度5下，无源在线方法相较无TTA分别提升ViT-B/16 13.3个百分点、CLIP ViT-B/16 11.6个百分点，达到74.9%与47.4%；同设置下基线ECE为ViT 18.00%、CLIP 14.70%，本方法降至9.53%与5.77%。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏轨迹对齐可为离线校正与轻量在线测试时自适应提供有效信号，兼顾精度提升与校准改善，且无需更新主干参数。

title: $M^2Net$: Unifying Scale-Specific Structures and Prototype Decomposition for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting
summary: Spatial-temporal forecasting is pivotal for intelligent urban management yet remains challenging due to the intricate coupling of spatial dynamics and temporal non-stationarity. Existing approaches, while effective, often overlook two fundamental characteristics of real-world data: (1) Granularity-dependence, where dominant spatial correlations shift significantly across different time scales, and (2) Signal entanglement, where global common patterns are inextricably mixed with node-specific disturbances. In this paper, we propose a novel framework named $M^2Net$ (Multi-Scale Masked attention and Prototype network) to unify scale-specific structural learning and semantic decomposition. First, to capture the evolution of spatial dependencies, we introduce a Multi-Scale Masked attention mechanism. By downsampling temporal features into multiple resolutions, we dynamically generate scale-adaptive spatial masks, allowing the model to distinguish between micro-scale physical neighbors and macro-scale functional correlations. Second, to disentangle unique variations from shared trends, we propose a Prototype Residual Learning module. It retrieves global common patterns from a momentum-updated prototype bank and subtracts them from node representations, explicitly forcing the network to model the residual unique deviations. By integrating these two orthogonal views, i.e., structural multiscaling and semantic decomposition, our approach effectively isolates valid spatial-temporal signals from noise. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that $M^2Net$ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on extensive empirical verifications.

AI.tldr: 提出M²Net框架，统一多尺度结构学习与语义分解以提升时空预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时空预测方法忽视真实数据的两个基本特性：粒度依赖性（主导空间相关性随不同时间尺度显著变化）与信号纠缠（全局共性模式与节点特有扰动混杂）。
AI.method: M²Net包含两个正交模块：(1) 多尺度掩码注意力（Multi-Scale Masked attention）：将时间特征下采样至多分辨率，动态生成尺度自适应空间掩码，区分微观物理邻居与宏观功能关联；(2) 原型残差学习（Prototype Residual Learning）：从动量更新的原型库检索全局共性模式并从节点表示中减去，强制网络建模残差特有偏差。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的大量实验表明M²Net优于现有最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合结构多尺度化与语义分解两个正交视角，可有效从噪声中分离有效时空信号，提升智能城市管理中的时空预测性能。

title: Dynamic Neural Optimal Transport for Subset Alignment
summary: We study optimal transport between distributions when only a subset of the target population is relevant to the source. The goal is to map the source distribution to a reweighted target distribution whose density ratio with respect to the full target lies in $[0, c]$. This constraint enables the transported distribution to select an appropriate target subpopulation while limiting how strongly any region of the target can be emphasized. We propose a dynamic neural optimal transport framework for this setting using two neural networks. The first parameterizes a time-dependent potential whose spatial gradient defines the velocity field and whose terminal value enforces the density-ratio constraint. The second parameterizes an interpolation between the source distribution and the learned terminal distribution. Unlike prior neural dynamic optimal transport methods, which typically assume a fixed terminal distribution, our formulation learns the terminal distribution within the support of the target. We demonstrate the method on positive-unlabeled learning, unpaired domain translation, and trajectory inference, where meaningful alignments exist between source and target distributions, but direct distribution matching is inappropriate because the target contains additional or irrelevant components

AI.tldr: 提出动态神经最优传输框架，在密度比约束下学习源分布到目标子分布（而非全目标）的映射，用于PU学习、非配对域翻译与轨迹推断。
AI.motivation: 现实任务中仅目标分布的一个子集与源相关，直接做整体分布匹配会把源映射到无关成分上，因此需要"选择性对齐"——只把源映射到目标的合适子群，同时限制对目标各区域的最大强调程度（密度比上界c）。
AI.method: 动态神经OT框架，用两个网络：网络一参数化时间依赖势函数，其空间梯度定义速度场，终值势通过约束强制执行密度比∈[0,c]；网络二参数化源分布与学习到的终端分布之间的插值。与既有神经动态OT固定终端分布不同，本方法在目标支撑内学习终端分布本身。
AI.result: 在正-无标签（PU）学习、非配对域翻译、轨迹推断三类任务上验证，能产生有意义的对齐，避免直接分布匹配因目标含额外/无关成分而失效。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习受约束的终端分布实现"选择性最优传输"，为源与目标仅部分相关的场景提供了可行的神经动态OT方案。

title: Axiomatic World Modeling for Physics Reasoning
summary: Recent research-level physics-reasoning benchmarks for LLMs reveal a failure mode that lies not in knowledge or execution, but in modeling the world being reasoned about. Models often silently alter given quantities, fabricate laws, or inject unstated assumptions to force a problem into familiar patterns, and then reason inside this corrupted world. We define this premise-level divergence as modeling drift: the gap between a model's internal axiomatic world model (AWM) and the true physical world specified in the problem. Although RLVR and PRM have yielded substantial gains in mathematics and code, their reward shapes do not directly supervise world modeling in axiomatic domains such as physics. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Axiomatic World Modeling (RLAWM), which optimizes the policy by penalizing divergence between its inferred axiomatic world model and the true physics world. RLAWM probes physics reasoning at two hierarchical levels (modeling and solving), each scored by a physically grounded reward. The modeling reward targets abstract knowledge formulation, evaluating whether the model captures the true axiomatic world before attempting calculation. The solving reward targets instantiated knowledge reasoning, checking whether the model's concrete derivation remains consistent with the axiomatic world. This two-level structure separates what world the model believes it is reasoning in from how it reasons within that world. The framework operates exclusively during training, with no extra cost during inference. RLAWM improves performance by up to +12.2 points on PhysReason and +5.2 on PHYSICS over the baseline. It also generalizes zero-shot across difficulty, source, and domain, with a 2.45x gain and +10 points over the strongest baseline on olympiad-level physics and math.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"建模漂移"(modeling drift)这一失败模式：LLM在物理解题中会篡改给定量、编造定律或注入未声明假设，其内部公理世界模型(AWM)偏离题目真实物理世界。为此提出RLAWM，在训练时对建模与求解两个层级分别施加物理接地奖励，惩罚AWM与真实世界的偏离。PhysReason最高提升+12.2分，PHYSICS提升+5.2分，奥林匹克级物理与数学任务零样本较最强基线提升+10分（2.45倍）。
AI.motivation: 现有物理推理基准显示，LLM的失败并非源于知识缺失或执行错误，而是对"被推理世界"的建模出错。RLVR与PRM虽在数学与代码上有效，但其奖励形状无法直接监督物理等公理领域中的世界建模。因此需要一种显式监督世界模型一致性的训练机制。
AI.method: 提出RLAWM（Reinforcement Learning with Axiomatic World Modeling）：以"模型推断的公理世界模型"与"题目真实物理世界"之间的偏离作为惩罚项优化策略。奖励分为两个层级——建模层奖励针对抽象知识形式化，检验模型在计算前是否捕获真实公理世界；求解层奖励针对实例化知识推理，检验具体推导是否与该公理世界保持一致。该结构将"模型认为自己在哪个世界中推理"与"如何在该世界中推理"分离。框架仅在训练阶段生效，推理时无额外开销。
AI.result: 在PhysReason上较基线最高提升+12.2分，PHYSICS上提升+5.2分；在难度、来源与领域上实现零样本泛化；在奥林匹克级物理与数学任务上较最强基线获得2.45倍增益及+10分提升。
AI.conclusion: 将物理推理的监督从答案正确性上移至公理世界建模层面，可有效缓解建模漂移；分层（建模/求解）的物理接地奖励提供了一种无推理期开销的通用强化学习范式，并能跨难度与领域泛化。

title: Dataset Inference for Data Provenance and Privacy Auditing in Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly deployed through black-box APIs and trained on large collections of real-world tabular datasets. As this training paradigm becomes more widely adopted, private or proprietary datasets may be incorporated into pre-training corpora, yet there are currently no dedicated methods for determining whether a given tabular dataset was used to train a TFM. As a solution, we introduce the first dataset inference method for TFMs, aiming to infer whether a suspect dataset was part of a model's pre-training data. We systematically analyze a broad collection of candidate signals that can be observed from a black-box TFM via input manipulation and find that individual signals provide only weak evidence of training data membership. However, by combining multiple complementary signals, we can infer dataset membership for several state-of-the-art TFMs trained on real tabular data, achieving up to 0.99 ROCAUC dependent on the TFM. We then study factors that influence dataset identification, including pre-training data composition, model capacity, and the use of real vs. synthetic data. Our results show that our dataset inference method is a practical auditing tool for detecting privacy leakage and the use of proprietary datasets in TFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向表格基础模型（TFM）的数据集推断方法，通过组合多种黑盒可观测信号判断某可疑表格数据集是否被用于预训练。
AI.motivation: TFM 通过黑盒 API 部署并以大规模真实表格数据预训练，私有/专有数据集可能被悄然纳入预训练语料，而目前缺乏判断某表格数据集是否参与 TFM 训练的专用方法，存在隐私泄露与数据滥用风险。
AI.method: 系统性分析通过输入操纵可从黑盒 TFM 观测到的一类候选信号；发现单一信号对训练集成员关系证据微弱，遂将多个互补信号组合成数据集级推断方法；并考察预训练数据构成、模型容量、真实数据与合成数据等因素的影响。
AI.result: 在多个基于真实表格数据训练的先进 TFM 上成功实现数据集成员推断，依 TFM 不同 ROCAUC 最高达 0.99。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可作为实用审计工具，用于检测 TFM 中的隐私泄露及专有数据集的使用。

title: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
summary: In long-term interactions with large language model (LLM) agents, users reveal habits through their choices and actions. These habits capture implicit user information that agents must infer across conversations. However, individual observations may provide only partial evidence about a habit or when it applies. Retaining past interactions alone does not ensure that agents can infer habits and apply them appropriately. We introduce HABIT-Bench to evaluate how well agent memory systems infer habits from weak evidence and apply them to later requests. We construct synthetic user histories from task-oriented dialogue data and controlled habit graphs. The histories span hundreds of sessions across food, finance, software, and travel. Four-choice tasks assess agents' ability to infer user habits and apply them appropriately. They include temporary exceptions, changes in habits, and suggestions that users have not accepted. Sampled tasks undergo independent human review. We evaluate eight memory methods with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.3-Flash. The best-performing memory method achieves 33.61\% macro accuracy across the four domains. Performance remains limited even when annotated evidence is supplied directly. These results expose a persistent gap between access to past interactions and the ability to infer and appropriately use user habits.

AI.tldr: 提出HABIT-Bench基准，评估智能体记忆系统能否从弱证据中推断用户习惯并在后续请求中正确应用。表现最佳的记忆方法在四个域上仅达33.61%宏平均准确率，即便直接提供标注证据性能仍受限，揭示"访问历史"与"推断并恰当使用习惯"之间存在持续差距。
AI.motivation: 长期交互中用户习惯通过选择与行为隐式暴露，智能体需跨会话推断这些隐含信息；但单次观察仅提供部分证据（习惯本身或其适用条件），仅保留过去交互并不足以保证推断与恰当应用，故需一个专门评测该能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建HABIT-Bench：基于任务导向对话数据与受控习惯图合成用户历史，覆盖餐饮、金融、软件、旅行四域、数百会话；设计四选一任务考察习惯推断与恰当应用，包含临时例外、习惯变化、用户未采纳的建议等情形；抽样任务经独立人工审核；用Qwen3-235B-A22B与GLM-5.3-Flash评测八种记忆方法，并设置直接供给标注证据的对照条件。
AI.result: 最佳记忆方法在四域宏平均准确率仅33.61%；即使直接提供标注证据，性能依然有限。
AI.conclusion: 现有记忆系统在从弱证据推断用户习惯并恰当应用方面存在持续且显著的能力缺口，获取历史交互信息不等于具备习惯推断与运用能力；该基准为后续改进提供评测基础。

title: An important Bottleneck in LLM Optimizers: Principle-Level Local Optima
summary: Feedback-driven LLM optimizers are increasingly used for evolutionary search, Bayesian optimization, heuristic design, and scientific discovery. Yet rapid initial gains often give way to prolonged plateaus despite substantial remaining evaluation budgets. We investigate \emph{principle-level search collapse}, where an optimizer's search becomes confined to a narrow set of design principles, even though it may continue to generate distinct candidates and achieve small improvements. We assemble a diagnostic benchmark spanning molecular optimization, network sentinel-node selection, and GPU-kernel optimization, and introduce a decision-tree protocol combining principle narrowing, prolonged performance plateaus, and gaps to attainable reference solutions. Across 161 assessable runs on the three problem domains, 78.3\% receive support for collapse, including 55.3\% with strong support. Candidate-level variation can nevertheless conceal restricted search at the principle level. We then test \emph{diversity injection}, a common response to search stagnation, such as higher t, multiple LLMs, and web search, and show that it provides limited and inconsistent benefits: among 65 molecular runs, still 73.8\% and 53.8\% receive support and strong support respectively. We finally test reference-principle interventions and find that they improve some runs, but their benefits vary across models and tasks: access to a better principle does not guarantee its effective use. Our benchmark and diagnostic protocol provide a basis for evaluating future optimizers on principle-level collapse. Our findings highlight the need for online collapse detection and better mechanisms for generating and maintaining alternative principles during optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"原则级搜索崩塌"概念并构建诊断基准与决策树协议，发现161次运行中78.3%存在崩塌支持、55.3%为强支持；常用的多样化注入效果有限，参考原则干预收益因模型与任务而异。
AI.motivation: 反馈驱动的LLM优化器在演化搜索、贝叶斯优化、启发式设计与科学发现中广泛应用，但常出现初期快速提升后长期停滞的现象，即使仍有大量评估预算。作者希望刻画这种停滞的本质：搜索被限制在狭窄的设计原则集合内。
AI.method: 构建涵盖分子优化、网络哨兵节点选择、GPU核优化的诊断基准；提出决策树协议，结合"原则收窄""性能长期平台期""与可达参考解的差距"三项判据判定崩塌；在三个域共161次可评估运行上测评；测试多样化注入（提高温度t、多LLM、网络搜索）；测试参考原则干预。
AI.result: 161次运行中78.3%获得崩塌支持，55.3%为强支持；候选层面的多样性可能掩盖原则层面的搜索受限；65次分子运行中即使采用多样化注入，仍有73.8%支持、53.8%强支持崩塌；参考原则干预能改善部分运行，但收益跨模型与任务不一致，获得更好的原则并不保证被有效利用。
AI.conclusion: 基准与诊断协议为评估未来优化器在原则级崩塌上的表现提供基础；研究强调需要在线崩塌检测机制，以及更好的生成与维持替代原则的机制。

title: Comparing Sparsified MLPs and Transcoders: Many Transcoder Features Are Neurons in Disguise
summary:
MLP neurons in transformer language models are widely understood to be polysemantic, motivating transcoders - sparse, learned approximations of MLP layers - as interpretable replacement models for mechanistic analysis. However, recent work shows that MLP neurons can be used to recover sparse, interpretable circuits (Arora et al. 2026, Ye et al. 2025), raising the question of whether transcoders are necessary for circuit analysis.
  We define neuron features as transcoder features whose weights are strongly aligned with individual MLP neurons, and show that they account for a substantial fraction of active features in late layers across 13 open-source transcoders. Only neuron features have a stable correspondence with something in the underlying MLP: other features vary more between training runs, do not match the MLP's Jacobian, and change less significantly from their random initialization. Our findings reframe MLP neurons as a stronger basis for interpretability than commonly assumed, and call for better methods of attributing the non-neuron structure that is used by the model.

AI.tldr: 作者定义"神经元特征"（权重与单个MLP神经元强对齐的transcoder特征），发现其在13个开源transcoder的深层中占据活跃特征的相当比例，且只有这类特征与底层MLP存在稳定对应关系；据此认为MLP神经元是被低估的可解释性基础，transcoder对电路分析的必要性存疑。
AI.motivation: MLP神经元被普遍认为具有多义性，因此研究者用稀疏学习的transcoder作为MLP层的可解释替代模型来进行机制分析。但近期工作表明，直接用MLP神经元也能恢复稀疏、可解释的电路（Arora et al. 2026; Ye et al. 2025）。这引出核心疑问：transcoder对电路分析是否真的必要？
AI.method: 提出"神经元特征"的操作性定义：transcoder特征中权重与单个MLP神经元强对齐者。在13个开源transcoder上统计这类特征在活跃特征中所占比例（重点考察深层），并从三个维度检验其与底层MLP的对应稳定性：跨训练运行的变异程度、与MLP雅可比矩阵的匹配度、相对随机初始化的偏离幅度。
AI.result: 在13个开源transcoder的深层中，神经元特征占活跃特征的相当比例。只有神经元特征与底层MLP中的某物保持稳定对应：其他特征在训练运行之间变异更大、不与MLP雅可比匹配、相对随机初始化的变化也更小（即更接近初始化、偏离不明显）。
AI.conclusion: 重新定位MLP神经元：它是比通常假设更强的可解释性基础，而非仅仅是多义性的障碍。同时指出模型实际使用的非神经元结构尚缺乏良好的归因方法，呼吁发展更好的方法来刻画这部分结构。

title: Inducing Fourier Geometry: A Smoothness Prior Imposes Approximate Translation Equivariance in Multimodal Stellar Embeddings
summary: Learned representations often contain geometric structure induced by symmetries in the underlying data. We ask whether a known continuous parameter space can instead be used to \emph{induce} such structure when the corresponding symmetry is only approximate. We introduce a graph-Laplacian smoothness prior that encourages representations to vary smoothly over a physical parameter space without specifying a representation geometry; in the continuum limit it selects Laplacian eigenfunctions and therefore predicts the Fourier-like geometry associated with translation symmetry. On multimodal stellar representations spanning six astronomical surveys, the prior induces Toeplitz Gram structure and sinusoidal modes along stellar parameters, including in modalities whose native representations lack this geometry, while modality-specific residuals preserve structure outside the imposed coordinates. Of the exact-symmetry predictions, stationarity in a recoverable warped coordinate survives; diagnostics assuming exact quantization or asymptotic rates do not. The prior also improves downstream linear-probe performance and label efficiency, suggesting a general strategy: where a meaningful continuous parameter space exists, its local geometry can serve as a data-informed prior.

AI.tldr: 提出一种图拉普拉斯平滑先验，利用已知连续参数空间在近似对称情形下诱导表示中的几何结构。
AI.motivation: 学习到的表示常含有由数据对称性诱导的几何结构。作者探究：当对称性仅为近似时，能否改用已知的连续参数空间来主动诱导这种结构。
AI.method: 引入图拉普拉斯平滑先验，促使表示在物理参数空间上平滑变化而不预设表示几何；在连续极限下该先验选择拉普拉斯特征函数，从而预测出与平移对称相关的类傅里叶几何。在覆盖六个天文巡天的多模态恒星表示上验证。
AI.result: 先验沿恒星参数诱导出Toeplitz Gram结构与正弦模态，包括原生表示缺失该几何的模态；模态特异残差保留施加坐标之外的结构。精确对称预测中，可恢复的扭曲坐标下的平稳性成立，而假设精确量化或渐近速率的诊断不成立。先验还提升了线性探针性能与标签效率。
AI.conclusion: 存在有意义的连续参数空间时，其局部几何可作为数据驱动的先验，是一种通用策略。

title: Rethinking EEG Spatial Super-Resolution as Dynamic State Decomposition and Filtering
summary: EEG spatial super-resolution aims to recover high-density neural signals from sparse electrode observations. Existing methods have achieved substantial progress through spatial modeling, generative reconstruction, and temporal representation learning. However, the current EEG state contains two different sources of information: predictable evolution inherited from preceding states and newly emerging changes revealed by the current observation. Most approaches typically do not model these two components explicitly. In this work, we formulate streaming EEG spatial super-resolution as a sequential state filtering problem and propose Dynamic State Filtering (DSF). Rather than relying on a single temporal reconstruction pathway, DSF combines a history-aware dynamical branch with an innovation-filtering branch that explicitly decomposes waveform-state estimation into prediction and observation-driven correction. To infer how spatially incomplete innovations should affect missing locations, DSF routes the observed innovations across electrodes through a mask-constrained, topology-aware transition operator and incorporates them through uncertainty-aware state correction. The two complementary estimates are finally fused to reconstruct the dense EEG signal. Experiments on SEED, SEED-IV and BCI2000 demonstrate that DSF improves reconstruction fidelity and downstream utility while maintaining robustness under dynamically changing and unreliable sparse observations.

AI.tldr: 将流式EEG空间超分辨率建模为序贯状态滤波问题，提出动态状态滤波（DSF），通过“历史感知动力学分支+新息滤波分支”显式分解预测与新息校正，在多数据集上提升重建保真度与下游效用。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG空间超分辨率方法（空间建模、生成式重建、时序表征学习）通常不显式建模当前EEG状态的两种信息来源：由先前状态继承的可预测演化，以及当前观测揭示的新增变化，导致重建与下游效用受限。
AI.method: 把流式EEG空间超分辨率表述为序贯状态滤波；DSF包含历史感知的动力学分支与新息滤波分支，将波形状态估计显式分解为预测与观测驱动校正；通过掩码约束、拓扑感知的转移算子将已观测电极上的新息路由至缺失位置，并以不确定性感知的状态校正融合，最终融合两路互补估计重建稠密EEG。
AI.result: 在SEED、SEED-IV与BCI2000上，DSF提升重建保真度与下游任务效用，并在动态变化且不可靠的稀疏观测下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 显式分解“预测演化”与“观测新息”的滤波式框架是EEG空间超分辨率的有效范式，兼具重建精度、下游可用性与对稀疏观测退化的鲁棒性。

title: Constructive Universal Approximation by Infinite-Dimensional Neural Networks via Gaussian-Weighted Ridgelet Transform
summary: Neural networks whose inputs are functions, as in operator learning, are usually shown to be universal by existence arguments, either by reduction to finite-dimensional networks or by Stone--Weierstrass-type density; these prove that approximants exist but say little about how the parameters depend on the target. We take a constructive route. We extend the ridgelet transform, an integral transform related to the Fourier, Radon, and wavelet transforms, to continuous maps on a separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, replacing the Lebesgue measure that is unavailable in infinite dimensions by Gaussian weights with a homogeneous mixture on the direction space. The resulting transform has a Plancherel identity and reconstruction formulas incorporating the frame operator, the correction induced by the weights, and it assigns to each target an explicit coefficient measure, one for every admissible analysis filter. From these representations we obtain uniform approximation on compact sets for all continuous non-polynomial activations of polynomial growth, including ReLU, and, by Monte Carlo sampling of the coefficient, finite-width networks with a dimension-free $O(N^{-1/2})$ error in the width $N$ for globally Lipschitz activations and coefficients with finite variation and second moments. Explicit examples include Gaussian targets and neural-operator layers. A companion Lean~4 formalization provides machine-checked proofs, with its correspondence to the manuscript documented at https://shosonoda.github.io/lean-operator-ridgelet/ .

AI.tldr: 本文将ridgelet变换推广到可分无限维Hilbert空间上的连续映射，用方向空间上的高斯权重替代不可用的Lebesgue测度，得到Plancherel恒等式与重构公式，从而对多项式增长的非多项式激活（含ReLU）给出紧集上的一致逼近，并用蒙特卡洛采样得到宽度无关维度的O(N^{-1/2})误差界。
AI.motivation: 算子学习中的函数输入神经网络（如neural operator）的通用性通常依赖存在性论证（化归为有限维网络或Stone–Weierstrass型稠密性），只能说明逼近元存在，却无法刻画参数如何依赖目标函数。作者希望走构造性路线，显式给出系数表示。
AI.method: 将ridgelet变换（与Fourier、Radon、小波变换相关的积分变换）推广到可分无限维Hilbert空间上的连续映射；由于无限维中无Lebesgue测度，改用高斯权重并在方向空间上取齐次混合。得到含frame operator与权重修正项的Plancherel恒等式和重构公式，对每个目标及每个容许分析滤波器给出显式系数测度；再通过对系数测度做蒙特卡洛采样构造有限宽网络。
AI.result: 对紧集上所有连续、非多项式且多项式增长的激活函数（含ReLU）获得一致逼近；对全局Lipschitz激活与有限变差、有限二阶矩的系数，得到宽度N的维度无关O(N^{-1/2})误差；给出高斯目标与neural-operator层等显式例子；并提供Lean 4机器验证形式化证明。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以构造性方式建立了无限维算子学习的ridgelet表示理论，把通用性从存在性提升为带显式系数与收敛率的重构，并通过形式化验证增强可靠性。

title: Concordance Plausibility Check for Intervention-Conditioned Human Digital Twins
summary: Intervention-conditioned human digital twins predict treatment alternatives that cannot be observed in the same patient. Ordinary predictive accuracy therefore cannot establish counterfactual credibility. We propose the Concordance Plausibility Check (CPC), a claim-centered framework combining real-world evidence, qualified simulation and clinical knowledge. CPC matches evidence to the causal claim, audits contradictions and shared dependencies, and reports Pass, Fail or reason-coded Indeterminate.

AI.tldr: 提出"一致性可信性检查"(CPC)框架，用于评估干预条件下的"人类数字孪生"所给出的反事实治疗预测是否可信，而非仅凭预测精度判断。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生用于预测同一患者无法观察到的替代治疗方案，属于反事实推断；因此常规预测准确度无法确立其可信性，需要面向"主张"的评估方法。
AI.method: CPC为以因果主张为中心的框架，融合真实世界证据、合格的仿真与临床知识；将证据与因果主张匹配，审查矛盾与共享依赖，并给出Pass、Fail或带原因编码的Indeterminate结论。
AI.result: 摘要未报告实证结果，仅给出方法设计与判定输出形式（三分类加原因编码）。
AI.conclusion: 反事实可信性需独立于预测精度的评估范式；CPC提供了结构化、可审计的判定路径，适用于数字孪生等干预条件下的因果预测。

title: Predicting CVSS and CWE from CVE Descriptions with Fine-Tuned Small Language Models
summary: Until April 2026, the National Vulnerability Database labeled nearly every published Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entry with a Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) v3.1 vector, a severity tier, and a Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) weakness type. Now, NIST enriches only the high priority CVEs, leaving many newly published vulnerabilities unlabelled with the classifiers that security teams use for patch triage. In CVE enrichment, we predict the eight base components of CVSS v3.1 vector, base score, severity tier, and CWE from the vulnerability's textual description alone. To prevent leakage between near-duplicate descriptions, all systems are trained only on CVEs published in 2022 and 2023. Results are evaluated on all 36,325 usable 2024 CVEs in the pinned NVD snapshot. All scores are either directly predicted, or calculated from predicted vectors using the CVSS formula. A fine-tuned 3.8B-parameter model Phi-3.5-mini, trained with LoRA in 2.5 hours on a single Apple M5 Pro chip, achieves 69.9% accuracy on severity and 70.9% on CWE. It matches the official vector exactly for 48.8% of test CVEs, outperforming TF-IDF logistic regression by 2.8 to 4.7 points on all accuracy metrics based on zero-exclusion paired bootstrap intervals. When we evaluate the base model with a zero-shot prompt, it achieves 20.8% accuracy on severity in a sample of 2,000 CVEs. In this same sample, its stated scores match its own vector precisely for only 3.4% of CVEs. However, deriving scores from predicted vectors boosts the critical recall of TF-IDF logistic regression from 50.7% to 73.3% with no additional cost. And since the errors of the fine-tuned model and TF-IDF affect different CVEs, at least one system matches the correct severity tier for 75.8% of test CVEs.

AI.tldr: 该文研究CVE富化：仅用漏洞文本描述预测CVSS v3.1的八个基础分量、基础评分、严重等级与CWE弱点类型，以应对NIST自2026年起仅富化高优先级CVE导致的标签缺失问题。
AI.motivation: NIST已停止对全部CVE标注CVSS v3.1向量、严重等级与CWE，仅富化高优先级条目，使安全团队的补丁优先级排序缺乏分类标签，需自动化富化手段。
AI.method: 以2022–2023年CVE为训练集（避免近重复描述泄漏），在2024年全部36,325条可用CVE上测试；采用LoRA微调3.8B参数Phi-3.5-mini（单张Apple M5 Pro约2.5小时），并与TF-IDF逻辑回归及零样本基座模型对比；评分可直接预测或按CVSS公式由预测向量计算；采用零排除配对bootstrap区间做显著性检验。
AI.result: 微调模型严重等级准确率69.9%、CWE 70.9%，向量完全匹配率48.8%，在所有准确率指标上领先TF-IDF逻辑回归2.8–4.7个百分点；零样本基座模型严重等级仅20.8%，其自述评分与自身向量一致率仅3.4%；由预测向量推导评分可将TF-IDF的critical召回从50.7%提升至73.3%且无额外成本；两系统错误互补，至少一个系统命中正确严重等级的比例达75.8%。
AI.conclusion: 中等规模微调模型可在消费级硬件上高效完成CVE多标签富化，向量推导评分是提升关键级召回的低成本手段，异构系统集成可进一步覆盖错误。

title: CADS: Measuring the Incremental Contribution of LLM Proposers in Sequential Biological Screens
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to guide sequential biological screens, yet standard evaluations rely on raw hit counts that conflate a proposer's value with the discovery capacity of the underlying algorithmic harness. Adaptive sampling and corrupted experimental readouts also leave standard feedback comparisons without a false-discovery guarantee. We present Certified Agentic Discovery Screens (CADS), an error-controlled measurement framework that quantifies a proposer's incremental value against an identical LLM-free loop. By integrating capped likelihood-ratio bounds, e-processes, and complete-family e-BH, CADS controls the terminal false discovery rate under the stated null and corruption conditions despite arbitrary dependence, adaptive sampling, and optional stopping. In DepMap-backed simulations, CADS exposes two evaluation artifacts: the LLM-free harness alone clears the feedback gate, and raw origin counts overstate LLM contributions because LLM picks displace fallback discoveries. On the initial 20 seeds, supplying tested-candidate history to Qwen2.5-7B shifts its net contribution from +0.35, with a 95% interval covering zero, to +2.90, with the interval above zero. This initial net effect did not persist in a 50-seed matched-quota replication. These results support net gain over an LLM-free loop, measured between separately certified sets, as the appropriate measure of proposer contribution.

AI.tldr: 提出CADS误差控制测量框架，用以量化LLM提议者在序列生物筛选中相对无LLM回路的净增量贡献，并在DepMap模拟中揭示hit计数类评估的两大伪影，同时报告LLM净效应的初步与非复现结果。
AI.motivation: 标准评估依赖原始hit计数，将提议者价值与底层算法框架（harness）的发现能力混为一谈；自适应采样与受污染的读出使常规反馈比较缺乏错误发现保证，因此需要一个可证明误差控制的度量框架。
AI.method: CADS将提议者与同一无LLM回路进行对照，采用截断似然比界、e-process与complete-family e-BH，在任意依赖、自适应采样与可选停止条件下控制终端FDR；并在DepMap支持的模拟中进行验证。
AI.result: CADS暴露两类评估伪影：无LLM框架本身即可通过反馈门槛；原始来源计数因LLM选择挤占回退发现而高估LLM贡献。Qwen2.5-7B在初始20个种子下净贡献由+0.35（95%区间含零）升至+2.90（区间不含零），但50种子匹配配额复制中该效应未持续。
AI.conclusion: 应以“相对无LLM回路的净增益、且分别在独立认证集合上测量”作为提议者贡献的恰当度量，而非原始hit计数或来源计数。

title: Torch-DPhys: A Torch-Native, MOOSE-Compatible Framework for Differentiable Physics Simulation and Hybrid Machine Learning Integration
summary: We present Torch-DPhys, a Torch-native framework implemented in PyTorch for differentiable physics simulation and hybrid physics-machine learning. It implements selected thermal-hydraulic modeling concepts and discretizations from MOOSE's Thermal Hydraulics Module and the System Analysis Module (SAM), with a preliminary extension to continuum mechanics. Native tensor residuals support CPU and GPU execution, compilation of selected numerical kernels, and sparse direct linear solves. Sensitivities are obtained by differentiating executed numerical operations or through discrete adjoints of converged residual equations. Verification combines analytical solutions, reference-code comparisons, and derivative checks. Demonstrations cover plane-strain elasticity, one- and two-loop thermal-hydraulic transients, and an axisymmetric molten-salt fast reactor. For the reactor, comparison with SAM-Lite gives a maximum normalized field discrepancy of 1.13 x 10^-5 over 200 adaptive time steps, demonstrating agreement between the tested discrete implementations. Selected transient sensitivities are assessed using tangent-linear calculations and finite differences on fixed time schedules. Two applications illustrate the framework's connection between simulation and optimization. A residual-adjoint parameter-identification calculation recovers nominal pump head and heating power with relative errors below 0.06% from noiseless synthetic MOOSE observations. A separate three-loop plant demonstration uses solver-in-the-loop training of a predictive controller by differentiating trajectory-level objectives through the thermal-hydraulic simulation. These examples illustrate a foundation for gradient-based inference, control, and coupled physics-machine learning models in nuclear engineering.

AI.tldr: 提出Torch-DPhys——基于PyTorch的可微物理仿真与物理-机器学习混合框架，移植MOOSE热工水力学模块与SAM的建模概念，初步扩展到连续介质力学，并通过多个算例验证其一致性与在参数辨识、控制优化上的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 核工程中的热工水力仿真与机器学习耦合、梯度型推断与控制缺乏原生支持自动微分、可在GPU上运行的框架；传统参考代码（MOOSE/SAM）不便求导，难以支撑优化与训练。
AI.method: 以原生张量残差形式实现MOOSE THM与SAM中的部分热工水力离散格式（含连续力学初步扩展），支持CPU/GPU、选定数值核的编译及稀疏直接求解；灵敏度通过自动微分已执行运算或收敛残差的离散伴随获得；采用解析解、参考代码对比与导数校验进行验证；应用示例包括残差伴随参数辨识与求解器在环训练预测控制器。
AI.result: 在轴对称熔盐快堆算例中，200个自适应时间步内与SAM-Lite对比最大归一化场偏差为1.13×10^-5；切线线性计算与有限差分对瞬态灵敏度评估一致；残差伴随参数辨识从无噪合成MOOSE观测中恢复泵扬程与加热功率，相对误差低于0.06%；三回路电厂演示实现通过热工水力仿真对轨迹级目标求导的求解器在环控制器训练。
AI.conclusion: Torch-DPhys为核工程中基于梯度的推断、控制与耦合物理-机器学习模型提供了可用的基础平台，其离散实现与参考代码一致并具备端到端可微能力。

title: HSPR: Recovering Software-Agent Benchmark Scores via Hierarchical Posterior Inference
summary: Evaluating software agents on a full benchmark is expensive. A small task subset can preserve agent rankings while yielding inaccurate scores. Historical responses provide useful structure, but tasks with identical source responses can have different outcomes for a new target agent. We introduce Hierarchical Score Posterior Recovery (HSPR), which combines source-fitted response factors with uncertain group success rates. Observed target outcomes update the posteriors over the target latent state and group rates; posterior-guided acquisition selects subsequent tasks. Its score-based criterion equals the expected one-step reduction in full-score posterior variance. Observed successes and posterior-predictive counts for unqueried tasks yield a full-score posterior. The final estimate uses its median with source-selected calibration. At a 10% task budget on four task banks from the SWE-bench family, HSPR achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) on three banks and the lowest maximum absolute error (MaxErr) on all four among the methods compared. Removing group uncertainty or replacing adaptive queries increases macro MAE in the respective controls. Macro MAE decreases across 5-20% budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出HSPR，融合源模型响应因子与不确定分组成功率，用后验引导主动采样，在10%预算下高精度估计软件智能体全基准得分。
AI.motivation: 全基准评测软件智能体代价高昂，小子集虽能保持排名却给出不准确分数，而历史响应虽有结构信息、但相同源响应的任务对新目标智能体结果可能不同，需兼顾准确分数估计与低预算。
AI.method: HSPR将源数据拟合的响应因子与不确定的分组成功率相结合；用目标智能体观测结果更新目标隐状态与分组率的后验；以后验引导的采集策略选任务，其基于分数的准则等价于全分数后验方差的一步期望下降；由已观测成功与未查询任务的后验预测计数构造全分数后验，最终取中位数并做源数据选定的校准。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench家族四个任务库、10%预算下，HSPR在三个库取得最低MAE、在全部四个库取得最低MaxErr；消融中去除分组不确定性或替换自适应查询均使宏平均MAE上升；宏平均MAE在5%–20%预算区间单调下降。
AI.conclusion: HSPR以分层贝叶斯后验恢复实现低成本、高精度的智能体全基准分数估计，分组不确定性与后验引导采样均为关键组件。

title: Muon Operates Beyond the Edge of Stability
summary: We study the Muon optimizer using sharpness and provide the first empirical evidence that the Flat Minima Hypothesis also applies to Muon. Further, we derive Muon's implicit preconditioner to analyze its potential Edge of Stability behavior. Experiments on CIFAR-10 show sharpness strongly correlates with generalization gap within each optimizer (Pearson $r = 0.45$-$0.69$, $p \leq 10^{-4}$), confirming the hypothesis holds for Muon similarly to Adam and SGD. However, Muon operates above the classical sharpness-based Adaptive Edge of Stability threshold that bounds diagonally-preconditioned optimizers like Adam and RMSprop, yet remains stable. Our findings suggest Muon operates in a fundamentally different regime than diagonally-adaptive methods. Defining the exact stability boundary for Muon remains an open question. All code is available at https://github.com/NikoCovic/DL-project.

AI.tldr: 首次用锐度(sharpness)为Muon优化器提供经验证据，验证平坦极小值假说同样适用于Muon，并揭示其运行在与对角自适应方法本质不同的稳定区域内。
AI.motivation: 平坦极小值假说与锐度-自适应稳定性边界此前主要针对SGD、Adam、RMSprop等对角预条件优化器建立，Muon作为基于矩阵正交化的新型优化器缺乏相关理论刻画，作者希望检验这些结论能否迁移到Muon。
AI.method: 以锐度为核心分析工具，推导Muon的隐式预条件器(implicit preconditioner)以分析其潜在的稳定性边缘(Edge of Stability)行为；在CIFAR-10上测量锐度与泛化差距的相关性，并将Muon的锐度与经典Sharpness-based Adaptive Edge of Stability阈值比较。
AI.result: 在每个优化器内部，锐度与泛化差距强相关(Pearson r=0.45–0.69, p≤10^-4)，说明假说对Muon与Adam、SGD同样成立；但Muon的运行锐度超过约束Adam、RMSprop等对角预条件优化器的经典阈值，却仍保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: Muon处于与对角自适应方法根本不同的运行区域，其精确稳定性边界仍未确定，是开放问题。

title: Selm: Self-Evolving Library Management for Multi-Skill Agent Optimization
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills as a lightweight way to acquire task-specific knowledge. Recent work enables skills to evolve from task trajectories. However, these methods often lack systematic management of evolved skills, making it difficult for agents to reuse and accumulate skills across domains, thus limiting performance on subsequent tasks.To reliably accumulate, reuse, and maintain useful skills across tasks, we present SELM (Self-Evolving Library Management), a framework that formulates skill evolution as library-level management. SELM jointly manages skill retrieval, updating, and lifecycle by maintaining skill confidence and utility signals. It introduces utility-aware retrieval to select useful skills, a Map-Reduce framework to generate targeted updates from task-specific experience, and lifecycle controls to retain or remove skills based on their effectiveness. These mechanisms enable the skill library to continuously accumulate useful experience while preserving and pruning skills across tasks, improving agent performance on complex tasks across diverse domains. We evaluate SELM on four agent benchmarks covering diverse tasks and execution environments, and SELM consistently outperforms in most settings.

AI.tldr: SELM将LLM智能体的技能演化重构为"技能库级管理"问题，联合管理技能检索、更新与生命周期，实现技能的跨任务积累、复用与维护。
AI.motivation: 现有工作虽能让技能从任务轨迹中演化，但缺乏对演化技能的系统化管理，导致智能体难以跨领域复用与积累技能，从而限制后续任务表现。目标是让技能可可靠地积累、复用并维持。
AI.method: SELM维护技能的置信度与效用信号，包含三个机制：(1) 效用感知检索（utility-aware retrieval），优先选取有用技能；(2) Map-Reduce框架，从任务特定经验中生成有针对性的技能更新；(3) 生命周期控制，依据技能有效性保留或删除技能。
AI.result: 在覆盖多种任务与执行环境的四个智能体基准上评测，SELM在多数设置下持续优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 将技能演化视为库级管理是有效范式：持续积累有用经验、同时保留与剪枝技能，可提升智能体在多样领域复杂任务上的性能。

title: Learning Administrative Boundary-Aware Location Encoders via Reverse Geocoding
summary: Location encoders learn compact representations of latitude--longitude coordinates for downstream geospatial prediction tasks. Existing approaches are pretrained using continuous or naturally occurring supervision, such as imagery, climate variables, or species distributions, and therefore do not explicitly capture administrative boundaries or place names, despite their strong influence on many real-world geospatial phenomena. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first method for learning administrative boundary-aware location encoders, using reverse-geocoded text as a self-supervised training signal. Our approach can be applied to existing location encoder architectures and consistently improves their downstream performance. We further introduce RevGeoRQ, a custom architecture tailored to reverse-geocoding supervision, which yields additional gains and exceeds contemporary location encoders on several downstream tasks. Finally, the use of human-interpretable reverse-geocoded strings and residual-quantized semantic IDs provides a more interpretable representation of geographic location than existing approaches. Code and model weights to be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个利用逆地理编码文本作为自监督信号学习行政边界感知位置编码器的方法，可应用于现有架构，并提出定制架构 RevGeoRQ，在下游任务上超过现有位置编码器并具更好可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有位置编码器多用影像、气候变量或物种分布等连续或自然监督预训练，未显式捕捉行政边界与地名，而后者对许多现实地理现象影响显著。
AI.method: 以逆地理编码文本为自监督训练信号学习位置编码器；该方法可加装于现有编码器架构；进一步设计适配逆地理编码监督的定制架构 RevGeoRQ，采用残差量化语义 ID。
AI.result: 方法在现有架构上一致提升下游性能；RevGeoRQ 带来额外增益，在多项下游任务上超过当代位置编码器；可解释性优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 行政边界感知的位置编码可通过逆地理编码文本自监督获得，兼具性能与可解释性优势；代码与模型权重将公开。

title: Frequency-Domain Membership Inference Does Not Beat Confidence Thresholding: A Band-Resolved Analysis of Why
summary: A widely repeated account of membership inference holds that models lean on fine-grained detail for samples they have memorized, so degrading an input's resolution should expose membership through how quickly a prediction falls apart. We test that account band by band. A monotone family of zero-phase low-pass filters is applied to each query image, the target's confidence on its original prediction is read at every step, and the resulting decay is scored in a dozen ways. Two federated ResNet-18 targets are studied, one trained normally and one pushed to a 45.1-point generalization gap. The account does not survive. On the normally trained target the best profile score reaches an AUC of 0.513 against 0.537 for a single confidence threshold, and on the overfit target 0.735 against 0.943. A search over 1206 candidate scores, with direction chosen on a held-out half and a fitted combination as an upper bound, produces no score that beats the threshold in either regime. The failure has a mechanism: the mean confidence gap between members and non-members grows as detail is removed, exactly as the hypothesis predicts, but the spread grows faster, so discriminability falls from the first step onward. Decomposing each image into phase and magnitude shows why no band-localized operation can work, since the advantage travels with image structure, surviving at 0.567 when the phase is kept and collapsing to 0.492 when only the magnitude is. Membership is a whole-image identity effect rather than an accumulation of spectral energy in any band, and defenses aimed at high-frequency reliance are aimed at the wrong target.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验"成员推理依赖细粒度细节、降分辨率可暴露成员身份"这一流行假设，通过对图像逐频带低通滤波并分析置信度衰减，发现该假设不成立：衰减剖面得分无法超越单一置信度阈值，原因在于类间均值差距虽增大但方差增长更快，成员身份是整图身份效应而非任何频带能量的累积。
AI.motivation: 文献中广泛流传一种成员推理解释：模型对被记忆样本依赖细粒度细节，因此降低输入分辨率会通过预测崩溃速度暴露成员身份。作者希望逐频带实证检验这一说法，并厘清其失效机制。
AI.method: 对每个查询图像施加一族单调的零相位低通滤波器，在每一步读取目标模型对原始预测类的置信度，并以12种方式对衰减曲线打分；研究两个联邦ResNet-18目标（一个正常训练，一个被推到45.1个百分点的泛化差距）；额外搜索1206个候选得分（在留出一半数据上选方向，并拟合组合作为上界）；进一步将图像分解为相位与幅度以定位信息来源。
AI.result: 正常训练目标上最佳剖面得分AUC为0.513，低于单一置信度阈值的0.537；过拟合目标上为0.735，远低于阈值的0.943。1206个候选得分在两种情形下均无一超越阈值。机制上，成员与非成员的平均置信度差距随细节移除而增大（符合假设），但方差增长更快，导致可区分性从第一步起就下降。相位/幅度分解显示：保留相位时优势维持在0.567，仅保留幅度时降至0.492，说明优势随图像结构而非特定频带能量流动。
AI.conclusion: 成员身份是整图身份效应，而非任何频带光谱能量的累积；基于"高频依赖"的防御瞄准了错误目标，频带局部化操作在原理上难以奏效。

title: Latent State Utilization in Probabilistic Circuits
summary: Probabilistic circuits (PCs) are generative models that support efficient probabilistic inference. Adding latent states to a PC increases its representational capacity, but yields diminishing gains in likelihood. We use mutual information to examine how the dependence represented by a trained PC changes with latent size. Experiments with Hidden Chow-Liu Trees (HCLTs) on ImageNet32 show that learned dependence grows slowly and remains well below both the latent-state upper bound and estimates of dependence in the data. To understand how learning uses these states, we examine how strongly each sample favors particular latent states and how broadly states are used across the dataset. Tracking these measurements during HCLT training distinguishes rapid early posterior concentration from the more gradual stabilization of sample-dependent state preferences. Early measurements also guide initialization selection in HCLTs and hidden Markov models (HMMs), as well as tree selection in HCLTs. The resulting choices improve the ultimate performance across the tested latent sizes, providing a practical benefit from our study of latent-state utilization.

AI.tldr: 该论文用互信息分析概率电路（PC）中潜在状态的实际利用情况，发现训练后的依赖增长缓慢且远低于潜在状态上界与数据依赖估计；据此提出的后验集中度与状态使用广度两项指标可用于初始化、模型/树选择，并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 在概率电路中加入潜在状态虽提升表示能力，但对似然的增益递减，说明潜在状态可能未被有效利用；作者希望量化"训练后的PC实际表示了多少依赖"以及"学习过程如何使用这些潜在状态"。
AI.method: 以互信息度量训练后PC所表示的依赖随潜在规模的变换（在ImageNet32上的HCLT实验）；并追踪两个指标：单样本对特定潜在状态的偏好强度（后验集中度）和状态在数据集上的使用广度，观察其在训练过程中的演化；再用早期测量指导HCLT与HMM的初始化及HCLT的树结构选择。
AI.result: 学习到的依赖增长缓慢，且明显低于潜在状态上界与数据中依赖的估计。训练过程呈现两阶段：早期后验快速集中，随后样本相关的状态偏好缓慢稳定。基于早期指标做出的初始化与树选择在各测试潜在规模下均提升最终性能。
AI.conclusion: 潜在状态的表示容量未被充分利用；互信息与后验/状态使用指标能刻画潜在状态的利用动态，并可作为实用的模型初始化与结构选择依据，带来可测量的性能提升。

title: Good Judgment, Bad Advice: Decision-Model Controllers Raise Agent Cost Without Improving Success
summary: Agent scaffolds increasingly delegate small decisions (whether to stop, verify, or change approach) to cheaper models. We ask whether a typed decision model, Jev 1.13, consulted only at deterministic decision points, makes a Claude Sonnet 5.5 terminal agent cheaper without making it worse. In a pre-specified study on Terminal-Bench 2.1, we hold one agent loop fixed and vary only the controller: none, deterministic rules, a small LLM (Claude Haiku 5.5) answering the same questions, Jev, and a placebo that samples Jev's development-phase choice frequencies at the same moments. On 21 held-out tasks (315 trials), Jev raised cost per attempt by 19% (geometric-mean ratio 1.19, 95% CI 1.02-1.36) at an identical pass rate (73.0% vs. 73.0%). Jev was cheaper than the small-LLM controller (ratio 0.81) but 22% more expensive than the placebo, and no pass-rate difference between arms was detectable. Offline, Jev ranked finish requests better than the alternatives (AUROC 0.78 vs. 0.62 for rules and 0.60 for the small LLM) but was poorly calibrated: its mean probability that a run was complete was 0.50 when 87% of those runs passed, so it asked the agent to verify work that was already correct. No controller ever chose to abandon a run. Informative decision signals did not become useful interventions; we discuss what that would require.

AI.tldr: 在固定 agent 循环下比较多种控制器（无、规则、小 LLM、类型化决策模型 Jev 1.13、安慰剂），Jev 未降低成本也未提升通过率，说明"有信息量的决策信号"未能转化为"有效干预"。
AI.motivation: Agent scaffold 越来越多地把"是否停止、是否验证、是否换策略"等小决策外包给更便宜的模型，但缺乏严格证据证明这类控制器真的能在不损害性能的前提下降低成本。作者因此提出可预注册的对照实验来检验。
AI.method: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上进行预注册研究，固定同一 agent 循环（Claude Sonnet 5.5 终端 agent），仅改变控制器：无控制器、确定性规则、小型 LLM（Claude Haiku 5.5）回答同样问题、类型化决策模型 Jev 1.13、以及按 Jev 开发期选择频率同刻采样的安慰剂。共 21 个留出任务、315 次试验；另做离线评估（AUROC）与校准分析。
AI.result: Jev 使每次尝试成本上升 19%（几何均值比 1.19，95% CI 1.02–1.36），通过率完全持平（73.0% vs 73.0%）。Jev 比小 LLM 控制器便宜（比值 0.81），但比安慰剂贵 22%；各臂之间未检出通过率差异。离线 Jev 对"完成请求"的排序优于规则（AUROC 0.78 vs 0.62）和小 LLM（0.60），但校准很差：预测完成概率均值 0.50，而实际通过率 87%，导致反复要求验证已完成的工作。无任何控制器选择放弃运行。
AI.conclusion: 具有判别力的决策信号并未转化为有益干预；仅靠决策点上的分类准确率不足以保证成本收益，需要更好的校准与干预策略（即"信号→干预"的转化机制）才能实现降本不降质。

title: Morpheus-2.0: Multiscale Probabilistic Forecasting with Dual-Axis Attention
comment: 26 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Aakriti and Manoj Cherukumalli contributed equally
summary: A universal forecaster is trained once and applied everywhere, so it must serve tasks whose schemas, forecast horizons, and temporal resolutions all differ. The number of targets and covariates changes from dataset to dataset, horizons vary by orders of magnitude, and sampling rates range from seconds to years. Existing time-series foundation models address these only in part, since they isolate each series or visit the two grid relations in separate blocks, and they fix the horizon and resolution before training begins. We introduce Morpheus-2.0, a compact encoder-only foundation model that represents targets and covariates on a single variable-time grid. Its dual-axis attention runs both relations side by side in every layer, one across variables at a timestep and one across time within a variable; a learned gate weights the two per layer, and an axis-aware rotary encoding preserves both grid coordinates. The forecast length is sampled during training, so one set of weights spans short to long horizons at no additional inference cost. Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale extends the model to several temporal resolutions at once, weighting them according to the series being forecast. Across GIFT-Eval, which spans several domains and frequencies, the two models give complementary operating points: Morpheus-2.0 attains 0.685 relative MASE with 81M parameters, while the larger Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale attains 0.646 relative MASE and 0.455 relative CRPS, the lowest of any published system on both metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出 Morpheus-2.0：紧凑的 encoder-only 时间序列基础模型，在统一可变时间网格上建模目标与协变量，采用双轴注意力（变量间/时间维并行）、逐层门控与轴感知 RoPE，训练时采样预测长度；其 Multiscale 版本同时覆盖多时间分辨率。在 GIFT-Eval 上取得 0.685（81M）与 0.646 relative MASE / 0.455 relative CRPS 的最优结果。
AI.motivation: 通用预测器需一次训练、处处适用，但各任务在 schema（目标与协变量数量）、预测步长（跨数量级）与采样分辨率（秒到年）上差异极大。现有时间序列基础模型仅部分解决：将每条序列孤立处理，或将"变量间"与"时间维"两种网格关系放在不同模块中分步建模，且在训练前即固定预测步长与分辨率，缺乏真正的统一性。
AI.method: 1) 将所有目标与协变量表示在单一可变时间网格上；2) 双轴注意力（dual-axis attention）在每一层并行执行两种关系——同一时间步跨变量的注意力与同一变量内跨时间的注意力；3) 学习式门控（learned gate）按层加权两轴贡献；4) 轴感知旋转位置编码（axis-aware RoPE）同时保留变量轴与时间轴两套网格坐标；5) 训练时随机采样预测长度，使同一组权重覆盖短至长步长且不增加推理开销；6) Multiscale 扩展通过按被预测序列加权的方式一次性处理多个时间分辨率。
AI.result: 在覆盖多领域、多频率的 GIFT-Eval 基准上，两模型形成互补工作点：Morpheus-2.0（81M 参数）达 0.685 relative MASE；更大的 Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale 达 0.646 relative MASE 与 0.455 relative CRPS，两项指标均为已发表系统中最优。
AI.conclusion: 将目标与协变量统一到单一时变网格并以逐层并行的双轴注意力建模，配合轴感知位置编码与训练期步长采样，可在单一紧凑模型内实现跨 schema、跨步长、跨分辨率的通用预测；多分辨率加权扩展进一步提升精度，验证了架构层面的统一设计优于分块处理与预固定步长/分辨率的做法。

title: Can AI agents make law? Evaluating AI legal relevance and creativity
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Data, prompts and transcripts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23435854
summary: Large language models, the artificial intelligence (AI) systems behind modern chatbots, are trained on vast amounts of legal text, but can they build on it to write law for situations that text never anticipated? In this study, we analyse AI agents' ability to draft a hypothetical "Constitution" for a "community of AI agents". We design "constitutional assemblies" in which a single language model plays several characters that debate to produce a draft constitution. We find that the assemblies converge on a robust floor of legal provisions, and generate a wide variety of different proposals around it, including several AI-specific provisions with no equivalent in human law. Looking more closely at the "creativity" of these AI agents, we find different levels: most proposals combine existing concepts and themes from human constitutions with AI-specific vocabulary. We introduce a measure of this recombination, which helps identify and highlight the most novel legal material. This study reveals a ceiling on AI creativity: the agents extend familiar legal ideas to new situations, but they do not work through what those situations would change. Although current AI models can help develop new laws, they still depend on human legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 研究让同一大语言模型扮演多个角色组成"制宪会议"，为"AI智能体共同体"起草假想宪法，发现AI能收敛出稳健的法律条款基础并生成AI特有条款，但创造力存在上限——主要是对人类宪法概念的重组式延伸，仍依赖人类法律推理。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在法律文本上大量训练，但能否超越既有文本、为前所未有的情境"写"法尚不清楚。作者希望实证检验AI起草法律的能力与创造力边界。
AI.method: 设计"制宪会议"实验：由单个语言模型扮演多个角色进行辩论，产出假想宪法草案；对提案进行条款层面分析，并引入"重组度"（recombination）度量，用于识别最具新颖性的法律内容。
AI.result: 各会议收敛出一层稳健的法律条款"下限"，并在其周围生成多样化提案，其中包含若干人类法律中无对应物的AI专属条款；创造性呈分层：多数提案是将人类宪法既有概念与主题与AI专属词汇相结合，重组度量可凸显最新颖的法律材料。
AI.conclusion: AI创造力存在"天花板"：智能体能将熟悉的法律理念延伸到新情境，却无法真正推演这些情境本身会带来何种改变。当前模型可辅助立法开发，但仍依赖人类法律推理。

title: PAC Learning with Query Feedback
summary: We study realizable multiclass PAC learning with query feedback, where each training example provides a single binary response indicating whether its true label belongs to a chosen subset from a fixed query family. Our main contribution is the query dimension, a combinatorial parameter that captures both the structure of the hypothesis class and the ability of the available queries to distinguish labels. This parameter generalizes the bandit DS dimension, which it recovers under singleton queries. We establish a sample-complexity lower bound of $Ω(D/\varepsilon)$ and an upper bound of $\widetilde{O}(D^2/\varepsilon)$, suppressing factors polylogarithmic in the number of labels and the failure probability. When the available queries can split every candidate set into two parts of comparable size, we improve the upper bound to $\widetilde{O}(D/\varepsilon)$, yielding a characterization up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 该文研究带查询反馈的可实现多分类PAC学习，提出"查询维度"D这一组合参数，兼顾假设类结构与查询区分标签的能力，给出样本复杂度下界Ω(D/ε)与上界Õ(D²/ε)，并在查询能均衡二分候选集时改进到Õ(D/ε)，实现对数因子内的刻画。
AI.motivation: 传统多分类学习通常假设可获得完整标签反馈，而实际中每次训练样本往往只返回单个二值响应（真实标签是否属于某个选定子集）。作者希望在更弱的查询反馈模型下刻画可实现多分类PAC学习的样本复杂度，需要一个同时反映假设类结构与查询族区分能力的组合参数。
AI.method: 引入"查询维度"D：一个组合参数，联合刻画假设类结构与固定查询族区分标签的能力；在单元素查询下退化为bandit DS维度。基于该参数分别推导样本复杂度的下界与上界，并在查询可将任意候选集均衡二分（分成规模相当的两部分）的情形下设计更优算法以收紧上界。
AI.result: 得到样本复杂度下界Ω(D/ε)；一般情形上界Õ(D²/ε)（忽略关于标签数与失败概率的polylog因子）；当查询族能均衡二分每个候选集时，上界改进为Õ(D/ε)，从而在对数因子内给出样本复杂度的紧刻画。
AI.conclusion: 查询维度D可作为查询反馈下多分类PAC学习的核心复杂度度量：它推广了bandit DS维度，并能在对数因子内基本刻画样本复杂度；查询的"均衡分割"能力可将上界从D²级别降至D级别。

title: From Prediction to Action: Population Health World Model for Digital Medicine
summary:
Digital medicine now captures data that traces individual health trajectories and reveals population health dynamics through electronic health records, claims, remote monitoring, wearable devices, mobile devices, social sensing data, medical images, etc. But much of its modeling still centers on task-specific, outcome-specific, and prediction-specific estimation. The next frontier is not simply better prediction, but action in an evolving health world shaped by multiple decision-makers, heterogeneous populations, resource constraints, and feedback in care delivery. This is why digital medicine now needs world models: not only to estimate what will happen, but to represent how actions change what can happen next -- whom to prioritize, how to allocate scarce resources, how to adapt care across subgroups, and how interventions reshape future health trajectories and population dynamics.
  We call such a model population health world model (PHWM): a more foundational representation of an evolving health world in which health states, individual trajectories, population health dynamics, interventions, constraints, and feedback are intrinsically coupled. Building a PHWM endows three unmet structural gaps in current digital medicine: dynamic health-state modeling, population-level intervention intelligence, and validation, equity, and governance for action-oriented use. We argue that addressing these gaps requires three minimal capabilities: representation learning under action-dependent observation, multi-scale intervention intelligence, and validation with explicit decision boundaries, while highlighting the importance of social, contextual, and public-health sensing data for action-oriented digital medicine.

AI.tldr: 提出"群体健康世界模型"(PHWM)概念，主张数字医学应从任务特定的预测建模转向可表征"行动如何改变未来健康状态"的世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有数字医学建模多聚焦任务特定、结局特定、预测特定的估计，难以支撑多决策者、异质人群、资源约束与反馈机制下的行动决策；真正的前沿不是更好的预测，而是行动。
AI.method: 概念性论述与框架构建：定义PHWM为内在地耦合健康状态、个体轨迹、群体动态、干预、约束与反馈的基础性表征，并识别三类结构缺口及对应三项最小能力，强调社会、情境与公共卫生感知数据的价值。
AI.result: 识别出当前数字医学的三类结构缺口——动态健康状态建模、群体层面干预智能、面向行动用途的验证/公平/治理；提出三项最小能力——行动依赖观测下的表征学习、多尺度干预智能、带显式决策边界的验证。
AI.conclusion: 数字医学需构建PHWM以支持行动导向决策；补齐上述缺口与能力是未来发展的关键方向。

title: Power-Law Correlations Without Apparent Temperature-Tuned Criticality in Fixed-Tree Hierarchical Languages
summary: Sampling temperature can substantially reshape autoregressive generation, but it is unclear when temperature changes in long-range correlations reflect a genuine phase transition rather than a smooth change in statistics. We study this question in a controlled analogue of temperature sampling: a finite-depth probabilistic context-free grammar on a fixed hierarchical tree, where exact next-token conditionals are computed by belief propagation and then rescaled by a softmax temperature before autoregressive sampling. We measure two-point mutual information between tokens as a function of separation. Across the tested temperatures and grammar ensembles, mutual information remains well described by a power-law envelope. Temperature changes the correlation magnitude and fitted exponent, but within the accessible system sizes we find no long-distance plateau characteristic of an ordered phase and no clear crossover to short-range exponential decay. An approximate mapping to an Ising model on a tree explains how exponential decay in tree distance becomes a power law in token distance, allowing power laws to persist without tuning to a special decoding temperature. This controlled baseline clarifies which temperature effects can arise from hierarchical structure alone, before adding training, approximation error, or neural architecture.

AI.tldr: 在受控的概率上下文无关文法+树上的Ising映射框架下，采样温度改变互信息的幅度与幂律指数，但在可及系统尺寸内未观察到有序相的长程平台或向短程指数衰减的明确转变；幂律相关可无需调参而持续存在。
AI.motivation: 采样温度会显著改变自回归生成，但"温度导致的长程相关变化究竟是真实相变还是统计量的平滑变化"缺乏判定依据；且真实模型混杂了训练、近似误差与网络结构，难以分离层次结构本身的效应。
AI.method: 构建受控类比：固定层次树上的有限深度概率上下文无关文法，用信念传播（BP）计算精确的下一词条件分布，再以softmax温度重标定后进行自回归采样；以token间隔为变量测量两点互信息，并给出树上的Ising模型近似映射以解释树距离的指数衰减如何转为token距离的幂律。
AI.result: 在测试的温度与文法集合下，互信息始终可由幂律包络良好描述；温度改变相关幅度与拟合指数，但在可及系统尺寸内未出现有序相特征的长距离平台，也未出现向短程指数衰减的清晰crosssover。
AI.conclusion: 幂律长程相关可仅由层次结构导致，无需将解码温度调至特殊点；该受控基线明确了在引入训练、近似误差或神经架构之前，哪些温度效应可归因于层次结构本身。

title: MM-LeJEPA: Correlated Gaussian Regularization for Multimodal Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
summary: LeJEPA derives an isotropic Gaussian embedding target by minimizing, under its task assumptions, a Fisher information criterion that controls the task-averaged squared prediction bias. This enables unimodal self-supervised learning without reconstruction decoders, exponential-moving-average teachers, or contrastive negatives. However, its isotropic task prior does not account for the cross-modal structure of multimodal tasks that read shared content. We introduce MM-LeJEPA by extending LeJEPA's task assumptions to multimodal learning. Specifically, we model multimodal tasks as strength-weighted combinations of components that read independent information from the two modalities and components that read the same content from both. Under explicit gradient-moment, correspondence, and symmetry assumptions, we derive a correlated Gaussian target that minimizes a weighted Fisher information functional under a fixed total variance constraint. An analytic transform adapts Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) to this target, yielding a two-term objective that combines distributional regularization with local-to-global prediction. The extension adds a single scalar hyperparameter, the target cross-modal correlation, and retains the simplicity of LeJEPA. On public audio-visual classification benchmarks, our results are competitive with representative open-source methods. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 将 LeJEPA 的单峰各向同性高斯目标推广到多模态，推导出相关高斯目标并改造 SIGReg，得到双项目标，仅增一个标量超参，音视频分类性能有竞争力。
AI.motivation: LeJEPA 通过最小化 Fisher 信息准则（控制任务平均平方预测偏差）导出各向同性高斯嵌入目标，从而无需重构解码器、EMA 教师或对比负样本。但其各向同性任务先验无法刻画多模态任务中跨模态读取共享内容的结构，因此需要把该理论框架推广到多模态学习。
AI.method: 将多模态任务建模为两组分量的强度加权组合：分别从两个模态读取独立信息的分量，以及从两模态读取相同内容的分量。在显式的梯度矩假设、对应性假设与对称性假设下，在固定总方差约束下最小化加权 Fisher 信息泛函，解析地导出相关高斯目标；再通过解析变换把 SIGReg 适配到该目标，形成"分布正则化 + 局部到全局预测"的双项目标，仅引入一个标量超参（目标跨模态相关度）。
AI.result: 在公开音视频分类基准上，结果与代表性开源方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: MM-LeJEPA 将 LeJEPA 的任务假设自然延拓至多模态设定，保持了原有简洁性（无解码器、无 EMA 教师、无负样本），代价仅为单一标量超参数，并在音视频分类上验证了有效性。
