We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. On RoboCasa, incorporating HWM into Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B yields a 2.7% relative improvement in task success. On real-world AgiBot World trajectories, it improves nDTW by 9.7% with Ctrl-World and Logic by 8.4% with EVAC.

AI.tldr: HWM：将世界模型骨干潜变量表示于"广义坐标+动量"的相空间中，用耗散哈密顿动力学进行前向传播，并通过可学习逆映射回原潜空间，从而提升长时程预测的稳定性与下游任务效用。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式具身世界模型虽能合成视觉上合理的动作条件未来帧，但其潜动力学通常由无约束的转移模块学习，递归rollout时易逐步偏离连贯的物理演化，长时程预测可靠性不足。作者据此探究：显式结构化潜状态演化能否改善想象轨迹的稳定性与实用性。
AI.method: 提出结构化动力学框架HWM：学习一个相空间，将骨干网络的潜变量表示为广义坐标与动量；未来状态经由耗散哈密顿动力学传播，再通过可学习逆接口映射回原始潜表示。该公式化可直接嵌入现有世界模型架构，无需改动感知或解码组件；同时引入多步转移监督，使结构化rollout与真实观测诱导的潜轨迹保持对齐。
AI.result: 受控仿真实验中，HWM对速度、加速度、加加速度（jerk）的估计更准确，并显著降低长时程能量漂移。在三种具身世界模型设定中评测（Ctrl-World单臂多视角、EVAC双臂单视角、Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B任务导向单臂预测）：RoboCasa上Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B任务成功率相对提升2.7%；真实AgiBot World轨迹上，Ctrl-World的nDTW提升9.7%，EVAC的Logic提升8.4%。
AI.conclusion: 显式结构化潜动力学（相空间+耗散哈密顿演化）是提升世界模型长时程预测可靠性的有效且可插拔的手段，在物理一致性指标与下游任务性能上均优于无约束潜动力学。

title: From Score to Diagnosis: Search-Independent Post-Diagnosis for Symbolic Regression
summary: Symbolic regression (SR) solvers employ diverse search mechanisms, yet most rely on the same low-information scalar fitness. Such scores provide little guidance on why a skeleton fails or how it should be revised. Recent methods develop new methods to address this bottleneck. Their enhanced feedback mechanisms are tightly coupled to their search processes and are difficult to reuse across diverse SR solvers. Instead, we ask whether a shared feedback mechanism can further improve diverse solvers facing the same bottleneck. To this end, we propose PostDiag, a search-independent feedback mechanism, which can be shared to different SR solvers. PostDiag introduces Patch-wise Feature Profiling (PFP) to capture local behavior through patch-wise features of level, trend, and roughness. Based on PFP, PostDiag quantifies Skeleton Expressiveness Risk by comparing the fitted candidate with the observations, and Skeleton Stability Risk by measuring variability of behavior after bootstrap refitting. The Diagnostic Risk Plane (DRP) combines two risks to determine whether a skeleton should be preserved, repaired, simplified, or rewritten, while the patch-wise discrepancies provide evidence for the intervention. An LLM editor then performs the diagnosis-guided intervention, and the validated revision is returned to the original solver through a lightweight adapter. Experiments across multiple LLM-based and GP-based SR solvers show that PostDiag consistently improves accuracy and accelerates convergence.

AI.tldr: 提出与搜索过程解耦的通用反馈机制PostDiag，可跨多种符号回归求解器共享，通过风险诊断与LLM编辑改进候选表达式，提升精度并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有符号回归（SR）求解器大多依赖低信息量的标量适应度，无法说明骨架（skeleton）为何失败、该如何修改；已有增强反馈方法与其搜索过程紧耦合，难以在其他SR求解器间复用。
AI.method: PostDiag包含：(1) Patch-wise Feature Profiling（PFP），用分段（patch）层面的水平、趋势、粗糙度特征刻画局部行为；(2) 基于PFP计算Skeleton Expressiveness Risk（拟合候选与观测对比）与Skeleton Stability Risk（bootstrap重拟合后行为变异）；(3) Diagnostic Risk Plane（DRP）结合两类风险判定保留/修复/简化/重写，并由patch级差异提供干预证据；(4) LLM编辑器执行诊断引导的干预，经验证的修订经轻量adapter回传给原求解器。
AI.result: 在多个基于LLM与基于GP的SR求解器上实验表明，PostDiag一致提升准确率并加速收敛。
AI.conclusion: 共享式、与搜索无关的诊断反馈机制可有效缓解SR的标量适应度瓶颈，具备良好的跨求解器可复用性与通用性。

title: MemPrice: Online Memory Allocation via Adaptive Pricing for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents face a fundamental allocation problem as interaction histories grow: which information to retain, how much context to devote to it, and at what granularity. Existing memory mechanisms largely focus on relevance, retrieval, or compression, leaving this allocation trade-off implicit. We introduce MemPrice, which treats active context as a shared resource and dynamically allocates it across memories and representation levels. MemPrice turns accumulated memory pressure into an adaptive price on context, encouraging detail only when its estimated retention value justifies the additional footprint. This pressure persists across memory refreshes, allowing the contents of memory to evolve while preserving long-run control over context usage. We show that irreversible compression can force linear worst-case regret against hindsight following its own memory trajectory, and introduce a same-state benchmark to evaluate allocation on MemPrice's realized memory states. MemPrice enforces the hard context budget at every round and regulates long-run occupancy through adaptive pricing, without prior knowledge of the interaction horizon. Under priced-frontier regularity, its average allocation-regret bound against this benchmark vanishes when accumulated estimation error is sublinear. We evaluate the framework under matched memory budgets on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, AppWorld, and WebShop across three foundation models, spanning both query-blind memory construction and goal-directed agent context management.

AI.tldr: MemPrice将活跃上下文视为共享资源，通过自适应“价格”在记忆条目与表示粒度之间动态分配上下文预算，在硬预算约束下实现长期占用控制。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体随交互历史增长面临根本性的分配问题：保留哪些信息、分配多少上下文、以何种粒度表示。现有记忆机制多聚焦相关性、检索或压缩，使这一分配权衡隐含且未被显式建模。
AI.method: 提出MemPrice：将累积的记忆压力转化为对上下文的自适应价格，仅当估计的保留价值足以抵偿额外占用时才引入细节；该压力在记忆刷新间持续存在，使记忆内容演化同时保持长期上下文用量控制。理论方面证明不可逆压缩会导致相对“沿自身记忆轨迹的事后最优”产生线性最坏情形遗憾，并提出同状态（same-state）基准以在MemPrice实现的实际记忆状态上评估分配；在priced-frontier正则性假设下，给出平均分配遗憾界（当累积估计误差为次线性时趋于零），无需预知交互时程。实验在LongMemEval、LoCoMo、AppWorld、WebShop上，跨三种基础模型、匹配记忆预算，覆盖查询盲记忆构建与目标导向智能体上下文管理两种设定。
AI.result: 理论上表明不可逆压缩存在线性最坏情形遗憾，而MemPrice在priced-frontier正则性下平均分配遗憾随累积估计误差次线性增长而消失；实验中在四个基准、三种基础模型及两类任务设定下于匹配记忆预算条件进行评估。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模上下文分配权衡（而非仅依赖相关性/检索/压缩）可带来有理论保证的长期成本控制；MemPrice在每轮强制满足硬上下文预算并通过自适应定价调节长期占用，且不依赖交互时程先验。

title: A Multi-Step Inertial ADMM Algorithm for Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning has recently emerged as an important paradigm for large-scale distributed model training, which can be naturally formulated as a class of distributed learning problems. The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is a widely used approach for solving such problems. However, its practical performance is often hindered by significant communication overhead and system heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose a multi-step inertial ADMM algorithm, called MiFedADMM, for federated learning. The proposed method leverages multiple historical iterates on the server side to construct a higher-order extrapolation after each aggregation to accelerate the convergence behavior. Under mild assumptions, we establish convergence results for the single-step variant of the proposed method and derive an O(1/K) convergence rate. Numerical experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and improved performance of the proposed method compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出多步惯性ADMM算法MiFedADMM用于联邦学习，在服务器端利用多个历史迭代构造高阶外推以加速收敛，单步变体具有O(1/K)收敛率。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可建模为分布式学习问题，ADMM是常用求解方法，但其实际性能常受通信开销大和系统异构性严重的制约，亟需加速收敛以减少通信轮次。
AI.method: 将ADMM引入联邦学习框架，提出MiFedADMM：在服务器每次聚合后，利用多个历史迭代点构造多步惯性（高阶外推）项，以加速迭代过程；并针对其单步变体在温和假设下进行收敛性分析。
AI.result: 理论上证明了单步变体的收敛性并给出O(1/K)收敛速率；在合成数据集与真实数据集上的数值实验表明，该方法相较现有方法具有更好的性能和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多步惯性外推可有效加速联邦ADMM的收敛，验证了该方法在联邦学习场景下的实用性与优越性。

title: Revealing what benchmark scores hide: Jointly measuring the breadth and reliability of LLM capabilities using accessibility profiles
comment: 26 pages total, 10 pages main text, 18 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/kazemf78/access-eval
summary: Language model benchmarks assign each question a single outcome from one fixed wording, even though the same underlying request can be expressed in many equivalent ways. We argue that the quantity of interest should therefore not be correctness on one wording, but the accessibility of an inquiry, which we define as the probability that a model succeeds across meaning-preserving formulations. The distribution of accessibility across inquiries reveals a structure that accuracy and existing best-, worst-, or average-case prompt scores collapse: how broadly a model's capabilities extend across inquiries and how dependably those capabilities can be elicited. Two models can have the same average performance while one succeeds across more inquiries unreliably and the other succeeds across fewer inquiries but more consistently, leading to opposite preferences depending on whether the task allows multiple retries until one success or when repeated consistent success is required. Across six benchmarks and more than twenty models, this tradeoff is common: for about half of the model pairs with nearly equal mean accessibility, which model looks better depends on whether one success across five formulations is enough or all five must succeed, quantities we call Access@5 and Reliable@5, respectively. For some pairs the two measures diverge significantly, by up to 10 points in opposite directions. Accessibility also reveals that scaling, reasoning, and prompt optimization can redistribute capability across inquiries in ways aggregate accuracy obscures, sometimes broadening the set of inquiries a model can succeed on while making success on them less repeatable. Accessibility turns formulation sensitivity from a nuisance into a measurable property of capability, distinguishing what a model can sometimes succeed on from what users can actually depend on.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以"可及性"(accessibility)取代单一措辞下的正确率，即模型在保持语义等价的不同表述上成功的概率；其分布揭示了准确率及现有最好/最坏/平均提示得分所掩盖的"能力广度"与"可靠性"之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型基准对每个问题只用一种固定措辞给出单一结果，而同一请求可用多种等价方式表达。作者认为真正应衡量的是"探究(query)的可及性"，而非某一措辞上的正确性，因为纯粹的准确率或best/worst/average-case提示分数会掩盖模型能力在问题集合上的分布结构。
AI.method: 将可及性定义为模型在语义保持的不同表述上成功的概率，并计算其在各探究上的分布。基于该分布提出两个指标：Access@5（五种表述中至少一次成功）与Reliable@5（五次全部成功），在6个基准、20多个模型上比较模型对。
AI.result: 约一半平均可及性相近的模型对，其优劣判断会因采用Access@5还是Reliable@5而反转；部分模型对两种指标差异显著，可达10个百分点的相反方向。此外，规模扩展、推理与提示优化会以聚合准确率无法呈现的方式重新分配能力——有时拓宽了可成功的探究集合，却降低了在这些探究上成功的一致重复性。
AI.conclusion: 可及性将措辞敏感性从"干扰因素"转变为可度量的能力属性，区分了模型"偶尔能成功"的探究与用户"实际可依赖"的能力；评估应关注能力在探究上的广度与可靠性权衡，而非单一措辞的正确率。

title: Theory-Guided Instance-Dependent Early Stopping via Second-Order Loss Dynamics
comment: 29 pages, 11 figures, 12 tables. Code available at https://github.com/ShoebAhad/theory-guided-ies
summary: Instance-dependent early stopping (IES) reduces training computation by skipping backpropagation for examples whose losses have stabilized, but the second-order loss-difference criterion used by IES lacks a theoretical justification. We develop Theory-Guided Instance-Dependent Early Stopping (TG-IES), which analyzes this criterion under explicit assumptions and derives a noise-calibrated mastery threshold and a conditional stability bound for instance exclusion. We show that second-order differencing has a favorable bias-variance trade-off over first- and third-order differences in a specific signal-to-noise regime, and that its signal contains both gradient-drift and curvature terms. TG-IES derives its stopping threshold and patience from training-run statistics rather than using the manually selected threshold of IES. Across CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, TG-IES saves 53-58% of backpropagation instances in its main convolutional settings while keeping accuracy within 0.1-0.9 percentage points of full training; in the primary ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 setting, this corresponds to 35.7% FLOP-normalized savings. The method also transfers to ViT-Tiny, where it achieves smaller savings and incurs a modest accuracy cost. These results provide a theoretical basis for second-order instance-dependent early stopping and show that theory-guided calibration can substantially reduce training computation under the assumptions and experimental settings studied.

AI.tldr: 论文为实例相关早停（IES）所用的二阶损失差分准则提供理论依据，提出理论引导的 TG-IES：在显式假设下推导噪声校准的掌握阈值与实例排除的条件稳定性界，论证二阶差分在特定信噪比区间具有更优偏差-方差权衡，其信号含梯度漂移与曲率项；阈值与耐心值由训练统计量自动导出。CIFAR-10/100 上节省 53–58% 反向传播实例，精度损失仅 0.1–0.9 个百分点（ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 主设定下相当于 35.7% 的 FLOP 归一化节省）；迁移到 ViT-Tiny 时节省较小且带来一定精度代价。
AI.motivation: 实例相关早停通过跳过损失已稳定样本的反向传播来降低训练计算，但其采用的二阶损失差分准则缺乏理论解释；同时 IES 的阈值与耐心值需人工设定，缺乏自适应依据。
AI.method: 在明确假设下分析二阶损失差分准则，推导噪声校准的掌握阈值与实例排除的条件稳定性界；比较一阶、二阶、三阶差分在特定信噪比区间内的偏差-方差权衡，并分解二阶差分信号为梯度漂移项与曲率项；由训练运行统计量自动确定阈值与耐心值，替代人工选取。
AI.result: CIFAR-10 与 CIFAR-100 上主流卷积设置中节省 53–58% 反向传播实例，精度相对全量训练仅差 0.1–0.9 个百分点；ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 主设定下对应 35.7% 的 FLOP 归一化节省；迁移至 ViT-Tiny 时节省幅度较小且存在一定精度代价。
AI.conclusion: 为二阶实例相关早停提供了理论基础，表明在所研究的假设与实验设定下，理论引导的阈值校准能在可控精度损失内显著降低训练计算量。

title: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
summary: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior. Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Using these resources, we train compact PocketWorker models. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, SFT raises the mean score from 46.6 to 64.1 on Claw-Eval, including a 31.9-point gain on Multi-turn tasks. An SFT-only extension to ClawMark demonstrates applicability across coworker benchmarks. We further compare RL training dynamics across configurations that vary reward processing and credit assignment. Improving training rewards provide preliminary evidence that the constructed environments support policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出CoworkEnv：一个能力引导的可执行训练环境合成框架，用于训练AI协作助手（PocketWorker）。SFT将Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct在Claw-Eval上的均分从46.6提升到64.1（多轮任务+31.9），并初步验证环境支持RL策略优化。
AI.motivation: AI协作助手需协调工具、跨轮次沟通并在动态工作区状态上行动，同时遵守工作流约束；而为此类能力构造训练经验，需要一致的请求、服务记录、工具接口与评分检查，现有环境构建困难。
AI.method: 以工作流需求引导任务构造，用程序化验证加反馈修复来校验生成的规格与评分行为；教师执行产生SFT示范数据，学生交互产生rollout与奖励用于RL；据此训练紧凑的PocketWorker模型，并比较不同奖励处理与信用分配配置下的RL训练动态。
AI.result: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct经SFT后Claw-Eval均分46.6→64.1，Multi-turn任务提升31.9分；SFT-only扩展至ClawMark显示跨benchmark适用性；训练奖励提升为环境支持策略优化提供初步证据。
AI.conclusion: CoworkEnv能以能力引导方式合成可执行训练环境，支撑SFT与RL训练紧凑协作模型，并具备向其他协作助手基准迁移的潜力。

title: No-Regret Revenue Maximization in Sequential Market Making Under Inventory Constraints
summary: Market makers keep trading efficient by setting bid and ask prices for buyers and sellers. In sequential market making, trades happen independently based on price thresholds, requiring the market maker to maintain balanced, low-risk inventory over T rounds. This paper studies how to maximize revenue with unknown buyer and seller valuations using regret minimization. When the market maker only sees trade success or failure, an algorithm achieves regret and inventory bounds proportional to T to the power of 2/3. When full order book data is available for failed trades, regret and inventory limits improve significantly to the square root of T. We also establish a fundamental trade-off via a lower bound, by proving that tighter round-by-round inventory limits strictly force higher minimum regret.

AI.tldr: 研究序贯做市下未知买卖双方估值时的收益最大化问题：仅观测交易成功/失败时，遗憾与库存界均正比于T^(2/3)；可获得失败订单的完整订单簿时，二者改进至√T；并给出库存约束与遗憾之间权衡的下界。
AI.motivation: 做市商需在T轮中维持低风险、均衡的库存并通过设定买卖价差获利，但在买卖双方估值未知、且序贯交易独立发生的情形下，如何同时控制遗憾与库存缺乏理论刻画。
AI.method: 将定价与库存管理建模为遗憾最小化问题，按信息反馈分两种设定设计算法：(1)仅能观测交易成败的bandit式反馈；(2)失败交易可获取完整订单簿数据；并通过下界证明构造库存约束与遗憾之间的基本权衡。
AI.result: 仅成败反馈下，算法同时达到与T^(2/3)成正比的遗憾界和库存界；在完整订单簿反馈下，遗憾与库存界显著改进至√T量级；下界表明逐轮库存上限越紧，最小遗憾必然越高。
AI.conclusion: 反馈信息的多寡决定序贯做市的可学习性上限（T^(2/3) vs √T），且库存风险控制与收益最优之间存在不可回避的内禀权衡，为做市算法设计提供了理论边界。

title: Towards Human-AI Complementarity for AI Safety
summary: Safely overseeing AI is increasingly challenging for the humans doing it, as they must evaluate longer and more complex outputs with every new model generation. To mitigate this challenge, we could leverage complementarity: where humans and models make different mistakes, combining their judgements could yield an oversight signal stronger than either produces alone. We study this opportunity in realistic, safety-relevant settings, contributing the largest known suite of such tasks (3,957 instances across 8 datasets and 6 domains) as well as a platform and data pipeline for measuring human, AI, and human-AI performance on matched items. We collected 35,613 judgements from 416 human raters, finding a considerable opportunity for a complementarity effect. We also found that with the assistance methods we tested, human raters corrected the AI's errors less often, even when overall human accuracy rose, and the hybridisation methods we tested added little over the better single source on average. While complementarity is an important and feasible engineering target for safe oversight, achieving it remains an open challenge for future work.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了迄今最大的安全监督基准（8个数据集、6个领域、3957个实例），并搭建测量人类、AI及人机协作表现的平台；采集416名评分者的35613条判断后发现存在明显的互补性潜力，但所测试的辅助与混合方法未能有效实现人机互补。
AI.motivation: 随着模型代际更新，人类需要评估越来越长、越来越复杂的输出，安全监督难度持续上升。作者希望利用"互补性"——即人类与模型犯不同的错误，将二者判断结合可产生强于任何单一来源的监督信号——来缓解这一挑战，并在真实且与安全相关的场景中检验该机会。
AI.method: 贡献了已知最大的此类任务套件（8个数据集、6个领域、共3957个实例），以及用于在匹配条目上测量人类、AI和人机组合表现的数据流水线与平台；收集了416名人类评分者的35613条判断，并测试了若干辅助方法和混合（hybridisation）方法。
AI.result: 人类与AI的准确率存在互补性空间，具备可观的互补效应潜力；但在所测试的辅助方法下，尽管人类整体准确率上升，人类纠正AI错误的频率却降低了；所测试的混合方法平均而言相比更优的单一来源提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 互补性是安全监督中一个重要且可行的工程目标，但如何真正实现人机互补仍是未来工作的开放挑战。

title: Representations Have Trajectories: Characterizing Temporal Representation Dynamics in Neural Networks
summary: Recent work has shown that deep neural networks exhibit an implicit low-rank simplicity bias. In this paper, we investigate the questions that naturally arise from this observation. What are the temporal consequences of low-rank simplicity bias during optimization? How does representation geometry evolve throughout optimization rather than only at convergence? Do different neural architectures exhibit distinct geometric optimization behaviors? To answer these questions, we conduct a large-scale empirical study tracking representational geometry throughout training. We find that neural networks follow three recurring geometric trajectories: persistent high-rank, collapse-and-recovery, and persistent low-rank. We further identify Destructive Representation Collapse (DRC) as a pathological regime in which representations collapse to rank-one and fail to recover, leading to a sustained loss of representational capacity. While collapse-and-recovery is consistently associated with successful optimization in controlled settings, experiments on real-world models show that the relationship between geometric trajectories and optimization outcomes is configuration dependent. Overall, our findings suggest that representation geometry evolves dynamically during training and provide a new perspective on how deep neural networks learn.

AI.tldr: 该文通过大规模实证追踪训练全程的表征几何，发现网络遵循三种反复出现的几何轨迹（持续高秩、坍缩-恢复、持续低秩），并识别出导致表征容量永久损失的"破坏性表征坍缩（DRC）"病态区间。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明深度网络存在隐式低秩简单性偏置，但该观察引出的一系列问题尚未解答：低秩偏置在优化过程中的时序后果是什么？表征几何在训练全程（而非仅在收敛点）如何演化？不同架构是否表现出不同的几何优化行为？
AI.method: 大规模实证研究，在整个训练过程中持续追踪表征几何（以秩为关键度量），覆盖受控设置与真实世界模型，并跨多种网络架构比较其几何演化行为。
AI.result: 网络呈现三类反复出现的几何轨迹：持续高秩、坍缩-恢复、持续低秩。其中"破坏性表征坍缩（DRC）"为病态区间——表征坍缩至秩一且无法恢复，造成表征能力的持续性损失。在受控设置中，坍缩-恢复与成功优化稳定相关；但在真实模型上，几何轨迹与优化结果的关系依赖于具体配置。
AI.conclusion: 表征几何在训练过程中是动态演化的，这为理解深度网络的学习机制提供了新视角；同时说明低秩偏置的后果并非单一，既有可恢复的良性坍缩，也存在导致容量永久丧失的病态坍缩。

title: CorrectRTL: Boost RTL Generation Quality Through Automated Self-Correction with Instruction Decomposition
comment: This paper is accepted by ICCAD'26
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong promise in specification-to-RTL generation. Among the explorations, the self-correction paradigm has significantly advanced LLM-based RTL generation. However, two challenges limit further progress. Existing benchmarks are saturated by advanced LLMs, leaving little room to evaluate the agentic self-correction framework. The monolithic self-correction paradigm rewrites the entire design at once, where LLMs are susceptible to error confusion and corruption of originally correct code. To address the benchmark challenge, we contribute ScaleBench, a more challenging benchmark of 200 complex RTL designs. To address the challenge in methodology, we propose CorrectRTL, an agentic framework that realizes a new decompose-then-correct paradigm, in which the LLM agent explicitly decouples scaffold construction from detailed implementation. CorrectRTL contributes three core techniques: (1)~\emph{Structure-oriented decomposition}, (2)~\emph{Snippet-based RAG}, and (3)~\emph{SVA-based self-correction}. On ScaleBench, CorrectRTL improves Pass@1 from 20.5% to 49.0% (+28.5%). On VerilogEval, CorrectRTL achieves up to 96.1% Pass@1, demonstrating consistent improvements across both simple and complex designs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出更具挑战性的基准 ScaleBench（200个复杂RTL设计）与分解式自纠正框架 CorrectRTL，在 ScaleBench 上将 Pass@1 从 20.5% 提升至 49.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有 specification-to-RTL 生成中，自纠正范式已有进展，但受两方面制约：一是现有基准已被先进 LLM 饱和，难以评价智能体式自纠正框架；二是单体式自纠正一次重写整个设计，易导致错误混淆并破坏原本正确的代码。
AI.method: 构建 ScaleBench 基准（200个复杂 RTL 设计）；提出 CorrectRTL 智能体框架，实现"先分解后纠正"范式，将脚手架构建与细节实现显式解耦，包含三项核心技术：结构导向分解、基于代码片段的 RAG、基于 SVA 的自纠正。
AI.result: ScaleBench 上 Pass@1 由 20.5% 提升至 49.0%（+28.5%）；VerilogEval 上 Pass@1 最高达 96.1%，在简单与复杂设计上均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过更难的基准与分解式自纠正框架，可有效突破现有评测饱和与单体式重写带来的错误累积问题，显著提升 LLM 的 RTL 生成质量。

title: DeliMF: Gated Cross-Attention Fusion of Structured Time Series and Clinical Text for Early Intensive Care Delirium Prediction
summary: Delirium affects a large fraction of intensive care unit (ICU) patients and foreshadows longer stays, lasting cognitive decline, and higher mortality. Flagging the patients who will become delirious within the first day of admission would give clinicians a window to intervene. Yet state-of-the-art predictors rely only on the structured electronic health record (EHR) of vital signs, laboratory values, and medications, while overlooking the free-text clinical notes written in the same window, which carry information the numbers cannot encode. To this end, we present DeliMF, a multimodal framework that fuses the structured time series with clinical text. It encodes the structured signals with a temporal Transformer and the time-stamped radiology reports with a clinical text encoder, and fuses the two through a gated cross-attention module. The gate learns a per-patient weight on the text; when a patient has no note the gate closes and DeliMF reduces to its structured-only form, giving robustness to missing text by construction. On an incident-only MIMIC-IV cohort, DeliMF improves significantly over the baselines, particularly on patients who carry clinical text, while losing nothing on those without. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of multimodal fusion and gated cross-attention, and a case study further shows that fusing clinical text with the structured stream recovers delirium cases that the structured data alone misses. We hope DeliMF encourages early ICU prediction to make fuller use of the overlooked clinical text and contributes to the early identification and timely intervention of delirium.

AI.tldr: DeliMF：门控交叉注意力融合结构化时序与临床文本的ICU谵妄早期预测框架
AI.motivation: ICU谵妄发生率高，且与住院时间延长、持续性认知下降和高死亡率相关；在入院首日识别将发生谵妄的患者可为临床干预争取时间窗。现有最优预测器仅依赖生命体征、检验值、用药等结构化EHR，忽略了同期自由文本临床记录中数字无法编码的信息。
AI.method: 提出多模态框架DeliMF：用时间Transformer编码结构化时序信号，用临床文本编码器编码带时间戳的影像报告，并通过门控交叉注意力模块融合两路信息。门控为每位患者学习一个文本权重；当患者无文本记录时门控关闭，模型退化为纯结构化形式，从结构上保证对缺失文本的鲁棒性。在仅含新发病例的MIMIC-IV队列上评估，并进行消融与案例分析。
AI.result: 在incident-only MIMIC-IV队列上显著优于基线，尤其在有临床文本的患者上提升明显，而在无文本患者上无性能损失。消融实验证实多模态融合与门控交叉注意力的贡献；案例分析表明融合临床文本可召回仅靠结构化数据漏检的谵妄病例。
AI.conclusion: DeliMF表明充分利用被忽视的临床文本有助于ICU谵妄的早期识别与及时干预，作者期望推动早期ICU预测研究更充分地使用临床文本。

title: VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse
summary: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising budget allocation, while the underlying VLA remains frozen. Across $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, X-VLA, and MolmoAct2 on LIBERO, MetaWorld, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, VLA-Rolling reduces action-chunk inference cost in all 16 model--benchmark pairs, achieving up to a $1.48\times$ speedup, while improving success rate in 14 pairs by up to $15.08$ percentage points. These results show that action tails are not merely discarded predictions, but reusable intermediate states that enable more efficient and accurate VLA inference. These results demonstrate that the action tail can support the generation of better actions with fewer denoising steps. Our project is available at https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/.

AI.tldr: 提出 VLA-Rolling：复用 flow-matching VLA 重规划时被丢弃的动作尾部作为下一段初始噪声，实现更少去噪步数下更高效准确的推理。
AI.motivation: Flow-matching VLA 在 receding-horizon 下每段只执行简短前缀即重规划，未执行的动作尾部被丢弃、下一段从全新高斯噪声重新生成，造成去噪计算浪费。作者观察：该尾部保留了可迁移的去噪进度，可作为初始噪声并与原生10步高斯基线相当或更优；但最优去噪预算样本间差异大，需按更新后的观测自适应分配。
AI.method: VLA-Rolling 为轻量推理框架，底层 VLA 冻结，含三阶段：①动作尾部继承（action-tail inheritance）；②逐动作置信度估计；③置信度引导的 refinement，通过重新加噪与去噪预算分配进行自适应复用。
AI.result: 在 π0.5、SmolVLA、X-VLA、MolmoAct2 与 LIBERO、MetaWorld、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 的 16 个模型-基准组合上，全部降低动作块推理开销，最高 1.48× 加速；14 个组合成功率提升，最高 +15.08 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 动作尾部并非无用预测，而是可复用的中间状态：以更少去噪步数生成更优动作，兼顾推理效率与任务成功率。

title: AdamPM: Memory-Efficient LLM Optimization via Moment Pooling
summary: Adam is widely used for training large language models (LLMs) owing to its strong optimization performance and training stability, but its element-wise estimation for the first and second moments incur substantial memory overhead. Although numerous memory-efficient optimizers have been proposed, many incur additional computational overhead or require additional tuning of hyperparameters. Consequently, Adam remains a dominant and reliable choice for LLM pre-training. We propose AdamPM (Adam with Pooled Moments), a simple and memory-efficient variant of Adam that groups adjacent moment entries along the row or column dimension and represents each group by a single shared mean. AdamPM can well inherit Adam's hyperparameter settings and is readily integrated into existing Adam optimizer implementations, with less memory overhead. We systematically investigate pooling of both first and second moment estimates and identify second moment pooling as the effective design. With a group size of $s$, AdamPM reduces second moment memory to $1/s$ of the original requirement. Extensive experiments on language model pretraining, fine-tuning and multimodal learning demonstrate that AdamPM maintains model performance and training speed while substantially reducing optimizer-state memory. Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/jixiaowei95/AdamPM}.

AI.tldr: 提出AdamPM，通过对Adam二阶矩估计沿行或列维度做池化（组内共享均值），将二阶矩内存降至1/s，保持超参数与实现兼容，性能与速度不降。
AI.motivation: Adam因优化性能和训练稳定性被广泛用于LLM预训练，但其逐元素的一阶、二阶矩估计带来显著内存开销。已有内存高效优化器常引入额外计算或需重新调参，因此Adam仍是LLM预训练的主流可靠选择，亟需一种低开销且易用、保持Adam行为的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出AdamPM（Adam with Pooled Moments）：将相邻的矩条目沿行或列维度分组，每组用单一共享均值表示。系统研究一阶与二阶矩的池化，发现仅池化二阶矩最为有效。组大小为s时二阶矩内存降为原来的1/s；沿用Adam超参数，可直接集成到现有Adam实现中。
AI.result: 在语言模型预训练、微调及多模态学习上的大量实验表明，AdamPM在显著降低优化器状态内存的同时，保持了模型性能与训练速度。
AI.conclusion: AdamPM是一种简单、易集成且低内存的Adam变体，通过二阶矩池化有效缓解优化器状态内存瓶颈，且无需额外调参，可作为Adam的实用替代。

title: SteadyThought: Mitigating LLM Under-Thinking via Thought-Level Preference Optimization
summary: Flexible switching between reasoning trajectories (i.e., thought switching) has significantly enhanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). However, existing models often switch excessively yet fail to sustain promising reasoning thoughts, a phenomenon termed "under-thinking". While recent efforts suppress switching to mitigate this, such over-correction may discard valuable trajectories. To address this challenge, we propose Steady Thought (ST), a novel thought-level preference optimization framework. ST formalizes under-thinking as a preference issue at switching points, forcing single-path continuations from identified points to yield high-quality reasoning. Then, ST performs thought-level preference optimization by treating the newly generated response as preferred and the original one as dis-preferred. Experiments across multiple models and datasets show that ST effectively reduces token consumption, achieving reductions of up to 63.8%, while maintaining strong reasoning accuracy. Further analysis suggests that ST helps models acquire a generalizable ability to reduce redundant switching across domains and languages. Code is available at https://github.com/MIRALab-USTC/SteadyThought.

AI.tldr: 提出Steady Thought (ST)框架，将LRM的"过度思考切换"（under-thinking）形式化为切换点的偏好问题，通过思维级偏好优化减少冗余切换，最多降低63.8%的token消耗且保持推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有大型推理模型（LRM）虽能灵活切换推理轨迹，但常过度切换又无法维持有前景的思路（"under-thinking"）；近期抑制切换的方法属于过度纠正，可能丢弃有价值的推理轨迹。
AI.method: 将under-thinking建模为切换点的偏好问题：强制从已识别的切换点进行单路径延展以生成高质量推理；再以新生成响应为偏好样本、原始响应为非偏好样本，进行思维级偏好优化（thought-level preference optimization）。
AI.result: 在多个模型和数据集上，ST有效降低token消耗，最高减少63.8%，同时保持较强的推理准确率；分析表明模型获得了跨领域、跨语言的减少冗余切换的可泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ST通过对切换点进行思维级偏好优化，在避免过度纠正的前提下缓解under-thinking，实现效率与准确率的平衡，并具备跨域跨语言泛化性。

title: TCMScience: An Autonomous Scientist for Traditional Chinese Medicine
summary: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) research connects classical texts, medicinal entities, molecular assays, computational predictions, and clinical studies. An autonomous research agent must preserve the inferential boundaries between these evidence types while coordinating analysis across heterogeneous resources. We introduce TCMScience, a scientific knowledge-discovery agent that separates language-model proposals from execution and release authority. Its architecture combines a trusted kernel, a scientific compiler, and claim-support contracts: plans are compiled into typed operations, execution is bounded by explicit permissions, and candidate findings are checked against source provenance, study design, and claim scope before release. The full capability registry contains 117 public-source connectors with 444 typed operations across 29 domains and 150 native tools across 12 domains; the TCM data hub catalogs 136 databases, 76 dataset specifications, and 84,294 formula-source records. These resources support model-independent workflows through browser and local execution interfaces. In a network-pharmacology analysis of Gegen Qinlian Tang, replacing the whole-proteome background with the assayed-protein background changed the number of significant pathways from 66 to zero; incorporating inactive screening records identified nine pathways, including drug-metabolism signals retained as mechanistic hypotheses. A governance ablation over 121 constructed erroneous outputs spanning 26 classes released 121 errors without governance, 57 with the domain layer, seven with the kernel, and zero with both layers. All 10 compliant controls were retained. These results establish complementary control of known failure modes and show how explicit evidence contracts change the conclusions an agent is permitted to report.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TCMScience——一个面向中医药科学知识发现的可信自治研究智能体，通过"可信内核+科学编译器+论断支撑契约"三层架构，将大模型的方案生成与执行/发布权限分离，实现跨异构证据类型的可审计推理。
AI.motivation: 中医药研究需贯通经典文本、药材质体、分子实验、计算预测与临床研究等多类证据，各类证据之间存在不可逾越的推断边界。通用自治智能体在协调异构资源时易混淆证据来源、越权执行或发布超出证据范围的论断，缺乏对已知失效模式的结构化控制。
AI.method: （1）架构上分离语言模型提议权与执行/发布权，由可信内核、科学编译器与论断支撑契约组成；计划被编译为类型化操作，执行受显式权限约束，候选发现需对照来源溯源、研究设计与论断范围校验后方可发布。（2）构建能力注册表：117个公开来源连接器（444个类型化操作、29个领域）、150个原生工具（12个领域）、TCM数据枢纽（136个数据库、76个数据集规范、84,294条方剂来源记录），支持浏览器与本地执行接口下的模型无关工作流。（3）以葛根芩连汤网络药理学分析验证背景集与阴性筛选记录对通路结论的影响；（4）以121条构造性错误输出（26类）开展治理消融实验。
AI.result: 背景集敏感性：将全蛋白组背景替换为实测蛋白背景后，显著通路数由66降至0；纳入无效筛选记录后识别出9条通路，其中药物代谢信号仅作为机制假设保留。治理消融：无治理层释放121条错误中的121条，仅域层释放57条，仅内核层释放7条，两层并用释放0条；10条合规对照全部保留。
AI.conclusion: 域层与内核层对已知失效模式形成互补控制，二者结合可完全拦截构造性错误且不损失合规输出；显式论断证据契约能实质性改变智能体被允许报告的结论，说明证据边界的形式化约束是可信科学智能体的关键设计要素。

title: One Skill Takes Over: Clashing Agent Skills and a One-File Fix
summary: Agent Skills are instruction files that tell a coding agent how to do one job. Users install skills from many authors, so two skills for the same job can be active at the same time. We ask what a model does when both skill files are in its context: does it combine their compatible rules, or follow one skill and drop the other? We build SkillClash, 16 pairs of same-job skills in which code checks every rule and a reference output shows the best result that can be reached. On seven models from five families, from 4B open models to Qwen3-235B and GPT-4.1, a skill's rules are followed 93 to 99% of the time when it is loaded alone and 61 to 62% when a same-job skill is loaded next to it. Most outputs show takeover: every rule that only one skill asks for is followed, and every rule that only the other skill asks for is dropped. The worked examples inside the skills drive this. When each skill file instead ends with one example that follows both skills, takeover falls to 1 to 15% on the six models we tested. Telling the model which skill has priority does not bring the dropped skill back, and telling it to apply both skills brings the dropped skill back only on the two strong models and leaves the interacting rules broken. One merged skill file written by the strongest model we used, Claude Opus 5.5, lets all seven models follow 96 to 99% of the achievable rules. Most of its gain over a plain list of both skills' rules comes from its one worked example, and such an example helps only when it is correct. Code and data: https://github.com/prazmara/skillclash

AI.tldr: 论文构建 SkillClash 基准，发现同时加载两个同职责指令技能时，模型几乎完全"接管式"遵循其中一个而丢弃另一个（93–99%→61–62%），此现象由技能内嵌示例驱动，改写为遵循两者的单一示例可大幅缓解。
AI.motivation: 现实中用户从不同作者处安装 instruction 型技能（Agent Skills），同一任务常存在多个来源的技能文件同时驻留上下文。论文关注的核心问题是：当两个同类技能共存于上下文时，模型是融合二者兼容规则，还是只遵循其一、丢弃另一。
AI.method: 构建 SkillClash：16 对"同职责"技能对，每个规则均可由代码自动校验，并提供参考输出作为可达最优上界。在 5 个模型家族、7 个模型（4B 开源模型至 Qwen3-235B、GPT-4.1）上对比"单独加载"与"同类技能并载"两种条件的规则遵循率；进一步做消融实验：修改技能文件末尾示例（改为同时遵循两技能的示例）、显式指定优先级、显式要求同时应用两技能，以及使用强模型（Claude Opus 5.5）撰写的单一合并技能文件。
AI.result: 规则遵循率在单技能加载时为 93–99%，两技能并载时降至 61–62%；多数输出呈"接管"模式：仅被某一技能要求的规则被遵循，仅被另一技能要求的规则被丢弃。技能内嵌的 worked example 是主要驱动因素；将示例替换为"同时满足两技能"的单一示例后，6 个测试模型的接管率降至 1–15%。指定技能优先级无法恢复被丢弃技能；指令要求同时应用两技能仅在两个强模型上有效，且交互规则仍被破坏。由 Claude Opus 5.5 撰写的合并技能文件使全部 7 个模型遵循 96–99% 的可达规则，其增益主要来自那一个 worked example，且示例正确才有效。
AI.conclusion: 同职责技能共载并非规则互补，而是示例驱动的"接管"失败模式；仅靠提示词层面的优先级/指令约束难以修复。有效路径是提供单一、经校验的合并技能文件，并配以同时满足两技能的、正确的 worked example。

title: How Much Do Activation Monitors Benefit from Original Model Computations?
summary: One powerful way to safeguard AI systems is to monitor their internal computations--where signs of undesirable behavior might be more easily detectable than from models' inputs and outputs alone. However, recent studies begin to question the premise that activations provide a unique window into model behavior. In this paper, we study how much of activation monitors' success depends on access to the original behavior-generating computations. Within a fixed choice of target model and monitoring architecture, we compare how well monitors trained and evaluated on trajectories that differ in computational context can predict the behavior of the original execution, after the transcript is changed in a controlled manner (e.g., its exact text, or chat formatting). We first find that much performance can be recovered without access to the original behavior-generating trace (in up to 4 models across 2 counterfactual monitoring tasks), but a mild yet consistent advantage to native-trained monitors remains, outperforming strongest controls by up to 0.014 AUROC. Interestingly, we find monitors trained with native access have notable uplift on original examples whose behavioral label changes under paraphrasing. We further find this a useful lens to expose limitations of baselines that use simple forms of privileged information (i.e., answer logit margins). While our results show the advantage of native monitor access is modest in aggregate, they highlight the importance of evaluations that identify if and when original model computations provide additional predictive value.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了内部激活监控器在多大程度上依赖“原始行为生成计算轨迹”，发现在无原生轨迹访问时性能大部分可恢复，但原生训练监控器仍有轻微而稳定的优势（最高+0.014 AUROC），且在改写导致标签变化的样本上提升显著。
AI.motivation: 监控AI系统内部计算（激活）被认为比仅依赖输入输出更易发现不良行为迹象，但近期研究开始质疑“激活提供了行为独特窗口”这一前提。作者希望量化激活监控器的成功有多少来自对原始行为生成计算的访问，从而厘清原生计算访问的真实预测价值。
AI.method: 在固定目标模型与监控架构的前提下，构造计算上下文不同的轨迹（如改变精确文本、聊天格式等受控转录改动），比较在原生轨迹上训练/评估的监控器与替代上下文训练/评估的监控器的预测能力；在2个反事实监控任务、最多4个模型上开展实验，并与使用简单特权信息（答案logit margin）的基线对比。
AI.result: 无原生行为生成轨迹访问时仍可恢复大部分性能；但原生训练监控器存在轻微且一致的优势，比最强对照组最高高出0.014 AUROC。原生访问训练的监控器在“改写后行为标签发生变化”的原始样本上有显著提升；该视角还揭示了基于答案logit margin等简单特权信息基线的局限。
AI.conclusion: 总体上原生监控器访问带来的优势幅度不大，但这强调了需要能够识别“原始模型计算何时、在何种情况下提供额外预测价值”的评估方法，而非笼统假定激活监控的独特优势。

title: DAGLoop: Aligning Method Design with Experimental Feedback in Automated AI Research
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027. Code: https://github.com/deng34567/DAGLoop
summary: Automated AI research agents aim to improve machine learning methods by iteratively proposing, implementing, and evaluating candidate methods. Existing work uses the outcome of each evaluation to determine how the next candidate should be revised for performance improvement. However, a candidate often combines multiple design decisions, and its overall outcome alone does not reveal which decisions produced their expected effects, whether their required conditions were satisfied, or which decisions should be retained or revised. Inspired by ablation studies in the machine learning community, we propose DAGLoop to test the expected effect of a design decision by comparing implementations with and without that decision while preserving the other decisions it requires. Specifically, DAGLoop translates each design decision's rationale into a testable expectation and pairs it with a targeted experiment, forming an experimental specification for assessing the expected effect under its required conditions. Using these specifications, we formulate ablation planning as the construction of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from the candidate method's design: nodes associate decisions with tests, and edges encode dependencies. The DAG specifies which decisions each experiment must retain and supports joint tests when an expected effect requires several decisions to act together. Outcomes are recorded with the tested decisions, expectations, and conditions to form structured research memory. This memory guides the agent in retaining experimentally supported decisions, revising unsupported ones, and planning further experiments when the evidence is unresolved. Experiments on dozens of research tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements achieved by DAGLoop across diverse executable research settings. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/deng34567/DAGLoop.

AI.tldr: DAGLoop通过把候选方法中的每个设计决策转译为可检验预期并配套定向消融实验，将消融规划建模为有向无环图（DAG）构造，实现决策级证据归因，从而提升AI研究智能体的方法改进效果。
AI.motivation: 现有AI研究智能体仅依赖候选方法的整体评估结果决定下一轮修订，但候选方法通常包含多个设计决策，整体指标无法揭示哪个决策产生了预期效果、其前提条件是否满足、以及哪些决策应保留或修改，导致反馈信号粗糙、归因不清。
AI.method: 借鉴机器学习中的消融研究，提出DAGLoop：将每个设计决策的理据（rationale）转写为可检验的预期，并配对针对性实验，形成"实验规范"以在所需条件下评估预期效果；将消融规划形式化为基于候选方法设计构建DAG——节点关联决策与测试，边编码依赖关系，从而指定每个实验必须保留的决策，并支持多决策协同时的联合测试；实验结果连同被测决策、预期与条件一并记录为结构化研究记忆，用于指导保留被实验支持的决策、修订未获支持的决策，以及在证据不充分时规划后续实验。
AI.result: 在数十个研究任务上的实验表明，DAGLoop在多种可执行研究环境中均取得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 以决策级消融与DAG依赖建模替代整体结果反馈，可有效提升自动化AI研究智能体的方法改进效率与可靠性；代码与评估脚本已开源。

title: Uncovering Semantic Hierarchies in Text-Attributed Graphs via Variational EM-based LLM-GNN Synergy
summary: While hierarchical structures are intrinsic to organizing human knowledge, current representation learning on text-attributed graphs predominantly operates on flat semantic spaces, overlooking the rich coarse-to-fine granularity inherent in real-world data. To bridge this gap, we propose SHiFT, which synergizes the reasoning power of LLMs with the structural representation capability of GNNs within an Expectation-Maximization (EM) paradigm. In the E-step, we harness LLMs as expert taxonomists to induce an explicit semantic tree, introducing a lightweight Mapping & Diagnosis strategy that reduces inference costs by surgically updating the hierarchy only when anomalies are detected. In the M-step, we align the GNN encoder with this induced hierarchy from complementary perspectives, including clustering partition, topological skeleton, and semantic concepts. Theoretical analysis interprets SHiFT as a generalized Variational EM algorithm. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SHiFT not only achieves state-of-the-art performance but also uncovers high-quality, human-readable taxonomies. Our code can be found at https://github.com/Cloudy1225/SHiFT.

AI.tldr: SHiFT在EM框架下融合LLM归纳的显式语义树与GNN表征学习，实现文本属性图上的层次化表示并达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有文本属性图表征学习多在扁平语义空间进行，忽视真实数据中由粗到细的层次粒度，难以刻画人类知识固有的层级结构。
AI.method: 提出SHiFT，在EM范式中结合LLM推理与GNN结构表征。E步以LLM为专家分类学家归纳显式语义树，并设计轻量级Mapping & Diagnosis策略，仅在检测到异常时局部更新层次以降低推理开销；M步从聚类划分、拓扑骨架和语义概念三个互补视角将GNN编码器与该层次对齐。理论分析将其解释为广义变分EM算法。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SHiFT取得SOTA性能，并挖掘出高质量、人类可读的分类体系（taxonomy）。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM归纳层次与GNN表征在EM框架下协同，可有效注入粗到细语义粒度，兼具性能优势与可解释性。

title: EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends
summary: Recent works show that LLMs can generate kernels with strong performance on server GPUs. Edge deployment presents distinct challenges because the hardware is heterogeneous, the software stacks are fragmented, and the resource budgets are tight. LLM kernel generation across diverse edge backends has yet to be studied systematically. We introduce EdgeKernelBench, which combines a unified IR deployment framework with a hierarchical benchmark for edge workloads. The unified IR captures reusable computation, scheduling, and memory decisions and connects to each target backend through a compiler interface. The benchmark spans progressively larger program scopes, from individual operators to compact model graphs, across representative edge application domains. We instantiate the design with TVM as a reference compiler and validate it across heterogeneous edge backends. With a single generation attempt, the best model achieves 64.5% Correct@1 but only 25.5% Fast@1.0. This gap shows that functional correctness does not consistently translate into performance gains. We therefore introduce the Layered Edge Kernel Agent (LEKA), which organizes optimization through a layered IR. On the agent evaluation subset, LEKA achieves 43.5% Fast@1.0, compared with 13.0% for direct generation and 26.1% for Claude Code. LEKA and Claude Code use the same base model and optimization budget. Together, EdgeKernelBench and LEKA support unified evaluation and layered optimization of kernels generated by LLMs across edge backends.

AI.tldr: 提出 EdgeKernelBench（统一IR部署框架 + 分层边缘负载基准）和 LEKA（分层IR优化智能体），系统评估并改进LLM在异构边缘后端的算子生成。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM算子（kernel）生成工作主要针对服务器GPU，而边缘部署面临硬件异构、软件栈碎片化、资源预算紧张等独特挑战，跨多样边缘后端的LLM kernel生成尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: EdgeKernelBench：统一IR捕捉可复用的计算、调度与内存决策，经编译器接口对接各目标后端，配合覆盖从单算子到紧凑模型图、跨典型边缘应用域的分层基准，以TVM为参考编译器实例化。LEKA：基于分层IR组织优化流程的智能体。
AI.result: 单次生成尝试下最佳模型达64.5% Correct@1 但仅25.5% Fast@1.0；在智能体评估子集上，LEKA 达43.5% Fast@1.0，直接生成为13.0%，Claude Code 为26.1%（后两者与LEKA使用相同基座模型与优化预算）。
AI.conclusion: Correct@1 与 Fast@1.0 间的显著差距表明功能正确性并不能稳定转化为性能收益；EdgeKernelBench 与 LEKA 共同支撑跨边缘后端的LLM生成算子的统一评测与分层优化。

title: Explore or Confirm? LLM Agents Misallocate Measurements Under Noise
comment: 38 pages, 12 figures. Code, data and environment: https://github.com/Xstendyl/wellocate
summary: As model reasoning gets cheaper, the physical experiment becomes the slow and costly step in discovery. Each experiment returns a noisy reading: a high value can mean a good candidate or a lucky draw. With a fixed budget, an AI agent must keep choosing between exploring a new candidate and confirming a promising one by re-testing it. We measure that choice in Wellocate, a simulated assay campaign with known true values. It is built on a generated landscape and on two real protein datasets, GB1 and PhoQ, scrambled so no model can answer from memory. We test five language models as minimal agents, with no tools and no memory beyond the history in each prompt. They misallocate in both directions. Three over-confirm, spending most of the budget re-testing. On the generated landscape one under-confirms, trusting single readings, and there every model ends with a worse final pick than a basic scripted strategy. Each failure has its own cause. The over-confirmers run short of new candidates worth trying: a list of untried candidates cuts their re-testing and, on real protein data, makes two of them pick much better. A running summary of their readings or a description of the landscape changes it by at most five percentage points. For the under-confirmer, re-testing its top candidates in a final round, replayed on its own campaigns, recovers only about a quarter of what it loses by picking the wrong candidate. This suggests confirmation has to run through the whole campaign. We release Wellocate as a benchmark and reinforcement-learning environment with frozen splits and scripted baselines. With it, anyone can measure how an agent splits its budget before trusting it with real experiments, and train agents to split it better. Code, data and the environment are available at https://github.com/Xstendyl/wellocate.

AI.tldr: 提出Wellocate基准：在固定预算下衡量AI智能体在"探索新候选"与"复测确认"间的预算分配，发现五个语言模型均存在系统性误分配。
AI.motivation: 推理成本下降使实验成为发现流程中的瓶颈；每次实验返回含噪读数，高值可能是好候选也可能是运气，固定预算下必须权衡探索与确认，而这一决策能力此前缺乏可测量的基准。
AI.method: 构建模拟测定campaign环境Wellocate，含生成landscape与两个真实蛋白数据集（GB1、PhoQ，经打乱以防记忆作答），真值已知；以5个语言模型作为最小智能体（无工具、仅依赖提示内历史）进行测试，并与脚本化基线比较；再做消融干预（未尝试候选清单、读数摘要、landscape描述、末期复测）。
AI.result: 模型双向误分配：三个过度确认、大量预算用于复测；一个在生成landscape上确认不足、轻信单次读数；所有模型最终选择均劣于基本脚本策略。提供未尝试候选清单可降低复测并在真实蛋白数据上显著改善两个模型的选择；读数摘要或landscape描述影响≤5个百分点；对确认不足者的末期复测仅挽回约四分之一的损失。
AI.conclusion: 确认必须贯穿整个campaign而非末期补救；发布Wellocate作为带冻结划分与脚本基线、可用于强化学习的基准与环境，以便在信任智能体做真实实验前测量并训练更优的预算分配。

title: Contrastive Adversarial Training for Robust Graph Neural Networks under Label Poisoning
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are effective for modeling relational data but are vulnerable to label poisoning, where a small number of corrupted training labels can propagate errors across the graph via message passing. Despite this risk, defenses against label poisoning remain underexplored: existing methods are primarily designed for label noise and often rely on robust losses or heuristic data cleaning that fail to distinguish adversarial poisoning from naturally hard examples. In this paper, we propose CoLAT (Contrastive Label-flipping for Adversarial Training), a novel contrastive adversarial training framework tailored for robust node classification on graphs. The core of our approach is a structure-aware detection model that uses contrastive learning to identify label-structure inconsistencies. Unlike prior contrastive methods that focus on representation learning, CoLAT leverages contrastive embeddings to select high-risk nodes that guide adversarial label-flipping during training. This alternating optimization not only performs structure-aware adversarial training but also implicitly sanitizes some corrupted labels, improving robustness against diverse attacks from the literature. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that CoLAT consistently outperforms existing defenses under various poisoning intensities while scaling efficiently to large graphs.

AI.tldr: 提出CoLAT——一种面向图节点分类的对比对抗训练框架，利用结构感知的对比学习检测标签-结构不一致节点，并据此引导对抗性标签翻转与交替优化，从而提升对标签投毒的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: GNN依赖消息传递，少量被污染的标签即可在图上传播错误，标签投毒风险显著；而现有防御多针对随机标签噪声，依赖鲁棒损失或启发式数据清洗，难以区分对抗性投毒与天然困难样本，相关防御研究不足。
AI.method: 提出CoLAT框架：核心为结构感知检测模型，用对比学习刻画节点标签与图结构的一致性/不一致性；不同于以往仅用于表示学习的对比方法，CoLAT将对比嵌入用于挑选高风险节点，在训练中以这些节点引导对抗性标签翻转，并与分类器训练构成交替优化，兼具结构感知对抗训练与隐式标签净化效果。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，CoLAT在不同投毒强度下均稳定优于现有防御方法，并能高效扩展至大规模图。
AI.conclusion: 对比嵌入可有效用于识别标签-结构不一致的高风险节点，将其引入对抗标签翻转训练可在提升鲁棒性的同时隐式净化部分被污染标签，为图上的标签投毒防御提供了新范式。

title: Spectral Adaptive Graph Transformer for Efficient and Scalable Traffic Forecasting
summary: Traffic forecasting models based on spectral graph convolution offer an interpretable account of how information is mixed between sensors, but they rely on an eigendecomposition of the graph Laplacian. It costs cubic time, is fixed by the road network, and provides a symmetric operator that cannot represent the directed propagation of traffic congestion. Attention-based spatio-temporal transformers remove these limitations but generate a dense sensor-by-sensor attention map at each layer and time step, so memory, rather than accuracy, becomes the binding constraint on large networks. We introduce the spectral adaptive graph transformer, whose spatial operator is learned rather than derived from the Laplacian, directed rather than symmetric, and conditioned on the current traffic state rather than a static state, at a cost linear in the number of sensors. A sparse road graph diffusion branch provides the strictly local propagation that a low-rank operator cannot express, and a zero-initialized gate learns the balance between the two. Before spatial mixing, a unit-mean-gain frequency-bin attention module reweights each sensor's short-term periodicities according to its identity and current context. Across six public benchmarks spanning 170 to 1843 sensors, evaluated over three random seeds, the proposed model attains the lowest error of any single end-to-end model on one benchmark and remains competitive with the strongest current attention models on the others, while using about a quarter of their memory and training about twice as fast.

AI.tldr: 提出谱自适应图Transformer（SAGT）：空间算子为线性复杂度、有向、状态条件化的低秩学习算子，辅以稀疏路网扩散分支与零初始化门控，并加入单位均值增益的频带注意力模块，在保持或接近SOTA精度的同时将显存降至约1/4、训练速度提升约2倍。
AI.motivation: 谱图卷积交通预测依赖拉普拉斯特征分解：立方时间复杂度、由路网固定不可学习、且对称算子无法刻画拥堵的有向传播；而时空Transformer虽消除上述限制，却在每层每步生成稠密的传感器两两注意力图，使大路网下的显存成为瓶颈而非精度。
AI.method: 1）空间算子改为学习得到而非由拉普拉斯导出，有向而非对称，并以当前交通状态为条件（状态条件化），代价随传感器数线性增长；2）低秩算子难以表达严格局部传播，故增设稀疏路网图扩散分支，用零初始化门控学习二者平衡；3）空间混合前，引入单位均值增益的频带注意力模块，按传感器身份与当前上下文重加权其短期周期性分量。
AI.result: 在6个公开基准（170–1843个传感器）、3个随机种子下评估：在1个基准上取得所有单端到端模型中的最低误差，其余基准上与当前最强注意力模型相当；同时显存约为其1/4，训练速度约为其2倍。
AI.conclusion: 以线性代价的学习型有向状态条件空间算子替代特征分解与稠密注意力，可在不牺牲精度的前提下显著缓解大路网的显存与训练时间约束，为谱方法与注意力机制之间提供了一条兼顾可解释局部传播与全局低秩混合的折中路径。

title: Native Probability Outputs for Clinical Triage: An Evaluation of Calibration and Decision Accuracy
summary: Patient-facing triage requires an appropriate care recommendation and recognition of when information is insufficient. We evaluate whether Jev, a decision model that returns probabilities over predefined actions, supports both judgments. Using CARE-Bench, we compare Jev with four general-purpose language models and three input-independent baselines across 925 decision points from 439 public cases. On the public test subset, Jev ranks fourth of five models by macro-F1 (0.461) but has the lowest observed multiclass Brier score (0.610), an 18.7\% improvement over uniform prediction (case-bootstrap 95\% interval, 4.9--31.1\%). Noul has lower binary Brier than Choice (0.215 versus 0.276). A evaluation of 453 HealthBench conversations again gives Jev the lowest observed Brier score (0.299), but measures a distinct emergency-referral judgment. Jev combines lower probability error with missed clarification needs in the four-action task. Asking about information sufficiency separately increases recall but also produces frequent unnecessary clarification assignments.

AI.tldr: 在 CARE-Bench（439 例、925 个决策点）上，评估输出预定义动作概率的决策模型 Jev 能否同时支持分诊推荐与信息不足识别；Jev 虽 macro-F1 仅排第四，但观测到最低多分类 Brier（0.610），同时存在澄清需求漏检。
AI.motivation: 面向患者的分诊既需给出恰当的照护建议，也需识别信息何时不足；本文检验以概率形式输出动作分布的决策模型能否同时支撑这两类判断。
AI.method: 在 CARE-Bench 的 439 个公开病例、925 个决策点，将 Jev 与四个通用语言模型及三个输入无关基线比较，采用 macro-F1、多分类/二分类 Brier 分数，并用 case-bootstrap 估计置信区间；另在 453 段 HealthBench 对话上以外部分析复测 Brier，并单独考察对"信息是否充分"的提问策略。
AI.result: 公开测试子集上 Jev 的 macro-F1 为 0.461，在五个模型中排第四；多分类 Brier 最低，为 0.610，较均匀预测改善 18.7%（case-bootstrap 95% 区间 4.9–31.1%）。二分类 Brier 上 Noul 低于 Choice（0.215 vs 0.276）。HealthBench 453 段对话中 Jev 的 Brier 最低（0.299），但衡量的是不同的急诊转诊判断。
AI.conclusion: Jev 实现了更低的概率误差，但在四动作任务中仍漏检澄清需求；将"信息充分性"单独提问可提升召回率，却伴随大量不必要的澄清指派，说明概率建模与信息不足识别尚未同时得到满足。

title: Memory, Know Your PLACE: Governing Lifecycle State and Query-Time Eligibility in Persistent-Memory Agents
summary: Persistent memory turns prior interactions into durable agent state, but existing systems provide limited control over whether that state remains valid and whether it should influence a later query. We argue that reliable memory requires governance over both state formation and query-time influence. We introduce PLACE, a factorized governance layer that adds write-side state certification and read-side authorization to a memory backend. A factorial evaluation on Mem0 with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B isolates the contribution of each mechanism. Results show that write-side governance substantially improves lifecycle state correctness, while read-side governance eliminates measured causal leakage from ineligible memory in the state-correct setting. Their combination achieves the strongest joint performance while preserving query-relevant support. These findings show that reliable persistent memory requires explicit control over both maintained state and query-time information influence.

AI.tldr: 提出 PLACE——面向持久记忆的因子化治理层，在写入侧做状态认证、在读取侧做授权，实验表明二者结合在保持查询相关支持的同时取得最佳联合性能。
AI.motivation: 持久记忆把历史交互转为持久化智能体状态，但现有系统对该状态是否仍然有效、以及是否应影响后续查询缺乏控制能力。作者认为可靠记忆需同时治理"状态形成"与"查询时影响"。
AI.method: PLACE 作为因子化治理层叠加于记忆后端：写侧引入状态认证（state certification），读侧引入授权（authorization）。在 Mem0 上以 Qwen2.5-3B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 做因子化消融评估，分离各机制贡献。
AI.result: 写侧治理显著提升生命周期状态正确性；读侧治理在状态正确的设定下消除了不可用记忆带来的可测因果泄漏；二者组合取得最强联合性能，同时保留查询相关的支持信息。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的持久记忆需要对所维护状态与查询时信息影响同时进行显式控制，读写两侧治理机制互补而非可替代。

title: Tensor Network Datamodels for Training Data Attribution
summary: Datamodels predict how a model's behavior changes when different parts of its training data are included or removed. However, linear datamodels assign fixed contributions to training units and cannot represent non-additive joint effects. We introduce Tensor Network Datamodels (TNDMs), which use low-rank tensor networks to model dependencies among training units while keeping the representation compact. TNDMs learn a map from subsets of the training data to the outcome of training on those subsets, allowing them to represent interactions among several training units. We prove that complementary and redundant training groups can induce high-degree subset functions with compact low-rank representations. A single fitted TNDM can then be used for several training data questions, including predicting the effect of removing data, measuring the importance of individual training units, identifying interactions between training units, and selecting useful subsets of the training data. We evaluate TNDMs on controlled tasks designed to contain strong interactions, as well as standard fine-tuning settings for classification and reasoning. On a controlled reasoning task, TNDMs outperform every baseline while observing only half as many training subsets, and TNDM-TT reduces prediction NMSE by $89\%$ relative to the linear datamodel after observing approximately $0.0061\%$ of all possible training subsets. In factual-association fine-tuning, a single TNDM-CP raises held-out $\mathrm{R}^2$ from $0.579$ to $0.668$ over the linear datamodel. These results demonstrate that compact low-rank models improve prediction when training data effects depend on combinations of training groups.

AI.tldr: 提出张量网络数据模型（TNDM），用低秩张量网络刻画训练单元间的非可加交互，紧凑地从训练子集到结果的映射，在控制任务与微调设置中显著优于线性数据模型。
AI.motivation: 线性数据模型对每个训练单元赋予固定贡献，无法表达多单元之间的非可加联合效应（互补或冗余的训练组），而实际中训练数据效应常依赖组合。
AI.method: TNDM用低秩张量网络（如CP、TT分解）学习从训练数据子集到该子集训练结果的映射，从而紧凑地表示多训练单元间的交互；并证明互补/冗余训练组可诱导出具有紧凑低秩表示的高阶子集函数。单个拟合的TNDM可复用于多种问题：预测移除数据的影响、度量单元重要性、识别单元交互、选择有用子集。
AI.result: 在含强交互的控制推理任务上，TNDM以仅一半的训练子集数量超过所有基线；TNDM-TT在观测约0.0061%的全部可能子集后，将预测NMSE相对线性数据模型降低89%。在事实关联微调中，单个TNDM-CP将留出R²从0.579提升到0.668。
AI.conclusion: 当训练数据效应依赖训练组组合时，紧凑低秩模型能显著提升预测性能，张量网络数据模型为建模非可加训练数据影响提供了有效框架。

title: Dialogue Generation for Conversational Recommendation Using User Search Interactions and Knowledge Graphs
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, The 3rd Workshop on Evaluating and Applying Recommender Systems with Large Language Models (EARL) at The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Large-scale conversational recommendation datasets typically require manual dialogue construction or annotation. We propose SearCl, which automatically generates conversational recommendation dialogues grounded in user search and click behaviors. SearCl segments user interactions into query sessions and derives each recommendation target from content selected after a search query. A configurable probabilistic state machine controls the dialogue flow, while two LLM agents acting as the seeker and recommender generate utterances according to turn-level constraints. To support recommendation, the recommender is provided with knowledge graphs constructed from metadata about the content items used in each dialogue, capturing their attributes and relationships. Using SearCl, we generate 3,538 dialogues from content search and click interaction data, covering 1,731 unique target items. Under an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, the resulting dialogues achieve higher quality scores than dialogues from existing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that SearCl enables controllable and knowledge-grounded dataset construction without human annotations.

AI.tldr: SearCl 基于用户搜索与点击行为自动生成对话推荐数据：将交互切分为查询会话、以搜索后所选内容作为推荐目标，用可配置概率状态机控制对话流程，两个 LLM 智能体分饰寻求者与推荐者按轮级约束生成话语，并为推荐者注入由内容元数据构建的知识图谱。共产出 3,538 条对话、覆盖 1,731 个目标物品，LLM-as-a-judge 评分优于现有基准。
AI.motivation: 大规模对话推荐数据集通常依赖人工构建对话或人工标注，成本高、难以扩展。作者希望无需人工标注即可可控地构建有知识支撑的对话推荐数据。
AI.method: (1) 数据来源：真实用户搜索与点击交互，按查询会话（query session）切分；(2) 目标推导：以搜索查询之后点击选择的内容作为推荐目标；(3) 对话流程：可配置的概率状态机控制对话流转；(4) 生成器：两个 LLM 智能体分别扮演 seeker 与 recommender，依据轮级约束生成话语；(5) 知识注入：从对话涉及内容的元数据构建知识图谱，刻画属性与关系，提供给推荐者作为推荐依据。
AI.result: 由内容搜索与点击数据生成 3,538 条对话，覆盖 1,731 个唯一目标物品；在 LLM-as-a-judge 评估协议下，所生成对话的质量得分高于现有基准数据集的对话。
AI.conclusion: SearCl 能够在无人工标注条件下实现可控、知识支撑的数据集构建，为对话推荐研究提供可扩展的数据生成路径。

title: fxBench: Evaluating and Understanding Formula Suggestions in Spreadsheets
summary: Spreadsheets are among the most widely used tools for computations, and formulas are their core building blocks. Besides agentic spreadsheet tools, proactive formula suggestions enable significant productivity gains and are now available in popular spreadsheet software (Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets). Such suggestions pose interesting challenges: the right context must be collected and represented for a machine learning model, which must then be able to write a correct formula, in a way that is fast and cheap enough to trigger on every = (or subsequent keystrokes for auto-completion) without taking users out of their editing flow. Surprisingly, there is no public benchmark for formula suggestions on real spreadsheets. In this paper, we therefore (1) introduce fxBench as a manually curated benchmark of 503 formula suggestion tasks based on Sheetpedia, (2) break down the formula suggestion problem into four capabilities (gather context, understand context, understand intent, write formula) that a formula suggestion system requires, and (3) evaluate existing and new approaches to understand bottlenecks in these capabilities that pose interesting research directions. Specifically, we annotate each benchmark with the cells that describe intent to determine the theoretical performance limit of a given context selection strategy, we evaluate performance of small and large models on different representations of context, including a dense format with high theoretical coverage at low token counts, and we fine-tune smaller language models to show that we can learn to understand such dense formats. Additionally, we perform quantitative and qualitative analysis on failure modes to understand bottlenecks in the formula writing capability; the best configuration only achieved 58.8% correct suggestions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向真实电子表格的公式建议公开基准 fxBench（503 个基于 Sheetpedia 的人工标注任务），并将公式建议问题分解为上下文收集、上下文理解、意图理解、公式编写四项能力，用以诊断现有方法瓶颈；最佳配置仅达 58.8% 正确率。
AI.motivation: 电子表格公式建议已集成于 Excel、Google Sheets 等主流软件，可显著提升效率，但其要求快速、低成本地在每次输入"="或后续按键时给出正确公式且不打断编辑流程；然而目前缺乏基于真实电子表格的公开基准，难以系统评估与定位瓶颈。
AI.method: (1) 构建 fxBench：基于 Sheetpedia 人工策划的 503 个公式建议任务；(2) 将问题分解为四项能力（gather context、understand context、understand intent、write formula）；(3) 标注描述意图的单元格以确定不同上下文选择策略的理论性能上限；比较小模型与大模型在多种上下文表示上的表现，包括低 token 数、高理论覆盖率 的稠密表示；并对小语言模型微调以学习理解稠密格式；最后对失败模式进行定量与定性分析。
AI.result: 通过意图单元格标注得到各上下文选择策略的理论上限；稠密表示在低 token 消耗下具备高理论覆盖率；微调后小模型可学会理解稠密格式；但公式编写能力是主要瓶颈，最佳配置仅实现 58.8% 的正确建议率。
AI.conclusion: 公式建议的关键瓶颈在于公式编写能力而非上下文覆盖，fxBench 为后续研究提供了可复现的评测基础与明确的研究方向。

title: BrandEval: A Two-Track Multi-Agent Benchmark for Risk-Sensitive LLM Crisis Communication
summary: Evaluating LLMs for crisis communication requires more than judging isolated responses, because public feedback and competitor actions can reshape trust over time. Existing benchmarks remain largely static and single-turn, offering limited evidence about long-horizon risk-sensitive communication. We introduce \textbf{BrandEval}, a two-track benchmark for product-crisis communication, focusing on public brand responses to product-related safety, quality, service, and trust incidents. BrandEval-Static evaluates stakeholder-aware strategic analysis, while BrandEval-Dynamic stress-tests response policies in \textbf{BrandPolis}, a controlled multi-agent sandbox with consumer feedback, competitor responses, and trust-risk trajectories. We also construct \textbf{BrandSRD}, a Chinese crisis-response dataset, and instantiate a reference Strategic Agent using \textbf{Strategic Rationale (SR)}. Across proprietary and open-source models, we find that static strategic quality is informative but incomplete: it aligns with some end-state outcomes but does not reliably predict volatility and delayed recovery; dynamic stress tests further expose tail-risk failures under manipulative or weakly grounded policies. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/htgan-ai/BrandEval.

AI.tldr: BrandEval：面向产品危机公关的双轨基准，包含静态战略评估（BrandEval-Static）与多智能体沙盒动态压测（BrandEval-Dynamic，即BrandPolis），并构建中文危机响应数据集BrandSRD与基于战略理由（SR）的参考战略智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM危机沟通评测多为静态、单轮，只评判孤立回复，无法刻画公众反馈与竞争对手行为在时间维度上对品牌信任的重塑，缺乏长程、风险敏感沟通的证据。
AI.method: 提出双轨基准：静态轨评估利益相关者感知的战略分析能力；动态轨在受控多智能体沙盒BrandPolis中，引入消费者反馈、竞争者响应与信任风险轨迹，对响应策略进行压力测试；同时构建中文危机响应数据集BrandSRD，并以战略理由（SR）实例化参考战略智能体。在闭源与开源模型上开展评测。
AI.result: 静态战略质量具有信息量但不完备：它与部分终态结果对齐，却不能可靠预测波动性与延迟恢复；动态压力测试进一步揭示在操纵性或依据薄弱的策略下存在尾部风险失效。
AI.conclusion: 单一静态评测不足以评估危机沟通能力，需引入多智能体、长程动态压力测试以暴露尾部风险；代码与数据集将开源。

title: How Does Muon Work in Private Deep Learning? Scalable Differentially Private Training via Orthogonalization
summary: Training deep neural networks requires optimizers that balance computational efficiency with formal data privacy. While orthogonalized update rules, such as the recently introduced Muon optimizer, have shown strong empirical performance and scalability, their behavior under Differential Privacy (DP) is not yet understood. In this paper, we propose DP-Muon, a differentially private variant of the Muon optimizer. By analyzing Muon's orthogonalized updates through the lens of a Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO), we show that the leading effect of per-example clipping is a positive rescaling of the gradient, to which the LMO is blind, so that only a small directional residual controlled by the centered gradient variance enters the optimization error. This yields an $\mathcal O(K^{-1/4})$ convergence rate, up to logarithmic factors, to a clipping-dependent neighborhood at a fixed noise scale and, with noise calibrated to a fixed $(\varepsilon,δ)$ budget, the standard $(\sqrt d/(n\varepsilon))^{1/2}$ privacy--utility bound of DP-SGD, without assuming bounded gradients. Furthermore, we investigate the hyperparameter landscape of DP-Muon and document how the optimal learning rate, momentum, and batch size change under privacy. Empirically, on image classification DP-Muon matches or improves on DP-SGD and DP-Adam, whereas on language modeling the best optimizer depends on the batch size, with DP-Muon best at small batches and DP-Adam best near the privacy-optimal batch size.

AI.tldr: 提出DP-Muon，将Muon的正交化更新通过线性最小化预言机（LMO）视角分析，证明逐样本裁剪的主要效应仅是对梯度的正向缩放（LMO对其"盲视"），仅有由中心化梯度方差控制的小方向残差进入优化误差，从而在无需有界梯度假设下获得与DP-SGD相同的隐私-效用界。
AI.motivation: Muon等正交化更新规则经验表现强、可扩展性好，但其在差分隐私（DP）下的行为尚不清楚；需要一个兼顾计算效率与形式化数据隐私的优化器，并厘清裁剪、噪声与正交化之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 将Muon的正交化更新解释为LMO，在此框架下分析逐样本裁剪的影响：证明主导效应是梯度的正向重缩放，而LMO对该缩放的尺度不变，故只有中心化梯度方差控制的小方向残差进入优化误差；结合固定噪声尺度与按固定(ε,δ)预算标定的噪声进行收敛与隐私-效用分析，并系统考察隐私下学习率、动量、批大小的超参数变化。
AI.result: 在固定噪声尺度下获得至对数因子为O(K^{-1/4})的收敛率，收敛到依赖裁剪的邻域；在噪声按固定(ε,δ)预算标定时，达到DP-SGD标准的(√d/(nε))^{1/2}隐私-效用界，且不假设有界梯度。实验上，图像分类中DP-Muon匹配或优于DP-SGD与DP-Adam；语言建模中最优优化器依赖批大小，小批时DP-Muon最佳，接近隐私最优批大小时DP-Adam最佳。
AI.conclusion: 正交化更新在DP下具有结构上的鲁棒性（对裁剪缩放不敏感），DP-Muon在理论上不劣于DP-SGD并在实践中具备竞争力；但最优优化器选择需结合批大小等隐私相关超参数，隐私会显著改变学习率、动量与批大小的最优配置。

title: Gaussian Process Bandits with Paired Auxiliary Observations
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used for expensive black-box optimization, yet observation noise makes each evaluation less informative and slows posterior learning. Standard BO learns from costly outcomes gathered during optimization. In many applications, however, low-cost auxiliary data are available beforehand. We introduce Auxiliary-Informed Gaussian Process Bandit (AI-GPB), a variance-reduction method that combines an offline estimate of the auxiliary mean with a correction coefficient learned from paired online observations. Notably, it exploits correlation between paired observation errors without requiring the auxiliary mean to approximate the objective. We establish finite-sample GP confidence bounds and regret guarantees, including explicit cumulative and simple regret rates for Matérn kernels. Numerical experiments across continuous BO benchmarks with varied landscapes and dimensions show consistent reductions in cumulative and simple regret relative to vanilla GP-UCB, even when within-pair correlation is moderate and the auxiliary mean is estimated from noisy offline data.

AI.tldr: 提出 AI-GPB：利用离线辅助均值+配对在线观测学习修正系数，在不需要辅助均值近似目标的前提下利用配对误差相关性降低后验方差，并给出有限样本置信界与 Matérn 核下的累计/简单遗憾率及实验验证。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化中观测噪声使单次评估信息量下降、后验学习变慢；标准 BO 仅依赖优化过程中获得的高成本结果，而许多应用中事先存在低成本辅助数据，尚未被有效利用。
AI.method: AI-GPB（Auxiliary-Informed Gaussian Process Bandit）：将离线估计的辅助均值与从配对在线观测中学到的修正系数相结合，通过利用配对观测误差之间的相关性实现方差缩减；不要求辅助均值逼近目标函数本身。
AI.result: 建立了有限样本的高斯过程置信界与遗憾保证，包括 Matérn 核下显式的累计遗憾率与简单遗憾率；在多种地形与维度的连续 BO 基准上，即使组内相关性中等、辅助均值来自含噪离线数据，累计与简单遗憾均相对 vanilla GP-UCB 稳定下降。
AI.conclusion: 低成本辅助数据可在理论上可靠地加速含噪 BO，且收益不依赖辅助均值的准确性或强相关性，是一种具有理论保证的方差缩减框架。

title: Aligning Language Models with Indigenous Community Cosmovision through Constitutional AI
comment: In preparation for the Dossier "Linguistics in AI and AI in Linguistics" of the journal TextoLivre
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly trained on corpora that reflect Western, anglophone worldviews. This asymmetry is not neutral: when a model answers questions about territory, community authority, or the relationship with nature, it does so from assumptions that may be alien to the communities using the system. This paper presents a system for aligning language models with the ethical principles of Indigenous communities in Latin America. Drawing on interviews with five Indigenous leaders and defenders, we built an operational cultural constitution grounded in an Indigenous cosmovision, with 12 principles. On this basis, we implemented a Constitutional AI (CAI) pipeline in two phases: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO). The base models were Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. With only 24 preference pairs, improvements were modest but detectable in intergenerational transmission, linguistic caution, and consultation and consent. Qualitative analysis reveals that the SFT phase was responsible for the primary shift in alignment, while DPO refined specific categories. The system was deployed in a conversational interface with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that allows communities to feed the knowledge base, turning alignment into a participatory cycle. We argue the architecture is functional and will scale qualitatively once the corpus is expanded and computing constraints are resolved. The work constitutes a first iteration of an epistemic justice mechanism for value alignment in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一套将语言模型与拉丁美洲原住民社区伦理原则对齐的系统：基于与五位原住民领袖的访谈构建含12条原则的"文化宪法"，用SFT+DPO两阶段Constitutional AI流程在Qwen2.5-7B/1.5B-Instruct上微调，仅24组偏好对即取得可检测但有限的改进，并部署带RAG的对话界面使社区可持续注入知识，形成参与式对齐闭环。
AI.motivation: 主流LLM训练语料反映西方英语世界观，在领土、社区权威、人与自然关系等问题上带有非中立预设，可能对使用该系统的原住民社区造成认识论不公正；作者希望构建一种面向全球南方的价值对齐机制。
AI.method: 访谈五位原住民领袖与维权者，提炼基于原住民宇宙观的可操作"文化宪法"（12条原则）；在其上实施两阶段Constitutional AI流水线：监督微调（SFT）+ 直接偏好优化（DPO），基座为Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct与Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct；并部署结合RAG的对话界面，允许社区向知识库贡献内容。
AI.result: 仅用24组偏好对，即在代际传承、语言审慎性、协商与知情同意三类维度上观察到幅度不大但可检测的提升；定性分析显示对齐转变主要来自SFT阶段，DPO则对特定类别做细化打磨。
AI.conclusion: 该架构在功能上可行，待语料扩充与算力约束缓解后可在质量上扩展；工作可作为全球南方价值对齐中"认识论正义"机制的首次迭代。

title: From Overparameterised Expressions to Parsimonious Models: Fisher-Geometric Pruning for Symbolic Regression
summary:
Genetic programming symbolic regression (GPSR) often returns expressions that are larger than necessary, with dormant branches and finely tuned algebraic configurations that fit sampling noise. Existing complexity-control strategies, such as multi-objective size-accuracy search or information criteria embedded in the fitness function, act on syntactic representations during model search. We introduce Fisher-Geometric pruning (FGP), a post-hoc model-reduction framework that acts on fitted models and can complement these techniques.
  FGP combines local information geometry at the maximum-likelihood solution with explicit compatibility tests for interpretable parametric boundaries. A taxonomy of parametric directions separates local sensitivity from proximity to reducible boundaries, enabling the treatment of unidentifiable directions and reductions through zero constraints, asymptotic limits, and signed parameter identifications. Candidate reductions are realised by symbolic contraction and refitting, then accepted only when their cross-validated predictive risk remains within a prescribed tolerance.
  We evaluate FGP on controlled diagnostic problems and Pareto fronts generated by GPSR. Across both settings, FGP substantially reduces structural complexity while preserving, and often improving, out-of-sample accuracy. Comparisons with competing pruning strategies and ablations show that, by combining geometric screening, boundary compatibility, and predictive validation, FGP yields the most consistent joint gains in parsimony and generalisation.

AI.tldr: 提出Fisher-Geometric pruning (FGP)，一种作用于已拟合模型的事后约简框架，结合最大似然解处的局部信息几何与可解释参数边界的兼容性检验，在保持甚至提升泛化精度的同时显著降低GPSR模型结构复杂度。
AI.motivation: GPSR常产生冗余表达式：包含休眠分支、过精细调参的代数配置而过拟合采样噪声。现有复杂度控制策略（多目标规模-精度搜索、嵌入适应度的信息准则）均在搜索过程中作用于句法表示，无法对已拟合模型做事后约简。
AI.method: FGP为事后模型约简框架：1）在最大似然解处计算局部信息几何，并检验参数边界（零约束、渐近极限、带符号参数识别）的兼容性；2）建立参数方向分类法，区分局部敏感性与接近可约简边界的程度，处理不可识别方向；3）通过符号收缩与重拟合实现候选约简，仅当交叉验证预测风险在预设容差内才接受。
AI.result: 在受控诊断问题与GPSR生成的Pareto前沿上评估：FGP大幅降低结构复杂度，同时保持并常提升样本外精度；与竞争剪枝策略及消融实验对比，FGP在简约性与泛化性的联合增益上最为一致。
AI.conclusion: 几何筛选、边界兼容性与预测验证三者结合使FGP成为可与现有搜索期复杂度控制技术互补的稳健事后约简方法，实现简约性与泛化性的协同提升。

title: Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: Agentic knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to solve complex questions through multi-turn interactions with a knowledge graph (KG). Outcome-supervised reinforcement learning derives verifiable outcome rewards from final answers but uniformly assigns each rollout's outcome-level advantage to all policy-generated tokens, creating a trajectory-to-operation mismatch since KG operations within a rollout can have varying effects on the search process and final answer. To address this, we propose Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR), which employs a training-only KG-state outcome model to estimate outcome-reward changes between adjacent KG search states and converts them into operation credit, from which token-wise weights are derived. These multiplicative weights reallocate token-level update magnitudes while preserving the sign of the outcome-level advantage at every generated token. Across three benchmarks, OACR achieves stronger overall performance than existing KGQA methods while using fewer inference-time LLM calls and tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR)，用仅训练时使用的KG状态结果模型估计相邻搜索状态间的结果奖励变化并转化为操作学分，进而得到token级乘性权重，在保持优势符号不变的前提下重新分配策略更新幅度，提升Agentic KGQA效果并降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: Agentic KGQA中，基于结果监督的强化学习仅从最终答案获得可验证奖励，并将同一rollout的结果级优势均匀分配给所有策略生成的token，导致"轨迹—操作"失配：一次rollout内不同KG操作对搜索过程与最终答案的贡献差异被忽略。
AI.method: OACR引入一个仅在训练阶段使用的KG状态结果模型，评估相邻KG搜索状态的结果奖励差值，将其转换为各KG操作的操作学分，并由操作学分派生token级权重；这些乘性权重用于重新分配token级更新幅度，同时保证每个生成token上结果级优势的符号不变。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，OACR整体性能优于现有KGQA方法，且推理阶段所需的LLM调用次数与token消耗更少。
AI.conclusion: 通过在轨迹内部进行细粒度的信用再分配，可在不改变优势方向的情况下提升强化学习训练的信用分配质量，实现更高效、更准确的Agentic KGQA。

title: Paired-Outcome Learning for Selective Spacecraft Attitude Capture under Torque Limits
summary: Torque-limited spacecraft attitude capture requires adapting the maneuver speed to uncertain braking authority. Faster settings can reduce average tracking error while worsening individual maneuvers, making selective modification of an existing controller a baseline-relative learning problem. A paired-outcome method combines three mechanisms: physically interpretable continuation policies with different speed envelopes, separate prediction of task failure and successful-pair tracking gains, and context-dependent rejection that executes the unchanged baseline. Complete paired simulations provide labels under common plant parameters and measurement seeds; training, validation, and calibration are separated by context. Basilisk experiments use 108 development contexts, 324 labeling rollouts, and 624 evaluation episodes across 48 test contexts, including disclosed post-freeze diagnostics. The selective controller reduces aggregate integrated attitude error by 4.67% relative to the branch baseline, with 17 improvements, 31 exact ties, and no observed regressions. Always using the fast alternative achieves a 4.81% reduction but worsens 11 cases. Gains occur in principal-axis, near-axis, braking-boundary, and selected noise/drift maneuvers; general coupled cases retain the baseline. Ablations show no additional aggregate benefit from branch commitment, active querying, or score subtraction. The evidence supports a restricted empirical trade-off between average improvement and individual regression, without establishing a closed-loop safety guarantee.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"配对结果"选择性控制方法，将力矩受限航天器姿态捕获中的速度自适应建模为基线相对的学习问题，在Basilisk仿真中将积分姿态误差降低4.67%且无观测退化。
AI.motivation: 力矩受限下制动能力不确定，快速设定可降低平均跟踪误差却会恶化个别机动，需在保留原控制器安全性的前提下选择性修改，而非全局替换。
AI.method: 三机制组合：(1) 具物理可解释性、不同速度包络的延续策略；(2) 分开预测任务失败与成功配对样本的跟踪增益；(3) 依上下文拒绝并使用未改动的基线。配对完整仿真在共用对象参数与测量种子下提供标签；训练、验证、校准按上下文分离。
AI.result: 108个开发上下文、324条标注rollout、48个测试上下文共624次评估；一体化姿态误差较分支基线降4.67%，17个改进、31个精确持平、无观测退化；始终采用快速替代方案降4.81%但11例恶化。增益集中于主轴、近轴、制动边界及部分噪声/漂移机动，一般耦合情形保持基线；消融显示分支承诺、主动查询、分数相减未带来额外整体收益。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持平均改进与个体退化之间存在受限的经验性权衡，未建立闭环安全性保证。

title: When Form Changes but Logic Doesn't: Building Logic-invariant LLMs through Logical Structure
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether this performance reflects an understanding of underlying logical structure or a reliance on shallow semantic cues. A key indicator of such understanding is whether models treat logically equivalent inputs consistently, producing the same predictions despite differences in expression. Through systematic evaluation on curated data, we show that even strong LLMs often fail this test: they do not consistently preserve predictions across logically equivalent inputs and generalize poorly to unseen logical forms. To address this limitation, we propose LoGIcal STructure-guided reasoning (LoGIST), a framework that guides LLM reasoning with explicit logical structure. LoGIST maps each input instance to a decision diagram, a directed acyclic graph that captures the underlying logical structure, and encodes this graph into a logical embedding that conditions the LLM's reasoning process. Across multiple training settings, LoGIST reduces inconsistency under logical equivalence and improves generalization to unseen logical forms, suggesting that logical invariance is a useful target for building more robust and generalizable logical reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文考察大模型是否真正理解逻辑结构：发现强LLM在逻辑等价输入上预测不一致、对未见逻辑形式泛化差；提出LoGIST，将输入映射为决策图并编码为逻辑嵌入来条件化推理，从而提升逻辑等价下的不变性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: LLM在多种推理任务上表现优异，但尚不清楚这种表现源于对底层逻辑结构的理解，还是依赖浅层语义线索。逻辑等价输入下预测一致（逻辑不变性）是判断模型是否理解逻辑结构的关键指标，而现有模型在此测试上普遍失败。
AI.method: 构建系统性评测，在精选数据上检验LLM对逻辑等价输入的一致性及对未见逻辑形式的泛化。提出LoGIST框架：将每个输入实例映射为决策图（捕获底层逻辑结构的有向无环图），再把该图编码为逻辑嵌入，用于条件化LLM的推理过程；并在多种训练设置下验证。
AI.result: 即使强LLM也常在逻辑等价一致性测试中失败，无法跨逻辑等价输入保持预测一致，且对未见逻辑形式泛化较差；LoGIST在多种训练设置下降低了逻辑等价下的不一致性，并提升了对未见逻辑形式的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑不变性可作为构建更鲁棒、更具泛化性的LLM逻辑推理的有用优化目标；显式逻辑结构引导（决策图+逻辑嵌入）是提升模型逻辑推理可靠性的有效途径。

title: Global Convergence in Deep Networks via the Second Law of Thermodynamics
summary: Existing convergence analyses of finite-width overparameterized deep neural networks under standard parameterization often rely on parameters remaining close to their initialization and typically neglect the role of noise, despite empirical evidence that stochasticity can improve optimization and generalization. To bridge this gap, we study $L_2$-regularized continuous-time Langevin dynamics (CLD) with isotropic noise, for training feedforward networks with smooth activations. We introduce a change-of-measure inequality, inspired by the second law of thermodynamics, that enables control of key properties of the training dynamics under the time-evolving parameter distribution. Leveraging a sharpened lower bound on the minimum eigenvalue of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) at initialization, we show that injected noise helps preserve NTK stability with high probability without confining the weights to a small neighborhood of their initialization. As a result, we derive a non-asymptotic upper bound on the expected training loss. Our analysis yields explicit conditions on width and noise temperature that guarantee convergence to a finite loss floor. Finally, we experimentally show the network Jacobian can change from initialization, departing the commonly analyzed lazy regime.

AI.tldr: 研究L2正则化连续时间Langevin动力学（CLD）训练前馈网络的收敛性，借助受热力学第二定律启发的测度变换不等式与NTK最小特征值下界，证明各向同性噪声可在参数显著偏离初始化时仍保持NTK稳定，给出期望训练损失的有限非渐近上界及宽度与噪声温度条件。
