AI.motivation: 现有有限宽度过参数化网络收敛分析通常依赖参数贴近初始化、忽略噪声作用，而经验上随机性可改善优化与泛化，二者存在缺口。
AI.method: 针对平滑激活前馈网络，分析带L2正则的各向同性噪声CLD；引入类比热力学第二定律的测度变换不等式，以控制时变参数分布下的动力学性质；并结合初始化时NTK最小特征值的更紧下界。
AI.result: 证明注入噪声以高概率维持NTK稳定性，同时不需将权重限制在初始化小邻域内；导出期望训练损失的非渐近上界，给出保证收敛至有限损失底的宽度与噪声温度显式条件；实验显示网络雅可比可偏离初始化，脱离惰性训练区间。
AI.conclusion: 噪声可替代“贴近初始化”的强假设，在更广范围内保持NTK稳定性并实现收敛；理论框架可刻画非惰性（非lazy）训练区间。

title: Stepwise Reasoning Verification: Don't Generate, Classify!
summary: Verifying the reasoning of large language models is increasingly important as they are applied to complex mathematical and scientific problems. Existing work focuses on large decoder models and reports mixed results for generative and discriminative verifiers, leaving unclear which paradigm is more effective and whether large models are necessary. In this work, we cast stepwise verification as a natural language inference task: the problem and partial solution prefix form the premise, while the next reasoning step serves as the hypothesis to be classified as entailed or non-entailed. This formulation enables error localisation at individual reasoning steps and direct comparison of encoder classification, decoder classification, and decoder verdict generation across model scales and annotation budgets. Across five reasoning datasets, a 0.15B encoder classifier outperforms most generative verifiers with up to 4B parameters. On identical decoder backbones, classification outperforms generation from 0.5B to 4B parameters and matches it on the strongest 7B backbone---reaching comparable performance with roughly one tenth as many annotated problems. Our findings establish classification as a parameter- and data-efficient approach to stepwise verification and show that strong verification does not require large generative decoders.

AI.tldr: 本文将逐步验证建模为自然语言推理任务，系统比较编码器分类、解码器分类与解码器生成三种范式，发现小型编码器分类器在参数和数据效率上显著优于大型生成式验证器。
AI.motivation: 现有验证工作集中于大型解码器模型，生成式与判别式验证器的效果报告不一，尚不清楚哪种范式更有效、是否必须使用大模型。
AI.method: 把逐步验证转化为自然语言推理：以题目与部分解答前缀为前提，下一步推理为假设，分类为蕴含/非蕴含；该形式支持逐步错误定位，并在不同模型规模与标注预算下直接比较编码器分类、解码器分类和解码器判定生成。
AI.result: 在五个推理数据集上，0.15B 编码器分类器优于多数参数量达 4B 的生成式验证器；在相同解码器骨干下，0.5B–4B 区间分类优于生成，在最强 7B 骨干上二者持平，且分类仅需约十分之一的标注问题量即可达到可比性能。
AI.conclusion: 分类是一种参数与数据高效的逐步验证方法，强验证能力并不依赖大型生成式解码器。

title: Process-Aware Event Log Augmentation for Process Prediction under Labeled Data Scarcity
comment: This paper has been accepted for the International Journal of Cooperative Information Systems
summary: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) forecasts future events of ongoing business processes based on event logs. However, deep learning PPM approaches are often limited by labeled data scarcity and the low variability of real-world logs. To address this, we introduce SiamSA-PPM, a self-supervised framework combining Siamese learning with statistically grounded data augmentation. It employs novel transformation methods that leverage control-flow semantics and frequent behavioral patterns to generate realistic, semantically valid trace variants, learning generalizable prefix representations without labeled supervision. Extensive experiments on real-world event logs with a wide range of variability, incorporating exhaustive hyperparameter tuning, demonstrate the value of this process-aware augmentation. Compared to state-of-the-art baselines, SiamSA-PPM achieves competitive or superior predictive performance in both next activity and final outcome prediction tasks. An open source implementation of our method is publicly available under https://github.com/SvStraten/SiamSA-PPM-Extension..

AI.tldr: SiamSA-PPM：结合孪生学习与统计驱动数据增强的自监督预测式流程监控框架，利用控制流语义生成语义有效的轨迹变体，无需标签即可学习可泛化的前缀表示，在下一活动与最终结果预测任务上取得有竞争力或更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 深度学习的预测式流程监控（PPM）受限于标注数据稀缺以及真实事件日志变异性低的问题，难以训练出泛化能力强的模型。
AI.method: 提出自监督框架 SiamSA-PPM，将孪生学习（Siamese learning）与有统计依据的数据增强相结合；设计新颖的变换方法，利用控制流语义和频繁行为模式生成真实且语义有效的轨迹变体，从而在无标签监督下学习可泛化的前缀表示。
AI.result: 在具有广泛变异性的真实事件日志上进行大量实验，并配合详尽的超参数调优，验证了流程感知增强的价值；与最先进基线相比，SiamSA-PPM 在下一活动预测和最终结果预测任务上均取得有竞争力或更优的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 流程感知的自监督数据增强可有效缓解标注稀缺问题，SiamSA-PPM 为 PPM 提供了一种可行的无监督表示学习方案，且已开源实现。

title: System X: An LLM Decision Model That Replies from Its Own KV Cache
summary: Decision models return probabilities over supplied options, but a deployed agent may also need to reply in words. The present study introduces System X, a large language model (LLM) decision model that adds a text-reply option to the LLM-as-Jev readout. When this option wins, or confidence is low, the same model continues from the decision's key-value (KV) cache, avoiding a repeated prompt prefill. Qwen3-0.6B has been fine-tuned with LoRA on Reason-9k and Bitext reply rows. JevBench accuracy shows no statistically significant change (55.4% to 54.5%, p=0.87), while expected calibration error falls from 0.292 to 0.169. Held-out Bitext routing accuracy reaches 98.3%. Cache reuse saves 15-37% of latency on an Apple M4 Pro, with token-identical replies in the FP32 demonstration cases. Scoring options on copies of the prompt cache matches full-sequence scoring to within 1.4e-6 in probability. Adding dialogue, industry and complaint data (System X+) improves support-task results but lowers IFEval accuracy from 55.5% to 45.0%. System X v4 uses Qwen3-1.7B, rebalanced data and teacher-rewritten reply targets. Against its base LLM, JevBench accuracy rises from 55.0% to 61.0% (p=0.04), with no statistically significant IFEval change (p=0.71). A matched latency test on unadapted Qwen3-1.7B saves 17-39%. One LLM judge prefers v4 replies to an unadapted 1.7B second call (31 to 11 pairs, p=0.003); the other's preference is not significant. These reply comparisons also differ in prompts and generation limits. State conflicts and unsupported reply details remain failure modes. Further studies with several seeds, human raters and real support data are recommended.

AI.tldr: 提出 System X：在 LLM-as-Jev 读出中加入"文本回复"选项，并复用决策 KV 缓存继续生成，避免重复 prefill；校准误差显著下降，路由准确率达 98.3%，缓存复用节省 15–37% 延迟。v4（Qwen3-1.7B + 数据再平衡 + 教师重写回复）使 JevBench 准确率 55.0%→61.0%，IFEval 无显著变化，但仍存在状态冲突与无依据细节等失败模式。
AI.motivation: 已部署的决策模型通常只输出候选选项上的概率分布，但实际智能体还需要用自然语言回复用户。将"决策读出"与"文本生成"分离会带来重复的 prompt prefill 开销与决策—回复不一致，且纯概率输出缺乏校准性。
AI.method: 在 LLM-as-Jev 读出中增加一个 text-reply 选项：当该选项胜出或置信度偏低时，同一模型从决策阶段的 KV cache 继续解码生成回复，省去重复 prefill。用 LoRA 在 Reason-9k 与 Bitext reply 行上微调 Qwen3-0.6B；并验证在 prompt cache 副本上打分与全序列打分的一致性。System X+ 额外加入对话、行业与投诉数据。System X v4 改用 Qwen3-1.7B，采用重平衡数据与教师重写的回复目标。评估含 JevBench 准确率、ECE、Bitext 路由准确率、IFEval、M4 Pro 延迟，以及 LLM judge 成对偏好。
AI.result: 0.6B：JevBench 准确率无显著变化（55.4%→54.5%，p=0.87），ECE 由 0.292 降至 0.169；留出 Bitext 路由准确率 98.3%；缓存复用降低 15–37% 延迟，FP32 演示用例回复逐 token 一致；缓存副本打分与全序列打分概率差 ≤1.4e-6。System X+ 提升支持任务表现，但 IFEval 由 55.5% 降至 45.0%。v4 相对基座：JevBench 55.0%→61.0%（p=0.04），IFEval 无显著变化（p=0.71），未适配 Qwen3-1.7B 上延迟节省 17–39%；一名 LLM judge 偏好 v4 回复（31:11，p=0.003），另一名不显著，且回复对比在 prompt 与生成长度限制上不一致。
AI.conclusion: 在决策读出中嵌入文本回复选项并复用 KV cache，可在几乎不损失决策精度的前提下改善校准并降低推理延迟；扩大模型与优化数据（v4）可带来显著准确率提升。状态冲突与无依据回复细节仍是主要失败模式，作者建议以多随机种子、人工评分与真实客服数据开展后续研究。

title: First-Order LoRA Training with Phone NPUs
summary: On-device fine-tuning lets a large language model (LLM) learn from its user's private data without uploading it. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the trainable parameters, but each first-order training step still multiplies by the frozen base-model weights during the forward pass, activation recomputation, and input-gradient computation. A phone's neural processing unit (NPU) already holds these weights for inference; using it for training also requires computing input gradients, which its inference interface does not support. We present a system that runs all three frozen-weight products on the NPU while keeping the training graph, adapters, and optimizer on the CPU. Its input-gradient kernels reuse the resident weight tiles and the forward dequantizer, avoiding a transposed weight copy and ensuring forward and backward use the same effective weights. To preserve usable gradients, the system selects precision by gradient sensitivity and applies a per-row range guard for half-precision (FP16) outputs. Its runtime fuses the remaining CPU operators and overlaps NPU execution with adapter computation, while resumable execution and thermal pacing let training proceed as a background job. We evaluate it on two Qualcomm Snapdragon platforms using four LLMs from the Qwen and Llama families. Our workloads cover nightly personalization with labels supplied on the phone and the public LaMP-2 benchmark; comparisons include an optimized CPU trainer, a phone-GPU trainer, forward-only training, and GPU-trained references.

AI.tldr: 提出一套在手机上训练LoRA的系统，把三次冻结权重乘积全部放到NPU上执行，训练图、适配器与优化器留在CPU，并在两款骁龙平台、四个Qwen/Llama模型上验证其优于CPU训练器、手机GPU训练器与仅前向方案。
AI.motivation: 端侧微调可避免上传用户隐私数据；LoRA虽减少了可训练参数，但每个一阶训练步仍要在前向、激活重计算和输入梯度计算中与冻结的基座权重相乘。手机NPU本已驻留这些权重用于推理，但其推理接口不支持输入梯度计算，因此无法直接用于训练。
AI.method: 将全部三次冻结权重乘积卸载到NPU，训练图、适配器与优化器保留在CPU；输入梯度核复用常驻权重分块与前向反量化器，避免转置权重拷贝，并保证前向与反向使用同一有效权重；按梯度敏感度为不同部分选择精度，对FP16输出施加逐行范围保护；运行时融合剩余CPU算子、将NPU执行与适配器计算重叠，并以可恢复执行和热节流实现后台训练。
AI.result: 在两款Qualcomm Snapdragon平台、Qwen与Llama家族共四个LLM上评测，负载包括手机端标注的夜间个性化与公开LaMP-2基准，对比对象为优化CPU训练器、手机GPU训练器、仅前向训练以及GPU训练参考。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明可借助NPU的常驻权重高效完成LoRA训练中的冻结权重乘积（含输入梯度），在真实手机平台上实现可用的端侧个性化训练，并兼顾精度、能效与后台运行实用性。

title: On Reasoning Correctness Directions
summary: We present experimental evidence suggesting that information about whether a model's reasoning is on the right track can be linearly decodable without defining a causally useful direction for steering. To study this, we introduce ChainSearch, a controlled arithmetic reasoning task that extends Countdown with explicit search and backtracking. We train a 3-million-parameter model to solve this task. Its compact size allows us to study internal model correctness directions in detail using linear probes, mean activation differences, and direct optimisation, as part of a rigorous search for internal reasoning-correctness directions. We find that while the model contains statistically significant internal directions of reasoning correctness, none of the resulting directions consistently improves reasoning under causal intervention. This calls into question whether the linear representation hypothesis is sufficient for identifying causally useful directions in the context of reasoning. Our code is made available together with this work.

AI.tldr: 论文在自建的算术推理任务ChainSearch上训练3M参数小模型，系统搜索"推理正确性"的内部方向，发现该信息可线性解码，但据此得到的方向在因果干预下无法稳定提升推理表现。
AI.motivation: 检验"模型是否在正确推理轨道上"这一信息能否不仅被线性解码，还能转化为因果有效的引导方向（steering direction），从而检验线性表示假设在推理情境下是否充分。
AI.method: 提出ChainSearch——在Countdown基础上加入显式搜索与回溯的受控算术推理任务；训练3M参数的小模型以便细致分析；采用线性探针、平均激活差与直接优化三类手段系统搜索内部推理正确性方向，并进行因果干预实验。
AI.result: 模型内部存在统计显著的推理正确性方向（线性可解码），但没有任何由上述方法得到的方向在因果干预下能一致地改善推理表现。
AI.conclusion: 线性表示假设或不足以识别推理场景中因果有效的方向；可解码性不等于因果可用性，这对基于激活引导的可解释性与控制方法提出警示。代码已开源。

title: Pair-Aware Optimization: Coordinating Exploration and Refinement for Jailbreaking LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are vulnerable to adversarial inputs that induce attacker-specified malicious behaviors, commonly referred to as jailbreaking. Existing optimization-based jailbreak attacks primarily employ first-order (FO) methods that leverage gradient information or zeroth-order (ZO) methods that rely on function-value feedback. However, their complementarity and optimization ordering remain underexplored. We systematically investigate four strategies: pure ZO, pure FO, ZO->FO, and FO->ZO, and develop a ZO-FO framework that explores adversarial prefixes through ZO optimization and refines their corresponding suffixes through FO optimization. To coordinate the two processes, we introduce Pair-aware optimization, which retains multiple prefix candidates, conditionally refines their suffixes and selects among the resulting prefix-suffix pairs. We further investigate agent jailbreaking from a more general stochastic-generation perspective, where the same adversarial input can induce diverse reasoning trajectories and actions that a single greedy output cannot capture. Accordingly, we adopt consistent stochastic decoding during both optimization and evaluation. Experiments across malicious-instruction and malicious-environment benchmarks demonstrate that hybrid optimization improves attack effectiveness over single-optimizer methods, while optimization order substantially influences performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究一阶(FO)与零阶(ZO)优化在LLM智能体越狱攻击中的互补性与顺序效应，提出ZO-FO混合框架(Pair-aware优化)并以一致随机解码进行评估，实验表明混合优化优于单一优化器且优化顺序显著影响效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于优化的LLM智能体越狱攻击仅使用FO(梯度)或ZO(函数值)单一方法，二者互补性及优化顺序尚未被探索；同时智能体在随机生成下同一对抗输入可产生多样推理轨迹，单一贪婪输出难以刻画。
AI.method: 系统性比较四种策略(纯ZO、纯FO、ZO→FO、FO→ZO)，构建ZO-FO框架：用ZO优化搜索对抗前缀，再用FO优化精炼对应后缀；引入Pair-aware优化，保留多个前缀候选、按条件精炼后缀并在前缀-后缀对中选择；在优化与评估中均采用一致的随机解码。
AI.result: 在恶意指令与恶意环境两类基准上，混合优化较单一优化器方法提升攻击有效性；优化顺序对性能有显著影响。
AI.conclusion: FO与ZO具有互补性，将ZO前缀搜索与FO后缀精炼结合并经Pair-aware协调可增强越狱攻击效果，且优化顺序选择是关键设计因素；随机视角下的一致解码更贴合智能体实际行为。

title: A failure of Imagination: VLMs fail to use visual representations for text, but self-distillation can help
summary: Vision-language (VL) models are typically built by fine-tuning a language model to attend to visual features in service of a Visual Question-Answering objective. We ask whether this alignment changes how language models represent text---especially on tasks where visualization would help, like geometry questions posed in words. We distinguish weak multimodality (the model can answer questions about an input image) from strong multimodality (the model's text representations themselves become vision-aligned, improving performance on text-only tasks with latent visual structure). To test for strong multimodality, we construct a task of shape-counting problems with paired equivalent text and image specifications. This task is trivial when the image is provided, but requires visualization when specified in text as line coordinates. We compare instruction-tuned Qwen-2.5 and Mistral models against their vision-aligned counterparts on the text variant of the task. We find that the multimodal models do no better in this setting, despite strong performance on the image version of the task. Probing experiments corroborate this: vision-aligned decoder embeddings carry no more visual structure than their text-only counterparts. Finally, we provide an optimization objective that distills in-context visual embeddings into text embeddings. This alignment induces gains on the text variant of the task without explicit task supervision, even on samples more complex than seen during alignment. This suggests that VQA-style alignment leaves available cross-modal transfer untapped.

AI.tldr: 论文提出区分"弱多模态"（能就输入图像答题）与"强多模态"（文本表征本身对齐视觉、从而提升纯文本任务），并构造图文配对任务检验，发现常规VQA式对齐并未带来强多模态，但通过将上下文视觉嵌入蒸馏进文本嵌入可无监督地激发跨模态迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型仅通过VQA目标微调语言模型去关注视觉特征，作者质疑这种对齐是否会真正改变语言模型对文本的表征，尤其是面对几何等需要可视化辅助的纯文本任务。核心动机是检验跨模态对齐是否被充分利用，即VQA式对齐是否留下了未被开发的跨模态迁移潜力。
AI.method: 1) 概念上区分弱多模态与强多模态；2) 构造"形状计数"任务，提供等价的文本规格与图像规格，图像版简单、文本版以直线坐标表述需内部可视化；3) 将指令微调Qwen-2.5与Mistral与其视觉对齐版本在文本版任务上对比；4) 探针实验检测视觉对齐解码器嵌入是否携带更多视觉结构；5) 提出优化目标，将上下文视觉嵌入蒸馏进文本嵌入。
AI.result: 多模态模型在文本版任务上并不比纯文本模型更好，尽管在图像版任务上表现强劲；探针实验表明视觉对齐解码器嵌入所含视觉结构不多于纯文本对应模型。所提出的蒸馏目标在无显式任务监督下即可在文本版任务上带来增益，且对未在对齐阶段见过的更复杂样本也有效。
AI.conclusion: VQA式对齐并未带来强多模态，其跨模态迁移能力大量未被开发；通过将上下文视觉嵌入蒸馏进文本嵌入，可激活潜在的视觉对齐文本表征，提示未来可设计更有效的对齐目标以释放跨模态迁移潜力。

title: Compose the Horizon: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting under a Sequential-Compute Trade-off
summary: Most long-horizon forecasters emit the complete future in one pass. We ask whether a compact operator can instead be reused to emit contiguous future blocks, trading stored parameters for sequential computation. Recursive Functional Decomposition (RFD) factorizes the horizon mapping into three parameter-shared block predictions. The blocks occupy disjoint future intervals and are concatenated, not added as trend, seasonal, or residual components, and each emitted block joins the rolling context that conditions the next application. In controlled three-seed experiments, removing forward feedback hurts all four evaluated datasets while stopping gradients through it changes little, so the useful signal is the evolving forecast state itself; reapplying the shared operator helps consistently, but by less than widening it. The model uses 0.08--0.46M parameters, yet its sequential channel-wise execution is slower and more memory-intensive than an iterative baseline at high channel count. In a frozen long-context evaluation against ten strong baseline families, RFD records lower test error in 23 of 24 cells; the comparison is cross-protocol, with RFD using 512/720-step context and the baselines using 96.

AI.tldr: 提出递归函数分解（RFD），用一个参数共享的紧凑算子分块递推地预测长时程未来：块占据不相交的未来区间并拼接，每块并入滚动上下文以条件化下一次应用。控制实验表明有效信号来自不断演化的预测状态本身；模型仅0.08–0.46M参数，但通道数高时串行执行更慢更耗内存；冻结长上下文评测中24个格子有23个误差更低（跨协议，RFD用512/720步上下文，基线用96步）。
AI.motivation: 主流长时程预测器一次性输出完整未来，参数存储开销大。作者探究能否用紧凑算子重复复用来逐块输出连续未来块，以"顺序计算"换"存储参数"。
AI.method: RFD将时程映射分解为三个参数共享的块预测；各块占据互不重叠的未来区间并拼接（而非按趋势/季节/残差相加分解），每次输出的块并入滚动上下文以条件化下一次应用。进行三随机种子控制实验：消融前向反馈（滚动上下文）、阻断其梯度、以及加宽算子与重复应用对比。并在冻结长上下文设定下与十个强基线族对比。
AI.result: 移除前向反馈在四个数据集上均变差，而阻断其梯度几乎无影响——说明有用信号是演化的预测状态本身；重复应用共享算子稳定有益，但增益小于加宽算子。模型参数0.08–0.46M，但通道数高时串行通道式执行比迭代基线更慢更耗内存。跨协议对比中24格有23格测试误差更低。
AI.conclusion: 参数共享的递推分块预测在极小参数预算下可取得强精度，但存在效率与严谨对比的局限；作者诚实给出跨协议比较与计算瓶颈分析。

title: P(Yes): 15$\times$ Improvements via Test-Time Scaling of Decision Models
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Interactive version: https://research.tearlabs.ai/pyes-search/ . Code and data: https://github.com/tear-labs/pyes-search
summary: Decision models answer typed questions, such as multiple-choice or yes/no questions, with a probability for each option. We add test-time search to frozen decision models, with no training: we show the model a complete proposed answer, read off its probability of saying "Yes" to the proposal's correctness, and search for answers that it rates higher. The search is done either by editing one answer at a time or by joint optimization, which changes several answers at once. Search raises accuracy for every model and test set we tried, and the gains are largest for exact correctness on logic puzzles, where every answer in a task must be right. On 128 such puzzles, it takes Qwen3.8-27B from 2 to 30 exactly correct puzzles ($15\times$) and its per-blank accuracy from 27.8% to 48.5%. On a shared set of 47 puzzles, searching over each model's own Yes/No score raises the per-blank accuracy of StartLux Instant, Perplexity Decider, Clef, and JEV, which we reach only through its public API, by 4.0 to 13.0 percentage points, and raises the number of puzzles they get exactly correct, out of 47 and averaged over three search seeds, from 10 to 35, 9 to 26, 2 to 11, and 9 to 31.7 respectively.

AI.tldr: 无需训练，仅在测试阶段对冻结的决策模型做搜索：让模型对完整候选答案给出 "Yes" 概率并据此搜索更高分答案，单答案编辑或联合优化均可，所有模型与测试集准确率普涨，逻辑谜题的完全正确率提升最显著。
AI.motivation: 决策模型以逐选项概率作答，但其自评信息未被充分利用；已有提升多依赖训练或额外监督，成本高且对黑盒模型不可行。作者希望以纯推理期、免训练的方式挖掘模型自身的正确性判断信号来提升答案质量。
AI.method: 把完整的候选答案回灌给冻结的决策模型，读取其对该答案"正确"回答"Yes"的概率作为打分函数；在此分数上做测试时搜索，两种形式：(1) 逐次编辑单个答案的局部搜索，(2) 同时改动多个答案的联合优化。搜索仅通过模型接口进行，可用于仅有公开API的闭源模型。
AI.result: 所有模型与测试集准确率均有提升，且完全正确率收益最大。在 128 个逻辑谜题上，Qwen3.8-27B 的完全正确谜题数由 2 增至 30（15×），单空准确率由 27.8% 升至 48.5%。在共享的 47 个谜题上，基于各模型自身 Yes/No 分数搜索，使 StartLux Instant、Perplexity Decider、Clef、JEV 的单空准确率提升 4.0–13.0 个百分点，完全正确谜题数（三次搜索种子平均）分别由 10→35、9→26、2→11、9→31.7。
AI.conclusion: 冻结决策模型内含可被搜索放大的自评正确性信号，测试时搜索是一种免训练、模型无关、对黑盒API亦适用的通用增益手段；在要求全部答案正确的严格任务上收益尤为突出，且不同模型间存在显著差异（如 Clef 增益最小）。

title: Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machines as Unsupervised Encoders for Biomechanical Movement Sequences
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Under review at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Biomechanical movement recordings are continuous, high-dimensional time series, and analyzing them without manually labeling them requires representations that capture how movements evolve over time. Most unsupervised representation-learning pipelines, however, treat each observation frame independently and discard this temporal structure, while energy-based models that could capture it have not extensively been adapted to biomechanical signals. So, this paper implements the Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RTRBM), a recurrent energy-based model, into an unsupervised encoder that maps windows of movement data to fixed-length embeddings, and tests what its recurrent structure contributes. We adapt the model to continuous-valued signals, stack it into a deep architecture, and integrate it into the SIT-FUSE segmentation pipeline. We evaluate the embeddings on simulated musculoskeletal reaching and on two real gait datasets, using clustering, reconstruction, and walking-speed classification of unseen subjects, and compare them against non-recurrent and non-probabilistic baselines, including a control that removes the recurrent connection. Clustering the embeddings recovers movement structure tied to progress toward the target without any labels, which also transfers to unseen episodes. On gait data, the embeddings outperform PCA and autoencoder baselines under a nonlinear probe. However, removing the recurrent connection does not yield a measurable loss on the reaching task, and simple per-channel summary statistics classify walking speed at least as well as the embeddings. The model is therefore a working, verified encoder for SIT-FUSE, while the evidence for a benefit of recurrence is mixed, and the learned embeddings did not outperform simple summary statistics on gait.

AI.tldr: 该文将循环时序受限玻尔兹曼机(RTRBM)改造为无监督编码器，把运动数据窗口映射为定长嵌入并接入SIT-FUSE分割流程；结果表明嵌入能无标签恢复运动结构，但循环结构的收益证据混杂，且在步态数据上未优于简单统计量。
AI.motivation: 生物力学运动记录是连续高维时间序列，无监督分析需要能刻画运动随时间演化的表征。但主流无监督表征学习流程逐帧独立处理、丢弃时间结构；而本可捕捉该结构的能量模型尚未被充分适配到生物力学信号上。
AI.method: 实现RTRBM这一循环能量模型作为无监督编码器：将其适配到连续值信号、堆叠为深层架构，并集成进SIT-FUSE分割流水线。在模拟肌肉骨骼伸手任务与两个真实步态数据集上评估嵌入，采用聚类、重构与对未见受试者的步速分类，与PCA、自编码器等非循环/非概率基线比较，并设置去除循环连接的对照实验。
AI.result: 聚类嵌入可在无标签条件下恢复与趋近目标进度相关的运动结构，并能迁移到未见片段；步态数据上嵌入在非线性探针下优于PCA与自编码器基线。但去除循环连接在伸手任务上未带来可测损失，且简单逐通道汇总统计量在步速分类上至少与嵌入相当。
AI.conclusion: 该模型是可用于SIT-FUSE的、经验证有效的编码器；但循环结构带来收益的证据混杂，且学习到的嵌入在步态数据上未能超越简单汇总统计量。

title: From Proposal to Execution: Modeling Interaction Semantics in Shared Autonomy
summary: In many human-AI systems, candidate actions are not executed directly but are first evaluated by another decision-making entity under a potentially different objective or decision model. Standard decision-theoretic frameworks do not require this interaction to be represented explicitly, as they define transition dynamics directly over state-action pairs, allowing evaluation to be absorbed within the transition model. We introduce a semantics-aware decision framework in which a candidate action is proposed, evaluated under an interaction context, and then resolved into an executed outcome. We formalize this through a joint action language and an interpretation function that maps each joint action and context to a semantic outcome. Transition and reward dynamics are induced through these semantic outcomes, thereby introducing an explicit representational layer for \textit{interaction semantics}. Semantic outcomes provide explicit units for organizing interaction principles, which can be instantiated through application-specific evaluation mechanisms and reused across distinct interaction instances. This provides a structured interface for specifying context-dependent evaluation separately from the resulting execution dynamics, without requiring changes to the underlying planning algorithm. We instantiate the framework in shared human-AI autonomy, capturing interaction patterns such as advisory and authorization, and illustrating how interaction context influences decision making. The resulting formulation remains compatible with standard Markov decision process (MDP) planning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种"语义感知决策框架"，把候选动作的"提出—在交互上下文下评估—解析为执行结果"显式建模，通过联合动作语言和解释函数定义语义结果，并由此诱导转移与奖励动态，从而为交互语义提供独立的表示层，同时保持与标准MDP规划的兼容性。
AI.motivation: 在人类-AI系统中，候选动作往往先由另一决策实体（可能有不同目标或决策模型）评估，而非直接执行。传统决策论框架直接在状态-动作对上定义转移动态，把这种评估"吸收"进转移模型，导致交互语义难以显式表达、难以复用和模块化。
AI.method: 引入语义感知决策框架：候选动作被提出、在交互上下文下评估、再解析为执行结果。用联合动作语言与解释函数将（联合动作, 上下文）映射到语义结果；转移与奖励动态由语义结果诱导。语义结果作为组织交互原则的显式单元，可由应用特定的评估机制实例化并跨交互实例复用，在规划算法不变的前提下把上下文相关评估与执行动态分离。实例化为共享人-AI自主（advisory、authorization等交互模式）。
AI.result: 框架成功实例化于共享人-AI自主场景，刻画了建议（advisory）与授权（authorization）等交互模式，并展示了交互上下文如何影响决策；所得到的表述与标准MDP规划保持兼容。
AI.conclusion: 通过在状态-动作与转移之间插入"语义结果"这一表示层，可将交互评估从执行动态中解耦，实现可复用、可插拔的交互语义建模，且不改变底层规划算法。

title: A Statistical Viewpoint on Adam, Shampoo and Muon
summary: We provide new statistical insights into designing stochastic optimization methods. By modeling the gradient via a normal distribution, we argue that the stochastic gradient should be whitened using its covariance. We give an online method for estimating the mean and variance of the gradients based on regularized likelihood or, equivalently, through a maximum a posteriori estimate. We then show how to use structured approximations to the covariance within this same framework, which includes diagonal and Kronecker-factored approximations. The diagonal approximation results in a method that is very closely related to Adam and performs as well in practice. The Kronecker approximation results in the new MN method, which is a variant of Shampoo and KL-Shampoo. We also recover Muon by applying this same statistical framework to the gradient direction rather than the full gradient. By combining this with a whitening step, we arrive at MN-Muon, a novel preconditioned version of Muon. Our experiments on GPT-2-type models at Chinchilla scale indicate that MND, the diagonal implementation of MN, outperforms both the Distributed Shampoo and the KL-Shampoo implementations in terms of stability, final validation loss and time taken. MND-Muon, the diagonal implementation of MN-Muon, improves on Muon in 21 of 24 paired GPT-small runs and achieves a lower best validation loss on GPT-medium, where it remains stable over the six tested learning rates. However, we found that NorMuon was comparable to MND-Muon and achieved a slightly lower validation loss on GPT-medium and at GPT-small batch 512 on FineWeb.

AI.tldr: 本文从正态分布建模梯度的统计视角重新审视随机优化方法，推导出梯度需用其协方差白化，并在统一框架下恢复出 Adam、Shampoo/KL-Shampoo、Muon 等方法，提出新的 MN、MN-Muon 及其对角实现 MND、MND-Muon。
AI.motivation: 现有随机优化方法（Adam、Shampoo、Muon 等）多为经验设计，缺乏统一的统计理论解释；作者希望以梯度的正态分布建模为出发点，给出白化与预条件设计的统计依据，并由此系统地推导和统一这些方法。
AI.method: 将随机梯度建模为正态分布，论证应使用其协方差对梯度进行白化；通过正则化似然（等价于最大后验估计）给出在线估计梯度均值与方差的方法；在同一框架下引入协方差的结构化近似（对角与 Kronecker 分解）；对角近似导出与 Adam 高度相关的方法，Kronecker 近似导出新的 MN 方法（Shampoo/KL-Shampoo 的变体）；将同一统计框架作用于梯度方向而非完整梯度可恢复 Muon，再结合白化步骤得到预条件版 MN-Muon。
AI.result: 在 Chinchilla 规模的 GPT-2 类模型实验中，MN 的对角实现 MND 在稳定性、最终验证损失和耗时上均优于 Distributed Shampoo 与 KL-Shampoo；MND-Muon 在 24 组 GPT-small 配对实验中 21 组优于 Muon，并在 GPT-medium 上于六种学习率下保持稳定且取得更低的最佳验证损失；但 NorMuon 与 MND-Muon 表现相当，在 GPT-medium 及 GPT-small batch 512 的 FineWeb 上验证损失略低。
AI.conclusion: 基于正态分布建模与协方差白化的统计框架能够统一解释并导出 Adam、Shampoo、Muon 等一系列优化方法，并催生性能更优的 MN 与 MN-Muon 系列；实证显示 MND 与 MND-Muon 具有竞争力，但相较 NorMuon 的优势并不显著。

title: Assessing the AI Readiness of Construction Datasets: A Multidimensional Operational Framework
summary: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in construction has increased the demand for datasets suitable for reliable model development, evaluation, and reuse. However, construction datasets vary widely in documentation, quality, governance, and evaluation support, and consistent criteria for assessing AI readiness remain limited. This study develops a Construction Dataset AI Readiness Framework with 30 attributes across four dimensions: Metadata Completeness, Data Quality and Representativeness, Data Governance and Accessibility, and AI Utility. The framework uses attribute-specific scoring, applicability screening, and automated and manual verification. It was evaluated using 21 publicly available datasets across seven data-type groups. Overall readiness scores ranged from 0.720 to 0.964, with a mean of 0.879. Hybrid verification achieved 90.5% agreement between automated suggestions and manually verified scores. The framework supports consistent assessment of heterogeneous construction datasets and identification of readiness gaps.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"建筑数据集AI就绪度框架"，含4个维度30项属性，对21个公开数据集评估，就绪度得分0.720–0.964（均值0.879），人机混合校验一致率达90.5%。
AI.motivation: 建筑领域AI应用快速增长，对可用于可靠建模、评估与复用的数据集需求上升；但建筑数据集在文档化、质量、治理与评估支持方面差异大，缺乏一致的AI就绪度评估标准。
AI.method: 构建含30项属性的四维框架（元数据完整性、数据质量与代表性、数据治理与可获取性、AI效用）；采用属性级打分、适用性筛选，以及自动化与人工相结合的混合校验方式；在7个数据类型组、21个公开数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 总体就绪度得分0.720–0.964，均值0.879；自动化建议与人工核验得分的一致率为90.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可支持异构建筑数据集的一致化评估，并识别就绪度差距。

title: An Impossibility Result for ETF Target Geometry, and an Equinorm Remedy for Imbalanced Analytic Continual Learning
comment: Accepted at the NeurReps 2026 Workshop (Extended Abstract Track), NeurIPS 2026
summary: Analytic continual learning (ACL) methods such as ACIL and GACL fit a ridge-regression classifier head on frozen features via the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury identity, achieving exemplar-free, exact updates. A separate line of work, Progressive Neural Collapse (ProNC), shows standard continual classifiers benefit from a progressively expanding Simplex Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF) target. It is natural to ask whether fusing the two ideas, exact analytic updates and ETF targets, would yield a better closed-form continual learner. We show this is not the case as the fusion turns out to be identical to plain one-hot ACIL. Further, Simplex ETFs are not nested across class counts, so the literal "progressively expand the ETF" construction stops yielding an ETF as new tasks arrive, and it introduces catastrophic forgetting ($4\times$ that of a classic ACIL head). We therefore separate an ETF's two defining properties, equiangularity and equinormality, and apply each on its own to the classifier weights rather than the targets, where the invariance above does not hold. Equinorm post-processing of the fitted weights recovers both tail-class and overall average accuracy across the long-tailed regime from 5:1 to 100:1 imbalance (e.g. +32.0 tail-accuracy points and +16.0 average-accuracy points at 100:1 on CIFAR-100/ViT), transferring in sign across two backbones and two datasets, at a mild cost of 5.4 average-accuracy points on CIFAR-100/ViT on near-balanced streams (below $\approx 3{:}1$). Equiangular geometry, by contrast, is exactly inert on the target side but actively harmful on the weight side, usually losing to plain one-hot. Hence, the generally useful part of Neural Collapse geometry in Analytic Continual Learning is equinorm post-processing of the weights, becoming more useful as class imbalance grows; and equiangularity is at best a no-op and induces catastrophic forgetting at worst.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验“解析式持续学习(ACL)+渐进式神经坍缩ETF目标”的融合设想，证明融合等价于普通one-hot ACIL，且字面“渐进扩张Simplex ETF”不构成ETF并引发灾难性遗忘；转而将ETF的等角性与等范性分别作用于分类器权重，发现仅权重等范后处理在长尾场景显著增益。
AI.motivation: ACL（如ACIL、GACL）借助Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury恒等式在冻结特征上精确闭式更新岭回归分类头，实现无样本回放的持续学习；ProNC则表明标准持续分类器受益于逐步扩张的Simplex ETF目标。作者据此提出自然疑问：将精确解析更新与ETF目标融合是否可得到更优的闭式持续学习器。
AI.method: 先做理论分析：证明ETF目标与ACIL的闭式更新融合后在数学上等同于普通one-hot ACIL；指出Simplex ETF在类别数变化时不具嵌套性，故“渐进扩张ETF”不再为ETF且导致遗忘（约为经典ACIL头的4倍）。随后将ETF的等角性(equiangularity)与等范性(equinormality)解耦，分别直接作用于拟合后的分类器权重，并考察长尾不平衡(5:1至100:1)与近平衡流下的表现，跨两种骨干与两个数据集验证。
AI.result: 权重等范后处理在长尾区间恢复尾部类与总体平均准确率，100:1下CIFAR-100/ViT上尾部准确率+32.0、平均准确率+16.0，符号效应跨两骨干两数据集一致；代价是近平衡流(≲3:1)下平均准确率下降5.4点。等角几何在目标侧完全无效(inert)，在权重侧则有害，通常劣于普通one-hot。
AI.conclusion: 在解析式持续学习中，神经坍缩几何真正普适有用的部分是分类器权重的等范后处理，且随类别不平衡加剧而增益增大；等角性最好情况是无效操作，最坏情况诱发灾难性遗忘。ETF目标侧的融合思路被证伪。

title: Formal Raising: Embedding Verifiable Ethical Properties into the Development of AI
summary: Alan Turing proposed constructing a ``child machine'' and educating it rather than directly programming an adult-like intelligent machine. Recent work on model raising revives this developmental view for Large Language Models by arguing that moral values should accompany capability acquisition from the beginning rather than be added only through post-hoc alignment. This paper proposes Formal Raising (FR): selected moral values are represented as explicit, machine-checkable properties that participate in development, evaluation, and action selection. We present a C-based reasoning framework in which candidate actions are evaluated against prioritized ethical properties. Conflicts are resolved w.r.t. a given order, strict rules are non-defeasible, and underdetermination is reported explicitly. Exceptions are not encoded as special cases but emerge from the comparison of alternatives. We provide examples that cover conflicts involving life, truthfulness, harm, privacy, autonomy, and strict rules. We outline a property layer inspired by a Property Specification Language (PSL) for state and temporal requirements and discuss its integration into a raising process.

AI.tldr: 提出"形式化养育"(FR)：将选定的道德价值表示为显式、机器可检验的属性，贯穿发展、评估与动作选择全程，并给出基于C的动作评估推理框架。
AI.motivation: 受图灵"儿童机器"构想与近期"模型养育"工作启发，主张道德价值应与能力获取同步，而非仅在事后对齐阶段追加。
AI.method: 将选定的道德价值形式化为可机器检验的属性；构建C语言推理框架，对候选动作按优先级道德属性进行评估；冲突按给定序解决，严格规则不可推翻，欠定情况显式报告；例外不编码为特例而由备选比较涌现；并勾勒受PSL启发的状态与时序要求属性层及其与养育流程的集成。
AI.result: 通过覆盖生命、真减、伤害、隐私、自主性及严格规则的示例，演示了冲突处理与需求满足情况。
AI.conclusion: 显式、可检验的道德属性可参与模型开发全程并指导动作选择，为"养育式"价值获取提供了可操作的形式化基础，后续将属性层集成到养育流程中。

title: LLM-Based Evaluation Planning for Heterogeneous Optimization
summary: Heterogeneous optimization problems require an optimizer to decide not only which candidate solutions to evaluate, but also which objectives and constraints should be evaluated under different costs and fidelities. Existing SOTA methods such as MFE-NSGA-III address this setting with manually designed selection metrics, but their behavior is largely determined by predefined heuristic rules and hyperparameters. In this work, we propose REP-HO, a reasoning-based evaluation planner that replaces the rule-based mixed-fidelity selection step with a large language model (LLM) planner. The LLM receives the same primitive optimization-state information as the heuristic planner, such as surrogate predictions, uncertainties, evaluation costs, and budget status. We first show that REP-HO achieves competitive performance compared to the human-designed metric-based method (MFE-NSGA-III). We then further enhance each decision with an adaptive nearest-neighbor summary, leading to better and more stable results. We evaluate REP-HO across five heterogeneous regimes covering cost imbalance, constraint difficulty, surrogate fidelity, budget level, and objective conflict. Across these regimes, one of the two variants obtains the best mean ranking score in every regime, REP-HO(Deepseek) is first or second throughout, and the planner shows adaptive allocation behavior, such as prioritizing constraint evaluations under tighter budgets and reallocating constraint evaluation budget when surrogate reliability changes. These results suggest that LLMs can serve as flexible evaluation planners for heterogeneous optimization, offering a general alternative to fixed hand-designed metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出REP-HO，用LLM替代基于规则的混合保真度选择步骤，作为异质优化中的评估规划器，性能与MFE-NSGA-III相当，加入自适应近邻摘要后更优更稳定。
AI.motivation: 异质优化问题中，优化器需在成本与保真度不同的情况下决定评估哪些候选解、目标与约束。现有SOTA方法（如MFE-NSGA-III）依赖人工设计的规则与超参数，行为由预设启发式主导，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: REP-HO以LLM作为推理式评估规划器，输入与启发式规划器相同的原始优化状态信息（代理模型预测、不确定性、评估成本、预算状态等），替代规则式混合保真度选择；并引入自适应最近邻摘要增强每个决策。
AI.result: 在涵盖成本失衡、约束难度、代理保真度、预算水平和目标冲突的五种异质场景中，两个变体均在每种场景获得最佳平均排名分数，REP-HO(Deepseek)始终位列前二；规划器表现出自适应分配行为，如预算紧张时优先评估约束、代理可靠性变化时重新分配约束评估预算。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为异质优化中灵活的评估规划器，为固定手工设计指标提供通用替代方案。

title: Bud ContextCompact 2.0: Context Compaction for Agent Success and Accuracy with Small Language Models and Constrained Context Windows
summary: Agents that work for many turns outgrow the context window of the model that serves them, and on small language models (SLMs) and constrained inference systems that window is small. Context compaction replaces older turns with a summary so a session can continue, but it is lossy, costs a model call, and can help or hurt depending on when it runs. We describe Bud ContextCompact 2.0, the compaction built into the Bud agent runtime, and evaluate it in two settings. On recall questions over recorded agent sessions, compaction to a 16K budget raised a 1.2B-parameter model's accuracy to 0.335, from 0.247 with truncation and 0.176 with its full 32K history (p < 0.001), and raised a 9B model from 0.515 (truncation) to 0.577 (p = 0.04). On 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks run end to end by a 27B reasoning model on a 49K-token window (556 graded sessions), compaction raised the resolve rate on long sessions from 41% to 53% (+12.3 points, 95% CI +1.6 to +23.0, McNemar p = 0.043), left short sessions unchanged, and used 13% fewer tokens per solved task at equal total cost. The main failure without compaction was not the history overflowing but a reasoning turn exhausting the room the history left. The gain has limits: it vanished under a 45-minute session budget, because each summary took a median of 161 s, and in a threshold study it appeared only when compaction triggered early enough to leave room. An 8B model submitted after about ten turns at 5-8K tokens and never needed compaction. We argue that the accuracy results transfer across hardware, including CPU inference, for an equivalent model and window, while the time cost scales with the hardware and must be budgeted for.

AI.tldr: 提出并评估 Bud ContextCompact 2.0 上下文压缩机制：在16K预算下将1.2B模型召回准确率从截断的0.247提升至0.335，长会话SWE-bench解决率从41%提升至53%，但收益受压缩触发时机与延迟预算制约。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体会话超出小模型与受限推理系统的上下文窗口；现有截断会丢失历史，而压缩有损、需额外模型调用，且效果依赖触发时机，需要系统评估其收益与边界。
AI.method: Bud agent runtime内置的上下文压缩（Bud ContextCompact 2.0）。两组实验：一是基于录制会话的召回问答，对比16K预算压缩、截断与完整32K历史（1.2B与9B模型）；二是100个SWE-bench Verified任务，由27B推理模型在49K窗口端到端运行（556个评分会话），并做阈值与时间预算研究。
AI.result: 召回任务：1.2B模型0.176（全历史）→0.247（截断）→0.335（压缩），p<0.001；9B模型0.515→0.577，p=0.04。SWE-bench：长会话解决率41%→53%（+12.3点，95% CI +1.6~+23.0，McNemar p=0.043），短会话无变化，每个已解决任务token减少13%、总成本持平。无压缩时主要失败原因是推理轮耗尽了历史剩余空间而非历史溢出。45分钟会话预算下增益消失（摘要中位耗时161s）；阈值研究显示仅当压缩足够早触发、留出空间时才有效；8B模型约10轮后即提交、从未需要压缩。
AI.conclusion: 上下文压缩在等效模型与窗口下具有跨硬件（含CPU推理）的可迁移准确率收益，但时间成本随硬件缩放，必须纳入预算；压缩应在留有空间的时机早期触发。

title: FlowMaker: From Tasks to Cost-Efficient Generative AI Workflow Deployments
summary: Generative AI workflows execute user tasks by composing sequences of LLM calls, where each call performs a sub-task (e.g., summarization or translation), forming a workflow. Executing such workflows requires decisions over workflow structure, model assignments, and deployment configurations, which jointly determine latency, cost, and accuracy under dynamic workloads and resource constraints. Existing systems optimize these decisions in isolation or fix them early, leading to suboptimal cost and goodput. We make two key observations. First, efficient serving requires jointly exploring all combinations of workflows, model choices, and deployment configurations under dynamic cluster state. Second, reuse of deployed LLMs is critical for reducing cost, but must be performed on-the-fly, as reuse depends on current load and resource availability. Together, these make selecting a workflow-variant-a combination of workflow, models, and deployment configuration-a time-critical problem. We present FlowMaker, which exposes a task-level interface and selects workflow-variants on behalf of users. To realize this, we design a constraint-guided load-aware pruning algorithm for fast, on-the-fly decisions. FlowMaker improves goodput by up to 10.14$\times$ and reduces cost by up to 2.77$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art baselines, including Murakkab.

AI.tldr: FlowMaker面向生成式AI工作流，通过联合选择工作流结构、模型与部署配置（workflow-variant）并在线复用已部署LLM，显著提升goodput并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 现有系统对工作流结构、模型分配和部署配置的决策是孤立优化或提前固定的，在动态负载和资源约束下导致成本与goodput次优；且LLM复用必须依赖当前负载与资源可用性做在线决策，使选择成为时间关键问题。
AI.method: 提出FlowMaker，暴露任务级接口并由系统代替用户选择workflow-variant；核心是约束引导、负载感知的剪枝算法，在动态集群状态下快速在线联合探索工作流、模型与部署配置的组合空间。
AI.result: 相比包括Murakkab在内的SOTA基线，goodput最高提升10.14倍，成本最高降低2.77倍。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化工作流结构、模型选择与部署配置并实现在线LLM复用，是提升生成式AI工作流服务效率、兼顾延迟、成本与准确性的有效路径。

title: When Empathy Misses the Goal: A Benchmark for Goal Displacement in LLM Advice
comment: Accepted for publication at the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Evaluations and Datasets Track
summary: Conversational large language models can respond with warmth and reassurance while failing to advance the user's stated goal. We conceptualize this failure as $\textbf{goal displacement}$, the substitution of persona-maintenance content for goal-relevant substance. To measure it, we introduce $\textbf{GDB}$ (Goal Displacement Benchmark), comprising 230 scenarios across nine domains and $4{,}134$ human-scored responses from 18 models. A $2 \times 2$ taxonomy crosses hard constraints with emotional distress, distinguishing failures to confront infeasible goals or combine empathy with practical guidance from reverse displacement, where unsolicited problem-solving replaces requested emotional support. A deletion-test rubric assesses whether substantive help remains after purely supportive sentences are removed. Independent raters achieve weighted $κ= 0.82$ against author scores for displacement severity. Trap displacement ranges from $0.0\%$ to $37.7\%$ and is strongly negatively correlated with Chatbot Arena Elo ($ρ= -0.706$, $n = 15$). Reverse displacement reaches $41.9\%$, including substantial rates in models with negligible trap displacement. A factorial probe supports a distinction from social sycophancy. Human-scored responses in the high-complexity, low-pressure condition exhibit $35.0\%$ sycophancy but $7.5\%$ displacement, with little association between the constructs. Matched OLMo-2 checkpoints show that mixed empathy-with-constraints displacement remains at $52.3\%$ after supervised fine-tuning and falls to $13.8\%$ after direct preference optimization. GDB provides a reproducible diagnostic of whether responses advance the operationalized user goal, supporting model comparison, post-training evaluation, and regression testing. We release the dataset, annotations, and rubric under CC-BY-4.0 and the evaluation code under MIT.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"目标位移"（goal displacement）概念，即模型以人格维持性内容替代目标相关实质，并引入GDB基准（9个领域230个场景、18个模型4,134条人工评分回复）进行度量。
AI.motivation: 对话大模型常以温暖和安抚性话语回应，却未能推进用户既定目标；作者将这种失败概念化为目标位移，并指出其与社交谄媚可能不同。
AI.method: 构建GDB基准：2×2分类法交叉"硬约束"与"情绪困扰"，区分未能直面不可行目标、未能将共情与实际指导结合，以及"反向位移"（以未经请求的问题解决替代所请求的情感支持）。采用删除测试评分准则，判断剔除纯支持性句子后是否仍保留实质帮助。进行独立评分者信度检验、与Chatbot Arena Elo的相关性分析、与社交谄媚的因子探针比较，以及匹配OLMo-2检查点的SFT与DPO对比。
AI.result: 独立评分者对位移严重度的加权κ=0.82。陷阱位移率0.0%–37.7%，与Chatbot Arena Elo强负相关（ρ=-0.706，n=15）。反向位移达41.9%，且在陷阱位移可忽略的模型中亦显著。高复杂度低压力条件下谄媚率为35.0%而位移仅7.5%，二者关联很弱。匹配OLMo-2检查点显示混合"共情+约束"位移在SFT后为52.3%，DPO后降至13.8%。
AI.conclusion: GDB提供了可复现的诊断工具，用于判断回复是否推进可操作化的用户目标，支持模型比较、后训练评估与回归测试；数据集与准则以CC-BY-4.0、评估代码以MIT发布。

title: RAFT: Redundancy-Aware Input Filtering for Temporal Graph Neural Network Training
summary: Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) have shown strong performance on dynamic graph learning tasks by continuously updating node memories from evolving interactions (i.e., events) and leveraging these memories for downstream predictions. As graphs grow rapidly in modern applications, training requires processing an increasing number of events; meanwhile, each event can update node memories used by later events, creating dependencies that constrain parallel execution and limit the benefits of additional computing resources. These costs motivate an upstream question: Are all events, and the dependencies they introduce, necessary for learning? We investigate this question through two roles of temporal events: prediction targets and historical events sampled as inputs. We observe that targets involving stable node memories tend to exhibit lower prediction loss, while filtering historical events associated with stable memories can retain similar training-loss trajectories in several evaluated settings. Together, these observations suggest an opportunity to identify input redundancy through changes in node memories. Building on this opportunity, we propose RAFT, a redundancy-aware input-filtering framework for TGNN training. RAFT tracks memory changes during training and uses them to guide two filters: a root-event filter removes selected prediction targets before training, and a support-event filter excludes selected historical context during sampling. Filtering inputs before their downstream preparation and processing reduces the work they trigger. Across three TGNN models and five datasets, RAFT reduces training inputs by 35.23% on average and up to 97.11%, while reducing recorded training time by up to 52.56\% with negligible changes to model precisions.

AI.tldr: RAFT：一种冗余感知的输入过滤框架，利用训练过程中的节点记忆变化识别并剔除冗余时序事件，最多减少97.11%训练输入、52.56%训练时间且精度几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 时序图神经网络（TGNN）需持续处理不断增长的交互（事件）并更新节点记忆，而事件间存在更新依赖，限制了并行性、削弱了额外算力的收益。因此作者追问：是否所有事件及其引入的依赖对学习都是必要的？
AI.method: 从事件的两类角色（预测目标、作为输入采样的历史事件）分析冗余：发现涉及稳定记忆的目标预测损失较低、过滤稳定记忆对应的历史事件仍能保持相近的训练损失轨迹。据此提出RAFT，跟踪训练中节点记忆的变化，设置两个过滤器：root-event filter在训练前剔除部分预测目标，support-event filter在采样时排除部分历史上下文，从而在输入准备与处理之前减少工作量。
AI.result: 在3种TGNN模型与5个数据集上，RAFT平均减少35.23%训练输入、最高97.11%，记录训练时间最多降低52.56%，模型精度变化可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 节点记忆变化可作为识别输入冗余的有效信号，基于该信号的输入过滤能在保持精度的前提下显著降低TGNN训练成本。

title: StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early
summary: Coding agents keep working on runs that will fail verification, and asking a frontier model to watch for this is expensive in its own right. We introduce StopLoss, a small external monitor that learns failure recognition from completed trajectories and their verifier outcomes. The name is inspired by the stop-loss order in finance: StopLoss ends a run early when the run is likely to fail, which saves resources. Final outcomes label earlier local windows, so a fine-tuned language model can score the most recent tool steps in a single forward pass, and a threshold calibrated on successful runs turns that score into an abort decision without changing the executor. Trained on GPT-family SWE-rebench trajectories and evaluated on SWE-bench Verified and a SWE-bench Pro subset with GPT and Claude executors, StopLoss is compared against six general-purpose judges reading identical windows. Outcome supervision lifts failure prediction from near chance to a useful signal at the first check, at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost per check than any tested judge. This translates into savings: relative to completing every task, StopLoss lowers cost per retained solve by 4.5\% on Verified while preserving 99\% of successful runs, and by up to 31\% on the costlier Pro subset, reaching 48\% with a Qwen3-8B backbone, and in all four settings its cost per retained solve is below that of every judge policy. Outcome-trained small monitors can make failure recognition cheap enough for early stopping to pay for itself.

AI.tldr: 提出小型外部监控器 StopLoss，从已完成的轨迹及其验证结果中学习失败识别，在运行时单次前向打分最近工具步并以校准阈值决定提前终止，低成本地止损无效运行。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体常继续运行注定无法通过验证的任务，而用前沿大模型充当监控者本身开销高昂，因此需要一种廉价的失败识别与早期终止机制来节省资源。
AI.method: 用最终结果对先前的局部窗口打标签，微调语言模型对最近工具步进行单次前向打分；在成功运行上校准阈值，将分数转为中止决策且不改变执行器；在 GPT 系列 SWE-rebench 轨迹上训练，于 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-bench Pro 子集上以 GPT/Claude 执行器评测，并与六个通用评审模型对比。
AI.result: 结果监督使首次检查的失败预测从接近随机提升为有效信号，每次检查成本比所有被测评审低一至两个数量级；相对完成所有任务，Verified 上每次保留求解成本降低 4.5% 且保留 99% 成功运行，Pro 子集最高降低 31%，以 Qwen3-8B 为骨干可达 48%，四种设置下成本均低于所有评审策略。
AI.conclusion: 由结果训练的小型监控器能使失败识别足够廉价，从而使提前停止在成本上自给自足。

title: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with General Utilities via Neural Dual Critics
summary: Reinforcement learning with general utilities optimizes nonlinear functionals of policy-induced occupancy measures. We develop a natural actor-critic method for concave RLGU objectives admitting an exact variational dual representation, with explicit constructions for a broad class of separable occupancy utilities. Rather than estimating the occupancy measure and then forming the policy-gradient pseudo-reward, our method learns this pseudo-reward directly as a function of the state-action pair using a neural critic. The critic is trained by projected stochastic updates, while multilevel Monte Carlo combines outputs across training horizons to control its bias at logarithmic expected cost. Our analysis separates conditional actor bias from estimator second moments and accounts explicitly for dual optimization, critic approximation, and neural linearization errors. Under policy-transfer, dual-stability, and local critic-regularity conditions, the method achieves $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ global convergence above policy, critic-class, and finite-width approximation errors using $\widetilde{O}(T)$ expected environment transitions and reference samples. For a fixed critic representation, this yields $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ sampling complexity above the approximation floor, covering infinite state-action spaces and occupancy utilities beyond fixed finite vectors of returns.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向凹型“通用效用强化学习”(RLGU)的自然 actor-critic 方法：用神经网络 critic 直接学习变分对偶表示中的策略梯度伪奖励，配合投影随机更新与多层蒙特卡洛控制偏差，在策略迁移、对偶稳定性与局部 critic 正则条件下取得 Õ(T^{-1/2}) 全局收敛与 Õ(ε^{-2}) 采样复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统 RL 只优化回报的线性期望，RLGU 需优化占用测度的非线性泛函，现有方法通常先估计占用测度再构造策略梯度伪奖励，存在估计误差累积、难以扩展到无限状态-动作空间与非有限维效用（如超出收益向量的固定有限维情形）的问题。
AI.method: 针对具有精确变分对偶表示的凹型 RLGU 目标（对一大类可分离占用效用给出显式构造），不显式估计占用测度，而是用神经 critic 直接以状态-动作对为输入学习伪奖励；critic 通过投影随机更新训练，并用多层蒙特卡洛（MLMC）跨训练时域组合输出以对数期望代价控制偏差；理论分析将对偶优化、critic 逼近与神经线性化误差同条件 actor 偏差、估计量二阶矩分离处理。
AI.result: 在策略迁移、对偶稳定性与局部 critic 正则性条件下，方法在策略类、critic 类与有限宽度逼近误差之上达到 Õ(T^{-1/2}) 全局收敛，期望环境转移与参考样本数为 Õ(T)；对固定 critic 表示，在逼近误差下限之上获得 Õ(ε^{-2}) 采样复杂度，覆盖无限状态-动作空间及超出固定有限收益向量类的占用效用。
AI.conclusion: 直接学习变分对偶伪奖励、并以 MLMC 控制 critic 偏差，是求解凹型 RLGU 的有效且可分析路径，可在一般占用效用与无限状态空间下获得接近无模型 RL 标准的收敛与采样复杂度，且误差来源被清晰分解。

title: From Clinical Risk Prediction to Operational Decisions: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for ICU Staffing
comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026, Applied Data Science Track
summary:
Advances in electronic health records (EHR) and large-scale critical care databases have enabled the development of machine learning models for the early detection of patient deterioration. While these models often achieve strong predictive performance for outcomes such as sepsis and mortality, most studies evaluate them purely on discrimination metrics. This leaves a critical gap: how to systematically translate probabilistic clinical risk estimates into downstream operational decisions under real-world constraints, such as shift rigidity and hiring delays.
  This study proposes an uncertainty-aware anticipatory staffing framework that bridges short-term patient risk prediction and staff planning without altering the upstream predictive model. Instead of relying on naive deterministic aggregation or fixed safety buffers, the framework explicitly models dynamic predictive uncertainty and evaluates extreme shortage exposure using Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). These aggregated, risk-calibrated demand signals are then embedded into an hourly rolling-horizon scheduling policy to generate delay-constrained staffing decisions.
  Evaluated on realistic trajectories from the MIMIC-IV database, the proposed framework demonstrates a favorable cost-shortage trade-off compared to deterministic and purely reactive baselines. Pareto frontier analysis illustrates how uncertainty-aware demand construction changes resource allocation under varying safety preferences, while stress testing confirms the framework's operational robustness even when subjected to systematic predictive bias in the form of calibration drift. By formalizing this translation layer, this work provides a principled, transparent pathway for safely integrating probabilistic AI outputs into high-stakes healthcare operational systems.

AI.tldr: 提出不确定性感知的预见性排班框架，将患者风险预测的原始概率经CVaR聚合为风险校准的需求信号，嵌入小时级滚动时域排班策略，在延迟与班次刚性约束下生成人力决策。
AI.motivation: 现有EHR/重症数据库机器学习模型多以判别指标评估（如脓毒症、死亡率），缺乏从概率风险到实际运营决策的系统性转换方法，且真实约束（班次刚性、招聘延迟）常被忽略。
AI.method: 不改动上游预测模型；显式建模动态预测不确定性，用条件风险价值（CVaR）刻画极端短缺暴露，将聚合的需求信号嵌入小时级滚动时域调度策略，产生延迟受限的排班决策；以MIMIC-IV轨迹进行实验。
AI.result: 与确定性聚合及纯被动反应基线相比，成本—短缺权衡更优；帕累托前沿分析显示不确定性感知的需求构建会随安全偏好改变资源分配；在校准漂移导致的系统性预测偏差压力测试下仍保持运营鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过形式化"翻译层"，为将概率性AI输出安全融入高风险医疗运营系统提供了有原则、可透明的路径。

title: Distribution-Based Regularization for Reward Fine-Tuning Diffusion and Flow Models
summary: Reward fine-tuning is an effective way to adapt pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models to downstream objectives, but aggressive optimization often leads to mode collapse and distributional drift. Existing methods attempt to control this drift with reverse-KL regularization, implemented as an $\ell_2$ penalty on the velocity field; however, this functions by indirectly constraining sampling dynamics rather than directly acting on the generated distribution. To address this, we propose DFR (Distributional Functional Rewards), which augments the task reward with a distribution-dependent, per-sample reward that acts explicitly on the generated distribution. Formally, we generalize the KL-regularized objective from expected rewards, which are linear in the model's distribution, to convex functionals of it. The first variation of this objective defines an effective, distribution-dependent reward that directly penalizes deviation from the pretrained distribution. This formulation yields additive per-sample rewards for the Fréchet distance (FD), maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), and DreamSim diversity, recovering several recently proposed rewards as special cases. Across various text-to-image fine-tuning tasks, DFR matches the peak reward of KL-tuned baselines while increasing diversity by up to 29% at equal or lower drift.

AI.tldr: 提出DFR（分布泛函奖励），把KL正则目标从期望奖励推广到分布的凸泛函，用其一阶变分定义依赖分布的逐样本有效奖励，直接惩罚对预训练分布的偏离，在文生图微调中达到基线峰值奖励且多样性提升最多29%。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流匹配模型的奖励微调易导致模式坍塌与分布漂移；现有方法用reverse-KL并以速度场的ℓ2惩罚实现，只是间接约束采样动力学，未直接作用于生成分布。
AI.method: 将KL正则目标从对模型分布线性的期望奖励推广为分布的凸泛函；该目标的一阶变分给出依赖分布的有效奖励，直接惩罚偏离预训练分布。该形式对Fréchet距离、MMD与DreamSim多样性均产生可加的逐样本奖励，并将若干近期提出的奖励作为特例纳入统一框架。
AI.result: 在多项文生图微调任务上，DFR在同等或更低漂移下达到KL调参基线的峰值奖励，同时多样性最多提升29%。
AI.conclusion: 以分布泛函及其一阶变分构造的逐样本奖励为控制奖励微调中的分布漂移提供了直接且统一的原理性框架，兼顾奖励与多样性。

title: Auditing Tool Traces in Agentic LLMs: Source Localization and Counterfactual Dependence Testing
comment: 12 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
summary: Agentic LLMs increasingly support scientific prediction by grounding decisions in external evidence. In biology, they promise accurate, interpretable predictions for important problems by integrating complex experimental and computational evidence. However, serialized tool results can contain hidden label shortcuts, such as dataset identifiers or template artifacts, that create apparent success without biological reasoning. To address this risk, we introduce a two-stage audit. Stage 1, Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition (PT2D), localizes label-predictive patterns to individual tool results while avoiding signal dilution in the concatenated tool trace. Stage 2, Token-Class Redaction, counterfactually tests whether the frozen LLM depends on the localized shortcut. We apply this audit to TCR-pMHC binding, where tool augmentation substantially outperforms a no-evidence baseline. At face value, this suggests that the LLM has learned to use scientific evidence. The audit overturns this interpretation: PT2D localizes the strongest signal to identifiers in one tool result, and redacting them reduces performance to chance. These findings show how hidden label shortcuts can masquerade as scientific reasoning or discovery, motivating source-level audits before benchmark gains are trusted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段审计方法（PT2D + Token-Class Redaction），揭示智能体LLM在TCR-pMHC结合预测中的性能提升实为工具结果中的隐藏标签捷径所致，而非科学推理。
AI.motivation: 智能体LLM通过外部工具证据支持科学预测，在生物学等任务中表面性能优异，但序列化的工具结果可能含数据集标识符、模板痕迹等隐藏标签捷径，导致"伪成功"。现有评估无法定位此类捷径来源。
AI.method: 两阶段审计：阶段一PT2D（Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition）将标签预测性模式定位到单个工具结果，避免拼接轨迹中的信号稀释；阶段二Token-Class Redaction对定位出的捷径做反事实测试，检验冻结LLM是否依赖该捷径。应用于TCR-pMHC结合预测任务。
AI.result: 工具增强显著优于无证据基线，表面显示LLM利用了科学证据；但审计推翻该解释——PT2D将最强信号定位于某一工具结果中的标识符，将其遮蔽后性能降至随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏标签捷径可伪装成科学推理或发现，在信任基准提升之前应进行来源级审计。

title: A Symmetry-Matching Approach to Blind-Spot Reduction in Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Language models can treat semantically distinct inputs as interchangeable at the representation level, creating blind spots that standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not target. In safety-critical settings such as clinical dosage extraction, legal clause interpretation, or financial amount verification, such failures can propagate silently into downstream decisions. We study this problem as one of feature-basis orientation. Building on a symmetry-matching view from algebraic error-detection theory, we add a differentiable $V_{\mathrm{Gini}}$ regularisation term to SAE training that penalises uneven perturbation response within a specified family. Across GPT-2, Gemma 2, and Qwen 2.5, a frozen multi-seed evaluation shows that $V$-regularisation raises both relative and absolute lower-tail responses while reducing response-profile imbalance, with no material general-text reconstruction degradation. JumpReLU and minimum description length (MDL) objectives remain close to the Standard SAE profile under the same protocol. Family-geometry controls show that the effect is not explained by template duplication or a single dominant perturbation family, and held-out probes plus null-calibrated separation tests evaluate how far the representation-level change carries to downstream discriminability. A zero-shot audit on out-of-distribution clinical radiology minimal pairs finds the relative weak-tail lift in all evaluated model-by-family cells, not perfectly rank-aligned with the trained statistic, and a held-out family audit finds it on family kinds never used in training. Together, the results show that perturbation-aware SAE training can reorient feature bases toward safety-relevant input changes while leaving downstream validation as a separate empirical step.

AI.tldr: 论文将"语义不同输入在表征层被当作可互换"的问题形式化为特征基定向问题，提出在SAE训练中加入可微的$V_{\mathrm{Gini}}$正则项以惩罚指定扰动族内不均衡的响应，从而抬升弱尾敏感性。
AI.motivation: 标准稀疏自编码器（SAE）目标不针对"语义不同但表征可互换"的盲点；在临床剂量抽取、法律条款解释、金融金额核验等安全关键场景中，此类失败会静默传播至下游决策。作者从代数纠错理论中的对称匹配视角切入，试图让特征基朝向安全相关的输入变化重新定向。
AI.method: 在SAE训练中加入可微的$V_{\mathrm{Gini}}$正则项，惩罚指定扰动族（family）内不均衡的扰动响应；在GPT-2、Gemma 2、Qwen 2.5上以冻结的多随机种子协议评估，并与JumpReLU、MDL（最小描述长度）目标对照；辅以族几何控制（排除模板复制与单一主导扰动族的解释）、留出探针与零校准分离检验，以及分布外临床影像最小对比对的零样本审计和留出族审计。
AI.result: $V$正则化同时提升相对与绝对下尾响应并降低响应谱不均衡，通用文本重构无明显退化；JumpReLU与MDL在同一协议下仍接近标准SAE画像。族几何控制表明效应不能由模板复制或单一主导扰动族解释。零样本审计在所有"模型×族"单元中均观察到相对弱尾提升，但其排序与训练统计量并非完全一致；留出族审计在训练中未使用的族类型上同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 扰动感知的SAE训练可将特征基重新定向至安全相关的输入变化，但下游可判别性提升仍需作为独立的经验验证步骤，不能由表征层指标直接推得。

title: Editing as Language: Teaching LLM Agents a Grammar for Native Context Editing
summary: A synopsis in novels folds a story into a few lines; a function in code gathers many steps with a single execution. Context editing is native to language itself. In this paper, we propose the Native Context Editing (NCE) framework, which gives language model agents a grammar for natively editing their own context. By encoding context-editing operations in a grammar of dedicated special tokens, we teach the agents to invoke edits through the language itself. We train agents on iteratively constructed trajectory segments, with each teacher edit conditioned on the evolving context. This establishes context editing as an atomic and inherent capability of LLM agents, enabling them to dynamically modify their context as they generate responses over long-horizon reasoning and interaction. Compared with context-editing methods that learn to generate tool-use code within specific external harness environments, our approach integrates context editing as an internal mechanism of the model's native generation process, enabling better generalization across diverse real-world workflows. On four long-horizon agentic benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro), NCE improves the average task success rate over the base model by 5.6 percentage points for LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse and by 4.5 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, while reducing average token usage by 36% and 15%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出Native Context Editing (NCE)框架，用专用特殊token的语法将上下文编辑内化为LLM智能体的原生生成能力，在四个长程智能体基准上平均成功率提升5.6/4.5个百分点，token消耗降低36%/15%。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文编辑方法依赖在特定外部工具环境中生成工具调用代码，与模型原生生成过程割裂，跨真实工作流的泛化性差；作者希望把上下文编辑变成语言模型内部的原子能力。
AI.method: 将上下文编辑操作编码为一套专用特殊token构成的语法，使智能体通过语言本身调用编辑；在迭代构建的轨迹片段上训练，每次教师编辑以演化中的上下文为条件，从而把上下文编辑确立为原子且内生的能力。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Multilingual、SWE-bench Pro四个长程智能体基准上，LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse平均任务成功率较基座提升5.6个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B-A3B提升4.5个百分点，平均token用量分别降低36%和15%。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文编辑内化为模型原生生成机制，而非外部工具调用代码，可获得更好的跨工作流泛化，并在提升长程任务成功率的同时显著节省token。

title: Arctic-SWE: Revisiting the Long Horizon Agent Training by Modeling-System Co-Design
summary: Long-horizon agent training, including software engineering, is advancing rapidly, but the recipe and infrastructure needed for a strong reinforcement-learning baseline remain difficult to reproduce. This makes gains from new algorithms or data hard to distinguish from improvements to an under-tuned baseline. We present Arctic-SWE, a fully asynchronous RL framework that establishes such a baseline through model-system co-design, using overfitting on a small task pool as the testbed. This testbed exposes failures that early reward gains conceal and guides the integration of established components: gated reward, importance-weight control, aligned training and inference engines, and consistent state across policy updates. No single component is new, yet together they form the missing foundation. On raw R2E-Gym data, without new algorithms or data work, Arctic-SWE trains Qwen3.5-4B to 62.0% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified. This is comparable to concurrent FrogNano (61.5%), which relies on online task synthesis, after about one-sixth as many training rollouts. Building on this foundation, we further filter and refine R2E-Gym, SWE-rebench V2, and Scale-SWE. With this curated subset, the 4B model improves from 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% to 65.0%/38.3%/59.7% on SWE-bench Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2, and the recipe also improves Qwen3.5-9B from 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% to 65.7%/39.6%/70.2% on Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2. Controlled comparisons show that both curation and test strengthening improve held-out performance, although stronger tests reduce apparent training-task mastery. Arctic-SWE provides a documented starting point for studying better algorithms, data and environments for asynchronous agent RL.

AI.tldr: Arctic-SWE是一个完全异步的软件工程智能体强化学习框架，通过模型-系统协同设计，在不引入新算法和新数据的前提下，用原始R2E-Gym数据将Qwen3.5-4B在SWE-bench Verified上的pass@1提升至62.0%，并以约六分之一的训练rollout数比肩依赖在线任务合成的FrogNano（61.5%）。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体训练（尤其软件工程）发展迅速，但强基线所需的配方与基础设施难以复现，导致新算法或数据带来的增益无法与"基线调优不足"带来的提升相区分。作者希望建立一个可复现、充分调优的RL基线，作为后续研究的可靠起点。
AI.method: 采用模型-系统协同设计，构建全异步RL框架，并以"小任务池过拟合"作为测试床来暴露早期奖励增益所掩盖的失败；集成门控奖励（gated reward）、重要性权重控制、训练与推理引擎对齐以及策略更新间状态一致性等既有组件；在此基础上对R2E-Gym、SWE-rebench V2、Scale-SWE进行筛选与精炼，并做受控对比。
AI.result: 原始R2E-Gym下Qwen3.5-4B达SWE-bench Verified 62.0% pass@1，与FrogNano（61.5%）相当但训练rollout约为其1/6；使用精炼子集后，4B模型在Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2上由47.4%/25.0%/37.9%提升至65.0%/38.3%/59.7%，9B模型由56.2%/31.9%/48.8%提升至65.7%/39.6%/70.2%。受控对比表明数据精炼与测试强化均提升held-out性能，但更强测试会降低训练任务上的表观掌握度。
AI.conclusion: Arctic-SWE为异步智能体强化学习提供了有文档记录的基线起点：四个既有组件的组合构成了缺失的基础，数据精炼与测试强化对泛化均有贡献，可用于进一步研究更优算法、数据与环境。

title: Symbolic Constraint Agents: Mining Formal Tool-Call Constraints to Prevent Agent Errors
summary: Symbolic constraints (programmatic, deterministic checks for tool calls) enable deterministic verification of LLM agents' tool calls, but existing approaches primarily enforce predefined safety policies rather than tool dependencies in complex tool environments. We explore whether symbolic constraints can be mined from environments and observations beyond predefined policies, and whether they can improve end-to-end task performance. We present Symbolic Constraint Agents (SCA), a framework that mines symbolic constraints from API documentation, refines them against execution traces, and checks the agent's tool calls with an SMT solver at runtime. A violation triggers a natural-language warning or, when the valid replacement is uniquely determined, an automatic repair. On AppWorld, refinement raises error-detection F1 from 37.0 to 58.3 on GPT-5.5 traces and from 39.3 to 61.9 on Qwen3.5-27B traces. At runtime, repair raises GPT-5.4-mini's task success by 5.4 points under a 40-call budget and 9.8 points when environment errors are hidden, while removing 59--87\% of failed calls across models, and transfers to $τ^2$-bench with gains of up to 5.6 points. These findings show that automatically acquired symbolic constraints can improve tool-calling reliability and task completion, particularly when failures are costly or difficult to diagnose.

AI.tldr: SCA框架从API文档中挖掘符号约束、用执行轨迹精炼、运行时用SMT求解器校验并警告或自动修复工具调用，显著提升错误检测F1与任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有符号约束方法主要用于执行预定义安全策略，而非复杂工具环境中的工具依赖关系；作者希望验证两点：能否从环境与观测中自动挖掘约束，以及这些约束能否提升端到端任务性能。
AI.method: 提出Symbolic Constraint Agents（SCA）：①从API文档挖掘符号约束；②基于执行轨迹对约束进行精炼；③运行时用SMT求解器检查智能体工具调用，违规时触发自然语言警告，或当有效替换唯一确定时执行自动修复。
AI.result: AppWorld上，精炼使错误检测F1从37.0提升至58.3（GPT-5.5轨迹）、从39.3提升至61.9（Qwen3.5-27B轨迹）；运行时修复使GPT-5.4-mini在40次调用预算下任务成功率提升5.4个百分点，隐藏环境错误时提升9.8个百分点；跨模型消除59–87%的失败调用，并迁移至τ²-bench取得最高5.6个百分点增益。
AI.conclusion: 自动获取的符号约束可提升工具调用的可靠性与任务完成度，尤其在失败代价高或难以诊断的场景中效果更为显著。

title: CARTA: Self-Supervised Reusable Transaction Embeddings via Heterogeneous Tokenization and Cross-Attention
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at ICAIF '26 (7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance), Milan, Italy, November 14-17, 2026
summary: Acquiring fraud labels for payment transactions is expensive and inconsistent across tasks, and high-cardinality identifiers such as merchant names make one-hot feature pipelines infeasible at scale. We present CARTA, a self-supervised encoder that learns a compact 16-dim embedding from raw transactions without labels; the frozen embedding is then reused for label-efficient fraud probing and exploratory unsupervised risk stratification without retraining the encoder. CARTA uses type-specific projections with learned embedding tables for high-cardinality identifiers, trained with token excision and InfoNCE contrastive loss. On IEEE-CIS, its linear probe at 1% of labels exceeds a raw-feature probe at 100%; on IBM TabFormer (2M rows), its frozen embedding reaches GBDT AUPRC 0.508, above frequency encoding (0.411) and the merchant-dropping baseline (0.022), though fully-supervised CatBoost is stronger. CARTA is a label-free, reusable representation that complements task-specific supervised models.

AI.tldr: CARTA是一种自监督编码器，从无标签原始交易中学习16维紧凑嵌入，冻结后复用于标签高效的欺诈探测和探索性风险分层，无需重训编码器。
AI.motivation: 支付交易欺诈标签获取成本高且跨任务不一致；商户名等高基数标识符使one-hot特征流水线在规模化场景下不可行。
AI.method: 采用类型特定投影，为高基数标识符引入可学习嵌入表，并以token剔除（token excision）和InfoNCE对比损失进行自监督训练。
AI.result: IEEE-CIS上，1%标签的线性探针超过100%标签的原始特征探针；IBM TabFormer（200万行）上冻结嵌入的GBDT AUPRC达0.508，高于频率编码（0.411）与剔除商户基线（0.022），但弱于全监督CatBoost。
AI.conclusion: CARTA是一种无标签、可复用的表示，可补充任务特定的监督模型。

title: Narrow Decision Models: A System-1 Architecture for Calibrated, Typed Decisions
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. A first training on real documents is summarized; full results on real data in production are left to a companion paper
summary: System One models, introduced with TypeSafe's Jev, answer typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities instead of generated text: choosing among options described in natural language (Choice), placing the state on an ordered scale (Score), or judging a yes/no statement (Noul). Jev is general-purpose: one set of weights, served as an API and adapted to a domain only through the request. We study the other end of the design space. A Narrow Decision Model (NDM) offers the same interface but is trained for the decisions of one organization, is small enough to run on its own infrastructure, and has an open architecture whose properties can be stated and tested. The state can be any text or structured record about which decisions are made; our running case is the routing of court communications. The architecture serializes a request as a prefix tree (the state, then each question, then each option) and runs a bidirectional encoder under a block attention mask with logical positions, so that each answer is, by construction, invariant to the order of its options and independent of the other questions asked. Routing through an organization chart is a composition of Choice decisions with an explicit "none of these" option. We describe training with proper scoring rules through a curriculum, calibration and abstention, decisions composed by rubrics, and a protocol that accepts or rejects the mechanism before held-out data is opened. A minimal validation on public and fictitious data shows that the invariances hold to rounding in a trained model, that a small instance routes on organization charts it has never seen well above lexical retrieval, and that, at equal compute, the block architecture reaches a lower loss than a pairwise cross-encoder. A first instance trained on real legal documents agrees with the LLM classifier in production on 91% of held-out documents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出窄域决策模型（NDM）：与通用System One接口一致（Choice/Score/Noel），但针对单一组织的决策训练、可本地部署、架构开放可检验。以法院通讯路由为案例，将请求序列化为前缀树并施加块注意力掩码与逻辑位置，使答案天然对选项顺序不变、且与其他问题独立。
AI.motivation: 现有System One类模型（如Jev）是通用型的：一套权重、以API提供、仅通过请求适配领域。作者希望探索设计空间的另一端——为特定组织的决策专门训练的小型模型，可运行于自有基础设施，且架构开放、属性可陈述与可测试。运行案例为法院通讯的路由决策。
AI.method: 架构将请求序列化为前缀树（状态→每个问题→每个选项），在块注意力掩码与逻辑位置下运行双向编码器，由构造保证答案对选项顺序不变且独立于其他问题；组织图路由以Choice决策组合，并设显式“以上皆非”选项。训练采用恰当评分规则（proper scoring rules）+课程学习，配合校准与弃答、基于rubric的组合决策，以及在打开留出数据前接受/拒绝机制的协议。
AI.result: 在公开与虚构数据上的最小验证显示：训练后模型的不变性达到舍入精度；小规模实例能在未见过的组织图上路由，显著优于词法检索；同等算力下块架构损失低于成对交叉编码器；首个在真实法律文件上训练的实例在生产留出文档上与LLM分类器一致率91%。
AI.conclusion: NDM表明专用、可自托管、架构可验证的窄域决策模型在保持统一类型化接口的同时具备可行性：不变性可由构造保证，组合式Choice路由泛化良好，且精度可与生产LLM分类器相当，为组织内部可信决策提供了一种替代通用模型的路径。

title: TrustAgent-RFF: Agentic Diagnostic Planning for Reliable RF Fingerprinting under Domain Shift
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to INFOCOM
summary: Radio frequency fingerprinting (RFF) models can achieve accuracy under source domain conditions but become unreliable when the receiver, distance, collection day, or environment changes. Incorrect predictions in unseen domains may receive high softmax confidence, making confidence thresholding insufficient for trustworthy deployment. We propose TrustAgent-RFF, a prediction level reliability framework for RFF that operates with a frozen in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) classifier without target domain labels. For each device prediction, the framework acquires radio frequency evidence: counterfactual stability, prototype consistency, acquisition domain similarity, and signal quality. A source calibrated trust estimator combines these diagnostics with classifier confidence, prediction margin, and evidence availability indicators. Source derived lower tail penalties and cross module interactions reduce trust when diagnostic signals indicate weak support. A large language model (LLM) based planner adaptively selects the next diagnostic action based on evidence, trust state, action costs, and remaining budget. A deterministic source calibrated decision layer updates the prediction state as Accept, Reject, or Defer. Experiments across five RFF datasets and classifier backbones reveal an average source to target accuracy drop of 38.7% and show that many incorrect target domain predictions remain highly confident.

AI.tldr: 提出 TrustAgent-RFF：面向射频指纹（RFF）的无目标标签、预测级可靠性框架，在冻结 I/Q 分类器上通过反事实稳定性、原型一致性、采集域相似度与信号质量等证据，配合源域校准的信任估计器与 LLM 规划器，输出 Accept/Reject/Defer 决策；五个数据集实验显示源到目标平均精度下降 38.7%，且大量错误预测仍具高置信度。
AI.motivation: RFF 模型仅在源域条件下准确，接收机、距离、采集日或环境变化后不可靠；且未见域中的错误预测常伴随高 softmax 置信度，使置信度阈值化不足以支撑可信部署。故需在无目标标签下提供预测级可靠性判断。
AI.method: 1) 冻结 I/Q 分类器，不访问目标域标签；2) 对每个设备预测采集证据：反事实稳定性、原型一致性、采集域相似度、信号质量；3) 源域校准的信任估计器融合上述诊断量与分类器置信度、预测间隔（margin）、证据可用性指标；4) 引入源域推导的下尾惩罚与跨模块交互，在诊断支持薄弱时降低信任；5) 基于 LLM 的规划器依据证据、信任状态、动作成本与剩余预算自适应选择下一诊断动作；6) 确定性源域校准决策层输出 Accept/Reject/Defer。
AI.result: 在五个 RFF 数据集与多种分类器骨干上实验，平均源到目标精度下降 38.7%；并发现在目标域中大量错误预测仍保持高置信度，验证了仅依赖 softmax 置信度的阈值方法失效。
AI.conclusion: 预测级、证据驱动的信任评估与自适应诊断规划，可在不依赖目标标签的前提下缓解 RFF 跨域可靠性问题，并为 Accept/Reject/Defer 的可信部署提供可行路径。（摘要未给出决策层在拒识/延迟后的风险-覆盖率定量收益，需见正文。）

title: Learning Which Device to Call: Online Tool Grounding for LLM Agents in IoT
summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) gives large language model (LLM) agents access to physical observations, but one requested capability is usually offered by several devices, and the agent's plan does not say which one to call. Existing work retrieves relevant tools and checks plan feasibility, without learning which eligible device returns a useful observation. Unlike previous works, we study online tool grounding: binding an already specified tool call to one physical endpoint under service cost and device participation constraints. We propose a framework that learns which physical device should execute each agent-issued call. It formulates selection as a contextual bandit problem and combines adaptive context partitions with hierarchical endpoint trees, so that execution feedback is reused across related requests and devices. Selection balances task success against service cost while respecting device capability, authorization, battery reserves, and availability. Gaussian reward aggregation provides an optional mechanism for protecting individual feedback values. Theoretical results establish a finite-horizon regret bound and differential privacy for released reward statistics under fixed, reward-independent assignments. In a simulated loading-dock workload, the proposed router achieves higher step success and better cost-adjusted service, at lower simulated device energy and latency, than nearest-device, advertised-quality, UCB1, and LinUCB selection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究物联网中LLM智能体工具调用的"在线工具接地"问题：在服务成本与设备参与约束下，将已确定的工具调用绑定到具体物理设备上。方法将设备选择建模为上下文赌博机，结合自适应上下文划分与层级端点树实现反馈复用，并给出遗憾界与差分隐私保证。仿真中优于最近设备、广告质量、UCB1与LinUCB基线。
AI.motivation: IoT为LLM智能体提供物理观测能力，但同一能力往往由多个设备提供，而智能体计划本身不指明调用哪一个。已有工作仅检索相关工具并检验计划可行性，未学习"哪个合格设备能返回有用观测"，即缺少对工具调用到物理端点绑定的在线学习。
AI.method: 将端点选择形式化为上下文赌博机问题；采用自适应上下文划分与层级端点树相结合的结构，使执行反馈可在相关请求与设备之间复用；优化目标在任务成功率与服务成本之间权衡，同时满足设备能力、授权、电量储备与可用性等约束；可选地用高斯奖励聚合机制保护个体反馈值；理论上在奖励无关的固定分配下给出有限时域遗憾界与奖励统计量的差分隐私。
AI.result: 在模拟的装卸码头（loading-dock）工作负载中，所提路由器相比最近设备、广告质量、UCB1与LinUCB选择策略，取得更高的单步成功率与更优的成本调整服务，同时模拟设备能耗与延迟更低。
AI.conclusion: 在线工具接地是可学习的问题：通过上下文赌博机与层级端点树的反馈复用，可在满足多维设备约束的前提下兼顾成功率与服务成本；理论保证（遗憾界、差分隐私）与仿真结果共同支持该方法作为LLM-IoT工具路由的可行方案，但验证仍限于模拟环境。

title: MLFont: Machine Learning-Driven Font Subsetting and Range-Compact Unicode-Range Slicing for Low-Latency Web Typography
summary:
CSS3 @font-face rules with unicode-range descriptors partition web fonts into downloadable slices. While Latin fonts need ~20 KB in WOFF2, Pan-European (LGC) and East Asian (CJK) fonts contain 2,297-30,759 codepoints (158 KB-5.9 MB in WOFF2), where heuristic partitioning causes unused-glyph downloads, high HTTP RTT, CSS bloat, or missing-glyph fallbacks. We present MLFont, a machine learning and optimization framework that learns font slicing strategies from corpora via three stages: (1) a Zipfian High-Frequency Tier (most) isolating top-frequency codepoints; (2) a Latent Co-Occurrence Topic Tier using Online Variational Bayes LDA (Online LDA) or a Deep Neural Network Topic Model (DNNTM) with Shannon Entropy Difference Loss and Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization; and (3) a Memetic Range-Compact Genetic Algorithm (GA) with Potts-Viterbi dynamic programming and island bridging that minimizes topic discrepancy and CSS fragmentation. Across five Google Noto fonts (LGC, KR, JP, TC, SC), MLFont cuts 3G per-glyph latency by 56.7%-75.3% over single-file delivery and 46.1%-66.3% over equal-bin baselines on CJK with 100% coverage, reduces CSS intervals by 17.9%-41.7%, and achieves 1.56x-6.09x cold-cache speedups (65.4%-84.9% CJK and 44.7% LGC bandwidth savings) across 20 websites in simulator and Headless Chrome benchmarks (45/45 exact slice-set parity).
  Code: https://github.com/wq2012/mlfont
  Models: https://huggingface.co/collections/wq2012/mlfont

AI.tldr: MLFont是一个机器学习与优化框架，通过Zipf高频层、潜在共现主题层（Online LDA/DNNTM）以及模因紧凑遗传算法（Potts-Viterbi动态规划+岛屿桥接）三阶段从语料中学习Web字体切片策略，在保持100%字形覆盖的前提下显著降低CJK/LGC字体的下载与延迟开销。
AI.motivation: CSS3 @font-face配合unicode-range可将Web字体切分为可下载分片，但Latin以外字体规模大：Pan-European(LGC)与东亚(CJK)字体含2,297–30,759个码点（WOFF2为158 KB–5.9 MB）。启发式切分会导致下载未使用字形、HTTP RTT高、CSS膨胀或字形缺失回退等问题，亟需数据驱动的最优切片方法。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：(1) Zipf高频层(mmost)，隔离最高频码点；(2) 潜在共现主题层，采用Online Variational Bayes LDA或深度神经网络主题模型(DNNTM)，引入香农熵差损失与Sinkhorn-Knopp归一化；(3) 模因式范围紧凑遗传算法(GA)，结合Potts-Viterbi动态规划与岛屿桥接，以最小化主题差异与CSS碎片化。
AI.result: 在五个Google Noto字体(LGC、KR、JP、TC、SC)上：相较单文件交付降低3G逐字形延迟56.7%–75.3%，相较等分箱基线在CJK上降低46.1%–66.3%，且保持100%覆盖；CSS区间数减少17.9%–41.7%；在20个网站的模拟器与Headless Chrome基准中实现1.56x–6.09x冷缓存加速（CJK带宽节省65.4%–84.9%，LGC节省44.7%），并达到45/45切片集完全一致性。
AI.conclusion: MLFont通过语料驱动学习生成的unicode-range切片策略，在保证字形全覆盖的同时兼顾延迟、带宽与CSS体积，优于启发式与等分箱方案，并已在模拟器与真实浏览器环境中验证一致性，具备实际部署价值（代码与模型已开源）。

title: Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness
comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, including references and appendices
summary: Completing complex tasks with language-model agents requires coordinating planning, execution, and review so the final result addresses the user's original objective. We present an agent execution harness that keeps the original objective separate from a revisable plan and an execution record. A planner assigns scoped tasks, workers produce outputs and artifacts, and a reviewer examines results against the original request before submitting or requesting additional work. Reusable domain-specific instructions guide these roles and are refined during construction using task inputs and execution trajectories, without official grading feedback. We evaluate complete harness configurations across terminal tasks, clinical responses, application building, and scientific questions. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, the harness passes 83 of 89 instances (93.26%); on HealthBench Professional, a Fable-configured system achieves a length-adjusted rubric score of 69.63 across 525 tasks. In a 53-task paired HealthBench comparison, the Fable-configured harness achieves an aggregate score 19.89 points higher than direct completion, despite a $-1.46$-point median task-level change; mean inference cost rises from \$0.29 to \$2.13 per task. We combine these outcomes with latency, documented instruction revisions, and reviewer decisions. Evaluating outcomes alongside execution trajectories and resource use clarifies how coordination supports task completion, where it introduces regressions, and at what cost.

AI.tldr: 提出一种语言模型智能体执行框架（execution harness），将原始目标、可修订计划与执行记录分离；由planner、worker、reviewer三角色协作，并用可复用领域指令在构建期迭代精炼。在Terminal-Bench 2.1上89个实例通过83个（93.26%），HealthBench Professional长度为校正后得分69.63（525任务）；配对比较中聚合分提升19.89分，但任务级中位数变化为-1.46分，平均成本由$0.29升至$2.13。
AI.motivation: 复杂任务需要规划、执行与复核的协同，但现有单次补全难以保证最终结果仍对齐用户原始目标。作者希望将目标、计划与执行轨迹显式分离，并评估协同机制对完成率、回归与资源开销的影响。
AI.method: 设计并实现一个agent执行harness：planner负责划分有界子任务，worker产生输出与产物，reviewer依据原始请求审查结果后决定提交或追加工作。角色由可复用的领域专用指令驱动，这些指令在构建期间使用任务输入与执行轨迹迭代修订，且不使用官方评分反馈。评估覆盖终端任务、临床回答、应用构建与科学问答四类场景，并结合延迟、指令修订记录与reviewer决策进行轨迹层面的分析。
AI.result: Terminal-Bench 2.1：89例通过83例（93.26%）；HealthBench Professional：Fable配置在525任务上长度校正rubric得分为69.63。53任务配对HealthBench比较中，Fable配置harness聚合得分比直接补全高19.89分，但任务级中位数为-1.46分；平均推理成本从每任务$0.29升至$2.13。
AI.conclusion: 将结果指标与执行轨迹、资源消耗并列评估，可以清晰刻画协同机制在何处促进任务完成、在何处引入性能回归以及所需代价；聚合提升与任务级中位数下降并存，说明收益分布不均，成本显著上升。

title: T-MUON: Tensorizing Muon via t-SVD for Large Language Model Pre-training
summary: Muon has recently emerged as a strong optimizer for large language model pretraining by exploiting matrix structure through polar orthogonalization.
