However, it processes each parameter matrix independently, whereas recent tensor-aware extensions of Muon jointly update groups of eligible matrix parameters through matrix unfoldings. In contrast, we propose T-MUON, a t-SVD-based generalization that groups structurally related Transformer gradients into third-order tensors and defines the corresponding Muon-style update directly through the $M$-transform. We show that the exact T-MUON update is a steepest-descent direction under the $\star_M$-spectral norm and establish a convergence guarantee. Across GPT-2-style and LLaMA-style models from 51M to 1.3B parameters trained on FineWeb and FineWeb-Edu, head-wise T-MUON with the identity transform consistently achieves lower validation perplexity than AdamW, Muon, and variants using DFT, DCT, or DST transforms. These gains persist in additional experiments with longer context lengths and larger token budgets, although the preferred tensorization mode varies across settings.

AI.tldr: 提出基于t-SVD的T-MUON优化器，将结构相关的Transformer梯度组成三阶张量，通过M-变换定义Muon式更新，实验验证其在1.3B以内模型上优于AdamW与Muon。
AI.motivation: Muon虽通过极正交化利用矩阵结构成为LLM预训练的有力优化器，但逐矩阵独立处理参数；近期张量感知扩展需借助矩阵展开（unfolding）联合更新，存在结构利用不充分的问题。
AI.method: 将结构相关的Transformer梯度分组为三阶张量，基于t-SVD构造T-MUON：直接在M-变换（M-transform）域中定义Muon风格更新；证明该更新是⋆_M-谱范数下的最速下降方向，并给出收敛性保证；实验中比较恒等变换与DFT、DCT、DST变换及head-wise张量化模式。
AI.result: 在FineWeb与FineWeb-Edu上训练51M–1.3B参数的GPT-2与LLaMA风格模型，head-wise T-MUON配合恒等变换的验证困惑度持续低于AdamW、Muon及DFT/DCT/DST变体；在更长上下文与更大token预算下优势保持，但最优张量化模式随设置变化。
AI.conclusion: T-MUON提供了有理论保证的张量感知Muon推广，实证表明在多种规模与配置下优于基线；最优张量化模式依赖具体设置，构成后续调优空间。

title: The Forward/Inverse Duality of Controlled Emergence:A Computational Design Program from Explanation to Engineering
summary: The macroscopic capabilities of intelligent systems arise from the local interactions of many simple units. When such systems are deployed in the real world, their behaviour must nevertheless be constrained, leaving designers caught between releasing adaptability and preventing loss of control, yet without formal tools to resolve the dilemma. This paper proposes a unified research program for controlled emergence that restates this tension as a pair of dual problems: the forward problem explains macroscopic behaviour from local rules, and the inverse problem solves for controllable rules and readout mechanisms from a desired target. We take an augmented quintuple as the formal object shared by both ends, and decompose ``engineering'' into three independently measurable coordinates: controllability, reproducibility, and degree of formalizability. On this basis we give three testable working hypotheses (critical scale; the cooperation and trade-off between constraint and adaptability; minimal constraint) and one feasibility criterion, which reduce inverse design from unconstrained optimization to interval checking. The program takes explicit failure boundaries as its premise, does not pursue complete control, and always preserves the system's room for self-organization. The reduced pilot experiment attached to this paper serves only to verify the executability of the research protocol and does not constitute a statistical test of the working hypotheses. This design language generalizes to multi-agent artificial intelligence, the industrial internet, and emergency response systems, all of which must confront emergence and controllability at once.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"受控涌现"统一研究纲领，把复杂系统设计中"适应性 vs 可控性"的张力重构为正向问题（由局部规则解释宏观行为）与逆向问题（由目标反解可控规则与读出机制）一对对偶问题。
AI.motivation: 智能系统的宏观能力源自大量简单单元的局部交互，但实际部署中其行为必须受到约束，设计者因此陷入"释放适应性"与"防止失控"的两难，且缺乏形式化工具来化解这一矛盾。
AI.method: 以"增广五元组"作为正逆两端共享的形式对象；将"工程化"分解为可控性、可复现性、形式化程度三个可独立度量的坐标；在此基础上提出三个可检验工作假设（临界规模；约束与适应性的协同与权衡；最小约束）及一个可行性判据，把逆向设计从不约束优化降为区间检验。
AI.result: 工作假设与可行性判据共同将逆向设计问题简化为区间检查，使设计流程具备可执行性；所附缩比先导实验仅验证研究协议的可执行性，不构成对工作假设的统计检验。
AI.conclusion: 该纲领以显式失败边界为前提，不追求完全控制，始终保留系统自组织空间；该设计语言可推广至多智能体人工智能、工业互联网与应急响应系统等同时面临涌现与可控性问题的场景。

title: Robust Direct Preference Optimization under Preference Label-Flip Attacks
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is widely used for offline Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. However, recent works have shown that DPO can be easily manipulated by adversarial preference label flip attacks, which are specifically designed to mislead the learner toward an attacker-chosen target policy. To address this issue, we design robust DPO methods that can defend against such attacks. Building on the property that lable flips induce parameter-independent gradient shifts in log-linear DPO, we propose Trim-$K$ Robust-DPO, which removes the $K$ highest-impact pairs, and Soft-Trim-$K$ Robust-DPO, which smoothly downweights them. We establish deterministic gradient perturbation bounds uniformly over all attack sets containing at most $K$ flips, explicitly separating defense-induced bias from surviving attack effects. Under bounded-region assumptions, these bounds yield time-uniform parameter and policy deviation guarantees. We further quantify how quadratic regularization improves curvature while introducing additional bias. Experiments on Stanford Human Preferences, HH-RLHF, and UltraFeedback-Binarized validate our analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文针对DPO易受偏好标签翻转攻击的问题，提出Trim-K Robust-DPO与Soft-Trim-K Robust-DPO两种鲁棒DPO方法，并给出确定性的梯度扰动界及时间一致的参数与策略偏差保证，实验验证了理论分析。
AI.motivation: DPO被广泛用于离线RLHF，但近期研究表明其易被对抗性偏好标签翻转攻击操纵，使学习器偏向攻击者选定的目标策略，因此需要能抵御此类攻击的鲁棒DPO方法。
AI.method: 基于标签翻转在log-linear DPO中引起与参数无关的梯度偏移这一性质，提出Trim-K Robust-DPO（剔除影响最大的K个偏好对）与Soft-Trim-K Robust-DPO（对其进行平滑降权）；在至多K次翻转的所有攻击集合上建立统一确定性梯度扰动的界，分离防御引入的偏差与残余攻击效应；在有界区域假设下导出时间一致的参数与策略偏差保证，并分析二次正则化对曲率的改善及其引入的额外偏差。
AI.result: 建立了对任意至多K次翻转攻击集合一致成立的确定性梯度扰动界，并给出时间一致的参数与策略偏差保证；明确了二次正则在提升曲率与引入偏差间的权衡；在Stanford Human Preferences、HH-RLHF与UltraFeedback-Binarized数据集上的实验验证了理论分析。
AI.conclusion: Trim-K与Soft-Trim-K Robust-DPO能有效防御偏好标签翻转攻击，理论界清晰刻画了防御偏差与攻击残余，实验支持了该分析。

title: Think, Compress, Answer: Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Grounding via Reasoning Compression
summary: Extended reasoning has substantially improved multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on tasks requiring compositional and relational inference. However, multimodal grounding imposes a distinct requirement: reasoning must ultimately converge on a target-specific compact representation that supports precise localization. As reasoning trajectories grow longer, they often expand into broad scene narratives and peripheral relational details, which can dilute grounded perceptual evidence and lead to ambiguous or incorrect predictions. Motivated by the information bottleneck principle, we propose Think-Compress-Answer (TCA), a reinforcement learning framework that decomposes multimodal grounding into three phases: free-form reasoning, target-aware context compression, and answer generation conditioned on the compressed context. TCA is optimized through a multi-stage Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with progressive rewards that establish the structured output protocol, minimize reasoning-specific information while preserving target-relevant content, and directly improve localization accuracy. This staged design enables MLLMs to retain the benefits of extended reasoning while distilling it into the minimal context required for grounding. Experiments across six multimodal grounding benchmarks show that TCA attains substantial zero-shot performance gains, demonstrating the effectiveness of reasoning compression.

AI.tldr: 提出Think-Compress-Answer（TCA）强化学习框架，将多模态定位分解为自由推理、目标感知上下文压缩、压缩条件下的答案生成三阶段，用多阶段GRPO与递进奖励优化，在六个定位基准上取得显著零样本提升。
AI.motivation: 扩展推理提升了MLLM的组合与关系推理能力，但多模态定位要求推理最终收敛到支持精确定位的目标特定紧凑表示。推理轨迹过长会扩展为宽泛场景叙述与边缘关系细节，稀释定位所需的感知证据，导致预测歧义或错误。作者受信息瓶颈原理启发，希望保留长链推理收益的同时将其蒸馏为定位所需的最小上下文。
AI.method: TCA框架包含三阶段：1）自由形式推理；2）目标感知上下文压缩；3）基于压缩上下文条件化的答案生成。采用多阶段Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）训练，配合递进式奖励：先建立结构化输出协议，再在保留目标相关信息的前提下最小化推理特定信息，最后直接提升定位精度。
AI.result: 在六个多模态定位基准上，TCA取得大幅零样本性能提升，验证了推理压缩的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将长链推理压缩为目标相关的最小上下文可有效缓解推理漂移对定位的干扰，表明"推理—压缩—作答"的分阶段强化学习设计能兼顾扩展推理的表达能力与定位任务对紧凑表示的需求。

title: ControlJEPA: Principled Trajectory Regularization via Lyapunov Tube Loss
summary: Next-token prediction leaves hidden-state trajectories largely unconstrained, while existing geometric regularizers primarily control the direction rather than the magnitude of trajectory deviations. We introduce \emph{ControlJEPA}, a trajectory regularization framework based on a discrete-time Lyapunov contraction condition from practical Input-to-State Stability theory. Its Lyapunov Tube Loss penalizes violations of this condition on a normalized, scale-invariant measure of transversal deviation. When the contraction condition holds at every step, the hidden-state trajectory remains within an explicit tube around the reference secant. In the partial-ISS regime, we bound mean transversal energy, temporal variance, and average tube width using the Lyapunov loss and contraction parameters, with horizon-independent variance bounds under uniformly bounded violations. ControlJEPA requires no architectural modifications. Across six benchmarks and six model families, it consistently improves accuracy and data efficiency over standard fine-tuning and prior trajectory regularizers. The resulting smoother transversal profile also persists empirically during inference, when the regularizer is inactive. The code is publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/t-khanusa/ControlJEPA}

AI.tldr: 论文提出ControlJEPA，一种无需改动架构的轨迹正则框架，基于离散时间Lyapunov收缩条件（ISS理论），用Lyapunov Tube Loss惩罚横向偏差违反，提升准确率与数据效率，并使推理期轨迹更平滑。
AI.motivation: 下一词预测对隐状态轨迹缺乏约束，现有几何正则手段主要控制偏差方向而非幅度，缺少对轨迹偏离大小的显式控制。
AI.method: 借鉴实际输入-状态稳定性（ISS）理论中的离散时间Lyapunov收缩条件，构造Lyapunov Tube Loss，在归一化、尺度不变的横向偏差度量上惩罚收缩条件违反；收缩成立时轨迹被限制在参考割线周围的显式管（tube）内，部分ISS情形下用Lyapunov损失与收缩参数界定平均横向能量、时间方差与平均管宽。
AI.result: 在六个基准与六类模型族上，相较标准微调与既有轨迹正则方法，一致提升准确率与数据效率；正则项不激活的推理阶段，更平滑的横向剖面仍经验性持续。
AI.conclusion: ControlJEPA以理论可证的收缩条件实现轨迹幅度正则，兼具无架构改动、可解释界与实证增益，代码已开源。

title: Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners: Adaptive Loop Halting on the Hypersphere
summary: Looped (weight-tied) transformers enable adaptive computation by allocating more iterations to harder inputs. Fixed-Point Reasoners (FPRM) achieve this with a damped fixed-point solver, but operate in an unbounded Euclidean residual space with coupled rescaling and relative-norm halting. We introduce Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners (SFPRM), which perform the same computation on the unit hypersphere of normalized transformers (nGPT). Input injection, damping, and halting become geodesic operations, yielding boundedness by construction and eliminating coefficient coupling. We prove fixed-point existence, local convergence under an explicit step-size condition, and global convergence under strong injection. On Sudoku-Extreme, Maze-Hard, and Mini-ARC, SFPRM achieves 96.6%, 87.9%, and 59.1% test accuracy, respectively, outperforming FPRM and other baselines while allocating test-time compute more effectively. Its converged geometry is also interpretable: token-input angles capture puzzle structure and predict correctness.

AI.tldr: SFPRM将FPRM的阻尼定点求解从无界欧氏残差空间搬到nGPT的单位超球面上，使输入注入、阻尼与停机均变为测地操作，由此在构造上获得有界性并解耦系数；理论上证明定点存在、显式步长下的局部收敛与强注入下的全局收敛，在Sudoku-Extreme/Maze-Hard/Mini-ARC上取得96.6%/87.9%/59.1%准确率。
AI.motivation: 循环（权重共享）Transformer 需按输入难度自适应分配算力，FPRM 用阻尼定点迭代实现这一点，但其迭代运行在无界欧氏残差空间，且缩放系数与相对范数停机准则相互耦合，带来数值不稳定与超参调优困难。作者希望在保持同等计算能力的前提下，以几何方式从构造上保证有界性并简化停机机制。
AI.method: 在归一化 Transformer（nGPT）的单位超球面上执行与 FPRM 相同的定点迭代：输入注入、阻尼与停机均改写为球面上的测地（geodesic）操作；阻尼对应沿测地线向输入点收缩，停机基于角度/测地距离而非相对范数，从而消除系数耦合。理论上给出定点存在性、显式步长条件下的局部收敛性以及强注入条件下的全局收敛性证明。
AI.result: 在 Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard、Mini-ARC 上分别达到 96.6%、87.9%、59.1% 的测试准确率，优于 FPRM 及其他基线，且测试时算力分配更有效；收敛后的几何具有可解释性——token 与输入之间的夹角能刻画谜题结构并预测答案正确性。
AI.conclusion: 将循环推理的定点求解几何化到超球面，可同时获得有界性、系数解耦、可证明的收敛保证与更优的测试时算力分配，并带来可解释的内部几何表征，为自适应计算型 Transformer 提供了更稳健的设计范式。

title: CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising way to improve the clinical reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), but current pipelines often rely on expert-labeled questions or costly synthetic-data generation. Meanwhile, the medical literature offers a wealth of high-quality unlabeled documents, including clinical case reports that trace the full clinical course from initial presentation to final treatment decisions. We study whether document-grounded self-play can convert these reports into effective RL training signals. We identify two challenges that limit existing self-play methods in this setting: knowledge-point fixation}, where the proposer repeatedly asks about a narrow set of salient clues in a source report, and difficulty-quality mismatch, where appropriately difficult questions may still be poorly formed or shallow, limiting their value for reasoner training. To address these challenges, we propose CasePlay, a self-play framework with two key components: (a) a Knowledge-Conditioned Proposer, which anchors question generation to case-specific knowledge points so that questions draw on a broader range of evidence from the source report; and (b) a Rubric-Judge Reasoner, which augments answer-accuracy feedback with rubric-based quality feedback on clue integration, reasoning depth, and option quality, guiding the proposer toward reasoning-intensive questions that better support reasoner training. Extensive experiments across seven medically related benchmarks demonstrate that CasePlay outperforms existing self-play baselines and improves the SFT warm-start model by 3.1 points on average, highlighted by a 6.3-point gain on LiveClin. This approach offers an effective path toward continually improving medical reasoning ability through self-play RL.

AI.tldr: 提出CasePlay自对弈框架，利用临床病例报告进行文档驱动的自我对弈强化学习，缓解知识点固化与难度-质量失配问题，在7个医学基准上平均提升3.1分。
AI.motivation: 现有提升LLM临床推理的RL流程依赖专家标注题目或昂贵的合成数据；而医学文献中大量高质量无标注文档（尤其是涵盖完整病程的临床病例报告）未被充分利用。作者探究文档驱动的自对弈能否将这些报告转化为有效的RL训练信号，并指出既有自对弈方法的两大瓶颈：知识点固化（proposer反复就报告中少数显著线索提问）与难度-质量失配（难度合适但题面粗糙或浅显，训练价值低）。
AI.method: CasePlay包含两个核心组件：(a) Knowledge-Conditioned Proposer——将题目生成锚定到病例特定的知识点上，使问题覆盖源报告中更广泛的证据；(b) Rubric-Judge Reasoner——在答案正确性反馈之外，引入基于评分细则的质量反馈（线索整合、推理深度、选项质量），引导proposer产出推理密集型题目。
AI.result: 在7个医学相关基准上的实验表明，CasePlay优于现有自对弈基线，相较SFT热启动模型平均提升3.1分，其中LiveClin上提升6.3分。
AI.conclusion: 文档驱动的自对弈RL是持续提升医学推理能力的有效路径，CasePlay通过知识点条件化提问与评分细则式质量反馈，将无标注病例报告转化为高质量训练信号。

title: HyperTaxa: Multiscale Genome Representations for Generalized Microbial Taxonomic Inference
summary: Reliable microbial taxonomic inference is challenged by the rapid growth of newly sequenced organisms and incomplete reference coverage. While alignment- and database-driven tools remain essential for reference-backed identification, they are not designed for learned inference over species absent from genome-level training. We introduce HyperTaxa, a taxonomy-aligned representation learning framework for open-set microbial taxonomic inference. HyperTaxa encodes whole genomes as multiscale hyperspectral k-mer transition fields and aligns these representations to a taxonomy-derived semantic space using a two-stage Node2Vec-to-MDS procedure that combines local graph structure with global hierarchical distance preservation. The resulting space supports zero-shot inference over species excluded from genome-level training but represented in the taxonomy, generalized zero-shot inference over seen and unseen species, and cascaded genus-to-species prediction. Across benchmark and large-scale disjoint-species evaluations, HyperTaxa improves taxonomic prediction over pseudo-image and transformer-graph baselines, with the strongest gains at higher taxonomic ranks. Ablations further show that multiscale transition encoding and taxonomy-aware alignment are key contributors to generalization. These results position HyperTaxa as a complementary taxonomy-aware representation and candidate-generation framework for microbial identification under incomplete reference coverage and open-set uncertainty.

AI.tldr: HyperTaxa：将全基因组编码为多尺度高光谱k-mer转移场，并用Node2Vec-to-MDS两阶段对齐到分类学语义空间，实现开放集微生物分类推断（零样本、广义零样本、属到种级联预测）。
AI.motivation: 新测序物种快速增长、参考基因组覆盖不完整，使可靠的微生物分类学推断受限；现有比对与数据库驱动工具适合参考支撑的鉴定，但无法对基因组级训练中未出现的物种进行学习式推断。
AI.method: 提出HyperTaxa分类学对齐表征学习框架：1）把全基因组编码为多尺度高光谱k-mer转移场表征；2）采用Node2Vec→MDS两阶段流程，将表征对齐到由分类学派生的语义空间，兼顾局部图结构与全局层级距离保持；3）该空间支持零样本、广义零样本以及属到种的级联预测。
AI.result: 在基准与大尺度不相交物种评估中，HyperTaxa的分类预测优于伪图像与Transformer图基线，且在高分类层级上提升最明显；消融实验表明多尺度转移编码与分类学感知对齐是泛化能力的关键来源。
AI.conclusion: HyperTaxa可作为互补的分类学感知表征与候选生成框架，用于参考覆盖不完整、开放集不确定性下的微生物鉴定。

title: Label-Space Mismatch Distorts Cross-Cohort Evaluation in Breast Cancer Molecular Subtyping
summary: Cross-cohort evaluation of breast cancer subtype classifiers is unreliable when source and target cohorts use different annotation standards: METABRIC labels six classes, PAM50 defines five, and a claudin-low prediction cannot be correct under a five-class standard. A classifier transferred from 1,369 METABRIC patients (train n=958) to TCGA-BRCA (n=987) and GSE21653 (n=266) separates three evaluation operations routinely conflated in cross-site comparisons. (1) Label-space restriction - an evaluation-rule change, not a retraining gain - is the dominant correction (73.76%->79.74% on TCGA-BRCA; 63.16%->68.42% on GSE21653); (2) EM prior correction on the reconciled space is an optional calibration step (Brier fidelity up, macro F1 down; to 80.65% and 74.06%); and (3) the target label space is not recoverable from unlabelled predictions (EM retains prior 0.0751 on the absent class; calibrated detectors fail), so compliance must come from cohort documentation. The protocol exposes why internal validation overstates cross-cohort value: multimodal fusion gains do not transfer (no configuration beats mRNA alone, n=694; McNemar p=0.13-1.00), and the genomic panel adds nothing to pathological complete response prediction over clinical variables (DeltaAUC = +0.0045). Clinically, without label-space compliance, cross-site accuracy comparisons misattribute annotation-standard differences to model skill; Luminal A/B and claudin-low boundary errors map to distinct treatment decisions; and subtype accuracy is a weaker portable endpoint than survival discrimination (external C-index 0.577-0.584). Reporting the cohort's allowed label set and applying label-space compliance are therefore prerequisites before any cross-cohort performance claim.

AI.tldr: 跨队列评估乳腺癌亚型分类器时，若源队列与目标队列的标注体系不同（METABRIC六类 vs PAM50五类），必须先做标签空间合规化，否则性能比较不可靠；标签空间限制是主要修正项，EM先验校准仅为可选步骤，且目标标签空间无法从无标签预测中恢复。
AI.motivation: 跨站点、跨队列的性能比较常把"标注标准差异"误归因为模型能力差异，尤其当源队列（METABRIC，六类，含claudin-low）与目标队列（PAM50，五类）标签空间不一致时，claudin-low预测在五类标准下必然被判为错误。作者希望厘清跨队列评估中被混为一谈的若干评估操作，并给出合规化前置条件。
AI.method: 将基于METABRIC（n=1369，训练n=958）的分类器迁移至TCGA-BRCA（n=987）与GSE21653（n=266），将评估拆分为三类操作：(1)标签空间限制（评估规则变更，非重训练增益）；(2)在调和空间上进行EM先验校正（可选校准）；(3)检验能否从无标签预测中恢复目标标签空间。另做内外部验证对比：多模态融合与单一mRNA、基因组panel对pCR预测的增量、以及生存判别C-index作为可移植终点。
AI.result: 标签空间限制为最主要修正：TCGA-BRCA 73.76%→79.74%，GSE21653 63.16%→68.42%；EM先验校正使Brier保真度提升但macro F1下降，性能达80.65%与74.06%。EM对缺失类保留先验0.0751，校准检测器均失败，说明目标标签空间不可从无标签预测恢复。内部验证高估跨队列价值：多模态融合无配置优于单一mRNA（n=694，McNemar p=0.13–1.00）；基因组panel对pCR预测较临床变量无增益（ΔAUC=+0.0045）。外部C-index仅0.577–0.584。
AI.conclusion: 跨队列性能声明的前提是报告队列允许的标签集并执行标签空间合规化；合规性须来自队列文档而非无标签预测推断。Luminal A/B与claudin-low的边界错误对应不同治疗决策，亚型准确率不如生存判别适合作为可移植终点。

title: LIRQuant: An Efficient Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization Method for Large Language Models
summary: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet activation outliers remain a key challenge for low-bit quantization. Existing global transformation methods overlook heterogeneous channel sensitivity to quantization noise, leading to suboptimal accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. To address this, we propose \textbf{Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization (LIRQuant)}, a sensitivity-aware framework that selectively applies transformations. LIRQuant identifies sensitive channels using a noise-weighted sensitivity metric, applying expressive learnable rotations only to these channels and lightweight fixed rotations to the remaining ones. This decoupled design reduces optimization complexity without sacrificing outlier smoothing capability. Extensive experiments across the LLaMA-2/3, Mistral, Qwen3, and Mixtral families demonstrate that LIRQuant achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under the challenging W4A4KV4 setting. Meanwhile, LIRQuant calibrates LLaMA-3-8B in only 25 minutes with 20.3 GB peak GPU memory, achieving the fastest calibration and the lowest memory footprint among recent learnable-rotation methods, and its fused inference kernels deliver up to $2.3\times$ prefill speedup and $3.5\times$ memory saving over FP16.

AI.tldr: LIRQuant是一种敏感度感知的后训练量化框架，通过仅对量化噪声敏感通道施加可学习旋转、其余通道使用固定轻量旋转，在W4A4KV4下取得SOTA精度并显著降低校准成本与推理开销。
AI.motivation: LLM低比特PTQ中激活离群值是主要障碍；现有全局变换方法忽略了不同通道对量化噪声的异质敏感度，导致精度-效率折中次优。
AI.method: 提出LIRQuant：（1）以噪声加权敏感度指标识别敏感通道；（2）对敏感通道施加表达力强的可学习旋转，对剩余通道施加轻量固定旋转，形成解耦设计，在保持离群值平滑能力的同时降低优化复杂度；（3）配套融合推理核。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-2/3、Mistral、Qwen3、Mixtral系列上，W4A4KV4设置下达到SOTA精度；LLaMA-3-8B校准仅需25分钟、峰值显存20.3 GB，为近期可学习旋转方法中最快且显存最低；融合核相对FP16实现最高2.3× prefill加速与3.5×显存节省。
AI.conclusion: 按通道敏感度差异施加差异化旋转变换，可在不牺牲离群值抑制能力的前提下简化优化，并为低比特LLM量化提供精度与部署效率兼得的实用方案。

title: PRECOCIAL: Pretraining with Code Curriculums via Iterative Search for Accelerated Learning
summary: Fully synthetic pretraining data generated by symbolic programs can bootstrap downstream training on naturalistic tasks, such as language modeling, but the generating programs have so far been designed by hand. We introduce PRECOCIAL, a method for automatically optimizing programs that generate synthetic pretraining data. Starting from an initial generator program, an LLM iteratively rewrites the program, and each rewrite is scored by pretraining a randomly-initialized transformer on its data and fine-tuning it on the downstream task. Because every score requires training, PRECOCIAL keeps a single network for the entire search, continuing its pretraining for each accepted program instead of training a new network per candidate, making it significantly more efficient. On four language and code datasets, at a fixed fine-tuning budget, optimized programs reach lower perplexity than hand-designed curricula, published procedural generators, random program mutation and the program the LLM writes in the first iteration of the search, and reach the same perplexity as the hand-designed curricula with 9-33% fewer fine-tuning steps. PRECOCIAL also ends with lower perplexity than FunSearch and AlphaEvolve, which train a new network for every candidate, at the same number of evaluations and a lower cost. We also observe that an optimized program generator from one domain transfers to datasets in other domains. Additionally, optimized programs allow for better downstream performance on four different reasoning and problem-solving tasks.

AI.tldr: PRECOCIAL 用 LLM 迭代改写"合成预训练数据生成程序"，并以整个搜索共享单个 transformer 的打分方式（每个被接受的程序继续预训练而非重训）显著提升搜索效率；在四个语言/代码数据集上优于手工课程、已发表过程式生成器、随机程序变异与首轮 LLM 程序，并优于 FunSearch 与 AlphaEvolve。
AI.motivation: 符号程序生成的完全合成预训练数据能够为语言建模等自然任务的下游训练提供引导，但此类生成程序此前均为人工设计，缺乏自动化优化手段。
AI.method: 从一个初始生成程序出发，由 LLM 迭代重写程序；每个候选的评分方式为：在其生成的数据上预训练一个随机初始化 transformer，再在下游任务上微调。由于每次评分都需训练，PRECOCIAL 在整个搜索过程中只保留单一网络，对每个被接受的程序沿用该网络继续预训练，而非为每个候选重新训练新网络。
AI.result: 在四个语言与代码数据集上、固定微调预算下，优化后程序的困惑度低于手工设计课程、已发表过程式生成器、随机程序变异以及 LLM 首轮写出的程序；达到与手工课程相同困惑度所需微调步数减少 9–33%。在相同评估次数与更低成本下，最终困惑度低于为每个候选重新训练网络的 FunSearch 与 AlphaEvolve。还观察到某一领域的优化生成器可迁移至其他领域数据集，且优化程序在四个推理与问题求解任务上带来更好的下游表现。
AI.conclusion: 合成预训练数据的生成程序可以被自动优化，且"单一网络持续预训练"的打分策略在保持效果的同时大幅降低搜索成本，优化程序具备跨领域迁移性与下游收益。

title: Neither Over- nor Under-Constrained: Evaluating LLM Personalization under a Constraint Qualification Audit
summary: Accurate evaluation of LLM personalization is hindered by current evaluation paradigms that over- or under-constrain the response space, yielding frequent false rejections and false acceptances. To reduce these false rates, we introduce ConQual-Audit, an audit-based framework that evaluates LLM personalization through a three-stage process: (1) extracting semantic constraints from user profiles and task-grounded reference; (2) qualifying constraints by pruning unnecessary constraints and recovering missing constraints; and (3) verifying candidate responses against the audited constraints via natural language inference. Across PrefEval and LaMP, ConQual-Audit outperforms nine baselines, attaining top AUCs (0.88 and 0.90) and the lowest false rate (0.21) on the leanest constraint sets at an amortizable audit cost. Crucially, this constraint audit is portable: integrating it into ExPerT and PREF helps revise smaller, higher-quality constraint sets to reduce their evaluation false rates.

AI.tldr: 提出审计式框架 ConQual-Audit，通过三阶段（约束提取—约束校准—NLI 验证）评估 LLM 个性化，显著降低误拒/误纳率。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 个性化评测范式对响应空间的约束过强或过弱，导致频繁的误拒（false rejection）与误纳（false acceptance），评测准确性受损。
AI.method: ConQual-Audit 三阶段流程：1）从用户画像与任务相关参考中提取语义约束；2）约束校准（qualification），剪除冗余约束并补全缺失约束；3）通过自然语言推理（NLI）将候选响应与审计后的约束逐条验证。
AI.result: 在 PrefEval 与 LaMP 上优于 9 个基线，AUC 分别达 0.88 与 0.90，在最精简约束集上误率最低（0.21），且审计成本可摊销；该约束审计可移植，集成到 ExPerT 与 PREF 后可获得更小、更高质量的约束集并降低评测误率。
AI.conclusion: 约束审计是提升个性化评测可靠性的关键环节；ConQual-Audit 兼顾准确性与成本，并具备良好的模块可移植性。

title: Certified Sparse Attention via Perturbed Retrieval
comment: 58 pages (10 pages main text, 48 pages appendix), 10 figures, 35 tables
summary: Sparse attention speeds up long-context decoding by reading few keys of the KV cache, but existing methods do not control the error of a query, and on real KV caches their errors have heavy tails. We show that perturbing the score of every key with an independent Exp(1) variable turns threshold retrieval into sampling keys with probability proportional to their attention weights. Lowering the threshold along a geometric grid gives nested samples, a Horvitz--Thompson estimate of the output at every level, and confidence bounds that hold simultaneously over all levels, so each head stops at the first level whose certificate meets the target error $\varepsilon$. With fresh perturbations at every decoding step, each certificate fails with probability at most $δ$ during generation. At a suitable threshold, the estimator reads $O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ))$ values regardless of the context length, and no adaptive method reads fewer, up to constants. A 4-bit scan with deterministic bounds, shared across a grouped-query-attention group, generates the candidates exactly but reads every key. On three LLMs and ten settings at 16K--128K tokens, no certificate is violated, and at equal keys read our 90th-percentile error is 4.6--7.9$\times$ lower than that of the best of 15 baseline families. At equal bytes, the best baselines have 0.6--1.6 times our 90th-percentile error and at least 4.9 times our largest. End to end, our method stays within one point of dense attention on tasks and within 0.1\% in PG-19 perplexity, and the strongest baselines at equal bytes score as well. On CPU, decoding steps at 32K--128K tokens run 1.1--1.4$\times$ faster than dense attention on the same 16-bit cache.

AI.tldr: 提出基于指数扰动与Horvitz–Thompson估计的稀疏注意力方法，为每个query提供可验证的误差证书，逐层停止采样，实现上下文长度无关的读取量，并在多模型、多设置下显著降低尾部误差。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏注意力仅读取KV cache中的少量key来加速长上下文解码，但不控制单个query的误差，且在实际KV cache上误差呈重尾分布，缺乏可靠保证。
AI.method: 对每个key的打分施加独立Exp(1)扰动，使阈值检索等价于按注意力权重成比例采样；沿几何网格降低阈值获得嵌套样本，在每层用Horvitz–Thompson估计输出并给出对所有层同时成立的置信界，每个head在首个满足目标误差ε的证书层停止；每步解码重新扰动使证书失败概率≤δ。配合跨GQA组共享、带确定性边界的4-bit扫描精确生成候选（读取全部key）。
AI.result: 适当阈值下估计器只读O(ε^{-2}log(1/δ))个值且与上下文长度无关，并在常数因子内达到自适应方法的下界。3个LLM、10种设置、16K–128K token上无证书被违反；等读取量下90分位误差比15类基线中最优者低4.6–7.9倍；等字节下基线90分位误差为本方法0.6–1.6倍、最大误差至少4.9倍。端到端任务性能与稠密注意力相差1点内，PG-19困惑度差0.1%内；CPU上32K–128K解码比同16-bit缓存的稠密注意力快1.1–1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力可具备逐query、可验证且有同时置信保证的误差控制，在保持精度接近稠密注意力的同时降低尾部误差并获得实际加速。

title: BitFlat: Error-Localized Bitstream Design for Robust Diffusion Image Compression
summary: Zero-shot diffusion image compression based on reverse channel coding achieves high perceptual quality at low bitrates without retraining, yet its bitstream remains vulnerable to bit flips. Prior work has shown that a joint combinatorial representation can amplify a single bit flip into substitutions of multiple atoms and that indexing each atom independently confines this error propagation. However, independent indexing reduces the number of atoms that fit within the bit budget and gives the decoder no indication of which atoms are corrupted. To address these issues, we propose BitFlat, a training-free error-localizing bitstream framework with two components. Blockwise Locality Alignment (BLA) decomposes the globally coupled atom selection at each diffusion step into independent selection units, each describing one signed atom from a dedicated codebook with a fixed-width field, so that any bit error affects only the unit in which it occurs. Reliability-Aware Diffusion Control (RADC) uses the bits saved by BLA to impose structured valid-codeword constraints within each field and converts the decoding state of each field into a binary reliability gate, which turns detected corrupted atoms into erasures at known positions and excludes them from noise synthesis. BitFlat requires neither target residuals nor additional network forward passes and leaves the diffusion model unchanged. Experiments on Kodak, DIV2K, and CLIC2020 show that BitFlat outperforms conventional, learned, and diffusion-based codecs at bit error rates from $10^{-4}$ to $10^{-2}$ and, even with $26.7\%$ fewer bits, surpasses Robust Turbo-DDCM.

AI.tldr: BitFlat：一种免训练、可定位比特错误的零样本扩散图像压缩比特流框架，通过分块局部对齐与可靠性感知扩散控制，在$10^{-4}$–$10^{-2}$误码率下优于传统、学习及扩散类编解码器。
AI.motivation: 零样本扩散图像压缩（基于反向信道编码）在低码率下无需重训练即可获得高感知质量，但其比特流对比特翻转脆弱。已有工作发现联合组合表示会使单个比特翻转放大为多个原子的替换，而独立索引每个原子虽能限制错误传播，却会减少比特预算内可容纳的原子数，且解码器无法获知哪些原子被破坏。
AI.method: 提出BitFlat框架，含两部分：(1) Blockwise Locality Alignment (BLA) 将每个扩散步中全局耦合的原子选择分解为独立选择单元，每单元以固定宽度字段描述来自专用码本的一个带符号原子，使任意比特错误只影响其所在单元；(2) Reliability-Aware Diffusion Control (RADC) 利用BLA节省的比特在每个字段内施加结构化有效码字约束，并将各字段解码状态转换为二值可靠性门，将检测到的损坏原子转化为已知位置的擦除并从噪声合成中排除。方法无需目标残差、无需额外网络前向，且不改变扩散模型。
AI.result: 在Kodak、DIV2K、CLIC2020数据集上，BitFlat在$10^{-4}$至$10^{-2}$误码率区间优于传统、学习型及扩散类编解码器；即使比特数减少26.7%，仍超过Robust Turbo-DDCM。
AI.conclusion: 通过分块局部对齐与可靠性感知控制，BitFlat在零样本扩散压缩中实现了免训练的错误局部化，兼顾鲁棒性与码率效率。

title: Block Recursive Transformers for Structured Parameter Sharing
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures. Published at EMNLP Findings 2026. Typo correction from camera-ready manuscript. Project website: https://aim-skku.github.io/BRT/
summary: Recursive Transformers depend not only on how many parameters are shared, but also on how shared parameters are organized across depth. Existing static schemes adopt two extreme reuse topologies: layer-wise repetition, where each layer is reused independently, and global cyclic reuse, where the entire stack is repeatedly applied as a single shared function. We argue that sharing granularity is an important factor in recursive parameter sharing. This study proposes Block Recursive Transformers (BRT), which partition layers into contiguous blocks and recursively reuse each block before moving to the next. This intermediate topology enables local refinement within blocks while preserving depth-wise transitions, without adding routing modules, auxiliary states, or extra training objectives. Across decoder-only models up to 1.7B parameters, with additional encoder-decoder and encoder-only studies, BRT improves validation negative log-likelihood and downstream accuracy over static recursive sharing baselines. Ablations and representation analyses further show that intermediate block granularity better balances local refinement and depth-wise differentiation. Project website: https://aim-skku.github.io/BRT/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Block Recursive Transformers（BRT），将层划分为连续块并在每个块内递归复用，再推进到下一块，以此作为介于层间独立复用与全局循环复用之间的中间共享粒度，在不增加路由模块、辅助状态或额外训练目标的前提下提升验证困惑度与下游准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有递归（参数共享）Transformer 采用两种极端复用拓扑：逐层独立重复（layer-wise repetition）与整栈全局循环复用（global cyclic reuse）。作者认为共享粒度本身是被忽视的关键因素，不同粒度会影响局部精炼与深度区分之间的平衡。
AI.method: BRT 将层分成若干连续块，每个块内部先被递归复用多次，再进入下一块，从而形成介于两种极端之间的中间拓扑。该方法不引入路由模块、辅助状态或额外训练目标；实验覆盖最多 1.7B 参数的 decoder-only 模型，并补充 encoder-decoder 与 encoder-only 研究，辅以消融与表示分析。
AI.result: 在 decoder-only 模型（最大 1.7B）及 encoder-decoder、encoder-only 设置下，BRT 相对静态递归共享基线在验证负对数似然与下游准确率上均取得改进；消融与表示分析表明，中间块粒度能更好地平衡块内局部精炼与跨深度的表示区分。
AI.conclusion: 共享粒度是递归参数共享设计中的核心要素，块级递归复用作为一种简洁的中间方案，可在不增加架构与训练复杂度的条件下优于两种极端静态共享拓扑。

title: When Safety Fails Collectively: Robust Alignment Against Harmful Fine-Tuning via Joint Weight Perturbations
summary: Harmful fine-tuning can rapidly erode the safety alignment of large language models, creating substantial risks when aligned models are adapted to downstream tasks. Existing alignment-stage defenses use harmful examples and simulated harmful perturbations during safety alignment to prepare models for later harmful fine-tuning, yet the collective effects of harmful weight perturbations remain underexplored. We identify a collective failure pattern: disjoint parts of a harmful perturbation have limited effects in isolation, but their joint application increases the model's harmfulness beyond the sum of their individual effects. Guided by this observation, we propose Joint Weight Perturbations (JWP), an alignment-stage defense that masks different parts of a harmful perturbation estimated from the current model and trains the model to respond safely in the resulting states. This exposes the model to different combinations of harmful perturbations and reduces its sensitivity to their accumulation during subsequent harmful fine-tuning. Experiments across downstream tasks and model families show that JWP offers stronger resistance to harmful fine-tuning than prior defenses while largely preserving task performance.

AI.tldr: 论文发现有害扰动存在"集体失效模式"（分散部分单独作用有限、联合作用超过个体效应之和），据此提出对齐阶段防御方法JWP，通过掩蔽有害扰动的不同部分训练模型在扰动状态下的安全响应。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐阶段防御虽利用有害样本和模拟有害扰动来提升模型对后续有害微调的鲁棒性，但有害权重扰动的"集体效应"尚未被充分探索；作者观察到分散的有害扰动部分单独效果有限，联合施加时却使模型有害性超过各单独效应之和。
AI.method: 提出Joint Weight Perturbations (JWP)：在训练中掩蔽从当前模型估计出的有害权重扰动的不同部分，使模型在由此产生的多个扰动状态下学习给出安全响应，从而暴露于不同的有害扰动组合。
AI.result: 在多个下游任务和模型家族上的实验表明，JWP对有害微调的抵抗能力强于现有防御方法，同时基本保持任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对有害权重扰动的累积/组合效应进行对齐训练，可有效降低模型对后续有害微调中扰动累积的敏感性，实现更稳健的安全对齐。

title: UtoMe: Observation-Uncertainty-Guided Token Merging for Weather Foundation Models
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Code and project page: https://ornl-utome.github.io/
summary: Weather transformers process dense reanalysis fields whose reliability varies across variables, locations, and weather regimes. Token merging can reduce computation, but feature similarity alone does not account for this heterogeneous input uncertainty. We introduce UtoMe, an observation-uncertainty-guided token merging framework that combines dynamics saliency with ensemble data assimilation spread as a relative input-reliability proxy. The resulting importance score protects selected tokens as anchors and calibrates bipartite matching between the remaining tokens. Three variants use external uncertainty at both training and inference, during training only, or neither stage. In ERA5 72-hour forecasting at two spatial resolutions, UtoMe improves Overall error over train-time ToMe at matched token budgets. At $1.40625^\circ$ and 50% token reduction, UtoMe-E lowers Overall error from 67.32 to 53.00 at the same 0.55x encoder FLOPs. Small reductions remain close to the full-token baseline; larger reductions incur measurable accuracy losses. Component ablations and spatial uncertainty controls support combining dynamics with aligned uncertainty when allocating a weather transformer's token budget.

AI.tldr: UtoMe：用集合资料同化的不确定性（spread）作为输入可靠性代理，结合动力学显著性来引导气象Transformer的token合并，在相同token预算下降低预报误差。
AI.motivation: 天气Transformer处理密集的再分析场，其可靠性随变量、位置和天气型而显著异质；仅凭特征相似性的token合并无法反映这种输入不确定性差异。
AI.method: 提出UtoMe框架：将动力学显著性（dynamics saliency）与集合资料同化的spread（作为相对输入可靠性代理）结合成重要性分数；该分数保护被选为锚点的token，并校准其余token间的二分图匹配。设计三种变体：训练与推理均使用外部不确定性、仅训练时使用、两者均不使用。评估于ERA5 72小时预报、两种空间分辨率。
AI.result: 在匹配token预算下，UtoMe相对train-time ToMe降低Overall误差；在1.40625°、50% token削减下，UtoMe-E将Overall误差从67.32降至53.00，编码器FLOPs相同为0.55x。小幅削减接近全token基线，大幅削减则出现可测的精度损失。组件消融与空间不确定性对照实验支持"动力学+对齐不确定性"的分配策略。
AI.conclusion: 将动力学显著性与对齐的输入不确定性结合来分配气象Transformer的token预算，可在同等计算量下提升预报精度，为不确定性感知的token合并提供了可行方案。

title: ToolOPD: Credit-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Tool-Use Agents
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) enhances the capabilities of small language agents by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model on student-generated trajectories. However, standard OPD implicitly assumes that credit is uniformly distributed across long-horizon trajectories, assigning the same strength of teacher supervision to different actions. Through credit-distribution analysis and outcome-reversal counterfactual experiments, we find that trajectory credit is concentrated on a small number of critical actions. Moreover, even when the trajectory is held fixed, reversing only the final outcome substantially changes the credit assigned to multiple interaction turns. These findings show that the uniform-credit assumption fails to identify critical decisions and ultimately degrades the model's reasoning accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose ToolOPD, an outcome-aware on-policy distillation framework designed for long-horizon tool use. ToolOPD first summarizes each completed trajectory and its outcome into a reusable hindsight skill. It then measures how this skill changes the teacher's probability of each student action token and converts the change into outcome-aware credit. The resulting credit preserves supervision that supports successful decisions or discourages failed ones, while suppressing irrelevant and conflicting signals. ToolOPD uses these credits to reweight the action-level distillation loss and jointly optimizes it with reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across multiple long-horizon tool interaction benchmarks demonstrate that ToolOPD significantly outperforms existing reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出on-policy蒸馏（OPD）隐含假设轨迹中各动作信用均匀分布，但实验发现信用集中于少数关键动作且受最终结果影响；据此提出结果感知的ToolOPD框架，通过hindsight skill衡量结果对教师概率的影响并转化为信用，重加权蒸馏损失并与强化学习联合优化，在长程工具交互基准上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: OPD对长程轨迹中不同动作给予同等强度的教师监督，违背信用分布实际集中的事实：信用集中于少数关键动作，且仅反转最终结果即便轨迹不变也会显著改变多轮交互的信用分配。均匀信用假设无法识别关键决策，最终降低推理准确率。
AI.method: 提出ToolOPD（结果感知的on-policy蒸馏框架）：1）将每条完成的轨迹及其结果总结为可复用的hindsight skill；2）度量该skill对教师在每个学生动作token上概率的改变，并将其转化为结果感知信用；3）该信用保留支持成功决策、抑制失败决策的监督信号，同时压制无关与冲突信号；4）用信用重加权动作级蒸馏损失，并与强化学习联合优化。
AI.result: 在多个长程工具交互基准上，ToolOPD显著优于现有强化学习与自蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: 均匀信用假设在长程工具使用中存在缺陷；显式建模结果对动作级信用的影响，并将重加权蒸馏与强化学习结合，是提升小型语言智能体长程工具使用能力的有效途径。

title: UpLoop: Upcycling Large Language Models with Gated Loop
summary: Looped large language models trade parameter storage for recurrent computation, but most are trained from scratch. In practice, pretraining with looped depth is expensive, making post-training upcycling of a pretrained non-looped LLM an attractive alternative. We introduce \textbf{UpLoop}, a post-training recipe based on \emph{layer-wise} recurrence. Instead of looping a whole model or a middle block, UpLoop loops each selected layer locally, preserving the pretrained depth hierarchy and avoiding feature-space mismatch. To make loop execution useful, we add hidden-wise gates on the attention and MLP residual branches, so later loops act as progressive refinements rather than redundant rewrites. Empirically, UpLoop breaks the commonly observed saturation at two loops ($R=2$) in prior looped models. Starting from Qwen3-4B Base and applying SFT, UpLoop improves the average accuracy across 20 benchmarks by 6.17\% at $R=3$. We use $R=3$ as the main setting for the best accuracy--cost trade-off, while both native and extrapolated $R=4$ yield further gains.

AI.tldr: 提出 UpLoop：一种基于逐层循环（layer-wise recurrence）的后训练升级方法，将预训练非循环 LLM 改造为循环深度模型，并通过隐维度门控避免循环冗余，在 R=3 时于 20 个基准上平均提升 6.17%。
AI.motivation: 循环（looped）大模型以循环计算换取参数存储，但多从头训练，且带循环深度的预训练代价高昂。因此将已预训练的非循环 LLM 通过后训练"升级（upcycling）"为循环模型是更具吸引力的替代方案。现有循环模型存在两个问题：整体或中段块循环会破坏预训练深度层级、引发特征空间失配；性能常在两轮循环（R=2）处饱和。
AI.method: UpLoop 采用逐层局部循环，而非循环整个模型或中间块，从而保留预训练的深度层级、避免特征空间失配。为让循环执行有效，在注意力与 MLP 残差分支上引入隐维度门控（hidden-wise gates），使后续循环成为渐进式精修而非重复改写。以 Qwen3-4B Base 为起点并施加 SFT。
AI.result: 打破以往循环模型在 R=2 处的饱和现象：R=3 时 20 个基准的平均准确率提升 6.17%；R=3 作为精度-成本最优主设定，原生与外推的 R=4 均带来进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 逐层循环加隐维度门控的后训练升级是低成本获得循环深度收益的有效路径，且循环深度收益可超越 R=2 继续累积并具备外推性。

title: CVaR-RMD: CVaR Selection Pressure for Robust Metaheuristic Discovery
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/BeyondHeaven/CVaR-RMD
summary: Large language models have recently been used to discover heuristics through iterative program search, offering a promising approach to automated algorithm design. However, candidates selected by average performance may degrade across instance families, random seeds, and problem scales because mean-based objectives can obscure rare but severe failures. We propose CVaR-RMD, a risk-sensitive evolutionary framework that uses an LLM to mutate executable heuristic programs and ranks candidates by empirical conditional value-at-risk over heterogeneous evaluation conditions. Across three combinatorial optimization domains, CVaR-based selection improves upper-tail performance and reduces failure rates while maintaining competitive mean performance. These gains persist on larger unseen instances and independently curated within-domain benchmarks

AI.tldr: 本文提出CVaR-RMD框架：用LLM通过进化式程序变异搜索启发式算法，并以经验条件风险价值（CVaR）在异构评价条件下对候选排序，从而抑制平均性能目标带来的长尾失败问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的迭代程序搜索在设计启发式算法时，多以平均性能作为候选选择标准；但平均目标会掩盖罕见而严重的失败，导致选出的候选在实例族、随机种子与问题规模变化时性能退化。
AI.method: 提出风险敏感的进化框架CVaR-RMD：由LLM对可执行的启发式程序进行变异，并在异构评估条件（实例族、随机种子、问题规模）下，用经验条件价值-at-风险（empirical CVaR）对候选进行排序选择。
AI.result: 在三个组合优化领域上，基于CVaR的选择在上尾性能上更优、失败率更低，同时平均性能保持竞争力；这些增益在更大规模的未见实例及独立构建的领域内基准上依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 将风险敏感目标（CVaR）引入LLM驱动的启发式程序搜索，可有效提升鲁棒性与泛化性，优于传统的均值导向选择策略。

title: Conjugate Compilation: Self-Improving Agentic Co-Compilation for Speculative Decoding
summary: As LLM adoption surges, scaling model serving requires unlocking stranded GPU capacity alongside deploying more GPUs. Speculative decoding brings two models into the serving process: a small draft model proposes tokens that a larger target model verifies. Yet compiling these models individually leaves their shared execution outside the compiler's optimization boundary. We introduce CONJUGATE COMPILATION, which reframes speculative decoding as a cross-model compilation problem and jointly optimizes the draft and target models within their shared execution rather than treating each in isolation. Our key insight is that cross-model compilation should be informed by the measured performance of the co-located shared execution it produces: an optimization that improves a kernel in isolation need not improve the models when they execute together. To expand cross-model opportunities, we devise operand layouts that interleave blocks from both models within common tiles, co-locating GEMM and non-GEMM work while preserving their mathematics. We realize CONJUGATE COMPILATION through a self-improving agentic search system in which an LLM edits cross-model optimization plans using the compiler and GPU execution as its environment. Each proposed plan is compiled and evaluated through its co-located shared execution, whose measured score, together with kernel-level verdicts and compiler feedback, informs subsequent proposals, while Monte Carlo tree search accumulates rewards to guide exploration. Across six single-GPU speculative-decoding configurations on NVIDIA B300 and RTX 5090 GPUs, CONJUGATE COMPILATION achieves a geometric-mean per-round speedup of 1.37x over conventional execution. Interleaved kernels raise this speedup to 1.45x, reaching 1.59x in the best case. CONJUGATE COMPILATION also improves GPU utilization on average by 1.46x on RTX 5090 and 1.50x on B300.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CONJUGATE COMPILATION，将投机解码视为跨模型编译问题，联合优化草稿模型与目标模型的共享执行，并利用LLM驱动的代理搜索系统实测协同执行性能来指导优化，在NVIDIA B300与RTX 5090上实现1.37x–1.45x加速。
AI.motivation: LLM服务规模扩张需释放被闲置的GPU算力。投机解码引入草稿模型与目标模型两个模型共享执行，但分别独立编译会使二者共享执行落在编译器优化边界之外；同时，孤立内核层面的优化未必能转化为两者协同执行时的整体收益。
AI.method: 将投机解码重构为跨模型编译问题，在共享执行范围内联合优化两个模型；以所生成的共置共享执行的实测性能作为优化依据；设计操作数布局，在公共tile内交错两个模型的block，使GEMM与非GEMM工作共置且不改变数学语义；通过LLM代理搜索系统实现，LLM以编译器与GPU执行作为环境编辑跨模型优化计划，结合内核级判定与编译器反馈，并用蒙特卡洛树搜索累积奖励引导探索。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA B300与RTX 5090的六个单GPU投机解码配置上，相对常规执行取得1.37x的每轮几何平均加速；交错内核将加速提升至1.45x，最佳达1.59x；GPU利用率平均提升1.46x（RTX 5090）与1.50x（B300）。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型、以实测共享执行性能为反馈的联合编译可有效提升投机解码的吞吐与GPU利用率，交错布局进一步扩大跨模型优化空间。

title: From Black Box to Controller: Inference-Time Steering of LLM via Feature Amplification
summary: Inference-time steering is crucial for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world applications, where they must flexibly adjust behavior preferences. For instance, a model should dynamically adjust its caution level based on the risk of the scenario. This requirement introduces a challenge: modulating the intensity of LLM preferences. Prompt engineering can require task-specific prompt design, while fine-tuning requires additional optimization and data. These requirements can make repeated behavioral adjustments costly. To address this, we introduce NeuroSteer, a plug-and-play framework that enables flexible, quantitative adjustment of LLM preferences at inference time. NeuroSteer employs a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) as its controller. Comparing neuron activation frequencies between positive and negative examples isolates "feature neurons" that correspond to target preferences such as politeness and positive sentiment. During inference, the activations of selected SAE features are amplified in the latent representations to steer the output distribution. Users can adjust the strength of this steering on a per-scenario or per-user basis, granting the LLM fine-grained, quantifiable trait modulation. Our experiments show that NeuroSteer can alter sentiment, toxicity, stance, and politeness at inference time. It achieves higher target-direction steering scores than the compared baselines in several settings, with task- and strength-dependent trade-offs in generation quality.

AI.tldr: NeuroSteer 是一个即插即用的推理时框架，利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）识别与目标偏好对应的“特征神经元”，通过放大其在潜表示中的激活来定量、可调地操控 LLM 的性格偏好。
AI.motivation: LLM 在真实部署中需根据场景风险等因素动态调整行为偏好（如谨慎程度），这本质上要求“调控偏好的强度”。但提示工程依赖任务特定设计，微调需要额外优化与数据，反复调整行为成本高昂。
AI.method: NeuroSteer 以 SAE 作为控制器：对比正负样本的神经元激活频率，隔离出对应目标偏好（如礼貌、正面情感）的“特征神经元”；推理时在潜表示中放大所选 SAE 特征的激活，从而引导输出分布；并支持按场景或按用户调节引导强度，实现细粒度、可量化的特征调制。
AI.result: 实验表明 NeuroSteer 可在推理时改变情感、毒性、立场与礼貌度；在多个设置下其目标方向引导得分高于对比基线，同时对生成质量存在依赖任务与强度的权衡。
AI.conclusion: NeuroSteer 提供了一种无需提示设计或微调、即插即用的推理时偏好定量调节方案，在引导效果上优于基线，但需权衡生成质量。

title: Latent World Models Should Plan with Distances Along the Latent Manifold
summary: Latent world models such as LeWM plan by searching for an action sequence whose predicted terminal latent is closest to the goal latent under an ambient norm, such as the Euclidean distance. Planning with such a cost assumes that proximity in the ambient latent space reflects proximity to the goal in the environment. Studying LeWM, we find that this assumption holds only in a small neighborhood around the goal, whereas farther away the L2 cost forms spurious low-cost basins that trap the planner. Yet neighborhood-based embeddings show that the latents retain the underlying physical state. We therefore hypothesize that the latents lie near a curved, low-dimensional manifold, and that the terminal cost should measure the distance along this latent manifold rather than through the ambient space. To estimate this manifold distance, we propose the Neighborhood Graph Cost (NGC), which computes shortest-path distances on a mutual nearest-neighbor graph constructed over training latents. NGC changes only the terminal cost and requires no retraining. This single change improves the planning success rate of LeWM across all four benchmark tasks and nearly solves TwoRoom and Reacher: even at the farthest goal offsets tested, NGC reaches 95% and 100% success, whereas the L2 cost falls to 27% and 81%. These results support the manifold hypothesis and our argument that latent world models should plan with distances along the latent manifold.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LeWM等潜空间世界模型的L2终端代价只在目标附近有效，远处会形成虚假低代价盆地；据此提出在潜空间流形上计算距离的邻域图代价（NGC），无需重训练即显著提升规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜空间世界模型（如LeWM）通过在环境中按欧氏（L2）等环境范数搜索使预测终端潜变量最接近目标潜变量的动作序列来规划，这隐含假设"潜空间中的邻近"等价于"环境中接近目标"。作者实证发现该假设仅在目标附近的小邻域内成立，距离较远时L2代价会产生虚假的低代价盆地，使规划器陷入局部陷阱。而基于邻域的嵌入显示潜变量仍保留了底层物理状态，说明问题出在代价度量而非表示本身。
AI.method: 作者提出"潜变量位于一个弯曲的低维流形附近"的假设，认为终端代价应度量沿该潜流形的测地距离而非环境空间中的距离。为此提出邻域图代价（NGC）：在训练潜变量上构建互最近邻（mutual nearest-neighbor）图，并在该图上计算最短路径距离作为终端代价的估计。NGC仅替换终端代价函数，不改变模型结构，也无需重新训练。
AI.result: 仅此一项改动便在四个基准任务上提升了LeWM的规划成功率。在TwoRoom和Reacher上几乎完全解决：即使在测试的最远目标偏移下，NGC仍分别达到95%和100%的成功率，而L2代价分别下降至27%和81%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持流形假设，并论证潜空间世界模型应使用沿潜流形的距离（而非环境空间距离）进行规划；终端代价度量是此类模型规划性能的关键瓶颈。

title: Whose Credential Is It? How Owner Attribution in Agent MemoryShapes Cross-User Account Misuse
summary: Shared long-term memory lets an LLM agent serving one user inadvertently retrieve another user's credentials, but it is unclear when such exposure leads to actual harm. We introduce a three-stage audit that separates three events: a foreign credential reaches the prompt (exposure), the agent acts with it (behavior), and the other user's account changes (state). In AppWorld, a store that mixes 763 past logins from all users retrieves another user's credential for 84.7 percent of required apps, yet agents rarely act on it. Misuse appears in a stress test where memory lacks the user's own credential and presents a single foreign one as the user's record: seven agents then use it in 80 to 94 percent of runs and change the victim's account in up to 43 percent, sometimes passing the official check. Naming the owner before or inside each credential line prevents most of this: with all else fixed, misuse falls from 92 to 1 of 305 paired runs, also with name-free usernames, though owner-bound notes cost 3 to 5 successful tasks per model on clean memory. A wrongly written owner largely restores misuse; trailing owner tags and added safety instructions help only some models. Agent memory should consistently record whose credential it stores, and evaluations should measure behavior, not only exposure.

AI.tldr: 该文提出三阶段审计框架，区分“凭证暴露—代理行为—账户状态变化”三个环节，发现共享长期记忆导致的跨用户凭证暴露在压力测试下会引发实际危害，而标注凭证所有者可大幅降低误用。
AI.motivation: LLM代理的共享长期记忆可能让服务单个用户的代理意外检索到其他用户的凭证，但现有工作不清楚这种暴露何时转化为真实危害，需要将暴露与危害解耦并量化。
AI.method: 提出三阶段审计：暴露（外来凭证进入提示）、行为（代理使用该凭证行动）、状态（受害者账户发生变化）；在AppWorld中构建混合763条历史登录记录的共享记忆库，并进行记忆缺失自身凭证、仅呈现单一外来凭证的压力测试；对比“在凭证前或行内标注所有者”“无姓名用户名”“所有者绑定笔记”“错误所有者”“尾部标签及安全指令”等干预。
AI.result: 混合记忆库中，84.7%的必需应用检索到他人凭证，但代理极少据此行动；压力测试下7个代理在80%–94%的运行中使用外来凭证，最多43%改变了受害者账户，有时甚至通过官方检查。标注所有者使误用从305对配对运行中的92降至1，无姓名用户名同样有效；但所有者绑定笔记在干净记忆上使每个模型损失3–5个成功任务；错误所有者标注基本恢复误用；尾部标签与安全指令仅对部分模型有效。
AI.conclusion: 代理记忆应一致记录凭证归属，评测应衡量行为而非仅暴露；所有者标注是有效但存在可用性代价的缓解手段，且依赖标注正确性。

title: Multifidelity Monte Carlo Estimator for High-Dimensional Quantities of Interest
summary: Multifidelity Monte Carlo (MFMC) reduces the cost of estimating the statistics of quantities of interest (QoIs) computed via expensive high-fidelity model by using cheaper low-fidelity models as control variates. We extend MFMC to vector-valued QoIs by replacing the scalar control-variate coefficients with matrices and minimizing a weighted mean-squared error. The optimal full-matrix coefficients are available in closed form, and their variance reduction is summarized by an effective correlation that takes the place of the squared Pearson correlation in the closed-form MFMC design. Restricting the coefficients to block-diagonal, diagonal, and scalar classes gives a nested hierarchy of estimators with increasing variance reduction and increasing pilot-data demand, with closed-form coefficients for compatible weightings. For a scalar QoI obtained by linearly projecting the state, correcting the full state before projecting is never worse at the population level. Experiments on a Gaussian problem, a reduced-order model of an advection--diffusion problem, and a coarse-grid two-phase flow problem show that the best class depends on the pilot size relative to the number of covariance quantities it must estimate, and that reusing the pilot samples lowers the mean-squared error.

AI.tldr: 本文将多重保真度蒙特卡洛(MFMC)推广到向量值QoI，用矩阵替代标量控制变量系数并最小化加权均方误差，给出闭式全矩阵系数及由其导出的有效相关性，并构建块对角/对角/标量三类嵌套估计器以揭示方差缩减与试点数据需求的权衡。
AI.motivation: 原始MFMC仅针对标量QoI，其控制变量系数为标量、以Pearson相关系数平方刻画方差缩减；当QoI为向量（如全场状态）时该框架不适用，需重新定义最优系数与相关性度量。
AI.method: 用矩阵系数替换标量系数，最小化加权均方误差，得到全矩阵系数的闭式解；定义有效相关性替代平方Pearson相关；将系数限制为块对角、对角和标量类，构造嵌套估计器层级（在相容权重下有闭式系数）；通过试点样本复用估计协方差。
AI.result: 全矩阵系数存在闭式解且其方差缩减可由有效相关性概括；全矩阵→块对角→对角→标量构成方差缩减递增、试点数据需求递增的嵌套层级；对线性投影得到的标量QoI，在总体层面先校正全状态再投影不劣于其他做法；高斯问题、平流-扩散降阶模型和粗网格两相流实验表明最优系数类别取决于试点规模与待估协方差量之比，且复用试点样本可降低均方误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为向量QoI提供了统一的MFMC矩阵系数框架与估计器层级，实践中应根据试点样本量与协方差估计维度选择系数类别，并通过复用试点样本进一步降误差。

title: PFedQFT: Personalized Federated Quantum-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Medical Large Language Models
summary: Medical data remain fragmented across institutional silos because of privacy, governance, and ownership constraints. Federated learning enables medical institutions to adapt large language models (LLMs) collaboratively without transferring raw records. However, independently parameterized low-rank adapters incur repeated parameter and communication costs across Transformer projections, while uniform aggregation may limit adaptation to heterogeneous institutional data. We propose PFedQFT, a quantum-inspired framework for personalized federated fine-tuning with a compact shared adapter. Specifically, PFedQFT constructs reusable orthonormal adaptation bases from compact skew-symmetric generators using a truncated matrix-exponential approximation followed by QR orthonormalization. Compatible projections reuse these bases, while a globally shared full core preserves the flexibility of each projection. Each client further maintains a lightweight private residual operator, whose directions are learned globally and whose coefficients remain local. Experiments on seven public medical tasks and multiple LLM backbones show substantial reductions in trainable parameters and per-round adapter upload volume, with competitive predictive performance on most tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PFedQFT，一种基于量子启发、采用紧凑共享适配器的个性化联邦微调框架，通过可复用的正交归一适配基、全局共享核心与客户端私有残差，在显著降低可训练参数与通信量的同时保持有竞争力的医疗预测性能。
AI.motivation: 医疗数据因隐私、治理与所有权约束分散在各机构孤岛中，联邦学习可在不传输原始记录的前提下协作适配LLM。但现有独立参数化的低秩适配器在Transformer各投影层重复产生参数与通信开销，且统一的均匀聚合难以适应异构的机构数据分布。
AI.method: PFedQFT由紧凑的斜对称生成元经截断矩阵指数近似与QR正交归一化，构造可复用的正交归一适配基；兼容的投影共享这些基，并配合全局共享的完整核心矩阵以保持各投影的表达灵活性；每个客户端另维护轻量私有残差算子，其方向全局学习、系数保持本地。
AI.result: 在七个公开医疗任务及多种LLM骨干网络上，显著减少可训练参数量与每轮适配器上传通信量，且在多数任务上取得有竞争力的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: PFedQFT为隐私受限的医疗多机构LLM协作微调提供了参数与通信高效的个性化联邦方案，验证了紧凑共享适配基与方向-系数解耦个性化的有效性，可作为资源受限场景下的实用范式。

title: Decentralized Online Exp-Concave Optimization
summary: Decentralized Online Convex Optimization (D-OCO) is a fundamental framework in which a set of local agents aims to minimize a sequence of global loss functions using only local computations and communications. While recent work has established near-optimal regret guarantees for convex and strongly convex losses, the case of exp-concave losses remains an open challenge: specifically, whether logarithmic regret is achievable. In this paper, we answer this question affirmatively by proposing Decentralized Online Newton Step (D-ONS), which adapts the idea of blocking and accelerated gossip to the Online Newton Step algorithm in a non-trivial manner. Concretely, our algorithm achieves a regret bound of $O\left(Nd(1-σ_2)^{-1/2}\,\log^2(T) \right)$ where $N$ is the number of agents, $d$ is the dimension, $T$ is the horizon, and $1-σ_2$ represents the spectral gap of the network. To our knowledge, this is the first logarithmic regret bound for decentralized online exp-concave optimization. We further establish a nearly matching lower bound of $Ω\left(Nd (1-σ_2)^{-1/2}\,\log(T/N) \right)$ showing the near optimality of our upper bound. Finally, we extend our algorithm to decentralized online linear regression in which the feasible domain is unbounded and features and labels are locally observed. By gossiping covariance and label-feature statistics, we also achieve logarithmic regret.

AI.tldr: 提出去中心化在线牛顿法D-ONS，首次实现指数凹损失下的对数遗憾界，并给出匹配下界及去中心化在线线性回归的扩展。
AI.motivation: 去中心化在线凸优化(D-OCO)中，凸与强凸损失已获得近最优遗憾保证，但指数凹(exp-concave)损失能否达到对数遗憾仍是开放问题。本文旨在正面回答该问题。
AI.method: 提出 Decentralized Online Newton Step (D-ONS)：将分块(blocking)与加速gossip思想以非平凡方式融入在线牛顿步算法，从而在仅本地计算与通信的约束下适配指数凹损失的二阶信息累积。
AI.result: 遗憾上界为 O(Nd(1-σ₂)^{-1/2} log²T)，其中N为智能体数、d为维度、T为时域、1-σ₂为网络谱隙；并证明下界 Ω(Nd(1-σ₂)^{-1/2} log(T/N))，表明上界近最优。
AI.conclusion: 这是去中心化在线指数凹优化的首个对数遗憾界。进一步将算法扩展到可行域无界、特征与标签均为本地观测的去中心化在线线性回归，通过gossip协方差与标签-特征统计量同样实现对数遗憾。

title: Fine-Grained Units, Flat Decisions: Hierarchical Micro-Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Models
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. Zukang Xu and Xinpei Gao contributed equally. Corresponding author: Dawei Yang
summary: Micro-expert pruning reduces the capacity of mixture-of-experts (MoE) models by removing coupled channels within routed experts. However, finer pruning granularity alone does not guarantee the preservation of downstream capabilities, as similar language-modeling perplexity can accompany substantially different task performance. We revisit micro-expert mask construction as two distinct decisions: allocating retained capacity across experts and selecting channels within that capacity. We propose UC-RAMP, a two-stage post-training pruning framework that explicitly separates these decisions. CAPE uses cross-domain calibration evidence to redistribute expert widths under an exact layer-wise budget, while RAMP refines channel composition at fixed widths through one-out, one-in exchanges guided by a channel-interaction surrogate. Across three MoE models at 25% and 50% routed-expert channel pruning, UC-RAMP achieves the highest ten-task mean accuracy among evaluated pruning methods in five of six settings. At 50% pruning, it outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 8.19, 3.96, and 6.14 percentage points across the three models, respectively. In a single-A100 deployment at 25% pruning, UC-RAMP reduces measured time to first token by 19.7--23.9% and time per output token by 20.2--22.3% relative to the unpruned model. The code is available at https://github.com/xzktx003/UC_RAMP.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段训练后剪枝框架UC-RAMP，将微专家掩码构建显式分解为"跨专家容量分配"(CAPE)与"固定宽度下的通道选择"(RAMP)，在三个MoE模型上于25%/50%通道剪枝下取得最优平均准确率，并带来实际加速。
AI.motivation: 微专家(micro-expert)剪枝通过移除路由专家内部的耦合通道来压缩MoE模型容量，但更细的剪枝粒度并不能保证下游能力保持：相似的困惑度可能对应差异显著的任务表现，说明单纯细化粒度不足以保留下游能力。作者因此将掩码构建重新审视为两个独立决策。
AI.method: 将微专家掩码构建分解为两个决策：(1) 保留容量在各专家间的分配；(2) 该容量内通道的选取。UC-RAMP为两阶段训练后剪枝框架：CAPE利用跨域校准证据，在精确的逐层预算约束下重新分配各专家宽度；RAMP在固定宽度下通过"一出一进"(one-out, one-in)通道交换精化通道组成，交换由通道间交互代理指标(surrogate)引导。
AI.result: 在三个MoE模型、25%与50%路由专家通道剪枝下，六个设置中有五个获得十任务平均准确率最高；50%剪枝时分别领先最强对比基线8.19、3.96、6.14个百分点。单A100部署下25%剪枝相对未剪枝模型，首字延迟(TTFT)降低19.7–23.9%，每输出token时间(TPOT)降低20.2–22.3%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 把微专家掩码构建拆分为容量分配与通道选择两阶段，比单纯提升剪枝粒度更有效，可在保持层预算与宽度的前提下显著改善下游任务性能并获得实际推理加速。

title: LLM Agents as Suppliers of Physical System Models: Calibration and Acceptance in Modelica
summary: To procure a model of a device, a client hands a supplier a description, sometimes with recorded data or a target response, and accepts the model against this handover. We let LLM coding agents act as the supplier on handovers with data, building Modelica models from library components for four simulated systems and a real switching magnet, and ask what acceptance certifies. Several agents reach the noise floor, but a handover admits a set of models: the description leaves parts of the structure open, and the data narrow it only to the agreed accuracy. We therefore accept by membership in this set, not by matching one reference, and add layers above behaviour: a physical invariant exposes an energy-creating model at the noise floor. Interpretability becomes a property of the delivered model, tested on a variant, read where none exists and shaped through the handover. Most failures are fits delivered with a systematic residual on their own fitting data, where the handover left open how close is close enough. In a follow-up, stating a threshold makes the agents compare against it, and more deliveries pass. The argument applies wherever a handover underspecifies a model meant to be read, not only run.

AI.tldr: 论文把“客户—供应商交付单”框架用于LLM编码代理构建Modelica模型的任务，主张验收应基于“模型集合的成员资格”，并补充物理不变量与可解释性等层次，而非匹配单一参考模型。
AI.motivation: 传统模型交付验收只检验行为是否达标，但交付单（描述+数据/目标响应）本身欠定：描述留有结构开放项，数据只能把模型收窄到约定精度，因此“匹配唯一参考”不足以说明验收到底认证了什么。
AI.method: 让LLM编码代理充当供应商，基于库组件为四个仿真系统和一个真实开关磁体构建Modelica模型；交付单含数据。用噪声下限判定拟合水平，以“模型集合成员资格”代替单一参考匹配，并在行为层之上加入物理不变量检验（暴露噪声下限上仍创造能量的模型），以及针对交付模型（及其变体）的可解释性测试；随后做追加实验，在交付单中明确给出阈值。
AI.result: 多个代理达到噪声下限；但同一交付单对应一组可接受模型，而非唯一解；物理不变量成功识别出在噪声下限上违反能量守恒的模型；可解释性被证明是交付模型的属性，可在变体上测试、在缺失处被读出、并可通过交付单塑造。多数失败是“在自身拟合数据上仍带系统性残差”的拟合，根源在于交付单未说明“多接近才算够”。追加实验中明确阈值后，代理会据此比较，更多交付通过。
AI.conclusion: 当交付单对模型欠定、且模型不仅是“运行”更要“被阅读”时，验收应基于模型集合成员资格并叠加不变量与可解释性层；明确阈值能显著提升交付合格率。该论证适用于任何交付单欠定模型的情形，不限于本文的系统。

title: TimelineAgent: An LLM-based Framework for Query-Centric Event Timeline Extraction Across Multiple Documents
summary: Query-centric cross-document event timeline extraction aims to construct event timelines from multiple documents under diverse query focuses. The task is very challenging due to the heterogeneous event modeling and reasoning requirements arising from both the intrinsic complexity of cross-document timeline construction and the diversity of query focuses. In this paper, we propose TimelineAgent, an LLM-based multi-agent framework featuring a multi-stage reasoning workflow, where heterogeneous event features are organized into reusable skills and orchestrated through a goal-oriented protocol. To facilitate evaluation, we construct a benchmark covering diverse query focuses. Experimental results show that TimelineAgent consistently outperforms existing methods, offering a practical framework for complex real-world timeline construction.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM的多智能体框架TimelineAgent，通过多阶段推理工作流解决以查询为中心的跨文档事件时间线抽取问题，并构建覆盖多样查询焦点的评测基准。
AI.motivation: 跨文档时间线构建本身具有复杂性，加之查询焦点多样，导致异构事件建模与推理需求高度异质，现有方法难以统一处理，因而该任务极具挑战性。
AI.method: 设计TimelineAgent：一个LLM驱动的多智能体框架，包含多阶段推理工作流；将异构事件特征组织为可复用技能（reusable skills），并通过目标导向协议（goal-oriented protocol）进行编排调度。同时构建覆盖多种查询焦点的评测基准。
AI.result: 实验表明TimelineAgent在构建的基准上持续优于现有方法，为真实场景下的复杂时间线构建提供了实用框架。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体+技能化异构事件特征+目标导向编排是应对查询导向跨文档时间线抽取的有效范式，为复杂现实应用提供可行方案。

title: Synergy-Aware Residual Flow Matching for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
summary: Predicting single-cell responses to genetic and chemical perturbations is important for understanding regulatory mechanisms and prioritizing therapeutic interventions. Existing methods have made progress by modeling perturbation-conditioned expression shifts with neural networks, graph priors, foundation-model representations, or distributional generative models. However, combinatorial perturbation prediction remains challenging because much of the response can be explained by additive single-perturbation effects, while the biologically informative signal often lies in a smaller non-additive residual induced by perturbation interactions. Directly generating the full post-perturbation expression profile may therefore allocate substantial capacity to the dominant additive component and underemphasize synergy-specific structure. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SynGeneFlow}, a synergy-aware flow matching framework that anchors the source distribution at an additive prior and learns a residual flow toward the true perturbed state. SynGeneFlow further incorporates perturbation-conditioned gene interaction modeling, where a static gene-gene mask provides biological structure and a perturbation-dependent deformation bias dynamically modulates gene-gene coupling. To preserve population-level response structure, we align both endpoint distributions and biological residual distributions with MMD-based regularization. We evaluate SynGeneFlow on genetic and drug perturbation benchmarks under observed-single, held-out, and cross-modality settings. The results demonstrate that residualizing flow matching around additive perturbation effects provides a biologically grounded and robust framework for single-cell perturbation response prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SynGeneFlow，一种以加性先验为源分布、学习残差流的协同感知流匹配框架，用于单细胞组合扰动的响应预测。
AI.motivation: 组合扰动预测困难：响应中大部分可由单一扰动的加性效应解释，具生物学意义的信号位于较小的非加性残差中；直接生成完整扰动后表达谱会使模型容量被主导的加性成分占据，弱化协同特异性结构。
AI.method: 基于流匹配（flow matching）的协同感知框架：将源分布锚定于加性先验，学习指向真实扰动状态的残差流；引入扰动条件化的基因互作建模——静态基因-基因掩码提供生物学结构，扰动依赖的形变偏置动态调制基因间耦合；并用MMD正则对齐端点分布与生物学残差分布以保持群体层面响应结构。
AI.result: 在遗传与药物扰动基准上，于observed-single、held-out及跨模态设定中进行了评估，结果显示围绕加性扰动效应构建残差流匹配是一种有生物学依据且鲁棒的框架。
AI.conclusion: 将流匹配残差化于加性扰动效应之上，可为单细胞扰动响应预测提供生物学合理且稳健的建模范式。

title: ActTime: Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series
summary: Time-series models increasingly condition on known future inputs. In controlled systems, some of these inputs are actions that can be changed, compared, and optimized before execution. A model must therefore do more than predict the realized future: it must predict how outcomes change under different actions from the same observed history and support reliable comparison of candidate plans. We introduce ActTime, an action-conditioned world model for time series. Over the observed history, ActTime updates variable-specific latent states through an action-conditioned transition and corrects them using observations. It then rolls the same transition forward under candidate actions to generate future trajectories. Training uses only factual trajectories, without paired alternative-action outcomes or planning supervision. We construct a simulator-grounded evaluation suite across building energy, traffic, greenhouse climate, and inventory management, covering factual prediction, intervention-effect prediction, offline decision making, and closed-loop planning. ActTime ranks first in 12 of 16 domain-task settings. Across eight methods, the mean pairwise model-ranking reversal rate is 17.8% between factual prediction and intervention fidelity, and rises to 28.4% between intervention fidelity and decision ranking. These results show that factual accuracy, intervention fidelity, and decision quality are related but not interchangeable.

AI.tldr: 提出动作条件世界模型 ActTime，仅用事实轨迹训练，即可在候选动作下推演未来并比较方案；构建含四类系统的仿真评测，在16项设置中12项第一，并揭示事实预测、干预保真与决策质量评价间的显著排名反转。
AI.motivation: 时序模型日益依赖已知未来输入，而在受控系统中部分输入是可比较、可优化的动作，模型不仅要预测已实现的未来，还要预测同一历史下不同动作导致的结果变化并支持候选方案比较；现有方法缺乏针对干预效果与决策质量的评估。
AI.method: ActTime 在观测历史上通过动作条件转移更新变量特定的隐状态，并用观测进行校正；随后在候选动作下滚动同一转移生成未来轨迹；训练仅使用事实轨迹，无需配对的反事实结果或规划监督。
AI.result: 构建覆盖建筑能耗、交通、温室气候与库存管理的仿真评测套件，涵盖事实预测、干预效应预测、离线决策与闭环规划；ActTime 在16个领域-任务设置中12个排名第一；跨8种方法，事实预测与干预保真之间的平均成对排名反转率为17.8%，干预保真与决策排名之间升至28.4%。
AI.conclusion: 事实准确性、干预保真度与决策质量相互关联但不可互换，单一事实预测指标不足以评价面向决策的时序世界模型。

title: Beyond the Teacher: Understanding and Preserving Distillation Overshoot in Agentic On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains agents on their own trajectories using supervision from a stronger teacher. We uncover a counterintuitive phenomenon in multi-turn agentic tasks: a smaller, initially weaker student can substantially outperform its teacher during training, only to regress as distillation continues. We term this phenomenon distillation overshoot. Through decision- and task-level analyses, we trace overshoot to two competing effects of OPD: repairing weak student decisions and eroding successful student choices that the teacher disfavors. Early in training, repair outpaces erosion, allowing the student to combine the teacher's corrections with its own strengths and surpass the teacher. As training continues, erosion overtakes repair, causing these gains to vanish. Motivated by this finding, we propose Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation (SPOD), which selectively masks conflicting teacher supervision on successful student choices and introduces a soft probability floor to counteract their erosion, while retaining teacher guidance elsewhere. SPOD requires only binary episode success and model probabilities already available during OPD. Across two model families and three agentic benchmarks, SPOD consistently outperforms ordinary OPD and evaluated variants, improving final success by up to 15.2 percentage points and surpassing the teacher by up to 20.0 points. Moreover, SPOD's final checkpoints outperform even ordinary OPD's best intermediate checkpoints in all six settings, demonstrating that beyond-teacher gains can be not only preserved but further extended. Code: https://github.com/Jike338/SPOD

AI.tldr: 该文发现多轮智能体任务中on-policy distillation存在"蒸馏过冲"现象：较小的学生模型在训练中可短暂超越教师，但随训练继续而性能回退；作者将其归因于"修复弱决策"与"侵蚀成功决策"两种竞争效应，并提出SPOD方法加以缓解。
AI.motivation: 已有OPD以更强教师监督学生自身轨迹，但作者观察到反直觉现象：初期更弱的学生在训练中可显著超越教师，随后又随蒸馏进行而退化（distillation overshoot）。论文旨在揭示该现象成因并提供解决方案。
AI.method: 通过决策级与任务级分析，将过冲归因于两类竞争效应：修复学生弱决策（repair）与侵蚀教师不认可的学生成功选择（erosion）。据此提出Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation（SPOD）：对成功的学 生选择有选择地屏蔽冲突的教师监督，并引入软概率下界（soft probability floor）以抵抗侵蚀，其余位置保留教师指导；仅需二值回合成功信号与OPD中已有的模型概率。
AI.result: 在两个模型家族、三个智能体基准上，SPOD一致优于普通OPD及所评估的变体，最终成功率最高提升15.2个百分点，并最多超越教师20.0个百分点；在全部六种设置中，SPOD的最终检查点均优于普通OPD的最佳中间检查点。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏过冲源于repair与erosion的动态失衡：早期修复占优使学生短暂超越教师，后期侵蚀占优致增益消失。SPOD通过保留成功选择、抑制侵蚀，可不仅保留甚至进一步扩展超越教师的收益，表明"超越教师"的增益可被稳定保持并放大。

title: TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction
summary: Accurate inpatient risk prediction requires modeling heterogeneous clinical evidence that accumulates irregularly over time. This challenge spans in-hospital mortality, prolonged length of stay, and readmission, each with task-specific observation windows. Existing multimodal approaches combine structured health record data, chest x-rays, and clinical text, but primarily focus on modality fusion or missing-modality compensation, with limited attention to temporal trajectories over an admission. We propose TRACE (TRAjectory modeling of multimodal Clinical Events), a daily-scale framework organizing clinical events into day-level trajectories, separating day-invariant global context from day-specific local events drawn from EHR data, chest x-rays, radiology reports, and discharge summaries. The trajectory is encoded using temporal attention, allowing unavailable modalities to emit no tokens. A phenotype-guided contrastive objective further organizes admissions under heterogeneous disease distributions. Across cohorts from MIMIC-IV, eICU, and MIMIC-III comprising nearly 180,000 total stays, we evaluate TRACE on mortality, length of stay, and readmission prediction. TRACE achieves the highest AUROC across all nine dataset-task settings and the highest ACC in eight, outperforming baselines. Ablation studies validate our attention masks and contrastive learning, while trajectory-level attribution localizes risk-associated hospital days and modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE框架，将多模态临床事件组织为日尺度轨迹，用时间注意力编码并配合表型引导对比学习，在三大数据集九项任务上取得最优AUROC。
AI.motivation: 住院风险预测需建模随时间不规则累积的异构临床证据，且不同任务（院内死亡、延长住院、再入院）观测窗口各异。现有多模态方法侧重模态融合或缺失模态补偿，对住院期间的时间轨迹关注不足。
AI.method: TRACE将EHR、胸片、放射报告、出院小结中的临床事件组织为日级轨迹，分离日不变全局上下文与日特异局部事件；采用时间注意力编码轨迹，使不可用模态不产生token；引入表型引导的对比目标以应对异质疾病分布下的入院样本组织。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV、eICU、MIMIC-III近18万次住院上评测：九项数据集-任务设置中AUROC全部最高，八项ACC最高。消融实验验证注意力掩码与对比学习有效性，轨迹级归因可定位风险相关住院日与模态。
AI.conclusion: 日尺度多模态轨迹建模结合表型对比学习能有效提升多任务住院风险预测性能，并提供可解释的时序与模态归因。

title: PACT: NVFP4 Data-Flow LoRA Fine-Tuning on Consumer GPUs
summary: Fine-tuning language models on consumer GPUs is constrained by computation and memory. Although LoRA reduces trainable parameters and optimizer state, frozen projections remain expensive, and activations retained for backward can dominate memory usage. We present PACT, a LoRA fine-tuning system that accelerates frozen projections with native NVFP4 GEMMs while reducing quantization and dequantization overhead and limiting quantization error. To reduce activation memory, PACT reuses quantized RMSNorm outputs and saves gate/up activations in NVFP4 for backward. To limit numerical error, it preserves BF16 inputs for forward nonlinear operations and calibrates frozen weights offline using GPTQ adapted to NVFP4 scales and quantized activations. Fused nonlinear kernels and cached forward and backward weight layouts reduce quantization and dequantization overhead. Evaluations across multiple models and tasks on a 16\,GB RTX~5080 show lower memory usage and faster LoRA fine-tuning with competitive accuracy, enabling model adaptation on resource-constrained consumer hardware.

AI.tldr: PACT：面向消费级GPU的LoRA微调系统，用原生NVFP4 GEMM加速冻结投影、以NVFP4保存激活降低显存、并用GPTQ离线校准控制量化误差。
AI.motivation: 在消费级GPU上微调受算力与显存双重约束：LoRA虽减少可训练参数与优化器状态，但冻结投影计算仍昂贵，且反向传播需保存的激活占用大量显存。
AI.method: 1）用原生NVFP4 GEMM加速冻结投影，降低量化/反量化开销；2）复用已量化的RMSNorm输出，并将gate/up激活以NVFP4保存供反向使用以省显存；3）前向非线性运算保留BF16输入，冻结权重用适配NVFP4 scale与量化激活的GPTQ离线校准以限制误差；4）融合非线性kernel并缓存前/反向权重布局减少量化/反量化开销。
AI.result: 在16GB RTX 5080上跨多模型多任务评估，显存占用更低、LoRA微调更快，且精度具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PACT使模型适配可在资源受限的消费级硬件上完成。

title: EvalRx: Agentic Diagnosis and Verified Repair of Foundation Models
comment: 23 pages. Technical report. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/evalvitals/evalrx
summary: Model evaluation reveals where models fail, but rarely why or whether a proposed fix genuinely works. We introduce EvalRx, an open-source agentic framework for statistically grounded model diagnosis and repair. EvalRx discovers systematic failure modes, explores candidate mechanisms, formulates falsifiable hypotheses, and verifies them by executing frozen, pre-specified tests before using supported diagnoses to guide tiered repair. Candidate repairs are validated against the unchanged model and promoted only when they improve the target behavior without unacceptable regression. Across language, vision-language, and audio-language settings spanning Gemini, Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, EvalRx improves performance in all 12 evaluated model family-modality combinations, with gains ranging from +1.4 to +10.9 percentage points (+5.8 points on average). These results show that model evaluation can serve not only to measure failures, but to support an auditable process for diagnosing and repairing them.

AI.tldr: EvalRx：一个开源的智能体框架，将模型评测从"测量失败"推进到"诊断失败原因并验证修复是否真正有效"，在12个模型族-模态组合上平均提升5.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有模型评测只能揭示模型在何处失败，却很少解释为何失败，也难以判断所提出的修复方案是否真正有效，缺乏统计严谨性与可审计性。
AI.method: 提出EvalRx智能体框架：(1)发现系统性失败模式；(2)探索候选失效机制；(3)构建可证伪假设；(4)通过执行冻结的、预先指定的测试来验证假设；(5)用获支持的诊断指导分层修复；(6)在未改动的模型上验证候选修复，仅在目标行为提升且无不可接受回归时采纳。
AI.result: 在Gemini、Qwen、Gemma、Nemotron等模型上，覆盖语言、视觉-语言、音频-语言三类设置，全部12个模型族-模态组合均获得提升，增益为+1.4至+10.9个百分点，平均+5.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 模型评测不仅能测量失败，还能支撑一个可审计的失败诊断与修复流程。

title: HCFM: Helmholtz Component Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection
comment: To appear as a conference paper in ICDE 2027
summary: Flow Matching (FM) is an efficient simulation-free approach for training flow-based generative models, making it a promising foundation for scalable time-series anomaly detection (TSAD). However, standard FM learns a monolithic vector field in which nominal transport and local density-changing behavior are entangled. This creates a central challenge for TSAD; local expansion and contraction carry crucial anomaly-sensitive information, yet isolating this signal requires expensive Jacobian-trace estimation over the entire field. We propose \emph{Helmholtz Component Flow Matching} (HCFM), an unsupervised TSAD framework that parameterizes the vector field prediction network with separate transport, compression, and residual heads. The transport head is constrained to be divergence-free, so divergence estimation is restricted to the compression head, while a lightweight residual head absorbs the remaining mismatch. This structured parameterization improves scalability and detection performance by separating volume-preserving nominal transport from density-changing compression, yielding cleaner anomaly signals from distinct deviations of nominal behavior. Experiments on large-scale univariate and multivariate TSAD benchmarks show that HCFM consistently improves detection accuracy while maintaining efficient inference compared with 16 baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/TrustAIoT/HCFM__time-series-anomaly/

AI.tldr: 提出Helmholtz分量流匹配（HCFM），将流匹配向量场分解为无散度的传输头、压缩头与残差头，把散度估计限制在压缩头上，从而在时间序列异常检测中获得更干净的异常信号，并在16个基线上提升检测精度。
AI.motivation: 流匹配（FM）是高效的无仿真生成模型训练方法，具备可扩展时间序列异常检测（TSAD）的潜力。但标准FM学习的是单一的整体向量场，名义传输与局部密度变化行为相互纠缠。对TSAD而言，局部膨胀与收缩携带关键的异常敏感信息，但要从整体场中隔离该信号需对整个场做昂贵的Jacobian迹估计，这是核心难题。
AI.method: HCFM为无监督TSAD框架，将向量场预测网络参数化为分离的传输头、压缩头和残差头：传输头被约束为无散度（divergence-free），使散度估计仅需作用于压缩头；轻量残差头吸收剩余不匹配项。以此将体积保持的名义传输与改变密度的压缩行为结构性解耦。
AI.result: 在大规模单变量与多变量TSAD基准上，HCFM相比16个基线持续提升检测精度，同时保持高效推理。结构化参数化还提升了可扩展性，并因传输与压缩的偏离可分别刻画而给出更清晰的异常信号。
AI.conclusion: 通过Helmholtz式分解的向量场参数化，HCFM在无需全Jacobian迹估计的前提下有效利用密度变化信息，兼顾检测性能与推理效率，为FM-based TSAD提供了可扩展的结构化方案。

title: From Trace to Fix: Residual Task State in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Recovering from failures in long-horizon, stateful language agents is challenging because the action introducing a defect, the symptom exposing it, and the persistent state requiring repair frequently diverge. Existing methods largely focus on retrospective failure attribution, leaving sequential diagnosis and state repair poorly integrated under constrained budgets. We introduce TRACE-FIX, a unified recovery framework centered on versioned residual task state. Trace transforms execution logs into a structured dependency-linked ledger, prioritizing unresolved task requirements rather than salient surface errors. Fix formulates recovery as budgeted planning over admissible actions, incorporating outcome forecasting and explicit repair-reserve constraints to prevent premature budget exhaustion. To rigorously decouple localization accuracy from downstream repair capability, we present LongH-Debug, evaluating root-cause attribution, verified-fault recovery, and end-to-end closed-loop execution independently. Our empirical analysis demonstrates that structured residual tracking substantially improves causal localization over raw-trace baselines, while budget-aware sequential planning converts verified fault signals into more reliable task recovery without destructive trial-and-error. Code is available at https://github.com/toffeecat/tracedp.

AI.tldr: 提出 TRACE-FIX 统一恢复框架，基于版本化残差任务状态，将失败定位与有预算约束的状态修复整合，并构建 LongH-Debug 基准解耦评估
AI.motivation: 长程、有状态语言智能体的失败恢复困难，因为引入缺陷的动作、暴露症状的动作与需修复的持久状态往往相互分离；现有方法多聚焦回溯性失败归因，在预算约束下顺序诊断与状态修复整合不足
AI.method: TRACE-FIX 含两部分：Trace 将执行日志转化为结构化、依赖关联的账本，优先处理未解决的任务需求而非显著的表层错误；Fix 将恢复建模为预算约束下对可容许动作的规划，引入结果预测与显式修复预留约束以避免预算过早耗尽。并构建 LongH-Debug，分别评估根因归因、经验证故障恢复与端到端闭环执行
AI.result: 结构化残差跟踪相比原始轨迹基线显著提升因果定位精度；预算感知的顺序规划能将已验证的故障信号转化为更可靠的任务恢复，且避免破坏性试错
AI.conclusion: 将追踪与修复统一于版本化残差状态之上，并解耦评估定位与修复能力，为长程有状态智能体的可靠失败恢复提供了有效范式；代码已开源

title: Policy Is Not Capability: Some Safety Benchmarks Measure Which Definition of "Unsafe" You Trained On
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, Sydney. 20 pages, 5 figures
summary: A guardrail classifier is reported as if unsafe were a property of text. It is not: it is a property of a policy, and the policy enters the model through its labels. We exploit an accident of an industrial deployment in which the same ~53k prompts were labelled twice, under two operational definitions ("is this a request for harmful content?" and "would a moderator block this?"), and used to train ten guardrail arms sharing architecture, codebase and optimiser family, at two model scales. First, the guardrail's own training corpus already contained the benchmarks: JailbreakBench-benign is 88% and OR-Bench-hard 82% present in the training pools, two over-refusal benchmarks, the kind a guardrail reports to argue it does not over-block.
