Everything below is decontaminated. Second, safety benchmarks stratify sharply by how much of their score is decided by the label definition rather than by the model: with architecture and optimiser fixed, the range across the ten arms is 0.99 on HarmBench-copyright and 0.043 on WildGuard-benign, a 23x spread. Third, a benchmark score can be moved across its entire range by 0.03% of the parameters. Across these arms HarmBench-copyright spans 0-100 and OR-Bench-hard over-refusal 3.4-56.4%, and the four arms whose last supervision signal carries a given policy occupy one extreme of both (exact rank p=0.005, or 0.04-0.14 at worst), at unchanged detection capability. For a distilled student the teacher's soft labels do this even when every hard label carries the other policy, so teacher provenance is an unrecorded confound in any released checkpoint. Fourth, validation accuracy on the one split that grades all twenty arms tracks agreement with the annotator's policy (rho=+0.74), not detection capability (rho=+0.34). We argue that guardrail evaluations should report contamination, a seed floor and the definition they were graded against as first-class variables.

AI.tldr: 护栏分类器的"安全性"不是文本属性而是策略属性；同一批~53k提示用两种标注定义训练10个护栏分支后，各安全基准分数随标签定义剧烈漂移（同一基准内跨分支极差最大达0.99，23倍差异），0.03%参数即可把基准分推到全量程两端，且验证准确率反映的是与标注策略的一致度（rho=+0.74）而非检测能力（rho=+0.34）。
AI.motivation: 现有工作把护栏分类器的基准分数当作模型固有能力来报告，忽视了"不安全"实为策略定义的产物、通过标签进入模型这一事实。作者希望量化标签定义、随机种子与数据污染对护栏评测的贡献，并把它们提升为一等评测变量。
AI.method: 利用一次工业部署中的"意外重复标注"：同一约53k提示按两种操作化定义（"是否为有害内容请求" vs "审核员是否会拦截"）各标注一次，训练10个护栏分支，架构、代码库、优化器族固定，覆盖两个模型规模；先做训练集与基准的去污染，再跨分支比较各安全基准得分极差，做参数级微扰实验（含精确秩检验p=0.005），并考察蒸馏学生中教师软标签的策略传导，最后用同时评阅20个分支的单一划分上的验证准确率做相关性分析。
AI.result: 1) 训练语料已含基准：JailbreakBench-benign 88%、OR-Bench-hard 82% 出现在训练池中，且两者均为过度拒答基准（去污染后结论仍成立）。2) 架构与优化器固定下，10个分支间极差 HarmBench-copyright 为0.99、WildGuard-benign 为0.043，相差约23倍。3) 0.03%参数即可让基准分跨越全量程：HarmBench-copyright从0到100，OR-Bench-hard过度拒答率从3.4%到56.4%；末次监督信号携带某策略的4个分支同时位于两端（精确秩p=0.005，最差0.04–0.14），而检测能力不变。蒸馏学生中，即便所有硬标签携带相反策略，教师软标签仍主导该偏移，故教师来源是发布检查点中的未记录混杂。4) 唯一评阅全部20个分支的划分上，验证准确率与标注者策略一致度相关 rho=+0.74，与检测能力相关仅 rho=+0.34。
AI.conclusion: 护栏基准分数主要编码的是标签策略而非检测能力，且可被极小参数扰动与环境/教师来源等隐性因素操控，存在"分数可游戏"与"混杂未记录"的双重风险。作者主张护栏评测必须将数据污染核查、种子下限（seed floor）以及所依据的标注定义作为一等变量显式报告。

title: Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Enhancing LLM Agents for Automated Fact-Checking with Human Expert Skills
summary: Automated fact-checking (AFC) systems powered by large language model (LLM) agents still face challenges in evidence retrieval and claim verification. Existing approaches improve their capabilities through computationally costly post-training or human-in-the-loop feedback that is difficult to scale. To transfer professional fact-checking expertise to LLM agents efficiently, we distill publicly available guidelines published by Agence France-Presse (AFP) Fact Check into a reusable, modular Professional Fact-Checking Skill (PFC-Skill). We then present SkillCheck, the first AFC system that gives LLM agents dynamic access to PFC-Skill to guide evidence retrieval and claim verification at inference time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkillCheck improves upon skill-free DEFAME baselines across multiple LLM backbones, with gains of 2.2--4.8 pp. in Accuracy and 1.5--6.3 pp. in Macro-F1 on the AVeriTeC benchmark. Notably, SkillCheck with GPT-4o-Mini exceeds DEFAME with GPT-4o by 3.4 pp. in Accuracy while cutting inference cost by roughly 61%. The performance gains also extend to open-web retrieval. Ablations show that incorporating the skill during evidence retrieval provides most of the gains, while incorporation into both stages yields the best overall performance. Case studies show that PFC-Skill enables more targeted search and closer scrutiny of evidence. To conclude, our work shows that LLM agents can "stand on the shoulders of giants" by drawing on the best practices of professional fact-checkers, substantially enhancing AFC performance without extra training or continuous human supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出将AFP事实核查指南蒸馏为模块化"专业事实核查技能"(PFC-Skill)，并构建SkillCheck系统，使LLM智能体在推理时动态调用该技能指导证据检索与断言验证，无需额外训练即可显著提升自动事实核查性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自动事实核查（AFC）系统在证据检索与断言验证上仍存不足，改进手段主要依赖计算昂贵的后训练或难以扩展的人工反馈闭环；如何高效地将专业事实核查经验迁移给LLM智能体，是本文要解决的问题。
AI.method: 将法新社（AFP）Fact Check公开指南蒸馏为可复用的模块化PFC-Skill；构建SkillCheck系统，使LLM智能体在推理阶段动态访问该技能，分别用于指导证据检索与断言验证两个阶段；在AVeriTeC基准上跨多个LLM骨干进行实验，并做开放网络检索扩展与消融、案例分析。
AI.result: 相较无技能的DEFAME基线，SkillCheck在多个LLM骨干上Accuracy提升2.2–4.8个百分点、Macro-F1提升1.5–6.3个百分点；GPT-4o-Mini版SkillCheck较GPT-4o版DEFAME准确率高3.4个百分点，推理成本降低约61%；增益可延伸至开放网络检索；消融显示检索阶段引入技能贡献最大，两阶段同时引入整体最佳；案例显示技能带来更精准的检索与更严格的证据审视。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体可通过借鉴专业事实核查者的最佳实践"站在巨人肩膀上"，在无需额外训练与持续人工监督的情况下显著提升自动事实核查性能。

title: The Optimal Sample Complexity of Pointwise Replicable Agnostic Learning
summary: Pointwise replicability asks that two independently trained predictors, using the same random seed, agree at each fixed query with high probability. We determine its optimal agnostic sample complexity on finite and countable domains. For every nonempty binary class of finite VC dimension $d\ge1$, the required number of independent examples is $Θ\!\left(\frac{d}{ρ^2α^2}+\frac{\log(1/β)}{α^2}\right)$, uniformly over independent accuracy, failure, and disagreement parameters $α,β,ρ\in(0,1/10)$. The learner returns one binary function, may be improper, and uses unrestricted shared randomness. Its sample budget is fixed before observing data, and the replicability guarantee includes queries of zero marginal mass. The main construction combines an ensemble of empirical-risk minimizers with a smooth, signal-dependent risk decomposition. A single shared phase selects the final binary predictor. Record times certify its weak-signal risk, while a uniform bound protects the strong-signal risk at that same selected time. A phase-comparison theorem controls the actual shared-seed execution under simultaneous changes in the marginals and risk coefficients. A rare repair step then makes the confidence cost additive. Together with matching lower bounds, this removes the remaining logarithmic overhead and parameter restrictions in the general countable-domain sample-complexity problem. This extended version also retains the earlier explicit constructions and their proofs, including proper learning for VC-one classes, the full finite-atom class, a faster realizable bound, and counterexamples that separate restrictions of particular algorithms from restrictions of the learning problem.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了有限及可数域上逐点可复制性（pointwise replicability）的最优不可知样本复杂度：对任意 VC 维为 $d\ge1$ 的非空二分类类，所需独立样本数为 $\Theta(d/(\rho^2\alpha^2)+\log(1/\beta)/\alpha^2)$，并给出匹配的上下界。
AI.motivation: 研究两个使用相同随机种子、独立训练的预测器在每个查询点上高概率一致（逐点可复制性）所需的样本量，旨在解决可数域一般情形下残留的对数开销与参数限制问题。
AI.method: 构造性上界：将多个经验风险最小化器组成集成，配合平滑的、依赖信号的风险分解；用一个共享相位选出最终二值预测器；用记录时间认证弱信号风险，再用一致界保护同一选定时刻的强信号风险；提出相位比较定理以控制共享种子执行过程在边际与风险系数同时变化下的行为；加入罕见修复步骤使置信代价可加。并构造匹配下界。扩展版保留原有显式构造与证明（VC 维为一类的 proper 学习、完整有限原子类、更快的可实现界，以及区分算法限制与问题限制的反例）。
AI.result: 得到对准确率、失败率与不一致参数 $\alpha,\beta,\rho\in(0,1/10)$ 一致成立的最优样本复杂度 $\Theta(d/(\rho^2\alpha^2)+\log(1/\beta)/\alpha^2)$；学习器可 improper、使用无限制共享随机性、样本预算在观测数据前固定，且复制保证涵盖零边际质量查询。上下界匹配，去除了对数开销与参数限制。
AI.conclusion: 逐点可复制性在有限与可数域上具有上述紧致样本复杂度；该结果推进了可数域一般样本复杂度问题的解决，并保留了此前各类显式构造与反例分析。

title: Auto-MD-bench: Evaluating Autoresearch Agents for Real-World Medical Tasks
summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly capable of developing machine learning (ML) models end to end. In medical practice, however, strong performance on the target metric does not fully characterize how good the models are in real-world use cases. For example, medical ML models should also provide well-calibrated risk estimates and remain robust across patient populations. Yet autonomous model development is typically guided by task objectives that emphasize simple predictive discrimination (e.g. AUROC). This raises a key question: are these objectives sufficient to guide agents toward models that meet the broader requirements of real-world medical use? In this study, we introduce Auto-MD-bench, a benchmark of 15 real-world medical tasks from 10 clinical datasets, spanning survival analysis, classification and sequential prediction, with external validation across cohorts, hospitals and time periods. We evaluate four agents: AIDE, AI Scientist v2, Codex, and Autoresearch. The strongest agents achieve competitive primary scores, yet their predicted risks are less calibrated than those of the simple baseline models, which could lead to severe medical accidents. Moreover, models with nearly identical primary scores can exhibit markedly different calibration, while performance varies substantially across population shifts. These findings show that primary task performance alone is insufficient to assess autonomous clinical modeling and multiple different metrics widely used in healthcare practice need to be taken into consideration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Auto-MD-bench基准（10个临床数据集、15个真实医疗任务，覆盖生存分析、分类与序列预测，并含跨队列/医院/时间的外部验证），评估AIDE、AI Scientist v2、Codex、Autoresearch四个自主智能体，发现其主指标具竞争力但风险预测校准劣于简单基线，且主指标相近的模型校准差异显著、群体分布偏移下性能波动大。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体已能端到端开发ML模型，但其开发过程通常由强调简单判别性能（如AUROC）的任务目标驱动。医疗场景要求模型同时具备良好校准的风险估计与跨人群稳健性，因此需检验：这些单一主指标目标是否足以引导智能体产出满足真实临床使用要求的模型。
AI.method: 构建Auto-MD-bench基准：涵盖10个临床数据集的15个真实医疗任务，任务类型包括生存分析、分类与序列预测，并设置跨队列、跨医院、跨时间段的外部验证。在该基准上评估AIDE、AI Scientist v2、Codex与Autoresearch四个自主建模智能体，比较其主指标、校准性及分布偏移下的表现。
AI.result: 最强智能体在主指标上取得有竞争力的成绩，但其预测风险校准性弱于简单基线模型，可能带来严重医疗风险；主指标几乎相同的模型在校准上可存在显著差异；在人群分布偏移下性能变化幅度大。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭主任务性能不足以评估自主临床建模，需综合考量医疗实践中广泛使用的多种指标（如校准、稳健性等），以引导智能体开发真正可用的医疗ML模型。

title: Can LLM User-Proxies Stand In for Humans in Reliance Measurement? Replicating Rel-A.I. with Simulated Users
summary: Can language-model user proxies reproduce human reliance on an AI answer across contexts? Published simulated-user studies do not establish validity for this partial-answer decision, and Rel-A.I.'s released human record omits trial-level choices. We audit its 90 printed questions and 15 domain-by-marker reliance rates using sampled decisions and counterbalanced A/B probabilities from open models through 72B parameters. A matched crossover varies the printed agent specialty within each question, separating question content, label averages, and their interaction. Mistral Small's strong-marker math-minus-law label marginal is -0.4 percentage points, yet matching the agent label to the question domain raises reliance by 13.3 points on average across the five domains. The best A/B proxy has 22.5-point absolute-rate error and 8.3-point domain-effect error against the human table. A two-sample independent-binomial human replication has 3.5-point expected domain-effect error under the stated working model. The interaction is model dependent, and inference layout changes identical-prompt probabilities. This single-study audit does not establish proxy validity for human effect sizes or general directional screening.

AI.tldr: 该文审计 Rel-A.I. 的 90 道题与 15 个"领域×标记"依赖率，检验开源语言模型模拟用户能否复现人类对"部分答案—建议采纳"的依赖模式；发现交互效应模型依赖强，最佳 A/B 代理与人类表的绝对率误差达 22.5 个百分点，单一研究的审计不足以确立代理有效性。
AI.motivation: 已发表的模拟用户研究未针对"部分答案决策"建立有效性，且 Rel-A.I. 公开的人类记录缺少试次级选择数据，因此无法直接验证 LLM 用户代理能否还原人类的跨情境依赖行为。
AI.method: 对 Rel-A.I. 的 90 道印刷题与 15 个领域×标记依赖率进行审计：用至 72B 参数的开源模型采样决策、以配平的概率做 A/B 呈现；设计匹配交叉（matched crossover）在每个问题内变换"代理专长"标签，从而分离题目内容、标签均值及其交互；并与两样本独立二项人类复现的预期误差对比。
AI.result: Mistral Small 的强标记"数学−法律"标签边际仅 −0.4 个百分点，但将代理标签与题目领域匹配后，五领域平均依赖率提升 13.3 个百分点；最佳 A/B 代理相对人类表的绝对率误差为 22.5 个百分点、领域效应误差 8.3 个百分点，而人类两样本复现的期望领域效应误差为 3.5 个百分点；交互效应依模型而异，且推断版式会改变同一提示下的概率。
AI.conclusion: 单一研究的审计无法确立 LLM 用户代理在人类效应量或一般性方向筛选上的有效性；标记—领域交互具模型依赖性，提示版式亦影响结果，模拟用户结果不宜直接外推至人类。

title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
summary: Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-driven, bidirectional historical inheritance. Drawing on a shared evolutionary archive and execution feedback, a meta-agent coordinates harness development from historical designs with model checkpoint selection or merging and subsequent adaptation under the selected harness, aligning inherited capabilities with evolving execution requirements to reduce brain--body mismatch. Using only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its own rejection-sampled trajectories, CoEvo-RSI makes Qwen3.5-9B competitive with larger models across diverse vertical applications, including multi-agent failure attribution, role-aware text-to-SQL, and smart-home instruction following. It surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TraceElephant (+14.16 agent accuracy) and GLM-5.3 on HomeBench VM (+4.90 success rate), underscoring the need for brain--body alignment and the potential of bidirectional historical inheritance to advance agent co-evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出CoEvo-RSI框架，通过智能体驱动的双向历史继承实现模型（脑）与执行脚手架（身体）的协同进化，缓解"脑-身失配"问题。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）智能体中模型-脚手架协同进化时存在"脑-身失配"：进化的脚手架要求模型尚未习得的行为，或限制模型已具备的能力。该问题持续存在却常被忽视。
AI.method: 构建共享进化档案并利用执行反馈，由一个元智能体协调：基于历史设计开发脚手架，同时进行模型检查点选择或合并，并在选定脚手架下对模型做后续适配，将继承能力与演化中的执行需求对齐。训练仅使用对自身拒绝采样轨迹的SFT。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-9B在多种垂直应用中可媲美更大模型，包括多智能体故障归因、角色感知Text-to-SQL与智能家居指令遵循；在TraceElephant上智能体准确率超过DeepSeek-V4-Pro +14.16，在HomeBench VM上成功率超过GLM-5.3 +4.90。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显脑-身对齐的必要性，并表明双向历史继承具有推进智能体协同进化的潜力。

title: SAR: Learning Global Item-Space Matching and Geometry-Aware Placement Ranking for Buffered Online 3D Bin Packing
summary: Online 3D bin packing with a bounded buffer requires irreversible item-selection and placement decisions under limited knowledge of future arrivals. Feasibility alone is insufficient, as feasible actions can produce different residual-space structures and subsequent packing opportunities. A central architectural question is how to allocate spatial reasoning between item selection and placement evaluation. We propose Spatial Affordance Retrieval (SAR), a novel learning-based framework that coordinates global item-space matching with geometry-aware placement ranking. A voxel-token spatial encoder represents 3D container occupancy, enabling a picker to match buffered items to the residual space without requiring item-specific placement proposals as inputs. After item selection, a loader ranks feasible rotation-position candidates using candidate geometry, local geometric features (LGF), and inter-candidate comparison, without directly accessing global spatial tokens. The feasible candidate set connects the two stages, which are jointly optimized under a shared long-horizon packing return. On the Random, JD, and SF datasets, the best SAR variants improve utilization over the strongest evaluated online baselines by 0.96-4.20 percentage points under the no-buffer setting (K=1). With a buffer (K=5), the best utilization rates across SAR variants reach 93.55%, 91.04%, and 90.41%, respectively. Ablations support the complementary roles of global item-space matching and geometry-aware placement evaluation, counterfactual analysis suggests that learned item selection favors greater future packing potential, and experiments demonstrate compatibility with multiple candidate generators.

AI.tldr: 提出空间可供性检索（SAR）框架，将全局物品-空间匹配与几何感知放置排序解耦协调，用于有界缓冲区在线3D装箱。
AI.motivation: 在线3D装箱在有界缓冲区下需在未知未来到达的情况下做不可逆的选品与放置决策；仅保证可行性不足，因为不同可行动作会产生不同的剩余空间结构和后续装箱机会。核心架构问题是：如何在选品与放置评估之间分配空间推理能力。
AI.method: SAR包含两级：1）体素-令牌空间编码器表示容器占用，picker据此将缓冲区物品与剩余空间匹配，无需以物品特定放置候选为输入；2）选定物品后，loader利用候选几何、局部几何特征（LGF）及候选间比较对可行旋转-位置候选排序，不直接访问全局空间令牌。可行候选集连接两级，二者在共享的长程装箱回报下联合优化。
AI.result: 在Random、JD、SF数据集上，无缓冲区（K=1）时最佳SAR变体较最强在线基线利用率提升0.96–4.20个百分点；有缓冲区（K=5）时最佳利用率分别达93.55%、91.04%、90.41%。消融支持全局物品-空间匹配与几何感知放置评估的互补作用；反事实分析表明学习到的选品偏向更高未来装箱潜力；实验显示与多种候选生成器兼容。
AI.conclusion: SAR通过将全局匹配与局部几何排序分工并由可行候选集衔接、联合优化，有效提升在线有界缓冲区3D装箱的利用率，并具备模块兼容性与可解释性证据。

title: Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization for Reasoning Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning improves the reasoning capability of large language models through verifiable rewards for mathematical and coding tasks. In token-level methods such as GRPO, clipping acts on individual token ratios while the reward and advantage apply to a complete response. Recent sequence-level methods align these units but still use fixed clipping bands, whose tail probabilities change as the score distribution evolves. We propose Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization (CSPO), which adaptively calibrates sequence-level clipping bounds using recent training statistics. The resulting band targets a specified marginal tail budget and adapts to policy drift; calibration conditional on response length requires additional assumptions. We bound the probability that a fresh score falls outside the band by the target miscoverage level plus explicit CDF discrepancy and drift terms. Under additional moment conditions, this bound also controls the objective and gradient error relative to the unclipped GSPO power surrogate. Experiments with the Qwen3-1.7B series show improvements over GSPO on difficult mathematical reasoning benchmarks and ALFWorld, with clipping endpoints that adapt during training.

AI.tldr: 提出CSPO，用共形预测自适应校准序列级裁剪边界，以目标尾部预算控制裁剪带并适应策略漂移。
AI.motivation: GRPO等token级方法的裁剪作用于单个token比率，而奖励与优势针对完整回复；近期序列级方法虽统一了单位但使用固定裁剪带，其尾部概率随分数分布演化而改变。
AI.method: 基于近期训练统计自适应校准序列级裁剪边界，使裁剪带满足指定的边际尾部预算并适应策略漂移；条件化于回复长度的校准需额外假设。
AI.result: 给出新分数落在带外的概率上界（目标误覆盖水平加显式CDF差异项与漂移项）；在额外矩条件下该界同时控制相对于未裁剪GSPO幂替代目标的目标误差与梯度误差；Qwen3-1.7B系列在困难数学推理基准与ALFWorld上优于GSPO，且裁剪端点随训练自适应。
AI.conclusion: 共形预测为序列级策略优化提供了带统计保证的自适应裁剪机制，兼顾理论可控性与实证性能提升。

title: When to Stop Asking: Factor Coverage Bias and LLM Determinability Judgments with Underspecified Information in Medicine
summary: Clinical decision-making often begins with underspecified information and requires not only gathering missing information but also knowing when to stop. This calls for judging determinability (whether the available information is sufficient for a decision) by considering whether missing information could change the conclusion, not simply the amount of available decision-relevant information. Reliance on this amount as a cue for determinability, which we term \textit{factor coverage bias}, could undermine the trustworthiness of large language models (LLMs) through premature conclusions or excessive information gathering, such as unnecessary invasive tests. Yet whether LLMs exhibit this bias remains insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we construct a controlled pairwise benchmark in which LLMs identify the determinable case within each determinable--undeterminable pair. We add a decision-relevant factor to either side while keeping each case's determinability unchanged, and similarly add irrelevant text to distinguish this bias from context-length effects. Adding a relevant factor made LLMs more likely to select the augmented case as determinable even when it remained undeterminable, an effect that persisted with increased reasoning effort, while adding irrelevant text made them less likely to select the augmented case, an effect that reasoning substantially reduced. These findings identify factor coverage bias as a failure mode distinct from context-length effects and a potential risk to LLM trustworthiness. Our work provides an evaluation framework for LLM trustworthiness under underspecification.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并验证LLM存在“因素覆盖偏差”：模型把「已有决策相关信息量」当作可判定性线索，而非判断缺失信息是否可能改变结论，从而在医学式欠定情境下产生草率结论或过度检查。
AI.motivation: 临床决策常从信息不充分的欠定状态开始，需判断信息是否足以决策（可判定性），关键是缺失信息是否会改变结论；而LLM可能误用信息量作为线索，损害可信度，此偏差尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 构建受控成对基准：每对含一个可判定案例与一个不可判定案例，令LLM选出可判定者。实验操控两方面——向任一侧添加决策相关因素（不改变其可判定性），以及添加无关文本以区分该偏差与上下文长度效应；并考察推理投入（reasoning effort）增加的影响。
AI.result: 添加相关因素后，即使该案例仍不可判定，LLM也更倾向将其选为可判定，且该效应在推理投入增加时依然存在；添加无关文本则使LLM更不倾向选择该案例，且推理可显著削弱此效应。
AI.conclusion: 因素覆盖偏差是区别于上下文长度效应的独立失效模式，构成LLM可信度的潜在风险；工作提供了欠定情境下LLM可信度评估框架。

title: Self-organizing reinforcement learning: a swarm approaches the explore-exploit optimum
summary: The explore/exploit trade-off is the core problem of reinforcement learning (RL). We show that a minimal foraging swarm approaches its optimum - the ideal-free / Nash allocation of a multi-agent resource-sharing game (an equilibrium, not a return maximum) - with no learner and no reward signal. Agents explore by heavy-tailed (Levy) flights, recruit neighbours to a discovery through a threshold cascade on their proximity network, and disperse as a patch crowds; this cascade cycle balances exploration and exploitation and drives foragers toward the ideal free distribution. The swarm attains the shape of this optimum (committed foragers track richness with slope 0.94) but not its exact equilibrium - it stays measurably exploitable - reaching it dynamically (~150 steps) through the coupling of recruitment to movement: remove the coupling and matching collapses (0.94 -> 0.08). The RL sits at the level of the problem and the allocation reached, not the micro-rule: no step evaluates payoff (reward-free by construction, though the crowd signal is informationally tied to payoff), and the swarm reaches the allocation without learning it (quality plateaus and re-settles after resources move, no cumulative gain). Against a trained baseline the comparison is two-sided: in an easier, disembodied game a learner is more precise, while in the same embodied environment the reward-free swarm reaches ~65% of a validated oracle ceiling at zero training and leads until trained PPO and centralised-critic (CTDE) learners overtake it (~74-75%, 16 seeds, all above the swarm mean) after ~4,000 of 15,000 training steps - its advantage is in budget, not asymptote. In this one setting we read it not as beating RL but as a strong zero-shot, reward-free operating point: a demonstration that the self-organizing physics of a minimal swarm can carry a collective close to the optimum RL seeks, with none of RL's machinery.

AI.tldr: 一个极简觅食群体在无学习器、无奖励信号的条件下，通过重尾（Levy）飞行、阈值级联招募与拥挤分散的循环，动态逼近多智能体资源分配博弈的ideal-free/Nash均衡（配比斜率0.94），但停留于"近似、可被利用"的非精确均衡；与PPO/CTDE对比显示其优势在于零训练预算而非渐近性能。
AI.motivation: 探索-利用权衡是强化学习的核心问题。作者希望检验：是否可以在完全不含RL机制（无学习器、无奖励评估、无累积学习）的最小群体自组织动力系统中，实现RL所求的集体最优分配，从而给出一个零样本、无奖励的强基线运行点。
AI.method: 构建最小觅食群体模型：个体以Levy重尾飞行探索，发现资源后通过邻近网络上的阈值级联招募邻居，斑块拥挤时分散，形成"级联循环"以平衡探索与利用。以multi-agent资源分享博弈的ideal-free/Nash分配为理想基准，做消融（移除招募-运动耦合）、与训练基线（PPO、集中式critic CTDE）在"具身"与"非具身"两种设置下对比，并检验质量是否随经验累积提升。
AI.result: 群体达到最优"形状"而非精确均衡：投入觅食者对斑块丰度的响应斜率为0.94，但仍可被测量地利用；约150步动态达到该配比。移除招募与运动的耦合后匹配崩溃（0.94→0.08）。质量呈平台化、资源移动后重新settle，无累积增益，说明未"学会"。对比：更简单的非具身博弈中学习器更精确；同一具身环境中无奖励群体零训练即达已验证oracle上限的约65%，直到PPO与CTDE在约15,000步中的第4,000步左右才超越（约74–75%，16个种子全部高于群体均值）。
AI.conclusion: 该文不主张"打败RL"，而是将最小群体的自组织物理视为一个强零样本、无奖励的运行点：集体可携带至RL所求最优附近，优势在训练预算而非渐近性能；RL位于问题与所达分配的层面，而非微观规则层面。

title: When Retrieval Partially Conflicts with Skills: Understanding Procedural Hallucination in Language Models
summary: Language models increasingly use skills that provide reusable instructions and procedures for task execution. After a relevant skill has been selected, the model may need to apply its governing procedure together with retrieved task context. When the retrieved context is useful but contains cues that violate the skill, the model must retain compatible information while rejecting the conflicting cues. We study failures in which the model adopts such cues and produces a retrieval-supported but skill-invalid answer, which we call procedural hallucination. We introduce SourceClash, a matched benchmark with 1,271 bundles and 6,355 prompts across ten procedural domains. Each bundle fixes the task, skill specification, and answer space while varying the relation between the skill and retrieval. Across nine models, valid-answer rates average 25.7% under conflicting retrieval, compared with 78.2% and 72.8% under two supportive retrieval settings. Mechanistic analysis of open-weight models shows that the answer-preference difference typically reaches its maximum shortly after generation begins. Residual replacement moves the model toward valid answers, while attention decomposition attributes most of the repair to value vectors. Intervention at the identified value pathway also improves final answer validity. These results characterize how partly conflicting retrieval changes skill-guided generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"程序性幻觉"(procedural hallucination)概念，即模型在检索上下文与技能冲突时采纳冲突线索、给出有检索支持但违反技能规范的答案；并构建SourceClash基准(1,271个bundle、6,355条prompt、10个程序性领域)系统测量该失败模式并做机制分析。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地使用"技能"(可复用的指令与流程)执行任务，且需将技能流程与检索到的任务上下文结合使用。当检索上下文虽有用但含有违反技能的线索时，模型应保留兼容信息、拒绝冲突线索。作者希望刻画模型在此情形下的失败模式及其内部机制。
AI.method: 构建SourceClash匹配式基准：每个bundle固定任务、技能规范与答案空间，仅改变技能与检索之间的关系(冲突检索 vs. 两种支持性检索)；在九个模型上评测有效答案率；对开放权重模型做机制分析，包括答案偏好差异的时间动态(残差流)、残差替换实验，以及注意力分解以定位修复来源，并对识别出的value向量通路进行干预。
AI.result: 九个模型在冲突检索下有效答案率平均仅25.7%，而在两种支持性检索设置下分别为78.2%和72.8%。机制分析显示答案偏好差异通常在生成开始后不久达到最大；残差替换可将模型推向有效答案；注意力分解将大部分修复归因于value向量；对识别出的value通路进行干预也能提升最终答案有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究刻画了部分冲突的检索如何改变技能引导的生成过程，指出程序性幻觉是一种可测量、可机制定位的失败模式，且value向量通路是其关键作用与可干预环节。

title: Polynomial Learning of Positive ReLU Networks under Gaussian Inputs
summary: We study bias-free, one-hidden-layer ReLU networks with nonnegative output weights under standard Gaussian inputs. Hidden directions may be arbitrarily close or linearly dependent. The labels have the target as their conditional mean, and only the unconditional second moment of the noise is bounded. We present a candidate real-arithmetic learning guarantee: a width-$k$ target with total output weight at most one can be approximated to squared prediction error $\varepsilon$ by a nonnegative ReLU network of width at most $k+\min\{k,d\}$, with sample and operation cost $(1+σ^2)\operatorname{poly}(d,k,\varepsilon^{-1},\log(1/δ))$. The argument combines implicit high-order moments with a direction cover that is complete for heavy atoms and sound for every output. Exact Gaussian soft localization refines this cover while pruning keeps at most $k$ centers at every scale. Clipping the query multipliers controls heavy-tailed, input-dependent noise without assuming a uniform conditional variance bound. A final convex fit and an exact sparsification step give the stated output width. We also obtain a parameterized projective direction-recovery guarantee. The result concerns real-arithmetic complexity; no bit-complexity or practical running-time guarantee is asserted.

AI.tldr: 研究了标准高斯输入下、输出权重非负的无偏置单隐层 ReLU 网络的实算术学习保证：宽度为 k（总输出权重≤1）的目标，可用宽度不超过 k+min{k,d} 的非负 ReLU 网络以平方预测误差 ε 逼近，样本与运算代价为 (1+σ²)poly(d,k,ε⁻¹,log(1/δ))。
AI.motivation: 目标网络的隐层方向可能任意接近甚至线性相关，标签仅以目标为条件均值、噪声仅有无条件二阶矩有界（可为重尾、输入依赖），因此需要在不假设均匀条件方差界、不要求方向分离的弱条件下建立可证明的学习保证。
AI.method: 结合隐式高阶矩与一个"对重原子完备、对任意输出可靠（sound）"的方向覆盖；用精确高斯软局部化细化该覆盖，并通过剪枝使每个尺度至多保留 k 个中心；对查询乘子做截断以控制重尾的输入依赖噪声；最后以凸拟合加精确稀疏化步骤得到所述输出宽度。
AI.result: 给出宽度 k、总输出权重≤1 的目标以平方预测误差 ε 被宽度 ≤ k+min{k,d} 的非负 ReLU 网络逼近的保证，样本与运算复杂度 (1+σ²)poly(d,k,ε⁻¹,log(1/δ))；另获参数化的投影方向恢复保证。
AI.conclusion: 结论限于实算术复杂度，不声明比特复杂度或实际运行时间保证。同时提供参数化的投影方向恢复结果，覆盖方向可线性相关、噪声重尾的设定。

title: FrontierRefactor: Benchmarking Multi-Scale Performance-Oriented Codebase Refactoring
summary: Autonomous codebase refactoring requires coding agents to restructure working software while strictly preserving externally observable behavior and prioritizing execution performance and compute efficiency over stylistic preference. Existing benchmarks: refactoring benchmarks assess functional correctness while overlooking runtime regressions, whereas code performance benchmarks target isolated micro-kernels that ignore codebase-scale complexity. We observe that refactoring scale is governed by the scope of the observable contract, the caller-visible interface fixing behavioral invariants while freeing private implementations for optimization. Building on this insight, we introduce FrontierRefactor, a benchmark of 60 qualified engineering tasks spanning four scales, from computational kernels to full repositories, across in-place optimization and cross-language rewriting. Evaluating frontier coding agents through a reference-free cascaded protocol across 1,080 execution runs reveals that correctness and speedup are largely decoupled: 41.2% of submissions satisfy functional equivalence yet fail to deliver verified performance improvements, with 19.3% suffering performance regressions and 21.9% trapped in measurement noise. Refactoring paradigms reveal orthogonal engineering bottlenecks: while cross-language rewrites gain speedups from native compilation after passing functional checks, agents struggle with contract fidelity, with pass rates dropping from 65.0% on modules to 32.6% at package scale; conversely, in-place optimization reliably preserves behavioral contracts at 86.5% but rarely achieves acceleration without physical performance profiling. Trajectory analysis shows that agents fall victim to uncalibrated micro-benchmarking illusions, an operational blind spot that multi-turn execution-timing feedback directly resolves, raising strict success from 16.0% to 40.0%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FrontierRefactor 基准（60 项任务、四种规模、原地优化与跨语言重写），用无参考级联评测协议在 1,080 次执行中发现：智能体的功能正确性与性能加速基本解耦，且提示其"契约保真度"与"性能剖析"是两类正交瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 自主代码库重构要求智能体在严格保持外部可观测行为的前提下重构可运行软件，并优先追求执行性能与算力效率。现有基准存在空缺：重构类基准只评功能正确性、忽视运行时性能回退；性能类基准只针对孤立微内核、忽视代码库级复杂度。作者进一步观察到重构的"规模"由可观测契约的范围决定——调用方可见接口锁定行为不变量，而私有实现被释放以供优化。
AI.method: 构建 FrontierRefactor 基准：60 项经筛选的工程任务，覆盖从计算内核到完整仓库的四种规模，涵盖原地优化与跨语言改写两类范式。评测采用无参考（reference-free）级联协议，对前沿编码智能体共执行 1,080 次运行，并配套轨迹分析与多轮执行计时反馈实验。
AI.result: 正确性与加速显著解耦：41.2% 的提交满足功能等价但未带来经核验的性能提升，19.3% 出现性能回退，21.9% 陷于测量噪声。两种范式瓶颈正交：跨语言重写在通过功能检查后可借原生编译获得加速，但契约保真度差，通过率从模块级的 65.0% 降至包级的 32.6%；原地优化能稳定保持行为契约（86.5%），但缺乏物理性能剖析时鲜有加速。轨迹分析显示智能体受"未校准微基准幻觉"误导，引入多轮执行计时反馈可直接缓解这一操作盲区，将严格成功率从 16.0% 提升至 40.0%。
AI.conclusion: 重构智能体的真实短板不在于写对代码，而在于以可观测契约界定重构规模、并以实测性能证据驱动优化决策；基准与级联协议为衡量"正确且更快"的重构能力提供了统一标尺。

title: Memory as Belief: Bayesian Evolution of Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory to accumulate past experiences for continual adaptation. However, effectively reusing memory requires accurately assessing its value, as retrieved experiences may become unreliable when transferred across task contexts. Despite its importance, memory valuation remains largely underexplored, with existing methods relying on historical retrieval success rates that overlook the context dependency of memory usefulness and the varying reliability of estimates under different amounts of evidence. Inspired by the Bayesian brain hypothesis, we propose BEAM (Bayesian-style Evolutionary Agentic Memory), a framework that reformulates memory value evaluation as a parameterized cognitive inference process, where memory value is represented as a context-conditioned dynamic belief rather than a passive historical statistic. Specifically, BEAM infers memory value beliefs from current task contexts and continuously calibrates them using execution feedback as empirical evidence, transforming memory from passive storage into an adaptive cognitive mechanism for continual self-evolution. Extensive experiments across reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that BEAM consistently improves memory utilization and enables continual self-evolution of LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 提出BEAM框架，将LLM智能体的记忆价值评估重构为贝叶斯式参数化认知推断过程，把记忆价值表示为上下文条件化的动态信念，并利用执行反馈持续校准，从而提升记忆利用率并实现持续自我进化。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖外部记忆积累经验以实现持续适应，但跨任务上下文迁移时被检索的经验可能不可靠，因此需准确评估记忆价值。现有方法依赖历史检索成功率，忽略了记忆有用性的上下文依赖性，以及不同证据量下估计可靠性差异，记忆价值评估研究不足。
AI.method: 受贝叶斯大脑假说启发，BEAM将记忆价值评估形式化为参数化认知推断过程：记忆价值不再是被动历史统计量，而是上下文条件化的动态信念；由当前任务上下文推断记忆价值信念，并以执行反馈作为经验证据对信念持续进行校准，使记忆由被动存储转变为自适应认知机制。
AI.result: 在推理与代码生成基准上的大量实验表明，BEAM 一致地提升记忆利用率，并支持 LLM 智能体的持续自我进化。
AI.conclusion: 记忆价值应建模为随上下文与证据动态更新的信念而非静态统计；贝叶斯式推断加执行反馈校准是提升智能体记忆复用有效性的可行路径。

title: Not Every Rollout Needs Distillation: Correctness-Filtered On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supervises student-generated trajectories with a reference-conditioned version of the same base model. We ask whether every trajectory supplies distinct supervision that warrants its distillation cost. Gradient measurements on Qwen3-1.7B at initialization reveal that correct and incorrect responses have similar individual gradient magnitudes, but incorrect responses have approximately three times the coherent gradient share. Their estimated population-mean directions also largely overlap. A signal--noise model fitted at a small group size tracks alignment at larger group sizes without refitting. Motivated by these measurements, we introduce correctness-filtered OPSD (C-OPSD), which generates one response per problem and distills only a subset of incorrect responses. Removing unselected rows before both distillation forwards avoids their teacher/student forward and student backward work. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, C-OPSD achieves on-par performance with full OPSD. In a measured micro-batch-size-four implementation, executed rows decrease by approximately 68%, and with retained rows packed into full micro-batches, training takes about 40% less time while rollout generation remains unchanged. Together, the measurements and training results connect outcome-conditioned supervision redundancy to more compute-efficient distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过梯度测量发现on-policy自蒸馏中正确/错误轨迹的监督信号高度冗余，提出仅蒸馏部分错误响应的C-OPSD，在保持性能的同时大幅降低训练计算量。
AI.motivation: 审视on-policy self-distillation(OPSD)中每条轨迹是否都提供值得其蒸馏成本的独特监督信号，即是否存在可视化约简的监督冗余。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-1.7B初始化时进行梯度测量（个体梯度幅值、相干梯度占比、总体均值方向重叠度），并拟合信噪比模型外推组规模；据此提出C-OPSD：每题生成一条响应，仅蒸馏若干错误响应的子集，并在蒸馏前向之前移除未选中行以省去师生前向与学生反向。
AI.result: 正确与错误响应的个体梯度幅值相近，但错误响应的相干梯度份额约为3倍，且两者总体均值方向高度重叠；小规模组拟合的信噪比模型无需重拟合即可预测大规模组对齐。C-OPSD在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B及AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25上与完整OPSD性能相当；微批为4的实现中执行行减少约68%，打包后训练时间约减少40%，而rollout生成不变。
AI.conclusion: 将结果条件化的监督冗余与更高效的计算蒸馏联系起来，表明仅蒸馏部分错误响应即可在几乎不损失性能的前提下降低训练成本。

title: ClinSDT: LLM-Encoded Clinical Semantic Guidance for Sepsis Treatment via Decision Transformer
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at CIKM 2026 (Full Research Track, Oral Presentation)
summary: Offline sepsis treatment aims to learn treatment policies from retrospective ICU trajectories. Decision Transformer-based methods provide a natural sequence modeling framework for this task, but they mainly rely on raw physiological states and historical clinician actions. Such raw trajectory tokens may not explicitly capture clinical semantics that clinicians use in practice, such as patient severity, recent treatment response, and current risk priorities. To address this limitation, we propose ClinSDT, an LLM-assisted Decision Transformer framework for offline sepsis treatment. ClinSDT uses a frozen LLM as a semantic bridge rather than a treatment decision maker. It constructs three clinical semantic views from ICU trajectories, namely Profile, Context, and Advisory, and inserts their encoded representations as independent tokens into a Decision Transformer policy. To support policy refinement and rollout, ClinSDT further trains a Treatment-Response Forecaster to estimate the next physiological state, SAPS-II change, and predictive uncertainty from state-action inputs. In the second training stage, the forecaster screens local counterfactual treatment candidates, and only low-uncertainty candidates with lower predicted SAPS-II increase are distilled into the policy after semantic regeneration. During inference, ClinSDT performs closed-loop treatment rollout by refreshing semantic inputs from the currently available patient state. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that ClinSDT achieves consistent relative improvements over representative imitation learning, offline reinforcement learning, and Decision Transformer baselines under the same rollout protocol. Code and data are available at https://github.com/KAG778/ClinSDT.

AI.tldr: ClinSDT是一个LLM辅助的Decision Transformer离线脓毒症治疗框架，通过引入临床语义token和不确定性感知的预测器蒸馏，在MIMIC-III/IV上优于代表性基线。
AI.motivation: 现有Decision Transformer方法仅依赖原始生理状态与历史临床医生动作，难以显式刻画临床实践中关键的语义信息（患者严重程度、近期治疗反应、风险优先级）。
AI.method: 将冻结LLM作为语义桥梁而非决策者，从ICU轨迹构建Profile、Context、Advisory三种临床语义视图，编码后作为独立token注入Decision Transformer策略；同时训练Treatment-Response Forecaster，从状态-动作输入预测下一生理状态、SAPS-II变化及不确定性。第二阶段中预测器筛选局部反事实治疗候选，仅将低不确定性且预测SAPS-II增幅较小的候选经语义再生后蒸馏进策略；推理时通过刷新当前患者状态的语义输入进行闭环rollout。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，相同rollout协议下相对代表性模仿学习、离线强化学习和Decision Transformer基线取得一致的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式临床语义视图与不确定性筛选的预测器蒸馏可有效增强Decision Transformer在离线脓毒症治疗策略学习中的表现，且LLM仅承担语义表征角色、不直接做治疗决策。

title: A Cue's Hidden Price: Auditing Seller Influence on AI Shoppers
summary: Large language models are increasingly asked to shop on a user's behalf, which lets seller-controlled content such as badges, endorsements, and framing steer what they recommend. That poses the question at the core of generative engine optimization (GEO): not whether seller content shifts an agent's choice, but how much. The usual gauge of that influence, how often a cue wins the choice, has a blind spot: once a cue is strong enough to be picked almost every time, the choice rate can no longer show how much stronger one cue is than another. We introduce price-equivalent (PE) auditing, which removes this ceiling by pricing the cue in money. In a counterbalanced, position-controlled forced choice, we raise the cued product's price until it is chosen only half the time, and report that premium as the cue's price-equivalent: a formally defined, policy-conditioned parity threshold that makes very different cues comparable. Priced this way, cues that look equally strong at equal price differ by a wide margin, so choice-rate audits substantially under-resolve seller influence. We run the audit over 113,472 trials, seven models across families, and two product categories. To our knowledge, we also run the first price-equivalent audit of a decision-native model, Jev, which outputs a choice probability directly instead of generating text; strikingly, its profile is unlike any text model we tested, resisting most cues yet remaining susceptible to the strongest social-proof claims. We release the stimuli, logs, and code as a benchmark that reports each model's cue-price profile rather than a single score, giving developers and auditors a common, reproducible way to measure how content moves AI shopping agents.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"价格等价（PE）审计"方法，用"货币溢价"为卖家内容对LLM购物代理的影响力定价，突破传统选择率的饱和上限，并据此对比七种文本模型与决策原生模型Jev的线索敏感度。
AI.motivation: LLM日益承担代用户购物的任务，卖家可控内容（徽章、推荐背书、表述框架）会左右模型推荐；GEO的核心问题不是"是否影响"而是"影响多大"。传统以"选择率"衡量影响力存在盲区：当某线索强到几乎总被选中时，选择率饱和，无法再区分不同线索的强弱差异。
AI.method: 提出价格等价审计：在平衡、位置受控的强制选择范式中，逐步抬高被线索标记产品的价格，直到其仅有一半概率被选中，该溢价即线索的价格等价——一个形式化定义、依赖策略的平价阈值，使异质线索可比。实验覆盖113,472次试验、跨模型家族的七个模型、两个商品类别，并对决策原生模型Jev（直接输出选择概率）完成首次PE审计。
AI.result: 按价格定价后，同等价格下看似强度相当的线索实际差距悬殊，表明选择率审计严重欠分辨卖家影响力。Jev的线索—价格画像与所有被测文本模型显著不同：它抵御多数线索，却仍易受最强社会认同类声称影响。
AI.conclusion: PE审计为衡量内容如何影响AI购物代理提供了共同、可复现的方法；作者发布刺激材料、日志与代码作为基准，输出各模型的"线索—价格画像"而非单一分数，供开发者与审计方使用。

title: Trackable Skill Library Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Skill-augmented agentic RL has emerged as an effective approach to improving LLM agents on long-horizon tasks. Despite this progress, individual skills may follow distinct trajectories as the policy evolves, with some becoming redundant after the model internalizes their capabilities, others remaining valuable as external scaffolding, and still others turning harmful. However, existing skill library systems fail to identify each skill's true contribution due to free-riding among co-retrieved skills, difficulty confounding across tasks, and the absence of skill-specific counterfactual evidence, which prevents reliable skill lifecycle management. We propose TrackRL, an agentic RL framework where skill tracking drives skill library full lifecycle management. Specifically, within each GRPO group, we turn grouped sampling into online randomized controlled experiments. Independent random injection and within-group contrasts on the same task isolate each skill's true contribution, and reliability-weighted aggregation accumulates evidence across groups. As evidence accumulates, we continuously track skill utility, which measures the skill's causal contribution as external scaffolding, and model mastery, which reflects how far the corresponding capability has been internalized. Along this line, we formulate skill lifecycle management as an evidence-gated state-transition process that governs each skill from generation and admission through protected incubation to retention, retirement, or removal, while a soft capacity bound controls library growth. Experiments show that TrackRL outperforms recent skill-augmented RL baselines in both library-assisted and skill-free evaluation, with further analyses revealing how skill value shifts during policy learning and how evidence-driven state transitions shape skill library evolution. Our code is available at https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL.

AI.tldr: TrackRL：以GRPO组内随机化对照实验估计每个skill的因果贡献，据此对技能库进行证据门控的全生命周期管理。
AI.motivation: 技能增强型agentic RL中，随策略演化，各技能命运分化（冗余、仍有价值、变为有害）；但现有技能库无法识别单个技能的真实贡献，原因有三：共同检索技能间的"搭便车"、跨任务难度混淆、缺乏技能级反事实证据，导致技能生命周期管理不可靠。
AI.method: 在GRPO每个group内将分组采样转为在线随机对照实验：对同一任务做独立随机注入与组内对比，隔离单技能真实贡献；用可靠性加权聚合跨组累积证据。持续跟踪两类量：技能效用（作为外部脚手架的因果贡献）与掌握度（对应能力内化程度）。将生命周期管理建模为证据门控的状态转移过程（生成→准入→受保护孵化→保留/退役/移除），并以软容量上限控制库规模。
AI.result: 在库辅助与无技能两种评估设定下均优于近期技能增强RL基线；分析揭示技能价值在学习过程中的迁移规律及证据驱动状态转移如何塑造技能库演化。
AI.conclusion: 通过反事实、细粒度的技能级证据追踪，可实现可靠的技能库全生命周期管理，提升长程任务上的LLM agent表现。

title: MASIF: Implicit Failures for Process Observability in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) can complete a task despite local execution errors that are corrected, bypassed, or carried forward without individually determining its outcome. We call these implicit failures (IFs) and study them as signals for process observability beyond final task outcome. Across 1,828 traces from nine MAS-benchmark configurations, IFs occur in 54.3% of successful and 75.2% of failed traces. We develop taxonomies of error types and subsequent absorption mechanisms, supported by human and cross-model annotation audits. Counterfactual replay further probes how repairing an IF changes the final outcome. To examine the practical value of IFs, we evaluate IF-based best-of-N trace selection against existing process reward models, and introduce a novel RL algorithm, IF-GRPO, that uses IF costs to refine preferences among successful trajectories in GRPO. Experiments show that IF-GRPO exhibits some gains in accuracy and process metrics. Importantly, it exposes trade-offs between task performance, IF count and cost, and token-normalized IF density. Overall, our results show that IFs provide complementary process observability into how MAS reach their outcomes, including error recovery, propagation, and IF-based process differences that final task success alone does not expose.

AI.tldr: 分析 1,828 条来自九个 MAS 基准配置的轨迹，揭示"隐式失败"(IF) 在成功轨迹中占 54.3%、失败轨迹中占 75.2%，并构建错误类型与吸收机制分类体系，进而用于过程可观测性评估与流程奖励/RL 改进。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统评估主要依赖最终任务结果，但局部执行错误可被纠正、绕过或继续携带而不单独决定成败，导致过程层面的失效信号被忽视，缺乏对 MAS 过程可观测性的刻画。
AI.method: 提出"隐式失败"(IF) 概念；在 1,828 条轨迹（九个 MAS 基准配置）上统计 IF 分布；构建错误类型与后续吸收机制分类体系，并进行人工与跨模型标注审核；采用反事实重放检验修复 IF 对最终结果的影响；评估基于 IF 的 best-of-N 轨迹选择（对比现有过程奖励模型），并提出 IF-GRPO 算法，用 IF 代价在 GRPO 的成功轨迹间细化偏好。
AI.result: IF 在成功轨迹中占 54.3%、失败轨迹中占 75.2%；反事实重放可揭示 IF 修复对最终结果的因果影响；IF-GRPO 在准确率与过程指标上有一定提升，同时暴露了任务表现、IF 数量与代价、以及 token 归一化 IF 密度之间的权衡；IF 信息与最终成功信号具有互补性。
AI.conclusion: IF 提供了超越最终任务成败的互补过程可观测性，能刻画错误恢复、错误传播以及仅凭任务成功无法显现的过程差异，可作为过程奖励与 RL 训练的有效信号。

title: FHKAN: Fractional Hermite Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Data-Driven and Physics-Informed Learning
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) replace fixed scalar weights by learnable univariate maps, yet most spectral KANs still rely on Chebyshev polynomials that live on a bounded interval and therefore require a saturating squashing of the pre-activation. We introduce the Fractional Hermite Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (FHKAN), a neural architecture that equips KANs with an adaptive, trainable fractional-order generalized Hermite basis. With a nonnegative shape parameter, the underlying generalized Hermite functions are orthonormal on the entire real line and uniformly bounded under a Gaussian envelope, so they act directly on unbounded pre-activations without any saturating map. We derive closed-form derivatives of the generalized, fractional, and scaled basis away from the origin and determine its order of differentiability at the origin, where the fractional power map creates a singular point. On synthetic regression, FHKAN attains the lowest test error at every network depth among nine fixed activations and the spline-based KAN. On image classification, image denoising, and sentiment analysis, the best-performing fractional Hermite block yields the highest accuracy or reconstruction quality. On physics-informed problems, FHKAN reaches mean absolute errors of order 10^-6 to 10^-5 on the Lane-Emden equation, residuals of order 10^-4 on the Burgers equation, and absolute errors below 10^-4 on a fractional delay differential equation.

AI.tldr: 提出FHKAN：用自适应可训练分数阶广义Hermite基替代Chebyshev基，可在无界预激活上直接工作，并在回归、图像、情感与物理信息任务上取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 现有谱型KAN多依赖定义在有界区间上的Chebyshev多项式，因而必须对预激活做饱和压缩映射，限制了表达与数值行为。需要一种定义于全实数、可直接作用无界预激活的正交基。
AI.method: 构建分数阶广义Hermite基（非负形状参数下在全实轴正交归一、受高斯包络一致有界）；推导广义、分数阶、缩放基在原点之外的闭式导数，并确定分数幂映射在原点奇异点处的可微阶数；将其作为可学习酉变元映射嵌入KAN，形成FHKAN及其最优分数Hermite块。
AI.result: 合成回归中在各网络深度取得最低测试误差（优于9种固定激活与样条KAN）；图像分类、图像去噪、情感分析中最佳分数Hermite块取得最高准确率或重建质量；物理信息问题上Lane-Emden方程MAE达10^-6~10^-5，Burgers方程残差约10^-4，分数阶延迟微分方程绝对误差低于10^-4。
AI.conclusion: FHKAN以无界域正交Hermite基消除饱和压缩，兼具理论可微性刻画与跨任务性能优势，是谱型KAN基函数选择的可行替代方案。

title: Are Self-Evolving Agents Continual Learners?
summary: Large language model agents are often deployed in environments where new knowledge, tools, and workflows keep arriving. Such an agent is therefore expected to adapt continually, learning new tasks as they arrive without forgetting earlier ones. This resembles the continual learning problem, but at a pace that conventional gradient updates cannot sustain. Nonparametric self-evolving agents are a natural alternative: they adapt by rewriting their own harness, such as prompts, memory, and skills, from task feedback while the model weights stay frozen. We study whether such agents are effective continual learners across four drifting task streams that shift in topic, workflow, or domain (built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld). Evaluating three representative methods spanning experience retrieval and self-modification (ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness), we find that although self-evolution improves aggregate performance on most streams, higher plasticity consistently comes at the cost of stability. Specifically, self-modifying methods apply global edits to a shared prompt or workspace, interfering with unseen tasks and overwriting earlier knowledge as the stream shifts. Conversely, similarity-based memory retrieval localizes updates across distant domains, but still retrieves foreign memories on unseen tasks and suffers from retrieval collision when similar queries require conflicting workflows. These findings show that current self-evolving agents remain incomplete continual learners.

AI.tldr: 研究非参数化自演化LLM智能体能否在任务流中持续学习，发现自演化虽提升总体性能，但可塑性提升以稳定性为代价，现有方法仍是不完整的持续学习者。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体常部署在持续涌现新知识、工具与工作流的环境中，需在不遗忘旧任务的前提下不断学习新任务，这构成持续学习问题；但该节奏之快使传统梯度更新难以承受，因此需考察权重冻结、仅靠改写提示/记忆/技能等"外部装置"的非参数化自演化智能体是否可行。
AI.method: 构建四条漂移任务流（分别沿主题、工作流、领域漂移，基于BIRD、BFCL、ScienceWorld），评测三类代表性方法：经验检索类（ReasoningBank）与自修改类（GEPA、Meta-Harness），从可塑性-稳定性权衡角度分析其持续学习表现。
AI.result: 自演化在多数任务流上提升总体性能，但可塑性提升始终伴随稳定性下降：自修改方法对共享提示或工作区做全局编辑，干扰未见任务并随流漂移覆盖先前知识；基于相似度的记忆检索虽能在差异较大的领域间局部化更新，但在未见任务上仍会检索到无关记忆，且当相似查询需要冲突工作流时出现检索碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 现有自演化智能体尚不是完整的持续学习者，其更新机制缺乏对更新作用范围与检索正确性的有效控制，可塑性-稳定性权衡尚未得到解决。

title: Learning without Overwriting: Structural Knowledge Fusion for Continual Learning
summary: Catastrophic forgetting in sequential deep learning arises from a fixed-capacity architectural constraint: parameter updates encoding new tasks perturb weight subspaces supporting prior representations. We introduce the Knowledge Fusion Network (KFN), which mitigates the stability-plasticity trade-off in class-incremental learning through novelty-gated structural expansion rather than parameter negotiation within a shared capacity budget. KFN decouples task acquisition from knowledge consolidation: each incoming task is learned in an isolated lightweight specialist network (2.8M parameters) and integrated into the global model via a Structural Fusion Module that allocates dedicated channel capacity conditioned on a quantitative novelty score. Dual structural isolation--channel-space separation with temporally phased gradient unfreezing--protects consolidated knowledge. On ten-task Split CIFAR-100, KFN achieves 11.94% minimum task accuracy and 71.16% task-10 accuracy, whereas shared-parameter baselines degrade severely: LwF to 9.07% average accuracy (0.00% min), Replay++ to 8.91% (85.08% forgetting), and Replay to 16.21% (73.44% forgetting); KFN's forgetting (57.92%) is 15.5 pp lower than Replay. Furthermore, KFN prevents logit-scale drift, maintaining near-symmetric task performance. Across CIFAR-100 and EuroSAT satellite imagery, KFN's class-incremental retention (72.7% and 42.5%) substantially exceeds the best baselines (29.6% and 0.94%). Crucially, KFN achieves parameter-efficient linear scaling, adding 25% of the base parameter count per step and requiring 25.1% of naive backbone duplication over ten tasks (28.1M vs 112.0M). With a 37.1% peak GPU memory reduction over full retraining, KFN establishes novelty-gated expansion as a practical path beyond fixed-capacity architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出知识融合网络（KFN），通过新颖性门控的结构扩展而非共享参数预算内的协商来缓解类增量学习中的稳定性-可塑性权衡，在Split CIFAR-100与EuroSAT上显著优于回放/正则化基线并实现参数与显存高效。
AI.motivation: 顺序深度学习中的灾难性遗忘源于固定容量架构约束：编码新任务的参数更新会扰动支撑旧表征的权重子空间。传统方法在共享容量预算内做参数协商（正则化、回放）难以兼顾稳定性与可塑性。
AI.method: KFN解耦任务获取与知识整合：每个新任务在隔离的轻量专家网络（2.8M参数）中学习；结构融合模块依据定量新颖性分数分配专用通道容量完成整合；双重结构隔离（通道空间分离＋分阶段梯度解冻）保护已固化知识。
AI.result: 十任务Split CIFAR-100上，KFN最小任务精度11.94%、任务10精度71.16%；基线严重退化：LwF平均9.07%（最小0.00%）、Replay++ 8.91%（遗忘85.08%）、Replay 16.21%（遗忘73.44%）；KFN遗忘率57.92%，比Replay低15.5个百分点，并抑制logit尺度漂移。CIFAR-100与EuroSAT上类增量保持率72.7%与42.5%，远超最佳基线29.6%与0.94%。参数线性扩展：每步增加基础参数量的25%，十任务仅需朴素骨干复制方案的25.1%（28.1M vs 112.0M），峰值GPU显存较全量重训练降低37.1%。
AI.conclusion: 新颖性门控的结构扩展是超越固定容量架构的可行路径，在精度保持、抗遗忘、参数与显存效率方面具有综合优势。

title: Minimum-Cost Robust Evidence Certificates for Horn Reasoning under Correlated Source Failures
summary: A small justification for a rule-based conclusion may disappear when a source is withdrawn, and multiple derivations need not provide independent evidence. We study minimum-cost certificates that preserve a Horn conclusion under every withdrawal of at most k source domains. Evidence records remain distinct from asserted facts, supporting replicated attestations and overlapping failure dependencies. Transversals of minimal-support footprints characterize robustness and explain why disjoint-proof requirements can reject valid certificates. An exact procedure alternates weighted evidence selection with a source-failure oracle. A rule-closed counterinterpretation yields a globally valid selection cut without enumerating supports or failure scenarios. We prove correctness, finite termination, and cost optimality, establish coNP-completeness of unrestricted verification and NP-completeness of synthesis for every fixed budget, and identify a tractable reachability restriction. Experiments on controlled benchmarks, reachability graphs, and ontology-derived instances demonstrate that our counterinterpretation-guided synthesis achieves up to 92% optimum coverage within practical resource bounds, outperforming scenario expansion and general abduction while confirming the necessity of transversal-based reasoning over proof-packing heuristics.

AI.tldr: 研究在至多k个来源域撤除下维持Horn结论的最小代价证明证书问题，用横截（transversal）刻画鲁棒性，提出交替加权证据选择与来源失效预言机的精确算法，并由规则封闭的反解释生成全局有效的选择割。
AI.motivation: 规则化结论的小型论证可能因来源撤除而消失，而多条推导未必提供独立证据；需要区分"证据记录"与"断言事实"，以处理复制性证言与重叠的失效依赖，从而在来源失效情形下保证结论的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 以最小支撑足迹（minimal-support footprints）的横截刻画鲁棒性；设计交替进行加权证据选择与来源失效预言机的精确算法；利用规则封闭的反解释（rule-closed counterinterpretation）在不枚举支撑与失效场景的情况下产生全局有效的选择割。
AI.result: 证明了算法正确性、有限终止与代价最优性；无限制验证为coNP完全，任意固定预算下的合成为NP完全，并识别出一类可处理的可达性限制；实验显示反解释引导的合成在实用资源限制内达到最高92%的最优覆盖率，优于场景展开与一般溯因方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于横截的推理优于证明打包启发式，且不交证明要求可能误拒有效证书；反解释引导的割生成在实践中高效且理论最优。

title: Indistinguishable Agents: Training Agent Privacy as Twin-World Indistinguishability
summary: LLM agents search, shop and send messages for their users, and every action is seen by some party. Existing privacy training rewards agents for not mentioning protected items, yet an observer can infer a private fact from what the agent does. Since an observer learns a fact only if its view changes with the fact, we propose \methodfull (\method), which trains on twin worlds that differ only in the private fact. A frozen distinguisher scores each observer's view by its log-likelihood ratio for the true world, and paired GRPO trains the agent on task success minus this ratio. We prove that this objective controls the Bayes success of every observer on every channel. On shopping and messaging tasks \method removes the leakage that disclosure judges and query-level rewards miss, while the agent still completes its tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 MirrorTwins（方法名以原文 \method 占位），通过在仅私有事实不同的"双生世界"上训练 LLM 智能体，以冻结判别器的对数似然比作为观察者推断泄漏的度量，配合成对 GRPO 优化"任务成功 − 该比值"，并理论证明该目标可控制任意观察者在任意信道上对私有事实的贝叶斯推断成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私训练只惩罚智能体"提到"受保护项（disclosure judges、query-level reward），但真正的风险在于观察者可从智能体的行为（搜索、购物、发消息等动作及其可见信道）反推出私有事实。只要观察者的视角随该事实变化，他就能学到事实，因此需要一种直接约束"行为—事实"可推断性的训练目标。
AI.method: 1）构造双生世界：成对环境中除私有事实外其余完全一致；2）冻结判别器（frozen distinguisher）对每个观察者的视角计算其在真实世界下的对数似然比（log-likelihood ratio），作为该观察者能推断出事实的程度；3）用成对 GRPO 训练智能体，奖励为任务成功减去该似然比；4）理论分析：证明该目标可控制每个观察者在每个信道上的贝叶斯推断成功率（Bayes success）。
AI.result: 在购物与消息传递任务上，该方法消除了 disclosure judges 与 query-level reward 无法捕获的泄漏，同时智能体仍能完成既定任务。
AI.conclusion: 将隐私保护形式化为"观察者视角对私有事实的敏感度"，并用双生世界对比 + 似然比奖励直接优化，是一种有理论保证且实证有效的智能体隐私训练范式；相较仅约束显式披露的既有方法，它覆盖了隐式行为泄漏。

title: Benefit-Targeted Routing and Bounded Revision for LLM-Based Evidence Screening in Manufacturing Supplier Discovery
summary: An evidence-review system must allocate additional model judgments and control their use. We study these software decisions on 6,164 frozen manufacturing source-task pairs. Benefit-targeted routing learns recovered agreement minus newly introduced disagreement. On the original 300-case test, 60 consultations yield 202/231 agreements with two human references versus 189/218 for a logistic-risk router. An additional 300 cases were independently annotated twice using equal frozen evidence. Without retraining the historical policies, the corresponding counts are 164/190 versus 163/193; the differences do not resolve an advantage. Strict scalar-Ridge controls share preprocessing, regularization and fitting, and remain inconclusive. Quotation and requested-state replacement gates retain rejected cases and budget costs; their joint gate rejects one original and two additional consultations without changing primary outcomes. Evidence ablations, fusion and bounded updates supply further controls. A completed 200-pair identity audit yields 97.45 percent weighted merge precision after eight author adjudications. This audits a provisional map, while prospective company-disjoint performance remains untested.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究证据审查系统中的软件决策：如何分配额外模型判断并控制其使用，并在6,164个冻结的制造业源-任务对上评估“收益导向路由”。
AI.motivation: 证据审查系统需要决定何时调用额外模型判断、以及如何控制这些判断的使用，但收益导向路由能否稳定优于基线路由尚不清楚，且需排除预处理、正则化与拟合等混杂因素。
AI.method: 在6,164个冻结的制造业源-任务对上，将“收益导向路由”建模为“恢复的一致性减去新引入的不一致性”；与逻辑风险路由对比。原始300例测试中做60次咨询。另独立两次标注300例，冻结证据、不重训历史策略。使用严格标量-Ridge对照（共享预处理、正则化与拟合），并设置引文门与请求状态替换门，保留被拒案例与预算成本；辅以证据消融、融合与有界更新控制，并完成200对身份审计（8次作者裁定）。
AI.result: 原始300例测试中，60次咨询相对两个人参考得到202/231一致，逻辑风险路由为189/218。追加300例重标注后，对应计数为164/190对163/193，差异未确立优势。严格标量-Ridge对照结论不确定。联合门仅拒绝1个原始与2个附加咨询，未改变主要结果。身份审计加权合并精度为97.45%。
AI.conclusion: 收益导向路由未显示稳定优于逻辑风险路由，严格对照亦不能定论；联合门未影响主结果。审计仅针对暂定映射，前瞻性公司不相交性能尚未检验。

title: M-JEPA: Predictive Self-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs with Scaffold-Shift Evaluation on Tox21
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures. Submitted (pre-peer-review) version; the final published version appeared in J. Chem. Inf. Model
summary: Self-supervised molecular representation learning is increasingly used to improve transfer on small, label-limited property prediction tasks, yet commonly used contrastive objectives can be sensitive to view construction and are often evaluated with protocols that report only discrimination. We adapt Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) to molecular graphs by masking chemically coherent connected subgraphs and training a context encoder to regress the masked target embedding produced by an exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher. To evaluate predictive self-supervision under realistic distribution shift, we introduce a leakage-resistant, compute-matched three-phase protocol: (i) an 80-run objective screening on ESOL with fixed compute budgets, (ii) JEPA-only refinement of masking and augmentation choices, and (iii) per-assay Tox21 evaluation under Bemis-Murcko scaffold splits with joint discrimination-reliability analysis and attribution diagnostics. Under matched compute, M-JEPA achieves substantially lower ESOL proxy RMSE than a compute-matched InfoNCE baseline (mean RMSE 2.12 vs 3.75; mean paired dRMSE 1.61; 95% bootstrap CI [1.52, 1.72]; Wilcoxon p=2.4e-4) and typically completes runs faster (~15-25 min vs ~35-45 min on a single GPU under identical hardware), albeit with higher runtime variance. On Tox21, improvements in ROC-AUC/PR-AUC are assay-dependent and do not uniformly imply better calibration; reliability diagrams and Brier/ECE metrics reveal endpoints where fine-tuning improves ranking but leaves probabilities miscalibrated.

AI.tldr: 将JEPA适配到分子图，用"掩码化学连贯连通子图+EMA教师回归"做自监督，并提出防泄漏、算力匹配的三阶段评估协议；匹配算力下M-JEPA的ESOL代理RMSE显著低于InfoNCE，Tox21上的排名提升依赖具体assay且不必然带来良好校准。
AI.motivation: 分子自监督学习常用于小样本、标签稀缺的性质预测迁移，但常用对比目标对视图构造敏感，且评估协议多只报告判别性能（discrimination），缺乏对真实分布偏移和概率可靠性的考察。
AI.method: 把Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA)适配到分子图：掩码化学连贯的连通子图，用上下文编码器回归由EMA教师产生的被掩码目标嵌入。评估采用防泄漏、算力匹配的三阶段协议：(i) 在ESOL上以固定算力预算做80次运行的目标函数筛选；(ii) 仅对JEPA精调掩码与增强选择；(iii) 在Bemis-Murcko骨架划分下做逐assay的Tox21评估，并进行联合判别-可靠性分析与归因诊断。
AI.result: 匹配算力下，M-JEPA的ESOL代理RMSE显著低于InfoNCE基线（均值2.12 vs 3.75；成对dRMSE均值1.61，95% bootstrap CI [1.52,1.72]；Wilcoxon p=2.4e-4），单GPU运行通常更快（约15–25 min vs 35–45 min），但运行时间方差更大。Tox21上ROC-AUC/PR-AUC提升因assay而异，且并不一致地意味着更好的校准；可靠性图与Brier/ECE显示部分端点微调改善了排序却仍概率失准。
AI.conclusion: 预测式（JEPA式）自监督在算力匹配条件下优于对比式（InfoNCE）目标，并在效率上有优势；但下游收益具assay依赖性，判别性提升不等于校准改善，因此需要联合报告判别与可靠性指标并辅以归因诊断来评估分子表示学习的真实效用。

title: CODA: Cohort- and Drift-aware Foundation Model for Multimodal Clinical Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse clinical tasks. However, existing approaches predominantly operate at the individual sample level and fail to model the interplay between population-level cohort patterns and patient-specific variation that underlie real-world clinical reasoning. In practice, clinicians routinely reason through patient cohorts sharing similar demographic, physiological, or pathological characteristics, while accounting for patient-specific deviations from the group prototype. Motivated by this gap, we propose CODA, a cohort- and drift-aware foundation model for multimodal clinical reasoning. CODA explicitly integrates cohort structure into the modeling pipeline through two complementary mechanisms: cohort-aware population stratification and drift-aware individual adaptation. In particular, we leverage reinforcement learning to discover clinically meaningful patient cohorts, and further model each patient's deviation from cohort prototypes as a structured drift signal encoding fine-grained individual heterogeneity. These cohort- and drift-aware representations are incorporated into the foundation model to enable reasoning that is simultaneously informed by population-level patterns and sensitive to individual-level variation. Extensive experiments on real-world electronic health record (EHR) benchmarks demonstrate that CODA achieves consistent effectiveness and strong generalizability across diverse clinical tasks, including closed-QA, open-QA, and report generation.

AI.tldr: CODA 是一个"队列感知+漂移感知"的多模态临床推理基础模型，显式建模人群队列结构与个体偏差，在 EHR 基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基础模型主要在单样本层面工作，缺乏对"人群队列模式"与"患者个体变异"相互作用的建模，而真实临床推理正是以同类患者群体为参照、同时关注个体偏离。为弥合这一差距，作者提出 CODA。
AI.method: 两大互补机制：(1) 队列感知的人群分层——用强化学习自动发现具临床意义的患者队列；(2) 漂移感知的个体适应——将患者相对队列原型的偏离建模为结构化漂移信号，编码细粒度个体异质性。两类表示注入基础模型，使推理同时受人群层面模式引导并保持个体敏感性。
AI.result: 在真实 EHR 基准上，closed-QA、open-QA 与报告生成等多类临床任务中均取得一致的有效性，并展现较强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将队列结构与个体漂移显式纳入多模态临床基础模型是有效方向，可在多种临床任务上提升性能与泛化性。

title: World Models, Trees and Foundation Models for Retail Forecasting: Evidence from Four Public Data Sets
comment: 37 pages, 18 figures, 26 tables. Code: https://github.com/karthik-iyer-au/retail-world-models, archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23448056
summary: A retailer makes different decisions at different grains of the product, store and time hierarchy: store orders for an item in a store, supplier funding for an item across stores, category performance by store, and the financial plan for the chain. Which forecasting model to use depends on the grain. This paper compares models at each grain on four public data sets (M5, six Dominick's categories, Breakfast at the Frat, and Corporación Favorita, the last kept out of all development), over rolling forecast origins with paired tests and model confidence sets. It covers price and promotion through the plan inputs these data record, not product, assortment or place. The models are a world model that carries each item's state forward under the price and promotion plan, the same network without that state, LightGBM, the Temporal Fusion Transformer, TimesFM, Chronos-Bolt, Timestral, seasonal naive, and an equal-weight average of the world model, LightGBM and TimesFM given the plan. The answer changed with the grain. For an item by store and an item across stores, the average had the lowest error on seven and eight of nine data sets, and the 90% confidence set held a median of 1 and 2 models. For a category by store, a category and the chain total, the lowest-error model differed between data sets and a median of 4 of nine models were not separated by the four to six windows available. For category-by-store planning cost, the average or LightGBM was lowest on seven of eight data sets, and the world model was lowest only on M5; it was behind LightGBM item by store on six of eight. Every trained model used the plan, and on the weekly promotion-driven data pretrained models were less accurate without it. These results hold for these data sets; a forecast solved across all four Ps, or a retailer's own data, may give different results. Every model, test and change that lost is reported.

AI.tldr: 零售商在不同粒度（单品-门店、单品的跨门店、门店品类、链条财务）做预测，本文在四套公开数据上比较世界模型、去状态网络、LightGBM、TFT、TimesFM、Chronos-Bolt、Timestral、季节朴素及三者等权平均，发现最优模型随粒度改变：单品×门店与单品跨门店上等权平均误差最低（9套数据中7/8套），品类与链条层面模型难被区分，且所有训练模型均使用了价格与促销计划输入。
AI.motivation: 零售商在商品、门店、时间层级的不同粒度上做不同决策（门店单品订货、跨门店供应商资金、门店品类表现、链条财务计划），适用的预测模型因粒度而异；需要系统比较不同粒度下的模型表现，并明确结论的适用范围与局限。
AI.method: 在四个公开数据集（M5、Dominick's 六品类、Breakfast at the Frat、Corporación Favorita，其中 Favorita 完全不入开发）上，于滚动预测起点使用配对检验与模型置信集比较候选模型：携带单品状态的世界模型、无状态同结构网络、LightGBM、Temporal Fusion Transformer、TimesFM、Chronos-Bolt、Timestral、季节朴素，以及世界模型+LightGBM+TimesFM（给定计划）的等权平均；仅通过数据记录的计划输入涵盖价格与促销，不涉及产品、品类结构或选址；报告全部失败模型、检验与改动。
AI.result: 结论随粒度变化：单品×门店与单品跨门店上，等权平均在9套数据中分别为7套和8套误差最低，90%置信集模型数中位数为1和2；门店品类、全品类与链条总量上，最低误差模型随数据集而异，9个模型中中位数4个无法被现有4–6个窗口区分；品类×门店规划成本上，平均或LightGBM在8套中7套最低，世界模型仅M5最低，且在单品×门店上8套中有6套劣于LightGBM；所有训练模型均使用计划输入，周度促销驱动数据上预训练模型缺乏计划时精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 模型优劣依预测粒度而变：细粒度（单品层）适合组合/等权平均，粗粒度（品类、链条）模型间难以区分且需更多评估窗口；结论限于这些数据集，跨四P统一求解或零售商自有数据可能给出不同结果；已完整披露所有失败模型与检验。

title: Motor compound fault diagnosis using an attention-based cross-talk architecture
summary: As physical AI increasingly relies on sensing to understand physical systems, reliable condition monitoring of industrial machinery has become more important. Motors are ubiquitous in industrial systems, and increasing system complexity raises the likelihood of simultaneous faults. Accordingly, compound fault diagnosis that identifies multiple fault components and their severities is increasingly required. Because different fault components jointly affect the same vibration signal, their severity classification can be formulated as related tasks, making multi-task learning (MTL) suitable for exploiting shared information. However, conventional shared-trunk architectures force tasks to share a common representation, potentially causing negative transfer because fault components are characterized by different time-frequency regions. To address this issue, this study proposes a Residual Neural Dimension Reductor with Time-Frequency Channel Attention (RNDR-TFCA), an attention-enhanced cross-talk architecture for multi-output compound fault diagnosis. RNDR-TFCA preserves task-specific feature extractors while selectively exchanging information across tasks. Time-frequency attention emphasizes informative intra-task regions, while channel attention enhances useful inter-task information after nonlinear feature fusion. Experiments on a rotor-bearing system with inner-race fault, outer-race fault, misalignment, and unbalance showed that RNDR-TFCA achieved a macro F1 score of 0.898, outperforming single-task, multi-class, shared-trunk, and cross-talk baselines. Ablation experiments confirmed the benefit of jointly applying both attention mechanisms. RNDR-TFCA required 713 K parameters and 170.42 MMACs, only slightly higher than RNDR. Channel-expanded baselines still underperformed RNDR-TFCA, indicating that the gain was not simply attributable to increased model capacity.

AI.tldr: 提出RNDR-TFCA——一种结合时频通道注意力的交叉对话（cross-talk）多任务架构，用于电机复合故障的严重程度诊断。
AI.motivation: 物理AI依赖传感理解物理系统，电机复合故障（多故障分量同时出现）诊断需求上升。多故障分量共同作用于同一振动信号，严重程度分类可视为相关任务，适合用多任务学习共享信息；但传统共享主干强制共享表征，而各故障分量的时频区域不同，易导致负迁移。
AI.method: RNDR-TFCA保留任务专属特征提取器，在任务间选择性交换信息；时频注意力强化任务内有效区域，通道注意力在非线性特征融合后增强任务间有用信息。实验在含内圈故障、外圈故障、不对中与不平衡的转子-轴承系统上进行，并与单任务、多分类、共享主干及cross-talk基线比较，另做消融与参数量分析。
AI.result: macro F1达0.898，优于各基线；消融实验证实两种注意力机制联合使用有效；模型仅需713 K参数与170.42 MMACs，略高于RNDR；扩容通道的基线仍不及本方法，表明性能提升并非单纯来自模型容量增大。
AI.conclusion: cross-talk结合时频与通道双重注意力可有效缓解共享主干的负迁移，实现高效多输出复合故障严重程度诊断，且性能增益源于结构设计而非容量扩张。

title: Sampling and Curvature in First-Exit Comparisons for Momentum SGD
summary: First-exit prediction for momentum SGD depends on sampling information that pointwise gradient laws omit. Strongly convex finite pools with identical pointwise laws and matched iid momentum dynamics can have different reshuffled exits; even analytic pools with uniformly close pointwise laws can have separated exit probabilities. For persistent sampling in one dimension, we establish an explicit $O(h)$ mean-exit comparison with a finite-rate switching process under nonvanishing component velocities and step-size conditions; iid sampling instead averages to an ODE. Retaining realized minibatches and sampled curvature yields finite-window exit brackets beyond this regime. In 32 trained ridge-logistic runs, 29 meet prespecified targets with rounding-certified brackets; an enclosure control explains most of the width advantage. Exact-real certificates establish finite means at the original tested radii for three ResNet-18 checkpoints and give local finite-mean conditions for tanh and ViT networks; their upper bounds remain loose, and original-radius ViT mean guarantees remain unresolved despite 128 fresh continuation paths. A two-network replication gives 32/32 successful seeds in each of four finite-path persistence comparisons. Independent equal-length controls retain slower exits after refresh resets than without resets, but the refresh-versus-random ordering reverses with update length at both networks. These interventions do not causally decompose raw momentum SGD. Neural step-size scaling does not validate the switching limit.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究动量SGD的首次逃逸(first-exit)预测问题，论证其依赖于逐点梯度律所忽略的采样信息，并在持久采样、iid采样及有限窗口等情形下给出理论刻画，辅以ridge-logistic与ResNet-18/ViT的实验验证。
AI.motivation: 逐点梯度律（pointwise gradient laws）通常被认为足以刻画优化动态，但作者希望指出：动量SGD的首次逃逸行为还依赖采样信息（如minibatch重排、持久采样与iid采样的差异），这些是逐点律无法捕捉的，因此需要新的理论工具与证书。
AI.method: 构造强凸有限池的反例（相同逐点律、匹配的iid动量动态但重排后逃逸不同；解析池中逐点律一致接近但逃逸概率分离）；在一维持久采样下建立与有限速率切换过程的显式O(h)平均逃逸比较（非零分量速度与步长条件下），并说明iid采样平均为ODE；保留实际minibatch与采样曲率得到有限窗口逃逸区间；用精确实数证书分析ResNet-18/tanh/ViT网络。
AI.result: 32次训练ridge-logistic运行中29次达到预设目标并具舍入认证区间，enclosure对照解释了大部分宽度优势；精确实数证书在三个ResNet-18检查点原始测试半径上确立有限均值，并给出tanh与ViT的局部有限均值条件，但上界偏松、ViT原始半径的均值保证仍未解决（128条新续路径）；两网络复现中四组有限路径持久性比较各32/32种子成功；等长对照显示刷新重置后逃逸更慢，但刷新与随机的排序随更新长度在两网络处反转。
AI.conclusion: 首次逃逸预测本质依赖采样信息，逐点梯度律不足；持久采样与iid采样在逃逸均值上有O(h)量级差异；有限窗口区间与精确实数证书可提供部分认证保证，但上界仍松、ViT原始半径的保证未定；所设干预不能因果分解原始动量SGD，神经步长缩放也不能验证切换极限。

title: When Should AI Chime In? Benchmarking Timely Contribution of Proactive Agents in Multi-Party Chat
summary: Proactive agents can support group collaboration by surfacing useful information without waiting to be asked, but even relevant contributions can be disruptive if poorly timed. In this work, we isolate the timing question: given a fixed candidate contribution such as a clarification or relevant fact, when should an AI agent chime in? We introduce PITCH (Proactive Intervention Timing in CHat), to our knowledge the first benchmark with large-scale human judgments of proactive agent timing collected from participants in the same unscripted multi-party conversations they took part in. To collect high-quality judgments, we design a novel interface in which 2-4 people chat synchronously, author candidate AI contribution messages, place their own and others' contributions into the chat history, and then deliberate as a group about the best placement for each message. PITCH contains 384 candidate contributions and 1,091 judgments, each marking an ideal turn, an acceptable window, or that a contribution should not appear, from 89 participants engaged in 35 conversations. Evaluating 15 models across 28 configurations, we find that while models can place contributions well when given the entire conversation history, they systematically chime in too early when asked to decide live as the conversation unfolds: best-turn accuracy falls from 57.8% to 19.0%, with nearly half of placements occurring before every participant's acceptable window. In comparison, lay humans deciding live are more accurate (23.7% vs 19.0%), and fewer of their placements are premature (39.7% vs 46.4%). Model reasoning traces show that 93% of intervention justifications cite relevance, while almost none consider waiting. By providing a human-grounded benchmark, our work reveals gaps in agents' ability to integrate into group settings and points towards proactive agents that can reason explicitly about appropriate timing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PITCH基准，用同一场真实多方对话中参与者的人工判断来评测AI主动插话时机：模型在离线全历史下最佳轮次准确率57.8%，但在在线逐轮决策时降至19.0%且近半插话过早，暴露其对"等待"缺乏推理。
AI.motivation: 主动型AI代理虽能主动提供澄清或相关信息，但时机不当会造成打扰。已有工作多关注"说什么"，本文隔离并聚焦"何时说"这一独立问题，并指出现有评测缺乏来自真实对话参与者的大规模人类时机判断。
AI.method: 构建PITCH（Proactive Intervention Timing in CHat）基准：设计新型协作界面，2-4名参与者同步聊天、撰写候选AI贡献消息，并将自己与他人的消息放入对话历史，再以小组形式讨论每条消息的最佳位置。数据含35场对话、89名参与者、384条候选贡献、1,091条判断，每条标注理想轮次、可接受窗口或"不应出现"。评测15个模型、28种配置，并对比人类在线决策与模型推理痕迹。
AI.result: 给定完整对话历史时模型定位最佳轮次准确率为57.8%；在线逐轮决策时降至19.0%，且46.4%的插话早于所有参与者的可接受窗口。人类在线决策准确率为23.7%、过早比例39.7%，优于模型。推理痕迹显示93%的干预理由诉诸相关性，几乎无模型考虑"是否需要等待"。
AI.conclusion: PITCH提供了人类判断支撑的时机评测基准，揭示主动代理在融入群组协作时存在系统性"过早介入"缺陷；未来应发展能显式推理合适时机（包括等待决策）的主动代理。

title: Shallow Probes Are Sufficient for Near-Oracle Personalization Depth Allocation in Federated Learning
comment: 6 pages, 9 figures. Accepted and presented at SINCONF 2026 (18th International Conference on Security of Information and Networks), Beykent University, Istanbul, Turkiye, 14-16 October 2026
summary: Rather than proposing a new federated optimizer, we study whether a small client-specific measurement budget can support cost-aware personalization-depth decisions under a utility that trades Macro-F1 against deployment cost. Exhaustive evaluation of six depths defines an offline oracle that is not deployable. We audit the Probe Sufficiency Hypothesis: three shallow probes (P0--P2) may contain most decision-relevant information for approaching that oracle. FedPBA is a secondary learned instantiation for deep-action extrapolation. On CIFAR-10/100 and patient-disjoint PTB-XL (45 sessions; 900 clients; 2700 evaluations; GroupKFold), training-free greedy probing achieves regret 0.0071 and 98.3 percent oracle recovery, beating metadata-only policies and FedPBA (0.0110 / 97.3 percent). Aggregate shallow-best versus oracle correlation is 0.9818 but falls to 0.578 on deep-oracle rows; PTB-XL deep-oracle cases remain a high-regret boundary without a validated escalation gate.

AI.tldr: 研究小规模客户端专属“探测预算”能否支撑成本感知的个性化深度决策：免训练贪心探测在CIFAR-10/100与PTB-XL上以0.0071后悔、98.3% oracle恢复率优于元数据策略与FedPBA，但深度动作外推仍是高后悔边界。
AI.motivation: 不追求新联邦优化器，而是检验一个实际问题：在Macro-F1与部署成本的效用权衡下，能否用很小的每客户端测量预算决定个性化深度。穷举六种深度的离线oracle不可部署，故需验证“探测充分性假设”——三个浅层探测（P0–P2）是否已包含逼近oracle所需的大部分决策信息。
AI.method: 以六深度穷举评估构建不可部署的离线oracle；提出免训练贪心探测策略作为主方法，FedPBA作为次级学习式实例化用于深层动作外推；在CIFAR-10/100与患者不重叠的PTB-XL（45会话、900客户端、2700次评估、GroupKFold）上，与仅元数据策略、FedPBA对比后悔与oracle恢复率，并分析浅层与oracle的相关性。
AI.result: 免训练贪心探测取得后悔0.0071、oracle恢复率98.3%，优于仅元数据策略与FedPBA（0.0110 / 97.3%）。聚合层面浅层最优与oracle相关性达0.9818，但在深度oracle行上降至0.578；PTB-XL深度oracle情形仍是缺乏已验证升级门控的高后悔边界。
AI.conclusion: 探测充分性假设在聚合层面成立：少量浅层探测即可接近oracle并支持成本感知的深度决策。但该证据不能外推到深层动作，浅层-深度相关性显著下降，深层场景需一个经验证的升级门控，此为后续工作方向。

title: TESS: LLM-guided Translation, Exploration, Simulation, and Search for Embodied Task Planning
comment: EMNLP 2026 findings. Code will be released at https://github.com/woyut/TESS_EMNLP26
summary: In this work we focus on the problem of embodied task planning, which requires an agent to accomplish a complex task by separating it into atomic actions. Recent studies have developed LLM-based methods to address this problem. However, the executability and correctness of the generated plans remain suboptimal in complex environments and tasks. On the other hand, classical search algorithms have the potential to solve the planning problems perfectly, yet they require fully observable environments, known state transitions and goal state, which are often unattainable in general task domains. Therefore, we propose to implement an LLM-guided search algorithm that makes the search process possible and efficient by incorporating LLMs' commonsense knowledge. Our method leverages LLMs to (1) translate natural language instructions into formatted goal conditions, (2) facilitate efficient exploration in partially observable environments, (3) implement a rule-based world simulator, and (4) prune the space of candidate actions to improve search efficiency. Experimental results on VirtualHome and ALFWorld demonstrate its superior performance.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM引导的搜索算法解决具身任务规划问题，利用LLM常识知识实现目标形式化、部分可观测环境下的高效探索、规则化世界模拟器与候选动作剪枝，在VirtualHome和ALFWorld上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: LLM-based规划方法在复杂环境与任务中生成计划的可行性与正确性仍不理想；经典搜索算法虽能完美求解规划问题，却依赖全可观测环境、已知状态转移与目标状态，在一般任务域中难以满足。因此需结合二者优势。
AI.method: 提出LLM引导的搜索算法，将LLM常识知识融入搜索：(1) 将自然语言指令翻译为格式化目标条件；(2) 促进部分可观测环境下的高效探索；(3) 实现基于规则的世界模拟器；(4) 剪枝候选动作空间以提升搜索效率。
AI.result: 在VirtualHome与ALFWorld数据集上的实验结果表明该方法性能优越。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM的常识知识与经典搜索算法相结合，可有效弥补LLM规划可执行性不足与经典搜索对环境假设过强之间的鸿沟，为具身任务规划提供可行且高效的方案。

title: ViCoR: Estimating Visual Necessity via Counterfactual Residuals for Multimodal Medical Data Selection
summary: Medical vision-language models often exhibit hidden stratification, where high overall performance masks failures on subtle visual findings and overlapping clinical conditions. We trace this failure mode to modality imbalance during fine-tuning, where strong linguistic priors can suppress visually grounded learning and induce plausible but weakly grounded rationales. Existing data selection methods usually score image-text pairs as holistic units, without separating visually necessary samples from shortcut-solvable ones. To address this problem, we propose ViCoR, a counterfactual-residual-based data selection method for Med-VLM fine-tuning. ViCoR estimates visual necessity through image-dependent optimization residuals, calibrates the resulting scores with medical supervision compatibility, and constructs a diversity-aware fine-tuning subset. Across two backbones, four external generalization benchmarks, and one multi-disease robustness benchmark, ViCoR-selected 20\% subsets achieve the strongest average performance compared with full-data fine-tuning and selection baselines. Gradient-level analysis and perturbation audits further show that ViCoR enriches image-dependent training signals and strengthens image-level and evidence-region dependence. The code will be available at https://github.com/htgan-ai/ViCoR.

AI.tldr: 提出ViCoR，一种基于反事实残差的数据选择方法，通过图像依赖的优化残差估计样本的视觉必要性，并结合医学监督兼容性校准与多样性构建微调子集，缓解Med-VLM微调中的模态失衡与隐藏分层问题。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型存在隐藏分层：整体性能高但掩盖了对细微视觉征象和重叠病症的失败。作者将其归因于微调时的模态失衡——强语言先验压制了视觉 grounding 学习，产生看似合理但依据薄弱的推理。现有数据选择方法以整对图文为单元打分，无法区分"视觉必需样本"与"可被捷径解决样本"。
AI.method: ViCoR包括三部分：(1) 以图像依赖的优化残差（反事实残差）估计样本的视觉必要性；(2) 用医学监督兼容性对分数进行校准；(3) 构建多样性感知的微调子集。
AI.result: 在两个骨干网络、四个外部泛化基准和一个多疾病鲁棒性基准上，ViCoR选取的20%子集在平均性能上优于全量微调与各选择基线。梯度层面分析与扰动审计进一步表明，ViCoR提升了图像依赖的训练信号，并增强了模型对图像级和证据区域的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 通过反事实残差驱动的数据选择可有效缓解医学VLM微调中的模态失衡，用少量高视觉必要性数据即可获得优于全量数据的泛化性与鲁棒性，并改善模型 grounding 的证据依赖。

title: EvoSkill v2: Fully Agentic Skill Evolution from Benchmark Adaptation to a Stateful Evolver
summary: EvoSkill v2 is a three-agent system that edits the instructions (skills) an agent is given, leaving its model and harness intact. The user starts a run by describing a benchmark and supplying a grader, which a benchmark adaptor turns into a benchmark-specific plugin. A solver attempts the tasks, and an evolver reads the solver's training rollouts and rewrites the skills at each epoch. We implement the evolver as one stateful coding agent with a bash tool for the whole run, unlike the two most common designs among the skill optimizers we surveyed: a sequence of single model calls, as in SkillOpt, and an agent that starts afresh each round, as in SkillBoost. We also measure how much the solver's rollouts vary from one attempt to the next, give the evolver several attempts per training task, and accept every epoch's skills instead of selecting among them on noisy scores. With fine-grained ground truth, EvoSkill v2's skills raised the held-out pass rate above the stronger of SkillOpt and SkillBoost by 7.7 percentage points on SpreadsheetBench v2 and by 5.4 on $τ^3$-bench banking. In both benchmarks and both feedback settings, EvoSkill v2's evolver cost less per percentage point of held-out pass rate gained than either baseline's optimizer. EvoSkill v2 also enables a less capable model to improve its own skills, demonstrated by a gain of up to 21.5 percentage points in the $τ^3$-bench banking experiment where Claude Haiku 5.5 powers both solver and evolver.

AI.tldr: EvoSkill v2 是一个三智能体系统，通过改写智能体的指令（skills）来提升性能，保持模型与运行框架不变。它用有状态编码智能体（带 bash 工具）贯穿全程作为 evolver，配合多轮采样与全量接受策略，在 SpreadsheetBench v2 与 τ³-bench banking 上超过 SkillOpt 与 SkillBoost，并具有更优的成本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有技能优化器多采用两种设计：一系列单次模型调用（如 SkillOpt）或每轮重新开始的智能体（如 SkillBoost），缺少跨轮次的状态积累；同时对 rollout 变异噪声处理不足（如依据噪声分数做选择）。作者希望在不改动模型与 harness 的前提下，仅通过编辑技能指令获得更稳定的性能提升与更低成本。
