AI.method: 三智能体架构：benchmark adaptor 将用户描述的基准与评分器转为基准专用插件；solver 执行任务；evolver 读取 solver 的训练 rollout 并在每个 epoch 重写技能。evolver 实现为单个有状态编码智能体，全程持有 bash 工具。三个关键设计：测量 solver 多次尝试间 rollout 的波动；每个训练任务给 evolver 多次尝试机会；接受每个 epoch 的技能而非在噪声分数上做择优筛选。
AI.result: 在细粒度 ground truth 下，EvoSkill v2 的 held-out 通过率在 SpreadsheetBench v2 上比 SkillOpt 与 SkillBoost 中较强者高 7.7 个百分点，在 τ³-bench banking 上高 5.4 个百分点。在两个基准、两种反馈设置下，其 evolver 每提升一个百分点 held-out 通过率的成本均低于两个基线的 optimizer。在 τ³-bench banking 实验中，由 Claude Haiku 5.5 同时担任 solver 与 evolver 时，模型可自提升技能，增益最高达 21.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过有状态、多次尝试、全量接受的技能编辑策略，即可在不动模型与 harness 的情况下显著优于主流技能优化器，并具备更优的成本效率；能力较弱的模型亦可通过该方法自举提升技能水平。

title: NeuroAct: Advancing EEG Analysis and Decoding via Dual-Loop Autonomous Research
summary: EEG analysis and decoding underpin brain-computer interfaces, cognitive assessment, and sleep monitoring. Fixed pipelines and reward-driven search do not explicitly determine how signal structure, representations, predictor behavior, and training dynamics contribute to performance or generalization gaps, leaving intervention choice underdetermined. We introduce NeuroAct, an autonomous research agent framework for EEG analysis and decoding. NeuroAct implements dual-loop autonomous research across EEG foundation models, task-specific predictors, and model combinations. In an inner loop, research, development, and review roles use evidence on signal structure, representations, predictor behavior, and training dynamics to test hypotheses, select analyses or interventions, and refine candidates using performance, stability, and cost feedback. An outer loop distills outcomes into conditional, testable recommendations with task and model conditions, then validates and revises them on subsequent tasks.We evaluate four settings: (A) EEG General Analysis, (B) Cross-task Model Optimization, (C) Single-task Open Research, and (D) Collaborative Prediction. In Setting A, NeuroAct's 80.88 macro-average exceeds BrainAgent's 63.13 by 17.75 points. In Setting B, NeuroAct raises EEGPT's mean balanced accuracy (BA) by 7.34 points and HBN Pearson's (r) from 0.6894 to 0.7362; in Setting C, it improves ADFTD BA by 16.33 points; and in Setting D, it raises Workload BA from 79.69% to 85.02%. Experience reuse raises BCIC-IV-2a BA from 34.66% to 50.81% while reducing LLM tokens by 64.02%, indicating recommendations improve cross-task performance. NeuroAct enables evidence-guided EEG research improved by cross-task experience.

AI.tldr: 提出 NeuroAct——面向EEG分析与解码的双环自主研究智能体框架，以内循环假设检验+外循环经验蒸馏实现证据驱动的干预选择，在四类任务设置上均显著优于基线并实现跨任务经验复用。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG分析多依赖固定流水线或奖励驱动搜索，无法显式刻画信号结构、表征、预测器行为与训练动态对性能和泛化差距的贡献，导致干预手段的选择缺乏依据（欠定）。
AI.method: NeuroAct 采用双环自主研究架构，覆盖EEG基础模型、任务专用预测器及二者组合。内循环中，研究/开发/评审三类角色基于信号结构、表征、预测器行为与训练动态的证据提出并检验假设，选择分析或干预，并依据性能、稳定性与代价反馈精炼候选；外循环将结果蒸馏为带任务与模型条件的可检验条件性建议，并在后续任务上验证与修订。
AI.result: 四种设置均有效：(A) EEG通用分析 80.88 对比 BrainAgent 63.13（+17.75）；(B) 跨任务模型优化使 EEGPT 平均平衡准确率提升7.34，HBN 的 Pearson r 由0.6894升至0.7362；(C) 单任务开放研究 ADFTD BA 提升16.33；(D) 协同预测 Workload BA 由79.69%升至85.02%；经验复用使 BCIC-IV-2a BA 由34.66%升至50.81%，同时 LLM token 减少64.02%。
AI.conclusion: NeuroAct 使EEG研究可基于证据引导，并通过跨任务经验复用持续提升性能与效率，为自主化EEG分析与解码提供了可迁移的研究范式。

title: Global probabilistic forecasting of air pollution
summary: Fine particulate matter (PM2.5) refers to particulate matter with an aerodynamic diameter of 2.5 micrometre or less. It comes from human activities, such as traffic and industry, and from wildfires, desert dust and gases emitted by vegetation. Short-term exposure to it accounts for about a million deaths a year. Operational forecasts run on grids tens of kilometres wide, which hide the pollution breathed by nearly two hundred million people a day. Machine learning has transformed weather forecasting, but data-driven forecasts of air pollution still blur extremes and lose skill as the air travels. Here we introduce Foehn, a generative model that learns from global kilometre-scale estimates of PM2.5 and computes where the air comes from. Over a year of retrospective forecasts, it outperforms the operational forecast at three stations in four and forecasts at the scale of this hidden exposure. Its ensembles are calibrated, and their mean detects local pollution extremes four days ahead as well as the operational forecast does one day ahead. Such forecasts could warn the millions whom coarse maps miss, once kilometre-scale data are available in real time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Foehn——一个从全球公里级PM2.5估计中学习、并能计算气团来源的生成式模型，其公里级PM2.5预报在75%的站点上优于业务预报，且集合校准良好，可提前四天捕捉局地污染极端事件。
AI.motivation: PM2.5短期暴露每年造成约百万人死亡，但现有业务预报网格为数十公里尺度，掩盖了每日近两亿人实际呼吸的污染暴露；机器学习已革新天气预报，但数据驱动的空气污染预报仍会模糊极端值，且随气团传输而预报技巧下降。
AI.method: 构建生成式模型Foehn，从全球公里级PM2.5估计数据中学习，并显式建模气团来源（计算空气来向），以生成公里尺度的概率（集合）预报。
AI.result: 在为期一年的回溯预报中，Foehn在四分之三的站点上优于业务预报，并能在揭示"隐藏暴露"的尺度上进行预报；其集合预报经过校准，集合均值可提前四天检测局地污染极端事件，效果相当于业务预报提前一天的水平。
AI.conclusion: 在实时公里级数据可用的前提下，此类预报能够为被粗分辨率地图遗漏的数百万人口提供预警。

title: DROD: Dual-Ratio Ordered Dropout for Federated Continual Learning on Heterogeneous Devices
summary: Federated learning for capacity-heterogeneous clients and federated continual learning are each well studied on their own, but their intersection -- clients holding differently sized models while every client's data stream also drifts over time -- remains underexplored. We study this setting directly, training a ResNet-18 fleet from scratch on Split-CIFAR-100 (10 tasks, class-incremental), and introduce DROD (Dual-Ratio Ordered Dropout), which builds on FjORD's Ordered Dropout by using two independent reduction axes to extract sub-models: a shortcut ratio and a branch ratio. On a shared parameter/FLOP budget ladder, DROD achieves the highest mean accuracy among the heterogeneous-model federated learning strategies we compare. Its advantage over the two strongest baseline geometries persists across every replay-buffer size we test and under ER, DER++, and BiC; under EWC, all three geometries collapse alike.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"容量异构客户端"与"联邦持续学习"的交叉场景：各客户端持有不同规模子模型且数据流随时间漂移。作者提出 DROD（Dual-Ratio Ordered Dropout），在 FjORD 的有序 Dropout 基础上用捷径比例与分支比例两条独立缩减轴提取子模型。在 Split-CIFAR-100 上从零训练 ResNet-18 机群，DROD 在共享参数/FLOP 预算阶梯上取得最高平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中的容量异构客户端与联邦持续学习各自已有充分研究，但二者交集——客户端模型规模不同、同时数据流持续漂移——仍缺乏探索。作者直接针对该设定开展研究。
AI.method: 提出 DROD（Dual-Ratio Ordered Dropout）：在 FjORD 的 Ordered Dropout 基础上引入两条独立的缩减轴（shortcut ratio 与 branch ratio）来提取嵌套子模型，从而在参数/FLOP 预算阶梯上为异构客户端生成几何结构可调的子网络。实验在 Split-CIFAR-100（10 个任务、类增量）上从零训练 ResNet-18 机群，并与多种异构模型联邦学习策略在相同预算下比较，同时结合 ER、DER++、BiC、EWC 等持续学习/回放方法及不同回放缓冲区大小进行评测。
AI.result: 在共享的参数/FLOP 预算阶梯上，DROD 在所比较的异构模型联邦学习策略中取得最高平均准确率；相比两个最强基线几何结构，其优势在所有测试的回放缓冲区大小下、以及在 ER、DER++ 和 BiC 下均保持一致；在 EWC 下三种几何结构均同样崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 双缩减轴的有序 Dropout 几何能在容量异构与数据漂移并存的联邦场景中带来稳定的精度增益，且该增益对回放策略与缓冲区规模具有鲁棒性；而基于正则化的 EWC 在此设定下失效，说明回放类机制更为关键。

title: Claim Laundering: When Agent Decision Models Trust Records Over Reality
summary: Agent decision models select actions in a single forward pass from inputs that combine environmental observations with the agent's own record of previous actions. When an action fails silently, these sources can conflict: the record reports success, but the environment shows that the step did not take effect. We ask which source determines the next decision. Across Android screen traces, ALFWorld, and WebShop, we construct paired states that independently vary the observation, the logged action, and an explicit success claim. In all 12 configurations of four decision models and three domains, records have a larger average effect on commitment decisions than observations; after claimed-but-failed steps, the models still stop, advance, or purchase in 53-100% of cases. Yet the relevant evidence is often represented internally: linear probes on intermediate hidden states distinguish successful from failed steps on held-out apps, tasks, and goals (AUROC 0.77-1.00), and activation patching reveals increasing influence from records in later layers. We use this signal in EVIGATE, an intermediate-layer veto that requires no additional forward pass and adds 0.04-2.0% serving latency. Under injected silent failures, EVIGATE improves task success by 18.7 points in live ALFWorld agents, 5.0 in WebShop, and 5.1 in a phone simulator, and in WebShop and the simulator it also outperforms random vetoes at the same rate. Its effectiveness depends on representative calibration states: gates calibrated on offline counterfactual states do not transfer reliably to live agent trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体决策模型在“记录成功但环境显示未生效”的冲突下更依赖哪一信息源，并提出中间层否决机制 EVIGATE 以缓解静默失败带来的错误承诺。
AI.motivation: 智能体决策模型将环境观测与自身动作历史记录拼接后单次前向推理选动作；当动作静默失败时记录报告成功、环境显示未生效，二者冲突。作者要回答：下一决策由哪一信息源主导，以及能否利用内部信号纠正该偏差。
AI.method: 在 Android 屏幕轨迹、ALFWorld、WebShop 上构造独立变化观测、日志动作与显式成功声明的配对状态，测试 4 个决策模型共 12 种配置；用中间隐状态的线性探针区分成功/失败步骤，并用激活修补分析各层影响；据此提出 EVIGATE——无需额外前向、仅增 0.04–2.0% 服务延迟的中间层否决机制。
AI.result: 全部 12 种配置中记录对承诺决策的平均影响大于观测；在声称成功但实际失败的步骤后，模型仍有 53–100% 概率继续停止、前进或购买。线性探针在留出应用、任务与目标上 AUROC 达 0.77–1.00，激活修补显示后层记录影响递增。注入静默失败下 EVIGATE 使任务成功率在实时 ALFWorld 提升 18.7 点、WebShop 5.0 点、手机模拟器 5.1 点，且在 WebShop 与模拟器上优于同比例随机否决。
AI.conclusion: 智能体决策显著受动作记录主导，尽管失败证据已在内部表征中可线性解码；EVIGATE 可低成本地将该内部信号转化为否决干预并提升任务成功率。其有效性依赖有代表性的校准状态：基于离线反事实状态校准的门控无法可靠迁移到真实智能体轨迹。

title: Improving the Expressive Power of Hybrid Sequence Models via Multi-Hop Retrieval
summary: Hybrid architectures offer a promising approach to efficient language modeling by combining a small number of full-attention layers with a larger number of efficient sequence layers, such as sparse attention and recurrent layers. While full-attention layers maintain a KV cache that grows linearly with sequence length, efficient layers typically rely on separate, fixed-size states rather than accessing this richer existing memory. Recent work has begun exploring ways to allow efficient layers access to the KV cache, but the theoretical benefits of such access, and the extent to which existing approaches can realize them remain poorly understood. We investigate these questions by analyzing the expressive power of individual hybrid blocks on function composition, a well-studied task in sequence-model expressivity associated with multi-hop reasoning. We first establish that both conventional hybrid blocks and those with top-$κ$ KV-cache access require $Ω(\sqrt{n})$ capacity to compute even two-function composition over a domain of size $n$. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the \emph{Multi-hop Retrieval Attention} (MuRA) hybrid block, a simple architecture that enables multi-hop retrieval from a shared KV cache while preserving asymptotic computational and memory efficiency. We prove that a single fixed size $m$-hop MuRA block can compute $m$-function composition, whereas computing $(m+1)$-function composition with the same retrieval depth requires polynomial model size, establishing a strict expressivity hierarchy in retrieval depth. Synthetic experiments support this hierarchy, showing that increasing retrieval depth enables learning progressively deeper compositions, substantially outperforming existing hybrid architectures. Together, our results identify multi-hop retrieval as a promising mechanism for improving the expressive power of efficient hybrid architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合架构中层间访问 KV cache 的理论收益，证明常规混合块及 top-κ KV 访问均需 Ω(√n) 容量才能完成二元函数复合；提出 MuRA 混合块，单次固定规模 m-hop 检索即可计算 m-函数复合，并建立检索深度的严格表达能力层级。
AI.motivation: 混合架构由少量全注意力层与大量高效序列层（稀疏注意力、循环层）组成。全注意力层维护随序列长度线性增长的 KV cache，而高效层通常只依赖独立的固定尺寸状态，无法利用这份更丰富的记忆。已有工作开始让高效层访问 KV cache，但这些访问的理论收益以及现有方法能在多大程度上实现收益，仍缺乏清晰理解。
AI.method: 以函数复合（与多跳推理相关的序列模型表达能力基准任务）为分析对象，刻画单个混合块的表达能力：先给出常规混合块与 top-κ KV-cache 访问块的容量下界 Ω(√n)（域大小 n、二元复合）；再提出 Multi-hop Retrieval Attention (MuRA) 混合块，允许从共享 KV cache 中进行多跳检索，同时保持渐近计算与内存效率；并通过理论证明与合成实验验证表达能力层级。
AI.result: 理论上：单次固定规模的 m-hop MuRA 块可计算 m-函数复合；而相同检索深度下计算 (m+1)-函数复合需要多项式规模的模型，由此确立检索深度上的严格表达能力层级。合成实验支持该层级：增大检索深度可学习逐步更深的复合，显著优于此前的混合架构。
AI.conclusion: 多跳检索是提升高效混合架构表达能力的有效机制；现有基于 KV cache 访问的混合块受容量下界限制，而 MuRA 通过保持效率的多跳检索突破了该限制，并形成随检索深度递增的严格表达能力层级。

title: OrderGPT: Generation Order as a Learnable Modeling Choice
summary: Generative modeling of discrete data has two popular paradigms: autoregressive models such as GPT, which factorize a sequence in a left-to-right (L2R) order, and masked diffusion models, which are essentially any-order autoregressive modeling. Rather than competing methods, these are the two extreme points of a single axis -- the generation order. For structured discrete domains without a natural traversal, both extremes may be suboptimal, yet the intermediate choice -- a single well-adapted order -- remains largely unexplored. We introduce OrderGPT, which builds on Any-Order GPT to learn a task-level generation order without canonical-order supervision. Our key observation is that predicting variables from randomly sampled reveal prefixes produces recurring attention patterns in the backbone that provide a model-dependent signal of predictive dependencies. We aggregate this signal into a reciprocal dependency graph and use a spectral teacher to derive continuous generation priorities. A lightweight OrderMLP integrated into the GPT backbone learns to predict these priorities from attention, incorporating order learning into the architecture within a single training run. Training gradually shifts toward the learned order, which is then frozen for subsequent autoregressive training and generation. The same mechanism adapts across modalities: adaptively it recovers near-L2R dependency structure in language, learns anatomically organized factorizations on human pose, and discovers a factorization on tabular data that places statistically and semantically related fields nearby, while improving downstream modeling metrics across all domains. The code is available at https://github.com/Chenhe-yang/OrderGPT/.

AI.tldr: OrderGPT 提出一种无规范顺序监督的任务级生成顺序学习方法：利用随机揭示前缀下注意力模式聚合为互依赖图，经谱教师得到连续生成优先级，并由 OrderMLP 学习预测，从而在自回归与掩码扩散两端之间选取适配的顺序。
AI.motivation: 自回归（L2R）与掩码扩散（任意顺序自回归）只是"生成顺序"这一轴上的两个极端；在缺乏自然遍历顺序的结构化离散域中两者均可能次优，而"单一且自适应的顺序"这一中间选择尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 基于 Any-Order GPT：从随机采样的揭示前缀预测变量时，主干注意力呈现可复现模式，作为依赖关系的模型内生信号；将其聚合为互依赖图，用谱教师导出连续生成优先级；在 GPT 主干中集成轻量 OrderMLP 从注意力预测这些优先级，在单次训练中完成顺序学习；训练逐步向学到的顺序迁移，随后冻结该顺序用于后续自回归训练与生成。
AI.result: 同一机制跨模态适配：语言上恢复接近 L2R 的依赖结构；人体姿态上学习到符合解剖学的因子分解；表格数据上发现的因子分解使统计与语义相关字段相邻，且在所有域上提升下游建模指标。
AI.conclusion: 生成顺序是一个可学习的连续谱，而非二选一的范式；注意力中隐含的依赖信号可无监督地导出有效顺序并融入架构，在保持自回归生成效率的同时获得跨模态一致的收益。

title: BatchParScale: Sparse Batch-Mixing for Sequence Models
summary: Recent test-time scaling methods improve model performance by increasing inference-time compute. One practical form of this is parallel scaling, where a model samples multiple independent reasoning streams and aggregates their answers using methods like voting, reranking, or verification. While effective, this approach leaves the streams uncoordinated, and a discovery made in one rollout cannot influence any other. Multi-Sequence Verifiers jointly score candidate answers after generation, but the reasoning streams remain independent during inference. ParScale takes a step toward model-internal parallel scaling by learning to aggregate multiple forward passes, but its streams still do not exchange information while processing a sequence. We introduce BatchParScale, an attention mechanism that allows parallel streams to exchange information through a small set of communication positions. We evaluate BatchParScale on a new Parallel Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval benchmark and in pretraining, fine-tuning, and cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning. Across these settings, BatchParScale outperforms ParScale on language-model loss and remains competitive on coordination-sensitive MARL tasks. Masked pretraining runs beat an unmasked single-sequence baseline despite local sequence corruption, and LoRA fine-tuning shows the mechanism can be added to a pretrained Transformer. At the same time, fact retrieval performance for pretrained and finetuned BatchParScale models remains unclear.

AI.tldr: 提出 BatchParScale 注意力机制，通过少量\"通信位置\"让并行推理流在推理过程中交换信息，在检索基准、预训练、微调与多智能体强化学习中优于 ParScale，但预训练/微调模型的事实检索能力仍不明确。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法（如并行采样+投票/重排序/验证、Multi-Sequence Verifiers、ParScale）虽提升效果，但各推理流彼此独立、无法共享推理过程中的发现，缺乏模型内部的流间协调。
AI.method: 提出 BatchParScale：一种允许并行流通过一小部分通信位置交换信息的注意力机制；构建新的 Parallel Needle-in-a-Haystack 检索基准，并在预训练、LoRA 微调及协作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）中评测。
AI.result: 在语言模型损失上优于 ParScale；在协调敏感的 MARL 任务上具竞争力；带掩码的预训练在存在局部序列损坏时仍优于未掩码单序列基线；LoRA 微调证明该机制可注入预训练 Transformer；但预训练与微调模型的事实检索性能尚不清晰。
AI.conclusion: 流间通信的并行缩放机制具备可行性与迁移性，可作为现有 Transformer 的增量模块，但其事实检索可靠性有待进一步验证。

title: CXBench: A Benchmark for Process-Compliant LLM Agents in Regulated Customer-Experience Workflows
summary:
Tool-using language agents increasingly perform regulated customer-service workflows, where a correct final state is insufficient: agents must also provide disclosures, obtain consent, and follow required procedures. Existing tool-agent benchmarks largely score final business states, accepting trajectories that reach correct outcomes through non-compliant processes.
  We introduce cxbench, a benchmark that evaluates outcome and process compliance separately across six regulated domains. Each task combines a customer request, a tool-based environment, and explicit process requirements. Rule cards link cited regulatory obligations to observable trace evidence. A hybrid grader combines deterministic checks for ordering and authority with an LLM judge for semantic requirements. We define a false-pass as an outcome-pass run that fails process checks.
  Across seven models and 120 tasks, 55.5% of the 840 retained executions are false-passes, representing 80.1% of outcome-passing runs; only 13.8% pass both checks. Process-inclusive evaluation changes the observed model ordering and exposes differences hidden by outcome-only scoring. cxbench makes these failures inspectable through trace-linked criteria.

AI.tldr: 提出cxbench基准，将受监管客服工作流中的"结果合规"与"过程合规"分开评估，发现仅看最终状态会掩盖大量过程违规。
AI.motivation: 工具型语言智能体越来越多地执行受监管的客服工作流，正确最终状态不足以判定合规：智能体还须履行信息披露、取得同意、遵循规定程序。现有基准多只评分最终业务状态，会接受"结果正确但过程不合规"的轨迹。
AI.method: 构建cxbench，覆盖六个受监管领域，每个任务由客户请求、工具环境与显式流程要求组成；用"规则卡"将引用的监管义务映射到可观测的轨迹证据；采用混合评分器，对顺序与权限做确定性检查，对语义要求用LLM评审，并以"假通过"（结果通过但过程检查失败）为关键指标。
AI.result: 在7个模型、120个任务共840条保留执行中，55.5%为假通过，占结果通过运行的80.1%；仅13.8%同时通过两项检查。纳入过程评估会改变模型排序，揭示仅结果评分所隐藏的差异。
AI.conclusion: 过程合规应与结果合规分开、可追溯地评估；cxbench通过轨迹关联的判据使此类失败可检视，表明现有工具智能体基准对合规性的评估存在系统性高估。

title: Emergent Sparsity: How Many Effective Variables Survive Coarse-Graining in AlphaEarth Embeddings?
comment: Camera-ready version of a paper accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Advances in Representation Learning for Earth Observation (REO), NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 15 figures
summary: AlphaEarth encodes each 10 m land pixel as a 64-component vector intended to support diverse global mapping tasks. Yet many scientific applications work at coarser spatial supports, for which fewer than 64 effective variables may suffice. We ask whether these vectors can be reorganized into ranked global nonlinear coordinates, how many suffice at a chosen reconstruction accuracy, and whether that number decreases with spatial scale. We thus describe effective dimension as a two-control surface over tolerance and spatial scale, rather than one intrinsic number. At each scale, a $β$-VAE scan with a common architecture produces a rank--distortion envelope, giving the smallest retained count achieved within the scanned family at each reconstruction tolerance. At 3% validation tolerance, this number falls from 24 to 7 when the scale is increased from 10 m to 78.9 km, whereas the corresponding PCA rank falls only from 46 to 38. Repeating the analysis on unit-norm targets preserves this trend.

AI.tldr: 提出将AlphaEarth 64维10米地表嵌入压缩为按秩排列的全球非线性坐标，并把"有效维度"定义为重建容差×空间尺度的二维控制曲面；β-VAE扫描下3%容差所需维数从10米的24降至78.9公里的7，而PCA仅从46降到38。
AI.motivation: AlphaEarth为每个10米陆表像元给出64维向量以支撑多种全球制图任务，但许多科学应用在更粗空间支持上工作，不足64个有效变量可能已足够。作者追问这些向量能否被重组为有序的全球非线性坐标、在给定重建精度下需要多少个、以及该数目是否随空间尺度下降，力图摆脱"单一内在维数"的看法。
AI.method: 把有效维度表述为容差与空间尺度的两控制曲面。在每个尺度上，采用相同架构的β-VAE扫描，得到秩—失真包络，即每条重建容差下所扫描族内达到的最小保留维数；并在单位范数目标上重复该分析作为稳健性检验，与PCA秩作对比。
AI.result: 在3%验证容差下，所需维数从10米的24降至78.9公里的7；对应PCA秩仅从46降至38。在单位范数目标上重复分析仍保持该趋势。
AI.conclusion: 有效维度应视为随容差与尺度变化的曲面而非固定内在维数；非线性β-VAE坐标在粗尺度上可实现远强于PCA的降维收益。

title: Productive State-Space Exploration for Multi-turn RL in LLM Agents
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Large Language Model (LLM) agents in multi-turn, long-horizon environments remains challenging due to inefficient action selection and repetitive behavioral patterns. In particular, agents often become trapped in high-confidence yet unproductive behaviors, repeatedly executing invalid actions or entering action loops that hinder task completion. We observe that these frequently violate environment preconditions, revealing a mismatch between the agent's representation of the internal state and the dynamics of the underlying environment. In addition, repetitive high-confidence actions lead to cyclical behaviors that provide little to no progress towards the goal. We argue that addressing these challenges requires more productive task-aligned exploration to improve the agent's understanding of environment dynamics. Motivated by intrinsic curiosity-driven exploration, we propose a conditional state-space exploration framework that balances task completion with intrinsic information-seeking behavior. Specifically, we introduce an intrinsic reward that penalizes actions whose observation duplicates prior state memory. This provides the benefit of reducing redundant behaviors and encouraging state-space coverage without relying on a general information-theoretic measure. Strong experimental results demonstrate that our approach substantially improves policy learning in multi-turn environments, mitigating invalid actions and repetitive loops.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多轮长程环境中LLM智能体动作选择低效、重复行为与无效动作频发的问题，提出一种条件状态空间探索框架，通过惩罚"观测结果与历史状态记忆重复"的内在奖励来抑制冗余行为并提升状态空间覆盖，从而改善策略学习。
AI.motivation: 多轮长程环境下的LLM智能体强化学习仍面临挑战：动作选择低效、行为模式重复。智能体常陷入高置信度但无产出的行为，反复执行违反环境前置条件的无效动作，或进入动作循环，阻碍任务完成。作者观察到这些现象源于智能体内部状态表征与环境动态之间的失配，以及高置信度重复动作导致的循环行为，因此需要更具任务对齐性的探索来加深对环境的理解。
AI.method: 受内在好奇心驱动探索启发，提出条件状态空间探索框架，在任务完成与内在信息寻求行为之间取得平衡。具体做法是引入一种内在奖励，对"观测结果与先前状态记忆重复"的动作施加惩罚，从而减少冗余行为、鼓励状态空间覆盖，且不依赖一般性的信息论度量。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了多轮环境中的策略学习效果，有效缓解了无效动作与重复循环问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过以状态记忆重复度为依据的内在奖励引导探索，可在不引入复杂信息论度量的前提下改善LLM智能体在长程多轮任务中的探索效率与策略质量。

title: EasyResearch: Honest Regression, Forecasting and Signal Classification for Researchers Who Do Not Program
summary: EasyClassifier showed that researchers who do not program can obtain honest classification results when the correct evaluation is the default. Most applied studies, however, predict a number, forecast a series or classify recordings, and each task has its own way of producing scores that do not hold on new data. We present EasyResearch, open-source analysis cores for regression, time-series forecasting and signal classification, and EasyResearch Desktop, a Windows application that runs these three tasks and EasyClassifier's classification without code. All four follow the same rules: everything learned from data is learned on training data only, models keep their published defaults with fixed seeds, the selected model receives a separate final score, forecasts are never evaluated on shuffled data, and every run writes a report with a Methods paragraph and the references for every method used. We measured whether the reported scores are honest by keeping part of each dataset untouched. In regression (9 public datasets, 90 runs), the common practice overstated R^2 by +2.2 points and the best comparison score by +2.5, while EasyResearch's final score was -1.0; screening predictors on all rows before cross-validation, which EasyResearch does not offer, reported R^2 = 0.27 on pure noise against -0.44 on new data. In forecasting (15 series), shuffled cross-validation over windows of past values promised errors 19% smaller than its chosen models achieved in the untouched future, while EasyResearch's final-period score was unbiased to within 1.5%; the models EasyResearch chose had 14% lower future error, and on random walks shuffled cross-validation chose a machine-learning model in 5 of 5 series, each worse in the future than repeating the last value, which EasyResearch chose 4 times. In signal classification (4 UCR datasets) one method won every comparison and neither estimate was biased.

AI.tldr: EasyResearch 提供回归、时间序列预测和信号分类的开源分析内核及免代码 Windows 应用，通过固定"训练专用/默认超参/独立终评/不打乱时序/自动报告"规则，系统性消除数据泄露与评估偏差。实验以留出数据为基准，发现常规做法高估 R² 约 2.2–2.5 点、时序打乱交叉验证误差低估约 19%，而 EasyResearch 的终评分近乎无偏。
AI.motivation: EasyClassifier 已证明"正确评估为默认"时非编程研究者也能得到诚实结果，但应用研究多涉及回归、序列预测与录音分类，各任务各有易导致过拟合式评估的评分方式；本文希望把"诚实评估"原则推广到这三类任务并降低使用门槛。
AI.method: 提出 EasyResearch 分析内核（回归、时序预测、信号分类）与 Windows 桌面应用（含 EasyClassifier 的分类）。统一规则：所有数据驱动学习仅在训练集进行；模型保持发布默认配置并固定随机种子；所选模型在独立留出数据上获得最终评分；预测任务绝不在打乱数据上评估；每次运行自动生成含 Methods 段与全部方法参考文献的报告。通过保留数据验证所报分数是否诚实，并与常见做法（如全样本筛选变量后交叉验证、打乱窗口交叉验证）对比。
AI.result: 回归：9 个公开数据集、90 次运行，常规做法将 R² 高估 +2.2 点、最佳对比分数高估 +2.5 点，EasyResearch 终评 −1.0 点；全行筛选变量后交叉验证在纯噪声上报 R²=0.27，新数据上为 −0.44。预测：15 条序列，打乱交叉验证承诺的误差比所选模型在未触及未来的实际误差小 19%，EasyResearch 末期评分偏差在 1.5% 内；其选出模型未来误差低 14%；随机游走 5/5 序列被打乱交叉验证选中机器学习模型且均劣于"重复上一值"，而 EasyResearch 4 次选择后者。信号分类：4 个 UCR 数据集上一种方法在所有比较中胜出，两种估计均无偏。
AI.conclusion: 将诚实评估设为默认并通过免代码工具落地，可在多类任务中显著降低乐观偏差；传统做法（尤其变量预筛与打乱时序交叉验证）系统性高估性能并可能误导模型选择，独立留出终评是可靠且可行的标准实践。

title: EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models
summary: Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. The dataset also provides unified evaluation splits and task-specific metrics, supporting offline pretraining and fair evaluation of EWAs. Beyond offline supervision, a defining characteristic of an EWA is its interaction with the environment; training solely on offline data is therefore insufficient, especially for generalizing to scenes not covered in the training distribution. Building dedicated real interactive environments, however, is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose a novel training scheme that employs a video world model as a low-cost environment proxy and performs interactive reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training of the EWA within it. Empirically, pretraining on EmbodiedWorld-200K substantially improves the open-world embodied planning ability of the EWA, and further RL post-training inside a world model yields clear gains on out-of-distribution scenes. The dataset, baseline checkpoints, and training and evaluation code are available at https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Embodied World Agents (EWA) 概念，构建 200K+ 规模、多层级标注的 EmbodiedWorld-200K 数据集，并提出以视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理进行交互式强化学习后训练，在分布外场景上取得明显提升。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能工作多局限于单场景特定任务，跨环境迁移能力差，面向开放世界的通用具身智能体（EWA）研究不足；且仅靠离线数据训练难以泛化到训练分布外的场景，而搭建真实交互环境成本过高。
AI.method: 1) 聚焦开放世界具身导航-规划任务，发布 EmbodiedWorld-200K 数据集，覆盖多样场景，每个样本含从底层相机运动轨迹到高层语义指令的多层级标注，并提供统一评测划分与任务专属指标；2) 提出以视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理，在其中对 EWA 进行交互式强化学习后训练。
AI.result: 在 EmbodiedWorld-200K 上预训练可显著提升 EWA 的开放世界具身规划能力；在世界模型中进行 RL 后训练后，在分布外（OOD）场景上获得明显增益。数据集、基线检查点及训练评测代码均已开源。
AI.conclusion: 离线大规模多层级监督预训练结合世界模型内的交互式 RL 后训练，是推进开放世界通用具身智能体研究的有效且低成本路径。

title: EG-GRPO: Evidence-Guided Step-level Credit Assignment for Deep Search Agents
summary: LLM-based search agents demonstrate strong capabilities in long-horizon information seeking and reasoning, typically trained via reinforcement learning. However, existing approaches predominantly rely on trajectory-level outcome rewards, providing limited supervision for complex search and reasoning processes. Although step-level credit assignment offers a promising solution, obtaining reliable and task-grounded supervision for open-ended search remains challenging. In this paper, we propose Evidence-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (EG-GRPO), a framework that derives step-level supervision from the evidence annotations available in synthetic deep search data. EG-GRPO identifies the first supporting citation for each required evidence claim and uses the newly acquired evidence to construct step-level process rewards. By representing the accumulated evidence as an evolving knowledge state, EG-GRPO further performs state-conditioned relative advantage estimation and combines the resulting step-level signal with the standard trajectory-level outcome advantage. Experiments on five challenging deep search benchmarks show that EG-GRPO generally outperforms standard GRPO and existing reward-enhanced and step-level RL baselines across different model scales. These results demonstrate that task-grounded evidence annotations can provide effective process supervision for credit assignment in deep search RL.

AI.tldr: 提出EG-GRPO，利用合成深度搜索数据中的证据标注构造步骤级过程奖励，并与轨迹级结果优势结合，实现LLM搜索智能体的细粒度信用分配。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM搜索智能体多依赖轨迹级结果奖励进行强化学习，对复杂搜索与推理过程缺乏监督；而步骤级信用分配在开放式搜索中难以获得可靠、任务对齐的监督信号。
AI.method: EG-GRPO从合成深度搜索数据的证据标注中提取步骤级监督：定位每个所需证据主张的首个支持性引用，用新获取的证据构建步骤级过程奖励；将累积证据表示为演化知识状态，进行状态条件化的相对优势估计，并与标准轨迹级结果优势相结合。
AI.result: 在五个具有挑战性的深度搜索基准上，EG-GRPO在不同模型规模下总体优于标准GRPO及现有的奖励增强与步骤级RL基线。
AI.conclusion: 任务对齐的证据标注可为深度搜索强化学习中的信用分配提供有效的过程监督。

title: ABACUS: Program-Guided Multistep Reasoning over Frozen Judgment Models
summary: Judgment models answer semantic questions by scoring a finite set of candidate outcomes. Can reusable programs turn these local decisions into powerful multistep reasoning? We introduce \method, a framework that jointly constructs judgment schemas and composition programs for frozen judgment models. A generative teacher designs the procedure offline; the judgment model resolves local semantic questions online, and the saved program composes its decisions into an answer. We study three allocations of design effort between humans and the teacher, focusing on construction through a shared interface. We instantiate the framework with Kev. On three selected BIG-Bench Hard tasks, nine independently constructed programs solve all 450 executions of 150 development inputs. A separate deployment study freezes three programs after development-set reference-agreement refinement and evaluates them on 600 held-out questions. These programs achieve near-perfect 99.67\% macro accuracy, versus 64.00\% for direct Kev and 68.80\% for final-answer-only Qwen3.5-4B. They attain comparable observed accuracy to Qwen's unrestricted response policy (99.07\%) with an \textbf{8.43-fold online speedup}: 0.255 versus 2.150 seconds per question. These results show how reusable programs can substantially expand the reasoning capability of a compact judgment model while keeping its parameters fixed.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 \method 框架，通过为冻结的判别模型离线构建可复用的"判断schema+组合程序"，将其局部语义判别能力转化为多步推理能力；在三个BIG-Bench Hard任务上达到99.67%宏准确率，并相对大模型有8.43倍在线加速。
AI.motivation: 判别模型只能对有限候选打分、做局部语义判断，难以直接完成多步推理。作者希望探索：不改变模型参数的前提下，能否用可复用的程序把局部决策组合成强大的多步推理能力。
AI.method: 提出 \method 框架：生成式教师离线设计判断schema与组合程序，冻结的判断模型在线解析局部语义问题，保存的程序把其决策组合成最终答案。作者研究人（人类）与教师在设计工作量分配上的三种方案，重点为通过共享接口进行构建，并以 Kev 作为实例化模型。
AI.result: 在三个BIG-Bench Hard任务上，9个独立构建的程序解决了150个开发输入的450次执行的全部；将3个程序在开发集参考一致性精炼后冻结，在600道留出问题上达到99.67%宏准确率，显著高于直接Kev的64.00%和仅输出最终答案的Qwen3.5-4B的68.80%；与Qwen无限制回答策略的99.07%观测准确率相当，同时在线速度提升8.43倍（每题0.255秒 vs 2.150秒）。
AI.conclusion: 可复用程序能在保持小模型参数冻结的情况下大幅扩展其推理能力，并兼顾准确率与在线效率。

title: Data-driven forecasting of tropical cloud forest phenology: A dynamical systems and machine learning hybrid approach
summary:
Forecasting how species and ecosystems respond to climate change is a critical challenge in ecology, particularly in hyper-diverse tropical biomes. While traditional phenological models often rely on preconceived functional forms, this study introduces a data-driven hybrid approach that integrates dynamical systems theory with machine learning to forecast flowering and fruiting cycles.
  Using a robust 35-year dataset from a Venezuelan tropical cloud forest, we reconstruct the system's state-space using delay vectors inspired by Takens' theorem, incorporating climate forcing variables such as temperature and precipitation. The model was trained using Gaussian Process Regression, providing both point predictors and explicit uncertainty estimates.
  Our results clearly suggest that the synergy between dynamical systems and machine learning effectively captures the non-linear complexities of ecological time series. Specifically, the model achieved higher predictive accuracy for flowering and fruiting. This hybrid framework offers a scalable tool for anticipating phenological mismatches and informing conservation strategies in the face of global environmental change.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出将动力系统理论与机器学习相结合的混合数据驱动框架，利用35年委内瑞拉热带云雾林数据，以Takens定理构造延迟向量状态空间并引入气候强迫变量，用高斯过程回归预测开花与结果物候，获得更高预测精度并提供不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 气候变化下预测物种与生态系统响应是生态学关键难题，热带高多样性生物群系尤甚；传统物候模型依赖预设函数形式，难以刻画生态时间序列的非线性复杂性。
AI.method: 基于35年委内瑞拉热带云雾林长期数据集；依据Takens定理用延迟嵌入构造状态空间，纳入温度、降水等气候强迫变量；采用高斯过程回归训练模型，同时输出点预测与显式不确定性估计。
AI.result: 结果表明动力系统与机器学习的协同能够有效捕捉生态时间序列的非线性复杂性，模型在开花与结果预测上取得更高的预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 该混合框架可作为可扩展工具，用于预判物候错配并为全球环境变化背景下的保护策略提供依据。

title: GLOBE: Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit via Unit-Sphere Trajectories
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve problem solving, but models often keep generating after the correct answer is already reachable; the extra steps raise serving costs and may replace a correct intermediate result with an incorrect one. We propose GLOBE (Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit), an online, training-free algorithm that terminates the model's CoT process early. GLOBE embeds each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reads the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. GLOBE first applies a trial phase that generates short trial answers in a separate branch, stopping the main stream on an accepted trial after checking confidence against a threshold. If generation continues, a trajectory phase stops the stream once this path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. On five benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0% across two models, and achieves a five-task average of 80.58%, comparable to Full CoT.

AI.tldr: GLOBE 是一种无需训练、在线运行的思维链早停算法，通过语义轨迹几何形态与试探分支置信度提前终止推理，在五个基准上减少约 50% 输出 token，精度与完整 CoT 相当。
AI.motivation: CoT 推理在答案已可达后仍继续生成，导致额外服务成本，并可能用错误步骤覆盖正确的中间结果，需要一种在线、免训练、通用（数学、工具调用、智能体记忆）的早停机制。
AI.method: 将每个完成的推理片段嵌入为单位球面上的点，读取语义轨迹的形状。方法分两阶段：1) 试探阶段，在独立分支中生成简短试探答案，将置信度与阈值比较，通过则停止主流；2) 轨迹阶段，若生成继续，则当路径反复反向且净进展很小时停止流。
AI.result: 在两个模型、五个基准（数学推理、工具调用、智能体记忆）上，输出 token 减少 49.7%，端到端实际耗时减少 51.0%，五任务平均 80.58%，与完整 CoT 相当。
AI.conclusion: GLOBE 表明基于语义轨迹几何形态的在线早停可在不损失精度的前提下显著降低推理开销，且无需训练、具跨任务泛化性。

title: A discrete-continuous-time stochastic framework for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder-related symptom modeling and pharmacological intervention via methylphenidate
summary: This paper presents an original mathematical and computational framework for modeling the efficacy of methylphenidate as an optimal control policy acting on the nonlinear dynamics of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder. Neural processes in ADHD are conceptualized as stochastic processes with trajectories that inherently converge towards stable, yet dysfunctional patterns associated with clinical symptoms. The pharmacological intervention is mathematically formalized as an external control signal that reassesses the system's drift and redirects these trajectories towards neurotypical regimes. To bridge these theoretical stochastic models with empirical clinical data, latent representations are inferred using a novel deterministic hybrid deep learning architecture, combining a one-dimensional convolutional neural network and a Vision Transformer, trained on preprocessed functional magnetic resonance imaging data.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个数学与计算框架，将哌甲酯建模为作用在ADHD非线性动力学上的最优控制策略，并用1D-CNN与Vision Transformer结合的确定性混合深度学习架构推断潜在表征，以连接随机过程模型与临床fMRI数据。
AI.motivation: ADHD神经过程可视为趋向稳定但功能失调模式的随机过程，需要一个能把药物干预形式化为外部控制信号、并将理论随机模型与经验临床数据衔接起来的建模框架。
AI.method: 将ADHD神经过程刻画为具有趋向症状相关吸引子的随机过程；把哌甲酯药效形式化为外部控制信号，用以修正系统漂移项并将轨迹重定向至神经典型区域；在预处理fMRI数据上训练由一维卷积神经网络与Vision Transformer组成的确定性混合深度学习架构，以推断潜表征并桥接理论模型与临床数据。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果；定性上给出了一套把最优控制形式化的药效模型与潜表征推断相结合的建模路线，声称可实现理论随机模型与经验临床数据的连接。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为ADHD药物治疗的机制建模提供了可控动力系统视角与混合深度学习的实证桥梁，属于方法学框架性贡献，其有效性有待实验验证。

title: On the Benefits of Uncertainty Estimation for Species Classification: A Case Study on Optimizing Expert re-Annotation
summary: Automated identification of diatoms from microscopic images is a cornerstone of large-scale freshwater biomonitoring, yet the high diversity of species and strong class imbalance pose significant challenges for reliable classification. In this study, we develop a ResNet-18 baseline for a 759-class diatom dataset and investigate how calibrated confidence estimates support selective classification to reduce expert workload without sacrificing taxonomic integrity. While the initial model exhibits overconfidence with an Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 0.117, post-hoc temperature scaling (T = 2.12) dramatically improves reliability, lowering the ECE to 0.055.By leveraging these calibrated probabilities within a triage framework, we demonstrate that a Selective Macro-F1 score of 99.01% can be maintained at 66.2% coverage (rejection threshold $τ$ = 0.934). Qualitative analysis reveals that the system effectively functions as an intelligent filter, consistently deferring rare taxa-such as AAMB and AASI-and ambiguous morphologies for expert review. Our findings, supported by the torch-uncertainty framework, highlight the potential of simple calibration techniques to make automated diatom identification practical and robust, prioritizing the preservation of rare species metrics essential for ecological assessment. To support reproducibility, our code, environment specifications, and calibration results are available anonymously at https://anonymous.4open. science/r/greenprwksp-B53D/README.

AI.tldr: 本文在759类硅藻图像数据集上构建ResNet-18基线，引入温度缩放校准置信度，并用于选择性分类分诊框架，在66.2%覆盖率下保持99.01%的Selective Macro-F1。
AI.motivation: 硅藻显微图像自动识别是大规模淡水生物监测的基础，但物种多样性高、类别极度不平衡，导致可靠分类困难；同时专家人工复核成本高，需要在保证分类完整性的前提下降低专家工作量。
AI.method: 构建759类硅藻数据集的ResNet-18基线模型；采用事后温度缩放（T=2.12）进行置信度校准以降低期望校准误差；将校准后的概率用于选择性分类/分诊框架，设定拒绝阈值τ=0.934，并结合torch-uncertainty框架实现。
AI.result: 初始模型存在过度自信，ECE为0.117；温度缩放后ECE降至0.055。在覆盖率66.2%（τ=0.934）下仍保持99.01%的Selective Macro-F1；定性分析显示系统能持续将稀有类群（如AAMB、AASI）及形态模糊样本转交专家复核。
AI.conclusion: 简单的校准技术即可使自动硅藻识别更实用、稳健，系统可作为智能过滤器优先保障稀有物种指标，对生态评估具有重要意义；代码与环境配置已匿名开源以支持可复现性。

title: World Model Interpretability: From Decoding Representations to Understanding Latent Worlds
summary: Emerging Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are moving beyond representation learning towards latent world models that support prediction, planning, and control. Yet their latent worlds naturally lack a human-interpretable interface. In this Perspective, we argue that as JEPA latents become internal states for prediction and action, interpretability must move beyond what they encode to how latent variables interact, evolve, and causally drive prediction. To this end, we envision a four-stage research agenda, involving Ground, Structure, Verify, and Act, to guide this shift toward actionable latent-world understanding. Within our framework, existing JEPA interpretability efforts provide early evidence for Ground, while systematic analysis of latent structure, causal verification, and intervention remains largely unexplored. Overall, this Perspective aims to call for a broader latent-world interpretability agenda that shifts attention from decoding representations toward understanding, validating, and acting on latent worlds.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇Perspective（观点）论文，提出JEPA潜在世界的可解释性研究议程，包含Ground、Structure、Verify、Act四个阶段，主张可解释性应从"编码了什么"转向"潜在变量如何交互、演化并因果驱动预测"。
AI.motivation: JEPA正从表征学习走向支持预测、规划与控制的潜在世界模型，但其潜在空间天然缺乏人类可解释接口；当潜在变量成为预测与行动的内部状态时，仅解读其编码内容的可解释性已不足。
AI.method: 提出四阶段研究框架：Ground（潜在变量与可观测语义/物理概念的对应）、Structure（潜在结构如关系与模块化组织的系统分析）、Verify（因果验证，检验潜在变量对预测的因果作用）、Act（基于潜在世界的干预与行动）。并将现有JEPA可解释性工作映射到该框架中进行定位。
AI.result: 现有JEPA可解释性努力仅为Ground阶段提供了初步证据；对潜在结构的系统分析、因果验证与干预（Structure、Verify、Act）基本尚属空白。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁建立更广义的"潜在世界可解释性"议程，将研究重心从解码表征转向理解、验证并作用于潜在世界，以实现可执行的潜在世界理解。

title: GraphEvoResearcher: Graph-Aware Training-Free Self-Reflective Reasoning for Cost-Bounded Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to chain intermediate conclusions while remaining cost-aware. Existing training-free self-reflective protocols (generate -> critique -> revise) improve accuracy but operate on a flat token stream: revisions cannot identify which prior step is unreliable, and early stopping cannot exploit structural convergence. We introduce GraphEvoResearcher, a training-free protocol that lifts EvoResearcher's self-reflective meta-reward onto an explicit reasoning graph - nodes are intermediate conclusions/evidence and edges encode support, contradict, and depends_on. A graph-aware meta-reward combines correctness, efficiency, reflection, diversity, and four structural signals (connectivity, acyclicity, branch coverage, path convergence) to decide whether to revise, backtrack, or stop. A graph-convergence early-stop terminates when evidence branches converge on a single conclusion. On a real LLM (DeepSeek), over GSM8K, MATH, and BBH (n=50 each), GraphEvoResearcher reaches 98%, 92%, and 82% respectively, the highest of all baselines, with the largest gains on the hardest set (MATH: +24 pp over single-shot, +12 pp over flat reflection), while keeping construction cost bounded at ~2 steps / 4.5-5 nodes. Our results indicate the structural signal of a reasoning graph is most valuable exactly where single-step reasoning is unreliable.

AI.tldr: 提出无训练协议 GraphEvoResearcher，将自反思元奖励提升到显式推理图上，用图结构信号指导修订/回溯/停止，在 GSM8K/MATH/BBH 上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有多跳 QA 的无训练自反思协议（generate→critique→revise）在扁平 token 流上运作，无法定位哪一步不可靠，早停也无法利用结构收敛信息，因此需要引入显式推理图。
AI.method: 构建推理图：节点为中间结论/证据，边编码 support、contradict、depends_on；设计图感知元奖励，融合正确性、效率、反思、多样性及四个结构信号（连通性、无环性、分支覆盖、路径收敛），据此决定修订、回溯或停止；并采用图收敛早停，当证据分支收敛到单一结论时终止。
AI.result: 在 DeepSeek 上，GSM8K/MATH/BBH（各 n=50）准确率分别为 98%、92%、82%，均高于所有基线；最难集 MATH 增益最大（较单次 +24 个百分点，较扁平反思 +12 个百分点），构建成本有界，约 2 步 / 4.5–5 节点。
AI.conclusion: 推理图的结构信号在单步推理最不可靠之处价值最大。

title: Learning When to Abort in Transformer Planning: A Mechanistic Study
summary: Planning does not by itself imply the ability to recognise errors, but recognising errors can improve planning capacity. In this paper, we study this phenomenon in Transformer planning. To analyze the inner mechanism, we follow the approach of Wang et al. (2024) and abstract planning as path-finding in graphs. In this setting, we train the model to detect the error of invalid transitions, i.e., after the model generates a next node that is not adjacent with the current node, the model should then generate a special abort token x. For expressiveness, we construct a Transformer with feed-forward width $O(|V|)$ for any fixed graph with node set $V$. It can detect all possible invalid transitions, and select a valid next node if the prefix is valid. We then propose a worst-case lower bound on feed-forward width, which makes the detector's linear width near-optimal up to logarithmic factors. In trained models, we demonstrate that invalid-transition detection increases previous-node attention, and most of the valid--invalid separation locates in the feed-forward network's output. This accords with our theoretical insights. Finally, we use this error detection to improve the model's performance: at inference, generating the abort token x will directly cause an external procedure to discard the attempt and restart from the original prompt. Experiments show that error detection combined with retry improves model's planning reliability on graphs, Countdown, and mazes.

AI.tldr: 本文将Transformer规划抽象为图上的路径搜索，训练模型检测非法转移（生成abort token x），从理论上证明前馈宽度O(|V|)的近最优性，从实证上揭示检测机制主要位于FFN输出并提升前节点注意力，并用"abort+重试"策略提升图、Countdown和迷宫任务的规划可靠性。
AI.motivation: 规划能力本身不蕴含错误识别能力，但错误识别可反哺规划；作者希望弄清Transformer在规划中实现错误检测的内在机制，并将其转化为可用的推理期纠错手段。
AI.method: 沿用Wang et al. (2024)把规划抽象为图上的路径搜索。训练模型在生成与当前节点不相邻的下一节点后输出特殊abort token x，以学习检测非法转移。构造前馈宽度为O(|V|)的Transformer，证明其可检测所有非法转移且在合法前缀下选出合法下一节点；并给出前馈宽度下界，说明该线性宽度在对数因子内近乎最优。随后在训练好的模型上做注意力与表征分析；推理时检测到abort即触发外部程序丢弃当前尝试并从原始提示重启。
AI.result: 理论上，O(|V|)前馈宽度即可覆盖全部非法转移检测，下界表明线性宽度仅差对数因子即最优。实证上，非法转移检测增强了模型对前一节点的注意力，合法/非法的区分主要集中在FFN输出，与理论预期一致。结合重试机制后，模型在图上规划、Countdown与迷宫任务上的可靠性均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 错误检测是可从规划训练中习得、且机制上可定位（FFN输出+前节点注意力）的能力；用abort token加外部重试可将其转化为实际性能增益，为Transformer规划的可解释性与可靠性改进提供了理论与实践双重支持。

title: ClueFlow: Learning Long-Horizon Search through Attributed Research-State Transitions
summary: Long-horizon search requires agents to acquire relevant evidence and integrate it into an evolving research state. Existing methods maintain research states to guide exploration or assign turn-level progress signals, yet grounding these signals in explicit, attributable state changes remains underexplored. We introduce ClueFlow, which learns long-horizon search from attributed research-state transitions. ClueFlow constructs Source-State-Final attribution chains that connect evidence-acquiring browser actions, Evidence and Candidate updates, and the final answer supported by those updates. During search, ClueFlow records typed state changes and potentially supporting browser actions, then applies gold-conditioned semantic validation and source tracing after execution. We use this attribution to guide both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. During SFT, attribution selects which decisions receive supervision with their original interaction contexts. During Turn-PPO, the same attribution augments outcome-based turn advantages with credit assigned along the Source-State-Final chains. Transition-level validation also recovers useful supervision from gold-consistent state changes in trajectories with incorrect final answers. We evaluate ClueFlow across two Qwen backbones and four search benchmarks spanning live-web and fixed-corpus settings, observing consistent gains from SFT and further improvements from PPO. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ClueFlow achieves 60.0% accuracy on BrowseComp and 72.0% on BrowseComp-Plus. In controlled BrowseComp-Plus experiments, attribution-guided SFT matches all-turn exact-context SFT using about 30% of the training tokens, while attribution-guided PPO outperforms outcome-only PPO by 4.1 pp. These results demonstrate that state-transition attribution enables efficient supervision and effective credit assignment for long-horizon search agents.

AI.tldr: ClueFlow 通过构建"来源-状态-最终答案"归因链，对长程搜索智能体的研究状态转移进行显式归因，并据此指导 SFT 监督选择与 Turn-PPO 信用分配，在多个搜索基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有长程搜索方法虽维护研究状态以引导探索或给出回合级进度信号，但如何将这些信号建立在显式、可归因的状态变化之上仍研究不足，导致监督低效、信用分配粗粒度。
AI.method: 提出 ClueFlow：构建 Source-State-Final 归因链，连接取证浏览器动作、Evidence/Candidate 更新与被其支撑的最终答案；搜索中记录类型化状态变化及潜在支撑动作，执行后做 gold 条件语义验证与来源溯源。SFT 阶段用归因筛选需监督的决策（保留原始交互上下文）；Turn-PPO 阶段沿归因链将信用注入基于结果的回合优势。另用转移级验证从最终答案错误但状态变化与 gold 一致的轨迹中回收监督。
AI.result: 在两个 Qwen 主干与四个搜索基准（实时网页与固定语料）上，SFT 稳定增益，PPO 进一步提升。Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 下 BrowseComp 达 60.0%，BrowseComp-Plus 达 72.0%。BrowseComp-Plus 受控实验中，归因引导 SFT 以约 30% 训练 token 达到全回合精确上下文 SFT 的水平；归因引导 PPO 较仅结果 PPO 提升 4.1 pp。
AI.conclusion: 状态转移归因可为长程搜索智能体提供高效监督与有效信用分配，是一种可推广的训练范式。

title: Where Groups Split: A Probe Prior for Nonzero Within-Group Variance in RL Post-Training
summary: Group relative policy optimization learns from a prompt only when the rewards in the sampled group disagree. With a binary verifier, a group that is entirely correct or entirely incorrect has within-group variance zero and a zero advantage. Uniform sampling continues to spend rollouts on prompts that are unanimous now and stay unanimous as training goes on. Pass rate is a weak forecast of that future. Two prompts at the same pass rate can move apart: one into the range where a finite group splits, and one toward a ceiling where the group becomes unanimous again. Aperture estimates the later pass rate from a short probe. A small subset of the pool is trained with the same recipe, every prompt is scored on the base model and on the probe model, and the two pass rates are plugged into the probability that a group of the training size is all wrong or split. The resulting weight is a static prior. It can be used alone or multiplied by an online scheduler, and the GRPO update is left as it is. On mathematical and logical reasoning with 1.7B and 4B models, the prior improves greedy accuracy over uniform GRPO and raises the fraction of groups with a nonzero advantage. The same prior still helps when it is combined with dynamic sampling or with selective rollouts.

AI.tldr: Aperture：用短探针模型估计提示的"未来"通过率，据此构造静态先验权重进行提示采样，提高GRPO中有非零优势的组比例。
AI.motivation: GRPO仅在组内奖励有分歧时才有学习信号；全对或全错的组方差为零、优势为零。均匀采样会持续在"当前一致且未来仍一致"的提示上浪费 rollout，而通过率本身是未来可分裂性的弱预测指标——相同通过率的两条提示可能分别走向"可分裂"和"再趋一致"。
AI.method: 先用少量提示子集以相同配方训练出探针模型；对每个提示分别在基座模型和探针模型上打分得到两个通过率，代入"训练规模组全错或发生分裂"的概率公式，得到静态先验权重；该权重可单独使用，也可与在线调度器相乘，GRPO更新本身不变。
AI.result: 在1.7B与4B模型的数学与逻辑推理任务上，该先验相比均匀GRPO提升了贪心准确率，并提高了具有非零优势的组占比；与动态采样或选择性rollout结合时仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 以"未来组可分裂性"而非当前通过率来分配rollout是一种有效且即插即用的提示采样策略，可与现有调度方法叠加。

title: Map-Distribution Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Agent Pathfinding
summary: Designing capable neural policies for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF), which map local observations to action distributions, represents an important challenge in multi-agent learning, with practical relevance to scalable collective automation problems such as warehouse logistics. In contrast to prior studies focusing primarily on individual policy design, this study explores a meta-level Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approach to learning-based MAPF. Specifically, given a collection of compact yet high-performing experts specialised for different map distributions, our architecture learns a router that selectively fuses their outputs according to each agent's local situation. We instantiate and validate this MoE approach with a commonly used graph neural network-based policy as well as a newly developed recursive action-token refinement model. Combined with supervised and reinforcement learning fine-tuning of the experts, our experiments show that MoE generally improves upon the pretrained policy and outperforms existing leading methods. At the same time, our findings reveal that appropriately trained, parameter-matched monolithic models still outperform MoE, highlighting a nuanced role for map-distribution MoE for MAPF.

AI.tldr: 该论文将MoE（混合专家）引入多智能体路径规划（MAPF），用一个路由器按各智能体的局部情境选择性融合多个针对不同地图分布训练的小型专家策略，并用GNN策略与新提出的递归动作token精炼模型两种骨干验证。
AI.motivation: 已有MAPF学习研究主要聚焦单个策略（个体策略）的设计，而忽视了在“元层面”对多个专门化策略进行组合与调度的可能性；同时实际场景（如仓储物流）中地图分布多样，单一策略难以全面覆盖，因此探索以地图分布为导向的专家混合机制是否有价值。
AI.method: 构建元级MoE架构：先训练一批紧凑但高性能、分别专精于不同地图分布的专家策略；再学习一个路由器，依据每个智能体的局部观测/情境自适应地选择并融合各专家输出。以常用的图神经网络（GNN）策略和一个新提出的递归动作token精炼（recursive action-token refinement）模型作为实例化骨干，并结合专家层面的监督学习与强化学习微调。
AI.result: 实验表明MoE总体上优于预训练的单体策略，并超过现有领先方法；但在训练得当且参数量对齐的条件下，单体（monolithic）模型仍优于MoE，说明地图分布型MoE在MAPF中的作用是有限度、情境依赖的。
AI.conclusion: MoE为学习型MAPF提供了一种有效的元级策略组合范式，但并非普适增益：其优势依赖于专家质量与路由学习，且在同参数预算下不及精心训练的单体模型，提示未来需在专家多样性、路由设计与参数效率上进一步权衡。

title: Follow the Mixed Groups: Ridge-Tracking Gaussian Sampling for Zero-Variance Web Rollouts
summary: Group relative policy optimization learns from a question only when the sampled responses disagree. A group that is entirely correct or entirely incorrect has zero reward variance and a zero advantage. On the Web, that group has already spent its searches and page fetches. Gaussian curricula aim the next batch at pass rates where a finite group can still mix. A Gaussian on the latest empirical rate treats every all-fail history as the same point, and a center stepped by the average signed change of those rates is pushed by prompts already stuck at 0 or 1. RIDGE keeps the Gaussian curriculum and changes the coordinate, the center, and the width. Each prompt carries a Beta posterior. The sampling weight is the marginal of a Gaussian target under a Gaussian approximation of that posterior, divided by a prediction of tool-call cost. The center and the width are an exponential smooth of the posterior means of groups that just came back mixed. All-correct and all-incorrect groups refresh the posterior and do not move the center. The GRPO update itself is unchanged. On two math backbones and a retrieval-augmented question answerer, RIDGE raises average accuracy by 3.4 and 2.9 points over GRPO and average exact match by 3.7 points, at 29.6\% fewer math rollouts and 32.7\% fewer tool calls than dynamic sampling.

AI.tldr: RIDGE 保留高斯课程（Gaussian curriculum）框架，但把坐标从"最新经验通过率"改为每个 prompt 的 Beta 后验，并用后验引导的中心、宽度与工具成本惩罚来分配采样权重，在 GRPO 更新不变的前提下提升数学与检索问答任务的准确率并显著减少 rollout 与工具调用。
AI.motivation: GRPO 只在组内样本答案不一致时才有梯度：全对或全错的组奖励方差为零、优势为零，而这类组在 Web 场景下已消耗了搜索与页面抓取成本。现有高斯课程用"最新经验通过率"作为采样目标，但把所有全失败历史视为同一取值，且中心按通过率的有符号平均变化更新，会被长期停滞在 0 或 1 的 prompt 拖偏，导致课程目标失效。
AI.method: RIDGE 保留高斯课程但改动三处：(1) 坐标——每个 prompt 维护一个 Beta 后验，把全对/全错历史视为有信息量的后验更新而非同一标量；(2) 权重——采样权重为高斯目标在 Beta 后验的高斯近似下的边际概率，再除以工具调用成本的预测值，以惩罚高开销 prompt；(3) 中心与宽度——仅用刚返回"混合组"（既有对又有错）的组后验均值做指数平滑，全对与全错组只刷新后验、不移动中心。GRPO 更新本身保持不变。
AI.result: 在两个数学骨干模型与一个检索增强问答器上，RIDGE 相比 GRPO 平均准确率提升 3.4 与 2.9 个百分点，平均精确匹配（exact match）提升 3.7 个百分点；相比动态采样（dynamic sampling），数学 rollout 减少 29.6%，工具调用减少 32.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将课程目标建立在后验估计上并显式建模工具成本，RIDGE 在无需修改 GRPO 优化器的前提下，同时改善了训练效率（更少 rollout 与工具调用）与最终效果，说明"如何选择被采样的 prompt"是 Web 智能体强化学习中与算法本身同等关键的设计维度。

title: Procedural Memory for Language Agents: A Neurosymbolic Perspective on Explicit Goal Structure
summary: Large language models remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks requiring procedural reasoning. We argue that a key cause is the absence of explicit procedural memory: accessible, modifiable knowledge of how tasks are accomplished, distinct from semantic and episodic memory. Goal-Oriented Graphs offer such a representation, encoding goals and prerequisite dependencies as inspectable symbolic structure. We examine their construction, the challenges they pose, and principles for integrating them with neural reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文主张 LLM 在长时程任务上不可靠的关键原因是缺乏显式的"程序性记忆"，并提出以 Goal-Oriented Graphs（目标导向图）作为可检查的符号化表示来承载程序性知识，讨论了其构建方法、挑战及与神经推理融合的原则。
AI.motivation: LLM 在需要程序性推理的长时程任务中表现不可靠；作者认为根源在于缺少显式的程序性记忆——即可访问、可修改的"任务如何完成"的知识，并将其与语义记忆、情景记忆区分开。
AI.method: 提出用 Goal-Oriented Graphs 表示程序性知识：以目标与前置依赖（prerequisite dependencies）构成可检查的符号结构；论文考察该类图的构建方式、所面临的挑战，以及与神经推理整合的原则。
AI.result: 摘要为立场/展望性工作，未给出具体实验数据或量化结果，主要贡献是概念论证与设计原则。
AI.conclusion: 显式程序性记忆是提升 LLM 长时程程序性推理可靠性的关键；符号化的目标导向图可作为其可行载体，需在构建与神经-符号融合层面进一步研究。

title: A Distribution-Free Separation Between Learned and Fixed Features
summary:
The success of neural networks is largely attributed to their ability to learn useful representations from training data. However, known results that prove a computational advantage of learned features over fixed ones are restricted to specific input distributions. We settle the COLT open question of Feldman, Kamath, and Srebro (2026) by showing that this advantage can persist in the distribution-free setting.
  We construct a family of hypothesis classes that can be efficiently learned by a natural gradient-based algorithm on a two-layer ReLU network, but cannot be represented by linear predictors over any fixed feature map with polynomial dimension (and runtime). Specifically, for any sufficiently small error and any sufficiently large runtime budget R (depending on the error), there exists a hypothesis class that the neural network learns under any input distribution to the desired expected classification error in time at most R, while the dimension complexity (governing the dimension needed by linear predictors) is superpolynomial in R.

AI.tldr: 该论文解决 Feldman、Kamath 和 Srebro（2026）提出的 COLT 开放问题，证明学习到的特征相对固定特征的计算优势在无分布（distribution-free）设定下依然存在。
AI.motivation: 神经网络的成功多归因于其学习有用表示的能力，但已有证明"学习特征优于固定特征"的计算优势结论都局限于特定输入分布，缺乏无分布设定下的证据。
AI.method: 构造一簇假设类：该类可被两层 ReLU 网络上的自然梯度算法高效学习，却无法由任何多项式维度的固定特征映射上的线性预测器表示（含运行时约束）。
AI.result: 对任意足够小的误差和足够大的运行时预算 R，存在一个假设类，神经网络在任意输入分布下以不超过 R 的时间达到目标期望分类误差，而线性预测器所需的维度复杂度（dimensionality complexity）关于 R 为超多项式。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的特征对固定特征的计算优势可在无分布设定下成立，正面回答了该 COLT 开放问题。

title: TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for time series reasoning, while models that reason over time series are usually with long chains of thought. However, this process often consumes thousands of tokens, directly leading to substantial latency during inference. In contrast, System 1 models such as Jev make decisions instantly and can naturally be an alternative, but raw time series are not compatible with the embedding space of these models, thus hindering the reasoning performance, especially when input series contain thousands of numeric points. In this paper, we make a very early attempt to propose a time series System 1 model, namely TimesJev. Specifically, we first formalize System 1 sufficiency in time series reasoning, which motivates a compressed representation for time series with key frequency patterns preserved. To construct this representation, we derive a dimension reduction objective that combines (i) a sufficiency divergence that measures the core information lost during compression, and (ii) a realizability divergence that quantifies the incompatibility of the System 1 model to the optimal prediction given this representation. We optimize this objective by learning time series compression with a gating mechanism for sufficiency, and then aligning the selected representation with the embedding space for realizability. Finally, experiments on 13 datasets demonstrate that TimesJev outperforms reasoning models by over 62% with 62.9% less inference time than their fine-tuned versions on average.

AI.tldr: 提出时间序列System 1模型TimesJev，通过保留关键频率模式的压缩表示与嵌入空间对齐，实现高效的时间序列推理，在13个数据集上平均超越推理模型62%以上且推理时间减少62.9%。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的时间序列推理模型通常依赖长思维链，消耗数千token，导致推理延迟高；而Jev等System 1模型可即时决策，但原始时间序列与其嵌入空间不兼容（尤其含数千个数值点时），阻碍推理性能。
AI.method: 形式化时间序列推理中的System 1充分性，指导构造保留关键频率模式的压缩表示；推导降维目标，结合衡量压缩核心信息损失的充分性散度与量化System 1模型与最优预测不兼容性的可实现性散度；用带门控机制的压缩学习保障充分性，并将所选表示与嵌入空间对齐以保障可实现性。
AI.result: 在13个数据集上的实验表明，TimesJev相较推理模型平均性能提升超过62%，且相比其微调版本平均推理时间减少62.9%。
AI.conclusion: TimesJev作为早期的时间序列System 1模型尝试，验证了以充分压缩表示结合嵌入对齐的路径，可在显著降低推理延迟的同时获得优于长思维链推理模型的性能。

title: Predicted Class Correction: Conformal Thresholds for Classes with No Calibration Data
summary: Class-conditional conformal prediction calibrates a separate score threshold for every class and therefore requires labelled calibration examples of every class. In long-tailed deployments these are exactly what is missing: rare classes are left with few or no held-out examples, and existing methods are either undefined for them or fall back to the shared marginal threshold. We ask whether the per-class correction can instead be predicted from descriptors of the class that require no labels at all. We propose Predicted Class Correction (PCC), which regresses the offset between the per-class and the marginal conformal quantile on geometric descriptors of the classifier head, shrinks the prediction by a scalar selected on the labelled classes, and refits a single marginal offset. The descriptors depend only on the model's weights, so a class with zero calibration examples still receives its own threshold, and since only one scalar is calibrated, split conformal's marginal guarantee is retained. On ImageNet, PCC improves worst-class coverage on such classes by 0.058 [0.006, 0.110] at matched average set size, 42% of an oracle that sees the test labels. Of eight baselines on the same splits, six change the statistic by exactly zero and the best reaches 0.016 with an interval containing zero, so PCC is the only one distinguishable from no improvement; the gain persists with only 100 labelled classes out of 1000. A second finding concerns evaluation: worst-class coverage becomes unmeasurable before it becomes unachievable. Below roughly 35 test examples per class no improvement can be shown even for an oracle, so a null result there reflects the evaluation set, not the method. Restricting evaluation above this depth recovers a significant improvement on Pl@ntNet-300K, where the effect had appeared absent.

AI.tldr: 提出预测类别校正（PCC），仅用分类器头权重的几何描述子回归“类条件—边际”分位差，使零标注校准样本的稀有类也能获得独立阈值，同时保留split conformal边际保证。
AI.motivation: 类条件保形预测需为每类单独校准阈值，但长尾部署中稀有类缺少甚至没有带标签校准样本，现有方法对其无定义或退化为共享边际阈值。
AI.method: PCC以分类器头权重的几何描述子（仅依赖模型参数、不含标签）回归类条件分位与边际分位之间的偏移；用标注类上选定的标量对预测做收缩，并重拟合单一边际偏移；因仅校准一个标量，保留split conformal的边际覆盖保证。
AI.result: ImageNet上，在平均集合大小匹配条件下，此类零样本类的最差类覆盖率提升0.058 [0.006, 0.110]，达可见测试标签oracle的42%；同划分下8个基线中6个统计量变化恰为0，最佳者仅0.016且置信区间含0；仅用1000类中100个标注类时增益仍存。评估层面：每类测试样本低于约35时，即使oracle也无法显示改进，零结果反映评估集而非方法；据此限制评估深度后，Pl@ntNet-300K上原呈缺失的效应恢复显著。
AI.conclusion: 无标签类别描述子可在无校准数据条件下预测类条件校正并保留边际保证，为长尾保形预测提供可行路径；同时最差类覆盖率存在可测性下限，评估需保证每类足够的测试样本量。

title: Understanding When Reflective Prompt and Skill Optimization Helps on Locally Served Reasoning Models: A Two-Model Study of GEPA and SkillOpt
summary: Reflective text-space optimizers such as GEPA and SkillOpt have reported large gains on frontier and mid-size models. We test replication across two reasoning-native target-serving configurations: DeepSeek V4 Flash through DwarfStar and Qwen3.8-27B through LM Studio. For each target, we evaluate the same held-out tasks and four conditions - minimal baseline, GEPA prompt, SkillOpt skill, and manually engineered prompt - on HotpotQA (n=500 per condition) and MATH-500 (n=250). In the primary Qwen v2 rerun under the same frozen protocol, GEPA selects the HotpotQA seed and exactly reproduces baseline behavior, whereas SkillOpt's validation gain reverses into held-out degradation. On MATH-500, GEPA raises exact match from 0.828 to 0.904 while reducing latency but increasing token consumption, so lower response time does not imply lower token cost. DeepSeek likewise shows its strongest GEPA effect on MATH-500 (0.852 to 0.908). Across both targets, GEPA's strongest gains occur on MATH-500, while neither optimizer improves the HotpotQA baseline. Optimization is therefore task- and method-dependent, and validation gains may reverse on held-out evaluation. An earlier Qwen run is retained as serving-sensitivity evidence. These results suggest that textual headroom for a model-task pair and the observed effect of a text-space optimizer are more informative when decomposed into content/reasoning, answer-realization/evaluator alignment, and serving-completion/reliability. The cross-benchmark pattern further suggests that optimization may benefit from low-ambiguity, actionable evaluation signals.

AI.tldr: 本文对GEPA与SkillOpt两种反思式文本空间优化器进行复现测试，发现其增益依赖于任务与方法：GEPA在MATH-500上稳定提升（Qwen 0.828→0.904，DeepSeek 0.852→0.908），但在HotpotQA上两个优化器均未能超过基线；SkillOpt的验证集增益在留出评估中反转为性能下降。作者主张将优化效果分解为内容/推理、答案实现/评测对齐、服务完成/可靠性三个维度，并提出低歧义、可执行的评测信号更利于优化获益。
AI.motivation: GEPA、SkillOpt等反思式文本空间优化器在前沿及中等规模模型上报告了大幅增益，但这些结论是否可跨模型服务配置复现、增益是否在留出集上稳健尚不清楚。作者因此设计冻结协议的复现实验，检验优化效果的可靠性与任务依赖性，并试图解释增益从何而来。
AI.method: 在两种推理原生目标服务配置（DeepSeek V4 Flash经DwarfStar、Qwen3.8-27B经LM Studio）上，对同一组留出任务比较四种条件：最小基线、GEPA提示、SkillOpt技能、人工工程提示。评测集为HotpotQA（每条件n=500）与MATH-500（n=250）。主实验为相同冻结协议下的Qwen v2重跑，并保留一次早期Qwen运行作为服务敏感性证据。分析上将优化效果拆解为内容/推理、答案实现/评测对齐、服务完成/可靠性三个成分。
AI.result: Qwen v2重跑中，GEPA选中HotpotQA种子并完全复现基线行为，SkillOpt的验证增益在留出集上反转为退化。MATH-500上GEPA将精确匹配从0.828提升至0.904，延迟下降但token消耗上升，说明响应时间降低不等于token成本降低。DeepSeek上GEPA最强效应同样出现在MATH-500（0.852→0.908）。跨两个目标，GEPA的最大增益均集中于MATH-500，而两个优化器都未提升HotpotQA基线。
AI.conclusion: 文本空间优化器的效果是任务与方法双重依赖的，验证集增益可能在留出评估中反转。对模型-任务对的"文本余地"与优化器观测效应，应分解为内容/推理、答案实现/评测对齐、服务完成/可靠性三个成分来解读。跨基准的模式进一步表明，低歧义、可执行的评测信号更有利于优化发挥作用。

title: CHSM8: A Chess Transformer that Follows Natural-Language Style Prompts
summary: We present CHSM8, a 210M-parameter chess transformer that plays moves conditioned on a free-text description of a playing style, e.g. "go for the Sicilian Defense", "solid, safe, risk-free chess" or "You are Magnus Carlsen in his prime". The model is pretrained without search on 1.07B filtered Lichess games, using a factorized move representation and legal-move masking. It reaches 1837 Elo against a strength-limited Stockfish and, in 1,000-game matches, beat every other public model we tested that was likewise trained without preference tuning, rewards or search, including one with 13 times as many parameters. We then fine-tune it to follow text on a synthetic dataset: Gemma-4-31B describes the playing style of 3M game sides, a 1B Gemma-3 model distilled from the 2.4M of those descriptions that contradict nothing on the board labels the rest, and every one of 30M selected game sides gets five descriptions. Supervised fine-tuning attaches a frozen text encoder through gated cross-attention, and direct preference optimization (DPO) uses the same moves under a mismatched description as the rejected sample. After DPO, style adherence rises on every prompt we test (for example, queens traded early 53% -> 67%, pawn moves 29% -> 32% of all moves, queenside castling 97.3% -> 99.7%), and strength without a prompt stays within noise of SFT (1792 vs. 1797 Elo). Design choices at every stage were made by fixed-budget automated search loops on top of standard architectures and training recipes. We document the full pipeline and the decisions behind it, report the ablations that failed, and evaluate the models across many style prompts and kinds of games, with 1,000 games per setting. The work is fully open source and reproducible: weights, datasets with all training labels, prompts, configurations, inference code and playable demos are public and free to build on.

AI.tldr: CHSM8：一个210M参数的国际象棋Transformer，能用自由文本描述棋风（如“走西西里防御”“稳健安全”“你是巅峰期的Magnus Carlsen”）作为条件走子。在10.7亿盘Lichess对局上无搜索预训练，达1837 Elo（对限强Stockfish），并在1000局对抗中击败所有同类无搜索/无偏好调优的公开模型（含参数量13倍的模型）。
AI.motivation: 现有棋类模型多为固定强度/固定风格的最优走子引擎，缺乏对自由文本棋风的可控性；同时缺少完全开源、可复现、含完整标签与消融记录的端到端流程。
AI.method: 预训练：1.07B过滤Lichess对局、无搜索、因子化走子表示+合法走子掩码。风格微调：合成数据构建——Gemma-4-31B为3M个对局方生成风格描述，用2.4M条矛盾较少描述蒸馏出1B Gemma-3模型标注其余对局，30M选中对局方各配5条描述；SFT通过门控交叉注意力接入冻结文本编码器；DPO以"相同走子+不匹配描述"为拒绝样本。各阶段设计选择由固定预算的自动化搜索循环确定。
AI.result: 预训练达1837 Elo，击败所有对比的无搜索公开模型（含13倍参数模型）。DPO后所有测试提示的风格遵循度提升：早换后53%→67%、兵走子占比29%→32%、后翼易位97.3%→99.7%；无提示强度与SFT持平（1792 vs 1797 Elo，属噪声范围）。每个设置1000局评测，并报告失败消融。
AI.conclusion: 文本条件化的风格控制在强棋力基础上可行，且DPO可在几乎不损失强度的情况下显著提升风格遵循；全流程（权重、带标签数据集、提示、配置、推理代码与可玩demo）开源可复现。

title: AuDQ: Auditable Data Quality through Agentic Rule Discovery
summary: High-stakes tabular pipelines rely on scattered, static quality checks that are hard to evolve and audit against policy intent. Regulated domains particularly suffer as the LLM-era automation raises expectations for traceability and accountability. We propose a vision for an ontology-grounded, repository-native data quality layer in which rules are first-class artifacts: versioned, provenance-linked to governance texts, and re-playable through immutable execution traces. As a first step toward validating this vision, we present a concrete implementation of its agentic rule-discovery core with two rule acquisition modes (Full-Agentic and Guided) and a human-in-the-loop (HITL) review interface. We define an evaluation framework and run experiments addressing whether our fully autonomous, divide-and-conquer agentic rule discovery produces rules of the same quality and diversity as those specified by a human expert, reporting preliminary results on two real world industry datasets in the finance and retail domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"本体驱动、仓库原生"的数据质量层愿景：将质量规则作为一等制品（版本化、可溯源到治理文本、具备不可变执行轨迹），并给出其智能体规则发现核心的初步实现与评测。
AI.motivation: 高风险表格流水线依赖零散、静态的质量检查，难以演进，也无法对照政策意图进行审计；在受监管领域，LLM 时代自动化又提高了对可追溯性与问责性的要求，因此需要更系统、可治理的数据质量机制。
AI.method: 提出本体驱动、仓库原生的数据质量层愿景（规则版本化、来源链接、可重放执行轨迹）；并实现其中的智能体规则发现核心，支持 Full-Agentic 与 Guided 两种规则获取模式，配有人工在环（HITL）审核界面；同时定义评测框架，采用分治式全自主智能体规则发现，在金融与零售两个真实行业数据集上做初步实验。
AI.result: 给出了分治式全自主智能体规则发现与人类专家规则在质量与多样性上的初步对比结果（两个真实行业数据集的预实验）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为规则即一等制品的数据质量层提供了可行起点，但当前仅完成规则发现核心的初步验证，整体愿景与评测仍有待扩展。

title: CD-OPD: Contextual Digest for On-Policy Distillation
summary: Teacher takeover in on-policy distillation (OPD) can produce incorrect responses even when the student and teacher independently answer the same problem correctly, a failure we quantify using Collaboration Failure Rate (CFR). To address it, we propose Contextual Digest for On-Policy Distillation (CD-OPD). CD-OPD structures the earlier context of teacher guidance through a teacher-generated dependency graph, curating the required problem conditions and preceding reasoning as node summaries alongside the unchanged guidance in a Contextual Digest before student continuation. We further develop online meta-reweighting, which compares Digest segment gradients with a task gradient from independent student responses to improve student-only performance, favoring updates predicted to reduce task loss. Across eight benchmarks, CD-OPD improves average accuracy by 1.32--7.05 percentage points over representative existing OPD methods. It also reduces CFR by 27.4\%--56.4\% relative to existing takeover-based OPD methods.

AI.tldr: 论文指出on-policy蒸馏中“教师接管”会导致Collaboration Failure Rate（CFR）问题，即师生各自能正确作答但接管后学生产出错误回答；提出CD-OPD，用教师生成的依赖图将早期上下文整理为节点摘要（Contextual Digest），并引入在线元重加权，在八个基准上平均准确率提升1.32–7.05个百分点，CFR相对现有接管式OPD方法降低27.4%–56.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏中教师接管（teacher takeover）环节存在反直觉失败：学生与教师独立作答均正确，但接管后学生仍生成错误回答。作者用CFR量化该问题，动机在于消除这一协作失效、并在不牺牲学生独立能力的前提下利用教师指导。
AI.method: 提出Contextual Digest for On-Policy Distillation（CD-OPD）：以教师生成的依赖图结构化早期教师指导上下文，将所需问题条件与前置推理整理为节点摘要，与未修改的指导共同构成Contextual Digest，供学生续写；并设计在线元重加权（online meta-reweighting），将Digest片段梯度与来自学生独立作答的任务梯度比较，偏向有利于降低任务损失的更新，以提升学生独立性能。
AI.result: 在八个基准上，CD-OPD相较代表性OPD方法平均准确率提升1.32–7.05个百分点；相对现有基于接管的OPD方法，CFR降低27.4%–56.4%。
AI.conclusion: 教师接管下的上下文不一致是OPD的关键失效来源，通过依赖图摘要化的上下文组织与面向任务损失的在线元重加权，可在提升蒸馏效果的同时显著缓解协作失效问题。

title: Operator-Mismatch Contrastive Learning for World-Relative Trajectory Coherence
summary: World models are increasingly judged by how well they rank plausible futures, yet plausibility alone is the wrong target. The same scene can evolve under many latent rules, and a future that is smooth and physically valid under one rule can be incoherent under the rule actually in force. We formalize the resulting failure, operator-blindness, and show that it is systematically hidden by standard evaluation: a scorer can attain near-perfect generic ranking while separating current-world from other-world futures no better than chance. We introduce Operator-Mismatch Contrastive (OMC) learning, whose semantic hard negatives are valid-but-wrong-operator trajectories, and a matching protocol that measures world-relative coherence directly. On a controlled synthetic benchmark with in- and out-of-distribution operator parameters, across two trajectory-scoring backbones, and on feature-level external validation with CoPhy ballsCF, OMC raises operator-sensitive scoring far above a chance baseline that nonetheless achieves 0.99 generic top-1. We prove that the wrong-operator negative is necessary both for the protocol to detect the failure and for the objective to fix it, and position OMC as an auxiliary coherence signal (a trajectory-coherence scorer, not a generative model, planner, or control agent) that can be attached to existing world-model representations.

AI.tldr: 论文指出世界模型评估中"似然性"是错误目标，形式化了"算子盲视"(operator-blindness)失败模式，提出OMC对比学习方法与配套评估协议。
AI.motivation: 世界模型日益以"未来排序能力"为评价标准，但仅凭合理/似然性不足：同一场景在不同隐规则(算子)下均可演化出平滑且物理合法的轨迹，而实际上有效的规则下却可能不自洽。标准评估中，打分器可达到近乎完美的通用排序，却无法区分当前世界与其他世界的未来(仅达随机水平)，该失败被系统性掩盖。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"算子盲视"失败；2) 提出Operator-Mismatch Contrastive (OMC)学习，其语义硬负样本为"算子正确性错误但轨迹本身合法"的轨迹(valid-but-wrong-operator)；3) 设计匹配协议直接度量"世界相对连贯性"(world-relative coherence)；4) 在两个轨迹打分骨干、受控合成基准(含分布内外算子参数)以及CoPhy ballsCF特征级外部验证上实验；5) 理论证明错误算子负样本对协议检测失败与目标函数修复失败均为必要。
AI.result: OMC将算子敏感打分显著提升至远高于随机基线，而该随机基线在通用top-1上仍达0.99；证明wrong-operator负样本对检测与修复双重必要性；并在外部特征级验证中复现结论。
AI.conclusion: OMC应定位为辅助连贯性信号(轨迹连贯性打分器，而非生成模型、规划器或控制智能体)，可附加于现有世界模型表征之上。

title: FinSafeGuard: A Quality-Driven Synthetic Dataset for Financial AI Safety
summary: Generating high-quality synthetic datasets at scale remains a fundamental challenge for training specialized AI systems in data-scarce domains. We present a comprehensive methodology that produces 14.3 million quality-filtered synthetic training examples from a structured taxonomy of 632,000 scenario specifications. Our four-stage pipeline ad- dresses critical challenges in synthetic data quality, diversity, and realism through: (1) systematic pre-generation research establishing optimal generation parameters via diminishing returns analysis, (2) conditional auto evolution mechanisms that remediate low-diversity batches during generation, (3) a two-layer semantic deduplication architecture combining lexical and embedding-based methods, and (4) LLM-as-Judge quality evaluation filtering samples based on behavioral correctness and tuple fidelity. Empirical analysis across three domains (Banking, Insurance, Financial Services) demonstrates domain-specific deduplication patterns ranging from 9.9% to 40.6%, with output generation modes exhibiting highest redundancy. Our batch size optimization reveals mode-specific diversity saturation thresholds, enabling principled allocation strategies. The complete pipeline reduces 26.4M raw samples to 14.3M high-confidence examples through merge (20.9% reduction), semantic deduplication (18.7% reduction), and quality-based filtering (15.9% reduction), providing a reproducible framework for domain-specific synthetic data generation with rigorous quality control.

AI.tldr: 提出一套四阶段合成数据生成方法，从63.2万条场景规格生成并筛选出1430万条高质量合成训练样本。
AI.motivation: 数据稀缺领域训练专用AI系统时，规模化生成高质量合成数据集仍是基础性难题，需同时保证质量、多样性与真实性。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：(1) 系统化预生成研究，通过收益递减分析确定最优生成参数；(2) 条件式自动演化机制，在生成过程中修复低多样性批次；(3) 两层语义去重架构，结合词法与嵌入方法；(4) LLM-as-Judge质量评估，基于行为正确性与元组保真度过滤样本。
AI.result: 三个领域（银行、保险、金融服务）去重比例为9.9%–40.6%，输出生成模式冗余最高；发现批次大小相关的模式特异性多样性饱和阈值。整体将2640万原始样本降至1430万，其中合并降20.9%、语义去重降18.7%、质量过滤降15.9%。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线为领域专用合成数据生成提供了可复现框架，具备严格的质量控制与有原则的资源分配策略。

title: Multi-site Learning for Forecasting Day-Ahead Wind-Power Production for Onshore Wind Farms in Great Britain with Deep Neural Networks
summary: Accurate day-ahead wind-power production forecasting is increasingly important for energy system operations, market activity and balancing Great Britain's grid as wind generation grows. In this study, we train multi-site deep neural networks (DNNs) using pooled historical production and reanalysis weather data from 88 onshore wind Balancing Mechanism Units (BMUs). Forecasts are produced at 09:00 UK time for the following midnight-to-midnight delivery day, matching NESO's operational day-ahead forecasting schedule. We use reanalysis weather as future covariates during training and numerical weather prediction (NWP) forecasts during inference, extending training beyond the available historical NWP archive. Our multi-site recurrent neural network outperforms site-specific RNNs and a multi-site XGBoost model, while processing the full future-weather trajectory for the forecast horizon further improves accuracy relative to hour-aligned approaches. Our best model, an RNN with a bidirectional weather encoder (BiRNN) for NWP trajectory processing, reduces MW mean absolute error and root mean squared error relative to NESO by 17.94% and 12.51%, respectively, across 638,246 matched BMU-hour observations under conditions approximating unconstrained wind farm operations. In 40 leave-one-out trials, the BiRNN achieves lower MAE than NESO at 32 excluded sites, indicating transferable forecasting ability despite reduced accuracy when sites are omitted from training. Our capacity-estimation, data-cleaning and reanalysis-based training approach provides a basis for scaling NWP-aware multi-site forecasting to additional wind farms, longer production histories, and increased forecast accuracy beyond that seen in this study.

AI.tldr: 该研究用88个在岸风电场池化数据训练多站点深度神经网络，以再分析天气作训练期协变量、NWP预报作推理期协变量，提前一日09:00出报（次日全天）。双向天气编码RNN（BiRNN）处理全时段NWP轨迹，较NESO将MAE、RMSE分别降低17.94%和12.51%，并在40次留一试验中32个站点优于NESO。
AI.motivation: 英国风电占比上升，日前风电功率预测对系统运行、市场交易与电网平衡愈发关键；单一站点建模数据有限、泛化差，且历史NWP存档长度限制了训练规模，需要可扩展的多站点、NWP感知的建模方案。
AI.method: 基于88个在岸风电机组（BMU）的并网历史出力与再分析气象数据构建池化数据集，统一进行容量估计与数据清洗；训练多站点DNN（RNN），训练阶段以再分析天气作为未来协变量（规避NWP存档不足），推理阶段改用NWP预报；对比站点独立RNN与多站点XGBoost；采用双向RNN编码器处理完整未来NWP时间轨迹，并与逐时刻对齐方式对比；开展40次留一站点试验评估可迁移性。
AI.result: 多站点RNN优于站点独立RNN与多站点XGBoost；处理完整NWP轨迹优于逐小时对齐方案。最优模型BiRNN在638,246条匹配的BMU-小时样本上（近似无约束运行的条件下），MW级MAE与RMSE较NESO分别降低17.94%与12.51%；40次留一试验中有32个被剔除站点MAE仍低于NESO，表明预测能力可迁移，但剔除站点后精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 容量估计、数据清洗与以再分析数据替代NWP训练的组合策略，为将NWP感知的多站点预测扩展到更多风电场、更长历史序列并进一步提升精度提供了可行基础。

title: CUA-Lite: An Open Platform for Computer Use Agents
summary: Open resources for computer use agents (CUAs) -- environments, datasets, and models -- remain scattered: without a standard, these resources cannot be integrated and scaled; additionally, evaluation, RL, and SFT cannot share one infrastructure. We present CUA-Lite, an open platform for developing CUAs, built around three standardized abstractions: (1) Unified environment interface, under which we integrate 12 benchmarks across desktop, browser, and mobile, plus lightweight VM-free sandboxes that replicate OSWorld's desktop at much lower cost, providing over 30,000 verifiable tasks. (2) Unified supervised data format, into which we convert the major public CUA datasets, from GUI grounding and understanding to full rollouts, and record our fresh rollouts from frontier CUAs on these verifiable environments. (3) Model harnesses shared across evaluation, RL, and SFT, one per model and implemented for 14 model families. Each harness runs its model in these computer environments, producing the rollouts that evaluation and RL consume, or renders stored supervised data into the model's own training format for SFT. We release reference scores across the integrated benchmarks, and show that RL and SFT through the same harness improve open-weight models. We release our dataset, code, and models, and the platform is open to contributions.

AI.tldr: CUA-Lite 是一个面向计算机使用智能体（CUA）的开放平台，通过统一的环境接口、监督数据格式和模型 harness 三大标准化抽象，整合 12 个基准与 3 万余可验证任务，并打通评估、RL 与 SFT 的共享基础设施。
AI.motivation: 现有 CUA 相关的环境、数据集与模型资源高度分散，缺乏统一标准，导致资源难以集成与扩展，且评估、RL、SFT 无法共享同一套基础设施。
AI.method: 提出三项标准化抽象：(1) 统一环境接口，整合桌面、浏览器、移动端共 12 个基准，并提供免虚拟机的轻量沙箱以低成本复现 OSWorld 桌面环境，合计 30,000+ 可验证任务；(2) 统一监督数据格式，将主流公开 CUA 数据集（从 GUI grounding/理解到完整 rollout）转换入该格式，并补充前沿 CUA 在可验证环境上的新 rollout；(3) 跨评估、RL、SFT 共享的模型 harness，按模型实现、覆盖 14 个模型家族，用于生成 rollout 或将监督数据渲染为各模型训练格式。
AI.result: 发布各整合基准的参考分数；实验表明通过同一 harness 进行 RL 与 SFT 均可提升开源权重模型。
AI.conclusion: CUA-Lite 以标准化抽象弥合 CUA 资源碎片化问题，实现评估、RL、SFT 共用一套基础设施，并开放数据集、代码与模型，欢迎社区贡献。

title: Mining the Self-Rewriting System: A Vision for Data Mining on AI-Native Infrastructure
comment: Accepted to the Blue Sky Track of the IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM)
summary: Classical data mining treats data as generated outside the learner.
