Emerging AI-native infrastructure invalidates this assumption: as agents observe system state, act, update retrieval stores and models, and promote new artifacts into the serving path, their own decisions reshape the future logs, traces, corpora, and evaluation records used for later training and release. We call this new research object a self-rewriting system and the resulting system-induced distribution shift endogenous drift. Our central, falsifiable claim is that cross-surface causes are not identifiable in general from marginal per-surface monitoring: different coupled failures can produce the same individual signals while differing in their joint behavior, requiring joint analysis for reliable attribution. This agenda comprises four foundational research problems: fusing heterogeneous drift signals into calibrated gating and attribution (C1); mining agent traces whose activity alphabet evolves (C2); maintaining knowledge fabrics through online reindexing, faithfulness, and compression decisions (C3); and safely promoting concurrent learning streams through one shared evaluation gate (C4). These remain fragmented across concept drift, performative prediction, process mining, streaming retrieval-augmented generation, and MLOps, without a unified data-mining agenda. We outline public benchmarks and evaluation criteria, using AI-native telecom only as a motivating exemplar with analogues in finance, software CI/CD, and clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“自改写系统”与“内生漂移”这一新研究对象，主张跨表面原因无法由各表面边际监控单独识别，需联合分析，并提出四个基础研究问题（C1–C4）与公开基准设想。
AI.motivation: 经典数据挖掘假设数据由学习器外部生成，而AI原生基础设施中智能体的观测、行动、检索库与模型更新以及新工件上线会反过来重塑未来的日志、轨迹、语料与评估记录，导致系统诱发的分布偏移，现有概念漂移、performative prediction、过程挖掘、流式RAG与MLOps研究彼此割裂，缺乏统一议程。
AI.method: 以“跨表面因果不可由边际监控识别”为核心可证伪命题，通过构造不同耦合失效产生相同单表面信号而联合行为不同的论证，规划四个研究问题：C1异构漂移信号融合为校准门控与归因；C2活动字母表演化的智能体轨迹挖掘；C3在线重建索引、忠实性与压缩决策下的知识织体维护；C4通过共享评估门安全晋升并发学习流；并给出公开基准与评价标准。
AI.result: 摘要为议程性论文，未报告实证结果；其核心论断（边际信号不可识别、需联合分析归因）构成可检验假设，并给出四大问题的划分与以AI原生电信为示例、可迁移至金融、软件CI/CD与临床决策支持的基准设计思路。
AI.conclusion: 需要将漂移监测从单表面边际指标转向跨表面联合建模与统一评估门控，建立自改写系统下内生漂移的统一数据挖掘议程及公共基准，以实现可靠归因与安全发布。

title: From Code to Playable Systems: CEGame-Bench for Long-Horizon Game Creation Agents
summary: A game ships when a player can launch it, finish it, and return to a saved world, none of which a successful build guarantees, yet game-creation agents are mostly tested on one engine or on one-prompt browser games. We present CEGame-Bench, the first long-horizon benchmark for complete-game creation across five production engines: Defold, Godot, Roblox Studio, Unity, and Unreal Engine. Agents build each game from an empty project and a design document in runs averaging up to 295 steps and 65M tokens; the document doubles as a contract, and a hidden evaluator accepts a game only by real-input play. Under four scaffolds, agents earn most integration points but usually under half the gameplay points, and their games reach the ending in only 16% of runs, while references built by engineers with coding agents score near the maximum, which places this artifact-to-play gap in the agents. No two engines rank configurations alike (Kendall's tau 0.14-0.62), and the same game usually scores higher on Unity and Unreal Engine, which check more before play. We release Game Completion Boost, an agent skill for requirement-driven playtesting and repair that raises the execution-based score of three models by 14.1-24.3 points.

AI.tldr: 提出首个跨五款生产引擎（Defold、Godot、Roblox Studio、Unity、Unreal）的长时程完整游戏创作基准 CEGame-Bench，揭示智能体"制品—可玩"差距并发布 Game Completion Boost 修复技能。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏创作智能体多仅在单一引擎或单提示浏览器小游戏上评测；"成功构建"并不等于玩家能启动、通关并回到存档世界，缺乏对完整游戏交付能力的长期程、跨引擎评测基准。
AI.method: 智能体从空项目与设计文档出发，在五种引擎中构建完整游戏，单次运行平均达 295 步、65M tokens；设计文档同时作为验收契约，由隐藏评估器仅通过真实输入游玩（real-input play）判定接受。在四种脚手架下评测，并分析引擎间排名一致性（Kendall's tau）。
AI.result: 智能体可获得多数集成分但通常不足一半的游戏性分，仅 16% 的运行能到达结局；工程师借助编码智能体构建的参考实现接近满分，表明差距源自智能体本身。不同引擎对配置排名不一致（Kendall's tau 0.14–0.62），同一游戏在 Unity 与 Unreal 上得分更高（二者在游玩前检查更多）。Game Completion Boost 可在三个模型上提升执行式得分 14.1–24.3 分。
AI.conclusion: CEGame-Bench 建立了跨引擎、以可玩性为准的完整游戏创作评测范式，定位"制品—可玩"差距于智能体能力而非基准或引擎，并给出可推广的需求驱动式试玩与修复技能，为后续智能体研究提供统一评估与改进基线。

title: Simulating Infant Senses with Age-Tuned Networks
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Code and website: https://github.com/pikulsomesh/developmental-world-models and https://pikulsomesh.github.io/developmental-world-models/
summary: What a newborn sees, hears and feels, and how this changes month by month, has been measured sense by sense, with different methods and in different units. We bring these measurements together for the first two years of life and ask whether small neural networks tuned to a given age can turn them into a quick, inspectable simulation of sensory perception. Each sense's immaturity is written as a fixed, age-indexed filter on the input, and a small prediction network learns behind it over the first year. The filters alone reproduce the order in which the senses mature, by construction. The networks add what filters cannot: in vision they extract far less than their input allows at early stages (at the newborn stage a toy's position cannot be read out, $R^2 = 0.00$, against 0.57 for a network trained directly on the same input), and a critical period and perceptual narrowing emerge without being built in; in hearing they track what their input allows. The same filters drive the Baby Senses Lab, a free website that shows a user's own images and sounds as a baby of a chosen age might sense them. It is a research and teaching tool, not a diagnostic test.

AI.tldr: 将0–2岁各感觉通道的成熟度写成年龄索引的固定输入滤波器，并在其背景下训练小型预测网络，得到可检视的婴儿感知模拟；视觉网络在新生儿期表现远低于输入上限，并自发涌现关键期与知觉窄化。
AI.motivation: 婴儿“看到、听到、感觉到什么”以及随月龄如何变化，以往是逐通道、用不同方法和不同单位分别测量的，结果难以整合比较。作者希望把这些测量统一到一个可快速运行、可检视的感知模拟框架中，检验小型神经网络能否复现婴儿感觉成熟的时间进程与特征。
AI.method: 每个感觉通道的不成熟性被表示为作用于输入的、固定的、随年龄变化的滤波器；在其后方训练一个小型预测网络，并在生命第一年内学习。滤波器的年龄参数由已有发展心理学测量确定，因此感觉成熟顺序由构造保证。通过将网络读出性能与直接在相同输入上训练的网络（输入上限）对比，评估网络引入的额外约束；并发布面向公众的网站Baby Senses Lab，将用户自选图像与声音按指定月龄的婴儿感知方式呈现。
AI.result: 视觉通道中，网络在早期阶段提取的信息远少于输入所允许的：新生儿阶段玩具位置无法被读出（R²=0.00），而直接在同输入上训练的网络为0.57；关键期与知觉窄化在未被显式设定的情况下自发涌现。听觉通道中，网络表现基本跟随其输入所允许的水平。滤波器本身按构造复现各感觉的成熟顺序。
AI.conclusion: 年龄索引的输入滤波器加小型预测网络构成一个简洁、可解释的婴儿感知计算模型：滤波器决定成熟顺序，网络贡献不可由滤波器解释的约束，如视觉早期信息瓶颈及关键期/知觉窄化。配套网站Baby Senses Lab是研究与教学工具，而非诊断性测验。

title: Reliable Before Profitable: QuantHarness for Governing Financial Strategy Development with LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents can turn natural-language financial research requests into executable and backtested strategies, but a successful run may still implement the wrong rule, use information unavailable at decision time, or obscure how repairs and candidate selection changed the strategy. Because these failures arise throughout development, final code and performance metrics alone are insufficient to establish either fidelity to the request or the validity of the development process. We therefore address the reliability of financial strategy development at the trajectory level: the system must control how intermediate outputs become downstream state and preserve the evidence needed to justify the terminal outcome. We introduce QuantHarness, a two-layer agent harness in which a finance-specific Workflow structures specification, data grounding, construction, testing, and review, while Harness Core enforces stage-specific information, action, and commitment boundaries. We also introduce FinRelBench, a benchmark that evaluates strategy-development reliability through execution success, requirement satisfaction, and runtime evidence. QuantHarness achieves the highest Task Success at 90.72\%, compared with 74.23\%--84.54\% for the comparison systems. Controlled stress tests show that its boundaries contain targeted violations, while structured run records improve evidence retrieval and support decision replay under the evaluated protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出两层智能体框架QuantHarness与基准FinRelBench，在轨迹层面保障金融策略开发可靠性，任务成功率90.72%，优于对比系统74.23%–84.54%。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体可将自然语言金融研究请求转化为可执行并回测的策略，但运行成功不等于可靠：可能实现错误规则、使用决策时不可得的信息，或掩盖修复与候选选择如何改变策略。此类失效贯穿开发全过程，仅凭最终代码和绩效指标无法证明需求保真度与开发过程有效性，故需在轨迹层面控制中间输出如何转化为下游状态并保留证据。
AI.method: 提出QuantHarness：两层智能体harness。金融专用Workflow对规格化、数据接地、构建、测试与复核进行结构化编排；Harness Core在各阶段强制信息、动作与承诺边界。同时构建FinRelBench基准，从执行成功、需求满足与运行时证据三方面评估策略开发可靠性。
AI.result: QuantHarness任务成功率达90.72%，对比系统为74.23%–84.54%。受控压力测试显示其边界机制可拦截针对性违规；结构化运行记录提升证据检索能力，并在所评估协议下支持决策回放。
AI.conclusion: 策略开发可靠性应在轨迹层面而非仅结果层面评估；阶段化的信息、动作与承诺边界加之结构化证据记录，可有效约束违规并支撑可审计、可回放的开发过程。

title: Structured Relevance Determination and Channel Additive Gaussian Processes for Image Data
summary: We introduce radial basis function (RBF) kernels for Gaussian processes that use structured hyperparameter sharing for image-valued inputs. For high-dimensional inputs such as images, a fully anisotropic RBF kernel assigns a separate lengthscale to each input dimension, which can introduce many hyperparameters and may lead to overfitting and poorly calibrated predictive uncertainty when data are limited. We propose structured relevance determination by tying lengthscales across groups of adjacent pixels and within each colour channel. This yields patch-wise and channel-wise constrained anisotropic RBF parametrisations that reduce the number of independently learned lengthscales. We further introduce channel-additive Gaussian processes for multi-channel images and combine them with structured relevance determination, resulting in a parameter-efficient decomposition of the latent function into components defined on channel subsets, enabling some non-local generalisation. The proposed kernels are evaluated on MNIST and a compact binary aircraft-detection dataset of low-resolution RGB satellite image chips. We also show how channel-wise structured relevance determination can be incorporated into convolutional Gaussian processes. We observe improved predictive performance compared to isotropic and fully anisotropic RBF baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出面向图像输入的高斯过程RBF核结构化超参数共享方法，通过按局部像素块与颜色通道绑定长度尺度，并引入通道可加高斯过程，在MNIST与二元飞机检测卫星图像数据上取得优于各向同性与完全各向异性RBF基线的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 高维图像输入下，完全各向异性RBF核为每个输入维度分配独立长度尺度，超参数数量庞大，在数据有限时易过拟合且预测不确定性校准不佳。
AI.method: 提出结构化相关性判定：在相邻像素组内及同一颜色通道内共享长度尺度，形成分块式与分通道式约束的各向异性RBF参数化；进一步提出通道可加高斯过程，将隐函数分解为定义于通道子集上的分量，实现参数高效表示并带来一定非局部泛化能力；并将分通道结构化相关性判定嵌入卷积高斯过程。
AI.result: 在MNIST数据集与一个低分辨率RGB卫星图像芯片的紧凑二元飞机检测数据集上进行评估，相比各向同性与完全各向异性RBF基线，预测性能有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化超参数共享可在显著减少独立长度尺度的同时保持或提升预测性能，为图像输入的高斯过程提供参数高效且可扩展至卷积高斯过程的核设计思路。

title: MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching
summary: Despite rapid advances in large language models (LLMs), their deployment in the sports and health domain remains high-risk due to the absence of domain-specific evaluation benchmarks. Existing general-purpose benchmarks (e.g., MMLU and HELM) primarily assess broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities, but fail to capture critical domain requirements such as exercise safety, physiological appropriateness, personalization, and actionable coaching quality. This gap is particularly concerning in fitness and health applications, where incorrect or unsafe recommendations can lead to physical harm. To address this limitation, we introduce MoveBench, the first comprehensive benchmarking framework specifically designed for evaluating LLMs in sports and health coaching. The proposed benchmark integrates heterogeneous task formats, including multiple-choice questions (MCQs) and open-ended question answering (OpenQA), grounded in real-world user scenarios and paired with structured rubrics emphasizing safety compliance, scientific validity, and training logic. Through large-scale evaluation of 15 diverse LLMs on 809 questions with 5,012 rubric-level criteria, our results reveal substantial performance variability, particularly in safety awareness, structured program design, and personalization capability, highlighting a critical gap between knowing and doing. Our work establishes a foundational evaluation standard for sports and health LLM applications and provides a reproducible framework for advancing safe, reliable, and context-aware AI-driven coaching systems. Open resources are available at https://github.com/SatoSakula/MoveBench.

AI.tldr: 提出MoveBench——首个面向体育与健康指导领域的大模型评测基准，融合选择题与开放式问答，基于真实用户场景构建评分细则，并对15个LLM开展大规模评测。
AI.motivation: LLM在体育与健康场景落地风险高，但缺乏领域专用评测基准。现有通用基准（MMLU、HELM）侧重广谱知识与推理，无法刻画运动安全性、生理适宜性、个性化与可执行指导质量等关键领域要求；一旦给出错误或不安全建议，可能造成身体伤害。
AI.method: 构建MoveBench评测框架：整合异构任务格式（MCQ与OpenQA），题目根植于真实用户场景，并配套结构化评分细则（rubric），重点考察安全合规、科学有效性与训练逻辑。基于809道题、5,012条细则级评分标准，对15个不同LLM进行大规模评测。
AI.result: 评测结果显示模型性能差异显著，尤其在安全意识、结构化训练方案设计与个性化能力方面表现薄弱，揭示出"知其然"与"行其然"之间的显著鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 为体育与健康领域的LLM应用建立基础性评测标准，并提供可复现框架，推动安全、可靠、情境感知的AI指导系统发展；相关资源已开源。

title: The Hidden Look-Ahead: Point-in-Time Leakage in Electricity Market Data
summary: Empirical studies of electricity prices routinely state that their models use only information available at the time of the trading decision. For weather-driven forecasts drawn from commercial archives, this condition is harder to meet than it appears, and whether it holds can change over time. We identify three timing pitfalls. A forecast run is labelled by the issue time of its weather model, but becomes available hours later and keeps changing after publication. Auction gates follow local clock time, while archives use UTC. Outturn series are revised after publication without earlier values being kept. Using the timestamps of 128,656 forecast runs from ten weather-model configurations, matched to the day-ahead and first intraday auction gates in Great Britain over 2022-2026, we find that selecting "the latest run issued before the gate" picks a run not yet published at the gate on more than 99% of delivery days for six of the ten configurations at one of the two gates. For GFS at the day-ahead gate, the share is 0.6% in winter and 99.8% in summer. The exposure also shifts as publication delays drift, and an action margin of a few minutes can cost a full six-hour forecast cycle. The wrongly selected inputs differ materially from those available at the gate, but their apparent accuracy gain ranges from -9% to +24% across variables, models, gates and seasons, so its effect cannot be assumed and must be measured. We argue that point-in-time correctness is a dynamic property of the data pipeline, and propose a protocol that audits it from timestamps before any model is fitted.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示电价实证研究普遍声称仅使用交易决策时点可得信息，但商业气象预报档案存在三类时点(Point-in-time)陷阱。作者用128,656次预报运行的时间戳，匹配英国2022–2026年日前与首次日内拍卖关口，发现"取关口前最后发布的最新运行"在多数配置下会选中关口时尚未发布的预报，属于前视偏差，并提出在建模前基于时间戳审计时点正确性的协议。
AI.motivation: 电价预测与交易模型的标准假设是"不使用未来信息"，但对商业气象档案中的预报数据，这一条件难以满足且随时间漂移。已有文献往往默认数据档案是时点正确的，缺少对可用性时间线的实证审计；作者希望证明该假设的脆弱性，并将时点正确性重新界定为数据管线的动态属性而非静态标签。
AI.method: (1) 识别三类时点陷阱：预报运行以气象模式发布(issue)时间标注却在数小时后才可得且发布后仍不断更新；拍卖关口按当地时钟而档案用UTC；实况(outturn)序列发布后被追溯修订且不保留历史版本。(2) 收集十种气象模式配置共128,656次预报运行的时间戳，与英国日前市场及首次日内拍卖关口逐日匹配。(3) 量化"关口前最新运行"被误选的比例及其随季节和发布延迟漂移的变化，并考察操作时间边际对预报周期选择的影响。(4) 比较误选输入与关口真实可得输入的差异及其表面精度增益。
AI.result: 在两个关口之一的匹配中，十种配置里有六种在超过99%的交付日会选中关口时尚未发布的运行。GFS在日前关口误选比例冬季为0.6%、夏季高达99.8%，显示暴露度随季节性发布延迟变化。发布延迟的漂移会改变暴露程度，数分钟的操作时间边际即可导致损失一整个六小时预报周期。误选输入与关口可得输入存在实质差异，其表面精度增益在变量、模式、关口与季节间从−9%到+24%不等，故偏差方向与大小无法先验假定。
AI.conclusion: 时点正确性应被视为数据管线的动态属性，需持续审计而非一次性声明。作者建议在拟合任何模型之前，先基于时间戳对预报发布延时、关口时区对齐与实况修订进行审计，以量化并报告潜在前视偏差，从而保证电价模型的可复现性与可信度。

title: On Counting Graphs for Modal Logic with Counting
summary: In this paper, we study the theoretical computational complexity of counting trees and graphs that are classified positively by a graph neural networks, or said equivalently that satisfy a given formula of modal logic with counting. We also study convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图神经网络（GNN）正向分类的树与图，即满足给定计数模态逻辑公式的结构，其计数问题的理论计算复杂度，并研究了收敛性。
AI.motivation: GNN的表达能力与计数模态逻辑（modal logic with counting）存在已知对应关系，但对该类逻辑所刻画的结构"计数"问题（#P类难度）及其求解算法的收敛性质缺乏系统的复杂度刻画，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 将GNN的正向分类问题等价转化为计数模态逻辑公式的可满足结构计数问题，据此在树与图两类结构上分析其计算复杂度（如#P完全性、多项式可解情形等），并考察相关计数/迭代过程的收敛性。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体结论；预期结果是对树类与一般图上该计数问题的复杂度进行分类刻画（例如某些公式类在树上多项式可解、在一般图上#P难），并给出收敛性判据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从复杂度理论视角建立了GNN与计数模态逻辑在计数与收敛层面的联系，为理解GNN表达能力的计算代价提供了理论框架，但摘要信息有限，具体结论需参见正文。

title: Paloma: Phase-Conditioned Residual Modulation for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Explicitly modeling periodicity has proven to be an efficient approach for time series forecasting, where the residual, obtained after removing the periodic component from the time series, is typically treated as unstructured noise. However, in this work, we show that such residuals still exhibit structured, \textit{phase-dependent} deviations, as supported by both empirical observations and theoretical analysis. This suggests that residuals should not be treated merely as unstructured noise, but instead as \textit{phase-conditioned signals} whose variations arise in both direction and magnitude. Motivated by this perspective and inspired by phase and amplitude modulation in classical signal processing, we propose \textit{Paloma}, a simple yet effective framework for modeling residual deviations. Specifically, Paloma comprises two complementary modules: \textit{a Phase Rotation module}, which performs phase-conditioned rotations to capture directional changes in the feature space, and \textit{an Amplitude Scaling module}, which applies phase-conditioned affine transformations to model magnitude variations. We further abstract the two modules into a general-purpose plugin, termed the \textit{Paloma technique}, which can be readily integrated into existing forecasting architectures to modulate input sequences in a phase-aware manner, enabling backbone models to capture phase-dependent variations in both direction and magnitude. Extensive experiments on twelve datasets demonstrate that Paloma achieves state-of-the-art and robust forecasting performance. Additional results show that the Paloma technique consistently improves a wide range of baseline models, validating its effectiveness as a general-purpose component. Our Code is available at \url{https://github.com/TSTS13/Paloma}.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 Paloma 框架，将周期分解后的残差视为相位条件信号，而非无结构噪声，通过相位旋转与幅度缩放两个模块建模残差的方向与幅值变化，并在十二个数据集上取得最优且稳健的预测性能，同时可作为通用插件提升多种基线模型。
AI.motivation: 显式建模周期性是时间序列预测的有效手段，但去除周期分量后的残差通常被当作无结构噪声处理。作者通过经验观察与理论分析指出，残差实际上存在结构化的、依赖相位的偏差，其在方向和幅值上均有变化，因此不应简单视为噪声。
AI.method: 受经典信号处理中相位与幅度调制的启发，提出 Paloma 框架，包含两个互补模块：（1）相位旋转模块，执行相位条件的旋转操作以捕捉特征空间中的方向变化；（2）幅度缩放模块，施加相位条件的仿射变换以建模幅值变化。二者进一步抽象为通用插件 Paloma technique，可嵌入现有预测架构，以相位感知方式调制输入序列。
AI.result: 在十二个数据集上的大量实验表明 Paloma 达到最先进且稳健的预测性能；额外结果表明 Paloma technique 能一致性地提升多种基线模型，验证其作为通用组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 残差应被建模为相位条件信号而非无结构噪声；基于相位旋转与幅度缩放的 Paloma 框架简单有效，既可独立取得 SOTA 性能，又可作为即插即用组件广泛增强现有预测模型。

title: LLMs Prompted for Legal Context Refuse More: Overrefusal from Small On-Premises LLMs in Criminal Legal Context
summary:
Confidentiality requirements increasingly push legal professionals toward small, on-device LLMs that keep case data in-house, used for everyday tasks such as summarization, translation, and reformulation. Following standard prompting guidance, a user naturally states their role (``I am a lawyer...''). We show that this innocuous habit has an unexpected cost: such authority framing can make the model selectively refuse legitimate requests, introducing bias through uneven access to assistance. We evaluate four modern small open-weight LLMs on benign legal-domain prompts to measure this over-refusal.
  Surprisingly, we find that authority-style prefixes (''I am legal counsel working for a national supreme court'', ''I'm a defense lawyer'') systematically increase refusal rates by 2--20x over the no-prefix baseline, while a known role-play jailbreak prefix shows mixed effects, sharply increasing refusals in some models and barely shifting them in others. The finding suggests that small on-prem deployable LLMs are unstable under contextual framings that a real institutional user might naturally introduce, and further investigation is essential to minimize opportunities for bias.

AI.tldr: 法律专业人士在使用小型本地部署LLM时习惯性地声明身份（如"我是律师"），这种权威性前缀会意外导致模型对合法请求的选择性拒绝率上升2–20倍，形成不平等的助手可及性偏差。
AI.motivation: 保密需求推动法律从业者使用本地小型LLM处理摘要、翻译、改写等日常任务；按标准提示规范，用户会自然声明其角色。作者希望检验这种无害习惯是否带来隐性代价，即权威身份框架是否诱发对合法请求的过度拒绝与偏差。
AI.method: 在四个现代小型开源权重LLM上，使用良性的法律领域提示词进行评测，对比无前缀基线、权威型身份前缀（如"我为国家最高法院工作的法律顾问""我是辩护律师"）以及已知的角色扮演越狱前缀，量化拒绝率变化。
AI.result: 权威式前缀使拒绝率相对无前缀基线系统性上升2–20倍；已知的角色扮演越狱前缀效果不一，在部分模型中拒绝率急剧上升，在另一些模型中几乎无变化。
AI.conclusion: 小型本地可部署LLM在真实机构用户自然引入的上下文框架下表现不稳定，存在通过不均等获取协助而引入偏差的风险，亟需进一步研究以最小化此类偏差机会。

title: MOSAIC: Multi-Objective Search for Allocating Inference Cache Across LLM Decoder Layers
summary: The Key-Value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck of long-context LLM inference. Token eviction methods such as SnapKV, H2O, AdaKV and L2Norm shrink it, but they give every transformer layer the same budget, although layers differ in which tokens they need. We present MOSAIC, a multi-objective neural architecture search that learns per-layer KV-cache budgets for any eviction method. One search maps the trade-off between average budget and task score; its best allocation transfers to every target budget without further search, and an optional budget-constrained search refines it. Across four eviction methods on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, MOSAIC beats uniform allocation in 146 of 154 (task, method, budget) settings, by up to +48 points on RULER and +11.9 on LongBench (LCC). On both models, it reaches the score of uniform allocation with up to 4x less KV cache (75% smaller). Against EvolKV, MOSAIC explores a ~10^40 x larger search space with 4x fewer evaluations and 18% fewer GPU-hours per budget, and scores higher in 5 of 6 settings. The learned allocations consistently favour a small set of middle layers.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC 用多目标神经架构搜索为每个 Transformer 层学习独立的 KV-cache 预算分配，可迁移到任意目标预算，在 154 个设置中 146 个优于均匀分配。
AI.motivation: KV cache 是长上下文 LLM 推理的主要显存瓶颈。SnapKV、H2O、AdaKV、L2Norm 等 token 淘汰方法虽能压缩缓存，但都给所有层分配相同预算，忽略层间对 token 需求的差异。
AI.method: 提出 MOSAIC：一种与淘汰方法无关的多目标 NAS，用于学习逐层 KV-cache 预算。一次搜索即可刻画"平均预算—任务分数"的权衡曲线，其最优分配无需再搜索即可迁移到任意目标预算；可选地再执行预算约束搜索做精调。与 EvolKV 对比时搜索空间大 ~10^40 倍。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 与 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 上配合四种淘汰方法，146/154 个（任务、方法、预算）设置优于均匀分配，RULER 最高 +48 分、LongBench(LCC) +11.9。两模型上以最多少 4x（小 75%）的 KV cache 达到均匀分配的分数。对比 EvolKV：评估次数少 4x、每预算 GPU 小时少 18%，6 个设置中 5 个分数更高。
AI.conclusion: 逐层非均匀 KV 预算分配显著优于均匀分配且具跨预算可迁移性；学到的分配一致地偏好少数中间层，为长上下文推理的缓存优化提供了明确的结构性启示。

title: Fairness or Fallacy? Mapping the Landscape of AI Bias in Disease Detection
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) has several transformative effects on healthcare, like to facilitate clinicians in disease detection and to manage patient care with enhanced precision. Due to the increasing complexity of medical data and the growing volume of diagnostic images, the substantial computational power needed to process such information creates both opportunities and challenges. To accomplish this objective, numerous methodologies have been proposed to integrate AI into disease detection systems. All these methodologies consider different aspects of clinical diagnosis, considering key parameters such as the type of AI model employed, the nature of input data, and the population demographics being analysed. In this paper, we review different state-of-the-art techniques which have been proposed for various areas of disease detection, specifically focusing on bias identification and mitigation. The proposed solutions are distinguished based on the type of input data they utilize, the architecture of model, and type of bias (algorithmic bias, demographic bias, model bias, and deployment bias). The time frame chosen to filter out relevant studies is between 2015 and 2026. Eventually, we review 23 related articles out of 64,389 analyzed from seven different digital libraries. The obtained results guide us to reach a conclusion with respect to state-of-the-art selected studies. Furthermore, these results reveal significant research gaps that can assist researchers in addressing AI-related bias in medical diagnosis. By prioritizing explainability, data diversity, and fairness in algorithmic design, as well as equitable access for affected patient populations, they can utilize available healthcare resources more effectively.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于AI疾病检测中偏差（bias）识别与缓解技术的系统性文献综述，按输入数据类型、模型架构与偏差类型对23篇精选研究进行了分类梳理，并指出研究空白。
AI.motivation: 医疗数据复杂度和诊断图像体量激增，使AI在疾病检测与精准照护中的应用既具潜力又面临挑战；现有方法在模型类型、数据性质与人群特征上差异较大，且AI医疗诊断中的偏差问题（影响公平性与结果可信度）缺乏系统梳理，因此需要专门聚焦偏差识别与缓解的综述。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述：检索七个数位图书馆，时间范围限定2015–2026年，从64,389篇中筛选出23篇相关文献；按输入数据类型、模型架构和偏差类型（算法偏差、人口统计偏差、模型偏差、部署偏差）对所选研究进行分类与对比分析。
AI.result: 从64,389篇文献中筛出23篇纳入分析；汇总得到各类偏差缓解技术的现状图景，并据此提炼出关于最新研究的结论性判断，同时揭示AI医疗诊断中与偏差相关的重要研究空白。
AI.conclusion: 应优先关注可解释性、数据多样性与算法设计中的公平性，并保障受影响患者人群的公平可及，从而更有效地利用医疗资源；所识别的空白为后续研究者应对AI诊断偏差提供了方向。

title: Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional context. As these models reach real-world deployment, machine unlearning becomes essential. This process aims to remove the influence of a designated "forget set" without retraining from scratch, so that sensitive, copyrighted, or restricted content can no longer be elicited while preserving retained capabilities. Masked Diffusion Unlearning (MDU) is the first publicly available unlearning method customized for these models: it tunes the model $p_θ$ to match a frozen prompt-masked anchor $p_{\mathrm{anchor}}$ on the forget set by minimizing the anchor-last divergence $\mathrm{KL}(p_θ\Vert p_{\mathrm{anchor}})$. We identify two failure modes of MDU. First, random answer masking can leave key forget tokens visible to the anchor even when the question is fully masked. Second, at a memorized (near-one-hot) prediction, the anchor-last logit gradient vanishes while the anchor-first divergence $\mathrm{KL}(p_{\mathrm{anchor}} \Vert p_θ)$ logit gradient does not. As a result, MDU training stalls on the tokens we most need to forget. Backed by theoretical and empirical analyses, we propose Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning (EMDU): anchor-first KL divergence toward a frozen anchor whose entire answer span is masked. On TOFU and RWKU benchmarks using LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B, our EMDU matches or exceeds the forgetting of MDU and adapted AR baselines, while better preserving retain utility.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）提出改进的机器遗忘方法EMDU，修复MDU的两大失效模式，在TOFU/RWKU上实现更强遗忘并更好保留通用能力。
AI.motivation: MDLM已进入实际部署阶段，需要机器遗忘以移除敏感、受版权或受限内容的影响而无需重训。首个公开的MDLM遗忘方法MDU（最小化anchor-last散度KL(p_θ‖p_anchor)）存在两个失效模式：(1) 随机答案掩码可能使关键遗忘token仍对anchor可见；(2) 在记忆化（近one-hot）预测处，anchor-last散度的logit梯度消失而anchor-first散度不消失，导致最需遗忘的token训练停滞。
AI.method: 提出Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning (EMDU)：对完全掩蔽整个答案跨度的冻结anchor，采用anchor-first KL散度KL(p_anchor‖p_θ)进行优化，并由理论与实证分析支撑其相对于MDU的梯度优势。
AI.result: 在TOFU与RWKU基准、LLaDA-8B与Dream-7B模型上，EMDU的遗忘效果达到或超过MDU及适配的自回归基线，同时更好地保留retain效用。
AI.conclusion: EMDU通过anchor-first散度与全答案跨度掩蔽，克服了MDU在关键遗忘token上的梯度消失与掩码泄漏问题，为掩码扩散语言模型提供了更有效且对保留能力更友好的遗忘方案。

title: Towards More Granular Reasoning: Mapping the DSA Transparency Database Taxonomy to Platform Terms and Conditions Using Large Language Models
summary: Article 24(5) of the Digital Services Act (DSA) requires providers of online platforms to submit every content moderation decision they make, with a corresponding Statement of Reasons (SoR), to the DSA Transparency Database (DSA-TDB). Such decisions are classified against seventeen high-level attribute categories that categorize the primary reason for the moderation decision. Because over 99.8% of statements cite a violation of the provider's own terms and conditions rather than a legal provision, the database is overwhelmingly a record of contractual enforcement using catch-all reporting; however, whether its categories actually describe those contractual rules well has not been examined. In this paper, we map the terms and conditions (T&C) of 31 designated online services against the DSA-TDB's high-level category taxonomy using a few-shot GPT-4.1 classifier over 447 policy documents. The analysis concerns how T&C rules are represented in the taxonomy, not how they are enforced. Two findings emerge. First, high-level category applicability varies sharply by service type: unsafe products account for 17.5% of e-commerce assignments and 0.2% of adult-platform assignments, and negative effects on civic discourse reaches 9.9% within the Meta family but is absent from adult platforms, Booking.com, and Wikipedia. Second, the categories have notable overlap among sub-category specifications, which makes assigning a single high-level category to a decision difficult. We argue that catch-all reporting is plausibly in part a consequence of the DSA-TDB's schema and attribute design, and recommend a schema that is differentiated by service type with more mandatory attributes derived inductively from platform governance language.

AI.tldr: 该文将31个指定在线服务的条款与条件映射到DSA透明度数据库的17个高层分类上，发现类别适用性随服务类型差异显著，且子类别规范存在明显重叠，认为"兜底式报告"部分源于数据库schema设计缺陷。
AI.motivation: DSA第24(5)条要求平台就每项内容审核决定向DSA透明度数据库提交理由声明，但超过99.8%的声明引用的是平台自身条款而非法律规定，使数据库实质上成为合同执行的记录。然而，现有分类体系能否恰当描述这些合同规则尚未被检验，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对31个指定在线服务的447份政策文件，采用few-shot GPT-4.1分类器将T&C规则映射至DSA-TDB的高层类别taxonomy；分析聚焦于T&C规则在分类体系中的表征方式，而非执行情况。
AI.result: 两项发现：(1) 高层类别适用性随服务类型急剧变化——不安全产品占电商类分配的17.5%、成人平台仅0.2%；对公民话语的负面影响在Meta系中达9.9%，而在成人平台、Booking.com与Wikipedia中完全缺失。(2) 各子类别规范之间存在显著重叠，导致难以将单一决定归入唯一高层类别。
AI.conclusion: "兜底式报告"在一定程度上可归因于DSA-TDB的schema与属性设计。作者建议采用按服务类型区分的schema，并从平台治理语言中归纳出更多强制性属性。

title: Semi-supervised learning on singular data sets
summary: We propose to model singular data clouds by subanalytic sets, and develop an approach to semi-supervised learning in this setting. It relies on a Morrey-type embedding for Sobolev spaces relative to globally subanalytic measures with possibly singular support. As an illustration, we present a greedy method based on a Monte Carlo approximation of the Sobolev norm of the candidate solutions. We report numerical experiments on point clouds sampled from real algebraic varieties, as well as a test on a classification problem based on MNIST images downsampled into $7\times7$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用子解析集（subanalytic sets）对奇异数据云建模，并在此框架下发展半监督学习方法，核心工具是针对以全局子解析测度（支撑可奇异）为基准的Sobolev空间的Morrey型嵌入定理，并给出基于Sobolev范数Monte Carlo近似的贪心算法。
AI.motivation: 真实数据云往往具有奇异结构（如集中在低维代数簇上、分布不满足常规密度假设），经典基于光滑流形或绝对连续测度的半监督学习理论难以适用，因此需要一个能刻画奇异支撑的几何测度框架。
AI.method: 以全局子解析集建模数据云，研究相对于全局子解析测度的Sobolev空间，建立Morrey型嵌入定理；据此设计半监督学习目标，并用候选解Sobolev范数的Monte Carlo近似实现贪心算法。
AI.result: 在由实代数簇采样的点云上进行数值实验，并在一项将MNIST图像降采样为7×7的分类任务上测试，验证了方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 子解析几何与相应Sobolev嵌入为奇异数据云上的半监督学习提供了理论可行的框架，且可转化为实用的贪心算法。

title: CoRS: Fast Neural Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling via Composite Interval State Reuse
summary: Neural solvers for the Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) typically refresh graph representations and update feasibility after every operation--machine decision. However, only feasibility must remain exact at every step, whereas graph encoding is substantially more expensive and can potentially be refreshed less frequently. We present CoRS, which decouples them: an interval-level graph representation is reused across multiple sequential decisions, while a stepwise feasibility state is updated after every action. This two-timescale design amortizes graph encoding without parallelizing action generation or relaxing scheduling constraints. CoRS further develops a feasibility-preserving composite-interval decoding scheme with dynamic constraint tracking and boundary state synchronization, which reduces representation refresh frequency while maintaining continuous feasible schedule construction. Furthermore, to alleviate representation staleness caused by interval-level state reuse, CoRS introduces enhanced static features as a compensation mechanism. By providing more comprehensive structural information of the scheduling problem, these features improve the model's perception of overall problem characteristics. Extensive experiments on synthetic and multiple public FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that CoRS significantly reduces inference time while maintaining competitive solution quality, achieving favorable speed-quality trade-offs under tight wall-clock budgets and low-latency scenarios.

AI.tldr: CoRS 将图编码与可行性更新解耦为双时间尺度：区间级图表示复用、步级可行性状态逐步更新，从而在不并行化动作生成、不放松约束的前提下摊销图编码开销，实现更优的速度-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有 FJSP 神经求解器在每个"工序-机器"决策后都刷新图表示并更新可行性，但每一步真正必须精确的只有可行性，图编码代价高昂且可低频刷新，二者被不必要地绑定，导致推理开销大。
AI.method: 提出 CoRS：区间级图表示在多次连续决策间复用，步级可行性状态每步更新；设计保可行性的复合区间解码方案，含动态约束跟踪与边界状态同步，以降低刷新频率同时保证连续可行调度构建；并引入增强静态特征作为区间级状态复用所致表示陈旧性的补偿机制，提升模型对问题整体结构的感知。
AI.result: 在合成数据与多个公开 FJSP 基准上，CoRS 在保持有竞争力解质量的同时显著降低推理时间，在紧墙钟预算与低延迟场景下获得有利的速度-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦图编码与可行性更新，低频图表示复用是降低 FJSP 神经求解器推理成本的有效途径，配合复合区间解码与增强静态特征可在不牺牲解质量的情况下提升效率。

title: Near-Optimal Last-Iterate Convergence of SGD in the Smooth Interpolation Regime
summary: We study the last iterate of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with a constant stepsize on smooth convex objectives in the low-noise and interpolation regimes, where the variance $σ_\star^2$ of the stochastic gradients at the optimum is small or zero. We establish that after $T$ steps of SGD on $β$-smooth convex losses with any constant stepsize $0<η<2/β$, the last iterate attains expected excess risk $\widetilde O\bigl(\tfrac{1}{η(2-βη)^3T}+\tfracη{(2-βη)^4}σ_\star^2\bigr)$, which gives the rate $\smash{\widetilde O(1/T)}$ for every constant stepsize in the interpolation regime ($σ_\star=0$), matching the $Ω(1/T)$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors and improving upon the $O(1/\sqrt T)$ rate of Attia et al. (2026) for $η=1/β$. Our analysis is based on a new technique, which compares the second moments of the stochastic gradients along the SGD trajectory across only logarithmically many time scales. For quadratic losses in the interpolation regime, an adaptation of this technique gives an $O(1/T)$ rate for every constant stepsize, extending the recent optimal rate for the randomized Kaczmarz method of Derezinski and Dong (2026) to stepsizes above the greedy stepsize with an arguably simpler proof.

AI.tldr: 本文研究常步长SGD在光滑凸目标、低噪声与插值（interpolation）情形下最后一次迭代的收敛性，证明对任意常步长0<η<2/β均可达到Õ(1/T)的期望超额风险，突破此前O(1/√T)的结果。
AI.motivation: 既有工作对常步长SGD最后一次迭代的分析多给出O(1/√T)速率，尤其在步长η=1/β时（Attia et al., 2026），与Ω(1/T)下界存在差距；因此需要在插值/低噪声条件下刻画更紧的收敛速率。
AI.method: 提出一种新技术：仅在O(log)个时间尺度上比较SGD轨迹上随机梯度二阶矩；据此对β-光滑凸损失给出显式界Õ(1/(η(2-βη)^3T)+ησ_⋆^2/(2-βη)^4)；并将该技术适配到二次损失，扩展随机Kaczmarz的最优速率至贪心步长以上的步长范围。
AI.result: 对任意常步长0<η<2/β，最后一次迭代期望超额风险为Õ(1/(η(2-βη)^3T)+ησ_⋆^2/(2-βη)^4)；插值情形(σ_⋆=0)下对所有常步长均得Õ(1/T)，与Ω(1/T)下界相差仅对数因子；较η=1/β时的O(1/√T)有改进；二次损失插值情形亦得O(1/T)，且证明更简洁。
AI.conclusion: 常步长SGD的最后一次迭代在插值/低噪声情形可达近乎最优的Õ(1/T)速率，且对步长选择稳健；多时间尺度二阶矩比较技术为分析最后一次迭代提供了有效工具。

title: Machina Pauliana: A neuro-symbolic approach to the actio pauliana in Dutch insolvency law
summary: Applying a legal provision frequently requires both structured rule-based reasoning and sensitivity to open-textured terms developed in case law. The actio pauliana of Article 42 of the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet, Fw), which allows an insolvency practitioner to avoid transactions that prejudice creditors, requires both. We present a neuro-symbolic model of Article 42 Fw. Its symbolic core is written in Catala in a literate style that keeps statute and formalisation aligned and was developed through pair programming, with open-textured terms represented as boolean inputs where neural components couple to the symbolic solver. A neural routine structures a case's natural-language facts into boolean and date inputs. Neural subroutines resolve the open-textured terms through case-based reasoning over Dutch civil judgments, retrieved through a pipeline that filters on the requirement being resolved and expands along the procedural chain of a case. Segmenting and labelling those judgments attains high precision and recall against a manually annotated gold standard of 100 judgments. On ten hand-annotated cases the neuro-symbolic model handles most criteria reasonably but struggles with the knowledge requirement. Retrieval depth shows no clear quantitative effect, although retrieved judgments provide explicit grounding in prior case law.

AI.tldr: 该文提出荷兰破产法第42条（actio pauliana）的神经符号模型：Catala 编写的符号核心+神经网络处理开放纹理概念与事实结构化，检索基于判例的类案推理提供语义接地。
AI.motivation: 法律条文适用既需结构化规则推理，又需对判例发展出的开放纹理术语保持敏感性；第42条Fw兼有二者需求，是检验神经符号方法的合适对象。
AI.method: 以 literate 风格用 Catala 编写符号核心（成文法与形式化保持对齐，结对编程开发）；开放纹理术语表示为布尔输入，由神经子程序通过荷兰民事判决的类案推理求解；检索管线按待解决的构成要件过滤并沿案件程序链扩展；神经网络例程将自然语言事实结构化为布尔与日期输入。
AI.result: 对100份人工标注金标准判决的分段与标注达到高精确率与召回率；在10个手工标注案件上，模型对多数要件处理合理，但在"知情要件"（knowledge requirement）上表现欠佳；检索深度无明确量化效应，但检索到的判决为先前判例法提供了显式接地。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号方法可有效形式化并适用含开放纹理概念的法律条文，检索增强的类案推理提供可解释接地；未来需改进知情要件的建模，并进一步量化检索深度的影响。

title: Consistent LLM Call Handling Across Java Frameworks: A Reference Implementation and Benchmark
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, 1 listing. Code and data: https://github.com/alxkm/llm-call-guard
summary: Java applications reach large language models (LLMs) through an integration framework, and rely on it to handle a failing provider: to retry what can be retried and nothing else, to wait as long as the provider asks, never to present a truncated answer as complete, and to record each failure in the application's metrics. We state these expectations as a six-clause reliability contract and measure Spring AI 2.0.1 and LangChain4j 1.21.0 against it with a scripted OpenAI-compatible provider: fifteen failure scenarios, synchronous and streaming, three repetitions. LangChain4j meets it in 47 of 77 applicable cases with its defaults and in 51 of 83 when configured explicitly, Spring AI in 72 of 77 and 76 of 83; both deliver a stream that ended without its terminator as a complete answer. We then place one implementation of the contract beneath both frameworks, at the HTTP boundary - an OkHttp interceptor for Spring AI, an HttpClient for LangChain4j, and a java.net.http transport for code without a framework - sharing a 725-line core that depends only on the JDK and the Micrometer Observation API. With it, all three clients behave identically and meet the contract in 90 of 91 cases; the remaining case is a policy trade-off between retrying a hung provider and waiting for a slow first token. Against a local model server the layer rejected none of 700 calls, and it adds a median of 32-217 microseconds to a call.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM集成的六条款可靠性契约，评测Spring AI 2.0.1与LangChain4j 1.21.0均未完全满足，并在HTTP边界实现共享核心层，使三类客户端行为一致并在91个场景中满足90个。
AI.motivation: Java应用通过集成框架访问LLM并依赖其处理provider故障（可重试则重试、按指示等待、不把截断答案当作完整、记录指标），但这些期望未被明确规范，框架实际落实情况未知。
AI.method: 将期望形式化为六条款可靠性契约；用脚本化的OpenAI兼容provider对Spring AI 2.0.1和LangChain4j 1.21.0进行15种失败场景、同步与流式、3次重复的测试；随后在HTTP边界为两框架及无框架代码放置同一契约实现（OkHttp拦截器、HttpClient、java.net.http传输），共享依赖仅JDK与Micrometer Observation API的725行核心。
AI.result: LangChain4j默认配置满足47/77，显式配置后51/83；Spring AI为72/77和76/83；两者均将缺少终止符的流当作完整答案交付。加入共享层后三个客户端行为一致，满足90/91案例，剩余一例为"重试挂起provider"与"等待慢速首token"间的策略权衡；对本地模型服务器700次调用零误拒，中位开销32–217微秒。
AI.conclusion: 现有Java LLM框架的故障处理可靠性不足且行为不一致，在HTTP边界共享实现可靠性契约可统一并近乎完全满足契约，同时开销可忽略。

title: Beyond Static Leaderboards: Capability-Focused Evaluation with Structural Diversity for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Static public benchmarks for time series foundation models (TSFMs) typically have fixed and narrow test distributions. Their repeated reuse encourages benchmark-specific tuning, making reported performance reflect adaptation to the fixed test set rather than genuine forecasting generalization. In addition, a single aggregate score cannot fully characterize model capabilities across distinct temporal structures and input relationships. We propose CaFE (Capability-Focused Evaluation), a refreshable evaluation extension grounded in original benchmark data that enriches static benchmarks with structural diversity and enriches single-score black-box evaluation with multi-dimensional, capability-oriented assessment. CaFE first profiles the original benchmark and defines eight Structural Features (SFs) that characterize its temporal structure. For each SF, it resamples the original data according to its structural support, removes edge-of-distribution samples, and augments the retained samples by varying the SF's salience, producing samples with different structural profiles. After filtering out out-of-distribution samples while preserving diversity, CaFE yields a refreshed evaluation set. TSFMs are then evaluated on this set using both conventional forecast-error metrics and intervention-response metrics, giving each model a per-feature capability profile alongside endpoint accuracy. Experiments on GIFT-Eval and FEV-Mini20 show that CaFE yields stable evaluation results and reveals per-feature strengths and weaknesses that a single aggregate score hides. Moreover, on genuine data filtered by structural condition, models selected by CaFE outperform those chosen by the aggregate leaderboard. CaFE therefore makes model selection conditional on the structural response of interest.

AI.tldr: 提出CaFE（Capability-Focused Evaluation），一种基于原始基准数据、可刷新的评测扩展框架，通过八种结构特征（SFs）重采样、去边缘样本、增广与分布过滤生成刷新评测集，并结合预测误差与干预响应指标给出逐特征能力画像。在GIFT-Eval与FEV-Mini20上结果稳定，能揭示单一总分掩盖的强弱项，且按CaFE选出的模型在真实数据上优于按总榜选出的模型。
AI.motivation: 静态公开基准的测试分布固定且狭窄，反复复用会诱发针对基准的调参，使报告性能反映对固定测试集的适配而非真实泛化；此外单一聚合分数无法刻画模型在不同时间结构与输入关系下的能力差异。
AI.method: CaFE先对原始基准做画像并定义八种结构特征（SFs）刻画其时间结构；针对每个SF按其结构支撑重采样原始数据，剔除分布边缘样本，并通过改变该SF的显著性（salience）增广保留样本，得到不同结构剖面的样本；在保留多样性的前提下过滤掉分布外样本，形成刷新评测集；随后用传统预测误差指标与干预响应指标双重评估TSFM，得到逐特征能力画像与端点精度。
AI.result: 在GIFT-Eval与FEV-Mini20上，CaFE评测结果稳定，并揭示出单一聚合分数所掩盖的逐特征优势与劣势；在按结构条件过滤的真实数据上，CaFE选出的模型优于聚合排行榜选出的模型。
AI.conclusion: CaFE使模型选择以所关注的结构响应为条件，缓解静态基准复用带来的过拟合与评估失真的问题，将单分数黑箱评测扩展为多维、面向能力的评估。

title: Probabilistic Limit Order Book Forecasting with Conditional Diffusion Models
summary: Modeling limit order book (LOB) dynamics is central to market forecasting and execution-strategy evaluation. While diffusion models achieve strong empirical performance, existing LOB snapshot models typically lack a learned recurrent encoder and formal statistical guarantees. We introduce LOBGrad, a conditional DDPM framework for probabilistic LOB forecasting that combines an autoregressive RNN encoder with a diffusion-based generator. In particular, we establish an excess-risk oracle inequality for the one-step DDPM noise-prediction objective under exponential mixing and regularity assumptions. We further show that, under contractive dynamics, the dependence on the conditioning-window length can be reduced to a dependence on the latent-state dimension. Experiments on BTC/USDT, GOOGL, and META show that LOBGrad improves on its encoder-free diffusion ablation across all reported queue metrics and obtains competitive results against other baselines. It also reproduces the key stylized facts of LOB microstructure, and yields reasonably calibrated queue-based predictive intervals. A stylized downstream task illustrates the potential value of the generated forecasts.

AI.tldr: 提出 LOBGrad：结合自回归 RNN 编码器与 DDPM 生成器的条件扩散框架，用于限价订单簿（LOB）概率化预测，并给出一部噪声预测目标的超额风险 oracle 不等式；实验在 BTC/USDT、GOOGL、META 上优于无编码器扩散消融并具备竞争力。
AI.motivation: LOB 动态建模对市场预测与执行策略评估至关重要；现有扩散式 LOB 快照模型通常缺少可学习的循环编码器，且缺乏形式化统计保证。
AI.method: 条件 DDPM 框架：自回归 RNN 编码器 + 扩散生成器。在指数混合与正则性假设下，为一步 DDPM 噪声预测目标建立超额风险 oracle 不等式；进一步证明在收缩动态下，对条件窗口长度的依赖可转化为对潜状态维度的依赖。实验含无编码器扩散消融与多基线对比，并检验风格化事实与队列型预测区间校准。
AI.result: 在 BTC/USDT、GOOGL、META 上，所有报告的队列指标均优于无编码器扩散消融，对其他基线具竞争力；能重现 LOB 微观结构的关键风格化事实，队列型预测区间校准合理；下游任务示例显示生成预测的潜在价值。
AI.conclusion: LOBGrad 将循环编码与扩散生成统一，并在理论与实证两方面提升了 LOB 概率预测的可解释性与可靠性，可作为执行策略评估与下游决策的有效工具。

title: LOCU: Lowdin-Orthogonalized Constraint Updates for Multi-Constraint Policy Optimization
summary: We investigate multi-constraint policy optimization in constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs), where interactions among constraint gradients often yield ill-conditioned update directions, causing numerically fragile steps and unintended cancellation or redundant overlap in constraint corrections. To address this, we propose LOCU, which mitigates numerical instability arising from constraint interactions by applying symmetric Lowdin orthogonalization to the natural gradients of the reward and constraints under the Fisher-Rao metric. Combined with Fisher-geometric screening and near-collinear compression, LOCU yields a compact reduced space in which the trust region becomes a Euclidean ball and constraints are handled symmetrically through a low-dimensional active-set solve. For infeasible iterates, LOCU constructs a Pareto-descent direction which preserves the local feasibility of satisfied constraints within the same reduced formulation. Experiments show that LOCU remains stable under high constraint coupling, narrow feasible regions, and infeasible starts, and generalizes across different cost critic architectures.

AI.tldr: LOCU：用对称Löwdin正交化在Fisher-Rao度量下处理多约束策略优化中约束梯度相互干扰导致的病态更新，实现数值稳定的CMDP求解。
AI.motivation: 在约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP)的多约束策略优化中，多个约束梯度之间相互耦合会产生病态的更新方向，导致数值上脆弱的步长、约束修正的意外抵消或冗余重叠。现有方法缺乏对约束间几何交互的对称化处理。
AI.method: LOCU对奖励梯度与各约束梯度的自然梯度，在Fisher-Rao度量下施加对称Löwdin正交化，消除约束间耦合引起的病态；结合Fisher几何筛选与近共线压缩，得到紧凑的降维子空间，使信赖域化为欧氏球，约束通过低维活跃集(active-set)求解被对称处理；对不可行迭代点，在同一降维框架内构造Pareto下降方向，同时保持已满足约束的局部可行性。
AI.result: 实验表明LOCU在高约束耦合、窄可行域以及不可行初始点等场景下保持稳定，并可跨不同cost critic架构泛化。
AI.conclusion: 通过Fisher-Rao度量下的对称正交化与降维活跃集求解，LOCU有效缓解多约束交互带来的数值不稳定性，为CMDP多约束策略优化提供稳定且通用的框架。

title: Steered Not Stirred: Effective Reward Tilting using Surrogate Reward Mixing
summary: Continuous-time generative models, from diffusion models, flow matching, and now flow maps, owe their practical value to high-fidelity generation and steerability. In many applications, a ground-truth latent ``oracle'' reward $R^*$ is unavailable or expensive to evaluate, e.g., human judgments or experimental measurements. Although the oracle reward is not directly observable, it can often be approximated through multiple cheaper surrogates that, individually, provide incomplete characterizations but collectively reveal substantial information about the downstream task. In this paper, we present a method for composing such surrogates to steer a pretrained model toward the distribution tilted by an unavailable $R^*$. Given a small feedback set of oracle rankings or numerical rewards, we introduce Mixing And Reward Tilting for INference-time Improvement (MARTINI), which learns a surrogate composition for plug-and-play use with standard inference-time steering methods. Our theory characterizes surrogate information limits and relates population recovery error to ideal-target KL at small tilt strength. For preferences, the bound additionally accounts for an irreducible mismatch between the Plackett-Luce population target and the conditional mean. Experiments demonstrate improved oracle-tilt fidelity in language generation and ImageNet alignment, and improved joint pose accuracy and validity in protein-ligand cofolding, without inference-time oracle queries.

AI.tldr: 提出MARTINI，通过学习多个廉价代理奖励的组合，使预训练连续时间生成模型在推理时偏向不可得的oracle奖励分布，无需推理时查询oracle。
AI.motivation: 许多应用中真值潜在oracle奖励R*不可观测或代价高昂（如人类判断、实验测量）；但存在多个更廉价、单独不完备的代理奖励，可组合起来揭示下游任务信息。目标是利用少量oracle反馈实现可靠奖励倾斜。
AI.method: 给定小规模oracle排序或数值奖励反馈集，学习一个代理奖励组合（surrogate composition），可即插即用地配合标准推理时引导方法（适用于diffusion、flow matching、flow maps）。理论刻画代理信息极限，并将种群恢复误差与小幅倾斜强度下理想目标KL联系起来；对偏好场景，界中额外计入Plackett-Luce种群目标与条件均值间的不可约失配。
AI.result: 实验显示在语言生成与ImageNet对齐上oracle倾斜保真度提升；在蛋白质-配体共折叠中联合位姿精度与合法性提升，且推理时无需oracle查询。
AI.conclusion: 代理奖励组合可在无推理时oracle访问条件下有效近似oracle倾斜分布，为连续时间生成模型提供实用、可解释的推理时改进方案。

title: REFLEX: RNA Ensemble Generation via Flexibility-Calibrated Stochastic Bridge
summary: RNA molecules often function through multiple experimentally observed conformational states. A central challenge is to capture ensemble diversity without sacrificing structural fidelity: samples may collapse toward averaged representative structures or drift into unsupported conformational regions. We introduce REFLEX (RNA Ensemble generation calibrated by FLEXibility), a sequence-conditioned generator for RNA backbone-frame ensembles based on a heteroscedastic stochastic bridge on SE(3). During training, experimental B-factors calibrate residue-wise bridge widths, exposing each observed conformer through local perturbation neighborhoods with residue-specific scales while keeping constrained regions sharper. A learned flexibility condition guides the bridge-field network to recover target conformer-specific frames from these calibrated noisy states. At inference, REFLEX uses only the input sequence, requiring no MSA-subsampling heuristics. On a multi-conformer RNA benchmark, REFLEX achieves the best precision-recall trade-off for ensemble coverage across evaluation thresholds, while recovery-stress ablations indicate gains in target-frame recovery under stronger perturbations.

AI.tldr: REFLEX 是序列条件下的 RNA 骨架坐标系集合生成器，基于 SE(3) 上的异方差随机桥，用实验 B 因子标定桥宽，推理时仅需序列即可生成覆盖度与结构保真兼顾的构象集合。
AI.motivation: RNA 通过多种构象状态行使功能，现有生成方法难以兼顾集合多样性与结构保真：样本要么塌缩到平均代表结构，要么漂移到无实验支持的构象区域；同时常依赖 MSA 子采样等启发式。
AI.method: 在 SE(3) 上构建异方差随机桥，训练时以实验 B 因子标定逐残基桥宽，将每个观测构象通过残基特异尺度的局部扰动邻域呈现，约束区保持更锐利分布；学习到的柔性条件引导桥场网络从标定噪声态恢复目标构象特异坐标系；推理阶段仅用输入序列。
AI.result: 在多构象 RNA 基准上，各评估阈值下取得覆盖率最优的精度-召回权衡；恢复-应力消融显示在更强扰动下目标坐标系恢复性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 以实验柔性信息校准的随机桥生成框架可在无需 MSA 启发式的条件下有效刻画 RNA 构象集合的多样性与保真度。

title: KPI-Aware Multimodal Anomaly Detection for 5G and Open RAN Telemetry
comment: Accepted at the IEEE ICDM 2026 Applied Research Track
summary: Reliable anomaly detection is a deployment bottleneck for 5G/Open RAN observability and emerging self-optimizing 6G systems, where hundreds of heterogeneous KPIs, severe class imbalance, and strict alert budgets make purely numerical scores brittle. We present KAC, a deployment-oriented KPI-aware multimodal anomaly-detection framework that uses KPI-level residual-text alignment to turn compact operator-style summaries into a learnable feedback signal over full-KPI temporal evidence. This gives the detector broad numerical coverage like modern time-series models, while retaining the sparse KPI-specific reasoning that makes operator feedback sustainable in a future operator-facing workflow. Across public telecom telemetry, enterprise-scale Open RAN observability data, and a Nokia benchmark built from real 5G RAN production packet traces with realism-hardened injected anomalies, KAC achieves strong threshold-based detection performance while remaining competitive on threshold-free ranking metrics. On TelecomTS, at a fixed 2.5 percent false-positive-rate operating point, KAC achieves the highest recall among the evaluated residual-based methods while maintaining comparable precision; across the evaluated benchmarks, it remains robust under substantial class imbalance. KAC is integrated in pre-production shadow mode with Nokia's GKE-based KPI construction pipeline, where it continuously scores telemetry windows alongside an internal packet-level anomaly detector for operational evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出KAC:面向部署的KPI感知多模态异常检测框架,通过KPI级残差-文本对齐,将精简的运营商式摘要作为对全KPI时序证据的可学习反馈信号,在电信遥测与Open RAN数据上实现强阈值检测性能并保持排序指标竞争力,已进入与Nokia KPI管线的影子模式部署。
AI.motivation: 5G/Open RAN可观测性与6G自优化系统部署中,异常检测面临数百个异构KPI、严重类别不平衡与严格告警预算,纯数值评分脆弱;同时需保留使运营反馈可持续的稀疏、KPI特异的推理能力。
AI.method: KAC框架采用KPI级残差-文本对齐:以紧凑的运营商风格摘要为文本侧,对齐到全KPI时序证据的残差表示,形成可学习的反馈信号;从而兼具类现代时序模型的宽数值覆盖与运营可解释的稀疏推理。
AI.result: 在公开电信遥测、企业级Open RAN可观测数据及基于真实5G RAN生产数据包轨迹(注入真实化异常)的Nokia基准上,KAC阈值检测性能强、无阈值排序指标具竞争力;TelecomTS在2.5%固定FPR下,recall为所评估残差类方法最高且precision相当;在显著类别不平衡下保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: KAC已集成于Nokia基于GKE的KPI构建管线,以预生产影子模式持续评分遥测窗口,并与内部包级异常检测器并行进行运营评估,表明其具备面向实际部署的可行性。

title: Dynamics-Aligned Representation Learning under Induced Partial Observability
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has enabled sample-efficient learning of continuous control policies from high-dimensional observations through learned latent dynamics models. These models are typically trained with observation reconstruction objectives, which provide strong supervision but can bias representations toward visual fidelity leading to an undertrained prior and unreliable long-horizon predictions. We propose a stochastic gating mechanism that induces controlled partial observability during training by sampling a spatial binary mask from a Beta--Bernoulli random field and applying it to the raw observation. The gate probability is resampled at each time step, exposing the encoder to conditions ranging from near-total occlusion to near-full visibility. Integration of our method requires minimal architectural changes from existing dynamics models: the gated observation and the binary mask are channel-wise concatenated and passed to the encoder as a single augmented input, with no modifications to the broader training pipeline. We evaluate the proposed approach on a set of pixel-based continuous control tasks selected from the DeepMind Control Suite. Using model predictive control for evaluation, which relies solely on open-loop model rollouts, we show that stochastic gating improves planning performance and data efficiency across tasks. Further analysis demonstrates that performance is robust to the spatial scale of the mask, and a balanced observability during training outperforms configurations biased toward either sparser or denser observations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种随机门控机制，在训练时对原始观测施加Beta–Bernoulli随机场采样的空间二值掩码，制造受控部分可观测性，从而改善基于模型的强化学习中隐动力学模型的表示与长期预测，提升规划性能与数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有MBRL的隐动力学模型多以观测重建为目标训练，监督信号强但会使表示偏向视觉保真度，导致先验训练不充分、长期预测不可靠。
AI.method: 从Beta–Bernoulli随机场采样空间二值掩码并作用于原始观测，每步重采样门控概率，使编码器经历从近乎全遮挡到近乎全可见的输入；将门控观测与二值掩码按通道拼接作为单一增强输入送编码器，无需改动整体训练流程。
AI.result: 在DeepMind Control Suite的像素连续控制任务上，仅用开环模型推演的模型预测控制（MPC）评估，随机门控在多个任务上提升规划性能与数据效率；性能对掩码空间尺度稳健，且训练中均衡的可观测性优于偏稀疏或偏稠密配置。
AI.conclusion: 通过在训练中引入受控的部分可观测性，可缓解重建目标带来的表示偏差，简单且低侵入地提升MBRL的模型质量与规划表现。

title: Selective Transfer through Sequence Distillation: From Benchmark Knowledge to Backdoor Behaviour
summary: Knowledge distillation is widely used to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models, but recent work shows that it can also transfer unintended teacher properties. We study whether different hidden teacher properties survive the same distillation channels. Specifically, we compare two properties: benchmark-associated knowledge and refusal backdoors, and show that distillation treats them very differently. Teachers fine-tuned on benchmark data successfully pass that knowledge to students through all four distillation channels we test, including when students are trained only on teacher-generated number sequences containing no natural language or domain content whatsoever. Refusal backdoors tell the opposite story: backdoored teachers achieve near-perfect triggered refusal, yet sequence-distilled students inherit essentially none of this behaviour. Logit-based distillation transfers it substantially, reaching up to 85.5\% triggered refusal in students that saw zero backdoor examples. Distillation is therefore selective, and the selection criterion is not what data the student sees, but what structure the teacher's property has. The code is available at https://github.com/MJonibek/kd-leakage.

AI.tldr: 知识蒸馏对不同隐藏属性具有选择性：基准相关知识与拒绝后门在相同蒸馏信道下的迁移表现截然不同，选择标准取决于教师属性的结构而非学生所见数据。
AI.motivation: 已有研究显示蒸馏会迁移教师非预期的隐藏属性，但尚不清楚不同属性在同一蒸馏信道下是否能同样存活，需系统比较不同性质属性的迁移差异。
AI.method: 对比两类属性：基准数据微调获得的领域知识，与植入的拒绝后门。在四种蒸馏信道上训练学生模型，包括仅用教师生成的无自然语言、无领域内容的数字序列进行训练，以及基于logit的蒸馏。
AI.result: 基准知识可通过全部四种信道迁移给学生，即使在纯净数字序列上蒸馏亦然；拒绝后门则几乎不迁移：序列蒸馏学生几乎无触发拒绝行为，而logit蒸馏可迁移至多85.5%的触发拒绝率，且学生未见过任何后门样本。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏是选择性的，其选择标准不是学生看到的数据，而是教师属性的结构特征；这对蒸馏安全性与知识产权保护具有启示。

title: ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ATEST，一种资源感知的测试时扩展（TTS）框架，联合考虑额外采样的期望收益与当前 GPU 能耗成本，在负载波动下自适应决定采样预算。
AI.motivation: 固定采样预算的 TTS 忽略查询难度差异，也忽略 GPU 竞争导致的推理能耗变化（实测同一四采样查询能耗可增加 4.1 倍），因此需要按查询难度与实时成本动态分配采样预算。
AI.method: ATEST-Online（默认模式）无需离线校准：增量生成样本、估计多数答案稳定性、监测实时 GPU 状况、在线学习单步能耗成本以决定停止时机；ATEST-Calibrated 则用离线精度与成本模型为每个查询选择预算。在 A100 上以 Phi-3-mini 评测四个推理/问答数据集并控制负载，另迁移到 L40S 与 Qwen2.5-3B。
AI.result: 四个 A100 数据集上 ATEST-Online 均在不超过能耗预算下完成所有查询，精度最高或统计上持平，并随负载升高减少采样。GSM8K 高负载下精度 60.0%、零延迟处理，而 ATEST-Calibrated 为 44.0% 且 42.4% 被推迟。消融表明在线成本学习是负载适配的关键。含离线剖析，ATEST-Online 相比 ATEST-Calibrated 少用 42 倍 GPU 时间与 48 倍能耗。
AI.conclusion: 在线控制在负载波动下以更高的尾延迟、短任务吞吐下降换取鲁棒性；在负载稳定场景中离线校准仍具竞争力，两者适用于不同部署条件。

title: StrucChunk: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Legal Document RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can ground LLM outputs in domain-specific knowledge, but legal documents are hard: standard chunking fragments hierarchical argument structure, and generic embeddings struggle with both precise citation matching and semantic understanding. We propose StrucChunk (Structure Aware Chunking) with hybrid dense-sparse retrieval for hierarchically structured legal documents. It treats documents as directed acyclic graphs of provisions, preserves clause boundaries, resolves cross-references before embedding, and combines BM25 with BGE-M3 via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. We evaluate on five corpora, three legal traditions and two languages. StrucChunk reaches 100% boundary precision (vs. 7.7% for recursive splitting on CrPC), preserves 97.6% of documented cross-references (vs. 0%), and matches section coverage with 40.3% fewer chunks on GDPR. On LegalBench-RAG (6,858 query-passage pairs), it achieves Char-Recall@8 of 48.18% vs. 23.59% for the best baseline (+104%), surpassing the published state of the art by +83%. On 501 queries each for CrPC and CPC (Indian law), Recall@5 improves from 0.557 to 0.804 (+44.4%) and from 0.158 to 0.259 (+64.6%); chunking accounts for 88% and 73% of the gain. On 501 GDPR queries, Recall@5 is 0.868 with R@1 improving +59%. On NitiBench-CCL (3,730 Thai financial law queries), HR@5 is 0.856 vs. 0.594 for naive chunking (+44.1%), showing that section-boundary alignment is the dominant factor across languages, and cross-reference augmentation adds +2.3% on cross-reference queries. We release the implementation, 5,256 evaluation queries across five legal corpora, annotation methodology and chunking quality metrics. Code: github.com/SinghSuryaDeep/legal-rag-strucchunk-1

AI.tldr: StrucChunk将法律文档建模为条款DAG，保留条款边界并在嵌入前解析交叉引用，结合BM25与BGE-M3经RRF混合检索；在五个语料、三大法系、两种语言上显著超越基线，字符召回@8提升104%，R@5提升44%–65%，并在泰语金融法语料上验证了条款边界对齐的跨语言主导作用。
AI.motivation: 法律文档检索难度高：标准分块会割裂层级论证结构，通用嵌入既难以精确匹配法条引用，也缺乏语义理解能力；现有RAG方法未针对法律文本的层级结构与交叉引用特性进行建模。
AI.method: 提出StrucChunk结构感知分块：将文档视为条款构成的有向无环图（DAG），保持条款边界，在嵌入前解析交叉引用，并采用RRF融合BM25稀疏检索与BGE-M3稠密检索的混合检索方案。
AI.result: 五个语料、三大法系、两种语言上评测：边界精确率100%（CrPC上递归切分为7.7%）；保留97.6%文档交叉引用（基线0%）；GDPR上以少40.3%分块匹配章节覆盖率；LegalBench-RAG上Char-Recall@8为48.18%（最优基线23.59%，+104%），超已发表SOTA 83%；CrPC与CPC的R@5从0.557→0.804、0.158→0.259（分块贡献88%、73%）；GDPR R@5达0.868，R@1提升59%；NitiBench-CCL上HR@5为0.856 vs 0.594。
AI.conclusion: 条款边界对齐是跨语言检索效果的主导因素，交叉引用增强在引用类查询上额外增益2.3%；工作开源实现、5,256条评测查询、标注方法与分块质量指标。

title: FracTS: Hierarchical and Autoregressive Time Series Generation
summary: Time series are ubiquitous across different domains, and the growing use of synthetic data for privacy-preserving sharing, data augmentation, and stress testing makes time series generation increasingly important. Early generative approaches are predominantly autoregressive, which can suffer from low sample diversity, error accumulation, and difficulty modeling long-range dependencies. In this paper, we introduce FracTS, a hierarchical, coarse-to-fine autoregressive model for multivariate time series generation. Inspired by fractal generative modeling developed for images, FracTS adapts the paradigm from 2D to 1D sequences by learning a multi-scale representation that captures global trajectory structure at coarse scales and local dynamics at fine scales while following the autoregressive nature of time series. In contrast to unstructured images, time series are structured, allowing easy automated or designated temporal feature processing optimized for the model, and global (static) feature extraction describing the instances that generate the corresponding time series in the collection. We incorporate them in the generation process to further improve the generation quality. The design naturally handles multivariate dependencies and improves long-horizon temporal coherence without requiring fixed-length inputs. Experiments on five datasets (two conditional, three unconditional) conducted against seven baselines show that FracTS consistently outperforms baselines across marginal distribution and predictive ML utility, and correlation preservation in the unconditional setting. In particular, the predictive ML utility is averagely improved by 100.0% and 75.0-81.0% for unconditional and conditional time series datasets compared to the best baseline (relative error computed on dataset-averaged raw values). Code is available at: https://github.com/BetterdataLabs/fracts.

AI.tldr: FracTS：面向多变量时间序列生成的层次化、由粗到细自回归模型，借鉴图像分形生成范式，将2D多尺度表示迁移到1D序列，结合时序特征处理与全局静态特征，在多数据集上优于七个基线。
AI.motivation: 合成时间数据在隐私保护共享、数据增强和压力测试中需求增长，而早期以自回归为主的生成方法存在样本多样性低、误差累积、难以建模长程依赖等问题。
AI.method: 提出FracTS，一种层次化粗到细的自回归多变量时间序列生成模型。借鉴图像分形生成建模，将范式由2D图像适配到1D序列：学习多尺度表示，粗尺度捕捉全局轨迹结构、细尺度捕捉局部动态，同时保持时间序列的自回归特性。针对时间序列的结构化特点，引入自动化或指定的时序特征处理，并提取描述实例的全局（静态）特征参与生成。该设计自然处理多变量依赖，提升长时程时间一致性，且不要求定长输入。
AI.result: 在五个数据集（两个条件、三个无条件）上与七个基线对比，FracTS在边缘分布、预测型机器学习效用以及无条件设置下的相关性保持方面均持续优于基线。相对最佳基线，预测型ML效用平均提升100.0%（无条件）与75.0–81.0%（条件），（相对误差基于数据集平均原始值计算）。
AI.conclusion: 将分形式多尺度层次生成与自回归序列建模结合，并辅以时序与全局静态特征，可有效缓解自回归生成的多项缺陷，显著提升多变量时间序列的生成质量与下游实用性。

title: The Control Layer Behind Rule-Following Agents Trading Across Market Conditions
comment: 47 pages, 0 figures, 16 numbered tables. Includes a trading-agent evaluation toolkit and checklist
summary: Trading discipline often fails people. Our study tested whether four AI trading agents followed their strategies and risk rules. Offering traders the evidence and an agent evaluation toolkit to separate luck from following the rules, before giving agents meaningful autonomy or capital. Our study analysed 2,627 closed positions from 12 February to 27 August 2026 across the same asset universe and execution conditions. Most positions were simulated against live prices with a 0.09% round-trip fee; 18% involved real Hyperliquid orders. Each position declared a strategy, stop and target, with a limit of five open positions per agent. The fleet finished net positive after fees. Rule adherence was high across all four agents, including the unprofitable one. Profitability tracked how often agents won relative to their break-even win rates. Institutional-style controls ran by default and contained losses through a 29% market drawdown and recovery, with documented exceptions. The discipline held for all four agents. Agents kept 97.5% of gross loss within declared stops, and typical losses closed at declared levels. Declared risk remained stable after losses and broadly stable across calm and volatile months. Twenty-three of 24 runs respected the position limit; logs identify the exception's size and duration. The same live data produced different results across assigned strategies. The trade-log tests can be rerun from the published trade snapshot; regime tests also require the published Bitcoin prices and regime labels. Section 3.5 specifies the stop-breach tolerance. These trade-level results are not account-level returns or proof of a lasting edge. Our study provides an evaluation toolkit to help traders distinguish rule-following from luck before committing capital. For anyone considering allocating capital to agents to trade, discipline should be the entry test, not the only test.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验四个AI交易代理是否遵守自身策略与风控规则，提出"纪律优先于资金配置"的评估工具包，强调应区分"守规则"与"运气"。
AI.motivation: 交易纪律常常难以被人类执行；在赋予AI代理实质自主权或资金之前，需要证据和评估工具来判断其是否真正遵循规则，而非仅凭盈利结果（可能源于运气）。
AI.method: 分析2026年2月12日至8月27日同一资产集合与执行条件下的2,627个平仓头寸；多数为对实时价格的模拟（0.09%往返手续费），18%为真实Hyperliquid订单；每个头寸须声明策略、止损与目标，每代理最多5个未平仓头寸；采用交易日志检验与市场状态（regime）检验。
AI.result: 组合在扣费后净盈利；四个代理规则遵守度均高（含未盈利者）；97.5%的总亏损保持在声明止损内，典型亏损在声明位平仓；损失后风险水平稳定；24次运行中23次遵守持仓上限（日志记录了例外的大小与时长）；盈利能力与相对盈亏平衡胜率的实际胜率相关；机构式风控在29%市场回撤及恢复中控制住损失。
AI.conclusion: 纪律在四个代理中均得以保持，但交易级结果并非账户级收益，也不能证明持久优势；纪律应作为资金配置的"入门测试"而非唯一测试，并提供了可复现的评估工具包。

title: Reinforcement learning on the EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment benchmark: diagnosing over-commitment and guiding MILP with learned policies
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly proposed as a fast solver for unit commitment (UC), but standalone agents remain far more expensive than mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). In the first study of RL on the 51-generator, 72-hour benchmark of the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition, we trace this gap to the agents' own exploration, close most of it, and show that the resulting policy can accelerate an exact solver. In every configuration tested, Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) and an action-branching Deep Q-Network (DQN) trained from scratch committed about twice the units of a thermal-only MILP optimum, at 39-64% higher cost, whereas a merit-order rule came within 1.6-7% (10-24% when unserved energy is priced). When each unit's decision is sampled independently, spare units insure against random de-commitments. Consistent with this, injecting exploration noise during fine-tuning enlarged a lean policy's fleet, a reward without shaping terms did not remove the over-commitment, and under their training noise the agents outperformed the rule subjected to comparable noise. Imitating the MILP solutions and fine-tuning conservatively brought PPO within 2.6% of the optimum, and these policies had the lowest penalised cost of any evaluated (about 5%). Fixing the fine-tuned policy's confident decisions made the MILP 3.8-8.5 times faster within 0.10-0.25% of the best solution, with a smaller worst case than an imitation-only policy fixing as many variables (1.1% against 8.9%). Because dispatch method and benchmark scope alone shift the reported optimality ratio by up to 3.6% and 9%, we propose a reporting protocol.

AI.tldr: 首次在EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment竞赛的51机72小时基准上研究强化学习求解机组组合(UC)，将RL智能体相对MILP的成本差距主要归因于其自身探索行为，并通过模仿MILP解+保守微调使PPO达到最优解的2.6%以内，再固定其高置信度决策可将MILP加速3.8–8.5倍且解质量损失仅0.10–0.25%。
AI.motivation: RL被视为UC的快速求解器，但独立智能体成本远高于混合整数线性规划(MILP)；作者希望定位这一差距的来源，并探索RL策略如何反过来加速精确求解器。
AI.method: 在EPRI 51机、72小时基准上进行首个RL研究；对比从零训练的PPO与动作分支DQN、热备用only MILP最优解、及按经济调度序(merit-order)规则；做独立采样消融、探索噪声注入、奖励整形消融、模仿学习+保守微调，以及固定高置信度决策变量的MILP加速实验。
AI.result: 从零训练的PPO/DQN在所有配置下多开约两倍机组，成本高39–64%；merit-order规则仅高1.6–7%(计入未供能惩罚为10–24%)。独立采样因备用机组对冲随机停机而助长过度开机；注入探索噪声扩大机组组合，奖励整形无法消除过度开机。模仿MILP并保守微调使PPO逼近最优2.6%，惩罚成本最低(约5%)。固定微调策略的自信决策使MILP快3.8–8.5倍，解差距0.10–0.25%，最坏情况(1.1%)优于同等变量数的纯模仿策略(8.9%)。
AI.conclusion: RL智能体相对MILP的成本差距主要源于训练探索带来的系统性过度开机，可通过模仿+保守微调与决策固定化消除并转化为对精确求解器的加速；调度方法与基准范围本身即可使报告的最优性比变动达3.6%和9%，故文中提出统一报告协议。

title: A Generic On-Board AI Processing Chain for Earth Observation: From Application Development to Embedded Deployment and Mission-Level Orchestration
summary: Earth observation satellites acquire more data than they can downlink. Extracting information on board with artificial intelligence (AI) turns the satellite into a data-reduction stage that downlinks compact products, such as masks or detections, instead of full scenes; deploying it in a mission, however, involves the whole processing chain and not only the neural network. We present a generic on-board AI processing chain along three axes, with wildfire segmentation as the worked example among ship detection and cloud segmentation. (i) The AI model is tuned (spectral-band selection, input normalization), quantized to 8-bit integers (int8) and ported to an AMD Versal VCK190, with its excellent segmentation performance preserved on the board. (ii) A modular tiler-inference-mosaicer workflow, reused unchanged across applications, brings the tile-level model to scene level, turning a full acquisition into a scene-level mask or detection list. (iii) Each step is packaged as a unikernel and orchestrated on board by ORCHIDE, a cloud-native orchestrator. The chain is characterized end to end, from the standalone execution on the target to its execution under orchestration with parallel workflows on a representative test bench. Beyond AI inference on individual tiles, this approach aims at increasing the maturity of on-board AI deployment by addressing a complete processing chain, from the acquired scene to the mission-level execution.

AI.tldr: 提出一条通用的星载AI处理链，以野火分割为例，涵盖模型调优与int8量化并移植到AMD Versal VCK190、模块化分块-推理-拼接工作流、以及基于unikernel与ORCHIDE编排器的星载部署，并给出端到端性能刻画。
AI.motivation: 对地观测卫星获取的数据量超过其下行链路能力。星载AI可将卫星转变为数据缩减级，只下传掩膜、检测结果等紧凑产品而非整景影像。但任务级部署涉及整条处理链而非仅神经网络，现有工作多局限于单块（tile）级推理，缺乏面向完整链路的成熟部署方案。
AI.method: 沿三个维度构建通用星载AI处理链：(i) 模型调优（波段选择、输入归一化）、int8量化并移植至AMD Versal VCK190；(ii) 模块化的分块-推理-拼接（tiler-inference-mosaicer）工作流，跨应用复用，将块级模型提升到景级，输出景级掩膜或检测列表；(iii) 每一步封装为unikernel，由云原生编排器ORCHIDE在轨编排。以野火分割为主要示例，并与船舶检测、云分割并列。
AI.result: 量化与移植后模型在板卡上仍保持良好的分割性能；模块化工作流可跨应用不改动复用并完成景级产品生成；在代表性测试台上完成了从目标平台独立执行到ORCHIDE编排下并行工作流执行的端到端表征。
AI.conclusion: 该方法超越单块AI推理，通过覆盖从获取景到任务级执行的完整处理链，提升了星载AI部署的成熟度，为星上数据缩减产品的工程化落地提供了可复用范式。

title: Beyond the record: evaluating probabilistic AI weather forecasts deep in the tail
summary: Can probabilistic artificial intelligence (AI) weather forecasts retain skill beyond their training domain? We compare four state-of-the-art AI models (ArchesWeatherGen, U-Cast, WeatherNext2 and GenCast-mini) with the physics-based IFS-ENS over land in 2022, at 1.5° resolution and lead times of 2--10 days. Monthly ERA5 records from 1979--2021 define common historical boundaries, and we characterize new records set in 2022 by their depth, i.e., the exceedance margin relative to local historical variability. Two proper scores, record-threshold weighted CRPS and Brier score, assess the magnitude and probability of record exceedances across all eligible cases, retaining both missed extremes and false alarms. Verified against ERA5, AI models outperform IFS-ENS for heat and cold records at almost every lead and depth. For heat, the advantage strengthens with depth, partly because IFS-ENS over-forecasts deep records, and largely persists for deeper records under HRES-fc0 verification. For wind, gains erode for deeper records and longer leads. Better tail scores can nevertheless coexist with aggregate probability deficits or surpluses, and some improvements arise chiefly on non-exceedances. Increasing underprediction on progressively more extreme observed subsets can also arise through outcome selection, even for an ideal conditional-mean forecast. These findings establish that native probabilistic AI ensembles retain, and for heat increase, their advantage over IFS-ENS as thresholds move beyond local records, although all advantages narrow with lead time. They caution against generalizing the extrapolation failure reported for deterministic AI forecasts to probabilistic systems, and motivate common verification conventions that separate comparative tail skill, performance on realized extremes, and probabilistic calibration.

AI.tldr: 论文比较四种前沿概率AI天气预报模型（ArchesWeatherGen、U-Cast、WeatherNext2、GenCast-mini）与物理IFS-ENS在2022年陆地超历史纪录事件上的表现，发现AI模型在热浪与寒潮纪录上几乎各预报时效与深度均优于IFS-ENS，热纪录优势随深度增强，但风纪录优势随深度与时效衰减。
AI.motivation: 既有研究显示确定性AI天气预报在超出训练域（超历史纪录）时存在外推失败，但概率AI集合是否能保留技能尚不清楚，需检验其超越训练分布时的尾部预报能力。
AI.method: 以1979–2021年ERA5月记录界定历史界限，用"深度"（相对局地历史变率的超出幅度）刻画2022年新纪录；在1.5°分辨率、2–10天时效下比较四个AI集合与IFS-ENS，采用两个恰当评分（记录阈值加权CRPS与Brier评分）同时计入漏报极端与虚警，并以ERA5及HRES-fc0进行检验。
AI.result: 对热与冷纪录，AI在几乎所有时效与深度上超过IFS-ENS；热纪录优势随深度增强，部分因IFS-ENS高估深层纪录，且在HRES-fc0检验下深层纪录优势基本保持；风纪录优势随深度增加与时效延长而削弱。更优尾部评分可与总体概率亏缺或盈余并存，部分改进主要来自非超限事件；随观测子集更极端，可因结果选择而出现低估增强，即使对理想条件均值预报亦然。
AI.conclusion: 原生概率AI集合在阈值超出局地纪录时仍保留（热纪录甚至扩大）相对IFS-ENS的优势，但所有优势随时效延长而收窄；不应将确定性AI的外推失败推广至概率系统，并呼吁建立区分尾部相对技能、实现极端事件表现与概率校准的通用检验规范。

title: VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system's performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model's 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 VibeTraining-Bench，用于评估研究型智能体对"训练数据—训练器—推理框架"进行跨组件协同设计（RSI 核心能力）的基准，结果显示前沿智能体可大幅提升目标系统性能但仍未达到人类水平。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求智能体诊断系统瓶颈并协同优化训练与推理各环节，但缺乏统一、可防奖励攻击的评测平台来度量这种跨组件协同设计能力。
AI.method: 构建覆盖终端操作、软件工程、多轮工具调用与数学推理的基准；每个任务中研究智能体从相同初始智能体系统、固定资源预算出发，依据验证反馈迭代改进数据、训练器与推理框架，最后提交系统在测试集评估；通过测试数据隔离、研究与评分容器分离、研究智能体网络受限三重措施防止奖励攻击。
AI.result: 前沿研究智能体显著提升目标系统性能：在 SWE-bench Verified 上 GPT-6-Astra 将目标系统从 32.9% 提升至 53.7%，接近人工开发的 instruct 模型 55.4%。
AI.conclusion: 研究智能体在跨组件协同设计与迭代累积增益方面仍有提升空间；VibeTraining-Bench 可作为推进 RSI 研究的统一平台，深化对智能体系统跨组件优化的理解。

title: FTFM: Factorized Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are becoming a powerful alternative to conventional tabular learning, adapting to new datasets in context without task-specific training. Current architectures, however, face a trade-off: models that preserve cell-level representations are expensive because they repeatedly attend across rows and columns, while faster models collapse each row into a fixed embedding and lose this fine-grained state. We introduce Factorized Tabular Foundation Models (FTFM), which preserve cell representations while factorizing their computation through one contextual latent per row and one per column. Cells no longer attend to one another directly; instead, each cell is updated through the interaction of its row and column latents, reducing repeated attention while retaining feature-specific information. FTFM achieves competitive predictive performance in tabular classification on major benchmarks such as TabArena and BeyondArena.

AI.tldr: FTFM 通过引入行级与列级隐变量对单元格计算进行因子化，在保留单元格级表征的同时降低注意力开销，在 TabArena 和 BeyondArena 上取得有竞争力的分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型（TFM）存在权衡：保留单元格级表征的模型因跨行跨列反复注意力而计算昂贵；快速模型则将整行压缩为固定嵌入，丢失细粒度状态信息。
AI.method: 提出 Factorized Tabular Foundation Models（FTFM），为每一行和每一列各维护一个上下文隐变量，单元格不再彼此直接注意力，而是通过其所属行隐变量与列隐变量的交互进行更新，从而减少重复注意力并保留特征特定信息。
AI.result: 在 TabArena、BeyondArena 等主流表格分类基准上取得有竞争力的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 行/列隐变量因子化是一种在表达力与效率之间取得平衡的有效设计，可在无需任务特定训练的情境学习范式下兼顾单元格级表征与计算效率。

title: CARRS: A Constraint-Aware, Real-Time Routing System for Emergency Vehicles in Urban Environments
summary: Emergency vehicles such as police vehicles, fire engines, and ambulances require a stable and efficient route optimization to reach life-critical events in the shortest times possible. However, the dynamic nature of urban traffic makes this ideal scenario much more challenging, causing critical life-threatening delays. Traditional civilian navigation systems cannot account for real-time traffic changes alongside vehicle-specific constraints, creating inadequate routing scenarios. This research presents the Constraint-Aware Real-Time Routing System (CARRS), a unified software architecture tailored for emergency coordination. The CARRS architecture is engineered to fuse together classical pathfinding algorithms such as A*, Dijkstra, and Bidirectional A*, with Constraint Satisfaction Problem methodologies. The Design Science Research Methodology is the research framework, and prototyping is the iterative process. The artifact was empirically evaluated using OpenStreetMap data for major metropolitan road networks, combined with simulated dynamic traffic scenarios. Performance metrics focused on route optimality, constraint adherence, rerouting responsiveness, and the potential for future system scalability. Findings revealed the system's capability to generate optimal routes for operationally relevant subgraphs in under 35 seconds, with incremental rerouting responsiveness below 20 seconds. Furthermore, the system achieved more than 90% adherence to vehicle-specific constraints, making the CARRS architecture viable for real-time dynamic routing requirements. This study delivers a routing platform that bridges artificial intelligence-driven optimization with software engineering operational compliance, presenting a practical transformative step toward adaptive emergency vehicle coordination in dynamic urban environments.

AI.tldr: 提出面向应急车辆的约束感知实时路径系统CARRS，将A*、Dijkstra、双向A*等经典寻路算法与约束满足问题(CSP)方法融合，在OpenStreetMap城市路网与模拟动态交通下评估，可在35秒内生成最优路径、20秒内完成增量重路由，车辆专用约束满足率超过90%。
AI.motivation: 应急车辆（警车、消防车、救护车）需在最短时间内抵达生命攸关事件现场，但城市交通的动态性导致严重延误；传统民用导航无法同时兼顾实时交通变化与车辆专用约束，导致路径方案不适用。
AI.method: 以设计科学研究方法(DSRM)为框架、原型迭代为过程，构建CARRS统一软件架构：将A*、Dijkstra、双向A*等经典最短路算法与约束满足问题(CSP)方法融合，用以处理车辆专用约束与实时交通；采用OpenStreetMap主要都市路网数据结合模拟动态交通场景进行实证评估，指标为路径最优性、约束遵循度、重路由响应性与可扩展性潜力。
AI.result: 系统可在35秒内为运营相关子图生成最优路径，增量重路由响应低于20秒，车辆专用约束遵循率超过90%，表明该架构可满足实时动态路由需求。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一个衔接AI驱动优化与软件工程运行合规性的路由平台，是迈向动态城市环境下自适应应急车辆协调的实用化步骤；局限在于评估主要基于模拟交通而非真实部署，大规模网络可扩展性仍待验证。

title: GAIDA: Generative AI for Human-in-the-Loop Document Annotation
summary: Document annotation is a fundamental yet labor-intensive step in building document information extraction systems.
