At its core, RSRL builds on three key designs: (1) Rubric-to-Capability Structuring first recovers the capability structure hidden in rubric criteria, (2) Self-Sufficient Capability Learning then uses this structure to bootstrap underdeveloped capabilities into effective learning, (3) Capability-Residual Credit Routing finally preserves capability-specific gains during optimization. Experiments show that RSRL consistently improves both overall performance and underdeveloped capabilities, boosting downstream scientific question-answering performance by up to 7.43 over the initial policy and 7.60 over non-rubric structured RL baselines, showing that reinforcement learning can substantially benefit from the capability structure encoded in rubrics.

AI.tldr: 提出RSRL框架，将评分量表（rubrics）的能力结构贯穿强化学习训练全过程，而非仅作直接奖励信号，显著提升整体与薄弱能力表现。
AI.motivation: Rubrics被广泛用于评估开放式问答，其显式准则蕴含丰富的学习指导信息，但现有方法仅将其作为直接反馈/奖励信号，未显式建模准则背后的能力，导致能力结构未被用于指导训练。
AI.method: RSRL基于三个关键设计：(1) Rubric-to-Capability Structuring，从rubric准则中恢复隐含的能力结构；(2) Self-Sufficient Capability Learning，利用该结构将发展不足的能力 bootstrap 为有效学习；(3) Capability-Residual Credit Routing，在优化过程中保留各能力的特定增益。
AI.result: 实验显示RSRL持续提升整体性能与薄弱能力，下游科学问答性能较初始策略最高提升7.43，较非rubric结构化RL基线最高提升7.60。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习能够显著受益于rubrics中编码的能力结构，rubrics的结构化信息可作为训练指导的有效来源。

title: Statistical Learning Theory for Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) learns from pairwise preferences through a logistic objective whose score-difference parameterization follows the Bradley--Terry model. We study how failure of this modeling assumption limits DPO, distinguishing structural misspecification from limited model capacity and finite-sample estimation. Our main contribution is a characterization of structural approximation error through the triangle-curl of the preference log-odds, which vanishes exactly when preferences admit a Bradley--Terry representation. We upper bound the achievable excess logistic risk by a score-class approximation term and a triangle-curl term, and establish a lower bound proportional to triangle-curl under additional boundedness assumptions. For ReLU score models, including clipped models, we derive explicit approximation rates showing that increasing capacity can eliminate the score-approximation term while leaving the structural obstruction unchanged. We further establish finite-sample bounds for clipped empirical risk minimizers that separate network approximation, structural misspecification, and estimation error. We place these results within a surrogate-risk framework by identifying contextual preference accuracy (CPA) as a natural measure of agreement between preference judgments and changes in pairwise probability ratios relative to the reference policy. Standard logistic consistency and calibration results connect DPO's objective to this policy property and transfer our excess-risk upper bounds to CPA, without treating CPA as a complete measure of generated-response quality.

AI.tldr: 本文从Bradley–Terry建模假设失效的角度刻画DPO的结构性极限，用偏好对数几率的三三角旋度（triangle-curl）给出结构性近似误差的精确刻画，并推导上下界、ReLU得分模型的近似速率、有限样本界以及基于上下文偏好准确率（CPA）的替代风险框架。
AI.motivation: DPO通过对数型目标从成对偏好中学习，其得分差参数化隐含Bradley–Terry假设。作者希望区分三类误差来源：结构性模型误设定、模型容量不足、有限样本估计误差，从而明确DPO性能上限究竟来自何处。
AI.method: 引入偏好对数几率的triangle-curl作为Bradley–Terry可表示性的判据（其为零当且仅当偏好可被BT表示）；证明可实现超额logistic风险的上界由得分类近似项与triangle-curl项构成，并在额外有界性假设下给出与triangle-curl成正比的下界；针对ReLU得分模型（含clipped模型）推导显式近似速率；为clipped经验风险最小化器建立有限样本界，分离网络近似、结构误设定与估计误差；并把结果纳入替代风险框架，将上下文偏好准确率CPA定义为偏好判断与相对参考策略的成对概率比变化之间的一致度。
AI.result: 得到结构性近似误差的刻画；超额logistic风险上界（得分近似项+triangle-curl项）与成比例下界；ReLU/clipped模型下增大容量可消除得分近似项但不改变结构性障碍；有限样本界将三类误差解耦；标准logistic一致性与校准结果将DPO目标与CPA联系起来，并把超额风险上界传递到CPA。
AI.conclusion: DPO的性能受限于Bradley–Terry结构性误设定，这一障碍不能通过增大模型容量消除；triangle-curl是量化该障碍的合适工具。CPA可作为与DPO目标自然衔接的策略性质度量，但不应被视为生成回复质量的完整指标。

title: Adaptive Decoding Methods for Token-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: Rollout decoding affects both which trajectories are used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and how many completion tokens are spent collecting them. We study whether candidate-token support should remain fixed or widen during training in the context of rollout sampling efficiency. Our main schedule moves from top-K=10 to K=20 and then to full support as the attempted-token budget increases. In a 4B code-RLVR setting, the schedule has a higher interpolated 150M-token validation value than its matched fixed-K=10 continuation in all three runs, with a mean gain of $1.80{\pm}0.42$ points. The schedule also performs comparably to a separately trained fixed-K=20 baseline, the strongest fixed-support setting in our sweep. Follow-up experiments suggest that late widening to full support is the most promising variant, although the evidence remains noisy, and mixed-reward-group diagnostics do not clearly explain the gain. An exploratory single-run test replay yields identical point estimates for the schedule and fixed $K=10$. Overall, our results show that rollout support is an important control for sampling efficiency in RLVR and motivate further study of adaptive support schedules.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RLVR中rollout采样时候选token支持集（top-K）应固定还是随训练逐步放宽。提出从K=10逐步扩至K=20再到全支持的schedule，在4B代码RLVR设置下，三个run的150M-token插值验证值均高于匹配的固定K=10，平均提升1.80±0.42分，与最强的固定K=20基线相当。
AI.motivation: Rollout decoding同时决定RLVR中哪些轨迹被用于强化学习以及消耗多少completion token，因此候选token支持集的设置直接关系采样效率；但现有工作缺乏对训练过程中支持集应固定还是放宽的系统研究。
AI.method: 以尝试token预算增长为触发条件，设计渐进式支持schedule：top-K=10 → K=20 → full support；在4B代码RLVR场景中与匹配的固定K=10、固定K=20基线在相同token预算下对比，以150M-token处的插值验证准确率为指标，并辅以宽化时机变体、混合奖励组诊断及单run重放测试。
AI.result: schedule在全部三个run中均优于匹配的固定K=10继续训练，平均增益1.80±0.42分；与Sweep中最强的固定K=20基线表现相当。后续实验显示"后期放宽至全支持"为最有希望的变体，但证据仍有噪声；混合奖励组诊断未能清晰解释增益来源；探索性单run重放中schedule与固定K=10点估计完全相同。
AI.conclusion: rollout支持集是RLVR中采样效率的重要控制变量，自适应支持schedule值得进一步研究；但当前效果量较小、证据存在噪声，结论需更大规模与更稳健的重放实验验证。

title: Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient MCI Conversion Prediction
summary: Allocating limited trainable capacity across convolutional layers is a central challenge in parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of pretrained three-dimensional (3D) networks. We propose Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation, which jointly selects input- and output-channel ranks under a fixed adapter-parameter budget while preserving the spatial kernel modes. To guide rank selection, we learn task-specific proxy updates from downstream training data and approximate them using candidate Tucker rank pairs. A perturbation analysis bounds the output discrepancy between the fixed proxy network and its Tucker approximation in terms of layerwise reconstruction residuals, motivating residual-based allocation. We normalize each squared residual by the corresponding proxy-update energy to compare relative approximation errors across layers. Dynamic programming minimizes their sum under a global budget constraint that accounts for both channel factors and the Tucker core. This yields a globally optimal allocation over the specified candidate rank pairs. We evaluate the method on the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort for predicting conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease within 36 months, using hippocampal segmentation pretraining. Across five random seeds, the proposed method achieves a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.7706, compared with 0.7239 for fixed-ratio Tucker adaptation and 0.7430 for full fine-tuning. The total number of trainable parameters is limited to approximately 0.618 million, accounting for only 1.45% of the full model. Adaptive Tucker rank allocation thus provides an effective approach to parameter-efficient transfer learning in 3D medical imaging.

AI.tldr: 提出Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation，在固定adapter参数预算下为3D网络各卷积层自适应分配Tucker通道秩，在ADNI的MCI→AD转化预测任务上以1.45%可训练参数取得AUC 0.7706。
AI.motivation: 预训练3D网络PEFT中，如何在卷积层间分配有限的可训练容量是核心难题；固定比例分配无法反映各层对下游任务的差异化重要性。
AI.method: 保留空间核模态，仅对输入/输出通道秩进行联合选择；用下游数据学习任务特定代理更新，并以候选Tucker秩对近似之；通过扰动分析给出固定代理网络与Tucker近似网络输出差异的层级重构残差界，从而以残差为分配依据；将各层平方残差用对应代理更新能量归一化以比较相对近似误差，再用动态规划在计入通道因子与Tucker核心的全局预算约束下最小化残差和，得到候选秩对上的全局最优分配。
AI.result: 在ADNI队列上以海马分割预训练预测36个月内MCI向AD转化，五个随机种子下平均AUC为0.7706，优于固定比例Tucker适配（0.7239）与全量微调（0.7430）；可训练参数约0.618M，仅占全模型1.45%。
AI.conclusion: 基于重构残差引导的自适应Tucker秩分配为3D医学影像的参数高效迁移学习提供了有效途径。

title: DeltaTrace: Efficient Signed Attribution for Reasoning Language Models
summary: We study how words in the context support or oppose a language model's response and present DeltaTrace, a novel attribution framework that explains the effect of input tokens on a fixed model response. DeltaTrace measures how the response's log-probability changes when the context tokens being explained are masked. To distribute this difference among source tokens, it constructs operator-specific local rules for finite changes and composes them backward through the computational graph using effective secant slopes. Each token is assigned a signed attribution as the inner product of its embedding displacement and the corresponding backward-propagated slope. Local conservation makes these contributions sum to the measured score difference and preserves their meaning when aggregated over sentences or passages. DeltaTrace supports both attention and linear-attention models, with auxiliary memory growing linearly with sequence length at fixed model dimensions and chunk size. On the evaluated attention model, DeltaTrace achieves the lowest deletion-faithfulness scores (RISE and MAS) on most retrieval and reasoning tasks and the highest needle-in-a-haystack Recall, exceeding FlashTrace by 5.67-24.33 percentage points. On the evaluated hybrid attention and linear-attention model, DeltaTrace lowers RISE on 9 tasks and MAS on 12 relative to FlashTrace.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DeltaTrace 归因框架，通过掩码上下文并测量响应对数概率变化，将其按有效割线斜率回传分配到各 token，实现对注意力与线性注意力模型的可信归因。
AI.motivation: 研究上下文词如何支持或反对语言模型的响应，需要一个能解释输入 token 对固定模型响应影响的归因方法，且需满足局部守恒、可跨句聚合以及适配线性注意力等高效架构。
AI.method: DeltaTrace 测量掩码被解释上下文 token 时响应对数概率的变化；为有限变化构造算子特定的局部规则，并用有效割线斜率沿计算图反向复合；每个 token 的归因取其嵌入位移与反向传播斜率的內积，得到带符号归因；局部守恒保证归因和等于实测分数差。辅助内存随序列长度线性增长（固定模型维度与 chunk 大小），支持注意力与线性注意力模型。
AI.result: 在注意力模型上，DeltaTrace 在多数检索与推理任务取得最低删除忠实性分数（RISE、MAS），并在 needle-in-a-haystack Recall 上超过 FlashTrace 5.67–24.33 个百分点；在混合注意力与线性注意力模型上，相对 FlashTrace 在 9 个任务降低 RISE、12 个任务降低 MAS。
AI.conclusion: DeltaTrace 是一种满足局部守恒、可扩展至线性注意力架构且忠实性更优的响应归因方法，在多类任务上优于 FlashTrace。

title: Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Unlike on-policy distillation (OPD), which depends on a separate teacher model, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a single language model acting simultaneously as the student and the teacher, with the teacher conditioned on privileged information. Despite this architectural simplicity, synchronous rollout generation dominates overall training time, creating a severe systems bottleneck when scaling OPSD. To address this, we introduce Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation (AsyncOPSD), a framework that decouples rollout generation from learner updates to improve training throughput. Since the teacher and student share parameters, AsyncOPSD eliminates the multi-model coordination overhead inherent to OPD architectures in asynchronous training. As the student policy evolves, buffered trajectories generated by older policies become stale, potentially degrading performance. To mitigate this, we introduce a distillation objective based on staleness-aware policy control and token-level entropy weighting. Across three model sizes and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AsyncOPSD improves the training throughput by $1.96$--$2.25\times$ over synchronous OPSD while increasing average benchmark accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出异步在线自蒸馏框架AsyncOPSD，将rollout生成与学习器更新解耦，并引入陈旧度感知策略控制与token级熵加权的蒸馏目标，在三种模型规模上实现1.96–2.25倍训练吞吐提升且平均准确率不降反升。
AI.motivation: 在线自蒸馏（OPSD）虽仅需单一模型同时充当学生与教师（教师以特权信息为条件），架构简单，但同步rollout生成占据主要训练时间，成为规模化时的严重系统瓶颈。而传统在线蒸馏（OPD）的异步化又面临多模型协调开销问题。
AI.method: 1) 将rollout生成与学习者参数更新解耦，实现异步训练；2) 因师生共享参数，天然规避OPD异步架构中的多模型协调开销；3) 针对缓冲轨迹随学生策略演化而陈旧的问题，设计基于陈旧度感知（staleness-aware）策略控制与token级熵加权的蒸馏目标。
AI.result: 在三种模型规模与数学推理基准上，AsyncOPSD相较同步OPSD训练吞吐提升1.96–2.25倍，同时平均基准准确率有所提高。
AI.conclusion: 异步化可作为提升OPSD训练效率的有效手段；结合陈旧度感知控制与熵加权可缓解轨迹陈旧带来的性能退化，实现吞吐与精度的双重收益。

title: Learn the Interface, Not the Implementation: Output Representation Dominates Training Regime in LLM-Based RTL Generation
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for presentation at VLSID 2027
summary: Large-language-model register-transfer-level (RTL) generation has concentrated on how to train the model: fine-tuning, continued pre-training, and reinforcement learning from a verifier. We argue this is the second-order question. On a bounded, formally specifiable task of generating single-error-correcting, double-error-detecting (SECDED) ECC memory wrappers, we hold the task, data, and correctness oracle fixed and vary two axes independently: the training regime (seven settings) and the output representation (four levels, from fully expanded flat Verilog to an eight-field configuration expanded by a deterministic generator). Because a reference generator exists, correctness is decided by formal equivalence over a design space of approximately ten million points, rather than sampled from a hand-written testbench. Two results follow. First, representation dominates: every representation close to raw RTL reaches a pass rate of at most 0.17, while the configuration reaches 0.83 with no training at all. Once the model emits the configuration, every training regime achieves a pass rate between 0.89 and 1.00. Second, raw RTL hits a hard output-length limit: a 512-bit design requires 44,237 tokens of flat Verilog compared with just 69 tokens for the configuration. Consequently, raw generation becomes infeasible above 32-bit data words rather than merely inaccurate. A model trained from scratch with fewer than 50 million parameters, combined with the verified generator, achieves 0.89 formal equivalence, compared with 1.00 for a 32-billion-parameter fine-tuned model, while using approximately 1600 times less inference energy per correct design. Inference energy also dominates amortized training energy. The lesson is to learn the interface, not the implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文在SECDED ECC存储包装器的可形式化任务上指出：对LLM-RTL生成而言，输出表示（representation）比训练范式更重要，应"学接口而非学实现"。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成RTL的研究集中于训练范式（微调、继续预训练、验证器强化学习），作者认为这是"二阶问题"；真正一阶的是任务、数据与输出表示的设计。为此需要固定任务、数据与正确性判据，独立变化训练范式与输出表示，量化二者各自的影响。
AI.method: 选取可形式化限定的SECDED ECC存储包装器生成任务；固定数据与oracle，独立遍历两轴：(1)训练范式（7种设置）；(2)输出表示（4个层级，从完全展开的扁平Verilog到由确定性生成器展开的8字段配置）。由于存在参考生成器，正确性由覆盖约一千万设计点的形式等价性判定，而非手写测试台采样。同时统计token长度与推理能耗。
AI.result: 表示占主导：接近原始RTL的表示通过率至多0.17，而配置表示在零训练下即达0.83；一旦输出配置，7种训练范式通过率均在0.89–1.00。原始RTL存在硬性输出长度瓶颈：512位设计需44,237个扁平Verilog token，而配置仅69个，故数据位宽超过32位时原始生成由"不准确"变为"不可行"。不足5000万参数、从零训练的模型配合已验证生成器达0.89形式等价，而320亿参数微调模型为1.00，但前者每正确设计的推理能耗约低1600倍；推理能耗还主导摊销后的训练能耗。
AI.conclusion: 在可形式化specify的任务上，输出表示而非训练范式是LLM-RTL生成的主导因素；让模型学习高层配置接口、把实现细节交给确定性生成器，可显著提升正确率、突破长度瓶颈并大幅降低能耗。

title: Out-of-Distribution Detection in Continual Learning
comment: Accepted at the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Out-of-distribution detection in continual learning (OOD-CL) is highly challenging, as it requires (i) learning a sequence of tasks without catastrophic forgetting, and (ii) identifying unknown samples (OOD) without access to known (in-distribution (ID)) data from past tasks, where standard confidence-based OOD scores tend to degrade. Existing methods largely rely on a rehearsal buffer of past data or assume closed-world settings, limiting their scalability and reliability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel OOD detection framework for rehearsal-free continual learning, inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), which mitigate catastrophic forgetting via their inherent local neuroplasticity. To better leverage KAN in OOD-CL, we introduce a task-adaptive classifier architecture, TA-KAN, which mitigates recency bias and enhances ID--OOD separability through task-specific control of activation locality. Furthermore, we propose a geometry-guided OOD score that complements TA-KAN classifier confidence without relying on past ID data. Our method significantly improves OOD detection while maintaining strong ID classification performance, achieving state-of-the-art results in OOD-CL.

AI.tldr: 提出无回放持续学习下的OOD检测框架，基于KAN的局部神经可塑性缓解遗忘，设计任务自适应分类器TA-KAN与几何引导OOD分数，实现SOTA的OOD-CL性能。
AI.motivation: OOD-CL需同时满足无灾难性遗忘与在无法访问过去任务ID数据条件下识别OOD样本；现有方法依赖回放缓冲区或封闭世界假设，且基于置信度的OOD分数在类增量场景下退化，可扩展性与可靠性受限。
AI.method: 受Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks（KAN）固有局部神经可塑性抑制遗忘的启发，构建无回放持续学习OOD检测框架；提出任务自适应分类器TA-KAN，通过任务级激活局部性控制缓解近因偏差并增强ID–OOD可分性；并提出几何引导的OOD评分，在不依赖历史ID数据的前提下补充TA-KAN置信度。
AI.result: 在保持较强ID分类性能的同时显著提升OOD检测效果，在OOD-CL设定下取得state-of-the-art结果。
AI.conclusion: 将KAN的局部可塑性引入无回放持续学习，配合任务自适应激活局部性调控与几何引导评分，可有效解决历史ID数据缺失下的OOD检测退化问题，为可扩展的OOD-CL提供新范式。

title: An Analysis of Semantic and Spatio-Temporal Co-evolution for Edge Classification on Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs
summary: Dynamic edge classification on text-attributed Web graphs, such as review networks, community forums, and news-derived knowledge graphs, requires high quality, adaptive semantic representations in the context of network evolution. Existing dynamic graph architectures typically initialize text feature vectors with pretrained language models and hold them static during training to preserve their semantic structure, forgoing the potential benefits of allowing them to co-evolve with network topology. In this work, we investigate the effects of enabling such co-evolution with a unified text-graph alignment framework that integrates a lightweight Transformer adapter to update token-level text representations via spatio-temporal gradients from a contrastive pretraining objective. To prevent detrimental semantic distortion, a language model maintenance objective anchors the evolving text embeddings to their original semantic structure. Evaluations on the Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark demonstrate that this anchored text-graph co-evolution consistently improves upon the edge classification performance of frozen-text baselines across diverse Web-related domains. Representational analyses reveal that the framework reduces anisotropy, improving the linear separability of text embeddings, and effectively encodes structural and temporal information into the semantic space. A computational efficiency analysis confirms that this beneficial semantic and spatio-temporal co-evolution is achieved without incurring the prohibitive computational overhead typical of end-to-end joint training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种统一的文本-图对齐框架，通过轻量级Transformer适配器让文本表示与图拓扑协同演化，并以语言模型维护目标约束语义结构，从而提升动态文本属性图上的边分类性能。
AI.motivation: 动态文本属性图（如评论网络、社区论坛、新闻知识图谱）需要高质量且能适应网络演化的语义表示。现有动态图架构通常用预训练语言模型初始化文本特征后保持冻结，以维持语义结构，但放弃了文本表示与网络拓扑协同演化的潜在收益。
AI.method: 构建统一的文本-图对齐框架：引入轻量级Transformer适配器，利用对比预训练目标产生的时空梯度更新token级文本表示；同时设置语言模型维护目标，将演化中的文本嵌入锚定于原始语义结构，以避免语义失真。
AI.result: 在Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark上，该锚定式文本-图协同演化在多种Web相关领域均稳定优于冻结文本基线；表示分析显示框架降低了各向异性、提升了文本嵌入的线性可分性，并将结构与时间信息有效编码进语义空间；计算效率分析表明该协同演化不产生端到端联合训练的过高开销。
AI.conclusion: 允许文本表示与图拓扑协同演化（并辅以语义锚定）可显著改善动态文本属性图上的边分类，同时兼顾语义稳定性与计算效率，是一种优于冻结文本范式的实用方案。

title: Maestro: Agentic Formal Proof Development by Coordination
summary: Lean is increasingly used to verify mathematical proofs and software produced by LLM agents, but writing formal proofs remains hard. Existing prover systems take a divide-and-conquer approach that recursively decomposes hard proof obligations into easier lemmas and splits again any lemma that resists proof. However, a lemma can resist proof for different reasons, including insufficient guidance, a false statement, or a flaw in the decomposition that produced it. Existing systems cannot tell these apart as a failed attempt reports little beyond its failure, and responses are confined to the failing node without considering the rest of the proof or revising the plan above it. The system may thus keep decomposing obligations along a flawed proof direction until the budget runs out, causing the whole proof attempt to fail. We introduce Maestro, a Lean prover harness that handles failures through global coordination. Provers report why they failed, not just that they failed, and a coordinator that sees the whole proof chooses an appropriate response, such as guiding a stuck prover, correcting a false lemma, or retracting a flawed subtree and replanning it. The same harness extends to verified code synthesis, where a checked counterexample sends the code back for repair. We evaluate Maestro with four frontier LLMs on seven mathematics and three software verification benchmarks. It proves more targets than each model's native coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) on every benchmark the agent has not already saturated, with the largest gains on research-level mathematics. With Claude Opus 5, it discovers its own proofs of 34 of the 48 theorems in the June 2026 release of arXivLean, against 19 for the native agent. It also outperforms all published prover systems on every benchmark they share, solving 669/672 PutnamBench, 59/60 Lean-IMO-Bench, and 6/6 IMO 2026.

AI.tldr: Maestro：通过"失败原因报告 + 全局协调器"实现 Lean 证明与验证代码合成的全局协调式证明器框架。
AI.motivation: 现有分治式 Lean 证明器无法区分引理失败的真正原因（指导不足、命题为假、分解本身有缺陷），失败信息贫乏且响应局限于失败节点，导致在错误证明方向上持续分解直至预算耗尽。
AI.method: 提出 Maestro 框架：证明器报告失败原因而非仅报告失败；一个掌握整体证明状态的协调器据此选择应对策略——引导卡住的证明器、修正假引理、撤销有缺陷的子树并重新规划；同一框架扩展到验证代码合成，以已校验的反例驱动代码返修。
AI.result: 在 7 个数学与 3 个软件验证基准上，用四个前沿 LLM 评估：在代理未饱和的每个基准上均超过原生编码代理（Claude Code / Codex），研究级数学提升最大；Claude Opus 5 下自主证明 arXivLean 2026 年 6 月版 48 个定理中的 34 个（原生代理为 19）；在共享基准上优于所有已发表证明系统：PutnamBench 669/672、Lean-IMO-Bench 59/60、IMO 2026 6/6。
AI.conclusion: 将失败诊断与全局协调引入证明搜索，可显著缓解错误分解方向导致的预算浪费，并在数学证明与验证代码合成两类任务上取得当前最优表现。

title: UtilityBench: Measuring Language Model Utility When Errors Have Different Costs
summary: As language models are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios with important outcomes, the impact of their mistakes often extends far beyond what correctness can capture. In domains like medicine, a single error can lead to serious consequences and put patient safety at risk. However, mainstream evaluation protocols still treat all errors as equal, overlooking the spectrum of real-world costs. To address this, we propose a utility-based evaluation paradigm that explicitly incorporates the varying consequences of errors. Guided by this principle, we develop UtilityBench, a large-scale benchmark of 15,000 instances with verifiable answers, quantifying error severity using Best-Worst Scaling to elicit meaningful, data-driven cost estimates. These quantified utilities shape when a model should answer or abstain, guiding it to make decisions that align with the true importance of each scenario. As another merit, we introduce UtilityAUC, a metric that measures the area under the utility curve determined by a model's response ordering, thereby enabling utility preference alignment beyond error frequency. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that UtilityAUC can distinguish between models where standard accuracy and AURC fall short. Empirically, evaluating 20 state-of-the-art models, we find that greater accuracy or more advanced architectures do not reliably translate to higher UtilityAUC, highlighting a gap between problem-solving ability and responsible decision-making in language model evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于效用的评测范式，构建 UtilityBench（15,000 条可验证答案实例，用 Best-Worst Scaling 量化错误代价）并引入 UtilityAUC 指标，衡量模型响应排序下的效用曲线下面积；对 20 个前沿模型的评测显示准确率或架构先进性并不能可靠转化为更高的 UtilityAUC。
AI.motivation: 现有主流评测把所有错误等同看待，忽略了真实场景中错误代价的差异（如医疗中单次错误可能危及患者安全），因此需要能显式纳入错误后果差异的评测协议。
AI.method: 以效用为导向：用 Best-Worst Scaling 引出数据驱动的错误严重度/代价估计，据此决定模型何时应作答、何时应弃答；构建 UtilityBench 基准；提出 UtilityAUC 指标，即由模型响应排序决定的效用曲线下面积，并提供理论分析说明其在标准准确率与 AURC 失效时仍具区分力；实证评测 20 个 SOTA 模型。
AI.result: 理论上，UtilityAUC 能区分准确率与 AURC 无法区分的模型；实证上，20 个 SOTA 模型中更高的准确率或更先进的架构并未稳定带来更高 UtilityAUC，揭示解题能力与负责任决策之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 评测应从"错误频率"转向"效用偏好对齐"，将错误代价纳入回答/弃答决策；UtilityBench 与 UtilityAUC 为衡量语言模型在真实高风险场景中的负责任决策提供了可操作工具。

title: Keep the Lineages Alive: Diversity-Preserving SMC for Diffusion LLM Decoding
summary: Inference-time sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding can improve the reasoning accuracy of masked diffusion language models (diffusion LLMs) without post-training by resampling a population of partial generations according to a reward. Its effectiveness therefore depends on the resampling step, which must concentrate computation on promising candidates while retaining enough diversity to explore alternative reasoning paths. The reward can be internal, the decoder's own confidence on the committed prefix, or external, a process reward model scoring that prefix. Under either reward, multinomial resampling can disrupt this balance by duplicating high-weight particles and discarding lineages that may still reach a correct solution. The effective sample size (ESS) does not register this loss: multinomial resampling resets it to its maximum even as distinct lineages disappear. To retain such lineages, we introduce lineage-preserving SMC (LP-SMC), which combines Chopthin resampling with an input weight floor. Instead of equalizing weights, Chopthin bounds the ratio between the largest and smallest weights it returns and carries the unequal weights forward. The floor limits how far below the maximum a weight may fall before resampling so that lineages with low early weight keep a chance to recover. Across mathematical-reasoning and code-generation benchmarks on two base models, LP-SMC raises oracle coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct particle, in every setting, by 1.8 to 25.6 points, and raises end-to-end accuracy under a common reward-model selector in eleven of twelve settings, by up to 7.9 points on LLaDA-1.5 and 18.3 on Dream-7B. The coverage gain persists under the external reward model, which suggests that diversity-preserving resampling and the guidance signal contribute separately to inference-time search.

AI.tldr: 提出保谱系的SMC解码（LP-SMC），用Chopthin重采样加权重下限替代多项式重采样，在扩散语言模型推理时搜索中保留多样谱系，显著提升覆盖率与端到端准确率。
AI.motivation: 推理时SMC解码依赖重采样在"聚焦高潜力候选"与"保持多样性以探索其他推理路径"之间取得平衡；但多项式重采样会复制高权重粒子、丢弃仍可能通向正确答案的谱系，且有效样本量（ESS）无法反映这种谱系丢失（重采样后ESS被重置为最大值）。
AI.method: LP-SMC（lineage-preserving SMC）：将Chopthin重采样与输入权重下限相结合。Chopthin不把权重等化，而是约束返回权重的最大/最小比值上限，并把非等权重继续向前传递；权重下限限制权重在重采样前相对最大值可下跌的幅度，使早期权重低但可能后期恢复的谱系保留机会。奖励可用内部置信度或外部过程奖励模型。
AI.result: 在两个基础模型的数学推理与代码生成基准上，LP-SMC在全部设置中提升oracle覆盖率1.8–25.6个百分点；在统一奖励模型选择器下，12个设置中有11个端到端准确率提升，LLaDA-1.5最高+7.9，Dream-7B最高+18.3；在使用外部奖励模型时覆盖率增益依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 保多样性的重采样与引导信号对推理时搜索的贡献相互独立、可叠加，验证了保留谱系对扩散语言模型推理搜索的重要性。

title: The KV-Surgeon: Compensation-Aware Offline KV-Cache Compaction
summary: Offline compaction of the key--value cache (KV-cache) reduces the cost of repeatedly querying a fixed context by constructing a smaller cache once and reusing it subsequently. The central challenge of compaction is deciding which cache entries to delete and which to retain. Existing methods score each candidate for deletion on its own, with the rest of the cache being held fixed. However, softmax renormalization of the attention operation couples these decisions in a nonlinear manner: removing one entry changes the attention weights of every remaining one. In this work, we introduce KV-Surgeon, which uses calibration data to take interactions into account in a tractable way. We derive a quadratic surrogate that admits closed-form expressions for jointly making the optimal greedy removal decision as well as compensation within the remaining entries. On QuALITY, LongHealth, and Long Code Arena, and at every evaluated compaction ratio, KV-Surgeon substantially advances the cost--accuracy Pareto frontier of dense and mixture-of-experts models from 4B to 30B parameters. At $50\times$ compaction, KV-Surgeon improves question-answering accuracy by up to four points over attention matching (Zweiger et al., 2026), the state of the art, at comparable cost. Lastly, we introduce an even faster variant, which also exceeds the state of the art while requiring only two fifths of its cost.

AI.tldr: KV-Surgeon 通过可处理的二次代理目标显式建模 softmax 重归一化导致的条目间耦合，联合决定删除与补偿，从而在同等成本下显著推进 KV-cache 离线压缩的 cost–accuracy Pareto 前沿。
AI.motivation: 离线压缩 KV-cache 可降低重复查询固定上下文的成本，其核心是选择删除与保留哪些缓存条目。现有方法对每个候选条目独立打分（其余缓存固定），但注意力 softmax 的重归一化会非线性地耦合这些决策——删除一个条目会改变所有剩余条目的注意力权重，因此独立打分会偏离真实影响。
AI.method: 提出 KV-Surgeon：利用校准数据以可处理方式计入条目间交互，推导出二次型代理目标，并获得闭式解，用于联合做出最优的贪心删除决策以及在剩余条目内进行补偿。
AI.result: 在 QuALITY、LongHealth、Long Code Arena 上，于每个评测压缩比下均显著推进 4B–30B 稠密与 MoE 模型的 cost–accuracy Pareto 前沿；50× 压缩时问答准确率较 SOTA（attention matching）最高提升 4 个点且成本相当；另提出更快变体，在仅需 SOTA 五分之二成本的情况下仍超越 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将 KV-cache 压缩从独立逐条打分转为在二次代理下联合优化删除与补偿，是一种有效且成本可控的范式；进一步可加速变体表明精度—成本权衡仍有改进空间。

title: Correctness-Dependent Asymmetric Target Distributions for Self-Distillation Policy Optimization
summary: Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can disrupt successful behaviors on correct rollouts while providing insufficient correction on incorrect ones. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation (APSD), which constructs correctness-dependent targets by mixing student and self-teacher distributions: interpolation preserves successful behaviors on correct rollouts, while extrapolation beyond the self-teacher strengthens correction on incorrect ones. We analyze APSD through divergence decomposition, reverse-KL barycentric geometry, and gradient analysis, highlighting the importance of gradient flow through student-dependent targets. Experiments under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and rich feedback show that APSD achieves strong overall performance against reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines and matches SDPO performance with 2.6x fewer training steps on average across Qwen3 model scales.

AI.tldr: 提出非对称策略优化（APSD）：按回答正确性混合学生与自教师分布，正确样本做插值以保留成功行为，错误样本做外推以加强纠错，并用散度分解、reverse-KL重心几何与梯度分析论证学生依赖目标中梯度流的重要性；在可验证奖励与丰富反馈的设置下优于RL与自蒸馏基线，平均以2.6倍更少训练步数达到SDPO性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自蒸馏策略优化通过反馈条件下的自教师提供稠密token级监督，但直接对齐自教师分布存在两点缺陷：在正确rollout上会破坏已有的成功行为，在错误rollout上纠正力度又不足。
AI.method: 提出APSD，构造依赖正确性的蒸馏目标：对正确rollout在學生与自教师分布间做插值以保留成功行为，对错误rollout做超出自教师的外推以强化纠错。理论分析采用散度分解、reverse-KL重心几何与梯度分析，强调经由学生依赖目标传递梯度的重要性。
AI.result: 在可验证奖励（RLVR）与丰富反馈两类实验中，APSD相对强化学习与自蒸馏基线取得较强整体表现；在Qwen3各规模模型上平均以2.6倍更少的训练步数达到SDPO的同等性能。
AI.conclusion: 按正确性非对称构造自蒸馏目标可同时兼顾成功行为的保持与错误行为的纠正，且学生依赖的目标带来有效梯度流，从而在效率与效果上均优于纯RL与常规自蒸馏方法。

title: Graph-to-Table Interfaces Control Relational Generalisation
summary: Graph-to-table systems combine three design choices: an encoder that maps relational evidence to feature rows, a context constructor that selects labelled examples, and a tabular decoder. We investigate whether these components can be evaluated independently through matched comparisons that change one component while holding the rest of the pipeline and the evaluation constant. Across logistic regression, CATBOOST, and TABPFN-3 on CLUTRR, 57 GraphLog worlds, and 57 knowledge graphs, we show that conclusions about one component can change when the others change. On CLUTRR, absolute positional encodings maintain all distinctions among the evaluated queries and fit the short-path setting nearly perfectly; yet, they generalise worse than relation-count features because the supported prefix acts as a shortcut that breaks down on longer paths. On GraphLog, encoder preference depends on the decoder, while the relation-count representation degrades as CatBoost tree depth increases. Across different knowledge graphs, adding the frozen ULTRA score to local features is consistently useful, whereas adding local features to the score has a smaller and less stable effect. A pointwise TABPFN-3 readout using the full encoder underperforms native ULTRA on 48 of 57 datasets. These results show that encoder assessment depends jointly on context and decoder, while panel-level conclusions can also depend on evaluation and aggregation protocols.

AI.tldr: 该文研究graph-to-table流水线（编码器、上下文构造器、表格解码器）能否通过“单组件匹配比较”被独立评估，结论是：组件评估强烈依赖其余组件与评测协议，独立评估往往不成立。
AI.motivation: graph-to-table系统由编码器、上下文构造器、表格解码器三部分组成，通常被分开报告优劣。作者质疑这种“单组件替换即可归因”的假设，希望检验在其余流水线与评测保持不变时，组件结论是否稳健。
AI.method: 采用匹配比较（matched comparisons）设计：每次只改变一个组件，固定其余流水线与评测。在CLUTRR、57个GraphLog世界、57个知识图谱上，使用逻辑回归、CATBOOST、TABPFN-3三类解码器，比较位置编码与关系计数特征、不同编码器表示、以及加入冻结ULTRA分数与局部特征的不同组合，并与原生ULTRA对比。
AI.result: CLUTRR上绝对位置编码能保留全部查询区分且近乎完美拟合短路径，但因前缀捷径在长路径泛化更差；GraphLog上编码器偏好依赖解码器，关系计数表示随CatBoost树深增大而退化；跨知识图谱上，在局部特征中加入冻结ULTRA分数稳定有益，反向加入则效果较小且不稳定；点式TABPFN-3读出在57个数据集中有48个不及原生ULTRA。
AI.conclusion: 编码器评估同时依赖上下文与解码器，面板级结论还受评测与聚合协议影响；因此graph-to-table系统的组件不应被视为可独立评估，需报告整体配置与评测协议下的结果。

title: PnP-CF: A Consensus Flow-Matching Solver for General Inverse Problems
comment: Short version accepted at PriGM Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods using continuous-time deep generative models as learned data distribution priors enable synthesizing high-quality solutions of model-based inverse problems. The quality of the solutions depends critically on the interplay and consensus between the inverse problem solver and the generative model sampler. We revisit a recently introduced flow-based PnP framework, which we refer to as PnP-CF (Consensus Flow), and extend its application to nonlinear inverse problems, including those with learned neural-network forward operators. PnP-CF combines a flow-matching denoiser with (i) ADMM-like dual variable updates and (ii) a time-adaptive pullback onto the intermediate flow probability path that combines a stochastic and a deterministic component. We discuss how these two features stabilize the algorithm and promote consensus, and demonstrate on a set of experiments that PnP-CF not only solves standard linear inverse problems with quality at least comparable to state-of-the-art baselines, but also extends gracefully to nonlinear inverse problems, including forward operators realized by pretrained neural networks, for which existing methods produce unsatisfactory results or fail completely.

AI.tldr: 提出PnP-CF（Consensus Flow）框架，将流匹配去噪器与ADMM式对偶变量更新、时间自适应的回拉机制结合，扩展至非线性逆问题（含神经网络前向算子），在标准线性任务上达到SOTA水平，在现有方法失效的非线性任务上仍稳健有效。
AI.motivation: 基于连续时间深度生成模型的PnP方法解逆问题的质量关键取决于逆问题求解器与生成模型采样器之间的交互与共识（consensus）。现有方法主要针对线性逆问题，面对非线性逆问题（尤其是神经网络实现的前向算子）时效果不佳甚至完全失效，因此需要重新审视并扩展基于流的PnP框架。
AI.method: 重新审视近期提出的基于流的PnP框架PnP-CF，并将其扩展到非线性逆问题。方法上，PnP-CF将流匹配（flow-matching）去噪器与两项机制结合：(i) ADMM式的对偶变量更新；(ii) 时间自适应的回拉（pullback）到流的中间概率路径，该回拉由随机分量与确定性分量共同构成。
AI.result: 实验表明，PnP-CF在标准线性逆问题上质量至少与SOTA基线可比；在非线性逆问题上（包括由预训练神经网络实现的前向算子）仍能优雅扩展并取得有效结果，而现有方法在这些场景下产生不理想结果或完全失败。
AI.conclusion: PnP-CF通过对偶变量更新与时间自适应随机-确定性回拉这两项机制，稳定了算法并促进求解器与采样器之间的共识，是一个可统一处理线性与非线性逆问题的有效PnP框架。

title: Scenario Generalization and Sector Transfer in Real Surface Irrigation Surrogate Modelling with Tabular Models
comment: Accepted at MACLEAN 2026 (Workshop on Machine Learning for Earth Observation), held in conjunction with ECML PKDD 2026
summary: Surface irrigation planning requires screening many operating conditions and spatial configurations, while high-fidelity shallow-water-equation (SWE) simulations are expensive. We study tabular surrogate models for predicting maximum water height from drone-derived field morphology, terrain, hydrological, spatial, and scenario descriptors, where each row represents a spatial cell under one irrigation scenario. To assess deployment feasibility, we evaluate gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular models, AutoML, and tabular foundation models (TFMs) under two regimes: same-sector generalization, where a model predicts unseen scenarios after observing a limited set of configurations in the same sector, and sector-out transfer, where knowledge learned from source sectors is transferred to an unseen sector. The main findings are twofold: a) under the evaluated fixed 8/32 same-sector split, surrogates achieve strong performance, especially with raw spatial coordinates; b) sector-out transfer is substantially harder because the target sector has different coordinates and geometry. Sector-frame normalization of spatial coordinates improves transfer across similarly structured sectors, but does not solve cross-shape generalization. Overall, tabular surrogates appear useful for same-sector scenario screening under this fixed split, while robust transfer to unseen sectors remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用于地表灌溉最大水深预测的表格型代理模型，比较梯度提升树、神经表格模型、AutoML 与表格基础模型（TFM）在同扇区泛化与跨扇区迁移两种设定下的表现。
AI.motivation: 高保真浅水方程（SWE）模拟成本高昂，而灌溉规划需筛选大量工况与空间配置，因此需要廉价代理模型；同时需评估其实际部署可行性，尤其是对未见过扇区的泛化能力。
AI.method: 以无人机获取的田块形态、地形、水文、空间及情景描述符为输入，每行代表某灌溉情景下的一个空间单元，预测最大水深。评估梯度提升树、神经表格模型、AutoML、表格基础模型；设定两种实验范式：(1) 同扇区泛化——在扇区内固定 8/32 划分下观测有限配置后预测未见情景；(2) 跨扇区迁移——由源扇区迁移至未见目标扇区；并考察原始空间坐标与扇区坐标系归一化坐标的影响。
AI.result: 在固定 8/32 同扇区划分下，代理模型表现优异，使用原始空间坐标时尤其明显；跨扇区迁移显著更难，因目标扇区坐标与几何形态不同。扇区坐标系归一化可改善相似结构扇区间的迁移，但无法解决跨形状泛化问题。
AI.conclusion: 在该固定划分下，表格型代理模型适用于同扇区情景筛选；但对未见扇区的稳健迁移仍是未解问题。

title: ProtGlycanDock: Towards Accurate Protein-Glycan Docking with Tailored Dataset, Benchmark and Model
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Datasets and source codes are released
summary: Performing accurate protein-glycan docking is critical to understanding protein-glycan interactions which govern many biological processes. However, this important task is hampered by the lack of tailored datasets, benchmarks and models for protein-glycan docking. To fill this blank, we first curate a standard benchmark ProtGlycanDock for training and evaluating protein-glycan docking models under both protein and glycan generalization settings. On this benchmark, we evaluate ten models in three categories, physics-based docking methods, machine-learning-based docking models and molecular structure prediction models. To obtain more precise binding poses, we further propose two finetuning techniques to inject the knowledge of glycan conformations into a general-purpose molecular structure prediction model. These two techniques respectively augment model inputs with glycan topological features and refine glycan binding pose with a glycan energy loss. Benchmark results show the superiority of AlphaFold 3 among existing methods, and the two proposed finetuning techniques can be well combined to achieve a state-of-the-art model for protein-glycan docking. Also, we perform stratified benchmark analysis and case studies to better understand the strengths and weaknesses of current models, providing insights for future model improvements. We maintain datasets at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ProtGlycanDock/ProtGlycanDock and source codes at https://github.com/kasawa1234/ProtGlycanDock

AI.tldr: 本文构建了蛋白质-聚糖对接基准 ProtGlycanDock，系统评测十种模型，并提出两种微调技术将聚糖构象知识注入通用分子结构预测模型，组合后实现最优对接性能。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质-聚糖对接对理解诸多生物过程至关重要，但该任务缺乏专用数据集、基准与模型，导致研究进展受限。
AI.method: 1) 策划并发布标准基准 ProtGlycanDock，支持蛋白质泛化与聚糖泛化两种设定下的训练与评测；2) 在基准上评测三类共十种模型：基于物理的对接方法、基于机器学习的对接模型、分子结构预测模型；3) 提出两种微调技术向通用分子结构预测模型注入聚糖构象知识：其一是以聚糖拓扑特征增强模型输入，其二是用聚糖能量损失精修结合构象；4) 开展分层基准分析与案例研究。
AI.result: AlphaFold 3 在现有方法中表现最优；两种微调技术可有效互补，组合后取得蛋白质-聚糖对接的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了蛋白质-聚糖对接在数据与评测上的空白，揭示了现有模型的优势与不足，并为后续模型改进提供方向；数据集与代码已开源。

title: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation
summary: Looped transformers reuse a shared block of layers to increase computational depth without increasing the number of trainable parameters. They are trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT). To save training compute, BPTT is often truncated to the last few loops, although this may weaken the benefit of looping. To study this tradeoff systematically, we jointly vary model size, training tokens, and forward and backward loop counts across nearly 600 training runs and fit a unified scaling law that captures the effects of looping and truncation through effective parameters. Despite the training-compute savings of truncation, our fitted law favors full BPTT when forward and backward loop counts are jointly optimized. In matched-compute runs, full BPTT through fewer loops consistently outperforms truncated settings of the same compute. The law further shows that at fixed model size, the compute-optimal loop count and training-token budget both grow with compute. When model size is also free, the law identifies two fully trained loops as the best looped setting. Experimentally, this setting achieves lower loss than the compute-optimal non-looped model with about 27% fewer non-embedding parameters and only 8% more training compute.

AI.tldr: 通过约600组实验与统一缩放律分析循环Transformer中BPTT截断的影响，发现全量BPTT配合更少循环数在等算力下更优，且最优循环数与token预算随算力增长。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer复用共享层以增加计算深度而不增加参数，但训练开销大；实践中常将BPTT截断到最近几轮以节省算力，这可能削弱循环的收益，该权衡此前缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 联合变化模型规模、训练token数以及前向与反向循环次数，开展近600次训练运行，拟合一个通过"有效参数"刻画循环与截断效应的统一缩放律。
AI.result: 拟合的缩放律显示，在前向与反向循环数联合优化时全量BPTT更优；等算力下，全量BPTT配合更少循环数一致优于同算力的截断设置。固定模型规模时，算力最优循环数与token预算均随算力增长；当模型规模也可自由选择时，两个完整训练的循环是最佳设置，其损失低于算力最优的非循环模型，非嵌入参数少约27%，训练算力仅多8%。
AI.conclusion: 截断BPTT虽节省训练算力，但在联合优化循环数时并不划算；全量BPTT与较少循环的组合更具算力效率，且缩放律可用于指导循环架构的算力最优配置。

title: FinHopper: A Progressive Multi-Hop Benchmark for Complex Financial Agents with Step-wise Evaluation
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 28 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. Benchmark: https://github.com/justajustin/FinHopper/
summary: Financial agents are expected to answer factual investment queries through open search, but financial multi-hop retrieval differs from general multi-hop QA in a crucial way: each intermediate answer is an exact typed constraint, such as an entity, date, event, or numerical indicator, that determines the next query. This strict answer-conditioned dependency makes small intermediate errors cascade into plausible but wrong search trajectories. We introduce FinHopper, a benchmark for complex financial agents with controlled reasoning depth from 1 to 6 hops, covering stocks, funds, and macroeconomic facts, with gold intermediate answers for process-level evaluation. To construct FinHopper at scale, we design a state-transition-based synthesis framework that composes verified atomic financial QA patterns into dependency-preserving chains, followed by targeted in-synthesis verification, model-ensemble checking, and public-search validation by financial experts. Experiments with 20 LLM-agent configurations show that public search tools are necessary but insufficient: performance drops sharply as hop depth increases, the best model remains far below human experts, and process-aware scoring reveals partial reasoning progress hidden by final-answer-only evaluation. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/justajustin/FinHopper/.

AI.tldr: 提出FinHopper，一个面向金融智能体的多跳检索基准，支持1–6跳可控推理深度，覆盖股票、基金与宏观事实，并提供金标准中间答案以进行过程级评测；同时给出基于状态转移的可扩展合成框架及多重校验流程。
AI.motivation: 金融多跳检索不同于通用多跳QA：每个中间答案都是精确的类型化约束（实体、日期、事件、数值指标），决定下一步查询，小误差会级联为看似合理但错误的检索轨迹。现有基准缺乏对答案条件依赖与推理深度的控制与过程级评估。
AI.method: 构建FinHopper基准，推理深度1–6跳可控，覆盖股票、基金、宏观事实，标注金标准中间答案。采用基于状态转移的合成框架，将经验证的原子金融QA模式组合为保持依赖关系的链，并结合合成内定向验证、模型集成检查与金融专家的公开搜索验证。
AI.result: 在20种LLM智能体配置上的实验表明：公开搜索工具必要但不充分；随跳数增加性能急剧下降；最佳模型仍远低于人类专家；过程感知评分揭示了仅看最终答案所掩盖的部分推理进展。
AI.conclusion: 金融多跳检索需过程级、深度可控的评测，FinHopper为此提供了可扩展的基准与合成范式，并显示当前LLM智能体在依赖链推理上仍有显著差距。基准已开源。

title: Provable Adversarial Detection: Prime Quantization meets Gromov--Wasserstein
summary: Adversarial vulnerability persists across modern vision architectures from CNNs to vision language models (VLMs), yet existing detection methods rely on heuristics without theoretical guarantees. We address the fundamental question of when adversarial perturbations can be provably detected from a geometric perspective. Our key insight is that adversarial perturbations cannot simultaneously preserve geometric structure across spaces with fundamentally different properties. Accordingly, we construct two such complementary metric spaces. First, we use a standard CNN embedding space $Z$, where adversarial samples exhibit significant displacement patterns. Second, we build a novel prime-quantized space $P$, that absorbs small perturbations through number-theoretic discretization, resulting in minimal displacement, while preserving discriminability. We then leverage the geometric discrepancies across spaces $Z$ and $P$ to detect adversarial samples. To the best of our knowledge, we establish the first rigorous separation theory for adversarial detection, proving that adversarial samples create unavoidable geometric inconsistencies across both spaces. Our framework provides theoretical guarantees including pixel-level absorption bounds, neighborhood diameter concentration, Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) separation theorems, and practical risk control. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical predictions and achieve consistently strong detection performance across a wide range of attack types and model families.

AI.tldr: 该论文从几何视角研究对抗扰动的可证明检测问题，构建CNN嵌入空间Z与素数量化空间P两个互补度量空间，利用跨空间几何不一致性检测对抗样本，首次建立对抗检测的严格分离理论。
AI.motivation: 对抗脆弱性广泛存在于从CNN到视觉语言模型（VLM）的各类视觉架构中，但现有对抗检测方法依赖启发式规则，缺乏理论保证。作者旨在回答"何时能从理论上证明对抗扰动可被检测"这一根本问题。
AI.method: 核心洞察是对抗扰动无法在性质根本不同的空间之间同时保持几何结构。据此构造两个互补度量空间：(1) 标准CNN嵌入空间Z，对抗样本在其中表现出显著的位移模式；(2) 新型素数量化空间P，通过数论离散化吸收小扰动，使位移极小同时保持判别性。利用Z与P间的几何差异进行对抗检测。
AI.result: 建立首个对抗检测的严格分离理论，证明对抗样本在两个空间间必然产生不可避免的几何不一致性。提供多项理论保证：像素级吸收界、邻域直径集中性、Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）分离定理以及实用风险控制。大量实验验证了理论预测，并在多种攻击类型和模型族上取得一致且强劲的检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨互补度量空间的几何不一致性可作为一种具有理论保证的对抗检测原则；素数量化空间与CNN嵌入空间的组合为可证明对抗检测提供了可行且有效的框架。

title: Learning from a Bandit Learner
summary: Classical inverse bandit methods typically aim to recover true reward parameters. In contrast, we infer a demonstrator's subjective beliefs, specifically its internal estimates of suboptimality gaps. We consider no-regret demonstrators that follow randomized policies, such as Thompson sampling, and characterize a family of algorithms for which per-step inversion is possible. This enables gap estimates to be recovered directly from the arm-selection distribution. Our analysis identifies an inherent stability-coverage trade-off: inversion becomes ill-conditioned as the demonstrator concentrates its probability mass on a single arm, while the number of informative rounds depends on the rate at which its policy converges. We establish conditions under which inversion is reliable and provide theoretical guarantees on the resulting estimation error. Experiments on simulated data support the analysis and illustrate how these conditions affect gap recovery in practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出逆向bandit问题的新视角：不恢复真实奖励参数，而是推断示范者的主观信念（内部次优性差距估计），针对Thompson sampling等no-regret随机策略给出逐步可逆算法族与理论误差保证。
AI.motivation: 经典逆向bandit方法以恢复真实奖励参数为目标，但示范者的决策依据往往是其主观信念而非客观参数，因此推断内部次优性差距（suboptimality gap）估计更贴合实际示范行为。
AI.method: 针对遵循随机策略（如Thompson sampling）的no-regret示范者：(1) 刻画一类可逐步（per-step）逆演的算法族；(2) 直接从臂选择分布中恢复gap估计；(3) 分析稳定性-覆盖权衡，即概率质量集中于单臂时逆演病态，而有信息轮数取决于策略收敛速度。
AI.result: 给出逆演可靠性的成立条件及估计误差的理论保证；仿真实验验证分析结论，并展示这些条件在实践中对gap恢复效果的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过从臂选择分布直接逆演主观gap估计，可在明确条件下实现可靠推断；稳定性-覆盖权衡是方法的内在限制，需在示范者集中度与策略收敛速率之间折中。

title: Declarative Explanations for Graph Neural Networks: A Demonstration
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven effective for graph analytical tasks, yet their "black-box" nature complicates the understanding of their layer-wise behavior and hinders their application to large graphs. We demonstrate SliceGXQ, an end-to-end declarative and interactive system for querying and exploring layer-wise explanations for GNNs over large-scale graphs. In particular, SliceGXQ provides (1) an interactive graphical user interface for dataset, model, and explanation configuration; (2) a lightweight SPARQL-like parser that allows users to specify target nodes, layers, explanation modes, and constraints; and (3) an integrated execution and visualization workflow that invokes SliceGX as its underlying explanation engine. We demonstrate how users can diagnose a misclassified node, identify problematic layers and influential messages, and perform targeted model debugging, together with large-scale graph interpretation and fraud-detection analysis. Our demonstration video and source code are available at https://github.com/jinzhaoqet/SliceGXQ.

AI.tldr: SliceGXQ 是一个端到端、声明式且可交互的系统，用于在大规模图上查询和探索 GNN 的逐层解释。
AI.motivation: GNN 的"黑箱"特性使得其逐层行为难以理解，也阻碍了其在大规模图上的应用，因此需要可交互的解释与查询工具。
AI.method: 系统包含三部分：(1) 用于配置数据集、模型与解释的交互式图形界面；(2) 轻量级类 SPARQL 解析器，支持指定目标节点、层、解释模式与约束；(3) 集成执行与可视化流程，底层调用 SliceGX 作为解释引擎。
AI.result: 演示了用户如何诊断误分类节点、定位问题层与有影响的message，并进行针对性模型调试，同时支持大规模图解释与欺诈检测分析。
AI.conclusion: SliceGXQ 提供了面向大规模图 GNN 逐层解释的声明式交互式查询与可视化能力，可用于节点诊断、层定位与模型调试；演示视频与源码已公开。

title: From Retrieval to Recognition:Knowledge-Enhanced Post-training of Time Series Foundation Models for Classification
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved notable progress in classification tasks through large-scale pretraining. However, their post-training practice mainly focuses on implicit parameter fine-tuning, where task-relevant information is entangled with abundant irrelevant knowledge in vast parameter spaces. This may hinder TSFMs from precisely activating useful knowledge for downstream classification. To this end, we propose Retrieval-to-Recognition (R2R), a plug-and-play post-training paradigm that adapts pretrained TSFMs to time series classification. Rather than pretraining a new foundation model, R2R improves how existing TSFMs are post-trained: it introduces a decoupled query encoder to extract discriminative patterns and retrieve instance-level numerical knowledge from a constructed knowledge base. The retrieved explicit knowledge is then fused with the TSFM's implicit parametric embeddings, enabling joint knowledge transfer at both the parameter and feature levels. In this way, R2R allows TSFMs to recall task-relevant patterns learned during pretraining, improving the efficiency of knowledge utilization in downstream classification transfer. Experiments on 158 time series datasets show that R2R consistently improves the classification performance of state-of-the-art TSFMs. Ablation and knowledge-enhanced studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的后训练范式R2R，通过检索显式数值知识并与TSFM隐式参数嵌入融合，提升预训练时间序列基础模型的下游分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的后训练主要依赖隐式参数微调，任务相关信息与海量无关知识纠缠在庞大参数空间中，难以精确激活对下游分类有用的知识。
AI.method: R2R不重新预训练基础模型，而是改进后训练方式：引入解耦的查询编码器提取判别性模式，从构建的知识库中检索实例级数值知识；将检索到的显式知识与TSFM的隐式参数嵌入融合，实现参数级与特征级的联合知识迁移。
AI.result: 在158个时间序列数据集上，R2R持续提升当前最先进TSFM的分类性能；消融实验与知识增强研究进一步验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式检索知识与隐式参数知识的结合使TSFM能更高效地召回预训练阶段习得的任务相关模式，提升下游分类知识利用效率。

title: Variance-Aware Non-Stationary Bandits:All-Budget Regret Bounds and Adaptation Costs

AI.tldr: 该文刻画了有界非平稳多臂老虎机中"方差预算Q"与"变化预算B"双约束下的动态遗憾权衡：给出极小极大动态遗憾约为 min{T, A+√(AQ)+(AQBT)^{1/3}+√(AT)·min{B,√B}}，并证明其匹配下界，同时量化了自适应损失。
AI.motivation: 低奖励方差能降低估计成本，但并不能免除对未观测臂的监控（未观测臂可能改善）。现有工作缺乏同时按"供给方差预算Q"和"变化预算B"刻画两类成本如何共同决定动态遗憾的精细权衡，因此需要精化 variance–variation tradeoff。
AI.method: 设定A个臂、时域T、累计均值变化上界B（不含初始向量）、每轮最大奖励方差之和上界Q。对每个可行(Q,B)建立极小极大下界与匹配算法：(1) 小正预算下采用安全校准阶段识别包含所有存活臂未来均值的公共区间；(2) 将观测裁剪到更宽区间以降低重启先验混合静态遗憾算法的成本；(3) 用原始均值解析参考控制残差，避免计入裁剪均值的变差；(4) 平衡裁剪偏差与监控项以闭合小预算噪声区间；(5) 固定oblivious构造给出匹配下界。Q=0确定性边界在无对数因子下单独刻画。
AI.result: 对每个可行(Q,B)，极小极大期望动态遗憾在单个对数因子内为 min{T, A+√(AQ)+(AQBT)^{1/3}+√(AT)·min{B,√B}}；Q=0确定性边界无对数项刻画。在披露的确定性单次改进族上，静态遗憾预算具有匹配的最坏情形变化遗憾前沿（含有限改进脉冲）；当单一策略与所有供给预算确定性oracle速率竞争时，产生Ω((T/A)^{1/4})的损失。
AI.conclusion: 统一刻画了方差与变差双预算下的极小极大动态遗憾及其相变结构，明确了裁剪+监控方案的最优性，并量化了自适应代价；无预算的低噪声调度问题仍为独立的开放问题。

title: Optimal Multi-Kernel Combination for Online Multi-Label Classification
comment: This manuscript has been submitted to Pattern Recognition for consideration and is presently under review
summary: Multi-label classification is particularly challenging in streaming scenarios, where data arrives sequentially. Online kernel methods offer a promising solution. However, prevailing methods rely on a single preselected kernel, making them prone to suboptimal choices since the global data distribution is unknown in advance in online settings. Although the recent method, Online Kernel Selection for Online Multi-label Classification (OKS-OMC), enables data-driven kernel selection, it fails to fully harness the complementary information from multiple kernels and encounters the curse of kernelization. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a novel online multi-kernel combination method for large-scale multi-label classification. First, an efficient and robust online single-kernel multi-label method is designed. Second, learning an optimal convex combination of multiple multi-label kernel classifiers is formalized as a structural risk minimization problem. An improved alternating optimization procedure is developed, in which the combination coefficients are updated by directly minimizing the objective function, while each kernel classifier is updated by minimizing a surrogate upper bound. This procedure decouples the learning of kernel classifiers from combination coefficients, allowing independent classifier updates via our single-kernel method and accelerating convergence to high-quality solutions. Our multi-kernel method is proven to asymptotically converge to the optimal fixed convex combination of the best fixed single-kernel models chosen in hindsight. Ablation studies confirm that our method's components outperform their counterparts in OKS-OMC. Comprehensive evaluations across 11 datasets and seven metrics demonstrate our method's overall superiority over existing online multi-label methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向大规模多标签分类的在线多核组合方法，通过结构风险最小化与改进交替优化实现多核互补，并以单核高效方法加速求解，理论上收敛到事后最优固定凸组合。
AI.motivation: 在线多标签场景中全局数据分布未知，现有在线核方法依赖单一预选核，易产生次优选择；OKS-OMC 虽支持数据驱动核选择，但未充分利用多核互补信息且面临核化诅咒（curse of kernelization）。
AI.method: 首先设计高效鲁棒的在线单核多标签方法；其次将多核多标签核分类器的最优凸组合学习形式化为结构风险最小化问题，并采用改进的交替优化：组合系数通过直接最小化目标函数更新，各核分类器通过最小化代理上界更新，从而解耦分类器与系数的学习，使各分类器可借助单核方法独立更新。
AI.result: 理论上证明方法渐近收敛到事后选取的最优固定单核模型之最优固定凸组合；消融实验表明各组件优于 OKS-OMC 中的对应部件；在 11 个数据集、7 项指标上的综合评测显示其总体优于现有在线多标签方法。
AI.conclusion: 多核在线组合可有效缓解单核选择偏差与核化开销，兼顾效率与精度，为大规模流式多标签分类提供可证明收敛的实用方案。

title: Nash-MOPD: Optimizing Task Trade-offs in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aggregates the capabilities of multiple domain-expert teachers into a single student model. However, all domains in MOPD share the student's finite budget of optimization steps and rollouts. Fixed uses constant domain sampling ratios based on corpus sizes; by contrast, D$^3$-MOPD adjusts the ratios using the teacher-student reverse-KL divergence and its recent decrease. However, favoring large recent decreases can direct more training toward domains that already improve quickly, while domains that improve more slowly may receive too few examples. To address inflexible allocation and the risk of giving insufficient training to domains that improve more slowly, we propose Nash-MOPD, an adaptive domain scheduler based on a local minimax game using existing reverse-KL statistics. The equilibrium maximizes the smallest predicted proportional reduction under the local model and gives more prompts to domains that need more examples for comparable improvement. Consequently, Nash-MOPD responds to changing learning progress and supports domains that improve more slowly without extra teacher queries or rollouts. At step 100, Nash-MOPD exceeds both baselines' final mathematics and code checkpoint scores on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and reaches Fixed's on Qwen3-8B-Base. Furthermore, it leads eight of nine reported metrics and is best or tied best on all six mathematics and code accuracy metrics, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Nash-MOPD，一种基于局部极小极大博弈的自适应域调度器，利用已有的 reverse-KL 统计量在多教师 on-policy 蒸馏中分配域采样比例，解决固定比例分配不灵活以及过度偏向快速提升域的问题。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 上第 100 步即超过两个基线的最终数学与代码 checkpoint 分数，并在 9 项指标中的 8 项领先。
AI.motivation: 多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（MOPD）中所有域共享学生模型有限的优化步与 rollout 预算。固定比例（基于语料规模）分配不够灵活；D$^3$-MOPD 依据教师-学生 reverse-KL 散度及其近期下降量调整比例，但偏好近期大幅下降会把更多训练导向提升已很快的域，而提升较慢的域可能获得过少样本，导致训练不足。
AI.method: 提出 Nash-MOPD 自适应域调度器：构建局部极小极大（minimax）博弈，仅复用已有的 reverse-KL 统计量，不引入额外教师查询或 rollout。其均衡解最大化最小的预测比例下降量（predicted proportional reduction），从而向"需要更多样本才能获得可比提升"的域分配更多 prompt，并能响应学习进度的变化。
AI.result: 在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 上，第 100 步即超过 Fixed 与 D$^3$-MOPD 的最终数学与代码 checkpoint 分数；在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上达到 Fixed 的水平。整体在报告的 9 项指标中 8 项领先，并在全部 6 项数学与代码准确率指标上均取得最优或并列最优。
AI.conclusion: Nash-MOPD 通过极小极大均衡实现更公平且动态的域预算分配，缓解慢提升域训练不足问题，在不增加额外计算成本的前提下显著提升多域蒸馏的效率与最终性能。

title: Dynamical Batching: How Class-Cycling Training Shapes the Internal Structure of Neural Networks
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/samuellozanoiglesias/dynamical_batching (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23349474)
summary: We investigate whether cyclically varying the class composition of training batches can modify both the performance and the internal organization of neural networks. Motivated by nonequilibrium systems, in which cycling between related sub-goals can make switching between their solutions increasingly efficient, we introduce Dynamical Batching (DB), a sampling protocol that periodically emphasizes each class while leaving the loss and the optimizer unchanged, and compare it with Uniform Batching (UB), in which every mini-batch has equal class proportions. In the regime where standard training fails, DB changes the outcome: on a three-arm spiral, a capacity-limited MLP that plateaus far below perfect accuracy under UB fits the training data under DB. Tracking individual weights, we find that under DB the change between class-specialized states is carried by a smaller set of weights than under UB, and that this set is markedly more persistent from cycle to cycle, on every synthetic dataset we test and in a wider network that fits the data under both protocols. This organization is a signature of the protocol rather than a predictor of its benefit: it appears equally where DB leaves accuracy unchanged. On CIFAR-10, the same protocol modestly improves the test accuracy of a channel-narrowed ResNet-10, a standard residual architecture, and of a second capacity-limited convolutional network. These results show that how class emphasis is distributed in time can shape both the solution a network reaches and the internal structure of the network.

AI.tldr: 提出“动态批采样”（DB），通过周期性强调各类别而不改损失与优化器，可改变网络性能与内部组织。
AI.motivation: 受非平衡系统启发：在相关子目标间循环切换可提升求解效率，作者探究按时间周期性改变训练批次的类别构成是否能同时影响网络性能与内部结构。
AI.method: 引入 Dynamical Batching（DB）：周期性强调每个类别，其余不变；与 Uniform Batching（UB，每批类别比例均等）对比。在合成数据集（三臂螺旋等）、受限 MLP 及更宽网络上追踪单个权重变化，并在 CIFAR-10 上用通道收窄的 ResNet-10 及另一容量受限卷积网络验证。
AI.result: 在标准训练失败的区间，DB 改变结果：容量受限 MLP 在 UB 下准确率远低于完美而停滞，在 DB 下能拟合训练数据。DB 下类别特化状态间的转换由更小的权重集合承担，且该集合跨周期更具持续性，在全部合成数据集及两种协议都能拟合的更宽网络中均成立。该组织特征是协议本身的签名而非收益的预测指标——在 DB 不改变准确率处同样出现。CIFAR-10 上 DB 小幅提升通道收窄 ResNet-10 及另一受限卷积网络的测试准确率。
AI.conclusion: 类别强调在时间上的分布方式能同时塑造网络所达到的解及其内部结构；DB 带来的权重组织变化独立于性能收益。

title: TaQFormer: A Treatment-as-Query Transformer with Data-Fusion for Multidimensional Treatment Modeling in Coupon Allocation
summary: We study coupon allocation on an online marketplace offering multiple service categories. Issuing coupons requires choosing a vector of category-specific discounts, accounting for both their direct effects and cross-category demand shifts. We present TaQFormer, a treatment-as-query Transformer for this multidimensional treatment setting. Each treatment coordinate is represented as a query token, allowing cross-attention to estimate the response to the full treatment vector. To combine large but policy-biased observational logs with a smaller stream of randomized controlled trial data, we use a two-stage pipeline: observational pretraining learns general outcome patterns, followed by LoRA fine-tuning on RCT data with a request-specific fusion gate. We evaluate the resulting system through the checks required for production, including offline uplift metrics, treatment-parallel serving, latency monitoring, and a 14-day online A/B test. At essentially the same subsidy cost rate, \model increases business value per user by 1.26\% over the production baseline and significantly outperforms both the production baseline and the RCT-only model, while meeting the latency budget. It was subsequently rolled out to all marketplace traffic and has operated at full scale for several months as of October 2026. The deployment illustrates how multidimensional treatment modeling and observational pretraining, combined with adaptation using RCT data, can support effective joint discount decisions in production.

AI.tldr: 提出 TaQFormer：将多维补贴向量的每个坐标表示为 query token 的 Transformer，用于在线市场多品类优惠券联合分配；采用观测数据预训练 + RCT 数据 LoRA 微调的两阶段流程，并在生产环境完成离线评估与 14 天 A/B 上线。
AI.motivation: 在线市场发放优惠券需同时决定各品类的折扣向量，既要考虑直接效应，也要处理跨品类需求转移；同时生产环境仅有大样本但有策略偏差的观测日志，而 RCT 数据样本小但无偏，如何兼顾二者用于多维处理（treatment）建模是核心问题。
AI.method: (1) TaQFormer（treatment-as-query Transformer）：每个 treatment 坐标作为一个 query token，通过 cross-attention 估计对完整 treatment 向量的响应，从而建模品类间交叉效应；(2) 两阶段训练：先在观测日志上预训练学习通用结果模式，再在 RCT 数据上用 LoRA 微调，并引入请求级融合门控（request-specific fusion gate）；(3) 生产验证流程：离线 uplift 指标、treatment-parallel serving、时延监控、14 天在线 A/B 测试。
AI.result: 在补贴成本率基本相同的条件下，TaQFormer 使人均业务价值较生产基线提升 1.26%，显著优于生产基线与仅用 RCT 训练的模型，同时满足时延预算；随后全量上线，至 2026 年 10 月已满规模运行数月。
AI.conclusion: 多维 treatment 建模、观测数据预训练与 RCT 数据自适应相结合，可支持生产环境中有效的品类联合折扣决策，并具备可部署性与可扩展性。

title: OceanTensorCube and ST-MMT: A Multimodal Data and Transformer System for Seven-Day Forecasting of Pyropia Bleaching
summary: Bleaching of cultured Pyropia (laver) causes losses in Korean seaweed farming. We present a system that forecasts bleaching seven days ahead for farm clusters. OceanTensorCube aligns 32 channels from public marine, meteorological, ocean-model and satellite sources on a 30 m grid, and ST-MMT, a 9.2-million-parameter spatiotemporal transformer with hub-style multi-head cross-attention between variable groups, maps a 14-day input window to a seven-day-ahead bleaching probability. On the validation set, a six-seed ensemble detects every reported positive at a false-alarm rate of at most 3.5%, an upper bound because the report-based labels are positive-unlabeled. A same-date control on separately trained models indicates that the architecture discriminates between clusters when the calendar is held fixed. We also report the system's weaknesses: skill falls steeply as the quarterly nutrient survey ages (ROC-AUC 0.94 at 30 days, 0.53 at 129 days), and a single LSTM on cluster-average series outperforms a single ST-MMT, with only the ensemble leading at the operating point. We describe the labeling procedure, the evaluation protocol and the operational gate that withholds forecasts when inputs are stale. The forecasting service is operated at https://oceantensor.ai.kr.

AI.tldr: 提出 OceanTensorCube+ST-MMT 系统，提前7天预测养殖紫菜白化；六种子集成在验证集上零漏报、误报率≤3.5%，但技巧高度依赖营养盐调查的时效性。
AI.motivation: 韩国紫菜养殖中培养紫菜（Pyropia/laver）白化造成经济损失，需要面向养殖簇群的提前预警能力，以便采取干预措施。
AI.method: 构建 OceanTensorCube：将公共海洋、气象、海洋模式与卫星共32通道数据在30 m网格上对齐；设计 ST-MMT——9.2M参数时空Transformer，变量组间采用hub式多头交叉注意力，把14天输入窗口映射为未来7天白化概率；评估采用六种子集成、基于报告的阳性未标注（PU）标签，并设同日对照实验与时效敏感性分析。
AI.result: 六种子集成检测出全部已报告阳性，误报率≤3.5%（因标签为阳性未标注，此为上限）。同日对照表明模型在日历固定时仍能区分簇群。弱点：随季度营养盐调查时效衰减，技巧急剧下降（30天 ROC-AUC 0.94，129天降至0.53）；单LSTM于簇均值序列上优于单ST-MMT，仅集成在工作点处领先。
AI.conclusion: 系统在验证集上实现零漏报的7天提前预警，并已上线运行（https://oceantensor.ai.kr），同时通过时效门控在输入过期时拒绝发布预报；但性能对营养盐数据的时效高度敏感，单模型优势有限，集成是必要的。

title: SEAM: Spectral Embedding Alignment and Merging for Low-Resource TTS
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Expanding the vocabulary of conditional text-to-speech (TTS) models typically requires extensive fine-tuning with paired audio, creating a major bottleneck for low-resource and cross-lingual adaptation. To address this, we introduce SEAM, a zero-audio initialization method that constructs embeddings for unseen tokens from known subtokens. Unlike standard pooling strategies that ignore sequential structure, SEAM applies a spectral filter to preserve temporal phonetic order and uses closed-form ridge regression to align the new embeddings with the pretrained conditioning manifold. Across three languages and two TTS architectures, SEAM approaches or matches baseline performance using up to four times less training data, reducing sample complexity by 75\% compared to random initialization and mean pooling. Our approach provides a lightweight, reproducible, and theoretically grounded solution for vocabulary expansion in low-resource speech synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出SEAM，一种零音频初始化的条件TTS词表扩展方法，从已知子词构造未见token的嵌入，在三种语言、两种TTS架构上以最多四倍更少的数据接近或达到基线性能。
AI.motivation: 条件TTS模型扩展词表通常需要对配对音频做大量微调，这成为低资源和跨语言适配的主要瓶颈。作者希望在不使用音频的前提下为新token构造可用的嵌入初始化，从而降低样本复杂度。
AI.method: SEAM从已知子词（subtokens）构造未见token的嵌入。与忽略序列结构的标准池化不同，它使用谱滤波器（spectral filter）保留时间上的音素顺序，并采用闭式岭回归（closed-form ridge regression）将新嵌入对齐到预训练条件流形上。
AI.result: 在三种语言和两种TTS架构上，SEAM以最多四倍更少的训练数据接近或匹配基线性能；相比随机初始化和均值池化，样本复杂度降低75%。
AI.conclusion: SEAM为低资源语音合成中的词表扩展提供了一种轻量、可复现且具有理论依据的解决方案。

title: Trust Your Targets: Is Target Propagation Block-Diagonal Gauss-Newton?
summary: Target propagation (TP) is a backpropagation alternative in which local targets carry the global learning signal. Prior works claim that TP performs Gauss-Newton (GN) optimisation on these targets, but the correspondence has only been established under unrealistic assumptions where hitting them exactly is trivial. Practical variants instead descend on a least-squares problem via a single gradient step. In this paper, we rederive TP from a trust region under an implicit, previously unexamined norm, and introduce CGTP (Conjugate Gradient Target Propagation), which uses conjugate gradients to solve the layer-local subproblems in parallel. A single adaptive parameter jointly controls this trust region and a matching bound on the weight update; KFAC emerges exactly as the special case where the per-sample Jacobians are replaced by their batch mean, giving its factored damping a variational grounding. On MNIST and Fashion-MNIST MLPs, CGTP matches the accuracy of ADAM and KFAC while needing orders of magnitude fewer outer iterations than ADAM (about 10x fewer backward-pass-equivalents overall), while remaining stable across depth.

AI.tldr: 本文从隐式范数下的信赖域重新推导目标传播(TP)，提出CGTP：用共轭梯度并行求解层局部子问题，单一自适应参数同时控制信赖域与权重更新界，且KFAC成为每样本雅可比取批均值的特例。
AI.motivation: 先前工作称TP在目标上做Gauss-Newton优化，但该对应仅在"精确命中目标"这一不现实假设下成立；实用变体实际只是用单步梯度下降求解最小二乘问题，理论基础薄弱。
AI.method: 在一种此前未被考察的隐式范数下构建信赖域，重新推导TP；引入CGTP，用共轭梯度并行求解各层局部子问题；以单个自适应参数联合控制信赖域与相应的权重更新上界，并说明KFAC是每样本雅可比被批均值替代时的精确特例，从而为其分解式阻尼提供变分解释。
AI.result: 在MNIST与Fashion-MNIST的MLP上，CGTP精度与ADAM、KFAC相当，但外层迭代次数比ADAM少数个数量级（总体约少10倍反向传播等价量），且随深度增加保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: CGTP为TP提供了信赖域/变分视角的理论基础，将KFAC纳入统一框架，并在实践中以更低计算代价取得可比精度与良好深度稳定性。

title: Learning SOCP Solver Dynamics with Graph Neural Networks
summary: Second-order cone programs (SOCPs) are a fundamental class of convex optimization problems widely applied across engineering domains. Classical interior-point methods are robust and accurate, but their iterative nature can be costly in real-time or repeated-solve settings. This has motivated learning-based solvers that approximate optimizer solutions with neural networks. Recent work has increasingly studied graph neural networks (GNNs) for linear, quadratic, and second-order cone optimization, leveraging their ability to model sparse relational structure among variables, constraints, and objective functions. Most existing GNN-based solvers compress the optimization process into a single forward pass, predicting the optimizer directly without using the intermediate trajectory produced by classical solvers. We introduce SOCPNet, a recursive GNN framework that uses solver trajectories to learn an iterative SOCP solution procedure. A shared GNN model is applied repeatedly, refining the current iterate at each step and enabling inference for a variable number of iterations. Rather than predicting the solution in a single pass, SOCPNet learns from intermediate iterates to progressively refine its estimates using a trajectory-regularized training procedure. We evaluate SOCPNet on multiple datasets spanning standard SOCP problem classes and show that it consistently reduces the final solution error relative to a SOCP-GNN baseline. Finally, we demonstrate how trained SOCPNet models can be used in a hybrid optimization pipeline by warm-starting a classical interior-point solver, reducing solver iterations without loss of accuracy.

AI.tldr: SOCPNet是一种递归图神经网络框架，利用内点法求解轨迹学习迭代式二阶锥规划(SOCP)求解过程，并通过热启动混合优化流程减少经典求解器迭代次数。
AI.motivation: 经典内点法在实时或重复求解场景中迭代成本高；现有GNN求解器多将优化过程压缩为单次前向传播，直接预测最优解而舍弃了经典求解器产生的中间轨迹信息，浪费了有价值的迭代结构。
AI.method: 提出SOCPNet递归GNN框架：共享同一个GNN模型并反复应用，每步精化当前迭代点，支持任意迭代次数的推理；采用轨迹正则化训练程序，从中间迭代点学习并逐步精化估计，而非单遍预测解；构建覆盖标准SOCP问题类的多个数据集进行评估。
AI.result: 在多个SOCP数据集上，相比SOCP-GNN基线一致地降低了最终解误差；训练好的模型可用于混合优化流水线，通过热启动经典内点法求解器，在不损失精度的前提下减少求解器迭代次数。
AI.conclusion: 将求解器轨迹引入递归GNN训练可有效提升SOCP近似解精度，并可作为热启动器与经典求解器结合形成混合优化流程，兼顾实时性与精度。

title: Toward Online Robust Zero-Sum Markov Games with Function Approximation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 70 pages, including appendices
summary: Online robust zero-sum Markov games pose a coupled operator-learning and game-solving problem: from nominal interaction data, the learner must recover a worst-case minimax Bellman operator while maintaining strategic coverage and controlling stage-game approximation error. Existing robust reinforcement-learning theory does not yet provide such an operator-learning perspective beyond specialized multi-agent settings. We develop an optimistic dual robust Bellman framework that combines dual robust Bellman fitting, optimistic minimax planning, backward-validated confidence sets, and exploiter-mix data collection. Our analysis is organized around the robust Bellman residuals induced by the candidate value class and yields a regret reduction that separates exploration complexity, robust operator-estimation error, stage-game solution error, and misspecification. Under explicit interpretable assumptions, we obtain conditional theorem interfaces for general and projected function approximation, together with closed results in several structured regimes, including tabular, epochwise cross-fit linear, self-normalized pure-online linear / finite-rank kernel, and projected RKHS truncation. Small-scale numerical experiments illustrate robustness calibration, strategic coverage, and the return-gap trade-off predicted by the framework.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"乐观对偶鲁棒Bellman框架"，从算子学习视角研究在线鲁棒零和Markov博弈，将后悔分解为探索复杂度、鲁棒算子估计误差、阶段博弈求解误差与模型误设四部分，并在多种函数逼近设定下给出条件性理论结果与闭式结论。
AI.motivation: 在线鲁棒零和Markov博弈本质上是算子学习与博弈求解相互耦合的问题：学习者需从名义交互数据中恢复最坏情形下的极小极大Bellman算子，同时保持策略覆盖并控制阶段博弈逼近误差。现有鲁棒强化学习理论缺乏这种算子学习视角，仅在特定多智能体设定下有结果。
AI.method: 构建乐观对偶鲁棒Bellman框架，包含四个组件：对偶鲁棒Bellman拟合、乐观极小极大规划、后向验证置信集、exploiter-mix数据采集；分析以候选值类诱导的鲁棒Bellman残差为核心组织。
AI.result: 得到将后悔显式分解为探索复杂度、鲁棒算子估计误差、阶段博弈解误差与误设项的可解释界；在明确且可解释的假设下，给出一般函数逼近与投影函数逼近的条件性定理接口，并在表格型、逐轮交叉拟合线性、自归一化纯在线线性/有限秩核、投影RKHS截断等结构化情形下获得闭式结果；小规模数值实验验证了鲁棒性校准、策略覆盖及框架预测的收益差距权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了在线鲁棒零和Markov博弈的算子学习理论视角，提供了模块化、可分解的后悔分析范式，并通过多类函数逼近下的闭式结果与数值实验验证框架的有效性与可解释性。

title: CAST: Cast-Admissible Generative Design and Shape Optimization with Paired Depth Images
summary: Deep generative design can produce complex geometries, but unconstrained representations may create undercuts that prevent release from a two-part mold. We present CAST, which reformulates three-dimensional shape generation under a selected mold-opening constraint as a two-dimensional image generation problem using paired top and bottom depth images. Each valid depth pair defines one material interval along a selected mold-opening direction, so reconstructions exclude undercuts in that direction by construction. Diffusion models generate candidate shapes in this representation, and a finite element analysis (FEA) guided optimizer refines the same two boundaries. We evaluate diffusion-based generation with limited training data comprising 211 SimJEB bracket designs. On SimJEB brackets, FEA-guided refinement with a volume penalty reduced compliance in 193 of 200 generated candidates. The median reduction across all candidates was 36.8 percent in the optimization FEA model. Reconstruction of existing brackets revealed a mass--stiffness trade-off: filling occluded regions increased material volume and reduced displacement under the evaluated loads. Paired depth images thus connect generative exploration and structural refinement in a shared design space that preserves the selected pull-direction restriction.

AI.tldr: 提出CAST：用成对上下深度图将二维扩散生成与FEA优化结合，在选定拔模方向下本征排除倒扣，实现可双件模具脱模的三维形状生成。
AI.motivation: 深度生成设计能产生复杂几何，但无约束表示易生成倒扣（undercut），导致无法从两件式模具中脱模。
AI.method: 将三维形状生成重构为基于成对顶/底深度图的二维图像生成问题：每对有效深度图沿选定开模方向定义唯一材料区间，重建结果按构造排除该方向倒扣；用扩散模型在该表示下生成候选形状，并以FEA引导的优化器对同一对边界进行细化。
AI.result: 在仅含211个SimJEB支架设计的有限训练数据上评估：FEA引导细化加体积惩罚在200个生成候选中使193个的柔度下降，全候选中位柔度降低36.8%（优化FEA模型）；重建既有支架显示质量—刚度权衡，填充遮挡区域增加材料体积并降低评估载荷下位移。
AI.conclusion: 成对深度图在保持选定拔模方向约束的共享设计空间中连接了生成式探索与结构细化。

title: Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures. Code, protocol and per-example outputs: https://github.com/AbdulRahmanIqbal/tdm-prevalence-shift
summary: Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability over caller-defined options, and Jev is described by its vendor as calibrated. But in deployment class frequencies change, so calibration measured on a fixed test set need not hold where thresholds are applied. Existing evaluations leave two gaps: the gains of vendor decision training have not been separated from those of the backbone under an identical readout, and TDMs have been tested only at the test set's class distribution. We ask whether decision training improves a model over its own backbone, and whether a TDM's calibration and thresholds withstand prevalence (label) shift as well as a fine-tuned classifier's. We compare three TDMs (Jev, Tev1-4B, Nimble-9B), their base models and two trained classifiers on identical decisions from five public datasets under simulated shift, with 35 paired tests fixed before any test was computed. First, decision training is not uniformly beneficial: Nimble-9B, which differs from Qwen3.5-9B only by a LoRA adapter, is better calibrated on intent tasks but 12.0 Macro-F1 points worse on financial sentiment. Second, under moderate shift Jev's expected calibration error (ECE) and threshold risk grow significantly more than a fine-tuned DeBERTa's only on financial sentiment, by 1.7 and 2.5 percentage points; averaged over 2,000 shift scenarios (exploratory), the gap is at most one point on every dataset. Third, EM prior correction with the model's mean development prediction as its prior needs no labels and lowers Jev's ECE under shift by 2.7 and 1.8 points on the two datasets where it is highest, although labelled recalibration lowers it far more. The three TDMs we tested are neither uniformly better than their backbones nor uniquely fragile under shift; for calibration, their main weakness is the miscalibration they already have without shift. We release all inputs, code and outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文在相同读出方式下比较三类Typed Decision Models(Jev、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B)与其backbone及两个微调分类器,考察决策训练是否带来增益,以及TDM的校准与阈值在标签流行率偏移下是否比微调分类器更脆弱;结论是决策训练并非普遍有益,TDM在偏移下也不独特脆弱,其主要校准弱点来自无偏移时已存在的失准。
AI.motivation: 现有评测存在两个空白:(1)未在相同读出下把厂商决策训练的增益与backbone本身的效果区分开;(2)仅在该测试集类别分布下评测TDM。而部署中类别频率会变化,固定测试集上的校准未必在阈值应用处成立,故需回答决策训练是否优于自身backbone、以及TDM的校准与阈值能否在流行率偏移下与微调分类器一样稳健。
AI.method: 在5个公开数据集、完全相同的决策输出上,对比3个TDM(Jev、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B)、其base模型与2个训练分类器;在模拟偏移下评测,预先固定35个配对检验再计算;并进行2000个偏移场景的探索性平均,以及以模型在开发集上的平均预测为先验、无需标签的EM先验校正。
AI.result: (1)决策训练并非一致有益:Nimble-9B仅比Qwen3.5-9B多一个LoRA适配器,在意图任务上校准更好,但在金融情感上Macro-F1低12.0个点。(2)中等偏移下,Jev的ECE与阈值风险仅在金融情感上显著差于微调DeBERTa(分别高1.7与2.5个百分点);2000个偏移场景平均(探索性)各数据集差距至多1个点。(3)以开发集平均预测为先验的EM先验校正无需标签,在ECE最高的两个数据集上把Jev偏移下的ECE分别降低2.7与1.8个点,但有标签的重新校准降幅更大。
AI.conclusion: 所测三个TDM既非一致优于其backbone,也非在偏移下独特脆弱;就校准而言,其主要弱点是未发生偏移时已存在的失准。作者公开全部输入、代码与输出。

title: CIS-Transolver: A Cross-Layer Incremental-State Neural Operator for Fine-Scale Automotive Aerodynamic Flow Prediction
summary: Neural operators offer an efficient data-driven approach to rapid prediction of complex automotive aerodynamic flows. However, spectral bias and other factors limit accurate reconstruction of fine-scale flow variations near complex geometries. Existing studies improve the representation and fitting of fine-scale information mainly through information extraction and training objectives. Further study is needed to determine how extracted local details can be used continually in subsequent operator computations and contribute effectively to the overall flow-field representation. We propose CIS-Transolver, a cross-layer incremental-state neural operator that extends fine-scale modeling from local information extraction to its use across layers. The method extracts fine-scale information through local multiscale analysis and encodes it as geometric moment states that are propagated and updated across layers. By combining information from previous layers with feedback to the value representations in Physics-Attention, the method allows local details to contribute continually to subsequent modeling of global physical correlations. We systematically evaluate CIS-Transolver on three public automotive aerodynamics benchmarks, ShapeNet-Car, AhmedML, and DrivAerNet++, covering surface pressure fields and volumetric pressure and velocity fields. CIS-Transolver achieves the lowest mean relative L2 error among the evaluated methods for all five prediction metrics across the three benchmarks. The relative error reductions average 8.72% across the five metrics compared with the best baseline for each metric, reaching 16.38% for ShapeNet-Car pressure prediction and 15.60% for AhmedML velocity prediction. These results provide a new approach to fine-scale flow prediction for complex geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出CIS-Transolver跨层增量状态神经算子，将细尺度信息编码为几何矩状态并在层间传播更新，在三个汽车气动基准上取得最低平均相对L2误差，平均降低8.72%。
AI.motivation: 神经算子可高效数据驱动预测复杂汽车气动流场，但频谱偏置等因素使其难以准确重建复杂几何附近的细尺度流动变化。现有工作多通过信息提取与训练目标改进细尺度表示与拟合，尚缺乏研究探讨提取的局部细节如何在后续算子计算中持续使用并有效贡献整体流场表示。
AI.method: 提出CIS-Transolver跨层增量状态神经算子：通过局部多尺度分析提取细尺度信息，编码为几何矩状态并在层间传播与更新；将前层信息与Physics-Attention中值表示的反馈相结合，使局部细节持续参与后续全局物理关联建模。
AI.result: 在ShapeNet-Car、AhmedML、DrivAerNet++三个公开汽车气动基准（覆盖表面压力场及体压力/速度场）上系统评估，CIS-Transolver在全部五项预测指标上取得最低平均相对L2误差；相较各指标最优基线平均降低8.72%，ShapeNet-Car压力预测达16.38%，AhmedML速度预测达15.60%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将细尺度建模从局部信息提取扩展到跨层利用，为复杂几何的细尺度流场预测提供了新途径。

title: Logit Averaging During Training Sets a New State of the Art for Non-Invasive Speech BCI
summary: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces are in practice limited by signal-to-noise ratio, and recent state-of-the-art methods address this limitation by aggregating over repeated trials of the same stimulus. Yet multi-trial aggregation has been treated inconsistently across the literature: some work averages brain signals at the model's input, other work averages predictions at the model's output, and neither treats aggregation as an architectural choice in its own right. We provide the first systematic comparison of aggregation strategies for non-invasive neural decoding, evaluating six paradigms (including logit averaging during training and three attention-based variants we introduce) across three datasets, four tasks, and two group sizes. We find that aggregation choice matters substantially: training-time logit averaging, the simplest method we propose, outperforms all others in 6 of 7 settings. On the phoneme classification setting of the 2025 PNPL competition, it sets a new state of the art, significantly outperforming the competition winner by 17.4 absolute percentage points in balanced accuracy.
