We further draw a theoretical connection between logit averaging and joint ensemble training, which has been shown to underperform independent ensembling in the deep learning literature; our results call into question recent explanations of why joint ensemble training fails. Together, these findings establish multi-trial aggregation as a key design choice for non-invasive neural decoding and identify training-time logit averaging as a simple, effective default.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统比较无创神经解码中的多试次聚合策略，发现训练期logit平均最简单且最优，在PNPL 2025音素分类任务上以平衡准确率高出冠军17.4个百分点刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 无创BCI受限于低信噪比，常用多试次聚合缓解，但文献中聚合位置不一致（输入端平均信号 vs 输出端平均预测），且从未将聚合视为独立的结构设计选择。
AI.method: 在3个数据集、4个任务、2种组规模上，系统对比6种聚合范式：包括训练期logit平均及作者提出的3种注意力变体。
AI.result: 训练期logit平均在7个设置中的6个上优于其他方法；在2025 PNPL竞赛音素分类设置上平衡准确率超出冠军17.4个绝对百分点；并建立logit平均与联合集成训练的理论联系，质疑了现有关于联合集成训练失效原因的解释。
AI.conclusion: 多试次聚合应被视为无创神经解码的关键设计选择，训练期logit平均是简单有效的默认方案。

title: An Empirical Study of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are critical for adapting large models under resource-constrained settings. However, as mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, which offer efficient inference at massive parameter scales, gain increasing prevalence in the community, a critical gap arising from the lack of systematic recipes for applying PEFT to MoE models. To narrow this gap, we conduct a large-scale systematic study that investigates a set of essential design recipes, including which modules should be adapted, which granularity should be used to adapt MoE modules, which PEFT method to use, and to what extent should the load-balancing objective be used, across three MoE backbones on downstream tasks and general knowledge tasks. Our experiments yield several key insights. First, adapting MoE experts alone achieves the highest downstream performance with competitive general capability retention under a comparable parameter budget. Second, native expert-weight updates offer a better downstream--retention trade-off than adapters that bypass experts or entire MoE modules. Third, LoRA and DoRA together define the strongest operating region for high downstream accuracy among the evaluated PEFT methods. Fourth, no nonzero load-balancing coefficient Pareto-dominates the zero baseline. We finally evaluate a weight-level redesign of MoE$^2$-LoRA on Qwen3. Moving its module-level bypass pool into native expert weights improves all four upstream endpoints by 2.4 to 17.9 points with 17% fewer trainable parameters and a 3.2-point average downstream cost.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了PEFT应用于MoE模型的设计配方，发现仅适配专家模块、原生专家权重更新、LoRA/DoRA效果最佳，且非零负载均衡系数无帕累托优势。
AI.motivation: MoE架构在超大规模参数下推理高效而日益普及，但缺乏将PEFT系统性应用于MoE模型的配方，存在关键空白。
AI.method: 在三个MoE骨干上开展大规模系统性研究，考察四个设计维度：适配哪些模块、以何种粒度适配MoE模块、选用哪种PEFT方法、负载均衡目标的权重程度；并在下游任务与通用知识任务上评估。
AI.result: 四项关键发现：(1) 仅适配MoE专家在可比参数预算下取得最高下游性能且通用能力保持具竞争力；(2) 原生专家权重更新在下游-保持权衡上优于绕过专家或整个MoE模块的适配器；(3) LoRA与DoRA构成高下游精度的最强操作区域；(4) 无非零负载均衡系数帕累托优于零基线。在Qwen3上对MoE²-LoRA做权重级重设计，将模块级旁路池移入原生专家权重，四项上游指标提升2.4–17.9点，可训练参数减少17%，下游平均代价3.2点。
AI.conclusion: 为MoE模型的PEFT提供了系统配方：优先仅适配专家、采用原生权重更新与LoRA/DoRA、不使用非零负载均衡系数；权重级重设计可在更少参数下显著提升上游指标。

title: CTLite: Lightweight Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Reusable Continuous-Time Summaries
summary: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting (IMTSF) requires capturing temporal dynamics and cross-variable dependencies from sparse, asynchronous observations. Existing methods often rely on learned temporal encoders, coupling historical representation construction with model optimisation and repeatedly processing the same observations. We propose CTLite, a lightweight forecasting framework that decouples historical summarisation from learned prediction. Specifically, a parameter-free continuous-time moment encoder summarises local levels and trends at multiple temporal scales while suppressing poorly supported slope estimates. A compact readout combines damped local extrapolation with a low-rank cross-variable correction that accounts for observation freshness, target availability, and forecast horizon. Since the historical summaries are independent of trainable parameters and forecast queries, they can be reused across optimisation steps and repeated predictions for an unchanged history without altering predictions or parameter gradients. Experiments on four real-world benchmarks show that CTLite achieves the best or second-best mean MSE and MAE among the evaluated methods with only 88-2,537 trainable parameters. Under matched GPU workloads at batch size 32, CTLite reduces inference latency by 18.6-87.3% compared with the latest models, including the cost of historical encoding. Reusing summaries further reduces total runtime by approximately 52% over 16 forecast calls on the same history compared with recomputing the encoder for every call, including the initial encoding cost. The code is at: https://github.com/SSMa913/NICLab-CTLite.

AI.tldr: CTLite 将历史汇总与可学习预测解耦：用无参数连续时间矩编码器提取多尺度局部水平/趋势并抑制不可靠斜率，再用紧凑读出（阻尼外推+低秩跨变量校正）完成预测，仅含88–2537个可训练参数，在四个基准上达到最优或次优精度，并显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 不规则多变量时间序列预测需从稀疏、异步观测中同时刻画时间动态与跨变量依赖。现有方法依赖可学习时间编码器，将历史表示构建与模型优化耦合，导致同一批观测被反复处理、计算冗余且推理开销大。
AI.method: 提出CTLite轻量框架，将历史汇总与学习式预测解耦：(1) 无参数的连续时间矩编码器在多个时间尺度上汇总局部水平与趋势，并抑制支撑不足的斜率估计；(2) 紧凑读出模块结合阻尼局部外推与低秩跨变量校正，校正项考虑观测新鲜度、目标变量可用性与预测步长。由于历史摘要与可训练参数及预测查询无关，可在优化步骤间和重复预测中复用，不改变预测结果与参数梯度。
AI.result: 在四个真实基准上，CTLite在参数量仅88–2,537的情况下取得最优或次优的平均MSE与MAE；在batch size=32的匹配GPU负载下，相较最新模型推理延迟降低18.6%–87.3%（含历史编码开销）；对同一历史进行16次预测调用时，复用摘要相较每次重算编码器（含首次编码成本）总运行时间再降约52%。
AI.conclusion: 以无参数历史摘要替代可学习编码器并结合轻量读出，可在极低参数量下兼顾精度与效率，并通过摘要复用进一步削减重复预测的运行时开销，为IMTSF提供了一种高效解耦范式。

title: A Simple and General Approach to top-$k$ Selection
summary: This paper considers the Bayesian top-$k$ identification problem, wherein a decision maker is tasked with selecting $k$ items from a pool of items of unknown quality. To assess the items, the decision maker adaptively allocates a fixed sampling budget, where each sample of an item yields a noisy observation of its quality, with the objective of minimizing the expected opportunity cost of the selected set. We propose an approach that allocates each batch of samples by minimizing a surrogate objective derived from an upper bound on the expected opportunity cost. The approach is general: samples can be allocated in batches, the selection size $k$ is arbitrary, and it applies to many sampling distributions. It is also simple and intuitive. We prove that the method's posterior expected opportunity cost decays at an exponential rate of at least half the best rate achievable by any sampling rule. In simulations across a wide range of settings, the method is competitive with, and often improves upon, the best existing algorithm in each setting.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于期望机会成本上界代理目标的批量采样分配方法，求解贝叶斯top-k识别问题，并证明其后验期望机会成本至少以最优速率的一半指数衰减。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯top-k识别需要在固定采样预算下自适应分配样本，既有方法通常局限于特定采样分布、特定k或单样本序贯分配，缺乏通用且易实现的采样规则。
AI.method: 以期望机会成本的上界构造代理目标，每批次通过最小化该代理目标来分配样本；方法支持批量采样、任意k以及多种采样分布。
AI.result: 理论证明：该方法的后验期望机会成本以指数速率衰减，且该速率至少为任何采样规则所能达到最优速率的一半；多设置仿真中与各设置下最优现有算法相当，且常优于其表现。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通用、简单直观，兼具理论速率保证与实证竞争力，是贝叶斯top-k识别中实用且接近最优的采样策略。

title: Rethinking LLM Fine-Tuning via Weight Space Reparameterization: Preserving Safety during Downstream Adaptation
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on downstream tasks often weakens their previously aligned safety behavior, creating an inherent trade-off between task adaptation and safety preservation. Existing approaches attempt to mitigate this issue by identifying safety-relevant neurons, layers, or update directions in the original parameter space. However, safety-related information is often distributed across many directions in this space, causing downstream updates to overwrite parameters that encode safety behavior. We propose WSR-Tune, a Weight Space Reparameterization-based fine-tuning framework that preserves safety during downstream adaptation. Our approach constructs a safety-conditioned basis and reparameterizes the weight matrices such that safety-relevant information becomes concentrated in a small subset of directions. We then identify safety-critical directions and freeze them in the reparameterized space, while updating the remaining complementary directions for downstream adaptation. By explicitly structuring the parameter space to disentangle safety and task information, our method reduces interference between objectives and enables simultaneous preservation of safety and improvement in downstream performance. Experimental results show that our method achieves a more favorable trade-off between downstream performance and safety retention, demonstrating its effectiveness for reliable LLM fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出WSR-Tune框架，通过权重空间重参数化将安全信息集中到少数方向并冻结，从而在微调中兼顾下游性能与安全保持。
AI.motivation: 在下游任务上微调LLM会削弱已对齐的安全行为，形成任务适配与安全保持之间的固有权衡。现有方法在原参数空间中寻找安全相关神经元、层或更新方向，但安全信息在该空间中分布广泛，下游更新易覆盖编码安全行为的参数。
AI.method: 构建安全条件基（safety-conditioned basis），对权重矩阵重参数化，使安全相关信息集中到少量方向；在重参数化空间中识别安全关键方向并冻结，仅更新其余互补方向以适配下游任务；通过显式结构化参数空间解耦安全与任务信息，降低目标间干扰。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在下游性能与安全保持之间取得更优的权衡，验证了其在可靠LLM微调中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过权重空间重参数化解耦安全与任务信息，可有效缓解微调导致的安全退化，实现安全保持与下游性能提升的同步达成。

title: On Learning Expand-and-Sparsify Representations
summary: Expand-and-sparsify ($\texttt{EaS}$) representations lift an input to a much higher dimension through a linear map and keep only the $k$ largest coordinates. Existing theory builds that map at random and needs the expanded dimension to grow exponentially in the input dimension, which puts the construction out of practical reach. We ask what is gained by learning the map by gradient descent instead, and how that gain depends on how wide the expansion is. We sweep $73$ OpenML classification tasks and $48$ regression tasks under a protocol that holds the datasets, expanded dimensions, sparsity levels and splits fixed across every method, and we summarise each comparison by a median over datasets and a Wilcoxon signed rank test. We report four findings. First, learning the expansion helps most when the expansion is narrowest, and its advantage over a random map decays to nothing by the widest expansions we run, so a learned $\texttt{EaS}$ layer can be made small. Second, with the map learned, a top-$k$ representation that keeps at most a tenth of its coordinates is indistinguishable from a dense $\texttt{ReLU}$ layer of the same expanded dimension at every expansion factor we test, while GELU and SiLU are not. Third, when the representation is forced to be binary the sparse code is the better of the two, and the reason is that binarization costs it nothing while it costs the dense layer accuracy. Fourth, how sparse the representation can be is governed by how wide it is: the sparsity level that is free rises as the expansion grows, so there is no fixed limit on how sparse it can be. The regression tasks reproduce the first finding and qualify the second and third.

AI.tldr: 学习式 expand-and-sparsify（EaS）在窄扩展时有优势，且学习后 top-k 稀疏表示可媲美同维度稠密 ReLU 层。
AI.motivation: 现有 EaS 理论采用随机线性映射，要求扩展维度随输入维度指数增长，难以实用；作者转而研究用梯度下降学习该映射能带来多少收益，以及收益如何随扩展宽度变化。
AI.method: 在两套大规模基准（73 个 OpenML 分类任务、48 个回归任务）上，固定数据集、扩展维度、稀疏度与数据划分，比较学习式与随机映射及稠密激活层，并用数据集上的中位数与 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验汇总结果。
AI.result: 四项发现：(1) 学习映射在最窄扩展时收益最大，随扩展加宽优势衰减至消失，故学习式 EaS 层可做得很小；(2) 映射学习后，保留不超过十分之一坐标的 top-k 表示在各扩展因子下与同维度稠密 ReLU 层无显著差异，而 GELU、SiLU 则不同；(3) 强制二值表示时稀疏码更优，因二值化对稀疏码无损而对稠密层有损；(4) 可用稀疏度随扩展宽度提升，“免费”稀疏水平上升，不存在固定稀疏上限。回归任务复现第一项发现，并对第二、三项给出限定条件。
AI.conclusion: 学习扩展映射可替代随机映射并支持小规模扩展；学习后的 top-k EaS 表示在广泛设置下是稠密 ReLU 的高效稀疏替代，其稀疏度上界由扩展宽度决定而非固定。

title: A Simple and Unified Method for Gradient-Variation Regret
summary: Gradient-variation online learning has attracted increasing attention for its connections to game theory and optimization. It has been studied in both non-stationary online learning, which aims to minimize dynamic regret against time-varying comparator sequences, and universal online learning, which seeks to adapt to unknown loss curvature. Prior work obtained gradient-variation bounds using different techniques tailored to each setting. We propose a simple and unified method based on surrogate losses with a quadratic penalty on decision movement, yielding gradient-variation bounds in both settings. For non-stationary online learning, the method induces an optimistic-to-gradient-variation reduction, enabling a broad class of algorithms to match the rate established by Zhao et al. (2024). For universal online learning, it yields a simple algorithm that matches the optimal universal regret bounds of Yan et al. (2024) while relaxing the extended smoothness assumption. Finally, we apply our method to online games and improve on existing guarantees.

AI.tldr: Proposes a unified surrogate-loss method with quadratic penalty on decision movement that yields gradient-variation bounds in both non-stationary and universal online learning, matching or improving state-of-the-art guarantees and extending to online games.
AI.motivation: Gradient-variation online learning bridges game theory and optimization, but prior work derived gradient-variation bounds via separate, setting-specific techniques for non-stationary online learning (dynamic regret) and universal online learning (unknown curvature). A unified treatment is desirable.
AI.method: A simple, unified approach using surrogate losses with a quadratic penalty on decision movement, which yields gradient-variation bounds across settings. In the non-stationary setting it induces an optimistic-to-gradient-variation reduction; in the universal setting it gives a simple algorithm relaxing the extended smoothness assumption.
AI.result: For non-stationary online learning, a broad class of algorithms matches the rate of Zhao et al. (2024). For universal online learning, the algorithm matches the optimal universal regret bounds of Yan et al. (2024) while relaxing extended smoothness. Applied to online games, it improves existing guarantees.
AI.conclusion: A single surrogate-loss-with-quadratic-penalty framework unifies gradient-variation analysis, recovers or improves prior bounds, and extends benefits to online games.

title: Wet-Biased Data Pipelines Mislead the Training and Evaluation of Generative Precipitation Nowcasting
comment: 63 pages, 7 figures and 3 tables in the main text, 11 supplementary figures and 9 supplementary tables. This work has been submitted to npj Climate and Atmospheric Science
summary: Generative models for precipitation nowcasting are trained and evaluated predominantly on wet-biased datasets, which over-represent precipitation events to emphasize rare extremes. Selecting test cases based on target observations is known to favor forecasts that match the selected distribution rather than the intended deployment distribution. We show analytically how this target-dependent sampling also shifts the conditional distribution learned by generative models. When training and test sampling match, even an ideal model learns precisely the distribution favored by evaluation, allowing the evaluation bias to conceal the training bias. Using a fixed satellite-to-radar diffusion model, we demonstrate that target-dependent test sampling can reverse the calibration assessment. The model appears under-predictive on a wet-biased test set but over-predictive on a deployment-representative test set. This result is replicated outside the model's training domain after a seven-year gap. Utilizing classifier-free guidance as an example, we demonstrate how the contradictory calibration assessment can misdirect downstream model development.

AI.tldr: 本文指出降水临近预报的生成模型普遍在湿偏置数据集上训练与评测，基于目标观测的测试案例选择不仅偏向“匹配所选分布”的预报，还会在解析上改变生成模型所学到的条件分布；当训练与测试采样一致时，即使是理想模型也恰好学到评测所偏好的分布，使评测偏差掩盖训练偏差。作者用固定的卫星—雷达扩散模型证明，目标依赖的测试采样可使标定评估结论反转（湿偏置测试集上表现为低估，部署代表性测试集上表现为高估），且该结果在七年间隔后、模型训练域之外仍可复现；以无分类器引导为例，说明矛盾标定结论会误导下游模型开发。
AI.motivation: 降水临近预报中的生成模型主要在湿偏置（wet-biased）数据集上训练和评估，以强调稀有极端事件；而依据目标观测挑选测试案例会偏向匹配所选分布而非真实部署分布的预报。作者希望揭示这种目标依赖采样如何同时影响训练所学分布与评估结论，并说明其造成的“训练偏差被评测偏差掩盖”的风险。
AI.method: 解析推导：分析目标依赖采样如何移动生成模型学习到的条件分布；论证当训练与测试采样相匹配时，理想模型恰好学到评测偏好的分布。实证：使用一个固定的卫星到雷达（satellite-to-radar）扩散模型，在湿偏置测试集与部署代表性测试集上对比标定评估；并在模型训练域之外、间隔七年后复现；以无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）为案例考察矛盾标定评估对下游开发的影响。
AI.result: 目标依赖的测试采样可使标定评估结论反转：同一固定模型在湿偏置测试集上表现为欠预测（under-predictive），在部署代表性测试集上表现为过预测（over-predictive）。该现象在七年间隔后、模型训练域之外得以复现；以无分类器引导为例，矛盾的标定评估会误导下游模型开发方向。
AI.conclusion: 湿偏置数据与目标依赖的测试采样会共同引入系统性偏差，且评测偏差可掩盖训练偏差，导致标定结论失真并误导模型迭代。因此需要按部署分布进行采样与评估，避免以目标观测筛选测试案例。

title: Strength Controls Change How Interventions Compare Across Sparse Autoencoder Codes
summary: Changing sparse autoencoder (SAE) codes can alter both intervention direction and magnitude, so comparing intervention effects requires a strength control specifying what is held equal. Norm matching and output calibration provide different controls, but whether interventions yield different effects across codes after strength matching remains unclear. We compare intervention effects under these controls for fixed feature groups in Gemma and Llama and observe: (1) Whole-patch scaling. With one coefficient per input, full-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) calibration leaves smaller mean effect gaps from the encoder-based reference intervention than total-norm matching for nonnegative least-squares (NNLS) refits. On new Llama inputs, total-norm matching loses 11 reference transfers, whereas full-output calibration preserves every transfer decision. (2) Positionwise scaling. On a small matched gender-agreement subset, positionwise norm matching leaves smaller observed mean gaps than full-output calibration. (3) Answer exclusion. Compared with unscaled NNLS, answer-excluded calibration reduces gaps in the measured subject-verb agreement comparisons but increases them for gender refits. Full-output KL calibration also reduces larger gaps for norm-matched constructed candidates, although matching coverage is incomplete in several settings. Since calibration uses the evaluated input's outputs, it serves as a diagnostic of residual disagreement.

AI.tldr: 本文比较稀疏自编码器（SAE）干预效应在不同"强度控制"（范数匹配 vs. 输出校准）下的差异，发现在整体缩放、逐位置缩放与答案排除三种情形下，校准与范数匹配各有优劣，且输出KL校准可作为残余分歧的诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 改变SAE编码会同时改变干预方向与幅度，因此比较干预效应需先指定"什么被保持相等"的强度控制。范数匹配与输出校准提供不同控制，但强度匹配后不同编码是否仍产生不同效应尚不清楚，需要系统比较。
AI.method: 在Gemma与Llama的固定特征组上，对比不同强度控制下的干预效应：(1) 整体patch缩放，每输入一个系数，比较全输出KL校准与总范数匹配（针对NNLS重拟合）；(2) 逐位置缩放，在小规模性别一致性匹配子集上比较逐位置范数匹配与全输出校准；(3) 答案排除，比较答案排除校准与未缩放NNLS。
AI.result: (1) 对NNLS重拟合，全输出KL校准相对基于编码器的参考干预，平均效应差距小于总范数匹配；在新Llama输入上，总范数匹配丢失11个参考迁移，而全输出校准保留了全部迁移判定。(2) 逐位置范数匹配在观测到的平均差距上小于全输出校准。(3) 答案排除校准缩小了主谓一致比较的差距，但在性别重拟合上反而增大；全输出KL校准也缩小了范数匹配构造候选的较大差距，但若干设置下匹配覆盖不完整。
AI.conclusion: 不存在普遍最优的强度控制：全输出KL校准在整体缩放与非负最小二乘重拟合下更优并保持迁移判定，逐位置范数匹配在逐位置情形更佳，答案排除的影响依赖任务。由于校准使用被评估输入的输出，它可作为残余分歧的诊断手段。

title: A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual program on unlabelled prompts solve for them. The program minimizes the worst per-domain residual and reports its energy-normalized values as the domain residual spectrum. Phase~2 lets this spectrum govern what may be added: RGBM passivates domains with low normalized residuals, trains isolated branches only for domains above the spectral gap, and writes back the admitted updates with calibrated shrinkage. On two open-source consolidation suites, the Phase~1 merge alone matches or outperforms fully trained multi-teacher distillation, and RGBM improves on it further with zero extra joint-training steps, whereas every un-gated write-back, including continued joint distillation from the merge, falls below it.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明多教师on-policy蒸馏目标在二阶意义下等价于Fisher合并（模型合并），据此提出两阶段的Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge（RGBM）合并流程，在开源整合套件上仅Phase 1合并即可匹敌或超过完整训练的多教师蒸馏，RGBM以零额外联合训练步数进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 将多个专用基础模型整合为统一通用模型是后训练的核心目标，现有两类方法各有缺陷：模型合并快速但被视为启发式、缺乏理论依据；多教师on-policy蒸馏虽能匹配分布，却需要大量rollout计算且存在跨任务梯度冲突。作者希望弥合二者，为合并提供理论基础并构建高效整合流程。
AI.method: 首先在同源专家的共享盆地（basin）内，证明多教师on-policy蒸馏目标在二阶近似下恰为Fisher合并目标，其极小值点即Fisher合并的闭式解，从而把合并视为蒸馏的闭式阶段。基于此提出RGBM：(1) Phase 1因全参Fisher合并在基础模型上不可行，将合并限制在任务向量子空间，并扩展切线空间分析，证明混合任务向量的系数同样混合隐式奖励，通过对无标注提示执行残差规划求解系数，最小化最差逐域残差并给出能量归一化的域残差谱；(2) Phase 2由该残差谱门控：对低归一化残差域进行钝化（passivate），仅对谱隙之上的域训练独立分支，并以校准收缩写回被接纳的更新。
AI.result: 在两个开源整合套件上，仅Phase 1的任务向量Fisher合并即达到或超过完整训练的多教师蒸馏；RGBM在此基础上零额外联合训练步数进一步提升，而所有未门控的写回方式（包括从合并结果继续联合蒸馏）均低于该结果。
AI.conclusion: 模型合并与多教师on-policy蒸馏是同一目标在不同阶次的体现，合并是蒸馏在二阶意义下的最优闭式阶段；残差谱门控的分支-合并流程能高效、可控地完成专门模型到通用模型的整合，且门控机制是性能提升的关键。

title: Concerns in Benchmarking Jailbreaks: An Empirical Study of Attack Success Rates
summary: Jailbreak methods are commonly compared using Attack Success Rate (ASR), but these comparisons depend on how responses are generated and judged. In this paper, we examine eight attacks against three open-weight language models using three evaluation procedures. Low-resource language attacks achieve a mean ASR of 96.0% under keyword matching but 2.7% under a Qwen3 evaluator following StrongREJECT scoring instructions. Changing the number and arrangement of attempts reverses the ranking of DeepInception and rewriting. In a separate experiment, sampling 100 responses for each unchanged request at Ollama's default temperature of 0.8 yields 100% ASR under keyword matching but 50% under the Qwen3 evaluator. Beyond evaluator sensitivity, these findings raise a safety concern: repeated sampling can expose residual unsafe behavior despite an initial refusal, suggesting probabilistic suppression rather than robust exclusion. We recommend explicit success definitions, matched response budgets, validated evaluators, and reporting cumulative failure under repeated interaction rather than relying on single-generation tests.

AI.tldr: 该文以三种评估流程检验八种越狱攻击对三个开放权重模型的效果，发现ASR高度依赖响应生成与判定方式：低资源语言攻击在关键词匹配下均值96.0%，而在遵循StrongREJECT评分的Qwen3评审下仅2.7%；改变尝试次数与排布可反转DeepInception与改写的排序。另在Ollama默认温度0.8下对同一请求采样100个响应，关键词匹配ASR为100%、Qwen3评审为50%。作者据此指出重复采样可暴露初次拒答后的残余不安全行为，属概率性抑制而非稳健排除，建议明确成功定义、匹配响应预算、使用经验证的评审器，并以重复交互下的累积失败率替代单次生成测试。
AI.motivation: 越狱研究普遍以攻击成功率（ASR）作为可比较指标，但ASR实际取决于响应如何被生成与如何被判定，导致不同工作间的结论难以类比；同时单次生成测试可能掩盖模型在重复交互中的残余风险。
AI.method: 构建统一实验框架：8种越狱攻击×3个开放权重模型×3种评估流程（关键词匹配、遵循StrongREJECT评分指令的Qwen3评审等），并系统变动尝试次数与排列方式来观察排序稳定性；另设独立实验，在Ollama默认温度0.8下对同一未改动请求采样100个响应，比较关键词匹配与Qwen3评审的ASR差异。
AI.result: 评估器敏感性显著：低资源语言攻击在关键词匹配下均值ASR 96.0%，在Qwen3评审下仅2.7%；攻击排序随尝试次数与排布变化而反转（DeepInception与改写）；重复采样实验中同一请求关键词匹配ASR 100%、Qwen3评审50%，表明初次拒答后仍存在被采样出的不安全响应。
AI.conclusion: ASR不具有跨评估流程的可比性，单次生成测试会低估风险；模型的安全对齐更接近概率性抑制而非稳健排除。建议报告时明确成功判定定义、匹配各方法的响应预算、采用经校验的评审器，并以重复交互下的累积失败率作为核心指标。

title: Bombadil: A Foundation Model for Plant Electrophysiology
summary:
Living plants, like animals, use electrical signals to carry information about their physiological state across their body, from roots to branches. These signals can be recorded, as they are in animals, from a pair of differential extracellular electrodes inserted into signal-conducting tissue. While machine-learning models have been trained to predict specific plant stress states from these signals, each of these models has been trained for only a single task and none have been designed to transfer across tasks, species, or environments. These approaches do not allow easy scaling across the wide range of species and environments that are relevant to agriculture, forestry, and horticulture for both commercial and consumer plant care.
  Here we present Bombadil, a foundation model for plant electrophysiology, pretrained without labels on over 4 million hours of electrical signals recorded from 100 plant species in ten distinct environments, including laboratories, greenhouses, commercial orchards, and natural forests. In this way, Bombadil is able to learn the fundamental features of plant electrical signals across a wide array of species and environments. Then, from those same electrical signals, Bombadil tracks changes in seven physiological indicators of plant stress, even among species and stressors with no labels in training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Bombadil——植物电生理学领域的基础模型，基于100种植物、10种环境下超400万小时无标签电信号的预训练，可跨物种、跨环境追踪七项植物胁迫生理指标，且在训练中未见过的物种与胁迫类型上同样有效。
AI.motivation: 植物与动物类似，通过电信号在体内传递生理状态信息，可由一对差分胞外电极记录。现有机器学习模型均为单一任务训练，无法跨任务、物种或环境迁移，难以在农林园艺及消费级植物养护所涉的广泛物种与环境间规模扩展。
AI.method: 构建基础模型 Bombadil：采集100种植物、10类环境（实验室、温室、商业果园、天然林等）超400万小时电信号，以无标签方式进行自监督预训练，学习植物电信号的通用表征；随后在下游以同一电信号追踪七项植物胁迫生理指标。
AI.result: Bombadil 习得了跨物种、跨环境的植物电信号基本特征，并能从同一电信号中同时追踪七项胁迫生理指标的变化；对训练中未标注的物种与胁迫因子亦具备泛化能力，实现了跨物种、跨环境的迁移。
AI.conclusion: 植物电生理基础模型为跨物种、跨环境的规模化植物状态监测提供了可行路径，可支撑农业、林业、园艺及消费级植物养护中的多任务、可迁移应用。

title: ITU-DESC: a missingness-aware machine-learning dementia risk score in the UK Biobank cohort
summary:
Background: Existing dementia risk scores rely on fixed, pre-selected features and linear models, or ignore bias from informative missingness in cohort data. Here we introduce the Istanbul Technical University Dementia Risk Score (ITU-DESC), an explainable machine-learning score for incident all-cause dementia that combines broad feature selection across roughly 8,000 candidate features with explicit control of missingness bias.
  Results: We studied approximately 500,000 UK Biobank participants with a median follow-up of 16.6 years. We withheld missingness patterns from the model using unconditional random hot-deck imputation. We stabilized feature selection by repeating BorutaSHAP-based feature selection with ten random-imputation seeds and selecting predictors chosen in at least eight of the ten seeds, which yielded 38 predictors. We trained a CatBoost gradient-boosted decision-tree model and evaluated it on a holdout test set of 50,041 participants. For all-cause incident dementia, ITU-DESC achieved an average precision of 0.138 (95% confidence interval 0.123-0.156) and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC) of 0.853 (0.844-0.863), significantly outperforming other risk scores, including the strongest comparator, the UK Biobank Dementia Risk Prediction model (0.118 and 0.841). We identified dementia risk predictors absent from established scores, including leukocyte telomere length and liver enzymes. Conclusions: ITU-DESC is the first dementia risk score to combine broad feature selection with explicit control of missingness bias.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释机器学习痴呆风险评分ITU-DESC，在约8,000个候选特征中做宽泛筛选，并显式控制缺失信息偏倚，在英国生物银行约50万人队列中优于现有评分。
AI.motivation: 现有痴呆风险评分依赖固定的预选特征与线性模型，或忽视队列数据中"信息性缺失"带来的偏倚，需同时解决特征覆盖窄与缺失偏倚两大问题。
AI.method: 基于UK Biobank约50万参与者（中位随访16.6年）；采用无条件随机热卡插补，使模型无法利用缺失模式；以10个随机插补种子重复BorutaSHAP特征选择，保留≥8/10次被选中的预测因子，得38个特征；训练CatBoost梯度提升决策树，在50,041人留出测试集评估。
AI.result: 全因痴呆预测的平均精度0.138（95%CI 0.123–0.156），ROC AUC 0.853（0.844–0.863），显著优于包括最强对照UKBDRP（0.118与0.841）在内的其他评分；并识别出既有评分未包含的预测因子，如白细胞端粒长度与肝酶。
AI.conclusion: ITU-DESC是首个将宽泛特征选择与显式缺失偏倚控制相结合的痴呆风险评分，兼具可解释性与预测优势。

title: Degree Bounds for Separating Polynomial and Neural Invariants for Point Clouds
summary: Neural networks that respect the symmetries of point clouds commonly compute high-order representations of the rotation group to improve their expressivity. Such models are known to be universal, and thus able to separate any pair of point clouds, when using representations of sufficiently high order, yet no precise bound on this order, as a function of the number of points, was previously known. We establish the first quadratic lower and upper degree bounds for polynomials that separate point clouds of n points up to rotations and permutations. By showing Tensor Field Networks and MACE can express all invariant polynomials of a given degree with sufficient representation order, we additionally derive the first explicit, quadratic bound on the representation order sufficient for these architectures to be complete, replacing previous existence results with concrete guarantees. We further show that, under local regularity assumptions, point cloud separation can be achieved with a message-passing-based model using invariants whose degree depends only on the size of a local neighborhood, rather than on the size of the full point cloud. Finally, we provide counterexamples showing MACE must compute high order irreducible representations to separate locally regular point clouds.

AI.tldr: 本文首次给出分离n点云（至旋转与置换）的多项式的二次下界与上界，并据此推导出 Tensor Field Networks 与 MACE 达到完备性所需的表示阶数上界。
AI.motivation: 等变点云网络依赖高阶旋转群表示来提升表达能力，已知阶数足够高时具备通用性，但此前缺乏该阶数关于点数的精确界，仅有存在性结论，缺少可操作的完备性保证。
AI.method: 构造分离点云的不变多项式的次数上下界分析；证明 TFN 与 MACE 在足够表示阶数下可表达给定次数的所有不变多项式；在局部正则性假设下，分析基于消息传递、仅依赖局部邻域大小的不变量的分离能力；构造反例检验 MACE 对局部正则点云的分离。
AI.result: 得到首个关于点数的二次次数上下界；给出 TFN 与 MACE 完备性的首个显式二次表示阶数上界；证明在局部正则假设下，消息传递模型可用仅依赖邻域大小的不变量实现点云分离；反例表明 MACE 必须计算高阶不可约表示才能分离局部正则点云。
AI.conclusion: 表示阶数与点数呈二次关系即可保证等变网络完备；局部结构可将所需阶数降至邻域尺度，但 MACE 在此情形下仍依赖高阶不可约表示，说明局部高效完备性并非免费获得。

title: Global Time-Aware Conditioning (GTC): A Mechanism for Time-Aware Pediatric Sleep Representation Learning
summary: Sleep physiology evolves throughout the night, with changes in sleep cycles, respiratory stability, and cardiovascular dynamics. However, self-supervised learning (SSL) methods for sleep typically process short, fixed-duration windows without explicitly modeling where each window occurs within the full sleep session. We introduce Global Time-Aware Conditioning (GTC), a mechanism that complements local positional encodings by conditioning latent representations on the global time-of-sleep of each input window. We integrate GTC into three representative SSL frameworks and evaluate them on five clinically relevant tasks with extreme class imbalance across two independent pediatric cohorts. GTC generally improves F1 and AUPRC across architectures and tasks, with gains persisting under cross-cohort transfer, highlighting the value of global temporal context for sleep representation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出全局时间感知条件化机制GTC，将各窗口的"整夜睡眠时刻"注入自监督睡眠表征，在两个儿童队列五项任务上普遍提升F1与AUPRC。
AI.motivation: 睡眠生理随整夜进程演变（睡眠周期、呼吸稳定性、心血管动态），而现有睡眠自监督学习通常处理短时固定窗口，未显式建模该窗口在整夜睡眠中的位置，缺乏全局时间上下文。
AI.method: GTC作为局部位置编码的补充：以每个输入窗口的全局睡眠时刻为条件，对隐表征进行条件化；将其集成到三种代表性SSL框架中，在五个临床相关任务上评估，覆盖两个独立儿童队列，任务具有极端类别不平衡，并检验跨队列迁移。
AI.result: 跨架构与任务上F1与AUPRC普遍提升，且增益在跨队列迁移下依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 全局时间上下文对睡眠表征学习具有明确价值，GTC是一种通用、可插拔的增强机制。

title: SleepPairNet: Learning Multimodal Pediatric Sleep Representations with Random-Pair Cross-Attention
summary: Analyzing physiological sleep signals is important for assessing sleep quality and detecting sleep-related disorders. Learning inter-modal relationships across physiological signals can provide richer representations for downstream sleep analysis. We introduce \textbf{SleepPairNet}, a multimodal self-supervised learning (SSL) framework that learns pairwise interactions between physiological signals through cross-attention. We propose a random modality-pair selection strategy that exposes the model to diverse signal pairs during pretraining, enabling flexibility across modality combinations at test time. Pretrained on the NCH dataset, SleepPairNet outperforms the evaluated SSL baselines on all respiratory tasks while remaining competitive on EEG-related tasks, and shows even stronger results when transferred to the external CHAT dataset.

AI.tldr: SleepPairNet：基于交叉注意力的成对模态自监督框架，用于生理睡眠信号分析。
AI.motivation: 睡眠质量评估与睡眠障碍检测依赖生理信号分析，跨模态交互可提供更丰富的表征，但现有多模态方法对测试时模态组合的灵活性不足。
AI.method: 提出多模态自监督学习框架SleepPairNet，通过交叉注意力学习生理信号间的成对交互；引入随机模态对选择策略，在预训练阶段让模型接触多样化信号对；在NCH数据集上预训练。
AI.result: 在所有呼吸相关任务上优于所评估的SSL基线，在EEG相关任务上保持竞争力；迁移至外部CHAT数据集时表现进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 成对跨模态自监督预训练结合随机模态对采样，可提升睡眠分析的跨任务与跨数据集泛化能力，并支持测试时的灵活模态组合。

title: VaDar: Implicit Goal Conditioning via Value Disaggregation
summary:
Long-horizon tasks are important for modern AI and robotics, yet pose a challenge for reinforcement learning. Historically, a popular approach has been to decompose a task into subgoals, and learn a subgoal-conditioned policy to execute each subtask in sequence.
  We introduce an alternative called Value Disaggregation (VaDar), which trains a single subgoal-independent policy to maximize a linear combination of per-subgoal critic values. Because subgoal information is needed only at training-time, VaDar removes the need for possibly costly or cumbersome subgoal-selection during policy deployment. Moreover, through careful experiments, we show that VaDar (1) is always competitive with, and frequently outperforms, natural baselines like goal-conditioning and (2) succeeds on tasks with non-sequential goal structure and multiple optimization objectives. In particular, VaDar is the first algorithm to solve challenging, long-horizon tasks in the RoboCasa suite, even when starting from a policy pretrained from behavior cloning with near-zero initial task success. Taken together, VaDar's successes suggest that subgoal information benefits actor-critic reinforcement learning by enhancing the efficacy of critic learning, whereas policy goal-conditioning is often unnecessary.

AI.tldr: 提出 Value Disaggregation (VaDar)：训练一个不依赖子目标的单一策略，使其最大化各子目标 critic 值的线性组合，从而在部署时省去子目标选择。VaDar 在多数任务上与目标条件基线持平或更优，并能处理非序列化目标结构与多优化目标，首次在 RoboCasa 长时序任务（即使从接近零成功率的 BC 预训练策略出发）上取得成功。
AI.motivation: 长时序任务对强化学习构成挑战。传统做法是将任务分解为子目标，并学习子目标条件策略依次执行各子任务；但这需要在策略部署阶段进行可能昂贵或繁琐的子目标选择。
AI.method: VaDar 训练单一的子目标无关（subgoal-independent）策略，其优化目标是各子目标 critic 值的线性组合。子目标信息仅在训练阶段使用（用于增强 critic 学习），策略本身不接收子目标输入。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) VaDar 始终与目标条件（goal-conditioning）等自然基线具有竞争力，且经常更优；(2) 在具有非序列化目标结构和多优化目标的任务上取得成功；(3) 是首个在 RoboCasa 挑战性长时序任务上成功的算法，即使从行为克隆预训练、初始任务成功率接近零的策略出发亦可奏效。
AI.conclusion: 子目标信息对 actor-critic 强化学习的价值在于提升 critic 学习的有效性，而策略层面的目标条件化通常并非必要；VaDar 为长时序任务提供了一种更简洁有效的替代范式。

title: The Effectiveness and Durability of Pretraining Data Filtering in Protein Language Models
summary: Pretraining filtering is one of the most common safeguards for open-weight language models. Here we study its effectiveness, durability and scalability using the ESM-2 family of protein language models. We find that filtering viral proteins from the pretraining data meaningfully degrades masked language modelling, mutation effect prediction and long-range contact prediction on viral proteins, while largely preserving performance on non-viral proteins. These effects are concentrated among proteins from human-infecting viruses, and grow as we scale models from 8M to 3B parameters. As models increase in size, we find that stringent filtering becomes more effective. However, fine-tuning on sequences from the removed viral families restores the lost performance. Although the cost to recover performance increases with model scale, even for the largest models it costs about 80 USD of H100 time. This work establishes pretraining filtering as moderately effective at selectively degrading performance on viral proteins, but not durable against fine-tuning with modest computational resources and access to relevant data.

AI.tldr: 本文以ESM-2蛋白语言模型为对象，系统评估预训练数据过滤作为一种开放权重模型安全防护手段的有效性、鲁棒性与可扩展性，发现该手段可选择性地削弱病毒蛋白性能，但可通过低成本微调恢复。
AI.motivation: 预训练数据过滤是开放权重语言模型最常见的安全防护措施之一，但其实际有效性、持久性与随规模变化的可扩展性缺乏系统实证，本文旨在量化这一防护的真实边界。
AI.method: 作者在ESM-2蛋白语言模型家族上，从预训练数据中过滤病毒蛋白，对比过滤前后模型在掩码语言建模、突变效应预测和长程接触预测上的表现；考察效应在感染人类病毒蛋白中的集中性，并将模型规模从8M扩展至3B参数；进一步在移除的病毒家族的序列上微调，评估恢复性能的代价。
AI.result: 过滤病毒蛋白显著降低了模型在病毒蛋白上的掩码语言建模、突变效应预测与长程接触预测性能，而非病毒蛋白性能基本保持；效应主要集中于感染人类的病毒蛋白，并随模型规模（8M→3B）增大而增强。模型越大，严格过滤越有效；但用被移除的病毒家族序列微调可恢复丢失性能，即使最大模型，恢复成本约为80美元的H100算力。
AI.conclusion: 预训练数据过滤在选择性削弱病毒蛋白性能方面具有一定效果，但当攻击者拥有相关数据且算力有限时，该防护并不具备持久性；因此其安全价值应被视作短期、可被微调突破的屏障，而非可靠的长期防护。

title: Nested Shared-Operator Recursion on ARC-AGI-1: An Empirical Study of HRM, TRM and URM
summary: Recursive reasoning models refine persistent internal states by repeatedly applying learned operators. We investigate whether adding a persistent intermediate state that integrates repeated updates of a faster state through the same operator improves predictive performance relative to each model family's baseline at matched parameter counts. We define this organisation operationally and implement it within three architectures: the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) and Universal Reasoning Model (URM). Using the official codebases on ARC-AGI-1, we compare each baseline with its parameter-matched nested variant. We evaluate held-out queries from tasks whose demonstrations were available during training. The experiments use a single-GPU budget far below the published training protocols. Under the tested conditions, nested variants show no consistent advantage in token accuracy, predictive loss or exact solving, which remains near zero for all configurations. The results therefore leave the hypothesis open. We specify a confirmatory comparison, with an informative baseline, multiple seeds, controls that isolate nesting and predefined criteria, to determine whether this organisation merits further development.

AI.tldr: 在ARC-AGI-1上以参数匹配方式，将"嵌套持久中间状态"结构分别植入HRM、TRM、URM三种递归推理模型，受限于单GPU低预算训练，嵌套变体在token准确率、预测损失与精确求解上均无稳定优势（精确求解接近0），故假设未被证实也未被否定，作者据此提出一个确认性实验方案。
AI.motivation: 递归推理模型通过反复施加学习算子来精化持续的内部状态；作者想检验：增加一个持久的中间状态、并由同一算子整合对更快状态的多轮更新，能否在参数匹配条件下提升预测性能。这是对"嵌套（分层多时间尺度）状态组织是否带来收益"这一组织性假设的直接检验，而非提出新模型。
AI.method: 1) 对"嵌套组织"给出可操作定义并在三种架构中实现：HRM、TRM、URM，各自构建与基线参数量匹配的嵌套变体；2) 使用官方代码库，在ARC-AGI-1上对比基线与嵌套变体；3) 评测训练中已提供示范任务的留出查询；4) 训练预算显著低于已发表协议，仅单GPU。
AI.result: 在所测试条件下，嵌套变体在token准确率、预测损失和精确求解三项指标上均无一致性优势；所有配置的精确求解率都接近零。因此结果对原假设既未支持也未反驳，属于不确定结论。
AI.conclusion: 现有实验不足以判定嵌套状态组织是否有价值，假设保持开放。作者提出确认性对比方案：采用更有信息量的基线、多种随机种子、能隔离"嵌套"这一因素的对照实验，并预设评判标准，以决定该组织结构是否值得继续开发。当前结果的局限主要来自极低训练预算与接近零的求解率，导致统计功效不足。

title: PACT: Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-Graphs for Dynamic Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Multi-agent approaches have been investigated recently as a means of improving the scalability of reinforcement learning for neural combinatorial optimization. Existing methods assume that all problem instance information is known upfront. However, real-world problems are often dynamic: relevant information is progressively revealed as the agents take actions (e.g., arriving at an edge in a routing problem only to discover it is untraversable). In such cases, existing methods fail to coordinate agents to explore and exploit the progressively revealed information. To address the arising coordination challenge, we introduce PACT (Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-graphs). PACT augments the environment graph with auxiliary nodes representing the plans of agents, which are connected to the resource nodes to indicate future dependencies. The proposed message-passing scheme over the augmented graph grounds inter-agent coordination in the environment and enables proactive, rather than reactive, conflict resolution. We show that PACT improves solution quality in dynamic problems relative to baselines and exhibits the best transfer to larger instances on which, remarkably, it outperforms centralized oracles with privileged access to instance uncertainty.

AI.tldr: PACT 通过将智能体计划表示为辅助节点并构建增广轨迹图，实现动态神经组合优化中的前瞻式多智能体协调。
AI.motivation: 现有面向神经组合优化的多智能体强化学习方法假设问题实例信息全部预先已知，而现实问题具有动态性（相关信息随动作逐步揭示，如路由中到达边才发现不可通行），这些方法无法协调智能体去探索与利用逐步揭示的信息，从而产生协调难题。
AI.method: 提出 PACT（Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-graphs）：在环境图上增广表示智能体计划的辅助节点，并将其与资源节点相连以表示未来依赖关系；在增广图上执行消息传递，使智能体间协调扎根于环境，从而支持前瞻性（而非反应性）的冲突消解。
AI.result: 在动态问题上，PACT 相对基线提升了求解质量；在更大规模实例上迁移效果最佳，甚至优于拥有实例不确定性特权信息的集中式 oracle。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体计划显式嵌入图结构并借此进行消息传递，是应对动态组合优化中多智能体协调挑战的有效途径，兼具质量与可扩展性优势。

title: Which Model for Which Role? Cost-Efficient Pareto Recommendation for LLM Agentic Workflows
comment: Preliminary version accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI)
summary: LLM agentic workflows increasingly employ different models for specialized roles. Users may prefer different trade-offs between task quality and deployment cost, sometimes also considering latency. Finding good assignments incurs a separate search cost from evaluating multiple candidates. We introduce Cost-Coupled Gittins (CC-Gittins), a multi-objective extension of single-objective cost-aware Gittins search for Pareto recommendation. It exploits the coupling between evaluation and deployment costs: assignments that cost more to deploy also cost more to evaluate. The search alternates between seeking higher quality and lower deployment cost, reusing each evaluation to inform both searches. After each batch, CC-Gittins recommends assignments that are nondominated under uncertainty-adjusted estimates of quality and deployment cost. We evaluate CC-Gittins on eight quality--cost matrices from workflows with two to five roles and up to 1,681 candidate assignments. We also evaluate the method with latency as a third objective. Across the eight benchmarks, CC-Gittins recovers a substantial fraction of the true Pareto frontier at roughly 10% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost, and recovers most of the frontier with few false positives by 30%.

AI.tldr: 提出CC-Gittins，将单目标成本感知Gittins搜索扩展为多目标Pareto推荐方法，利用“评估成本与部署成本耦合”的特性，在约10%穷举评估成本下恢复大部分真实Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体工作流常为不同角色分配不同模型，用户需在任务质量与部署成本（有时含延迟）间权衡。寻找优秀分配方案本身需要额外搜索成本（需评估大量候选组合），现有单目标成本感知搜索无法直接给出多目标Pareto推荐。
AI.method: CC-Gittins：单目标成本感知Gittins搜索的多目标扩展。核心利用评估成本与部署成本的耦合（部署越贵的分配评估也越贵）；搜索在“追求更高质量”与“追求更低部署成本”之间交替，并复用每次评估同时服务于两个搜索方向；每批评估后，基于经不确定性调整的质量与部署成本估计，推荐非支配（nondominated）分配方案。
AI.result: 在8个质量—成本矩阵基准（2至5个角色、最多1,681个候选分配）上评估，并额外测试以延迟为第三目标的情形。结果：约10%穷举评估成本即可恢复真实Pareto前沿的相当大比例；到30%成本时可恢复大部分前沿且假阳性很少。
AI.conclusion: 利用评估—部署成本耦合的多目标Gittins搜索能以极低搜索成本高效获得高质量Pareto推荐，适用于质量-成本及质量-成本-延迟的多目标模型分配场景。

title: Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: Mitigating Rubric Hacking through Latent Dimension Recovery and Balancing
summary: Rubric hacking limits both performance and training robustness in rubric-based reinforcement learning. By decomposing rubrics into sub-dimensions, we reveal the Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: as the total rubric score increases, certain sub-dimension scores systematically decrease, suggesting the model sacrifices specific quality aspects to optimize the aggregated objective. From the sub-dimension perspective, we observe two phenomena: (1) dimension imbalance, causing the policy to favor heavily covered dimensions; (2) dimension absence, leading to a systematic gap between rewards and true quality. To mitigate these issues, we propose Fair-Race Dimension Aggregation (FRDA), which has generations compete within each dimension separately to mitigate rubric imbalance, and Residual Semantic Dimension Completion (RSDC), which mines evaluation dimensions implicitly encoded in a holistic preference signal to complete rubric coverage. Experiments in chat, science, and medical domains indicate that FRDA mitigates rubric hacking with more stable improvements, while RSDC outperforms both single-reward training and naive multi-reward aggregation, yielding generally higher-quality responses.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示基于评分标准（rubric）强化学习中的“评分标准内奖励分歧”现象，并提出FRDA与RSDC两种方法缓解rubric hacking，提升训练稳定性与回答质量。
AI.motivation: rubric hacking同时损害基于rubric的强化学习的性能与训练鲁棒性：模型为优化聚合总分而牺牲某些子维度质量，导致奖励与真实质量脱节。
AI.method: 将rubric分解为子维度揭示“Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence”，并归纳为维度不平衡（dimension imbalance，策略偏向覆盖充分的维度）与维度缺失（dimension absence，奖励与真实质量存在系统性偏差）两类现象；据此提出FRDA（Fair-Race Dimension Aggregation，在每个维度内单独进行生成竞争以缓解rubric不平衡）与RSDC（Residual Semantic Dimension Completion，从整体偏好信号中挖掘隐含的评价维度以补全rubric覆盖）。
AI.result: 在chat、科学、医学领域实验中，FRDA缓解rubric hacking且提升更稳定；RSDC优于单一奖励训练与朴素多奖励聚合，产生整体更高质量的回答。
AI.conclusion: 子维度视角可有效诊断rubric hacking的成因，基于维度公平竞争与语义补全的两项设计能够提升rubric-based RL的鲁棒性与输出质量。

title: Parallel Language Models via Variational Decoding
summary: Autoregressive language models emit one token per forward pass. This causes high inference latency, in particular as models are scaled up for quality. In this paper, we introduce Parallel Language Models (PLMs), which generate mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass by routing dependencies through latent auxiliary variables. PLMs are trained using a variational bound that reduces to an autoregressive loss plus a parallel decoding loss. Empirically, PLMs are on a faster and better Pareto frontier than autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. Pretrained PLMs achieve near-autoregressive pretraining loss on model scales of 80M to 3B parameters, and speedup follows a power law in model size. When post-trained, our 1.3B model matches or exceeds an identically trained autoregressive model on math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks, speeding up inference $2.3\text{-}5.7\times$. Together, we show that parallel generation can be trained from a single training objective at autoregressive quality. We will make our code available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm.

AI.tldr: 提出并行语言模型（PLMs），通过潜变量路由依赖，在单次前向中并行生成相互一致的多个token，并以单一变分界训练，实现接近自回归质量且2.3–5.7倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型每次前向仅产生一个token，随模型规模增大用于提升质量时，推理延迟显著升高，成为部署瓶颈。作者希望在不牺牲生成质量的前提下实现并行解码。
AI.method: PLMs在单次前向中生成一组互相一致的token，token间的依赖通过潜辅助变量（latent auxiliary variables）路由；训练采用变分下界目标，该目标可分解为自回归损失加并行解码损失，从而用单一训练目标同时获得自回归式建模与并行生成能力。实验上与自回归和离散扩散基线在速度—质量Pareto前沿上对比。
AI.result: 在80M至3B参数规模上，预训练PLMs的损失接近自回归模型，且加速比随模型规模呈幂律增长；经过后训练，1.3B模型在数学、代码与指令跟随基准上持平或超过同等训练的自回归模型，推理加速2.3–5.7倍；整体处于更优的Pareto前沿。
AI.conclusion: 并行生成可以由单一训练目标训练得到，并达到自回归级别的质量，同时显著降低推理延迟；代码将开源。

title: GeoSplit: Selective Edge--Server Map Acquisition for Cross-User Travel-Mode Recognition
summary: Networked mobility sensing couples local trajectory inference with remote geospatial context, making communication decisions part of the prediction system. We present GeoSplit, an edge--server framework for travel-mode recognition that separates the utility of map evidence, its training-time transfer, and its selective acquisition at runtime. On GeoLife with 10% labels, we evaluate these components under user-day and user-disjoint grouping. For unseen users, aligned full-map context raises macro-F1 from 0.7154 to 0.7864, while map-informed distillation yields a motion-only student at 0.7225. Through a compact query interface, entropy gating achieves 0.7729 macro-F1 versus 0.7738 for all queries, querying 39.5% of trajectories and reducing application payload by 60.5%. Under user-day grouping, selective and all-query scores are similarly close at a 21.6% query rate. Learned value estimation and probability fusion offer no consistent improvement. These results illustrate communication-efficient edge--server inference for an intelligent transportation sensing task.

AI.tldr: GeoSplit 是一个边-云协同的出行方式识别框架，将地图证据的效用、训练期蒸馏迁移与运行时选择性获取解耦；在 GeoLife（10% 标注）上以熵门控查询 39.5% 轨迹即达到接近全查询的 macro-F1，并降低 60.5% 应用层负载。
AI.motivation: 网络化移动感知需要把本地轨迹推断与远端地理空间上下文耦合，使通信决策成为预测系统的一部分。作者希望厘清三个此前混杂的问题：地图证据本身有多大效用、其能否在训练期迁移到仅用运动信息的模型、以及运行时能否按需少量获取地图信息以节省通信。
AI.method: 提出 GeoSplit 边-服务器框架，将系统拆分为三部分：(1) 全图上下文对齐的地图证据效用评估；(2) 地图指导的知识蒸馏，得到仅依赖运动信号的轻量学生模型；(3) 通过紧凑查询接口在推理时以熵门控选择性地向服务器请求地图信息。在 GeoLife 数据集、10% 标注条件下，分别采用 user-day 与 user-disjoint 两种分组方式进行受控对比，并额外考察学习式价值估计与概率融合。
AI.result: 在未见用户（user-disjoint）设定下，对齐的全图上下文将 macro-F1 从 0.7154 提升至 0.7864；地图指导蒸馏使仅用运动特征的学生模型达到 0.7225。熵门控以 0.7729 macro-F1 逼近全查询的 0.7738，仅查询 39.5% 的轨迹并将应用层负载降低 60.5%。user-day 分组下，选择性查询与全查询在 21.6% 查询率时同样接近。学习式价值估计与概率融合未带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明地图证据的收益、其训练期可迁移性以及运行时选择性获取是可分离且可量化的，简单的熵门控即足以实现接近全量信息的精度，而更复杂的价值估计与融合机制并无必要。该工作展示了面向智能交通感知任务的通信高效边-云推理范式。

title: Doubly Robust Learning of Heterogeneous Survival Treatment Effects under Time-Varying Treatments
summary: Estimating heterogeneous survival treatment effects (HSTEs) from time-to-event data under time-varying treatments is important in fields such as medicine (e.g., to decide which sequence of treatments is better in terms of survival probability). However, this task is challenging because treatment decisions, patient characteristics, and censoring probability often evolve together, requiring sequential adjustment for both treatments and censoring. Existing survival learners mostly consider a single baseline treatment assignment, while longitudinal treatment-effect learners typically assume uncensored outcomes. In this paper, we introduce a novel doubly robust learner for heterogeneous survival treatment effects under time-varying treatments and history-dependent censoring. Our framework separates the intervention window from the survival horizon, with treatment prescribed for a finite period, after which care follows its natural course. We further establish the favorable theoretical properties of Neyman-orthogonality, rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency. The framework accommodates flexible machine learning models for nuisance estimation and treatment-effect regression. We evaluate our learners through several numerical experiments, demonstrating their effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出一种双重稳健学习器，用于估计时变治疗与历史依赖删失下的异质生存治疗效果（HSTE），分离干预窗口与生存期，并具备Neyman正交性、速率双重稳健与准神谕效率等理论性质。
AI.motivation: 在医学等领域，需从时变治疗的时间-事件数据中估计异质生存治疗效果，以判断哪种治疗序列在生存概率上更优。然而治疗决策、患者特征与删失概率共同演化，需对治疗与删失进行序贯调整；现有生存学习器多只考虑单一基线治疗分配，而纵向治疗效应学习器通常假设无删失。
AI.method: 构建面向时变治疗与历史依赖删失的新型双重稳健学习器：将干预窗口与生存期分离，治疗仅在有限时段内施加，之后按自然病程随访；框架支持灵活的机器学习模型用于干扰参数估计与治疗效应回归。
AI.result: 理论上建立了Neyman正交性、速率双重稳健性和准神谕效率等良好性质；通过多组数值实验评估学习器，验证其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该双重稳健框架可在时变治疗和历史依赖删失下有效估计异质生存治疗效果，兼具灵活性与理论保证，适用于临床治疗序列决策。

title: Deep Pontryagin Learning for Continuous-Time Stochastic Control with Jumps
summary: We develop a deep Pontryagin learning framework for high-dimensional continuous-time stochastic control problems that naturally accommodates jump-diffusions. In contrast to direct policy optimization, which repeatedly differentiates the objective through the entire time-discretized dynamics, our method separates adjoint learning from policy improvement by explicitly incorporating state-sensitivity information from the Pontryagin stochastic maximum principle. For a fixed Markov control, we first compute pathwise adjoint labels by backpropagating the reward through time along simulated state trajectories, and project these labels onto the Markov state through a supervised regression step. The control is then updated by enforcing the pointwise Hamiltonian stationarity condition. We prove that the resulting projected adjoint process satisfies a discrete-time Pontryagin principle and converges, as the time step tends to zero, to the solution of the corresponding continuous-time adjoint backward stochastic differential equation. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy, stability, and scalability of the approach.

AI.tldr: 提出深度庞特里亚金学习框架，将伴随学习与策略改进分离，用于含跳扩散的高维连续时间随机控制问题。
AI.motivation: 直接策略优化需反复通过整条时间离散化动力学对目标求导，计算代价大且不稳定；希望借助庞特里亚金随机最大值原理中的状态敏感性信息改进求解。
AI.method: 固定马尔可夫控制下，沿模拟状态轨迹将奖励反向传播得到路径级伴随标签，再通过监督回归把这些标签投影到马尔可夫状态上；随后利用逐点哈密顿平稳条件更新控制。
AI.result: 证明所得投影伴随过程满足离散时间庞特里亚金原理，并在时间步趋于零时收敛到相应连续时间伴随倒向随机微分方程的解；数值实验显示方法具有准确性、稳定性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过分离伴随学习与控制更新，为高维连续时间（含跳扩散）随机控制提供了理论有保证且可扩展的求解途径。

title: Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing
summary: Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\log\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation. It applies to transformers whose only positional input is an additive attention bias that eventually becomes constant, including NoPE and a recursive implementation of ALiBi. Once an identical-token run exceeds the resulting saturation threshold, further repetitions leave the logits unchanged. If this threshold grows sublinearly with $N$, these models cannot both complete a long all-identical copy and stop correctly, a pattern resembling the termination errors of frontier LLMs. In synthetic copying experiments, baseline transformer models fail on long repeated strings even within the training range. Trained VO models, by contrast, generalize beyond the training lengths with near-perfect accuracy up to length $\approx 5005$, the selected primes' period product.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Transformer在重复字符串复制任务中的终止与泛化问题，提出基于VO旋转和小素数周期编码的构造性方案，并用不可能性结论解释现有位置编码的失效。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM几乎能完美复制随机文本，却在长重复字符块上过度生成或截断。原因是重复串中局部内容匹配无法确定复制应继续的位置与终止时机，作者希望从理论与构造两方面刻画并解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出两层Transformer构造：采用O(log log N)位数精度与O(log N/log log N)宽度，使用RoPE式注意力value与output旋转（VO-rotations），以小素数周期编码相对分隔符锚点的距离，借助中国剩余定理联合区分所有所需距离，使单一检索规则即可选择下一个源token或结束标记。同时证明在顺序有限精度softmax累加下、仅依赖最终变为常数的加性注意力偏置（含NoPE与递归ALiBi）的宽度无关不可能性结果。
AI.result: 理论上该构造可复制任意长度至设计视界N的字符串并在任意重复下正确终止；不可能性结果指出，当同token连续段超过饱和阈值后重复不再改变logits，若阈值对N次线性增长，则此类模型无法同时完成长全同复制与正确终止。合成实验中基线Transformer即使在训练范围内也在长重复串上失败，而训练后的VO模型可外推到约长度5005（所选素数周期乘积）并接近完美准确率。
AI.conclusion: 周期化位置编码（VO旋转+CRT）为重复串复制与终止提供了可证明可行的机制，而缺乏此类周期性距离信息的有限精度加性偏置位置编码存在根本性局限，这与前沿LLM的终止错误现象相呼应。

title: Cross-Fitting for Neural Posterior Estimation
summary: Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) fits an amortized conditional density estimator to a simulated training set of complete-data realizations. NPE's training objective, log-likelihood, favors posterior approximations that assign arbitrarily high density to the training points, and typical families of amortized conditional density estimators (e.g., normalizing flows, Gaussian encoders) are flexible enough to oblige. The resulting policy of extreme overconfidence translates poorly to held-out data. Early stopping and other regularizers can prevent this degeneracy, but they are limited to selecting posterior approximations along an unfavorable optimization trajectory set by in-sample residuals, where the posterior mean is underfit while the posterior variance is overfit. To avoid this trade-off, we propose Cross-Fitting NPE (CF-NPE), which uses sample splitting to separate conditional-mean estimation from the estimation of the posterior's higher moments. Using $K$-fold cross-fitting, CF-NPE fits $K$ posterior-mean regressors and then fits a conditional density estimator to the resulting out-of-fold residuals. In experiments with synthetic data and in a cosmological application, CF-NPE achieves higher held-out log-likelihood than standard NPE and typically improves calibration. CF-NPE is most useful in high-dimensional, simulation-limited settings.

AI.tldr: 提出CF-NPE，用样本拆分将后验均值估计与高阶矩（方差）估计解耦，缓解NPE因训练目标而导致的过度自信问题，在合成与宇宙学任务上取得更高的held-out对数似然与更好校准。
AI.motivation: NPE以对数似然为目标训练摊销条件密度估计器，该目标偏好对训练点赋予任意高的密度，而归一化流、高斯编码器等估计器族足够灵活,会顺应这一偏好，导致极端过度自信，泛化到held-out数据时表现差。早停等正则化手段只能在由样本内残差决定的、不利的优化轨迹上选取近似解，形成"后验均值欠拟合、后验方差过拟合"的权衡，无法根治。
AI.method: 提出Cross-Fitting NPE（CF-NPE）：利用样本拆分把条件均值估计与后验高阶矩估计分离。采用K折交叉拟合（cross-fitting），先训练K个后验均值回归器，再对产生的out-of-fold残差拟合一个条件密度估计器，从而避免同一数据同时决定均值与散布度。
AI.result: 在合成数据实验与一项宇宙学应用中，CF-NPE的held-out对数似然高于标准NPE，并且通常改善校准（calibration）。
AI.conclusion: CF-NPE通过交叉拟合解耦均值与高阶矩估计，规避了NPE的过拟合—过自信权衡，在数据维度高、模拟预算有限的场景中最有价值。

title: CAVA: Complementary-Label-Aware Data Valuation
summary: Complementary-label learning (CLL) trains a classifier from labels that name a class an instance does not belong to. Such labels are cheap to collect from crowdworkers or vision-language models (VLMs), making them attractive for large-scale annotation. However, both sources can mistakenly assign the true class as the complementary label. Such annotation errors are particularly harmful in CLL because the model is explicitly trained to suppress the correct answer. Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation. We show that this makes the OT label groups noisy mixtures whose behavior depends on the noise rate. The transferred score is informative only at sufficiently high noise, becomes uninformative at the crossover rate $1/M$ for $M$ classes, and reverses below it, where practical CLL annotation typically operates. We propose CAVA, which introduces a complementary label cost and a label margin that isolates the contribution of each complementary label to the transport potential. The margin keeps a consistent direction across noise rates, detects diagonal noise with a parameter-free threshold of closed-form precision, and allows detected samples to be recycled as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random. With only a fraction of the clean validation data, it also improves every CLL objective we evaluate, showing that OT-based valuation becomes reliable once the semantics of complementary supervision are modeled explicitly.

AI.tldr: 提出CAVA，通过引入互补标签代价与标签间隔修正最优传输数据估值在互补标签学习中的语义错配，实现对角噪声检测与样本回收。
AI.motivation: 互补标签可由众包或视觉语言模型廉价获取，但两类来源都可能把真实类别误标为互补标签，而CLL显式抑制正确答案，使这类错误格外有害。直接迁移OT数据估值会因训练与验证集标签语义相反产生错配。
AI.method: 分析表明OT标签组是随噪声率变化的噪声混合：得分仅在噪声足够高时有信息，在交叉率1/M处失效，低于该率则反转。CAVA引入互补标签代价与标签间隔，隔离每个互补标签对传输势的贡献，使其方向在噪声率间保持一致，并以无参数闭式阈值检测对角噪声，检测出的样本可回收为普通标签监督。
AI.result: 在合成与人工标注基准上，CAVA几乎完美分离对角噪声，而直接迁移OT估值劣于随机；仅用部分干净验证数据即可提升所评估的所有CLL目标。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模互补监督语义后，基于OT的数据估值在CLL中变得可靠。

title: recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models
summary: Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensive and prone to memorization. Test-time scaling offers a complementary path, but methods developed for autoregressive LLMs do not transfer directly: masked encoders lack a generation loop, and amino acids do not verbalize in a reasoning language. Instead, we adapt recursive pretraining to masked pLMs, where a weight-tied Transformer core refines residue-aligned hidden states over an adjustable number of cycles. We instantiate this recipe as recAMPLIFY, a pLM with 155M unique parameters trained on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M. Despite 56% fewer parameters, it improves CASP contact recovery and three out of four supervised tasks, notably raising fold accuracy by 22.5%. Because optimal depth for recAMPLIFY varies across tasks and assays, we then introduce Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a framework that decodes each protein from a probability-weighted mixture of hidden states visited during recursion. GMR employs a learned residual gate at scalar, low-rank, or per-dimension resolution to control how much of each cycle's proposed update is accepted into the state. This unifies halting and gating into a single adaptive computation objective while recovering PonderNet-style halting as a special case without gates. Layered on top of recAMPLIFY, GMR further reduces expected layer depth by up to 37%, although the accuracy trade-off varies by task. Mechanistic analyses show that residual gating controls recurrence stability beyond the trained depth and that halt depth tracks biological properties.

AI.tldr: 将递归预训练迁移到掩码蛋白语言模型，提出recAMPLIFY（155M参数，与AMPLIFY-350M同用2T token，参数少56%），并进一步提出门控混合递归GMR，把停机与门控统一为单一自适应计算目标。
AI.motivation: pLM进展主要依赖扩大模型与数据规模，成本高且易记忆化；测试时缩放是有益补充，但自回归LLM的方法无法直接迁移：掩码编码器缺少生成循环，氨基酸也无法用"推理语言"进行言语化表达。
AI.method: 把递归预训练适配到掩码pLM：权重共享的Transformer核心在可调循环次数下反复精化与残基对齐的隐状态，实例化为recAMPLIFY。此后提出Gated Mixture Recurrence（GMR）：以概率加权混合递归过程中访问的隐状态来解码蛋白，采用可学习的残差门（标量、低秩或逐维分辨率）控制每轮候选更新被接纳的程度，将停机与门控统一为单一自适应计算目标，把PonderNet式停机作为无门控特例。
AI.result: recAMPLIFY以少56%参数改进CASP接触恢复及四项监督任务中的三项，折叠准确率提升22.5%。GMR在recAMPLIFY之上使期望层深最多再降37%，但精度权衡因任务而异。机理分析表明残差门控可在训练深度之外控制递归稳定性，停机深度与生物学性质相关。
AI.conclusion: 递归/测试时计算是扩展pLM的一条有效且省参数的替代路径，GMR为深度自适应提供统一框架，并揭示门控与停机具有可解释的生物学与稳定性含义。

title: Trajectory Replay: Continuous-Time Mixture Transport for Lifelong Generative Models
summary: Adapting pre-trained continuous-time generative models to sequentially incoming data without forgetting earlier tasks is a central challenge in lifelong learning. A leading strategy, generative replay, uses a generative model trained on historical tasks to augment its own continual update with synthetic samples from experience. However, it requires full trajectory simulations at every training step, which accumulate discretization errors and can degrade the replayed historical distribution. Here, we propose trajectory replay, which bypasses sample generation by training an updated velocity field to match both a frozen historical velocity along its trajectories and the incoming task's velocity field, weighted by a stability-plasticity coefficient. Through the lens of continuous-time transport, we show the resulting optimum averages the two task velocities by their respective densities and generates the mixture of their probability paths. Combined with mean velocity distillation, trajectory replay accesses historical trajectories using only a few network evaluations per continual update. Empirically, it outperforms generative replay and distillation baselines on class-incremental image generation. In two biological case studies, trajectory replay extends generative perturbation models to new contexts and experimental batches across two data modalities while preserving treatment-effect prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 trajectory replay：不做样本生成，而是让更新后的速度场同时匹配冻结历史速度场沿其轨迹的取值与当前任务速度场，并用平均速度蒸馏降低网络评估次数；在类增量图像生成与两个生物扰动建模案例中优于生成式回放与蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 将预训练连续时间生成模型适配到序贯到达的数据且不遗忘是终身学习的核心难题。主流生成式回放需在每步训练中做完整轨迹模拟，累积离散化误差并可能劣化回放的历史分布。
AI.method: 以连续时间传输为视角，训练新的速度场同时拟合冻结历史速度场沿其轨迹的取值与当前任务速度场，以稳定性-可塑性系数加权；结合平均速度蒸馏，使每次持续更新仅需少量网络评估即可访问历史轨迹。
AI.result: 理论上证明所得最优解按各自密度对两个任务速度做加权平均，并生成二者概率路径的混合；实证上在类增量图像生成中超过生成式回放与蒸馏基线；在两个生物案例中把生成式扰动模型扩展到新情境与新实验批次（跨两种数据模态）且保持处理效应预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹回放以轨迹级匹配替代样本级回放，避免完整仿真带来的误差累积，并在效率与抗遗忘上兼顾，适用于图像生成与生物扰动建模等跨任务、跨批次持续学习场景。

title: Simulation Priors for Rapid Adaptation in Model-Based RL for Autonomous Racing
summary: Reinforcement learning enables learning high-performance control policies, but its reliance on extensive interaction limits deployment on physical systems where data collection is costly, and failures are unsafe. We introduce Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA), an offline-to-online model-based RL framework that uses structured simulation priors for rapid adaptation. PIA pretrains a world model on heterogeneous low- and high-fidelity simulated trajectories, then adapts it with limited target-domain interaction using uncertainty-regularized planning. Rather than requiring an accurate simulator for policy transfer, PIA treats simulated trajectories as biased priors whose residual mismatch is corrected during online adaptation. We evaluate PIA in autonomous racing using high-fidelity simulation and on a real full-size autonomous race car. In simulation, PIA adapts faster across track and surface shifts than strong baselines, achieving lower lap times and fewer failures. On hardware, PIA achieves reliable few-shot adaptation with less than one hour of on-vehicle interaction.

AI.tldr: PIA是一种离线到在线的基于模型强化学习框架，将多保真仿真轨迹作为有偏先验，通过不确定性正则化规划在目标域少量交互中快速校正残差偏差，并在自动驾驶赛车仿真与实车中实现少样本适应。
AI.motivation: RL依赖大量交互，在数据采集昂贵且失败不安全的物理系统上难以部署；同时传统sim-to-real要求高精度仿真器才能迁移策略，这一假设过强。
AI.method: PIA先在异构的低保真与高保真仿真轨迹上预训练世界模型，再用不确定性正则化的规划方法、以有限的目标域交互对世界模型进行在线适应；把仿真轨迹视为有偏先验，在适应过程中校正残余不匹配，而非追求精确仿真器下的策略迁移。
AI.result: 在高保真仿真赛车任务中，PIA在赛道与路面变化下比强基线适应更快，圈时更低、失败更少；在真实全尺寸自动驾驶赛车上，以不足一小时的车上交互实现可靠的少样本适应。
AI.conclusion: 将多保真仿真作为有偏先验并结合不确定性正则化的在线世界模型适应，可有效降低对精确仿真器的依赖与实车交互成本，为安全、数据受限的物理系统提供可行的离线到在线RL路径。

title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
summary: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro

AI.tldr: HarnessPro：无需标签、以「性能–成本」双目标进化智能体 harness，并输出 lite/medium/heavy 三档 harness 供不同预算部署。
AI.motivation: 现有通过递归自我改进（RSI）提升 harness 的方法虽能涨点，但执行成本随之升高，缺乏在提升任务表现的同时控制成本的手段。
AI.method: 标签无关（label-free）进化流程：用 LLM 生成的测试评估候选 harness，不接触真值解与官方测试；专用智能体诊断执行轨迹，按不同「性能–成本」优先级规划更新并实现为候选 harness；用归一化加权平方距离选择（normalized weighted squared distance selection）同时产出成本导向（lite）、均衡（medium）、性能导向（heavy）三档 harness；入选 harness 进入下一轮迭代，由执行反馈指导更新。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-Bench Pro、ProgramBench 上评测，使用 GPT-5.5+Codex 与 GLM-5.2+Claude Code 两种配置。GPT-5.5+Codex 下 heavy 模式相对 RHO 平均通过率提升 2.0 个百分点，平均单任务成本下降 26.1%；GLM-5.2+Claude Code 下该优势同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 以多目标（性能+成本）方式进化 harness 并显式提供多档 Pareto 式方案，可在无真值监督条件下同时获得性能提升与显著降本，且跨模型/框架组合具备可迁移性。

title: Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility: A Theoretical Framework for Multi-Agent Task Obstructions
summary: Multi-agent systems can differ under identical agents and communication budgets when they support different forms of joint interaction. We introduce Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility (TSI), a sheaf-theoretic framework separating task-level compatibility obstructions from system capability. A task is represented by an interaction complex $K$ and a capacity sheaf $\mathcal{F}$; nonzero $H^n(K;\mathcal{F})$ defines a structural signature, while registered interventions test capability. For cocycle data, cochain realization is solvable exactly when the represented cohomology class vanishes. Examples show that the signature is sheaf-relative, and the degree-1 reduction yields cycle-space witnesses and observation requirements. We evaluate two finite one-round models. Across 15,625 degree-1 inputs, an all-agent additive primitive solves decision and repair exactly; the optimal pairwise system reaches 88.80% on decision, one input above the 88.79% majority-class baseline, and 26.63% on repair. On a degree-2 tetrahedral-boundary task over 531,441 inputs, the same-2-skeleton system retains all four three-agent primitives yet matches the pairwise-only optimum throughout the registered separation window, whereas adding the class-filling four-agent primitive makes both tasks exact. Status-preserving robustness checks retain exact performance but are not cost-matched to the class-restoring ablation. Conditional on the registered primitives and cost models, TSI provides task-relative, falsifiable tests of higher-order interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出拓扑不可约层（TSI）框架，用层论将任务级兼容性障碍与系统能力分离，并以有限实验验证高阶交互的可证伪判定。
AI.motivation: 相同智能体与相同通信预算下，多智能体系统的联合交互形式不同会导致性能差异，现有分析缺少区分"任务结构性障碍"与"系统能力不足"的形式化工具。
AI.method: 以交互复形 K 与容量层 F 表示任务，用非零上同调 H^n(K;F) 作为结构签名；用注册干预测试能力；当且仅当所表示的上同调类消失时，上链实现可精确求解。度数-1 情形给出循环空间见证与观测需求；并评估两个单轮有限模型（全智能体加性原语 vs 最优成对系统；2-骨架系统 vs 类填充四体原语）。
AI.result: 度-1 任务 15,625 个输入：全智能体加性原语在决策与修复上均精确；最优成对系统决策 88.80%（仅比 88.79% 多数类基线高一个输入），修复 26.63%。度-2 四面体边界任务 531,441 个输入：2-骨架系统保留全部四个三体原语，却在注册分离窗口内与仅成对最优持平；加入类填充四体原语后两任务均精确。保状态稳健性检查保持精确性能，但与恢复类的消融未做成本匹配。
AI.conclusion: 在注册原语与成本模型条件下，TSI 提供任务相对、可证伪的高阶交互检验；结构签名为层相对量，度-1 约化可给出循环见证与观测需求。

title: Training with ML-labeled Data via Stochastic First- and Zeroth-Order Optimization
summary: Training a machine learning (ML) model is an optimization process that typically requires a set of examples with ground-truth labels beforehand. Obtaining these ground truths usually requires laborious human effort and can be costly. The scalability of human labeling becomes a concern when there are a large number of data points that need to be labeled. To address this practical issue, we consider an optimization setting where a subset of samples has ground-truth labels, while the remaining data points were labeled by an ML predictor, which could potentially assign incorrect labels to those points. We propose both first-order and zeroth-order stochastic optimization methods for training on datasets consisting of a mix of true-labeled and ML-labeled samples. We further conduct comprehensive empirical studies from training a linear regression model to fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) to showcase the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms for training with ML-labeled data.

AI.tldr: 论文考虑部分样本带真实标签、其余样本由ML预测器标注（可能含错标）的优化设定，提出一阶与零阶随机优化方法来训练此类混合标注数据集，并通过从线性回归到LLM微调的实验验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 获取真实标签需耗费大量人力且成本高昂，数据规模大时人工标注的可扩展性受限；因此需研究在仅少量真标签、其余由ML预测器标注（含潜在错误）条件下的模型训练优化问题。
AI.method: 将训练数据建模为真标签样本与ML标注样本的混合，并针对该设定分别设计一阶和零阶的随机优化算法。
AI.result: 开展较全面的实证研究，覆盖从线性回归模型训练到大型语言模型（LLM）微调，验证所提算法在ML标注数据上训练的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的一阶与零阶随机优化方法能够有效支撑混合真标签与ML标注数据的模型训练，在实际场景中具有可行性与实用价值。

title: On Data Scaling in Tabular ML: More Data, Better Generalization?
summary: Recent work in tabular machine learning has emphasized the importance of diverse and realistic evaluation settings. The niche of large-scale (1M+) data, however, remains under-explored. To study training-data scaling, we assemble eight real-world tabular datasets with up to around ten million training examples, retaining the natural distribution shifts of the tasks and using random-split evaluation as a control. We find that GBDTs and MLP-based models show broadly similar scaling trends, with gains from both additional training data and algorithmic improvements. Tabular foundation models show more varied scaling behavior, with recent versions benefiting more consistently from larger contexts even under distribution shift. However, scaling training data under distribution shift introduces new challenges: in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance mostly improve together at smaller scales but can diverge at larger scales. We examine this through MLP capacity sweeps and comparisons of the validation distributions used for tuning and early stopping in MLPs and GBDTs. We also compare common practices of using validation data, contrasting its use for model selection in MLP pipelines with using it for in-context fitting in tabular foundation model pipelines. Under stronger shifts, MLPs selected using validation representative of the evaluation conditions generally maintain or improve performance as training data grows. In contrast, including such examples in context improves foundation-model performance, but does not prevent deterioration with increasing training size in our experiments.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建八个百万级真实表格数据集（最多约千万训练样本），系统研究大规模表格学习中的数据规模扩展规律，发现GBDT与MLP扩展趋势相近，而表格基础模型行为更多样；并揭示分布偏移下训练数据扩大会导致ID与OOD性能在大规模时出现分化。
AI.motivation: 表格机器学习领域重视多样、真实的评估设置，但大规模（1M+）数据这一细分方向仍缺乏研究；同时训练数据扩展在分布偏移下的行为尚不清楚，需要可控的真实基准来考察扩展趋势与调优/验证实践的影响。
AI.method: 汇集八个保留任务自然分布偏移的真实表格数据集（最多约千万训练样本），并以随机划分评估作为对照；比较GBDT、MLP类模型与表格基础模型的扩展趋势；通过MLP容量扫描以及MLP与GBDT所用验证/早停分布的对比，分析ID与OOD性能分化；并对比MLP流水线中用验证集做模型选择与基础模型流水线中做上下文拟合（in-context fitting）两种实践。
AI.result: GBDT与MLP扩展趋势大体相似，额外训练数据与算法改进均带来收益；表格基础模型扩展行为更不一致，较新版本在更大上下文下更稳定受益，即便存在分布偏移。训练数据扩展引入新问题：小规模时ID与OOD性能多同步提升，大规模时可出现分化。较强偏移下，用以代表评估条件的验证集进行选择的MLP通常随训练数据增长保持或提升性能；而将此类样本纳入上下文虽能改善基础模型性能，却未能阻止其在训练规模增大时的性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 大规模表格学习的数据扩展并非单调改善OOD表现，验证集分布选择与模型流水线设计（模型选择 vs. 上下文拟合）对分布偏移下的扩展行为具有关键影响，需要更贴近评估条件的验证策略。

title: Two hidden layer suffice: the caterpillar net
comment: 17 pages. Lean formalization and paper sources: https://github.com/JayPiZimmermann/Max_Caterpillar
summary: Every continuous piecewise linear (CPWL) function is a finite signed sum of maxima of affine functions, making maximum representation a central problem in the study of the expressiveness of ReLU networks. A now-disproved conjecture predicted logarithmic depth for maxima. Inspired by the proof by Brunck et al. (2026) that two hidden layers suffice for general CPWL functions, we give the Caterpillar Net, a nonrecursive construction for the maximum of $N$ inputs with two hidden layers of widths $O(N^2)$ and $2^{O(N\log N)}$. The construction has a direct geometric interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Caterpillar Net"，用两个隐藏层、宽度 $O(N^2)$ 与 $2^{O(N\log N)}$ 的非递归结构，实现对 $N$ 个输入的最大值表示，并给出几何解释。
AI.motivation: 连续分段线性（CPWL）函数可写成仿射函数极大值的有限符号和，因此"极大值表示"是研究 ReLU 网络表达力的核心问题。此前关于极大值需对数深度的猜想已被推翻，而 Brunck 等人（2026）证明一般 CPWL 函数两层隐藏层足够，本文受此启发，构造显式的极大值网络。
AI.method: 提出 Caterpillar Net：一种非递归构造，用两个隐藏层表示 $N$ 个输入的极大值，第一层宽度为 $O(N^2)$，第二层宽度为 $2^{O(N\log N)}$；构造具有直接的几何解释。
AI.result: 给出 $N$ 输入极大值的两层隐藏层显式网络，宽度分别为 $O(N^2)$ 和 $2^{O(N\log N)}$，且为非递归实现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为"两层隐藏层足以表达 CPWL 函数"提供了具体的构造性实例，将抽象存在性结果细化为显式、具几何直觉的网络结构，有助于理解 ReLU 网络的深度-宽度权衡。

title: Learning to Refer: Inference-Time Collaboration in Decentralized Federated Learning
summary: In decentralized federated learning, heterogeneous clients may develop complementary expertise, yet each query is typically evaluated only by the client where it arrives. To exploit this distributed expertise without global coordination, we formulate inference-time collaboration as budgeted local expert referral, a graph-constrained routing process in which a query can move only between neighboring clients and only visited clients contribute to its final prediction. EdgeDRM implements this framework by learning a density-based routing potential for each client: differences between neighboring potentials provide the comparisons used to select successive referrals, while local task models generate predictions that are aggregated along the resulting route. Both training and inference are decentralized, using only neighbor-local information without a central router or graph-wide client scoring. We establish estimation guarantees for the learned comparisons and characterize how local improvement and graph structure govern prior-weighted density gains from referral. Experiments on benchmark and real-world medical data show that EdgeDRM outperforms graph-matched decentralized baselines in most settings, with the clearest benefits under sparse connectivity.

AI.tldr: EdgeDRM 将去中心化联邦学习中的推理期协作建模为“有预算的本地专家转诊”问题——受图约束的路由过程：查询只能在相邻客户端间迁移，仅被访问客户端贡献预测。方法为每个客户端学习基于密度的路由势函数，用邻居势差做比较以选择下一跳，再沿路径聚合本地任务模型输出；训练与推理均去中心化，仅用邻居局部信息。理论给出比较估计保证，并刻画局部改进与图结构如何决定转诊带来的先验加权密度增益。实验在基准与真实医疗数据上多数设置优于图匹配的去中心化基线，稀疏连通下优势最明显。
AI.motivation: 去中心化联邦学习中异构客户端可形成互补专长，但查询通常只由接收它的客户端单独评估，导致分布式专长未被利用。若引入全局协调又违背去中心化原则，因此需要一种无需中心路由器、无需全局客户端评分的本地协作机制。
AI.method: 提出 EdgeDRM：为每个客户端学习基于密度的路由势（density-based routing potential）；以相邻客户端势差作为比较信号选择连续转诊，形成受图约束且有预算的路由；沿最终路径聚合本地任务模型的预测。训练与推理均只用邻居局部信息，完全去中心化，无中心路由器。理论上建立所学比较的估计保证，并分析局部改进与图结构对先验加权密度增益的支配关系。
AI.result: 在基准数据集与真实医疗数据上，EdgeDRM 在大多数设置下优于图匹配的去中心化基线；在稀疏连通（稀疏图）条件下收益最为显著。理论部分给出了路由比较的估计保证，并量化了局部改进与图结构对转诊增益的影响。
AI.conclusion: 推理期协作可形式化为图约束的本地专家转诊，仅凭邻居局部信息即可实现有效路由与预测聚合；稀疏图下转诊收益最大，表明该机制适合通信受限的去中心化部署。局限在于收益依赖图结构与局部改进程度，稀疏图中的路由预算与势函数估计质量可能成为瓶颈。

title: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
comment: 38 pages, 13 figures, 20 tables. Code available at https://github.com/zfying/brain-lora
summary: Brain encoding models aim to predict neural responses to stimuli. The most widely used approach fits readouts from frozen pretrained backbones. Using neural data to train large models from scratch or fully fine-tune them after task-pretraining has proven difficult because neural data is costly and limited. We show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables us to effectively adapt very large pretrained backbones for brain encoding with a small number of trainable parameters. To make it computationally practical, we exploit the backbone's causal structure to predict multiple timepoints in a single pass instead of using sliding windows, significantly reducing feature-extraction cost. This enables efficient fine-tuning of multimodal backbones with up to 104B parameters, the largest model adapted for brain encoding to our knowledge. Trained with a low-rank adapter (LoRA) and a lightweight readout, our approach consistently improves brain encoding performance across nine diverse multimodal backbones. On the same Qwen3-Omni backbone as the prior state-of-the-art (SoTA), our method BrainLoRA achieves the best published performance on the Algonauts 2025 Challenge. We also show the adapted multimodal backbones remain interpretable: modality attribution recovers the canonical sensory topography that prior work often obtains by construction from separate unimodal encoders, and neural adaptation increases the contribution of audio inputs and cross-modal mixing within the backbone. To scale out the number of adapted models, we develop a multi-LoRA kernel that accelerates joint training of multiple LoRAs on a shared backbone. This enables an ensemble of 200+ adapted models that ranks first on the public Algonauts post-challenge leaderboard at the time of writing. Together, our results highlight PEFT as an efficient and powerful paradigm for brain encoding.

AI.tldr: 提出用参数高效微调(PEFT)适配超大预训练多模态骨干网络做大脑编码：利用骨干因果结构单次前向预测多时间点以降低特征抽取成本，用LoRA+轻量readout适配最大104B参数模型，并在Algonauts 2025挑战赛上取得最优成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有大脑编码主流做法是在冻结的预训练骨干上训练线性读出，而用神经数据从头训练或全参数微调大模型代价高且数据稀缺；需要一种在有限神经数据下高效适配超大骨干的范式。
AI.method: 1) 采用参数高效微调(PEFT)替代冻结骨干+readout；2) 利用骨干因果结构一次前向预测多个时间点，替代滑窗，显著降低特征抽取计算量；3) 低秩适配(LoRA)加轻量readout，可训练参数极少；4) 提出multi-LoRA kernel加速共享骨干上多个LoRA的联合训练，用于构建集成。
AI.result: 在9个多模态骨干上一致提升编码性能；在与此前SoTA相同的Qwen3-Omni骨干上，BrainLoRA取得Algonauts 2025挑战赛最佳公开成绩；成功适配至104B参数规模；可解释性分析显示模态归因恢复经典感觉地形图（此前需靠分离的单模态编码器构造得到），且神经适配提升了音频输入与跨模态混合的贡献；200+适配模型集成在公开post-challenge榜单排名第一。
AI.conclusion: PEFT是高效且强有力的大脑编码范式，可在有限神经数据下把超大预训练多模态骨干转化为高性能、可解释的编码模型，并通过多LoRA并行训练规模化集成。

title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
summary: We propose KronLSTM, a linear attention architecture based on the Kronecker Delta Rule, a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. KronLSTM extends the xLSTM family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. This minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates, making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling.
