The resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a Markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution, while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. Hence, KronLSTM ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. Experiments show that KronLSTM is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing linear attention architectures, including models of the (Gated) DeltaNet family, with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. These results establish the Kronecker Delta Rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. Our code (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) and models (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) are open-source.

AI.tldr: 提出 KronLSTM：基于 Kronecker Delta Rule 的线性注意力架构，以"最小侵入"的矩阵记忆修正机制实现稳定、可解析的联想记忆，在长上下文任务上具竞争力。
AI.motivation: Delta-rule 式记忆更新在修正某一关联时会扰动已存储的其它信息，干扰较大；同时记忆状态常需额外的归一化与稳定化机制。作者希望找到一种干扰更小、且无需额外稳定化即可保持有界记忆动态的更新规则，以适用于长上下文语言建模。
AI.method: 1) 定义 Kronecker Delta Rule 作为关联矩阵记忆的新型更新规则：修正目标关联时仅在矩阵空间的单一方向上修改记忆，实现最小侵入式修订；2) 将其嵌入 xLSTM 家族，构建 KronLSTM 线性注意力架构；3) 理论上将记忆动态刻画为收敛到稳态分布的马尔可夫链，并证明记忆矩阵的期望范数在整条输入序列上一致有界。
AI.result: 理论层面：记忆动态具马尔可夫链收敛性与范数一致有界性，无需额外的记忆状态归一化/稳定化机制。实验层面：KronLSTM 与现有线性注意力架构（含 Gated/DeltaNet 系列）相当且常优于它们，在长上下文基准上表现尤为突出。代码与模型均已开源。
AI.conclusion: Kronecker Delta Rule 可作为循环线性注意力中稳定联想记忆的有效且可解析的基础；KronLSTM 提供了低干扰、内在稳定的记忆修订范式。

title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
comment: 24 pages, 14 figures, 12 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.

AI.tldr: WeAct 将能力专用的 LoRA 适配器选择纳入智能体动作空间，通过原生工具调用接口在执行中动态组合能力，缓解长程智能体的灾难性遗忘，并在八项深度研究基准上显著优于全量微调与静态适配器合并方法。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体的轨迹交织了异构能力需求：更新共享参数学习新能力会遗忘旧能力（灾难性遗忘）；而轨迹不同阶段所需能力不同，传统联合训练与静态适配器合并却在整个执行过程中保持固定参数配置，无法按需切换。
AI.method: 在冻结主干上独立训练各能力专属的 LoRA 适配器，并将“适配器选择”加入智能体动作空间，形成权重级内部动作（Weight-level Internal Actions）；这些内部动作借助模型原生工具调用接口，在共享上下文中实现按需的能力组合，并支持仅新增/更新单个适配器的模块化持续适配。
AI.result: 在八个深度研究基准上，Qwen3-32B 配 WeAct 相比全量微调平均准确率提升 6.2%（且算力更少），相比最强静态 LoRA 合并方法提升 27.5%；通过新增代码计算适配器扩展能力、更新写作适配器提升报告质量，主干与其他适配器保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 将能力选择动态化、模块化到权重层面的内部动作，可在低算力下兼顾多能力学习与抗遗忘，并实现智能体的模块化持续适配。

title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
summary: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon

AI.tldr: 提出Halcyon系列早期融合多模态自回归模型，完全从头在GPIC（1亿图文对）上预训练，无需语言预训练即可实现强T2I生成，且预训练算力大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I系统普遍依赖互联网规模的语言预训练来获得文本条件生成能力，作者质疑语言预训练对强T2I生成是否必要。
AI.method: 构建GPIC数据集（100M图文对）；设计早期融合的多模态自回归模型Halcyon（0.52B与1.6B），从零开始预训练；通过受控实验检验纯文本预训练的贡献；并用I2T监督替代caption dropout。
AI.result: Halcyon-0.52B以gFD 48.0优于LlamaGen-XL/8的63.3，预训练算力少18.2倍；Halcyon-1.6B以35.3优于JiT-T2I-XXL/8++的41.0，算力少275倍。受控实验表明纯文本预训练并不提升T2I生成；I2T监督可赋予图像描述能力且保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 强T2I系统可完全从头训练，无需互联网规模语言预训练；语言预训练并非T2I性能的必要条件。
